title: Senior IT Operations Engineer
description:
**ABOUT DIGITAL.AI**

Digital.ai is the only AI-powered software delivery platform purpose-built for the enterprise, enabling the world’s largest organizations to build, test, secure, and deliver high-quality software. By unifying

AI-driven insights, automation, and security across the software development lifecycle, Digital.ai empowers enterprises to deliver innovation with confidence. Trusted by 5,000 global enterprises, Digital.ai is redefining how enterprises build better software in an AI-driven world. Additional information about Digital.ai can be found at digital.ai and on Twitter, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Our space and our audience:

We help our customers innovate and transition to cloud and modern architectures, deliver strong developer experience while maintaining security and control with platform engineering capabilities, develop quality and secure mobile apps, and leverage and manage AI in the SDLC. Our global clients lead their industries as innovators in digitization across financial services, retail, telco, public services, technology, manufacturing, transportation, and energy with our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. We currently serve:

* Over 50% of Fortune 100 companies
* 8 of 10 top banks
* 5 of 10 largest gaming companies
* 5 of 10 global airlines
* Over 50 worldwide government entities

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer with about three years of hands-on experience to manage the Apple and Windows fleet that our global workforce depends on. You will run Microsoft 365 and endpoint management day to day, handle device purchasing across regions, and support colleagues in many time zones.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and availability of production systems and services
* Troubleshoot and help resolve technical issues related to infrastructure, networks, and applications
* Support office/IT equipment management, including purchasing, installations, and software updates
* Assist in maintaining performance standards (SLAs) and metrics reporting to support data-driven decisions
* Own day-to-day support for macOS, Windows, and mobile endpoints, from triage through resolution
* Administer Office 365 and Azure, including Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Entra ID (Azure AD) identities, licensing, and account lifecycle
* Build, deploy, and maintain device policies and app packages in Microsoft Intune
* Manage Apple devices through Iru, covering enrollment, configuration profiles, patching, and compliance
* Run device procurement for both global and local purchases, including vendor coordination, specifications, staging, and asset tracking
* Provide support to colleagues across regions and time zones, with clear communication and follow-through
* Work in night shift coverage for global support, independently resolving issues that arise from U.S. based employees during their standard working hours
* Troubleshoot basic networking issues such as DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, and Firewall
* Support Linux systems, Windows systems and Windows Server components at a basic level, including user, group, and service administration
* Document procedures, keep the knowledge base current, and help improve the onboarding and offboarding process

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CCNA, AWS, or MCSE
* Basic Linux administration skills
* Experience with global or multi-region device procurement
* Experience supporting a distributed workforce across several countries
* Scripting for automation, such as PowerShell or shell
* Experience in a remote IT environment and supporting distributed team members in the U.S.

**SKILLS AT A GLANCE**

Microsoft 365, Office 365, Azure, Intune, Iru, macOS, Windows, Linux, Windows Server, Networking, Global procurement, Asset management

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Flexible working hours and an informal work environment, on-site or remote
* Paid Time Off (PTO) program plus recognized holidays
* Unlimited access to continuous learning and professional development with TalentLMS
* Mentorship and dedicated learning time
* Team building and other unifying events
* Opportunity to work with a diverse, globally distributed team

**Why Digital.ai?**

At Digital.ai, we’re more than just a software company — we’re a team of innovators, thinkers, and problem-solvers. By joining our sales organization, you’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative environment that encourages professional growth and values diverse perspectives. You’ll work with some of the brightest minds in the industry, all while having the opportunity to shape the future of AI-enabled enterprise software development.

If you're ready to take your sales career to the next level and make a real impact with a leading tech company, we want to hear from you.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Digital.ai is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We maintain compliance with federal, state, and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination on the basis of age, race, color, gender, identity, gender expression, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, religion, physical or mental ability, medical condition, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship status, protected military or veteran status, and all other protected classifications. We welcome everyone and believe that diversity is the foundation of innovation. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please advise us within your job application or cover letter.

FRAUD PREVENTION ALERT

Please note that Digital.ai does not use third-party recruiters. In an effort to protect you against possible impersonation, please verify the sender’s email address, and if you are contacted by an unfamiliar or third party requesting personal or financial information on Digital.ai’s behalf, please reach out directly to Digital.ai to confirm.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Adnova**

Adnova is a creative workflow and ad operations platform used by 5000+ DTC brands and performance marketing agencies, mostly in the US and UK. Our products, including Creative Analytics, Ad Launcher, Inspo and Creative Hub, plug into ad accounts and help teams find winning ads, launch faster and research competitors. We’re bootstrapped and profitable.

**The role**

We’re hiring someone to own it end to end. You’ll be the person customers rely on when something breaks, and the person engineering trusts to only escalate what’s actually a bug.

**What you’ll do**

* Own technical support across Slack Connect channels, Intercom and email, with clear response and resolution times
* Debug issues yourself: check logs, inspect API responses, query the database, reproduce bugs, and find the root cause before escalating
* Troubleshoot Meta integrations: ad account connections, permissions, token expiry, Business Manager setup, and data sync gaps
* Write clean Jira tickets for real bugs, with steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behaviour, and impact, then follow up until they’re fixed
* Spot recurring issues and push for fixes, so the same ticket doesn’t come up 20 times
* Build and maintain help docs, macros and saved replies
* Help set up support automation and AI-assisted replies
* Run onboarding and troubleshooting calls with customers when needed
* Help customers using our API and MCP server

**What we’re looking for**

* 2–4 years in technical support, support engineering or QA at a SaaS company
* Comfort with REST APIs, JSON, browser dev tools and reading logs
* Basic SQL or MongoDB querying
* An understanding of how web apps work: auth, OAuth, webhooks, and frontend vs. backend issues
* Clear, calm written English for US/UK customers. You can explain a technical problem to a non-technical marketer
* Ownership. You close the loop and don’t just pass tickets along
* Willingness to work hours that overlap with US/UK customers

**Bonus**

* Experience with the Meta Ads API, Business Manager, or any ad tech or martech product
* Scripting in Python or JavaScript for quick checks and automations
* Experience with Pylon, Intercom, Jira or similar tools
* Experience writing help-centre documentation

**Why join**

* Take full ownership of support at a fast-growing, profitable SaaS company
* Work directly with the CTO and founder, with real influence over the product
* A clear path to Support Lead as the team grows
* Competitive salary based on experience

title: NOC Engineer
description:
**Navalur, Chennai | Full-Time | On-site**
**Company Description**
We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Associate Systems Engineer to join our dynamic IT infrastructure team. If you're someone who loves solving problems, is eager to learn, and wants to build a solid career in systems and infrastructure - this is a great place to start. This role will be instrumental in maintaining and enhancing our server, workstation, and cloud environments while ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across our systems.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities For System Engineer**

* Assist in installing, configuring, and maintaining Windows and Linux server operating systems
* Support Active Directory management including accounts, permissions, and policies
* Help in setting up and maintaining DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing services
* Learn and assist in workstation/laptop deployment, patching, and updates
* Participate in monitoring system health and performance, and provide first-level IT help desk support to end users resolving hardware, software, and connectivity issues promptly
* Work with the team to troubleshoot issues related to hardware, drivers, or operating systems and escalate complex cases with proper documentation
* Manage and track user requests and incidents through the ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution and a smooth end-user experience
* Support the scheduling and application of security patches, backups, and updates
* Manage Microsoft 365 services including user accounts, email configurations, license assignments, and security policies to ensure secure and uninterrupted business operations
* Troubleshoot M365-related issues across Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
* Learn about virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V and assist in managing virtual machines
* Contribute to system hardening and security monitoring with guidance
* Assist in writing and maintaining simple automation scripts (PowerShell, Bash) for routine tasks
* Help document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps
* Collaborate with teams across networking, storage, and security for daily operations

**Requirements**

* B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* 0–2 years of experience or internship in system administration, IT helpdesk, or IT infrastructure is preferable
* Basic understanding or exposure to Windows/Linux server operating systems
* Hands-on or working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and email security is preferred
* Eagerness to learn about Active Directory, networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, IP), and system security
* Interest in virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V) or cloud integration is a plus
* Familiarity with scripting tools such as PowerShell or Bash is an added advantage
* ITIL Foundation certification is a good to have
* Good communication skills for working in a team environment
* Ability to follow workflows and take guidance from senior engineers
* Strong curiosity and willingness to build a career in systems and infrastructure engineering

Skills: bash,cloud,infrastructure,email,hyper-v,active directory,it,security

title: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Responsible for the operation of production environments, including systems and databases, supporting critical business operations. Will perform administration and analysis for multiple production environments and recommend new and novel solutions to improve availability, performance, and supportability. This is an opportunity to bring a combination of deep technical knowledge with administration/analysis knowledge of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure to provide escalation support to a wide range of complex production environment problems related to immense growth, scaling, leveraging the cloud, extremely high performance, and high availability requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize all production server hardware and software. Provide escalated technical support for complex technical issues which may include leading problem management cases and providing management status. Coordinate escalated support cases and lead appropriate internal technical resources and/or third party vendors to resolution and coordinate a storage infrastructure of Oracle system and database appliances. Responsible for Oracle production environments; assist with server operating system and application upgrades, bug fixes, and patching; and work on standardization projects for both hardware and software under the Oracle technology stack while providing consistent system uptime as expected in a Cloud environment. Provide on-call support, on a rotating basis.

Career Level - IC3

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. description:
**”Accelerating business to improve the lives of people”. This is our purpose statement and encapsulates what we enthusiastically do every day. We integrate our customers’ IT systems to make sure that the right data is at the right place at the right time when they digitalize their processes. Companies need their systems to talk to each other to ensure that cars roll off the factory line, that everyone receives their payments on time, and that you can buy what you need from a supermarket.**
**Our success story began in 1986, when we helped the German automotive industry to digitalize their paper-based supply chains. Today, SEEBURGER is a leading global B2B software provider with more than 1,000 #businessaccelerators in 15 countries worldwide and over 10,000 satisfied customers that rely on our innovative solutions.**
SEEBURGER India Private Limited
  
  
CONSULTANT
  
  
**Job Description Your Role In Seeburger**
The need for integration is continuously growing. You, as a SEEBURGER Application Support/The Middleware Administrator (Senior) requires self-motivation and technical proficiency in the SEEBURGER administration and configuration of server and Clients including effective troubleshooting abilities. Overall responsibility for performance, availability, and scalability of the infrastructure. Customer satisfaction is our core value proposition.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities**
Your main task is the Application support for our Business Integration Suite. This includes classic product support as well as operational and monitoring responsibilities within the scope of SEEBURGER Remote Services. \
  
  

* Excellent understanding of the internet protocols TCP/IP, LDAP/LDAPS, SSL/TLS etc.
* Knowledge of L1, L2 and L3 level production support and technical issue resolution for SEEBURGER BIS suite of products or other integration products like Sterling,TIBCO, Software AG, Axway, and Dell Boomi etc.Ensure successful technical operations of the enterprise Managed File Transfer & EDI platforms.

* Certificate generations , setting up user Password encryption settings, Configuration of multi-tier password policies, pgp encryption and ssh keys etc.,
* Proficiency in Application Maintenance & Stability.
* Knowledge in Advanced LDAP concepts, enterprise LDAP deployments.
* Assist in production issue resolution and root cause analysis.
* Knowledge in application deployment.
* Strong Infrastructure knowledge & Problem management skills.
* Review logs for user activity.
* Experience in BIS Monitoring and dashboard.
* Experience in Change Management Process.
* Experience in troubleshooting issues in globally distributed system.
* Solve support cases independently via remote support and if needed together with the 3rd level support.
* You not only correct errors, but also improve the operation of SEEBURGER solutions together with the customer through appropriate problem management.
* In addition to the classic production support and monitoring, as a part of the support team you will assist the customer with software updates, system analysis and projects in the service environment.
* Knowledge on TPM (Trading partner management).
* Reviews system periodically for betterment and identify room for improvement.
* Remains updated regarding EDI and internet field technological developments.
* Should be well versed with common EDI X12 transactions, mapping, end-to-end testing, practices, and procedures within the field.
* You need to solve Data quality issues and Adapter/Connectivity issues.
* Analytical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate clearly and in a timely manner with all customers, partners and users, internal and external.
* Understanding of mission critical enterprise computing environments, customer focus.
* Excellent customer, telephone, oral and written communications skills to effectively interact with customers.
* Strong ethics and professionalism.
* Assisting and helping the colleagues and ramping up the new / junior resources.

**Preferred Qualification.**

* Minimum 7 years’ experience in Seeburger BIS suites.
* Experience with B2B/MFT/API/ESB solutions (TIBCO, Software AG, IBM, Axway, Mulesoft, CA, Apigee, Dell Boomi, Oracle)
* Good understanding and experience in any of the popular Integration software products in the Industry and are willing to continuously upgrade your knowledge.
* Familiarity with message standards like: JSON, XML (SEPA, SWIFT, ISO20022), EDIFACT, X12, TRADACOMS, etc.
* Having experience with industry specific business processes and related message/file formats is a plus.
* Experience on cloud providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
* Proficiency with UNIX, LINUX and Windows platforms connecting to servers via Putty, Tera term and WinSCP, and good to have working knowledge on shell scripting, Perl and JAVA scripting and UNIX commands.
* Good IT knowledge (network, server operating systems, application servers).
* Experience in escalation management, Handling data center issues is a plus.
* Proficiency with database systems (e.g., DB2, Oracle, SQL, and/or Sybase).
* Proficiency with B2B and Monitoring solutions.
* Familiarity with network connectivity and communication protocols (AS2, FTP, SFTP,OFTP, MQ etc..).
* Proficiency with XML and EDI (ANSI X12/EDIFACT).
* Experience with Rosetta-Net and ebXML industry standards.
* Experience with Java and/or REST API.
* Writing technical specifications.
* Knowledge on HPSM, JIRA, Remedy, SNOW, Putty, WinSCP, Filezilla will be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with WebServices, XLST, WSDL, SOAP, REST, BPEL, BPMN, JDeveloper, SoapUI, Jenkins, Ant, Maven, etc.
* Implementation, understanding of, and consulting experience with SOA and EAI.
* Demonstrated experience with High-Availability, performance testing and tuning parameters on multiple engagements.
* Fundamentals in Continuous Integration and Development (CICD) as well Build and Monitoring toolsets.
* Certifications in security, cloud and agile development.
* Experience in incident management as well as good knowledge in dealing with IT service applications.
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly.
* Should have worked extensively on EDI standards, mapping, integration methods, practices, and procedures within the field.
* Experience in Middleware technologies like Websphere, Weblogic, Tomcat, Apache, IIS will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding and experience in any of the popular Integration software products in the Industry and are willing to continuously upgrade your knowledge.
* Ability to pro-actively seek for self-development.
* Flexible, self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure in an international and culturally diverse organization.
* Time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize assigned tasks, problems and requests in a high pressure environment.

**Benefit from being part of a globally renowned company that is driving digitalisation forward. We continue to grow - and so can you! It is important to us that you can fully utilise your talents and strengths and go your own way, regardless of whether you are aiming for a specialist or management career. With our expertise and growth in a future-oriented industry, we offer a wide range of opportunities and secure jobs. At SEEBURGER, we value the supportive atmosphere and family environment. #StrongerTogether is one of our corporate values and characterises the way we live together.**
**Sounds exciting? Become a #Businessaccelerator today!**

title: Operations Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

OEC is in the middle of a multi-year journey to modernise its infrastructure and applications, transforming how we build, deploy, and operate software at global scale. The Operations Specialist (L2) is a core member of the Monitoring Team within the Enterprise Operations Team, responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of OEC’s observability stack, primarily powered by Datadog.

In this role you will own L2 alert triage, incident response, dashboard development, and service onboarding — contributing to the team’s tooling standards and best practices. You will also handle day-to-day server monitoring, infrastructure support, and service management tasks that keep OEC’s global platforms running reliably.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties (essential to the job)**

**Monitoring & alerting**

* Design, configure, and maintain Datadog monitors, composite alerts, and notification channels for production and non-production environments.
* Own the L2 alert triage process — investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated alerts from L1, ensuring timely root cause identification.
* Tune alert thresholds and suppression rules to minimise noise and reduce false positive rates.
* Manage SLO (Service Level Objective) definitions, tracking, and reporting across assigned services.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

**Dashboards & observability**

* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards covering infrastructure health, application performance, log analytics, and business KPIs.
* Configure and manage Datadog APM (Application Performance Monitoring), distributed tracing, and error tracking for key services.
* Implement and manage log ingestion pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based monitors.
* Develop and maintain Synthetic monitors (API and browser tests) for uptime and user experience validation.

**Service onboarding & integrations**

* Onboard new services and infrastructure components into the Datadog monitoring framework in collaboration with DevOps, Cloud, and Engineering teams.
* Configure and maintain Datadog integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Rackspace), Kubernetes, containerised workloads, and third-party tools.
* Support the migration of legacy monitoring tooling (SCOM, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Pingdom, Apigee, Redgate, IDERA) into Datadog.

**Incident response & runbooks**

* Act as L2 escalation point during incidents — perform deep-dive investigations using metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for common alert scenarios, incident response procedures, and post-incident remediation steps.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews, documenting root cause findings and identifying monitoring gaps to prevent recurrence.
* Alerts system owners, stakeholders, and management of degraded system status and Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents; issues tickets for incident and problem escalation.

**AI & automation**

* Leverage Datadog AI capabilities including Watchdog, anomaly detection, outlier detection, and Bits AI to improve proactive issue detection.
* Implement forecast-based monitors for capacity management (CPU, memory, disk).
* Use AI-based alert correlation and deduplication features to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive monitoring tasks using Datadog’s API and scripting tools.

**Standards & governance**

* Adhere to and actively contribute to monitoring standards, tagging strategies, and naming conventions.
* Participate in regular alert quality reviews, dashboard audits, and SLO compliance checks.
* Maintain accurate documentation of monitoring configurations, integrations, and architectural decisions.
* Creates and maintains knowledge articles to be used internally and/or externally for training, best practices, solutions, or processes relating to applications, environments, and related technologies.

**Infrastructure operations & support**

* Analyses and troubleshoots Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations and processes.
* Performs moderately complex database administration.
* Monitors data centre networks, infrastructure bandwidth, application health, servers, and other infrastructure; coordinates and communicates with vendors.
* Diagnoses and researches (using knowledge base) application incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests; provides assistance and guidance to associate operations specialists.
* Adheres to all incident and service request processes and procedures in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Diagnoses, researches, and resolves Level-2 technical hardware and software incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests.
* Works on ad-hoc projects to support Infrastructure Engineering or other departments, as requested.
* Demonstrates a flexible and adaptable approach to work and adjusts to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.
* Collaborates with DevOps, Cloud, and application teams to align monitoring coverage with service requirements.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

**Experience, Skills and Key Competencies**

At least 5+ years of experience in an infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or monitoring engineering role is required, with hands-on experience in Datadog and working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and containerised environments.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on experience with Datadog — monitors, dashboards, APM, log management, SLOs, and synthetic monitoring.
* Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS required; Azure or GCP a plus) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability concepts: metrics, traces, and logs.
* Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of ITSM concepts and ticketing workflows (Jira, JSM, or ServiceNow).
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations, Active Directory, and internet protocols (HTTP, FTP, DNS, IP, SSH).

**Soft skills & competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to produce runbooks and incident summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively across Engineering, DevOps, and Operations disciplines.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they escalate.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to work; able to adjust to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Datadog Fundamentals or Datadog APM certification (or actively working towards one).
* At least 2 year of experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of network monitoring and distributed systems architecture.
* Exposure to ITIL or ITSM frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
* Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, JSM, Confluence) for documentation and ticket management.

**Special Position Requirements**

* Must be able to read, write, understand, and speak fluent English.
* Must be able to work flexible shifts including holidays and weekends, to provide support across locations and time zones.
* Must be able to participate in an on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

title: Lead, PKI & Cert Management
description:
**Job Summary**
Join Standard Chartered Bank's Data Security team as a Lead in PKI and Certificate Management, a pivotal role within our global Cyber Security framework. Data security underpins every facet of our operations, ensuring robust protection against evolving cyber threats and fostering secure growth across more than 70 countries. This role places you at the heart of our digital transformation journey, delivering best-in-class Public Key Infrastructure services that enable our business units to build, deploy, and operate secure applications with confidence. You will collaborate with diverse teams to strengthen the Bank's security posture and support our commitment to maintaining trust and resilience in a rapidly changing cyber landscape. If you are an expert with extensive PKI experience, passionate about driving security innovation and operational excellence, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on a global scale.
  
  
As the Lead for PKI and Certificate Management, you will contribute strategically and technically to safeguard critical information assets, working with a dynamic team dedicated to fostering a secure banking environment. Your expertise will underpin the assurance standards that empower our stakeholders worldwide, ensuring uninterrupted business continuity and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee and manage the Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services infrastructure, maintaining the highest levels of operational integrity for Root CA, Issuing CA, NDES/SCEP, OCSP, and CRL systems.
* Lead initiatives to enhance certificate lifecycle management, proactively identifying opportunities to upgrade toolsets and processes to support cloud, network, endpoint, and database environments.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with business, infrastructure, and security operations teams to architect solutions that enforce robust data protection and regulatory compliance.
* Provide expert technical guidance, advisory support, and incident response leadership to swiftly address and remediate security vulnerabilities within the PKI landscape.
* Design, review, and maintain certificate templates that meet current and anticipated business requirements while aligning with security best practices.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including architecture, policies, operational procedures, and configuration standards to ensure knowledge continuity and audit readiness.
* Conduct periodic PKI health assessments, monitor system performance and capacity, and validate disaster recovery processes to ensure resilient service availability.
* Analyze security incidents and conduct vulnerability assessments, applying risk-based approaches to inform security controls and tolerance decisions.
* Contribute actively to the governance framework, ensuring alignment with risk and audit requirements to uphold the integrity of the Bank’s cybersecurity infrastructure.
* Communicate effectively across all organisational levels, providing clear, concise updates and technical insights to both senior leadership and hands-on practitioners.

**Skills And Experience**
**Core Skills and Experience:**

* A minimum of eight years’ experience in data security with a focus on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate management, demonstrating hands-on expertise.
* Comprehensive knowledge of cryptographic key management principles and hardware security modules (HSM).
* Proven experience administering Microsoft PKI solutions at scale, including Root Certification Authorities, Subordinate CAs, OCSP responders, and certificate revocation infrastructure.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards such as PCI-DSS, alongside practical expertise in tokenization, data masking, and data dispersion techniques.

**Additional Technical Competencies**

* Programming skills in languages such as Java or Python to support automation, integration, and tooling development associated with certificate management.
* Ability to apply security assessment methodologies and perform vulnerability analyses related to encryption and PKI environments.

Demonstrated capacity to work within complex organisational structures and effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders is essential for success in this position.
  
  
**Motivations**
At Standard Chartered, we value individuals who approach their work with integrity and courage, embodying our principle to 'Do the right thing.' We encourage our team members to be resilient agents of change, thinking client-first and embracing continuous innovation. Motivated professionals who seek to uphold ethical standards while driving security excellence thrive in our environment. If you have a passion for contributing meaningfully to a global institution’s security posture and cherish collaborative, principled leadership, this role will offer a fulfilling platform to realise your ambitions.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Experience:**

* Proven experience managing Public Key Infrastructure and cyber security infrastructure components at an enterprise level.
* Relevant professional certifications including Microsoft PKI Specialist, CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), and CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) are highly desirable.

**Language Proficiency**

* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English are required to engage effectively with international teams and document critical security procedures.

Candidates with additional certifications or experience in risk management frameworks and cloud security technologies will be considered favourably.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

description:

The Engineer – Digital & Drawing Management (SPI Administrator) role is part of Shell’s SEAM (Safety, Environment & Asset Management) organization under Technical Asset Support (TAS), which provides centralized technical expertise to support global assets remotely. The position plays a key role in maintaining the quality, accuracy, and integrity of instrumentation engineering data, supporting Shell’s asset management, reliability, and digital transformation objectives. By managing SmartPlant Instrumentation (SPI) databases and associated engineering documentation, the role helps ensure that critical asset information is accessible, standardized, and aligned with business and operational requirements.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role combines instrumentation engineering knowledge with digital data management expertise. Responsibilities include administering and maintaining SPI databases, managing instrument specifications, loop diagrams, and wiring records, as well as ensuring data synchronization across systems such as GSAP, AVEVA AIM-A, SQL, and Digital Twin platforms. The position works closely with engineering, maintenance, and operations teams to support safe and reliable plant performance, making it well suited for candidates with a background in Instrumentation & Control Engineering, oil and gas operations, process industries, and engineering information management.

* Manage SPI database merging, claiming, and transitions into production within site‑specific SLAs.

* Perform routine database cleanup, quality checks, and resolve discrepancies between SPI, SAP, AIM‑A, and Digital Twin.
* Manage SPI user accounts, roles, permissions, and access controls.
* Ensure robust QA/QC processes and support a “First Time Right” quality culture.

title: Technical Support/SKIL Instructor
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
  
  
Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor
  
  
**Role Description**
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you are considered a subject matter expert in NCR Atleos ATM products and act as an advanced level remote support analyst and technical learning instructor. You are part of our support services and learning delivery teams, and your passion for providing exceptional customer service, technical guidance, and effective instruction contributes to our world-class high level of customer satisfaction and associate readiness.
  
  
Acting as second line support to NCR Atleos Field Service Technicians and as an instructor for assigned technical learning programs, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with your focus being finding the right solution for each Field Service Technician, learner, and customer. You connect with Field Service Technicians to address questions and resolve various problems, including uncommon or complex issues, knowing when and who to turn to for additional support. You also facilitate classroom, lab, virtual instructor-led, and online learning experiences that enhance technical capability and improve the overall effectiveness of the business unit/organization.
  
  
You will have a proactive approach and may handle problems before they start by identifying knowledge gaps, improving course content, creating knowledge articles, and feeding live field learning back into training materials and knowledge systems. No matter the situation, your formal training, technical expertise, available knowledge repositories, and adult learning techniques will allow you to provide Field Service Technicians and learners what they need when they need it. Additionally, you will always be on the lookout for preventative measures you can take, escalate issues appropriately, contribute to continuous improvement, and serve as an ambassador for the NCR Atleos brand.
  
  
Your goal is to keep our Field Service Technicians, learners, and customers completely assured and satisfied through your technical expertise, instructional capability, consistent communication, and commitment to quality support and effective learning delivery.
  
  
Position Summary & Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you will provide support to Field Service Engineers who will generally be onsite at a customer location and requiring technical assistance.
  
  
The support will include problem identification, analysis, diagnosis, and resolution.
  
  
You will utilize Knowledge Systems provided by NCR Atleos and other vendors as appropriate to identify solutions to known problems.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that solutions provided are successful, ensuring first time and long-term resolution of the problem.
  
  
If no known solution can be identified, you are responsible for escalation to other support groups where deeper level skilled personnel are available.
  
  
You retain ownership of escalated problems/issues through to resolution.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that NCR Atleos Management is informed if resolution to a problem will take longer than contractual requirements require.
  
  
You will provide input to the Knowledge Systems as and when required and create and publish knowledge articles when required.
  
  
You will coordinate with your peers, Management, Learning teams, and other support groups in providing part numbers, technical details, field learning, and product/process information to Field Service Technicians and learners.
  
  
You will act as a second line escalation point for junior colleagues and provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance where required.
  
  
You will facilitate course delivery using classroom, lab, VILT (virtual instructor-led training), online, and other approved methods of instruction.
  
  
You will execute course delivery according to the published training schedule.
  
  
You will maintain classroom facilities, training center, lab environment, training equipment, and learning materials necessary for the class.
  
  
You will work collaboratively with and around other team members in a Lab environment.
  
  
You will support course development by providing subject matter expertise for assigned products, technical procedures, and service processes.
  
  
You will perform course maintenance and identify required updates to course content using existing knowledge, field feedback, service trends, and analytical skills.
  
  
You will use a variety of delivery techniques, leveraging formal and informal delivery tools such as virtual classrooms, web conferencing, discussion forums, blogs, wikis, job aids, and short-form instructional videos where applicable.
  
  
You may serve as course owner for assigned instructor-led training courses.
  
  
You will develop or support performance support materials, including job aids, technical tips, procedural guides, and YouTube-style videos where applicable.
  
  
You will mentor new instructors and support knowledge transfer across technical support and learning teams.
  
  
You will manage day-to-day operations of the learning center where assigned, including keeping it clean, organized, and ready to support the best learning environment possible.
  
  
You will use continuous improvement processes and tools to improve Services Learning and Technical Support processes and increase the value-add provided to our customers.
  
  
You will deliver quality support and enhanced results meeting established KPI and Customer SLA requirements.
  
  
You will provide onsite and lab support for equipment as required.
  
  
You must be willing and able to work flexible schedules, which may include night and weekend shifts, and perform overtime work upon management request or business need.
  
  
You will perform travel as required, where applicable.
  
  
You must maintain a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.
  
  
You will comply with NCR Atleos policies which include but are not limited to:
  
  
The Company’s Shared Values and Code of Conduct.
  
  
Employee Health and Safety policy and standards.
  
  
Accurate timekeeping and records of hours worked.
  
  
Company Fleet policies and requirements, where applicable, which include but are not limited to NCR Atleos requirements for safe driving.
  
  
You will perform other corresponding duties and tasks in accordance with your qualifications, as directed by Employer.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
High School Diploma.
  
  
Prior work experience in a Customer Support or Technical Support role is required, with experience supporting customers in the Financial sector and/or Retail and Hospitality sector being a must where applicable.
  
  
3–5 years of experience working with, supporting, troubleshooting, or servicing technical equipment, heavy machinery, ATMs, retail technology, networking hardware, or similar technical environments; or an Associate Degree in a technical field or in education.
  
  
Experience servicing NCR Atleos supported equipment or equivalent technical platforms is required where applicable.
  
  
Must be authorized to work in the country where position is posted.
  
  
Must be a local candidate for in-country teams.
  
  
PC proficiency.
  
  
Proficiency with Windows-based applications/tools and MS Office products.
  
  
Good English communication skills and telephony etiquette; other languages may be required for certain teams.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Engineering Management
description:
**Lead Global Cloud Innovation as Manager of Cloud Operations (COPS)**
Are you an experienced engineering leader passionate about scaling mission-critical cloud infrastructure and pioneering AI and agentic automation? Trimble is seeking an exceptional Manager of Cloud Operations (COPS) to lead our Chennai Cloud Operations team. In this pivotal leadership role, you will oversee the daily management of Trimble Viewpoint's Global Cloud Services—supporting 22,000+ servers and 6,000+ customers in North America—while driving our strategic operational roadmap toward an AI-first future.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**About Trimble Viewpoint:**
Trimble Viewpoint provides market-leading construction management software solutions that connect the office, team, and field. Our cloud services deliver enterprise-grade performance, high reliability, and integrated data visibility to thousands of construction organizations worldwide.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this high-impact position, you will direct the global heartbeat of Trimble Viewpoint’s cloud estate. Operating from our Chennai office in an IST-driven collaborative model with our North American teams, you will champion agentic AI workflows, autonomous patch and incident pipelines, and FinOps cost-governance disciplines. You will have full executive support to cultivate an exceptional engineering culture, mentor top cloud talent, define technical standards with Information Security and Product Leadership, and lead the operational transition toward intelligent, self-healing cloud ecosystems.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Leadership & AI Vision: Develop and implement the technical roadmap for AI-enabled cloud operations, championing agentic automation with human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints across deployments, server lifecycle management, and daily workflows.
* Global Estate & 24/7 Service Oversight: Oversee 24/7 cloud operations across 22,000+ servers and 6,000+ enterprise customers, managing disaster recovery, capacity modeling, event management, incident resolution, and change governance.
* SLA & MTTR Optimization: Own customer-facing uptime and system reliability metrics, deploying AI-assisted root-cause analysis (RCA), predictive alerting, and automated remediation to systematically drive down Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
* AI-SecOps & Audit Readiness: Champion AI-SecOps practices to integrate machine learning into threat detection, vulnerability remediation, and security incident response, ensuring full compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and ITIL standards.
* FinOps & Capacity Planning: Direct cloud financial operations (FinOps) through AI-driven cost analytics to forecast capacity, optimize global cloud spend, and enforce team-wide budget accountability.
* Team Leadership & Global Governance: Directly manage and mentor the Chennai Cloud Operations team, cultivating high AI fluency, structured career paths, and seamless cross-regional governance with North American counterparts.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Professional Leadership: 10+ years of overall IT and cloud infrastructure experience, with a proven track record in a direct people management and engineering leadership role.
* Service Management Frameworks: In-depth working knowledge and operational execution of ITIL disciplines (Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration, and Release Management).
* Escalation & Crisis Management: Proven ability to manage complex, high-priority operational escalations, maintain composed customer communications, and drive rapid incident containment.
* Customer Onboarding & Process Transition: Demonstrated experience facilitating customer onboarding and smooth enterprise transitions into cloud operations support.
* Global Cross-Functional Alignment: Track record of driving standard processes, operational rigor, and unified metrics across distributed, multi-region teams.

**Bonus Points For**

* Cloud & AI Certifications: Professional certifications in Microsoft Azure and/or recognized AI/ML platforms.
* Agentic Automation & Scripting: Practical exposure to building or supervising automated agentic workflows, autonomous remediation runbooks, or modern telemetry stacks.
* Compliance Expertise: Direct experience managing audits and operational security controls under SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 frameworks.

**Logistics**

* Location: Chennai, India
* Department: Global Cloud Services / Cloud Operations (COPS)
* Level: M3
* Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

**How to Apply:**
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

If you need assistance or would like to request an accommodation in connection with the application process, please contact careers@trimble.com.

title: Couchbase Database Administrator
company: Inde Dutch Engineering & Aerospace Services Ltd
description:
Preferred

Couchbase Administration Skills

• Install, configure, administer, patch, upgrade, and maintain multi-node Couchbase clusters across development, test, staging, and production environments

• Manage Couchbase Data, Query, Index, Search, Analytics, and Eventing services based on workload requirements

• Administer buckets, scopes, collections, nodes, service quotas, replicas, compaction settings, and cluster rebalance activities

• Plan and execute node addition, removal, failover, recovery, cluster expansion, and capacity changes with minimal service disruption

• Support Couchbase Server on Linux and, where applicable, Couchbase Capella or Couchbase deployments on cloud and Kubernetes platforms

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Performance, Query, and Indexing

• Monitor cluster health, node utilization, disk and memory consumption, latency, throughput, rebalance status, replication queues, and service-specific metrics

• Tune memory quotas, vBuckets, indexes, compaction, query services, and workload placement for performance and stability

• Create, review, and optimize SQL++ queries, execution plans, Global Secondary Indexes, and index partitioning strategies

• Troubleshoot slow queries, indexing failures, hot nodes, skew, timeouts, out-of-memory conditions, and application connectivity issues

• Perform capacity planning, growth forecasting, workload analysis, and performance benchmarking for high-volume environments

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

High Availability, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

• Design and maintain high-availability configurations using replicas, failover, rebalance, and resilient cluster topology

• Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Cross Data Center Replication for disaster recovery and geographically distributed workloads

• Plan and execute full and incremental backups, restores, retention policies, archive management, and periodic recovery validation

• Develop and test disaster recovery procedures, including failover and failback runbooks, recovery objectives, and operational readiness

• Participate in business continuity exercises and resolve replication lag, conflicts, connectivity, and recovery-related issues

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Security and Compliance

• Implement role-based access control, least-privilege administration, service accounts, password policies, and periodic access reviews

• Manage TLS certificates and encryption in transit and at rest in accordance with enterprise security standards

• Configure auditing, logging, network controls, and secure connectivity between applications, clusters, and administrative tools

• Support vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance evidence, patch governance, and audit requests

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Automation, Monitoring, and Operations

• Automate routine administration, health checks, deployments, backup validation, and reporting using Shell, Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies

• Use Couchbase command-line utilities and management APIs for cluster operations, diagnostics, backup, and recovery

• Integrate metrics and alerts with enterprise monitoring platforms; experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or comparable tools is preferred

• Support Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, or Couchbase Autonomous Operator

• Perform incident, problem, change, release, service-request, and root-cause-analysis activities in line with ITIL processes

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Collaboration and Communication

• Work closely with application, cloud, DevOps, network, storage, security, and architecture teams to support reliable production services

• Advise development teams on document design, bucket, scope, and collection architecture, indexing, connection management, and efficient query patterns

• Lead technical troubleshooting during critical incidents and communicate impact, recovery actions, risks, and preventive measures to stakeholders

• Create and maintain standard operating procedures, runbooks, architecture documents, operational checklists, known-error records, and knowledge articles

• Provide technical guidance, peer reviews, mentoring, and knowledge transfer to operations team members

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Nice to Have

• Experience with Couchbase Capella, cloud migration, hybrid-cloud deployment, or platform modernization

• Knowledge of Couchbase Mobile, Sync Gateway, full-text search, Analytics, Eventing, or data integration patterns

• Experience migrating from relational or other NoSQL platforms to Couchbase

• Familiarity with Java or other Couchbase SDKs, CI/CD pipelines, and observability practices

• Couchbase or relevant cloud and database certifications

Additional Information

The role may require working in a 24x7 support model, including rotational shifts, scheduled maintenance, and on-call support for mission-critical production environments. The successful candidate should be comfortable coordinating with global teams and managing high-severity incidents under defined service-level commitments.

title: network engineer II
description:
**About The Team — NOC (Network Operations Center)**
The Network Operations Center (NOC) team is responsible for the health and availability of the network infrastructure powering Walmart US Stores, Sam's Club locations, and Distribution Centers. Our team consists of 10 members operating across a follow-the-sun model spanning the US and India, ensuring round-the-clock coverage and rapid response regardless of time zone.
  
  
At any given moment, the NOC team is the frontline safeguard ensuring that store, club, and distribution center networks remain operational — enabling associates and customers to communicate, transact, and operate without disruption. A network hiccup isn't just a technical event; it's a potential barrier to a customer's shopping experience or an associate's ability to serve them, and our team exists to prevent and resolve that impact as quickly as possible.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Identify and Troubleshoot network incidents prioritizing it based on the impact to Walmart associates and customers.
* Understand how to use monitoring tools which can help detect issues proactively and work toward a faster resolution
* Work with the urgency assigned to mitigate the issue within the SLA defined.
* Coordinate with counterpart teams to understand the details pertaining the issue and assist with resolution.
* Understand the need of the store and club business partners and work with them in tandem.
* Be crystal clear in written and oral communications. Work with US engineers and partners and handover status to US shift when India shift is over.
* Leverage the overall experience to gauge the situation and act swiftly as per the need of the hour
* Maintaining the network devices to be in compliance for efficient operation

**What You'll Bring**

* Minimum 3-4 years of pure network engineering experience – having worked in a NOC environment or project implementation team.
* Good experience handling network hardware – routers, switches & access points.
* Good to have - Linux and Python/ AI automation knowledge in network space

NOC Skillsets
  
  
Networking background with Hands-on experience in Routing & Switching (CCNA/ JNCIA/CCNP).
  
  
Strong understanding and experience working on routers, switches, APs on various platforms (Cisco, Juniper, Meraki). Such as Cisco 2900, 4K ISR, ENCS5412, Cisco 3650, 3850, 4500, 6500, 9300, Juniper EX2300, EX4600 and Meraki MS425, MS225.
  
  
Experience in routing protocols : RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, IS-IS and BGP
  
  
Strong troubleshooting skills on Juniper/Cisco and Meraki devices along with SDN knowledge.
  
  
Understanding and troubleshooting of Switching concepts like VLAN, VTP, STP, RSTP, Ether-Channels (PAGP & LACP) and Stacking.
  
  
Basic knowledge of Broadcast/ARP/MAC address
  
  
Wired & Wireless Networking knowledge
  
  
Should have hands on troubleshooting experience of VLAN
  
  
Should have implemented and troubleshooted HSRP
  
  
Hands on experience on MPLS protocol.
  
  
Experience in IPSEC & DMVPN technology.
  
  
Troubleshooting knowledge in wireless : CAPWAP, LWAPP protocols ,Cisco AP’s, Mist APs, MR46 Meraki APs and Wireless controllers.
  
  
Usage of ticketing and troubleshooting tools like Service now and Wireshark respectively
  
  
WLAN IEEE802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax Test experience
  
  
Performance WLAN tests (preferable)
  
  
Knowledge in Nexus, automation and SDWAN technologies is an added advantage
  
  
Scripting Knowledge of Automation Scripts - Python / Perl / TCL - added advantage
  
  
Independent Project handling with analytical ability
  
  
**Wireless ( Store & DC )**
Maintaining the functionality of the stores/Clubs wireless connectivity and entirety of the network at all of our distribution centres.
  
  
Troubleshooting general wireless slowness at stores and clubs/DC’s.
  
  
Working a wide variety of wireless escalations through outlook and Service now.
  
  
Working on all self-service incidents that are created by stores associates that relate to any potential wireless issues they are experiencing.
  
  
Take calls from both associates and venders over a variety of wireless issues and push them to resolution.
  
  
Working with store associates to power cycle any of the wireless hardware infrastructure if needed.
  
  
Communicating with third party vendors to ensure that they have everything working on their equipment and for any equipment that needs to be replaced.
  
  
We will also ensure that they are doing their part by getting hourly updates from them for any issues they have with their equipment
  
  
Perform wired troubleshooting that could potentially affect wireless devices.
  
  
Ensuring the switches power supply is giving enough POE to power on all of the access points.
  
  
Checking DHCP Snooping on all switches and interfaces.
  
  
Checking for DHCP/DNS errors in the ISP and ensuring that the wireless devices are receiving IP addresses.
  
  
Performing in depth troubleshooting with members of management by having them recreate the issue while we track the device and pinpoint what exactly they are having issues with.
  
  
Communicating with store associates for validation that they themselves and customers are able to use their personal and corporate devices without any issues or slowness.
  
  
Validating the meshed AP in the yard of a DC are set up correctly.
  
  
Work with the systems team at DCs to notify them of any Access points that are offline. Monitoring the store wireless environment and logistics environment.
  
  
Monitor auto-generated tickets for down Access points and down Internet VRFs.
  
  
Working with Wireless controllers – Cisco (HREAP), MIST.
  
  
Working with the wireless engineering team on certain changes to the environment.
  
  
**Wired (Store & DC )**
Troubleshooting packet loss, overutilization, and down circuits
  
  
Troubleshoot any and all routing issues at store & DC level.
  
  
Troubleshoot voice issues, from a single extension to all the voice at site. This includes static, one-way dialling, paging, stuck calls; and down voice gateways, and voice cards on routers.
  
  
Troubleshoot end devices that are not receiving an IP address, not connecting, or are experiencing slowness.
  
  
Work with third party vendors on incidents to troubleshoot and/or replace connections, cabling, and hardware.
  
  
Working with L3 and Cisco on any TAC cases for the store wired/ voice environment.
  
  
Working with sites to T/S down equipment before dispatching cabling and or replacements.
  
  
Assisting Field Support on Down systems and Down Power situations.
  
  
Monitoring overall ticket queues and making sure to maintain all tickets so that they do not go outside their SLA.
  
  
Assisting Field Project Supervisors and Store Planners with port configurations whenever the tool fails them..
  
  
Working with sites to troubleshoot and resolve spanning-tree issues.
  
  
Troubleshooting impacting DC voice issues.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.

**Ready to combine hands-on network engineering with practical team leadership?**
We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Engineer with 15 + years who can guide colleagues, coordinate delivery and still enjoy getting close to the technology.
  
  
ASSA ABLOY Global IT manages shared infrastructure, global applications and security for globally delivered solutions. We operate in a multi-sourcing environment and work closely with internal customers, strategic partners, suppliers and colleagues across the world.
  
  
In this role, you will join the Global IT Network Services organisation, part of the Infrastructure team. Your main focus will be wireless and LAN services, while your wider network perspective will help the team deliver stable, secure and future-ready services.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will be a senior technical contributor and a natural team lead for the WiFi and LAN area. You will help the team plan and prioritise work, coordinate technical activities, and ensure consistent and well-aligned delivery.
  
  
This is a role where leadership is combined with means stepping away from engineering. You will work hands-on with architecture, design, implementation, troubleshooting and documentation, while coaching colleagues and creating a collaborative, accountable way of working.
  
  
You will also act as an important link between engineers, customers, service management and external providers. By turning requirements and operational feedback into practical improvements, you will help develop global network services that provide real business value.
  
  
The wider team supports infrastructure services across WiFi, LAN, WAN, Remote Access, DDI, firewalls, load balancing, web security and monitoring, providing opportunities to collaborate broadly between teams .
  
  
**To summarise:**
You will lead through expertise, teamwork and a strong commitment to hands-on contribution.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide day-to-day technical leadership for the team, including planning, prioritisation and coordination of work.
* Coach and support engineers, encourage knowledge sharing and help the team grow its technical capability.
* Acting as a contact for network infrastructure within all the global regions.
* Work closely with customers and colleagues worldwide on service enquiries, incidents, changes and improvements.
* Collect requirements and feedback from customers and stakeholders, then translate them into practical solutions.
* Contribute to common network architecture, design standards, roadmaps and service catalogue development.
* Review service performance, metrics and SLAs, and be able to lead improvement activities when needed.
* Present technical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Keep processes, operational routines and documentation clear, current and useful.
* Involved and influence in 24/7 operation optimization vs delivery.

**What you bring**
We are looking for someone with strong technical skills who is confident taking the lead and works well with others. You can organise work in a clear and practical way without adding unnecessary processes. You also understand how to meet today’s operational needs while continuing to improve services for the future.
  
  

* Proven experience as a team lead, technical lead or senior engineer who has coordinated and guided others.
* At least ten years of experience in network infrastructure, including significant hands-on work in projects or complex enterprise environments.
* Very strong knowledge of LAN, WiFi, routing and switching.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco wireless technologies, including WLC, Catalyst Center and Cisco ISE.
* Experience working with global service providers, partners and distributed teams.
* A good understanding of service management, SLAs, operational processes and continuous improvement.
* Strong skills in technical design, documentation, troubleshooting and stakeholder communication.
* A customer-focused, structured and proactive approach.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with agile ways of working.
* Background in customer-facing engineering, consulting, professional services, presales, post-sales or product development.
* Experience contributing to service roadmaps, service catalogues and vendor evaluations.
* Relevant Cisco certifications or equivalent practical expertise.

**What we offer**

* A visible role in a global network organisation with the opportunity to influence services used across global regions.
* A combination of technical depth, team leadership and service development.
* Close collaboration with experienced colleagues, customers and strategic technology partners.
* A working environment where practical ideas, clear communication and a positive team spirit matter.

****Location****

* Chennai, India.
* The role is based at the ASSA ABLOY office.

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.
  
  
As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.
  
  
As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Mainframe Systems Automation Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge.
