**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe Systems Automation Specialist, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting automation solutions across IBM Z mainframe environments to improve operational efficiency, system availability, and service reliability. You will leverage tools such as IBM System Automation, NetView, OPS/MVS, REXX, and scheduling platforms to automate system monitoring, recovery, and workload management. The role involves collaborating with infrastructure, operations, and application teams to ensure resilient, automated, and optimized mainframe operations.

**What You Will DO**

  

* Design, implement, and maintain automation solutions for IBM Z mainframe environments to improve system reliability and operational efficiency.
* Develop and support automation using tools such as IBM System Automation, NetView, OPS/MVS, and REXX.
* Monitor system health, automate recovery procedures, and minimize manual intervention during incidents.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to optimize workload scheduling and system performance.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance availability, resilience, and operational excellence across the mainframe platform.  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 7+ years of experience in Mainframe Automation on IBM z/OS platforms.
* Hands-on expertise with automation tools such as IBM System Automation, NetView, Broadcom OPS/MVS, and MainView Auto Operator.
* Strong knowledge of message automation, event-driven automation, and operational process automation.
* Experience in installation, upgrade, customization, administration, and maintenance of z/OS automation products.
* Proficiency in JCL, REXX, and CLIST scripting for automation development and support.
* Working knowledge of z/OS administration, JES2/JES3, SDSF, OMEGAMON, SYSVIEW, MainView, and NetView.
* Ability to integrate and customize automation solutions for IMS, CICS, DB2, MQ, OMEGAMON, and other enterprise tools.
Experience supporting disaster recovery, high availability initiatives, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving continuous automation improvements.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience working with GDPS environments, including integrating new systems and supporting business continuity, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions.
* Exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as OMEGAMON, SYSVIEW, and MainView for proactive system management.
* Ability to automate operational processes using REXX, CLIST, JCL, and z/OS automation frameworks.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments with strong focus on resiliency, availability, and operational excellence.

Flexibility to support US prime shifts, off-hours on-call rotations, weekend activities, and critical production support as required by client commitments.  



**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

description:

**Job Summary:**

  

Seeking an experienced Senior System Administrator to design, manage, and scale mission-critical infrastructure across AWS and Azure. This role involves administering Linux platforms, container orchestration (EKS/AKS), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and automation (Ansible). The ideal candidate will ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing systems through proactive monitoring, automation, and continuous improvement.

**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Cloud Infrastructure (AWS & Azure)
  + Manage and optimize AWS services (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, ALB/NLB, CloudWatch, EKS).
  + Support Azure environments (VMs, VNets, NSG, Azure Monitor, AKS, Azure Load Balancer, ).

  + Automate tasks using Bash/shell scripting and Ansible.

  + Design and maintain L4/L7 load balancing solutions (ALB/NLB, Azure Load Balancer, Nginx, HAProxy, or F5).
  + Configure SSL/TLS offloading, health checks, routing, and traffic policies.
* Containers & Orchestration (EKS/AKS)
  + Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters, including RBAC, networking, storage, and security controls.
  + Perform cluster upgrades, manage deployments, scaling, and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  + Build and manage Terraform-based deployments with modules, version control, and environment segregation.
  + Implement policy-as-code and maintain secure state management.
* Automation (Ansible)
  + Develop and maintain playbooks/roles for provisioning, patching, and configuration management.
  + Integrate Ansible workflows with CI/CD pipelines and secrets management.
* Security, Compliance & SRE Operations
  + Enforce CIS/NIST/ISO hardening standards, patch/vulnerability management, IAM policies, and incident response.
  + Define and track SLIs/SLOs, conduct RCAs and post-mortems, and maintain KB documentation.
* Collaboration & Mentorship
  + Work closely with development, network, and security teams to deliver resilient infrastructure.
  + Mentor junior administrators and contribute to knowledge transfer and documentation.
* **Core Competencies**
  ---------------------

  + Ownership and accountability for production systems.
  + Clear documentation and knowledge sharing.
  + Strong analytical and communication skills.
  + Security-first mindset and attention to detail.
  + Ability to prioritize and perform under pressure with on-call responsibilities
  + 24\*7 shift along with Oncall responsibility

**General Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System
* Comply with Cubic Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures
* Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of the organisations
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures
* Other duties as requested

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

  

* 7 - 12 years of Linux system administration with strong AWS & Azure experience (core services, networking, IAM, EKS).

Working knowledge of Azure and AKS.

* Proficiency in Terraform and Ansible.
* Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, firewalls, SSL/TLS).
* Skilled in monitoring/observability (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Azure Monitor).
* Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning abilities; scripting in Bash/Python.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Windows Server Administration (AD, DNS, Group Policy).
* VMware Administration (ESXi, vCenter, vSAN).
* Familiarity with Ivanti, GitOps (Argo CD/Flux), CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

Employee

title: Manager, IT Infrastructure
description:
**Manager, IT Infrastructure**

Mumbai

Working at Teach For India

Teach For India is on a journey to reach an India free of poverty and filled with love by ending educational inequity in our country. Fifteen years into our journey we are a movement of ~5000+ Alumni working at all levels of the education system, who are reaching 1 in 10 children across the country. These Alumni have graduated from our two-year Fellowship Program where they taught in under-resourced classrooms to put ~33,500 low-income children on a different life path. Today, we have ~1000 Fellows and are the largest pipeline of driven, skilled talent into the educational ecosystem in India. Over 16,000 Teach For India students have appeared for the 10th grade board examinations till date, with an impressive 95% pass rate across cities as of November 2024.

In 2022, we embarked on
**Phase 4**
, our fourth strategic phase. We have a bold and ambitious ten-year journey ahead of us that aims to
**grow 50,000 leaders**
, who will
**work collectively**
, and
**with love**
, to
**transform the lives of 1 in 10 low-income children in our regions**
, through an
**education that unleashes the potential of self, others and India**
. In this decade, five key priorities will lead us to this vision.

1. **Strengthen**
   our core Fellowship to build strong teacher leaders who provide an excellent and equitable education to our children and continue to do so beyond the Fellowship
2. **Scale**
   our impact by strategically introducing additional Fellowships as alternative pathways for leadership development
3. **Match**
   the Alumni of our programs at an intersection of their interests and the needs of the system and our children
4. **Advocate**
   for key issues that impact educational equity, and engage 3.5% of the population in the movement for educational equity
5. **Act**
   collectively with our Alumni to learn about and address key issues in our regions.

Our work will only be completed when we have built a movement of leaders that is large enough to ensure that every child in India attains an excellent education.

We pride ourselves as being a passionate, idealistic, mission-driven team of individuals. We’re committed to learning and excellence in our roles, and to being deeply rooted in our core values.

What Teach For India Can Offer You

* The opportunity to be part of one of the most established and visionary movements in the education sector in India which is at a pivotal point in terms of expanding its scale and outreach across the nation and working with changemakers across the country.
* A challenging yet flexible workplace in which every individual employee’s Staff journey is tracked for excellence and leadership development.
* A work environment in which employees’ holistic well-being is a core priority, enabling people to be their best selves.
* Access to connections and resources from the global Teach For All network that includes partner organizations spanning 50+ countries across 6 continents.
* Remuneration that is competitive within the top quartile of the Indian NGO pay scales, and a benefits package that includes extensive medical insurance and maternity coverage for both parents.

Position Summary

**Reporting to:**
Senior
Manager, IT Infrastructure

The Manager, IT Infrastructure will be responsible for ensuring each staff member and Fellow has continuous and secure access to IT Infrastructure hardware and enterprise applications for their day-to-day work activities.

Responsibilities

**Primary responsibilities:**

* **System Management:**
  Manage allocation, maintenance, and up-gradation of hardware and enterprise applications, internet connections, their maintenance, and up-gradation of network equipment in all offices.
* **Purchase and Vendor Management:**
  Manage the vendors and purchase IT infrastructure hardware and enterprise software as per the purchase process.
* **Asset Management:**
  Maintain records of all IT assets to plan for maintenance, upgrades, retirements, and future IT investments.
* **Data Backup and Recovery:**
  Responsible for data backup and recovery of deleted or lost data of users.
* **Systems’ Audit:**
  Manage systems audit and assess their outcomes.
* **Implement technology policies:**
  Implement the technology policies approved by the management and train the users about the technology policies.
* **Software Compliance:**
  Ensure timely renewals of all enterprise software application platforms, that the number of software licenses is adequate for each team, and 100% of devices used in Teach For India have genuine software licenses.

Additional Responsibilities

**As Manager Infrastructure at Teach For India**

* Contribute to
  **the team goals and priorities**
  beyond individual goals and priorities
* Serve as an
  **ambassador of the Teach For India brand**
  and an advocate for our work and for educational equity in our country through both internal and external communication after commiting time in our classrooms to understand our work more deeply
* Support with key organizational areas such as
  **Recruitment, Selection, Fundraising, Volunteering, Movement Building**

Minimum Qualifications, Experiences and Expectations

* 2-3 years working experience as IT Manager / Technology Manager in a small to medium enterprise.
* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunication is preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of System Administration with problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Familiarity with various operating systems (Windows, Mac, Android) and platforms.
* Ability to be resourceful, take responsibility and find practical solutions to problems.
* Ability to work in a deadline-based environment.
* Google/Microsoft certification in IT/System Administration is a plus, but not mandatory.
* Experience working with mobile device management tools is a plus, but not mandatory.

***Note:***
*We want to hear your unique voice and perspectives through the process, hence all applicants are expected to personally author statements of purpose/essays in the application form. Sole use of AI or Chat-GPT based tools may lead to disqualification from the process.*

description:
🚀
**We’re Hiring: IT Admin and Operations Manager**

📍
**Location:**
Mumbai, India

4+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**🌐 About Ubiqedge Technology Pvt. Ltd.**

Ubiqedge Technology Pvt. Ltd. is an AIoT company combining hardware, software, and AI to deliver intelligent industrial solutions. Our solutions include IoT-based telemetry, remote monitoring, data analytics, and industrial automation across industries such as water management, infrastructure, and manufacturing.

**🎯 About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on, process-oriented
**IT Admin and Operations Manager**
to manage day-to-day IT operations, infrastructure, employee IT support, device management, security coordination, and administrative systems.

The successful candidate will act as the internal point of contact for IT operations, working closely with our Managed Service Provider (MSP), external vendors, and internal teams to ensure reliable, secure, and efficient IT services across the organization.

**🔧 Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure & Technical Support**

* Manage the complete laptop and desktop lifecycle, including procurement, configuration, allocation, repairs, and disposal.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating systems, Wi-Fi, LAN, VPN, printers, and other IT-related issues.
* Coordinate with the MSP for advanced troubleshooting and infrastructure support.
* Maintain IT documentation, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.

**2. User & Workspace Administration**

* Administer user accounts, permissions, email accounts, licenses, and application access across Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
* Manage employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding, ensuring timely access provisioning and revocation.
* Maintain access approval records and conduct periodic access reviews.
* Ensure appropriate access controls and least-privilege practices.

**3. IT Security & Device Management**

* Coordinate endpoint security, device encryption, patch management, antivirus/EDR, and MDM/UEM implementation with the MSP.
* Monitor device compliance and pending security updates.
* Coordinate MFA implementation, firewall updates, and security incident response.
* Maintain security records and support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audit readiness.

**4. IT Asset & Software License Management**

* Maintain an accurate inventory of IT assets, including laptops, desktops, peripherals, and networking equipment.
* Manage asset tagging, employee assignment records, acknowledgements, and asset returns.
* Track warranties, AMC contracts, repairs, replacements, software licenses, and subscription renewals.
* Coordinate periodic asset verification with Finance and Administration.

**5. Network & Infrastructure Operations**

* Monitor office internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, LAN, VPN, and network equipment.
* Coordinate with ISPs and the MSP to resolve connectivity issues and maintain backup internet arrangements.
* Maintain network documentation and escalation contacts.
* Track recurring outages and ensure corrective actions are documented.

**6. MSP & Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary coordinator between employees, management, and the MSP.
* Track IT incidents and service requests, ensuring timely resolution and SLA adherence.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance, patching, and periodic security reviews.
* Assist with vendor evaluation, procurement, quotation comparisons, negotiations, and contract renewals.

**7. CCTV, Access Control & Office Administration**

* Coordinate maintenance of CCTV systems, NVR/DVR equipment, and office access-control systems.
* Maintain surveillance system availability and approved data-retention practices.
* Coordinate office IT infrastructure, equipment supplies, and maintenance vendors.
* Maintain attendance system records and generate reports for HR, where assigned.
* Work with HR, Finance, Operations, and external service providers to resolve administrative issues.

**💻 Required Skills & Experience**

✅ Minimum 4 years of experience in IT administration, IT operations, desktop support, or infrastructure support.

✅ Hands-on experience managing Windows desktops/laptops; macOS exposure is preferred.

✅ Practical experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration.

✅ Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and firewall basics.

✅ Experience with endpoint security, patch management, antivirus/EDR, and MDM/UEM platforms.

✅ Knowledge of IT asset management, software licensing, procurement, and vendor coordination.

✅ Experience working with an MSP, IT AMC provider, or external infrastructure support team.

✅ Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

✅ Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a growing organization.

**⭐ Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, IT audits, and security compliance documentation.
* Familiarity with IT service management tools, ticketing systems, and SLA reporting.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft 365, or ITIL Foundation are an advantage.

**📈 What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will help establish accurate IT asset records, standardize onboarding and offboarding processes, improve MSP coordination, identify security gaps, reduce recurring IT issues, and maintain clear IT operations reporting for management.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows structured processes, proactively resolves issues, and ensures employees receive timely and reliable IT support.

📩
**Interested candidates can apply directly through LinkedIn or share their updated resumes.**

🤝 Know someone who would be a good fit? Feel free to share this opportunity!

title: IT Administrator / IT & Admin Executive
description:
**About Venxr**
Venxr is an AI-powered AdTech company building products for media planning and campaign management across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, YouTube, and OTT. We help simplify complex, multi-platform advertising workflows through technology.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an organized and proactive IT Administrator / IT & Admin Executive to manage the company's IT infrastructure, hardware and software assets, user access, and day-to-day IT administration.
  
  
The role will be responsible for maintaining accurate IT records, managing the complete lifecycle of company assets and software, supporting employee onboarding and offboarding, resolving basic IT issues, and coordinating with external IT vendors when required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Asset & Inventory Management
* Manage and maintain a centralized IT asset register covering laptops, desktops, monitors, mobile devices, accessories, networking equipment, and other IT assets.
* Track complete asset lifecycle including purchase, allocation, transfer, repair, replacement, return, and retirement, along with serial numbers, asset IDs, warranty details, condition, and assigned users.
* Manage the issuance and recovery of IT assets during employee onboarding, transfers, and exits.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets and reconcile records with actual inventory.
* Track hardware warranties, repairs, replacements, and maintenance requirements and coordinate with vendors when necessary.
* Software, License & Subscription Management
* Maintain a centralized inventory of software, licenses, subscriptions, and applications used across the organization.
* Track license ownership, users, costs, validity, renewal dates, and usage.
* Monitor upcoming renewals and coordinate timely renewal or cancellation of subscriptions.
* Maintain records of software/access assigned to employees and ensure access is updated when employees join, change roles, or leave.
* Identify unused, duplicate, or unnecessary licenses and support effective utilization and cost control.
* User Access & Employee IT Support
* Manage and coordinate employee IT requirements, including laptops, email accounts, software, applications, and system access.
* Maintain records of employee accounts, access permissions, and assigned IT assets.
* Coordinate timely creation, modification, and revocation of user access during onboarding, role changes, and offboarding.
* Ensure all company IT assets and access are properly recovered or deactivated during employee exits.
* Provide first-level support for common hardware, software, email, connectivity, printer, and system-related issues.
* IT Infrastructure & Vendor Coordination
* Support basic administration of office IT infrastructure including Wi-Fi, internet, printers, networking equipment, and other workplace technology.
* Troubleshoot basic technical issues and coordinate with external IT service providers for issues requiring specialized support.
* Maintain an IT issue/ticket tracker and ensure reported issues are followed through to resolution.
* Coordinate with IT and technology vendors for purchases, repairs, installations, maintenance, and service requirements.
* IT Documentation, Compliance & Reporting
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of IT assets, software, licenses, subscriptions, vendors, warranties, purchases, and IT-related expenses.
* Maintain supporting documentation such as invoices, quotations, purchase records, license details, warranty documents, and service records.
* Prepare periodic reports on asset allocation, inventory status, software licenses, upcoming renewals, repairs, replacements, and IT expenses.
* Ensure IT records are organized, accessible, and updated whenever there is a change in assets, users, or software access.
* General Administrative Support
* Assist HR and management with IT-related requirements for employees and office operations.
* Coordinate technology-related office requirements and support general administrative activities when required.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support, IT Asset Management, System Administration, or a similar role.
* Good understanding of hardware, software, IT asset management, and user access management.
* Basic knowledge of Windows systems, networking, email, printers, and common workplace applications.
* Experience maintaining IT asset/inventory trackers and software/license records.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong organizational, documentation, and follow-up skills.
* Good communication and vendor coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple IT requirements independently and prioritize tasks effectively.

**What This Role Will Own**
The selected candidate will have primary responsibility for maintaining visibility and control over the companies:
  
  

* Hardware → What devices do we have, where are they, who is using them, and what condition are they in?
* Software → What applications and licenses do we have, who is using them, and are they being utilized effectively?
* Subscriptions → What are we paying for, how many licenses do we have, and when do they renew?
* Access → Who has access to which systems, and is access updated when employees join, change roles, or leave?
* IT Lifecycle → What was purchased, assigned, transferred, repaired, replaced, returned, or retired?

title: Lead IT Service Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Lead – Service Desk**
**Location:**
Pune, India |
**Experience:**
8+ years |
**Team:**
Corporate IT – IT Services |
**Reports to:**
Senior Manager, IT
  
  
**Job Description**
Lead day-to-day Service Desk operations as the senior technical escalation point for IT Services, ensuring consistent, secure, and high-quality support across identity, Microsoft 365, Windows and macOS endpoints, collaboration services, and the employee lifecycle. The role owns SLA performance, ITIL process adherence, vendor coordination, and service reporting, while driving automation and continuous improvement, delivering white-glove executive support, and mentoring engineers to build a capable, high-performing team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead daily Service Desk operations, including ticket queue management, shift and roster planning, workload distribution, and on-call coverage.
* Ensure support SLAs are consistently met and take prompt corrective action when service levels fall short.
* Review weekly Service Desk performance reports with the IT team and present findings and action plans to IT Management.
* Ensure the team follows the ITIL framework and formal change management procedures for consistent service delivery.
* Coordinate with vendors and third-party partners on support, procurement, and service delivery.
* Track IT assets and hardware and software inventory, and support technology procurement.
* Provide IT Management with regular, clear status updates on tasks, projects, and priority issues.
* Lead troubleshooting for complex incidents affecting users, endpoints, applications, identity, and collaboration services, acting as the escalation point for IT Services Engineers.
* Coordinate cross-team resolution with Infrastructure, Security, Network, and Application teams.
* Participate in the weekend on-call rotation to handle critical incidents, coordinate escalations, and restore service quickly.
* Identify recurring issues and implement lasting fixes, self-service options, and measurable improvements.
* Administer and improve Okta SSO, MFA, application integrations, group management, and lifecycle processes, validating access configurations, attribute mappings, and provisioning and deprovisioning flows.
* Promote secure access practices and lead access reviews, audit readiness, and lifecycle governance.
* Manage advanced administration across Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, and endpoint services, and lead Windows device deployment, configuration, and service improvements.
* Lead macOS and MacBook fleet management using Iru (formerly Kandji), including zero-touch deployment through Apple Business Manager, Blueprints, Library items, configuration profiles, app deployment, OS updates, and patching.
* Administer macOS compliance and security controls such as FileVault, Gatekeeper, and device posture policies, and troubleshoot complex macOS hardware, OS, and application issues.
* Deliver white-glove support for executives and VIP users, ensuring technology readiness for meetings, presentations, and visits.
* Support and troubleshoot Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Zoom Rooms, and conference room AV, and provide live support for town halls, training sessions, and key business meetings.
* Perform proactive conference room and meeting technology checks to prevent disruptions.
* Improve FreshService service catalogs, workflows, dashboards, reports, ticket routing, assignment logic, and SLA practices.
* Build automation using Okta Workflows, FreshService Workflow Automator, Power Automate, scripting, or approved AI tools.
* Evaluate new technologies, AI tools, and automation opportunities, and adopt them responsibly where they improve service delivery.
* Lead onboarding, offboarding, contractor management, access changes, device readiness, and asset retrieval, ensuring every activity is documented, controlled, timely, and aligned with security requirements.
* Mentor and coach engineers through regular check-ins and run knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Create and maintain SOPs, support standards, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks, and review the team's technical documentation for quality and accuracy.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in IT services, Service Desk, or end-user support, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* Proven experience managing Service Desk operations, including SLA management, rostering, queue management, and performance reporting.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL practices, including incident, request, problem, and change management.
* Advanced administration and troubleshooting across Okta, Microsoft 365, Entra ID or Active Directory, Intune, and Exchange Online.
* Hands-on experience with Okta SSO, SCIM, MFA, provisioning, deprovisioning, and application integrations.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Iru (formerly Kandji) to manage MacBooks at scale, including Apple Business Manager, Blueprints, configuration profiles, and macOS security and compliance.
* Strong FreshService knowledge, including service catalog, workflow, routing, dashboard, and reporting configuration.
* Experience with automation platforms and scripting, such as Okta Workflows, FreshService Workflow Automator, Power Automate, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Experience supporting executives, Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams, and conference room AV technologies.
* Experience managing vendors, IT asset inventory, and technology procurement.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis, interpret service data and trends, and translate findings into practical, lasting improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Okta Workflows and AI-enabled service desk tools.
* Experience supporting audits, access reviews, and security compliance programs.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable automation, self-service, and service improvement outcomes.
* Certifications such as ITIL 4 Foundation or higher, Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator or Administrator Expert, and Iru (Kandji) or Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP).

**Educational Qualification**
BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA or B.Sc., preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Security Automation Lead
description:
**Job Title**
Cyber Security Platform Engineer
  
  
**Location**
India (Pune)
  
  
**Reports to**
Cyber Security Engineering Lead (India) with functional alignment to Head of Cyber Platform Engineering
  
  
****Role Overview****
FNZ is building a global Cyber Platform Engineering function responsible for the operation, reliability, and evolution of the firm’s core security platforms.
  
  
We are seeking a Cyber Security Platform Engineer to join the growing engineering capability in India. This is a hands-on technical role focused on operating and improving FNZ’s production cyber security platforms.
  
  
The successful candidate will help ensure FNZ’s security platforms remain reliable, well-configured, and continuously improving through engineering, automation, and operational excellence.
  
  
This role sits within Cyber Platform Engineering, not the Security Operations Centre (SOC). The focus is on engineering and operating security platforms, rather than monitoring alerts or performing SOC analysis.
  
  
You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC.
  
  
****Core Responsibilities****
Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ’s production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.
  
  
The role combines hands-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms
* Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management
* Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance
* Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms
* Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ’s global security and operational standards
* Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows
* Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems
* Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency
* Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements
* Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms

Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset
**,**
identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time
  
  
Incident Engineering Support
  
  
Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required.
  
  
**This Includes:**

* Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting
* Assisting with root-cause analysis
* Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents

The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation.
  
  
Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ’s security platform environment.
  
  
**This Includes:**

* Identifying recurring operational issues
* Contributing to automation initiatives
* Improving platform observability and operational metrics
* Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities

Working Pattern
  
  
The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations.
  
  
Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out-of-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows.
  
  
****Required Experience****
Candidates should demonstrate hands-on experience operating enterprise security platforms.
  
  
**Typical Background Includes:**

* 3–6 years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles
* Hands-on experience working with enterprise security platforms
* Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls
* Experience working within distributed global engineering teams

Technical Experience
  
  
Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected:
  
  

* Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne
* Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access
* Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application-layer protection platforms
* Security logging and SIEM platforms
* Email security platforms and secure email gateways
* Vulnerability management platforms
* Network security controls, including next-generation firewalls

Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments.
  
  
Engineering & Automation Experience
  
  
**Experience In The Following Areas Is Beneficial:**

* scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar)
* working with APIs for platform integrations
* infrastructure automation or configuration management
* operating security tooling in cloud environments

Nice to Have
  
  
**Experience In The Following Areas Would Be Beneficial:**

* infrastructure-as-code or DevOps practices
* cloud security platform engineering
* integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines
* platform telemetry and observability tooling

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will:**

* support the reliable operation of FNZ’s security platforms
* contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives
* help maintain platform performance and stability
* collaborate effectively with global engineering teams
* grow technical expertise across FNZ’s security platform ecosystem

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ’s global technology infrastructure.
  
  
**The Cyber Platform Engineering Team Ensures These Platforms Remain:**

* reliable
* scalable
* well-engineered
* continuously improving

This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ’s global environment.
  
  
***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Security Operations Analyst
description:
The Security Operations Analyst is a key member of the information security team who ensures:
  
  

* Security tools operate effectively.
* Incidents are promptly detected, investigated, contained, and remediated.
* Vulnerabilities are promptly identified and remediated.

**About This Role**
The Security Operations Analyst is a key member of the information security team who ensures:
  
  

* Security tools operate effectively.
* Incidents are promptly detected, investigated, contained, and remediated.
* Vulnerabilities are promptly identified and remediated.

**What You'll Do**

* Monitor and administer a suite of best-of-breed security tools:

+ Web Application Firewall (WAF) and Denial of Service Protection
+ Endpoint Protection
+ Endpoint Detection Response (EDR)
+ Firewall and Network Intrusion Detection/Prevention (IDS/IPS)
+ Identity Protection
+ Brand Protection
+ Cloud Security Posture Management
+ Identity Prote ction
+ Attack Surface Management
+ AI Governance
+ Pentesting

* Contain, remediate, and document reported security incidents.
* Perform threat and vulnerability assessments, maintain vulnerability metrics, and implement remedial actions required, including annual pentests.
* Contribute to Third Party Risk Management security and compliance evaluations of new and existing partners.
* Lead or participate in application and infrastructure security risk assessments and audits.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for security playbooks and tools.
* Recommend and apply system and network hardening best practices.
* Evaluate and recommend new security software and technologies to address new threats.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree or working toward a degree focused on cybersecurity or related experience.
* Knowledge of information security principles, security risk assessment, threat modeling, vulnerability management, incident response, and identity and access management.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATTACK, ISO 27001, OWASP Top Ten, and other security frameworks.
* Knowledge of network architecture concepts and protocols.
* Knowledge of Linux, Windows, and AWS infrastructure.
* Knowledge of scripting technologies (Python, Power Shell, Linux Shell).
* Experience with security tooling noted above or similar.
* Industry Certifications (e.g. CISSP, CompTIA/Security+/Linux+, CISA)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Continuous improvement mindset.
* Collaborative work style.
* Strong customer/client focus, with the ability to manage expectations appropriately, provide a superior customer/client experience and build long-term relationships.
* Ability to work well under minimal supervision and be reliable.
* Ability to hold an incident response on-call shift to support Comscore’s 24x7 SOC which may include occasional weekend or after-hours coverage, when needed.
* Ability to work under stress and handle multiple high-pressure situations simultaneously.
* Ability to be available and contribute to work meetings during US hours (Pacific and Eastern Time mornings).

**Shift Timing**
The regular hours for this position will cover a combination of business hours in the US and India – typically 2PM-11PM IST. Occasionally, later hours may be required for meetings with teams in other parts of the world. Additionally, for the first 4-6 weeks of onboarding and training, US Eastern time hours (IST -9:30) may be required.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical: Comscore offers a collective Private Medical Insurance scheme which is 100% covered by Comscore.
* The benefit is applicable to employees, an employee’s spouse, up to two children and parents.
* Pension: Provident Fund: Comscore bears both the employee and employer contribution.
* Time Off Annual Leave: Comscore offers market competitive annual leave of 26 Annual Leave
* Days (8 Casual and 18 Privilege), following local guidelines and practices.
* National Holidays and Festival Holidays: 10 Days.
* Sick Leave: 10 Days.
* Additional Leave: Paternity, Bereavement, Marriage, Maternity, Additional Pregnancy / Birth Related Leave
* Christmas / New Year Paid Leave, Comscore offers a week of Company paid leave over the Christmas / New Year period.
* Summer Hours: Comscore has a culture that rewards employees for their hard work. When you work hard, you need time to recharge and refresh. Early releases on Fridays are subject to manager approval.
* Internal Career Development Opportunities (minimum of 6 months tenure in the current position and in discussion with supervisors)
* Access to hundreds of professional e-learning courses, specifically created for Comscore
* Be creative: You don’t have to follow the norm to be successful – we encourage you to think outside the box. Our culture is built on encouraging innovative ideas, communication and joint success.
* Informal Work Atmosphere: We believe in getting the job done in a comfortable, casual environment!
* The ability to become a truly global engineer, with exposure to markets across the world. With more than 30 offices around the world, many Comscore teams work together across locations.

**About Comscore**
At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.
  
  
Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.
  
  
At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.

The individual will be responsible for ensuring that employees have access to the right tools, licenses, devices, and permissions to perform their jobs effectively and securely. This person will own the administration and documentation of the company's technology stack, identify opportunities to reduce software costs, evaluate new technologies, and help employees get the most out of the tools they use.

The ideal candidate is organized, technically proficient, security-conscious, and comfortable managing a diverse range of SaaS applications, cloud services, and IT infrastructure in a growing organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. SaaS Application & License Management**

* Manage the organization's software subscriptions, licenses, and user accounts across all business applications.
* Administer tools and platforms including Microsoft 365, Zoho Workplace and other Zoho applications, AWS, Apollo, Tailscale, Cloudflare, Cursor, AI tools, and other current or future company applications.
* Provision, assign, modify, reclaim, and revoke licenses based on employee roles, requirements, and employment status.
* Maintain a centralized inventory of applications, including license counts, assigned users, subscription plans, renewal dates, costs, billing information, and application owners.
* Monitor license utilization and identify unused, duplicate, underutilized, or redundant subscriptions.
* Manage renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and vendor communications.
* Ensure license assignments comply with vendor licensing terms and organizational policies.

**2. User Access, Identity & Permission Management**

* Manage employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across all company applications.
* Configure and maintain role-based access control (RBAC), permissions, and access policies within each platform.
* Create and manage user groups, teams, departments, and permission groups to ensure the right employees have access to the appropriate features and resources.
* Implement least-privilege access principles and ensure access is granted based on business requirements.
* Review access rights periodically and remove unnecessary or outdated permissions.
* Administer multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and related identity and access management features where supported.
* Maintain auditable records of user access, license assignments, access changes, and administrative actions.
* Coordinate with department leads to understand access requirements and approve changes where necessary.

**3. IT Asset & Hardware Management**

* Manage the organization's hardware inventory, including laptops, peripherals, networking equipment, and other IT assets.
* Coordinate with approved vendors for laptop procurement, configuration, shipping, delivery, repairs, replacements, and warranty claims.
* Track device assignments, serial numbers, asset tags, specifications, purchase dates, warranty details, shipping status, and employee ownership.
* Ensure devices are prepared and delivered to employees before their joining dates, including remote employees where applicable.
* Maintain records of device allocation, returns, repairs, replacements, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate secure device setup, software installation, updates, and data removal when devices are issued, reassigned, or returned.
* Track hardware expenditure and identify opportunities to optimize procurement costs and device utilization.

**4. Cloud Infrastructure & Networking**

* Provide basic administration and operational support for cloud services, particularly AWS, including user access, permissions, account organization, resource visibility, and usage monitoring.
* Maintain a working understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, IP addressing, VPNs, routing, firewalls, connectivity, and network troubleshooting.
* Administer and support networking and connectivity tools such as Tailscale and Cloudflare, including relevant access policies, configurations, and user permissions.
* Assist with managing domains, DNS records, SSL/TLS certificates, and other related services where applicable.
* Troubleshoot routine connectivity, access, configuration, and endpoint issues.
* Coordinate with developers, cloud engineers, or external specialists for complex infrastructure changes, outages, or technical issues.
* Monitor cloud and service usage, flag unusual activity, and help identify cost optimization opportunities.

**5. IT Documentation, Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain a centralized and up-to-date IT asset and software inventory.
* Develop periodic reports covering:
* Software applications and subscription plans.
* Total licenses purchased, assigned, available, and unused.
* License costs, renewals, and upcoming contractual commitments.
* Employee access, user groups, roles, and permissions.
* Hardware inventory, assignments, procurement, and warranty status.
* Cloud service usage and relevant expenditure.
* Access reviews, offboarding completion, and outstanding IT issues.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for application administration, access requests, device management, and employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Maintain appropriate records to support internal audits, security reviews, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, accessible to authorized personnel, and updated whenever changes are made.

**6. Technology Evaluation & Cost Optimization**

* Evaluate new software, AI tools, productivity applications, and infrastructure solutions based on business requirements.
* Research alternatives to existing tools and compare features, pricing, security, integrations, scalability, and ease of use.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate applications, eliminate redundant subscriptions, negotiate better pricing, and optimize license allocation.
* Prepare recommendations for management, including cost-benefit comparisons and implementation considerations.
* Assess new AI tools and developer productivity platforms, including tools such as Cursor, against business needs and applicable security policies.
* Coordinate pilots, trials, and rollouts of approved tools.
* Maintain an up-to-date view of the organization's technology stack and recommend improvements as the company grows.

**7. Employee Training & IT Support**

* Help employees understand and use the company's software applications effectively.
* Conduct onboarding sessions, tool demonstrations, training workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Create user guides, FAQs, and documentation for frequently used tools and workflows.
* Assist employees with application access, license issues, permissions, device setup, connectivity, and routine technical problems.
* Promote the effective adoption of existing tools before recommending additional software.
* Track recurring IT issues and recommend process or configuration changes to prevent them.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration, IT operations, systems administration, SaaS administration, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience administering multiple SaaS applications, managing user accounts, and assigning software licenses.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Zoho applications, cloud platforms, and modern business productivity tools.
* Understanding of user provisioning, access controls, RBAC, user groups, MFA, and basic identity management.
* Working knowledge of AWS administration, account permissions, and cloud cost monitoring.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience managing hardware inventory, laptop procurement, vendor coordination, shipping, and asset tracking.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
* Ability to evaluate software products, compare alternatives, and make cost-conscious recommendations.
* Good communication skills and the ability to train employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and coordinate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with identity providers and SSO solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with endpoint management and device security solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools.
* Experience with IT asset management, SaaS management, or license optimization platforms.
* Basic understanding of cloud security, access auditing, backup practices, and incident response.
* Familiarity with AI productivity tools and developer tools, including enterprise account management and data security considerations.
* Experience creating automated workflows or scripts for user provisioning, reporting, and routine IT administration.
* Relevant certifications in Microsoft 365, AWS, networking, or IT service management are an advantage.

* Leading the technical design, setup, and integration of Ping Identity solutions across cloud and on-premises client environments
* Installing, upgrading, and configuring PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, and PingOne products in clustered environments
* Gathering business and technical requirements from client stakeholders and translating them into scalable identity and access management solution designs

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24x7 rotational shifts; flexibility for night, weekend, and holiday coverage; on-call support based on project assignment
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience with at least 2 Ping products, including PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, or PingOne
* Experience architecting and deploying Ping Identity solutions that support authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and policy enforcement
* Experience configuring single sign-on (SSO) and federation integrations using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC)

description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
With over 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business, or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking a
***PUNE***
based
***VP Database Operations Manager***
to join our
***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
in Global Technology & Operations.
  
  
**Team/Group Description**
This position operates in a fast-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
  
  
**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real-time global decision-making, powers enterprise-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent & ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long-term organizational objectives.

**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise-scale data infrastructure.
  
  
You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high-impact challenges.
  
  
With global scope, mission-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
  
  
**Professional development value of this role**
Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization - such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
  
  
**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Demonstrated success leading large-scale, global or multi-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission-critical system reliability.

**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.

**Skills**

* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase & IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.

**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**

* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Netrix Global is seeking a
**Network Engineer**
who will be responsible for maintaining and administering our client’s computer networks. Your primary duties will include maintenance of computer networks, hardware, software, and other related systems, performing disaster recovery operations, protecting data, software, and hardware from attacks, and replacing faulty network hardware components when necessary. You will also be working closely with the users of our network in order to identify potential issues and fix existing problems.
  
  
To be a successful candidate, you will need to have a strong understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware. You will also need to be able to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network devices including WAPs, firewalls, routers, switches, and controllers. A deep knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols is highly desired.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Maintaining and administering computer networks and related computing environments including systems software, applications software, hardware, and configurations.
* Performing disaster recovery operations and data backups when required.
* Protecting data, software, and hardware by coordinating, planning and implementing network security measures.
* Troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and other network and system problems.
* Monitoring network performance to determine if adjustments need to be made.
* Conferring with network users about solving existing system problems.
* Operating master consoles to monitor the performance of networks and computer systems.
* Coordinating computer network access and use.
* Provide specific detailed information for hardware and software selection.
* Ability to travel to client sites as needed, both locally and air travel in cases where necessary
* Availability to work all shifts as needed.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**

* Working experience/exposure on one or more of the following platforms:

+ Cisco
+ Juniper
+ Fortinet
+ Palo Alto
+ Sonicwall
+ Checkpoint
+ Ubiquiti
+ HP
+ Dell
+ Aruba
+ Arista
+ VMWare/Velocloud
+ Silverpeak
+ Meraki

* Certification level of CCNA route/switch or equivalent vendor preferred
* Associate’s degree in Information Technology related field of study with a network engineering focus preferred.
* Understanding of network infrastructure and network hardware and firmware.
* Ability to think through problems and visualize solutions.
* Ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers.
* Knowledge of application transport and network infrastructure protocols.
* Ability to create accurate network diagrams and documentation for design and planning network systems.
* Ability to quickly learn new or unfamiliar technology and products using available documentation and other resources.
* Ability to work with all levels of staff within and outside of IT and outside the organization.
* A self-starter able to work independently but comfortable working in a team environment.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Dependable and flexible when necessary.
* Network security experience preferred.

**Shift Timing**
: US business hours (8 am - 5pm CT), must work both weekends
  
  
**About Us**
At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.
  
  
We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!
  
  
Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today’s most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.
  
  
We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country’s top system integrators.
  
  
At Netrix, we’re driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Us**
We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.
  
  
To learn more about Netrix Global please go to www.netrixglobal.com

Under general direction of the designated Manager, individuals will be responsible for operations, installation, and performance of the SAP and Non-SAP Oracle database landscapes. **Technical Experience And Educational Requirements**

Ø Minimum 5-8 yrs of Professional and responsible experience as Oracle database Administrator, handling SAP & Non-SAP DBs (12c to 19c) Infrastructure activities.
  
  
Ø Manage and monitor Oracle databases required for Non-prod and Prod DBs running on Exadata environment.
  
  
Ø Install, configure, and maintenance of Oracle databases 12c to 19c running on Exadata environment.

Ø Creating standby database (Active Data Guard), configure Data Guard broker and maintenance.
  
  
Ø Resolve standby database out of sync and other generic issues related to data guard environment.
  
  
Ø Perform DR drill activity for Active Data Guard, Cascade and Snapshot standby databases.
  
  
Ø Configure physical backup and recovery strategies using Oracle’s RMAN utility to ZDLRA/ZFS appliance.
  
  
Ø Restoring and recovery of Oracle databases in various scenarios.
  
  
Ø Experience on ZDLRA appliance for Oracle database backup as plus
  
  
Ø Logical backup and restore using Data pump (expdp & impdp) utility.
  
  
Ø Add, delete/drop disks for storage management & performance in ASM environment.
  
  
Ø Generate, review, and analyze AWR, ASH and ADDM Report for database performance analysis.
  
  
Ø Knowledge of Performance Tuning – SQL queries, Database and RMAN backup.
  
  
Ø Good basic knowledge of the Oracle RAC environment on Exadata environment.
  
  
Ø Patches apply (RU/RUR/MRP/One-off) for GRID/DB homes (RAC) using rolling fashion method on Exadata environment.
  
  
Ø Troubleshoot cluster related issues using srvctl or crsctl utility or by reviewing cluster logs.
  
  
Ø Add, configure, monitor HA services and workload mgmt. for application batch or report jobs.
  
  
Ø Experience with Oracle Partitioning, Oracle Advanced Compression, Oracle Transparent Data Encryption
  
  
Ø Knowledge of Oracle Enterprise Manager 13cR5 Grid Control for DBA environment.
  
  
Ø Install, configure, and maintain OEM agent (13cR5) on RAC environment.
  
  
Ø Good knowledge of Oracle Exadata Machine architecture and all component layers.
  
  
Ø Good understanding of Exadata Features & functionality - Smart Scan, Storage Indexes, Smart Flash Cache, IORM, DBRM etc.
  
  
Ø Monitor and manage Exadata Machine for mission critical databases - Compute, Storage, Network, PDU.
  
  
Ø Troubleshot Hardware failure events, break-fix & follow-up with Oracle support for the part replacement.
  
  
Ø Raise priority SR for critical issues or own open ASR issues and work with Oracle platinum team.
  
  
Ø Raise Patch request with Oracle Platinum team for scheduling the patch/upgrade activity on the Exadata machines
  
  
Ø Provide the DBA support during the patching event (Monthly/Quarterly) for Exadata environment.
  
  
Ø Review performance metrics for Exadata machine via OEM Console -- CPU/Memory/IO/Network etc.
  
  
Ø Generate Exa check report and review on Monthly basis for score analysis on Exadata environment.
  
  
Ø Generate AWR/ASH/ADDM reports for Exadata machine periodically, review and performance tuning.
  
  
Ø Provide support for database issues on 24x7 (on-call) and responding to critical situations.
  
  
Ø SNOW ticket tool to handle INC, CHG, REQ, PBI, and Jira Tool for user/project requests (SRs).
  
  
Ø Escalation to oracle support on issues related to all environments (Production, Test and Development).
  
  
Ø Knowledge of Azure/OCI cloud for Oracle database environment as plus.
  
  
**Minimum Interpersonal Skills, Knowledge And Ability Requirements**
Ø Must have experience installing and supporting Oracle RAC databases.
  
  
Ø Minimum 5-8 yrs. Oracle database experience, with multiple installations.
  
  
Ø Experience with Oracle ZDLRA appliance for backups a plus.
  
  
Ø Ability to foster innovation and “out of the box” thinking while ensuring practical applications
  
  
Ø Ability to direct the formulation, definition and documenting of system architecture and objectives for assigned projects
  
  
Ø Solid understanding of business requirements and ability to prepare architectural specifications from which applications will be designed
  
  
Ø Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, good group presentation skills
  
  
Ø Strong organizational skills, Good analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills to evaluate business problems and apply technology knowledge to identify appropriate solutions
  
  
Ø Good interpersonal skills; effective team player, Excellent discovery and active listening skills
  
  
Ø Good relationship building skills, Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
  
  
Ø Knowledge of computers to operative effectively with computer hardware such as general mainframe, midrange, network and desktop technologies; computer software includes application development lifecycle, ServiceNow, MS Office Suite and Outlook

Ø Experience with Oracle Partitioning, Oracle Advanced Compression, Oracle Transparent Data Encryption

Ø Knowledge of Oracle Enterprise Manager 13cR5 Grid Control for DBA environment.
