title: ICT Active Head
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION – ICT ACTIVE HEAD
  
  
Company: Labotek Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
  
Department: IT / ICT / Infrastructure
  
Designation: ICT Active Head
  
Reporting To: Project Head / IT Head / Technical Head
  
Location: CCS
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
## 1. Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient ICT Active Head to lead and manage active IT infrastructure systems, including network switches, routers, servers, wireless networks, CCTV, Access Control Systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and related ICT infrastructure.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for technical planning, system configuration, implementation, troubleshooting, commissioning, team management, and project coordination. The role requires strong knowledge of networking, data centre infrastructure, system integration, and ICT operations, along with excellent reporting and documentation skills.
  
  
## 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
### A. ICT Active Infrastructure Management
  
- Lead the implementation, configuration, integration, and commissioning of active ICT infrastructure systems.
  
- Manage network switches, routers, servers, wireless access points, network controllers, and associated equipment.
  
- Oversee the installation, configuration, and integration of CCTV surveillance systems, Access Control Systems, and BMS interfaces, as applicable to project scope.
  
- Ensure proper connectivity and integration between active equipment and passive infrastructure, including racks, patch panels, Cat-6 cabling, and fibre-optic networks.
  
- Ensure systems operate efficiently and comply with approved technical specifications and project requirements.
  
  
### B. Network Planning & Configuration
  
- Plan and manage network architecture, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, switching, and network segmentation as required.
  
- Configure and troubleshoot managed switches, routers, servers, and other active network devices.
  
- Coordinate network connectivity, fibre links, patching, and equipment integration with passive infrastructure teams.
  
- Monitor network performance, connectivity, availability, and system reliability.
  
- Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, configuration backups, and other technical documentation.
  
  
### C. CCTV, Access Control & BMS Integration
  
- Supervise the configuration, testing, and commissioning of CCTV cameras, Network Video Recorders (NVRs), Video Management Systems (VMS), and associated network components.
  
- Oversee the integration and operation of Access Control Systems, including controllers, readers, and management software.
  
- Coordinate the integration of BMS interfaces with relevant ICT and monitoring systems, where applicable.
  
- Troubleshoot communication, connectivity, configuration, and integration issues.
  
- Ensure system functionality is verified against approved drawings, specifications, and client requirements.
  
  
### D. Project Execution & Site Coordination
  
- Plan and monitor ICT active system installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning activities at the CCS site.
  
- Prepare project schedules, resource plans, deployment plans, and activity trackers.
  
- Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, technicians, vendors, consultants, and client representatives.
  
- Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
  
- Identify technical risks, material requirements, site constraints, and dependencies, and escalate issues to management.
  
- Ensure the availability of approved drawings, equipment, software licences, and other required resources.
  
  
### E. Testing, Commissioning & Quality Assurance
  
- Prepare and execute testing and commissioning plans for active ICT systems.
  
- Verify equipment configuration, connectivity, performance, and interoperability.
  
- Ensure compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, manufacturer recommendations, and applicable standards.
  
- Conduct site inspections and quality checks to identify and resolve installation or configuration deficiencies.
  
- Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), system demonstrations, and client handovers.
  
- Ensure all observations and defects are documented, tracked, and closed within agreed timelines.
  
  
### F. Troubleshooting & Technical Support
  
- Lead the diagnosis and resolution of network outages, hardware failures, configuration issues, and system integration problems.
  
- Provide technical guidance to engineers and technicians during installation, testing, and maintenance.
  
- Coordinate with OEMs, system integrators, and vendors for technical support and warranty-related issues.
  
- Analyse recurring faults and implement corrective and preventive measures.
  
- Support preventive maintenance and operational continuity of deployed ICT systems.
  
  
### G. Team Leadership & Resource Management
  
- Lead, supervise, and mentor ICT engineers, network engineers, technicians, and other assigned team members.
  
- Allocate responsibilities and monitor daily work progress.
  
- Review manpower deployment, productivity, work quality, and adherence to project schedules.
  
- Conduct technical briefings and knowledge-sharing sessions for the team.
  
- Ensure team members follow site safety requirements and approved working procedures.
  
  
### H. Documentation & Management Reporting
  
- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports.
  
- Develop professional PowerPoint presentations, Excel trackers, dashboards, and technical reports for management and client reviews.
  
- Maintain network diagrams, equipment lists, configuration records, test reports, snag lists, and commissioning documentation.
  
- Prepare material requirement lists, technical compliance reports, and equipment status updates.
  
- Maintain as-built drawings, operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals, warranty details, and handover records.
  
- Report project delays, technical challenges, resource gaps, and corrective action plans to management.
  
  
### I. Client, Vendor & Internal Coordination
  
- Act as the technical point of contact for ICT active systems at the assigned site.
  
- Coordinate with clients, consultants, OEMs, vendors, and internal project teams.
  
- Participate in technical meetings, progress reviews, inspections, and commissioning discussions.
  
- Ensure timely resolution of client observations and technical queries.
  
- Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure the timely availability of approved equipment and materials.
  
  
### J. Safety, Security & Compliance
  
- Ensure compliance with company policies, site safety procedures, and applicable technical standards.
  
- Follow secure network configuration practices, access control procedures, password management, and configuration backup protocols.
  
- Ensure appropriate protection of client data, system credentials, and confidential technical information.
  
- Maintain proper records of system changes, configuration updates, and maintenance activities.
  
  
## 3. Educational Qualifications
  
  
- B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Instrumentation Engineering.
  
- Relevant certifications in networking, cybersecurity, CCTV, or ICT infrastructure will be an added advantage.
  
  
## 4. Experience Required
  
  
- Minimum 8-15 years of relevant experience in ICT active infrastructure, network implementation, system integration, or infrastructure projects.
  
- Prior experience leading engineers and technicians at project sites is preferred.
  
- Hands-on experience with network switches, routers, servers, IP networking, CCTV, Access Control Systems, and BMS integration.
  
- Experience in data centres, government infrastructure projects, or large-scale ICT deployments will be preferred.
  
  
## 5. Technical Skills
  
  
- Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, and IP addressing.
  
- Practical experience with managed switches, routers, servers, and network troubleshooting.
  
- Understanding of fibre-optic and structured cabling infrastructure.
  
- Knowledge of CCTV, NVR/VMS, Access Control Systems, and BMS integration.
  
- Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and project reporting.
  
- Ability to read technical drawings, network diagrams, BOQs, and equipment specifications.
  
- Familiarity with network monitoring tools, configuration management, and testing procedures.
  
  
## 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
- Timely completion of ICT active installation and commissioning activities.
  
- Network and system availability, stability, and reliability.
  
- Successful completion of testing, integration, and client acceptance.
  
- Reduction in recurring technical faults and resolution time.
  
- Compliance with approved technical specifications and quality standards.
  
- Timely submission and accuracy of project reports and documentation.
  
- Effective utilisation and productivity of deployed manpower.
  
- Timely closure of site observations, snags, and client complaints.
  
- Compliance with safety, security, and project procedures.
  
  
## 7. Preferred Qualifications
  
  
- Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or relevant vendor-specific ICT certifications.
  
- Knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals and network security practices.
  
- Experience with data centre infrastructure and monitoring systems.
  
- Familiarity with AutoCAD, network design tools, and project management software.
  
- Experience with government, enterprise, or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  
  
## 8. Working Conditions
  
  
- The position is site-based at CCS and may require travel to other project locations as per business requirements.
  
- Flexibility to work beyond standard working hours during critical installations, testing, commissioning, or project deadlines.
  
- Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and work effectively under pressure.

description:
**Meet the Team**
At Splunk and Cisco, we believe in turning data into answers. As a Professional Services Architect (Security), you will be the technical and strategic authority for our Security portfolio and a Trusted Advisor to our customers. You will architect solutions across our SIEM and SOAR ecosystems, including Splunk Enterprise Security, UEBA, and SOAR. You aren’t just deploying software; you are architecting outcomes that protect organizations from the next generation of threats, with the opportunity to take ownership of your work, learn from industry leaders, and play a vital role in a team that celebrates collective success. * Foster Growth: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, mentoring team members and contributing to a collaborative, high-performance environment.

description:
**Job Description**
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA L3 FICO Consultant
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA L3 FICO Consultant to provide advanced functional support, incident resolution, enhancements, and continuous improvement for SAP Finance and Controlling processes. The consultant will serve as the escalation point for complex FICO issues, collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams, and ensure stable, compliant, and efficient SAP S/4HANA operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide Level 3 functional support for SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling modules.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production incidents, recurring issues, and root causes within agreed SLAs.
* Configure and support SAP S/4HANA FICO processes, including:
* General Ledger Accounting (GL)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Asset Accounting (AA)
* Bank Accounting and Cash Management
* Cost Center Accounting
* Profit Center Accounting
* Internal Orders
* Product Costing and CO-PA / Margin Analysis
* Tax configuration and statutory reporting support
* Support period-end and year-end closing activities, including reconciliations, financial reporting, allocations, settlements, depreciation runs, and foreign currency valuation.
* Investigate integration issues between FICO and other SAP modules, including MM, SD, PP, PM, PS, and Treasury, as applicable.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring issues.
* Gather business requirements, prepare functional specifications, and coordinate with ABAP, Basis, Security, and integration teams.
* Support change requests, minor enhancements, testing, transport management, and deployment activities.
* Prepare test scenarios, conduct unit testing, support SIT/UAT, and coordinate defect resolution.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, financial compliance, and change-management processes.
* Maintain functional documentation, configuration documents, support knowledge articles, and process flows.
* Work closely with finance users, business process owners, and external vendors to improve system performance and usability.
* Participate in SAP S/4HANA upgrades, rollouts, migrations, and transformation initiatives when required.
* Mentor L1/L2 support resources and provide subject-matter expertise for FICO-related issues.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 5–8+ years of SAP FICO functional consulting experience, including significant experience in SAP S/4HANA.
* Strong hands-on configuration knowledge in SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling.
* Experience providing L3 production support in a global or enterprise SAP environment.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial closing processes, and controlling processes.
* Experience with:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA
* New Asset Accounting
* S/4HANA Finance data model
* Fiori applications for Finance
* Parallel ledgers, document splitting, and multi-currency scenarios
* Intercompany accounting and reconciliation
* Knowledge of integration points between FICO and MM, SD, PP, and other SAP modules.
* Ability to write clear functional specifications and work effectively with ABAP developers.
* Experience with SAP Solution Manager, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar incident/change-management tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize critical issues, and manage multiple support requests.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification.
* Experience with Central Finance, Group Reporting, Treasury, Cash Management, or SAC financial reporting.
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori, embedded analytics, CDS views, and reporting tools.
* Experience in SAP ECC to S/4HANA conversion or greenfield implementation projects.
* Experience working in Agile, ITIL, or DevOps-based support environments.
* CPA, CA, CMA, ACCA, or other finance/accounting qualification is an advantage.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Advanced SAP FICO troubleshooting and configuration expertise
* Strong financial and accounting process knowledge
* Root cause analysis and issue-resolution capability
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Documentation and change-control discipline
* Customer-focused communication
* Ability to work under pressure during financial close cycles

title: Security Analyst
description:
**Role Summary :**

The Senior Endpoint Vulnerability Analyst supports vulnerability remediation efforts across enterprise endpoints (laptops, servers), network devices, cloud instances and Application environments. This role executes the vulnerability remediation lifecycle for assigned work—triage, risk-based prioritization, root-cause analysis, solution validation, deployment coordination, and reporting—partnering with security, operations, engineering, dark web, brand Monitoring and application teams. The ideal candidate demonstrates endpoint technical depth, works independently on complex issues, contributes to automation and process improvements, and supports governance activities (SLAs, exception handling, and risk reporting) that improve the firm’s overall risk posture.

**Responsibilities:**

• Monitor and analyze endpoint vulnerability findings using VA tools

• Assess findings to determine business impact, root cause, and remediation requirements

• Apply risk-based prioritization aligned to vulnerability severity, exploitability, asset criticality, and remediation SLAs

• Coordinate endpoint remediation activities, including Windows and macOS updates and configuration changes

• Patch management activities (OS and third-party applications)

• Partner with testing teams to validate remediation solutions prior to deployment

• Create and manage ServiceNow incidents/requests and change records; support the change management process

• Coordinate remediation execution with cross-functional teams (testing, deployment, operations, policy, and application owners)

• Provide endpoint troubleshooting support related to vulnerabilities and remediation deployments

• Facilitate meetings with internal teams (and business partners, as needed) to drive timely vulnerability resolution

• Maintain remediation tracking data (task lists, status, owners, and timelines)

• Prepare regular status reporting on remediation progress, exceptions, and outstanding risk

• Support remediation exceptions and risk acceptance/waiver workflows; ensure documentation and approvals meet governance requirements

• Produce and communicate vulnerability remediation metrics (e.g., aging, SLA attainment, recurrence) and provide insights to support decision-making.

• Use AI platforms to create dashboard and improvise real time vulnerabillity tracking and reporting

• Prioritize and manage multiple concurrent remediation efforts in a deadline-driven environment

• Follow established security, operational, and documentation standards; document work performed and outcomes

• Build strong working relationships with partner teams to ensure consistent remediation outcomes

• Identify recurring remediation gaps and contribute to process improvements (standard operating procedures, playbooks, automation) to reduce repeat vulnerabilities.

• Monitor dark web, deep web, Telegram and threat forums for organisational exposure, leaked credentials and sensitive data.

• Monitor brand impersonation, phishing websites, fake domains, typo squatting and fraudulent social media accounts.

• Identify and assess credential leaks, data leaks and emerging threats impacting the organisation, brands and executives.

• Coordinate takedown of malicious domains, phishing sites and impersonation accounts.

• Triage alerts, assess risk and coordinate remediation with SOC, IT, Legal and business teams.

• Maintain threat exposure dashboards and management reports with key risks and remediation status.

• Integrate relevant intelligence and IOCs with SIEM/SOC operations for proactive threat detection.

**People Management :**

The incumbent holds no direct supervisory responsibilities but is expected to engage effectively within their function and collaboratively across cross-functional teams. This role contributes meaningfully, whether through operational contributions and/or by offering specialized expertise, guidance, and support, to ensure alignment with either functional and/or strategic organizational goals and objectives.

**People / Technical Competencies :**

Experience with vulnerability scanning and reporting tools (e.g., Tenable/Nessus)

Experience with endpoint security, patching, or vulnerability remediation processes

PowerShell scripting skills (writing, testing, troubleshooting, or modifying scripts)

Working knowledge of AI platforms and new tools utilisation

Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for tracking and communication

Experience using ticketing and change management platforms

Experience with remote support and troubleshooting tools.

**Experience:**
4+ years of experience in vulnerability management, patch management, or a closely related discipline

title: Systems Engineering Specialist- EUC Applications Packaging Engineer
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Specialist- EUC Applications Packaging Engineer to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
  
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Advanced Application Packaging
  

* Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
* Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
* Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
* Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
* Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
* Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.

Compatibility Remediation
  

* Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
* Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
* Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures — custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
* Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
* Assess applications for MSIX packaging suitability and document conversion feasibility with recommended approach.

Deployment Integration Automation
  

* Build SCCM application models with complex detection methods, global conditions, requirement rules, and multi-deployment-type configurations.
* Develop PowerShell automation scripts for batch packaging operations, package validation, and SCCM/Intune inventory reporting.
* Integrate packaging workflows with software delivery pipelines — scripted uploads to Intune via Graph API, SCCM package import automation.
* Support Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline integration for automated package build and test workflows.
* Develop and maintain packaging test scripts for regression automation on golden image environments.

Quality Governance
  

* Define and enforce packaging standards, quality checklists, and peer review processes for the India packaging team.
* Conduct technical review of packages produced by junior packagers and provide structured feedback.
* Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.
* Contribute to SLA governance by tracking packaging queue metrics, turnaround times, and defect rates.
* Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
* MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
* Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
* PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
* Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
* Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
* Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
* Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
* Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent senior enterprise packaging experience will be considered.

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**

**What You’ll Do**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

* Detail-oriented and hands-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer-facing, fast-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.

* Accurate and reliable platform configurations.
* Stable day-to-day CCaaS operations and timely issue resolution.
* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

title: IAM Engineer
description:
Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, you will design, build and operate identity services that secure access to Macquarie’s Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) platforms while supporting their reliability, security and continuous improvement. You will provide trusted advisory support on UAM governance, operating models, risk management and roadmaps, while contributing to assurance, audit and risk oversight activities. Working within an Agile team, you will collaborate with identity, platform and application teams across the full engineering lifecycle, from solution design and development through to production support.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* 5+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), including User Access Management (UAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and access governance frameworks.
* Strong understanding of access governance controls, including User Access Reviews (UAR), Access Profile Reviews (APR), Segregation of Duties (SoD), and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Sound knowledge of end-to-end access lifecycle management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, certification, and access control best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with technology, cyber security, risk, audit, and business teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and continuous improvement mindset, with experience working in Agile environments and leveraging automation and cloud-based technologies.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

**About Technology**
Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.
  
  
**Inclusion at Macquarie**
We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.
  
  
We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**Technical Account Engineer - I ( Noida)**
Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.
  
  
**About The Role**
Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.
  
  
Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.
  
  
You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.
  
  
**What You Will Actually Do**

* Own your named accounts technically. Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
* Get customers using the platform extensively. Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
* Craft success plans that can be measured. Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
* See trouble coming. Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
* Run the cadence. Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
* Help the accounts grow. Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.
* Make the team better. Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

**Where and When**

* This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
* Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
* You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
* Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.
* A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
* Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
* A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

**The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See**

* Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
* A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
* Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
* Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.

**Global Managed Service – Identity and access Management – Senior**
The Okta Provisioning Senior Consultant is a critical role responsible for overseeing and ensuring the effective management of user identities and access permissions within an organization using the Okta Identity Management platform. This senior-level position involves leading provisioning processes, developing strategies for integration and automation, and ensuring compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**

* Lead the administration and management of user accounts, roles, and access rights within the Okta platform.
* Design and implement efficient user provisioning and de-provisioning workflows in collaboration with HR, IT, and security teams.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Okta authentication, authorization, SSO, and MFA solutions.
* Oversee the integration of new applications with Okta and ensure seamless SSO experiences across the organization.
* Develop and maintain IAM policies, procedures, and documentation, ensuring they are up-to-date and compliant with industry standards.

title: Junior System Administrator
description:
**Designation:** Junior System Administrator  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Qualification:** Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology,

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Junior System Administrator to support and maintain the company's computer systems, hardware, network infrastructure, and IT services. The candidate will be responsible for providing day-to-day technical support to employees, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and ensuring the smooth functioning of IT operations.

2. Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. System Hardware and Maintenance

* Install, configure, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Troubleshoot hardware failures and perform basic repairs and upgrades.
* Maintain system inventory, asset records, and warranty details.
* Perform routine preventive maintenance of IT equipment.
* Coordinate with hardware vendors and service providers for repairs and replacements.

B. Networking and Connectivity

* Basic knowledge of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.
* Configure and troubleshoot network connectivity issues.
* Assist in managing switches, routers, firewalls, and network cabling.
* Troubleshoot internet connectivity, IP address conflicts, and network access issues.
* Assist in network monitoring and maintaining network documentation.

C. Operating Systems and Software Support

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows operating systems and approved business applications.
* Support user account creation, password resets, and access permissions.
* Install authorized software, drivers, and system updates.
* Troubleshoot operating system errors, application issues, and system performance problems.

D. Server and IT Infrastructure Support

* Assist in basic server maintenance and monitoring.
* Support Active Directory and domain user management, where applicable.
* Assist with file-sharing permissions, shared folders, and printer access.
* Support data backup activities and verify backup status.
* Escalate critical server and infrastructure issues to the senior IT administrator.

E. IT Support and Security

* Provide technical support to employees for hardware, software, email, and network-related issues.
* Record, track, and resolve IT support tickets within the required timelines.
* Follow IT security policies, antivirus procedures, and access-control requirements.
* Ensure proper handling of company data and confidential information.
* Prevent unauthorized software installations and use of external storage devices as per company policy.

F. Documentation and Administration

* Maintain IT asset registers, software licence records, and maintenance logs.
* Document troubleshooting procedures and recurring technical issues.
* Track IT consumables, spare parts, and equipment service requests.
* Support IT audits and other IT-related administrative activities.

3. Required Technical Skills

* Basic knowledge of computer hardware, assembly, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Working knowledge of Windows 10/11 installation and configuration.
* Basic networking knowledge, including LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.
* Familiarity with routers, switches, Wi-Fi access points, and network cabling.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365, Outlook, and email configuration.
* Understanding of antivirus, endpoint security, backups, and data protection.
* Good troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

4. Preferred Skills

* Basic exposure to Windows Server and Active Directory.
* Familiarity with firewall and VPN troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and user account management.
* Basic knowledge of remote desktop support tools and IT ticketing systems.
* Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, CCNA, or Microsoft fundamentals are an advantage.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely resolution of IT support requests.
* Reduction in recurring hardware and network issues.
* Proper maintenance of IT assets and inventory records.
* Completion of scheduled preventive maintenance.
* Compliance with IT security policies and software licensing requirements.
* Timely escalation and documentation of critical issues.
* Employee satisfaction with IT support services.

6. Personal Attributes

* Willingness to learn and develop technical skills.
* Good problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Strong communication and teamwork.
* Responsible handling of company equipment and confidential information.
* Ability to support employees across departments and company locations.

**Reporting To:** IT Admin Manager.

Benefits:

* Life insurance

title: Associate Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an Associate Cloud Operations Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team and support reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient production platforms across a multi-cloud, multi-region environment.

The Associate Cloud Operations Engineer is a
*hands-on, database-focused role*
responsible for executing well-defined operational and database administration activities, handling routine service requests, following established procedures, and assisting with production support for SaaS services and cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have foundational knowledge of databases and cloud technologies, with a strong interest in developing their skills in Cloud Operations and Database Administration.

The Associate Cloud Operations Engineer will work alongside experienced Cloud Operations engineers and collaborate with other teams to support day-to-day operations, database activities, production monitoring, incident resolution, automation, and continuous improvement. The role provides an opportunity to progressively develop the technical expertise and operational experience required to independently support the team’s platforms.

This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in our Bangalore office.

**Job Requirements:**

* 0–2 years of experience in database administration, cloud operations, infrastructure support, DevOps, or a related technical role.
* Foundational knowledge of Oracle RDBMS.
* Basic understanding of relational database concepts, SQL, backup and recovery, and database performance fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Basic understanding of Linux and command-line operations.
* Exposure to shell scripting, Python, or similar scripting languages is preferred.
* Ability to follow documented operational procedures and work effectively within established processes.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Willingness to participate in maintenance activities and, after appropriate training, an on-call rotation.
* AWS, Azure, or any database-related certifications are a plus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Follow documented processes and procedures to support Oracle, PostgreSQL and MySQL databases.
* Handle service requests and operational tickets in accordance with established processes and SLA requirements.
* Perform routine database administration and maintenance activities according to established operational standards and runbooks.
* Monitor production and non-production environments, respond to alerts, and follow documented troubleshooting and escalation procedures.
* Perform database schema maintenance and migrations using documented procedures and change-management processes.
* Execute database backup, restore, and recovery activities by following established runbooks and validation procedures.
* Use SQL and basic shell/Python scripting to perform routine operational, troubleshooting, and automation activities.
* Support database performance troubleshooting by gathering required information, performing documented checks, and escalating complex issues to senior engineers when needed.
* Perform tenant rebalancing and other scheduled maintenance activities by following established procedures and change controls.
* Follow security, access management, change management, incident management, and other Cloud Operations processes.
* Maintain accurate documentation and update operational runbooks when processes or procedures change.
* Work with experienced engineers to troubleshoot issues that fall outside established procedures or require deeper technical expertise.
* Continuously develop technical knowledge across the databases, cloud platforms, and operational tools supported by the team.
* Participate in the team's 24x7 on-call rotation after completing the required training, demonstrating readiness, and becoming familiar with the applicable operational runbooks.

* Design, develop, and operate scalable and maintainable data pipelines in the Azure Databricks environment
* Develop all technical artefacts as code, implemented in professional IDEs, with full version control and CI/CD automation
* Enable data-driven decision-making in Supply Chain Management (SCM) by ensuring high data availability, quality, and reliability
* Implement data products and analytical assets using software engineering principles in close alignment with business domains and functional IT
* Apply rigorous software engineering practices such as modular design, test-driven development, and artifact reuse in all implementations

**Dimensions/ Organization/ Magnitude**

* Global delivery footprint; cross-functional data engineering support across SCM domains
* Collaboration with business stakeholders, functional IT partners, product owners, architects, ML/AI engineers, and Power BI developers
* Agile, product-team structure embedded in an enterprise-scale Azure & Azure Databricks environment

**Main Tasks**

* Data Pipeline Development
* Design scalable batch and streaming pipelines in Azure Databricks using PySpark and/or Scala
* Implement ingestion from structured and semi-structured sources (e.g., SAP, APIs, flat files)
* Build bronze/silver/gold data layers following the defined lakehouse layering architecture & governance
* Data & Analytics business applications
* Implement use-case driven dimensional models (star/snowflake schema) tailored to SCM needs
* Ensure compatibility with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) via curated data marts and semantic models
* Data Warehouse Integration
* Implement enterprise-level data warehouse models (domain-driven 3NF models) for SCM data, closely aligned with data engineers for other business domains
* Develop and apply master data management strategies (e.g., Slowly Changing Dimensions)
* Data Quality & Testing
* Develop automated data validation tests using frameworks
* Monitor pipeline health, identify anomalies, and implement quality thresholds
* Establish data quality transparency by defining and implementing meaningful data quality rules with source system and business stakeholders and implementing related reports
* Data Engineering Excellence
* Develop and structure pipelines using modular, reusable code in a professional IDE
* Apply test-driven development (TDD) principles with automated unit, integration, and validation tests
* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fail-fast deployment strategies
* Commit all artifacts to version control with peer review and CI/CD integration
* Collaboration & Requirements Engineering
* Work closely with Product Owners to refine user stories and define acceptance criteria
* Translate business requirements into data contracts and technical specifications
* Participate in agile events such as sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
* Documentation & Governance
* Document pipeline logic, data contracts, and technical decisions in markdown or auto-generated docs from code
* Align designs with governance and metadata standards (e.g., Unity Catalog)
* Track lineage and audit trails through integrated tooling
* Performance Optimization
* Profile and tune data transformation performance
* Reduce job execution times and optimize cluster resource usage
* Refactor legacy pipelines or inefficient transformations to improve scalability

**Qualifications**
**Required knowledge:**

* Strong experience with modern data engineering technologies, including Azure Databricks, PySpark, Scala, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2).
* Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT architecture, orchestration frameworks, and scalable data platform design.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, Git-based development workflows, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Proficiency in agile software delivery methods, including Scrum, SAFe, test-driven development, and collaborative development practices.
* Good knowledge of data warehouse concepts, including dimensional modeling, normalization, star schemas, and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCDs).
* Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and best practices for operating lakehouse environments.
* Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting solutions, preferably including Power BI and tabular analysis tools.
* Basic understanding of advanced analytics, data mining, machine learning concepts, and AI-driven use cases.
* Knowledge of AI services, large language models (LLMs), and API integration concepts.
* Understanding of supply chain management processes, data structures, and business KPIs is beneficial.

**Education / Certification:**
Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
  
  
Certifications in software development and data engineering (e.g., Databricks DE Associate, Azure Data Engineer, or relevant DevOps certifications).
  
  
**Professional Experience:**
3–6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering roles in enterprise environments. Demonstrated experience building production-grade codebases in IDEs, with test coverage and version control.
  
  
**Project and/or Process Experience:**
Proven experience in implementing complex data pipelines and contributing to full lifecycle data projects (development to deployment)
  
  
Experience in at least one business domain: SCM or a comparable field
  
  
**Leadership Experience:**
Not required; however, experience mentoring junior developers or leading implementation workstreams is a plus
  
  
**Intercultural / International Experience:**
Experience working in international teams across multiple time zones and cultures, preferably with teams in India, Germany, and the Philippines.

title: Sr Specialist, Information Technology
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 
  
  
**Your Role at Baxter**
As Senior Software Engineer / Software Architect, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for critical healthcare product platforms in regulated environments, setting strategic technology direction while contributing directly to software development, modernization, incident resolution, and continual service improvement. You will design and deliver secure, reliable, maintainable software, guide engineers, govern technical decisions, and support production services. Working across architecture, engineering, delivery, quality, validation, infrastructure, security, and product teams, you will enable frequent value delivery while maintaining appropriate GxP, risk-management, and change-control practices.
  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* Mentor engineers and promote ownership, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence, including code quality and maintainability.
* Establish and apply development standards, coding guidelines, architectural principles, secure development practices, and technical governance; lead architecture, design, and code reviews.
* Partner with Product, Quality, Validation, Infrastructure, Security, and business stakeholders to plan, estimate, prioritize, and deliver compliant releases from concept through production.
* Support global business-critical applications by leading complex troubleshooting, incident response, root-cause analysis, and remediation, and by driving resilience improvements, observability, monitoring, performance optimization, and continual service improvement.
* Ensure development and release activities meet applicable GxP, quality, security, and validation expectations, including governance, change control, risk management, and audit and inspection readiness.
* Use and promote AI-assisted engineering responsibly to improve development, code review, documentation, analysis, testing, and modernization, while validating outputs and applying appropriate governance and human oversight.

**What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, a related discipline, or country equivalent is preferred; 12+ years equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Advanced practical knowledge of software engineering, object-oriented design, design patterns, application architecture, and secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Strong commercial experience with C#/.NET, PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor), modern web technologies, REST APIs, SQL, and relational database design.
* Experience designing, developing, and supporting web applications and distributed systems, including ASP.NET solutions, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS front ends, authentication and identity solutions, and API integrations.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Web Services, cloud-native design concepts, infrastructure and application hosting models, monitoring and observability, CI/CD, DevOps principles, and cloud security controls.
* Proven ability to lead and mentor engineers, influence technical direction, communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, resolve complex problems, and make pragmatic decisions that balance immediate delivery with long-term sustainability.
* Experience leading technical improvement and supporting critical production applications throughout the delivery lifecycle, within structured governance, risk, release, and change-management processes.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted software development tools responsibly, including assessing output quality, recognizing limitations, and protecting sensitive information
* Comfortable working through ambiguity and competing priorities, collaborating across functions with a high level of accountability and ownership.
* Significant experience as a Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead, Software Architect, or comparable role delivering complex enterprise software across multiple technologies and architectural patterns.
* Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical technology, or another regulated industry, including knowledge of GxP, computerized system validation, software validation, quality management, and regulated change control, is preferred.
* Experience with global healthcare platforms, cloud modernization, or technical governance forums such as architecture review boards or technical councils is a plus.

title: Senior / Lead Platform Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**About Cogentiq I2C**
Cogentiq I2C is Fractal's agentic AI platform for invoice-to-cash operations, spanning Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Credit Risk, and Invoice Management. The platform runs on a four-tier architecture: a Next.js application layer, FastAPI services, the Cogentiq APA agentic orchestration layer, and a data estate built on Azure Databricks and PostgreSQL. Deployments land in client Azure tenancies against live ERP data (Dynamics 365, SAP), which means deployment engineering is a first-class discipline, not an afterthought to development.
  
  
**Why this role, now**
The platform has crossed from being built to being deployed. Collections is entering pilot with enterprise clients, and the deployment machinery is real: Databricks Asset Bundles with one-click, script-based deployment; auto-loader ingestion running historical and incremental loads into a common data model; versioned bundles and wheel-file packages delivered through Git and Azure Artifactory; and a quick-start standard under which a newcomer must be able to stand up the full data platform by running one setup script. This role carries that machinery into client environments and makes it hold under client governance, client data, and client timelines. It owns everything between our release artefacts and a running, observable, correctly governed installation; candidates who want to work on agent behaviour and LLM integration should apply to the AI FDE track instead.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the deployment architecture of client installations from environment readiness through hypercare: bundle strategy, environment topology (Dev, QA, production; per-client catalogs), release sequencing, and sign-off that the installation meets the validation standard.
* Navigate Unity Catalog and platform governance Client and internal IT control catalog and metastore provisioning, storage decisions, and access models. You will assess what their governance model means for our setup scripts, negotiate provisioning paths, and know when a shared-infrastructure convenience creates an SOW, NDA, or data-isolation problem that must be escalated rather than worked around.
* Set and enforce the platform engineering standards: idempotent, rerunnable deployments; fail-fast error handling with no silent except-and-continue paths; environment-variable-driven parameterisation with a single point of change per client value; and configuration conventions that hold across Databricks today and Fabric tomorrow.
* Own the shared utilities architecture: interface-function contracts and factory-pattern abstractions across Databricks, Fabric, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and storage back ends, packaged as versioned wheel files through Azure Artifactory, so swapping a client's platform is a configuration change, not a rewrite.
* Make the hard ingestion calls: auto-loader versus custom conflict-driven ingestion when the client will not provision Databricks, checkpoint and reprocessing strategy, retry and alerting design per pipeline, and writeback reliability to the application database.
* Run incident command during deployment and hypercare. When a deployment breaks in a client environment, you run the incident: triage across the data estate, the application database, and upstream ERP feeds; communicate honestly with the client; and land the fix and the post-incident correction to the playbook.
* Own the deployment playbook as a product. The quick-start guides, validation suites, and synthetic data configurations you leave behind must make the next deployment cheaper. The bar is that a newcomer deploys the platform from your playbook with one setup script.
* Coach junior Platform FDEs, reviewing their work against the standards you set and growing them toward deployment ownership.

**What You Need**

* 6 or more years in data platform or deployment engineering, with at least two years deploying into environments you did not control (client tenancies, regulated environments, or equivalent).
* Deep Azure Databricks: Asset Bundles, workflows, Unity Catalog and metastore governance, cluster and library management, service-principal automation, and the CLI.
* Strong Python and SQL, with the judgement to review pipeline code for idempotency, failure behaviour, and configuration hygiene, not just correctness.
* PostgreSQL in production: schema evolution, write reliability, connection behaviour under load.
* CI/CD for data platforms: Git-based release flows, semantic versioning, artefact repositories, and backward compatibility across component versions.
* Domain literacy in order-to-cash and accounts receivable data: invoices, receipts, remittances, customer masters, and ERP AR structures in Dynamics 365 or SAP. You cannot validate a deployment whose data you do not understand.
* Client-facing composure: you will be the technical face of the deployment to client IT and finance stakeholders.
* Nice to have: Microsoft Fabric, observability design (OpenTelemetry, Application Insights), and experience taking a data product through pilots at multiple clients in parallel.

**Success in the first year**

* Two client deployments taken from environment readiness through hypercare, each validated against the standard suite and signed off on schedule.
* A deployment playbook that demonstrably reduced the cost of the deployment that followed it, measured in elapsed time from access granted to validated installation.
* Platform standards (idempotency, fail-fast, parameterisation) adopted across the data engineering codebase, evidenced in review practice, not just documentation.

title: BI Data Engineer
description:
****Who we are****

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings. 

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

****About the Team and the Work****

The BI Engineering team owns the acquisition, storage, modelling and provisioning of data that powers reporting, billing, product decisions and, increasingly, operational features consumed by systems outside BI. Our Redshift-centred warehouse handles hundreds of millions of events a day across a wide suite of products, and the roadmap for the next 18-24 months is the longest and most ambitious it has ever been. We are leveraging AI Workflows and agents across the team for ETL monitoring, query optimisation, code generation, documentation, and performance monitoring. 

You'll join at a point where the team is moving beyond "keep the pipeline running" into four parallel streams of work:

* ****Redshift Optimisation:****

  Optimising cluster and table configurations, including distribution, sort keys, and compression, to improve query performance. Analysing long-running queries and applying query-level optimisations, while leveraging data aggregation and retention strategies to improve performance, reduce storage, and manage data growth effectively.
* ****Data Aggregation & Retention:****

  Designing and building roll-up layers that preserve analytical value while enabling safe deletion of raw-level data. This includes schema design, backfills, data reconciliation, and ensuring backward compatibility for existing reports and consumers.
* ****Data provision:****

  Enabling teams to access data by creating curated, fit-for-purpose datasets and APIs for product, operations, and integrator-facing systems. These externally consumed solutions require high availability and strong data reliability.
* ****Infrastructure and Performance.****

  Strengthening pipeline monitoring through automated setup and built-in notifications, while proactively identifying query optimisation opportunities and cost-efficiency improvements. Defining solutions to manage data limitations and retention, with data volume remaining a key constraint shaping the overall roadmap.

****What will you be doing at Yoti?****

* Own Redshift performance and capacity, balancing reliability, query performance, scalability, and cost.
* Design and deliver data aggregation and retention solutions, including roll-ups, reconciliation, backfills, and safe removal of historical source data.
* Build data-provisioning solutions for product, operational, and integrator-facing consumers, ensuring reliable and accurate access to curated data.
* Build and maintain reliable ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines, including third-party API integrations and failure handling.
* Establish data quality, reconciliation, and monitoring practices for critical data flows and reporting.
* Apply AI and automation to improve engineering workflows, monitoring, optimisation, and delivery.
* Make informed trade-offs between infrastructure improvements, feature delivery, and compliance priorities.

****Requirements / What are we looking for? (5+ years of experience required)****

****Essential - Redshift depth.****

Deep, hands-on Redshift experience is the single most important requirement. You should be able to talk credibly about:

* Distribution and sort key design, query optimisation, WLM/Auto WLM, concurrency scaling, and Short Query Acceleration.
* Vacuum, Analyse, table maintenance, and managing bloat and unsorted data at scale.
* Redshift Spectrum, external schemas, S3 integration, and cross-cluster data movement using Data Sharing, UNLOAD/COPY, and snapshots.
* Capacity planning, RA3 sizing, workload isolation, and cost optimization.

****Desirable****

* Strong SQL across Redshift and PostgreSQL, including complex queries, window functions, and query tuning.
* Strong Python skills for building ingestion, ETL/ELT, and reconciliation frameworks. Node.js or Go is a plus.
* Hands-on AWS experience across S3, MWAA/Airflow, Lambda, Glue, Athena, IAM, CloudWatch, RDS, and OpenSearch.
* Strong analytical data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling, SCDs, and scalable reporting structures.
* Experience integrating REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, retries, idempotency, and rate-limit handling.
* Experience with containerisation, orchestration, and CI/CD for data workflows.

****Interview Process****

Stage 1 - Call with a Talent acquisition Team member (30 minutes)

Stage 2 - Call with Data Engineer & Chief of Product Operations (60 minutes)

Stage 3 - Technical Evaluation 

****What’s in it for you?****

* Flexible working (Core working hours, Hybrid working)
* Performance based discretionary annual bonus
* LTIP (Long term incentive plan)
* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law
* PF as per law
* 18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Annually)
* 10 declared holidays (Annually)
* 5 fully paid days of Selfie Time - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etc
* Quarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs.
* Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc)

This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. We value a positive attitude and people who have a collaborative, creative and transparent approach to solving problems.

****AI Usage during the recruitment process****

AI Usage in Recruitment policy

to know more about how Yoti uses AI in the recruitment process and our stance on how candidates can use AI during the interview process.

****We believe in equal opportunities****

It takes a diverse community of passionate, talented and committed people to build a simpler, more secure way of proving identity. We’re an equal opportunity employer, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, with different outlooks and experiences.

**A Series A funded California based Software Development Company is Looking for:******
**Role Summary**
You''ll own the harder end of the platform — complex integrations, pipeline reliability at scale, and the architectural work that keeps a growing number of per-customer requirements sustainable. You''ll set the technical bar, review others'' work, mentor the junior engineer, and partner with the Lead on design decisions. You''re expected to operate with a high degree of independence and improve the system, not just feed it.
  
  
**What You''ll Do**

* Own complex, high-stakes integrations end-to-end — warehouse/database sources (Postgres/Supabase, Snowflake), custom-auth providers, and large historical backfills.
* Drive the platform & reliability workstream: incremental/watermark-based loading, resumable pipelines, dedup-aware serving, observability (SLOs, freshness alerts, run manifests), and cost control.
* Lead the shift from per-customer pipelines toward templated, config-driven onboarding — common frameworks with per-customer configuration.
* Design data models and transforms for new domains make and document architecture decisions (ADRs).
* Set and enforce engineering standards through code review mentor the Data Engineer and raise the whole team''s bar.
* Handle the tough operational incidents — root-cause failures, fix the class of bug, and prevent recurrence.
* Partner with the Lead on technical discovery for new customers (source assessment, feasibility, data-readiness).

**Must-have Hard Skills**

* 4–5 years of professional data engineering, with a track record of owning production pipelines end-to-end.
* Expert Python and advanced SQL strong data modelling (dimensional modelling, slowly-changing dimensions, medallion/bronze-silver-gold).
* Deep experience with ETL/ELT at scale — incremental loading, CDC, idempotency, backfills, and handling late/duplicate data.
* Hands-on with an OLAP/columnar store (ClickHouse strongly preferred Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift acceptable) including performance and cost tuning.
* Orchestration experience (Dagster preferred Airflow/Prefect fine) and transformation tooling (dbt or equivalent).
* Strong AWS and containerized deployment (Fargate/ECS, Docker, Secrets Manager, IAM least-privilege).
* Experience building multi-tenant data systems and integrating many heterogeneous third-party sources.
* Solid grasp of data quality, testing, and observability as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts.

**Nice-to-have**

* Open table formats (Apache Iceberg) and lakehouse architectures.
* `dlt`/Airbyte for warehouse extraction Nango or similar for OAuth integration management.
* Experience designing config-driven / templated ingestion frameworks that scale across many customers.
* Exposure to distributed / large-scale processing (Spark, Trino, or DuckDB) — increasingly relevant as we scale toward 150+ customers and a lakehouse architecture.
* Domain exposure to POS, labor/scheduling, or accounting/finance data.

**Traits & Soft Skills**

* Technical leadership without a title — you raise standards by example and through review, and people trust your judgement.
* Systems thinking— you optimize for the whole pipeline''s reliability and cost, and you see where bespoke work will become unmaintainable before it does.
* Pragmatism — you know when to ship a solid solution and when to invest in the durable one you evolve the system in thin slices rather than rip-and-replace.
* Mentorship — you make the engineers around you better and you explain the why, not just the what.
* Calm ownership under pressure— when a production pipeline breaks, you lead the fix and the prevention.
* Clear written communication — ADRs, runbooks, and PR descriptions that others can act on.

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Role: Senior Data Engineer**

**Location: Remote, anywhere in India**

**Exp: 5-7 Years**

**Domain: FinTech · Dental SaaS**

**Working hours: IST, Overlap of 4 hours with UK 12:30 PM - 9:30 PM IST**

**Notice period: Immediate Joiners**

Client is a UK multi-tenant financial and operational intelligence platform for dentalgroups. Clients use it for board packs, dashboards, Excel reporting, reconciliation andfinancial automation.

DenPay, pay and reconciliation module, handles clinician pay, NHS/Private/Planincome, deductions, month-end controls and Xero posting.

The platform runs on Azure. It ingests data from dental practice management systems,Compass and Xero into a Bronze/Silver/canonical PostgreSQL model. Client supports around 150 dental sites today and is scaling towards 2,000.

**The role**

This role adds engineering capacity to our senior UK Data Engineer so we can onboard new dental groups faster and strengthen the data layer. The senior engineer owns the architecture and sets direction and standards; you take on hands-ononboarding and engineering tasks and build up ownership over time.

You will work across source ingestion, Bronze/Silver/canonical PostgreSQL models,reconciliation, and the business-ready datasets behind dashboards, Excel reporting,DenPay and future AI agents.

**Our mandate: data that is complete, correctly mapped, reconciled, fresh, traceable,scalable, and safe to publish.**

**Core principle**

A pipeline completing is not the same as data being trusted. A dataset is publishable only when expected data arrived, freshness passed, mapping passed, quality checks passed,and source reconciled to target. You should instinctively ask: did all the data arrive, was itmapped correctly, did it reconcile to source, and is it safe for the client to see?

**Key responsibilities**

**Client onboarding**

* Connect new dental groups' sources (SOE, Dentally, SFD, CareStack, Compass andXero) to the platform.
* Map, cleanse and validate each client's historical data before go-live.
* Configure tenants, chart-of-accounts mappings and site hierarchies.
* Reconcile loaded data to source and document any variances before data reaches the client.

**Data engineering (with the senior engineer)**

* Ingestion pipelines for SOE, Dentally, SFD, CareStack, Compass and Xero.
* Bronze / Silver / canonical (Gold) architecture that is metadata-driven and reusable,not per-client hard-coded.
* Canonical mapping that resolves source identifiers into WorkFin identities acrosstenant, legal entity, practice, provider, clinician, contract, Xero organisation, trackingcategory and reporting period.
* Business-ready datasets for EBITDA and Journal 2, clinician production and providertime, NHS activity (UDA/UOA), Private and Plan income, cash flow, and DenPaycalculations.
* Data completeness and reconciliation control layer: automated checks for arrival,freshness, row counts, source-to-target and financial-total reconciliation, duplicates,nulls, schema drift, and unmapped practices or clinicians.
* Internal data control dashboard with Green/Amber/Red status and drill-down fromClient to Practice to Source to Dataset to Pipeline Run to Exception.

**Ways of working**

* Take tasks from the senior UK Data Engineer, report progress daily and flag blockersearly.
* Document pipelines, mappings and onboarding steps clearly.
* Use Git and follow agreed code review, CI/CD and release practices.

**Tech stack Area & Technology**

* Cloud: Microsoft Azure: Data Factory, Data Lake,Functions, Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC
* Database / warehouse: PostgreSQL (multi-tenant; Bronze/Silver/canonicalmodels)
* Pipelines: Python, SQL, PySpark
* Reporting: Power BI, Excel reporting
* Accounting integration: Xero API
* Source systems: SOE/EXACT, Dentally, SFD, CareStack, Compass
* Engineering: Git, CI/CD, automated testing

**Essential skills and experience**

* 5+ years in data engineering, with production pipelines you have built and supported.
* Strong Python and SQL, ideally PostgreSQL, including performance tuning.
* ELT/ETL architecture, dimensional and canonical modelling.
* Azure Data Factory and Data Lake.
* API ingestion, schema mapping and reconciliation logic.
* Incremental and idempotent pipelines, observability and lineage.
* Understanding of financial data: ledgers, chart of accounts, P&L, reconciliations.
* Clear written and spoken English, comfortable working directly with a UK team.
* Self-managing and reliable when working remotely across time zones.

**Desirable Good to have:**

* PySpark/Databricks, Azure Functions, Key Vault, managed identities,RBAC, secure credential handling, CI/CD, automated testing.
* Strongly preferred: financial or accounting data, Xero, healthcare/dental systems, multi-tenant SaaS, payroll/clinician remuneration, and GDPR-regulated environments.

title: Associate - Analytics Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Join a team focused on analytics enablement—designing analytics-ready data models and a trusted semantic layer that standardizes business metrics. You will partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into well-modeled datasets in Databricks and Snowflake, using SQL as your primary language and Python when needed. As an
**Analytics Solutions Associate**
within
**Analytics Engineering**

You will partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into governed, reusable datasets and semantic definitions. You will own the structure and usability of downstream analytics by defining grains, dimensions, facts, conformed entities, and metric logic so teams can move faster with confidence. You will collaborate with upstream engineering partners to ensure source-to-model alignment and ensure data quality and documentation meet a high bar. Success looks like consistent key performance indicator definitions across dashboards, clear semantic conventions, and performant, well-documented models.
  
  
Job responsibilities

* Collaborate with upstream teams on source system understanding (including semi-structured data and non-relational sources) and ensure analytics models reflect correct business meaning.
* Establish modeling standards: naming conventions, documentation, lineage, metric governance, and change management for semantic definitions.
* Support enablement by documenting curated datasets, creating user guidance, and helping consumers adopt the semantic layer correctly.
