title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About us**

Triton Infotech works with large, diverse datasets for AI development and enterprise use. We bring together structured and unstructured data from many sources and prepare it for secure storage, evaluation and delivery.

**The role**

A hands-on engineering role. You’ll own the pipeline that turns incoming data into an organised, verified, usable repository, working directly with terabyte- to petabyte-scale data, storage hardware, cloud platforms and AI-assisted workflows. You should be as comfortable debugging a failed transfer at the command line as managing a NAS or designing a repeatable ingestion and quality-check process.

**What you’ll do**

* **Data collection and ingestion:**
  coordinate receipt of datasets from multiple partners in India and abroad, via disks, NAS shares, secure links, cloud buckets and hosted repositories, and build reliable bulk upload, download and sync workflows.
* **Centralisation and organisation:**
  consolidate incoming data into Google Workspace and cloud object storage (GCS, S3, Azure Blob) with clear directory structures, naming conventions, metadata catalogues and source-level inventories.
* **NAS and storage systems:**
  configure, run and troubleshoot network-attached storage (SMB, NFS, rsync, SFTP/SSH), including RAID, permissions, snapshots, disk health, throughput, backup and recovery.
* **Cloud infrastructure:**
  work across GCP, AWS and Azure (compute, object storage, IAM, CLIs, lifecycle policies, transfer tools, logging and cost controls), and choose approaches based on volume, security, performance and budget.
* **Systems work:**
  use Linux, shell scripting and Python to automate file handling, large transfers and transformations, and diagnose filesystem, network, memory and disk I/O bottlenecks.
* **File-format fluency:**
  inspect, validate, convert and extract data across PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, JSON, XML, images, video, audio, archives, databases and engineering/CAD formats (DWG, DXF, STEP, STL, IFC).
* **Cleaning and QA:**
  find duplicates, corrupt or incomplete files, inconsistent metadata and missing records, using checksums, deduplication, schema validation, batch transformation and exception reports.
* **AI-enabled operations:**
  use Claude, ChatGPT and coding assistants to speed up scripting, classification, metadata extraction and QA, with proper review steps, and never share restricted data with external AI tools without authorisation.
* **Traceability and governance:**
  keep a record of every batch (when it arrived, where from, file count, size, format, changes made, access restrictions and delivery status), with least-privilege access, encryption and retention controls.
* **Operational ownership:**
  monitor ingestion jobs, maintain runbooks and dashboards, resolve transfer failures, coordinate with partners and the internal team, and deliver organised, verified datasets on time.

**What we’re looking for**

* Hands-on experience in data engineering, infrastructure, DevOps or systems administration, with large and varied datasets
* Strong Linux, Python and Bash skills
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and with large file transfers (rclone, rsync, cloud CLIs)
* Familiarity with NAS, file-transfer protocols, permissions and backups
* Careful, well documented and security-minded; able to own work end to end
* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Experience with multi-terabyte or petabyte-scale repositories, Docker, Git, SQL or OCR / document-processing pipelines

Oversee end-to-end ingestion processing, ensure automated generation and distribution of Data Statistics Reports (DSR), and establish benchmarks for file-level, CI-level, and Industry-level Data Quality Indexes (DQIs). Critical Data Element (CDE) & Lineage Management: Own and continuously update the CDE Master Register covering key attributes such as Loan Status, DPD, Outstanding Balance, and Demographics. Design and enforce risk-based data lineage tracking from initial SFTP ingestion through to consumer credit reports (CIRs) and scoring models. Regulatory Compliance & Policy Alignment: Ensure strict compliance with statutory credit data retention policies (7- year and perpetual retention rules) and RBI guidelines. Work closely with legal and compliance teams to adapt internal governance policies to evolving regulatory standards. Dispute Resolution Governance: Monitor and optimize dispute resolution workflows to ensure adherence to the statutory 30-day resolution SLA. Collaborate directly with the Internal Ombudsman on complex or escalated dispute rejections to maintain fairness and accuracy. Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Algorithm Tuning: Analyze quarterly delink logs and customer complaint dumps to conduct deep-dive RCAs. Identify and resolve algorithm defects, fine-tuning entity resolution match logic and adjusting match thresholds within DCtrl. Member Engagement & Data Remediation: Drive engagement with Credit Institutions (CIs) to resolve recurring submission errors, monitor compliance, and enforce data cleanup and resubmission schedules. Audit & Anomaly Detection: Execute routine KYC anomaly audits focusing on key identifiers like PAN, Aadhaar, and Voter ID to ensure data integrity and prevent identity misclassification. Data Trends: Data Trend Analysis & Reporting: Extract, analyze, and publish data trends to deliver actionable insights to key stakeholders, serving as early warning indicators to mitigate potential risks. What Experience You Need Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Finance, or related quantitative fields. Experience: 15+ years of relevant experience in Data Governance, Data Quality Management, or Business Intelligence within a Credit Bureau, Financial Institution, or Fintech. Domain Knowledge: Deep expertise in Indian Credit Bureau standards (UCRF, CICRA, DPDP), entity resolution, cascading match algorithms, and data lineage mapping. Technical & Analytical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, SAS/Python, database architecture (Cassandra/Oracle), ETL frameworks (Talend GCP), and statistical sampling methods. Leadership: Strong cross-functional leadership, executive presentation capabilities, and experience presenting governance outcomes to Senior Leadership teams and board committees. What Could Set You Apart Prior Experience in Data governance role with large Bank, NBFC or CIC #India

description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design and implement a data architecture that supports the organization’s business goals and objectives
* Develop data models, define data standards and guidelines, and establish processes for data integration, migration, and management
* Create and maintain data dictionaries, which are a comprehensive set of data definitions and metadata that provide context and understanding of the organization’s data assets
* Ensure that the data is accurate, consistent, and reliable across the organization. This includes establishing data quality metrics and monitoring data quality on an ongoing basis
* Work closely with other IT professionals, including database administrators, data analysts, and developers, to ensure that the organization’s data architecture is integrated and aligned with

other IT systems and applications
  
  

* Stay up to date with new technologies and trends in data management and architecture and evaluate their potential impact on the organization’s data architecture
* Communicate with stakeholders across the organization to understand their data needs and ensure that the organization’s data architecture is aligned with the organization’s strategic

goals and objectives
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* A BTech / MTech degree in Computer Science or a related field
* At least 7+ years of experience in working on data architecture
* Expertise in data modeling and design, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models,

and must be able to translate business requirements into data models
  
  

* Proficient in a variety of data management technologies, including relational databases,

NoSQL databases, data warehouses, and data lakes
  
  

* Expertise in ETL processes, including data extraction, transformation, and loading, and must

be able to design and implement data integration processes
  
  

* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools and techniques and must be able to design

and implement data analysis and reporting processes
  
  

* Familiar with industry-standard data architecture frameworks, such as TOGAF or Zachman,

and must be able to apply them to the organization's data architecture
  
  

* Familiar with cloud computing technologies, including public and private clouds, and must be

able to design and implement data architectures that leverage cloud computing
  
  

* Certificates in Database Management will be preferred

title: R0000860 - Professional Services Consultant
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
**Role Description**
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
**Your Opportunity**
Join our team as a Professional Services Consultant, a critical role focused on the technical design, deployment, and adoption of the New Relic Observability platform for our most strategic customers. You will serve as the deep technical expert, translating complex customer needs into robust, scalable, and automated Observability solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the customer's modern, often cloud-native, application and infrastructure environments. You will architect solutions that leverage Platform Engineering best practices, integrating New Relic seamlessly into their CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and internal developer platforms to drive wall-to-wall observability. Your success will be measured by the depth of technical value realized and the long-term strategic adoption of the platform across customer organizations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Architect and Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of comprehensive New Relic solutions, focusing on large-scale deployment, data correlation strategies, and best practices for instrumenting microservices, serverless, and complex distributed systems.
* Platform Integration & Automation: Design and implement automated deployment and configuration solutions for New Relic using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (e.g., Python, Go, Shell). Deeply integrate Observability into customer's Platform Engineering and CI/CD workflows (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions).
* Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Observability concepts, APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, and Log Management. Lead technical workshops and design sessions with customer architects, engineers, and leadership to define the implementation roadmap.
* Troubleshooting and Optimization: Provide advanced technical guidance during initial deployments and optimization phases, addressing complex data ingestion, performance, and platform configuration challenges.
* Knowledge Transfer & Best Practices: Create and deliver technical documentation, blueprints, and training to enable customer Platform teams and internal Professional Services/Partner resources to confidently manage and extend the implemented solution.

**Your Qualifications**
We believe that experience comes in many forms and are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you believe you have the skills to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply.
  
  

* Extensive Technical Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical consulting, solutions architecture, or senior engineering role, specifically focused on cloud and application performance technologies.
* Platform Engineering Mastery: Proven, extensive experience with core Platform Engineering concepts, including building and maintaining automated, self-service infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
* Automation and DevOps Proficiency: Deep expertise in Automation, Scripting (e.g., Python), and CI/CD practices and tools. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is highly valued.
* Observability Expertise: Exceptional knowledge and practical experience with Observability concepts (The Three Pillars) and products (New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, etc.) is extremely important. You can articulate the 'why' and 'how' of Observability to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Consultative Influence: Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and drive consensus on complex technical architectures.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.
  
  
We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.
  
  
**Our hiring process**
In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.
  
  
We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
  
  
Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.
  
  
New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U.S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process.
  
  
Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build, and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications, built with modern technology stacks and increasingly with AI-assisted and agent-assisted development, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior individual contributor role that reports to the Engineering Manager. The role can independently handle a software module/function, which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management, and communication, and is accountable for the delivery outcomes of the wider team. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for role modeling, and for coaching and mentoring of the team from a technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise-scale applications at Bain, and help drive the overall delivery outcomes of the team.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting, and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades, primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Project/Product Managers.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI agents responsibly to improve team productivity and code quality, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Champion secure software development practices, including secure use of AI-generated code, review of AI output, and protection of data and prompts.
* Own both development and testing: create the end-to-end test plan, execute it, and ensure zero-defect delivery.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support, and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills, e.g. creating automation tests, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing, etc., through internal/external trainings to be a T-shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies, especially in Gen AI, LLMs, and AI agents, beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts, e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, and Product Owner to improve team performance.
* Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with zero defects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T-shaped behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience providing technical leadership to a group of developers.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* AI and Gen AI: understanding of large language models (capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns), Gen AI application development, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vectors, vector databases, machine learning fundamentals
* Secure development: secure software development practices, including for AI-driven development
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, .NET and .NET Core, Java, or equivalent; C#, T-SQL, etc.
* Web frameworks/libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design; microservices, API design, and cloud-native patterns

description:

**Job Description:**
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
  
  
Cloudera is looking for an Infrastructure Support Engineer II to join our Cloud Operations team and help deliver a fast, reliable support service across our global infrastructure estate. This is a hands-on role at the front line of how our engineering and business teams get access to, and get answers about, cloud, on-premises and AI platform services.
  
  
You will own day-to-day operational requests across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, support our on-premises private cloud and Cloudera platform deployments, and you will be one of the first people in the company supporting our internal AI platform. You will also help build the runbooks, automation candidates and knowledge base that make the whole service faster over time. If you like solving problems quickly, writing down what you learned, and then removing the need to solve it again, this is a good fit.
  
  
This role reports into Cloud Operations and works closely with our platform engineering, FinOps and identity teams.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Support Engineer II you will:
  
  

* Own and resolve day-to-day cloud operational requests across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, including access, identity, account lifecycle and resource queries
* Provide support for our internal AI platform, including access and key management, usage and quota questions, model availability, and onboarding new teams onto the platform
* Support our on-premises private cloud and Cloudera platform deployments, handling user access, environment queries and documented break-fix, and escalating operational issues to the engineers who own the stack
* Triage, diagnose and resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues, escalating cleanly with good evidence when an issue needs platform engineering or architecture input
* Execute documented change against our cloud estate safely and accurately, and raise simple infrastructure-as-code changes for review
* Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base articles so that recurring requests become self-service
* Use AI-assisted tooling to triage, research and draft resolutions faster, while remaining accountable for the accuracy of every answer that reaches a requester
* Maintain the accuracy of our configuration management data and service catalog
* Maintain the inputs to our Infrastructure-As-Code and Github workflow.
* Handle first-line cloud cost and tagging questions, escalating complex optimization work to our FinOps team
* Own the handover between time zones so nothing is dropped between regions
* Identify the requests that should not exist and propose the automation that removes them

We're excited about you if you have:
  
  

* Two to four years of experience in cloud operations, infrastructure support or IT support, across cloud or on-premises environments
* Working knowledge of AWS, plus Azure or Google Cloud
* Experience working a ticket queue in a service management tool, ideally ServiceNow
* Confidence at the command line and with Linux
* Excellent written communication, because most of this work is written
* A track record of following documented process accurately, and improving it where it falls short
* An interest in identity and access concepts such as SSO, IAM and single sign-on group management

Nice to have:
  
  

* Exposure to Github, Terraform or other infrastructure as code
* Exposure to cloud cost management or FinOps practices
* Experience using AI or large language model tooling in a professional setting
* An associate-level cloud certification

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

title: Senior Net Suite Enterprise Application and Architecture
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

The Senior Manager, NetSuite Enterprise Applications & Architecture will lead hands-on NetSuite implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing platform ownership. The role requires strong expertise in NetSuite financials, inventory, procurement, order management, and distribution workflows. The ideal candidate will drive solution design, validate business processes, maintain financial controls, and ensure a scalable, reliable ERP environment.

**Responsibilities:**

**NetSuite implementation and solution ownership**

* Participate directly in solution design, configuration, prototyping, testing, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Learn and document company's current processes, legacy applications, business rules, controls, data structures, and operational dependencies before replacing or redesigning them.
* Translate business requirements into practical NetSuite designs that favor standard functionality when it meets the business need.
* Review partner-proposed designs, identify gaps and downstream consequences, and challenge recommendations that create avoidable complexity, weak controls, or poor operational outcomes.
* Own material application design decisions and maintain functional architecture, configuration, decision, and support documentation.

**Financial management and controls**

* Support the design and configuration of general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, bank reconciliation, intercompany activity, financial dimensions, allocations, fixed assets, and period close
* Understand and validate the accounting consequences of transaction design across sales, purchasing, inventory, fulfillment, billing, returns, credits, and adjustments
* Protect subledger-to-general-ledger integrity through reconciliations, conversion validation, controlled posting logic, and clear exception handling.
* Partner with Finance to establish approvals, role permissions, audit trails, segregation of duties, and other control requirements.
* Validate financial reporting outputs and ensure configuration supports accurate, explainable, and repeatable close processes.

**Order to cash and customer operations**

* Design and support customer master data, sales orders, pricing, allocations, fulfillment, invoicing, payments, returns, credits, and related workflows.
* Support both owned-inventory and drop-ship transaction models, including customer-specific item references and order requirements.
* Evaluate the effect of design choices on customer service, warehouse execution, fulfillment accuracy, margin, and accounting.
* Work with process owners to define exceptions, approvals, controls, and measurable acceptance criteria for end-to-end customer transactions.

**Procure to pay inventory and warehouse processes**

* Design and support vendor master data, purchasing, purchase orders, receiving, vendor bills, matching, landed cost, payments, and returns.
* Support item master design, units of measure, locations, lot traceability, transfers, adjustments, cycle counts, costing, and inventory reconciliation.
* Address food-distribution requirements such as master case and break pack, assemblies, repack, catch weight, lot control, and related accounting flows when applicable.
* Confirm that application design works in the operating environment and does not shift hidden effort or control risk into warehouse, procurement, customer service, or Finance teams.

**Configuration administration and release governance**

* Configure or oversee roles, permissions, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, dashboards, approval processes, and application preferences.
* Establish standards for configuration, customization, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, naming, documentation, and environment management.
* Evaluate native functionality before approving extensions and ensure each customization has a clear owner, business purpose, test plan, and support approach.
* Maintain disciplined development, test, sandbox, and production practices with documented change control and release procedures.
* Support production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and manage an enhancement backlog based on business value, control risk, and operational need.

**Master data testing and cutover**

* Help define customer, vendor, item, pricing, chart-of-accounts, location, and other master-data structures, ownership, approval rights, and system-of-record boundaries.
* Participate in data mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios covering normal transactions, exceptions, integrations, financial posting, operational handoffs, and reporting.
* Take an active role in conference-room pilots, system and integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, go-live readiness, and hypercare.
* Reject incomplete testing or unresolved defects that could compromise financial integrity, inventory accuracy, customer service, or operational continuity.

**Long term platform ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner and subject-matter expert for the NetSuite application environment.
* Build sufficient internal knowledge to reduce unnecessary dependence on outside consultants while using specialized partners where they add value.
* Maintain current documentation, operating procedures, configuration standards, training materials, and decision history.
* Evaluate new capabilities and enhancements against business value, total cost, control implications, operational impact, and supportability.
* Help establish a scalable ERP operating model that can support organic growth, new operating requirements, and future acquisitions.

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of ERP implementation, enterprise applications, or ERP administration experience, including at least five years of meaningful hands-on NetSuite experience.
* Participation in at least one full-cycle NetSuite implementation with direct responsibility for design, configuration, testing, conversion, cutover, or stabilization.
* Strong knowledge of NetSuite financials and core ERP capabilities, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, order management, purchasing, and inventory.
* Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, inventory accounting, financial controls, reconciliations, and subledger-to-general-ledger integrity.
* Demonstrated ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into practical, supportable system designs.
* Hands-on experience with roles, permissions, workflows, saved searches, reporting, master data, data conversion, and test execution.
* Ability to assess operational impacts and work effectively with Finance, procurement, operations, warehouse, customer service, and technology teams.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations using business, accounting, control, data, and operational evidence.
* Strong documentation, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the platform.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* NetSuite OneWorld experience and relevant NetSuite certifications.
* Food distribution, wholesale distribution, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive industry background.
* Experience with lot-controlled inventory, catch weight, repack, assemblies, drop ship, EDI-enabled transactions, or complex pricing.
* Experience migrating from Microsoft Dynamics GP or another legacy ERP.
* Familiarity with SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, SuiteAnalytics, NetSuite APIs, and integration concepts.
* Experience supporting multi-entity or acquisition-driven organizations.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

title: Senior Threat Intelligence Researcher
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to
**end cyber risk**
.
  
  
We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.
  
  
More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.
  
  
**About The Position**
We are looking for a
**Senior Threat Intelligence Researcher**
to help achieve this mission.
  
  
The Senior Threat Intelligence Researcher will contribute to our Threat Intelligence organization by leading advanced cyber threat intelligence research and translating adversary insights into measurable defensive outcomes. This role focuses on deep technical analysis, adversary tracking, intelligence-driven detection, and operational collaboration to improve threat visibility, detection coverage, and incident response effectiveness across the organization.
  
  
As a senior technical authority, this role will shape intelligence methodologies, establish analytical standards, mentor peers, and deliver actionable intelligence that directly strengthens Arctic Wolf’s security operations and customer protection capabilities.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Threat Intelligence Research and Adversary Tracking**

* Lead and contribute to threat actor, malware family, and campaign tracking by correlating malware samples, infrastructure, delivery mechanisms, and adversary tradecraft.
* Own end-to-end cyber threat intelligence investigations, from initial research and hypothesis development through validation, reporting, and operational implementation.
* Conduct cyber threat intelligence research aligned with established frameworks such as the Cyber Threat Intelligence lifecycle, MITRE ATT&CK, and the Diamond Model.
* Perform static and dynamic malware analysis across malicious binaries, scripts, and document-based delivery mechanisms.
* Investigate malicious network infrastructure and command-and-control activity by pivoting across domains, Internet Protocol addresses, certificates, and related artifacts.
* Apply advanced open-source intelligence techniques, pivoting methodologies, and enrichment across multiple intelligence platforms and data sources.
* Research Deep Web ecosystems, including crimeware-as-a-service and ransomware-as-a-service operations, to identify emerging threats, adversary relationships, and evolving attack methodologies.
* Analyze Windows and macOS internals, including application programming interfaces, obfuscation techniques, system calls, and execution behaviors.
* Analyze and correlate large-scale datasets using Structured Query Language, Python, or Excel to identify patterns, generate actionable intelligence, and support evidence-based decisions.

**Intelligence-to-Detection and Operational Impact**

* Translate intelligence findings into actionable detection and threat hunting logic using technologies such as YARA, Sigma, and Suricata.
* Own the lifecycle of intelligence-driven detection improvements, from identifying intelligence gaps and developing detection hypotheses to validating coverage and measuring operational effectiveness.
* Take accountability for ensuring that intelligence findings are translated into practical defensive improvements rather than remaining limited to research reports or theoretical assessments.
* Develop intelligence-to-detection feedback loops that identify coverage gaps, assess detection effectiveness, and continuously improve defensive capabilities.
* Partner closely with Security Operations Center and Managed Detection and Response teams to operationalize intelligence into detection, triage, investigation, and response workflows.
* Provide escalation support for high-confidence threat events, including intelligence enrichment, attribution context, assessment of potential impact, and recommended response actions.
* Contribute real-time intelligence support during active incidents and investigations, ensuring findings are communicated promptly and translated into actionable recommendations.
* Support Request for Intelligence workflows by owning assigned requests from initial assessment through research, delivery, and follow-up, ensuring that outputs address the operational team's requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of intelligence-led initiatives using measurable outcomes such as detection coverage, investigation efficiency, escalation quality, and response time improvements.

**Automation, Scalability, and Analytical Excellence**

* Develop automation and enrichment workflows using scripting languages such as Python to improve research efficiency, data quality, and intelligence delivery.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual activities and build scalable intelligence workflows that support growing operational requirements.
* Own the implementation and continuous improvement of assigned automation initiatives, ensuring they deliver measurable efficiency gains and remain reliable in production environments.
* Establish repeatable research methodologies, intelligence validation practices, and analytical standards to improve consistency, accuracy, and reproducibility.
* Analyze operational feedback, detection gaps, and intelligence quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on their potential security impact.
* Create scalable intelligence dissemination methods, including threat alerts, intelligence briefs, technical reports, and knowledge base updates, ensuring that relevant teams receive timely and actionable information.

**Collaboration, Technical Leadership, and Knowledge Sharing**

* Collaborate with Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, Incident Response, Security Operations Center, and Managed Detection and Response teams to align intelligence priorities with operational and customer security needs.
* Take ownership of assigned intelligence initiatives and drive them forward independently, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to resolve dependencies and achieve agreed outcomes.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, share investigative techniques, and contribute to the development of technical standards within the research organization.
* Communicate complex technical findings clearly to technical and operational audiences, ensuring that recommendations are understood, actionable, and aligned with business priorities.
* Publish technical research, tradecraft methodologies, blogs, and whitepapers, or present findings at industry workshops and conferences.
* Stay informed about emerging adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, assess their relevance to Arctic Wolf customers, and proactively recommend improvements to intelligence coverage and defensive capabilities.

**You Will Be Successful In This Role If**

* You have 5+ years of relevant experience and are recognized as a technical authority within one or more adversary ecosystems, such as ransomware, financially motivated crimeware, or nation-state operations.
* You have strong experience in cyber threat intelligence research, adversary tracking, and intelligence analysis.
* You have hands-on experience applying threat intelligence to detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, or threat modeling.
* You have experience with malware analysis tooling, host telemetry, and network telemetry analysis.
* You possess strong knowledge of modern threat intelligence frameworks, analytical methodologies, and adversary research techniques.
* You demonstrate end-to-end ownership by independently driving investigations and intelligence initiatives from problem identification through execution, validation, and measurable outcomes.
* You can translate complex intelligence findings into actionable recommendations and demonstrate how your work improves detection coverage, investigation quality, or defensive capabilities.
* You take accountability for the quality, accuracy, timeliness, and operational relevance of your intelligence deliverables.
* You proactively identify gaps in intelligence coverage, investigative processes, and detection capabilities, and drive improvements without waiting for predefined instructions.
* You are comfortable working independently in ambiguous, fast-changing threat environments, making informed decisions, and adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
* You have strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and their operational implications.
* You have experience mentoring peers, sharing technical expertise, and contributing to research standards and best practices.
* You are passionate about improving intelligence-driven security operations and delivering measurable improvements to customer security outcomes.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience publishing threat research, whitepapers, or presenting at industry conferences.
* Experience collaborating with external intelligence-sharing communities or trusted industry partners.
* Experience building scalable threat intelligence workflows, enrichment pipelines, and operational frameworks.
* Familiarity with large-scale telemetry analysis and data science methodologies.
* Experience automating intelligence research, enrichment, and analysis workflows.
* Experience defining success metrics, measuring the effectiveness of intelligence-led initiatives, and using operational feedback to drive continuous improvement.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and delivering outcomes in environments where requirements and priorities evolve rapidly.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Improved detection effectiveness: Intelligence-driven improvements result in measurable gains in detection coverage, detection quality, and operational visibility across Arctic Wolf security platforms.
* End-to-end ownership: Intelligence investigations and initiatives are driven from initial problem identification through actionable recommendations, operational implementation, and validation of results.
* Actionable intelligence: Research findings directly strengthen incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, and defensive decision-making.
* Measurable operational impact: Intelligence-led enhancements contribute to reduced investigation and response times, improved escalation quality, and increased operational efficiency.
* Proactive threat identification: Emerging adversary tactics, infrastructure, and campaigns are identified and communicated in time to support appropriate defensive action.
* Scalable intelligence capabilities: Research methodologies, enrichment workflows, automation, and validation practices improve the consistency, reliability, and scalability of intelligence operations.
* Continuous improvement: Feedback from operational teams and intelligence consumers is used to identify gaps, refine analytical approaches, and strengthen defensive capabilities.
* Effective collaboration: Security Operations Center, Managed Detection and Response, Detection Engineering, and Incident Response teams receive timely, relevant intelligence that supports their operational objectives.
* Customer security outcomes: Intelligence research and operational improvements contribute to stronger customer protection, faster threat identification, and improved organizational resilience.

Do not meet all the requirements? That is okay. We still encourage you to apply. We have many opportunities and are always looking for strong talent.
  
  
**Benefits**
All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
  
  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

**Security Requirements**
At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.
  
  
**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

description:

GRC Specialist to execute the day-to-day work that keeps our compliance and risk programs running — from responding to customer security questionnaires to supporting audits and assessing vendor risk. You'll work closely with Engineering, IT, Sales and Customer Success to turn security and compliance requirements into clear, evidenced answers, while the GRC Lead sets overall program strategy and priorities.

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes

* Agility in Action: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

**Role Summary:**

The Senior SIEM Consultant position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. In this role, you will work with our customers , supporting our mission to help them quickly and completely adopt our Security Operating Platform, leaving them more secure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of information security and networking and extensive experience interacting with customers. Securonix Next-Gen SIEM and UEBA experience, although desired, is not required, but the candidate must have SIEM and SOAR software expertise and be willing to train on the Securonix platform and products.

**Primary Responsibility:**

* Lead end-to-end SIEM implementation or integrations in a customer environment.
* Understand customer business requirements and the threat landscape applicable to their industry’s vertical sector to develop tailored use cases for security and Incident monitoring.
* Coordinate with customers to deploy collectors and agents in the on-premises network for data collection and forwarding.
* Work with customers to design and implement secure data flow into the Securonix cloud, following industry-standard best practices.
* Coordinate with service delivery managers, management, engineering, maintenance, and operational support teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Develop content, use cases, data models, dashboards, and connectors to support custom user requirements.

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
**About Futureforce University Recruiting**
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.
  
  
**Job Category**
Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure
  
  
**Job Details**
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Information Security Associate – Risk Operations**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Who We Are And Where We're Going**
**Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline.**
Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We're replacing that model with one that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.
  
  
**Our Strategy**
**Risk-informed, control managed.**
We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. This proves trust while delivering risk operations, compliance artifacts, and outputs, and it opens access to new markets through the product we build and the behavior we change.
  
  
**Visibility and invention.**
We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. We equip the Assurance team with a new way of protecting Salesforce, through the invention we create together. We also invest in the people who work here, with room to grow, take on new challenges, and drive excellence.
  
  
**Always in front.**
We turn gaps into signals, alerts, and escalations. When a control fails, it flows into a workflow built to help stakeholders meet their trust obligations. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.
  
  
We're hiring people who want to build this future. You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do …**
Risk Operations provides a centralized approach to identifying, prioritizing, and managing cybersecurity risks, driving accountability, faster decision-making, and measurable risk reduction. The team partners across security, engineering, and business functions to streamline risk management processes, improve visibility into risk exposure, and ensure timely escalation and resolution.
  
  
We're looking for an Information Security Associate who is excited to help build and support a growing Risk Operations function. In this role, you'll be at the center of day-to-day security issue and exception management activities, helping ensure risk cases are accurately documented, efficiently processed, and consistently tracked through resolution. You'll work closely with experienced risk and security professionals while contributing to the development of workflows, processes, and reporting that will help shape how Risk Operations operates at scale.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for an early-career security professional who enjoys solving problems, bringing organization to complex processes, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  
  

* Rapid Decision Management: We work in a business. Predictability and rapid decisions are the core outcomes you’ll bring to the job. Support rapid risk decision-making by coordinating timely reviews, approvals, and escalations, ensuring decision-makers have the information needed to assess risks and take action.
* Support day-to-day security risk operations by managing the intake, triage, and tracking of security issues and exceptions to accelerate risk-based decisions and timely resolution.
* Coordinate issue and exception management activities, including reviewing submissions for completeness, following up with stakeholders, tracking remediation commitments, monitoring exception expiration dates, and supporting timely case resolution.
* Maintain accurate and complete risk records in case management platforms, ensuring consistent documentation, appropriate case status, and reliable data for operational reporting.
* Partner with security, engineering, and compliance teams to gather information, clarify case requirements, resolve operational blockers, and accelerate risk-based decision-making by ensuring stakeholders have the information, context, and visibility needed to take timely action.
* Support timely risk decisions and escalations by monitoring case progress, identifying stalled requests or decision gaps, and coordinating follow-ups to ensure issues and exceptions move efficiently through established governance and approval workflows.
* Assist with operational reporting and metrics, including tracking case volumes, aging, remediation progress, exception renewals, and other key performance indicators to provide visibility into risk operations activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate repetitive tasks, helping streamline case handling, improve data quality, and enhance the overall stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to broader Risk Operations initiatives by supporting ad hoc requests, process improvements, and emerging operational needs as the team establishes and matures its capabilities.

**What You Bring ...**

* You have +2 years of experience in information security or security operations, or a related field.
* You have a foundational understanding of information security concepts, including security findings, risk remediation, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance.
* You have sufficient technical ability to serve as one of many eyes as we assess the certainty of our compensating controls and exposures.
* You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities while maintaining accurate records.
* You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information for completeness, identify inconsistencies, and recognize when issues require additional attention or escalation.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, clarify requirements, and drive timely follow-through.
* You are comfortable learning new tools, navigating workflow or ticketing systems, and working with spreadsheets and data to support operational activities.
* You are adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes and responsibilities are still being established.
* You have a continuous improvement mindset and are eager to learn, contribute ideas, and help build scalable and efficient security risk management practices.

**How We Work**

* Engineering-first culture. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
* Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
* Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
* Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
* Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
* Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.

**Modern Tooling Acumen**
Direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. Must be able to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes.
  
  
Graduates need direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. This is a newer requirement; candidates who have actively experimented with and used tools like Gemini, Cursor, or other agent-based frameworks will be stronger candidates.
  
  
**About Futureforce**
FutureForce is for college students or new grads wanting to experience life at Salesforce, one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies 5-years-running and one of Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” 8- years-running. FutureForce interns work on live projects, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact that they can show to friends, family, and future employers if we don’t hire them first (and, we hire 80% of our eligible interns)!
  
  
They have the chance to collaborate and connect with the Salesforce interns from all over the world. And, like all Salesforce employees, interns also have many possibilities to volunteer, making a lasting impact in the community.
  
  
FutureForce offers a collaborative work environment, which promotes innovation, provides flexibility and most importantly is fun!
  
  
Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Cyber Defense Engineering II - Endpoint Protection
description:
**Role Overview**
You will become a key member of Cyber Defense Engineering - Endpoint Protection team and will support senior colleagues in configuring and maintaining security controls across the endpoint security domain. Your primary goal is to ensure 100% endpoint security agent deployment, visibility and control enforcement compliance across the enterprise.
  
  
This will primarily involve: managing endpoint security agent health, deploying and troubleshooting agent version upgrades and security content updates, refining AV / EDR policy configurations and exclusions to reduce "noise" while maintaining high security posture.
  
  
Additionally, you will play a hands-on role in ensuring seamless, secure, and performant enterprise-wide AV / EDR control migrations between industry-leading platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Endpoint Security Agent Management: Work with your Cyber Defense colleagues as well as Desktop, Server, Cloud Compute engineering and other technology teams as required to deploy, update, and troubleshoot endpoint security agents across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoint environments.
* Platform Management: Assist in driving enterprise-wide deployments and migrations of next-generation AV / EDR controls, ensuring consistent coverage during transition periods.
* Policy Administration: Assist with the configuration and maintenance of all policies in the endpoint security control domain, primarily including: prevention, detection and response, device control, security content updates, exclusions, network containment and host-based firewall rules management.
* Health Monitoring: Proactively identify and resolve incidents of non-compliant compute endpoints with unhealthy endpoint security agent states.
* Issue Resolution (Tier 1/2 ticket management): Monitor the Cyber Defense Engineering - Endpoint Protection ticket queue, taking ownership of tier 1/2 operational support requests and incidents.
* Exclusion Tuning: Work with system owners as required to configure and maintain narrowly defined AV / EDR exclusions to prevent false positives without creating security gaps, while also ensuring system performance.
* Documentation: Upkeep of the team’s internal knowledgebase including all documentation pages and standard operating procedures (SOPs) relating to endpoint security agent and platform management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Technical Skills & Work Experience**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field (or 2-4 years of equivalent hands-on experience in IT security, systems support, or engineering related roles).
* OS Fundamentals: Strong grasp of Windows, Mac, and Linux operating system internals, command-line usage and log analysis.
* Scripting: Basic proficiency in at least two common scripting languages (e.g. PowerShell for Windows environments, Bash for Linux/macOS environments, Python for cross-platform support).
* Networking: Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP and DNS (e.g. how endpoints communicate across enterprise networks, how endpoint security agents communicate with cloud-based cybersecurity platforms).
* Industry Certifications:

○ Foundational IT security certifications (e.g. CompTIA Security+)
  
  
○ Endpoint security administration oriented certifications are highly preferred / desirable.
  
  
**Professional & Soft Skills**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong communication skills with the ability to navigate complex enterprise IT ecosystems and work effectively with other teams and system owners to enforce endpoint security control compliance.
* Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically during issue / incident triage and perform root-cause analysis (For example: when troubleshooting endpoint security agent health issues).
* Adaptability & Time Management: Capable of balancing day-to-day operational support and incident ticket queues with long-term, enterprise-wide platform maturity efforts.

**What Makes a Candidate Stand Out?**

* Enterprise Platform Experience: Hands-on experience supporting enterprise-grade cybersecurity and/or IT systems management platforms and controls at scale.
* Familiarity with SIEM Query Languages: Working knowledge of one or more SIEM query language for querying endpoint telemetry data (e.g. SPL, KQL, CQL, or UDM Search/YARA-L).
* API Knowledge: Practical experience of using cybersecurity and/or IT systems management platform APIs for script development (e.g. for report generation and workflow automation).b

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
**Senior Cloud Security Engineer**

**Department:**
Security Engineering

**Function:**
Security Engineering and Operations

**Reports To:**
Manager

**Location:**
Bangalore, India

**Job Description**

Rakuten Symphony is seeking a hands-on Senior Cloud Security Engineer to support security engineering and security operations for applications, cloud infrastructure, network platforms, and on-premises environments. The role will be responsible for implementing and operating security controls, configuring firewalls and WAFs, monitoring security events, investigating incidents, managing vulnerabilities, and improving the security posture of production environments. Experience with AWS and GCP security services is preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement, operate, and continuously improve security controls for applications, cloud infrastructure, servers, networks, and platforms.
* Configure and manage security technologies including firewalls, WAFs, F5 security solutions, Cisco security solutions, network access controls, and traffic-filtering policies.
* Configure and maintain AWS WAF, GCP Cloud Armor, F5 Advanced WAF, and equivalent technologies.
* Configure and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP security features, including virtual servers, access policies, SSL/TLS controls, traffic management, and WAF policies.
* Configure and manage relevant Cisco security technologies, including firewalls, network security controls, VPNs, access policies, and security monitoring.
* Develop and tune security rules to protect applications and APIs from SQL injection, cross-site scripting, path traversal, bot activity, denial-of-service attacks, and other malicious traffic.
* Monitor firewall, WAF, F5, Cisco, operating system, application, network, cloud, and security logs.
* Investigate security alerts, suspicious traffic, unauthorized access, abnormal application behavior, and potential indicators of compromise.
* Support security incident response, including analysis, containment, recovery, and post-incident improvement.
* Investigate compromised accounts, service accounts, cloud credentials, servers, containers, and application workloads.
* Implement and review identity and access management controls across cloud, network, Linux, and application environments.
* Perform security hardening and vulnerability remediation for Linux servers, virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes platforms, and cloud workloads.
* Support the secure operation of on-premises Kubernetes and managed cloud Kubernetes environments.
* Review Kubernetes configurations, workload permissions, ingress controls, secrets, container images, and exposed services.
* Perform security posture reviews and track remediation of identified weaknesses.
* Analyze findings from vulnerability scanners, security-monitoring tools, cloud security tools, penetration tests, and configuration reviews.
* Develop scripts and automation to support security monitoring, investigation, alert handling, rule deployment, and security validation.
* Support integration with SIEM, vulnerability-management, endpoint-security, and incident-response platforms.
* Participate in threat modelling, security architecture reviews, risk assessments, and security design reviews.
* Review application and infrastructure changes to ensure appropriate security controls are implemented before deployment.
* Work with application, DevOps, SRE, platform, network, infrastructure, and SOC teams to address security risks.
* Maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, technical standards, and operational documentation.
* Support security audits, compliance activities, evidence collection, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **5–8 years of experience in security engineering, security operations, network security, infrastructure security, or cybersecurity.**
* Strong hands-on experience in security monitoring, incident investigation, vulnerability management, system hardening, and security control implementation.
* Experience configuring and managing firewalls, WAFs, F5, Cisco security technologies, IAM, network controls, logging, and monitoring tools.
* **Experience with AWS or GCP security services is preferred.**
* Practical experience with AWS WAF, AWS IAM, security groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, or equivalent AWS services.
* Experience with GCP Cloud Armor, GCP IAM, VPC firewall rules, Cloud Audit Logs, or equivalent GCP services is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP, F5 Advanced WAF, Cisco firewalls, Cisco VPN, or related security technologies.
* Good knowledge of Linux security, hardening, patching, access control, and troubleshooting.
* **Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, containers, and container security.**
* Good understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP, routing, load balancers, reverse proxies, and network segmentation.
* Experience analyzing security logs and investigating suspicious events.
