title: Senior Information Security Risk Analyst
description:
**About Fam (previously FamPay)**

  

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
  
  
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
  
  
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

  
  

**Role Overview**
We are seeking a proactive and detailed-oriented IT Risk & Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for executing cybersecurity risk assessments for our third-party vendors, suppliers, service providers and internal IT risk management processes. You will collaborate closely with IT, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Risk teams to identify, evaluate, and mitigate technology and vendor risks across the organization.
  
  
**Must-Haves**

  

  
* **Experience:**
  3 to 5 years of dedicated experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity, third-party risk management (TPRM), or information security governance
  
* **IT Risk Knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of internal IT general controls (ITGC), access control, disaster recovery, cloud security concepts, and data protection principles
  
* **Framework Familiarity:**
  Working knowledge of industry frameworks and standards, such as RBI Framework for Outsourcing of Payment and Settlement-related Activities by PSOs, RBI MD on Cyber Resilience & Digital Payment Security Controls, ISO 27001, ISO 31000, and NIST CSF
  
* **Artifact Evaluation:**
  Demonstrated ability to review vendor reports, security certifications, penetration test summaries, and questionnaires
  
* **Analytical & Communication Skills:**
  Excellent analytical, organizational, and documentation skills with the ability to communicate risk findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders
  
* **Ownership:**
  Proven ability to manage multiple vendor assessments and internal risk tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  
  

  

**Good to Haves**
  

  
* Professional certifications or active progress toward certifications such as
  **CISA**
  ,
  **CRISC**
  ,
  **ISO 27001 LA/LI**
  etc
  
* Prior experience working in financial services, technology, or other regulated environments
  
* Hands-on experience using GRC tools or dedicated Third-Party Risk Management platforms
  
* Basic awareness of AI-enabled features in GRC or risk tools
  
* Experience supporting IT disaster recovery exercises or business continuity planning.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**
  

**1. IT Risk Management**

  

  
* **Risk Assessment & Identification:**
  Execute internal IT risk assessments across IT infrastructure, cloud environments, business applications, and operational workflows
  
* **Risk Register Maintenance:**
  Maintain and regularly update the enterprise IT Risk Register, tracking risk treatment plans, remediation timelines, and risk acceptance approvals
  
* **Internal Controls Evaluation:**
  Assess the effectiveness of internal IT controls, including access management, backup and disaster recovery, change management, and data security
  
* **KRI & Risk Reporting:**
  Monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and assist in preparing periodic risk reports and metrics for management and oversight committees
  
  

  
  

**2. Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPRM)**

  

  
* **Vendor Risk Assessments:**
  Perform end-to-end cybersecurity risk assessments for third-party vendors, suppliers, and external service providers
  
* **Artefact Review & Analysis:**
  Review vendor security documentation, including reports, certifications, penetration testing summaries, architecture diagrams, and security policies
  
* **Questionnaire Evaluation:**
  Review and evaluate vendor responses to cybersecurity questionnaires, due diligence requests, and risk evaluations
  
* **Risk Quantification & Tracking:**
  Assign vendor risk ratings, document identified gaps, establish remediation action plans, and track vendor progress on outstanding risk items
  
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with Procurement, Legal, and stakeholder teams during vendor onboarding, ongoing monitoring, and contract reviews
  
* **Incident Monitoring & Escalation:**
  Monitor vendor-related security incidents and advisory alerts, escalating potential issues in accordance with incident response protocols.
  
  

  
**Why Join Us**
  

* **High ownership:**
  Define and drive Fam’s IT risk posture from the ground up—shaping IT, IS & outsourcing risk frameworks
  
* **Org-level impact:**
  Influence decision-making at the highest levels, working cross-functionally with security, legal, engineering, vendors and leadership to embed a strong risk and compliance culture across the org
  
* **Zero to one opportunity:**
  Build scalable, audit-ready systems and processes in a fast-moving startup environment where your work directly enables product innovation and regulatory trust
  
* **Mission-driven:**
  Be part of India’s first payments platform purpose-built for teenagers and young adults—balancing growth with trust, responsibility, and user safety

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

**Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck**

  

• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.

  

• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).

  

• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.

  

• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

  

• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.

  

• Access the latest gadgets and tools.

  

• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.

  

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

  

• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.

  
  

**Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️**

  

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.

  
  

**Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech**

  

FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.

  
  

**Trusted by leading investors**

  

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.

  
  

**Join Our Dynamic Team**

  

At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.

  
  

Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
  
  
**PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.**

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Ping Federate - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality work products within deadlines, actively leading, mentoring, and guiding junior team members. You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading the technical design, setup, and integration of Ping Identity solutions across cloud and on-premises client environments
* Installing, upgrading, and configuring PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, and PingOne products in clustered environments
* Gathering business and technical requirements from client stakeholders and translating them into scalable identity and access management solution designs
* Planning and executing integration, performance, and user acceptance testing, and troubleshooting advanced integration issues with internal and vendor support teams
* Creating technical, architectural, administrator, and end-user documentation to support deployment, maintenance, and adoption
* Supporting compliance with client security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards throughout the deployment lifecycle

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24x7 rotational shifts; flexibility for night, weekend, and holiday coverage; on-call support based on project assignment
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience with at least 2 Ping products, including PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, or PingOne
* Experience architecting and deploying Ping Identity solutions that support authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and policy enforcement
* Experience configuring single sign-on (SSO) and federation integrations using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Experience deploying and upgrading PingFederate, PingOne, PingAccess, or PingDirectory in customer environments, including migrations and clustering for high availability
* Experience configuring Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) connections, including Active Directory or OpenLDAP, for authentication and directory lookups
* Experience customizing authentication policies, adapters, token mapping rules, and workflows within Ping Identity products
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Ping Identity certification
* Experience with certificate management and secure key handling
* Experience integrating with Active Directory, LDAP, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, or cloud directories
* Experience with Java, JavaScript, HyperText Markup Language (HTML), or Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, or Shell scripting for deployment automation
* Experience with user provisioning or System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) integrations in PingOne or PingFederate

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. title: Customer Experience Engineer II
description:
**Overview**
The Security Customer Experience Engineer is a highly customer-connected engineering role within Microsoft Security, focused on the Microsoft Defender portfolio. This role carries end-to-end ownership of high-impact, mission-critical customer escalations, ensuring not only timely resolution but also sustained customer confidence during complex and sensitive situations. Beyond resolving incidents, the engineer plays a strategic role in strengthening product reliability and supportability by working closely with Engineering and Product teams, translating real-world customer challenges into actionable improvements that enhance overall service quality and trust. The position extends well beyond traditional escalation management. It actively contributes to transforming our team within Customer Value Creation from a reactive, case-driven function into a proactive, intelligence-led execution model. By identifying patterns, driving structured feedback loops, and enabling preventative improvements, the engineer helps improve customer outcomes, accelerate engineering responsiveness, and elevate operational efficiency across the organization. Success in this role requires deep technical expertise across security and compliance technologies, strong customer empathy, executive-level communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and high-pressure environments with clarity, composure, and accountability.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Escalation Ownership
  
  

* Own and drive resolution of mission-critical escalations for Microsoft Defender customers in a 24x7x365 environment.
* Engage directly with customers via phone, email, and web channels, providing clear, structured, and confident updates during high-severity incidents.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor during complex, sensitive, and high-pressure situations.
* Restore and maintain customer confidence through transparency, accountability, and structured problem-solving. 2. Deep Technical Problem Solving
* Diagnose and resolve complex issues across the Microsoft Defender suite, including:
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Microsoft Defender for Cloud
* Microsoft Defender for Office
* Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Solution Architects, and Support Engineers to deliver durable, high-quality resolutions.
* Maintain strong hands-on technical depth and continuously expand expertise in Microsoft Security and Compliance technologies. 3. Product Feedback & Continuous Improvement
* Translate customer escalations and issue patterns into actionable insights for Engineering and Product teams.
* Contribute to improvements in product reliability, diagnostics, documentation, and self-remediation guidance.
* Participate in feature readiness reviews, validation testing, and design discussions to prevent future customer impact.
* Influence product design and supportability by representing real customer experiences. 4. Operational Excellence & Proactive Practices
* Apply structured, repeatable approaches to escalation management to improve consistency and time-to-mitigation.
* Identify recurring product or customer pain points and propose proactive improvements, automation strategies, and AI-assisted practices.
* Leverage modern tooling, including AI-based investigation and summarization capabilities, to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Help scale best practices across teams to reduce recurrence and operational friction. 5. Collaboration & Team Enablement
* Partner across Engineering, CSS, CSU, Account Teams, Product Management, and UX to ensure aligned customer outcomes.
* Share knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned to elevate technical capability across the organization.
* Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**
Required/minimum qualifications - Bachelor's Degree Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND 2+ years experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Other Requirements**
Other Requirements
  
  
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
  
  

* This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional or preferred qualifications - Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Data Analytics/Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), or related field AND 5+ years experience in technology industry, cloud, technical support, and/or customer experience engineering OR equivalent experience. 1+ year(s) of customer facing experience.
  
  
**#MSFTSecurity**
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Professional Services Consultant- EMEA
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Professional Services Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid, Bangalore role , reporting to the Senior Manager, Professional Services. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical authority for our enterprise customers — architecting, deploying, and optimizing solutions across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and increasingly complex hybrid environments, you will be the expert who turns that complexity into clarity. You bring deep technical depth, a strategic consulting mindset, and the ability to engage equally well with hands-on engineering teams and senior business stakeholders — delivering outcomes that are secure, scalable, and built to last.Work Shift: EMEA time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Own the full technical engagement lifecycle for enterprise customers — from discovery and solution design through deployment, adoption, and continuous optimization
* Architect and integrate ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange across complex, multi-cloud and hybrid enterprise environments including AI-driven workload scenarios
* Lead Zero Trust maturity assessments, technical discovery workshops, and migration planning sessions with customer and partner stakeholders at all levels
* Guide customers on securing modern identity frameworks, SaaS ecosystems, and AI-powered workflows — translating evolving threat landscapes into actionable, platform-led security outcomes
* Partner with sales, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact consultancy and deployment services that accelerate customer time-to-value

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* 6+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles — Professional Services, Security or Network Consulting, Technical Account Management, Escalation Engineering, or SOC operations
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating Zscaler solutions — ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX — across large-scale, complex enterprise environments
* Strong command of modern identity and access frameworks — SAML, SSO/IdP integrations, MFA, conditional access, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles
* Solid foundation across networking and security fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, PAC files, GRE/IPSec tunnels, proxies, and next-generation firewalls
* Working knowledge of AI/ML security concepts — including shadow AI risk, data loss prevention in AI-powered environments, and securing LLM and API-driven workloads

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Hands-on experience securing cloud-native architectures on Azure, AWS, or GCP — including AI/ML pipelines — with practical exposure to SASE, SSE, and converged security frameworks
* Understanding of AI governance, data security posture management (DSPM), and the security implications of enterprise GenAI adoption
* Industry certifications: ZDTA / ZDTE, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent cloud and security credentials

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans

title: Security Engineer
description:
**Summary**
The Cloud Security team is seeking an experienced IAM Engineer to manage and enhance identity and access management platforms across a multi-cloud environment, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. This night shift role supports real-time coverage during US business hours and involves working within a global IAM operations team.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* **Identity & Access Management:**
  + Operate and maintain enterprise identity services across authentication, federation, access management, lifecycle, and governance.
  + Provision, modify, and revoke user and service account access across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
  + Create and manage IAM roles, policies, permission sets, service principals, managed identities, and service accounts.
  + Implement and enforce role-based access control (RBAC).
  + Implement and support SSO, MFA, conditional access, federation, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, and directory integrations.
  + Conduct periodic access reviews and access certifications to enforce least-privilege.
  + Manage federated access and single sign-on (SSO) integrations across cloud providers and enterprise applications.
* **Cloud Account Lifecycle & Onboarding:**
  + Onboard new cloud accounts, subscriptions, and projects — configuring IAM controls, security baselines, and team access.
  + Manage the full lifecycle of cloud accounts from creation through decommissioning.
  + Create reusable standards, patterns, automation, and runbooks for identity integrations and operations.
  + Coordinate with infrastructure, networking, platform, and product teams during onboarding.
* **Security, Compliance & Governance:**
  + Investigate overly permissive roles, unused credentials, and inactive service accounts.
  + Assess identity platforms and access patterns to reduce risk and support audit and compliance needs.
  + Support compliance audits — prepare evidence, validate access controls, enforce policy.
  + Assist in remediation efforts and incident response as needed — collaborating with operations and engineering teams to resolve access-related issues.
  + Enforce IAM policies, naming conventions, and tagging standards across cloud environments.
* **Automation & Operational Excellence:**
  + Assist in IAM automation efforts as needed — contributing to scripts, tools, and process improvements.
  + Improve identity service reliability through incident response and security hardening.
  + Contribute to the identity roadmap by recommending improvements to security, usability, and operational efficiency.
  + Document procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles for IAM operations.
  + Process access requests and change requests via ticketing systems, ensuring SLAs and security standards are met.
  + Participate in weekend on-call rotation (8-hour shifts).
  + Perform structured shift handoffs with the day team to ensure continuity across time zones.

 
  
**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with cloud IAM across at least two of: AWS, Azure, GCP.
* Demonstrable experience operating and maintaining IAM capabilities across enterprise environments, including public cloud and on-premises systems.
* Deep understanding of identity and authentication protocols such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, LDAP, Kerberos, and SCIM.
* Experience with enterprise identity platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, or similar technologies.
* Working knowledge of MFA, conditional access, privileged access, identity lifecycle processes, access reviews, and least-privilege access models.
* Strong knowledge of security standards, control frameworks, risk management practices, and identity security best practices.
* Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across distributed systems.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities — working effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and application owners across time zones.
* Proven ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple engineering initiatives simultaneously.

 
  
**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience engineering identity and access management solutions across authentication, federation, access control, lifecycle management, access governance, or related identity domains.
* Preferred: Experience with automation of IAM processes, proficiency in scripting languages, OCI experience, relevant certifications, and experience with privileged access management.

title: SDE3, Infrastructure Security Engineer (DevSecOps)
description:
**About The Team**
Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.
  
  
The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.
  
  
**About The Role**
You are an infrastructure engineer whose first instinct is security, and who builds rather than only operates. You have worked on banking, fintech, payments or similarly regulated products, where a misconfiguration is an incident and an audit is routine. Here you set what “secure” means across Sarvam’s infrastructure and build the automation that enforces it, so security is a property of the pipeline rather than a review step. You work closely with the compliance team.
  
  
This is a hands-on role: most of your time goes into building, and you guide engineering teams across Sarvam on security — setting standards, reviewing security-relevant work and mentoring engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and enforce security baselines for Kubernetes, cloud accounts, container images and CI/CD across all clouds
* Write the policy gates in the delivery pipeline (OPA / Conftest, Kyverno or equivalent): network exposure, IAM, image provenance, secrets, data residency
* Own secrets and workload identity: Vault or cloud-native equivalents, rotation, short-lived and scoped credentials, no long-lived keys
* Build detection and response: runtime security (Falco / Tetragon or equivalent), log-based detections, alerting and playbooks
* Run the finding-to-fix loop for security findings: triage, assign, fix, add a detection, retest
* Use LLMs and AI agents in security work: triaging findings, reviewing infrastructure changes, tuning detections, drafting incident timelines — and secure the agents themselves with scoped, short-lived permissions and audit trails
* Harden the supply chain: image signing and scanning, dependency policy, SBOMs
* Automate compliance evidence (CERT-In, ISO 27001, SOC 2, DPDP) together with the compliance team
* Set the security standards other engineers follow and review security-relevant changes
* Take part in on-call and lead security incidents

**Requirements**

* 5–9 years in DevOps, platform or security engineering, with at least 2 in a bank, fintech, payments company or other regulated environment
* Strong Kubernetes and Linux fundamentals; has run production clusters on at least one major cloud
* Hands-on with Terraform / OpenTofu and GitOps (ArgoCD or Flux)
* Has built security automation, not only operated tools: policy-as-code, secrets rotation, CI/CD security gates or detection pipelines
* Working knowledge of IAM, network security, TLS and secrets management across clouds
* Scripting and tooling in Python or Go
* Has been through security audits and knows what evidence auditors need
* Has built or used AI-based automation in infrastructure or security work, and understands the risks of AI agents: prompt injection, over-broad permissions, unreviewed actions
* Nice to have: Vault, SPIFFE / SPIRE, Falco or Tetragon, Cloudflare WAF, incident response lead experience, multi-cloud experience

title: Edge Software & Security Engineer
description:
Role Summary
  
  
Design and build the software foundations that power secure, scalable edge platforms. This role combines edge software skills, platform development, and secure by design strategies to ensure devices can be deployed, updated, managed, and trusted throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Design and develop edge platform services, frameworks, and tooling for embedded and edge environments
* Build secure-by-design platform capabilities including secure boot, cryptographic services, trusted storage, and device identity
* Design and implement resilient OTA update systems for firmware, operating systems, and edge applications
* Develop device lifecycle management capabilities including provisioning, onboarding, configuration management, and retirement
* Implement supply chain security controls including firmware signing, SBOM generation, artifact provenance, and build integrity
* Build and secure CI/CD pipelines, developer workflows, and software delivery toolchains for edge platforms
* Integrate TPMs, TEEs, and secure elements to establish hardware-rooted trust
* Implement device attestation, integrity validation, and remote trust verification mechanisms
* Develop automation, observability, diagnostics, and fleet management capabilities for large-scale edge deployments
* Partner with hardware, firmware, cloud, and product teams to define platform architecture, security requirements, and threat models

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in edge, embedded, platform, or security engineering
* Strong software development experience in Python, Go, C/C++, or Rust
* Experience building software for optimized containerized apps, embedded Linux, or edge computing environments
* Hands-on experience with secure boot, TPMs, secure elements, key management, and hardware-rooted trust
* Knowledge of OTA update architectures, software packaging, and fleet deployment strategies
* Experience implementing secure software supply chains, code signing, SBOMs, and artifact provenance
* Familiarity with containerized edge workloads and orchestration technologies
* Understanding of device identity, attestation, lifecycle management, and zero-trust principles
* Familiarity with operating CI/CD pipelines and modern SDLC practices
* Proficiency with Git and familiarity with Jira, Confluence, and collaborative engineering workflows

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing platform SDKs, APIs, and developer tooling

* Exposure to managing large-scale fleets of connected devices
* Knowledge of cloud-to-edge architectures and hybrid deployment models

****Software Engineer 3 – Network Security****
**Team: Network Security
  
  
Location: Bengaluru**
**About The Team**
**The Network Security team builds and operates foundational network segmentation capabilities that help protect eBay’s production environments across clusters, datacenters, and cloud footprints. The team develops control-plane/data plane services and platform integrations that enforce policy boundaries, strengthen isolation, and improve the security and reliability of critical traffic flows.**
****Role Summary****
**We are seeking a Software Engineer 3 to join the Network Security team with strong hands-on experience in backend systems with Kubernetes framework, and networking fundamentals. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain reliable software components and services that support network policy enforcement and segmentation across distributed environments. You will contribute to production-ready platform capabilities with a strong focus on quality, operability, scalability, and secure engineering practices.**
****What You’ll Do****

* Design, build, and maintain reliable control-plane services that orchestrate network policy and segmentation across Kubernetes clusters and datacenters.
* Develop integrations with SDN and CNI layers such as Istio, Envoy, Calico, or Cilium, along with Linux networking primitives such as iptables, nftables, routing, and VXLAN.
* Write production-quality code backed by unit and integration tests, CI/CD pipelines, and strong observability practices including metrics, logging, and tracing.
* Troubleshoot and debug Kubernetes, Linux networking, and distributed-systems issues, and contribute to incident response and postmortem follow-through.
* Collaborate with partner teams across Security, SRE, and Cloud Platform to deliver reliable and maintainable platform capabilities.
* Improve the reliability, scalability, and operational readiness of services through better rollout practices, configuration management, monitoring, and automation.
* Participate in design discussions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and contribute to implementation planning for features and enhancements.
* Support a culture of engineering excellence through code reviews, documentation, and thoughtful operational ownership.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of software engineering experience in backend or systems engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Go, Python or a similar systems-oriented language, with hands-on experience building distributed services.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP, Linux, and container networking fundamentals.
* Strong Kubernetes fundamentals and hands-on experience building or operating services, controllers, operators, or similar platform components.
* Proven debugging and troubleshooting skills across Kubernetes, Linux networking, and distributed systems.
* Experience running and maintaining services in cloud environments at scale.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, observability, and production support practices.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Experience with etcd, SQL or NoSQL datastores, and control-plane design patterns.
* Familiarity with service mesh technologies, eBPF, or advanced networking and policy frameworks.
* Experience with security policy engines such as OPA or Gatekeeper, multi-tenancy, or multi-cluster controllers.
* Exposure to event pipelines and messaging systems such as Kafka, PubSub, or SQS.

****Why This Role Matters****
**This role is an opportunity to help build and evolve a critical segmentation platform that protects eBay’s infrastructure at scale. You will work on foundational networking and security capabilities that improve isolation, reliability, and operational resilience across distributed systems. Your work will directly strengthen the platform services that safeguard critical traffic and enable secure growth across eBay’s environments.**

title: Senior Software engineer - Advanced Threat Protection
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Security Engineer, Customer Identity, Advanced Threat Protection

**Get to know Okta**

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

**The Role**

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment.

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

**Responsibilities:**

* Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)
* Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants
* Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses
* Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there
* Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited
* Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants
* Establish a deep understanding of Okta Customer Identity products and infrastructure
* Build, deploy & maintain scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize AI threat defenses at scale
* Help meet our operational security commitments by thinking like an attacker, assessing the risk, and advising on mitigation strategies
* Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations and root cause analysis

**What this position is not:**

* Dedicated application security, code review, or compliance-focused work
* Reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them

**Requirements:**

title: SOC Analyst
description:
About the Role

  

Reward360 Global Services (R360) operates a banking loyalty and rewards platform integrated with major Indian and international banks, including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank. As R360 stands up a dedicated inhouse Security Operations Centre (SOC), the Permanent SOC Analyst will be a frontline defender for production environments serving these regulated banking clients, delivering 24x7 detection, triage, and incident response across our EDR/XDR stack, while maintaining strict compliance with PCI DSS v4.0.1, the RBI Cyber Security Framework, and the DPDP Act 2023.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

1. 24x7 Detection & Monitoring

* Monitor CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne , PIM,PAM, and DAM Singularity consoles for endpoint, cloud workload, and identity-based threat detections across production and UAT estates.
* Maintain client-segmented visibility and SLA adherence for HDFC, ICICI, and Kotak-linked environments in line with each bank's InfoSec SLA and contractual security addenda.

2. Triage, Investigation & Escalation

* Perform L1/L2 alert triage and investigation, mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK tactics/techniques.
* Tune detection rules (custom IOAs in CrowdStrike, Deep Visibility / STAR rules in SentinelOne) to reduce false positives without eroding coverage.
* Escalate confirmed incidents per the SOC escalation matrix, with clear severity classification and business-impact framing.

3. Incident Response

* Execute containment, eradication, and recovery actions using EDR host-isolation and remediation capability.
* Preserve chain-of-custody and forensic integrity for evidence supporting internal investigations and, where required, regulator/bank-facing reporting. Support incident timelines aligned to RBI's cyber-incident reporting mandate and CERT-In reporting obligations.

4. Threat Hunting & Detection Engineering

* Run hypothesis-driven threat hunts across endpoint telemetry, prioritizing BFSI-targeted TTPs (banking trojans, ATM/POS malware families, phishing-to-RAT chains, credential-harvesting campaigns).
* Correlate EDR telemetry with SIEM, AWS WAF, CloudTrail, and application logs to reconstruct crossenvironment attack chains.

5. Compliance, Audit & Change Support

* Provide InfoSec sign-off inputs for change requests (PCCB) impacting SOC-monitored assets, where applicable.
* Support PCI DSS QSA assessments, ISO 27001 audits, and bank-specific annual vendor security reviews with SOC tooling evidence (alert logs, detection coverage reports, response-time metrics).

6. Documentation & Mentorship

* Maintain shift handover notes, SOC playbooks, and runbooks; contribute to continuous improvement of detection use cases.
* Mentor SOC interns on triage methodology, tool usage, and escalation discipline.

  

Required Qualifications

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2–3 years of hands-on SOC / blue-team experience, ideally within BFSI, fintech, or another regulated environment.
* Working expertise with at least one EDR/XDR/ platform, incident responder; CrowdStrike Falcon and/or SentinelOne Singularity strongly preferred.
* Solid grounding in the MITRE ATT&CK framework, cyber kill chain analysis, and common BFSI threat-actor TTPs.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms (Splunk / QRadar / Microsoft Sentinel / ELK) for cross-source log correlation.
* Working knowledge of PCI DSS v4.0.1 (particularly Requirements 10, 11, and 12), the RBI Cyber Security Framework, and DPDP Act 2023 fundamentals.
* Comfort with Windows and Linux internals, core network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S), and common attack vectors.
* Scripting/automation ability (Python or PowerShell) for detection engineering or SOAR playbook development is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with building internal SOC tools and Agentic automation

  

Preferred Certifications

  

* CompTIA Security+ / CySA+

CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) or Responder (CCFR) CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)

CSA OSDA

  

Soft Skills

  

* Willingness and ability to work rotational shifts, including nights and weekends, as part of 24x7 SOC coverage.
* Strong written communication for incident reports, shift handovers, and periodic client-facing summaries.
* Composure under pressure, able to prioritise correctly during multi-alert or major-incident scenarios.

Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. We advance innovative ideas every day to build stronger clients, individuals, and communities. title: SOC Analyst Intern
description:
**About the Role**
==================

R360 is building a dedicated in-house Security Operations Center (SOC) to deliver 24x7 monitoring for its bankinglinked platforms serving HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank. This internship gives you structured, mentored exposure to enterprise EDR/XDR tooling CrowdStrike Falcon and SentinelOne Singularity — inside a live, regulated BFSI environment. It's a rare early-career opportunity to build real SOC muscle memory rather than lab simulations, under the direct supervision of senior analystss.

**Key Responsibilities (Under Supervision)**
--------------------------------------------

* Assist with L1 alert monitoring and triage across CrowdStrike Falcon and SentinelOne Singularity dashboards.
* Learn to map detections against the MITRE ATT&CK framework to classify alert severity and intent.
* Support shift handover documentation and SOC ticket logging in Jira.
* Assist senior analysts with evidence collection during incident investigations.
* Learn foundational log correlation across SIEM, WAF, and CloudTrail data sources.
* Participate in SOC playbook walkthroughs and incident-response tabletop exercises.
* Help document standard operating procedures (SOPs) and new detection use cases.
* Progressively take ownership of low-severity alert closure, with mandatory senior-analyst review before closure.

  

**Learning Outcomes**
---------------------

* Hands-on operational experience with two industry-leading EDR/XDR platforms.
* Exposure to real BFSI incident-response workflows and their regulatory context (PCI DSS v4.0.1, RBI Cyber Security Framework).
* Foundational SOC analyst skills that map directly to L1/L2 career progression.

  

**Eligibility**
---------------

* Graduate with any background.
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS), operating systems (Windows/Linux), and core security concepts.
* Self-driven learners with prior exposure to CTF platforms (TryHackMe, HackTheBox) are strongly preferred.
* Willingness to work in shifts, including some night/weekend rotations, as part of SOC exposure.

  

**Preferred**
-------------

* A personal CTF/lab track record — TryHackMe or HackTheBox profile link is welcomed with the application.

SOC Lab project Networking, OS, **Program Structure**

### **1. Month 1–2Foundations**

* SOC fundamentals orientation; guided walkthroughs of CrowdStrike Falcon and SentinelOne Singularity; shadowing L1 analysts on live alerts.

### **2. Month 3–4Guided Triage**

* Hands-on alert triage with mandatory senior review; MITRE ATT&CK practice drills; introduction to SIEM correlation basics.

### **3. Month 5–6Supervised Independence**

* Independent handling of low-severity alerts (reviewed before closure); capstone project — build one detection use case or SOC playbook end to end.

### **4. Conversion**

* Performance evaluated against triage accuracy, escalation judgment, documentation quality, and shift reliability; strong performers are considered for full-time SOC Analyst conversion.

title: Director - SN Platform Manager
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The ServiceNow (SN) Platform Manager is accountable for the stability, compliance, and evolution of the ServiceNow platform within the ServiceNow Platform and Enterprise Tools Domain. The role ensures that core ServiceNow platform is secure, resilient, compliant, and fit for purpose, supporting critical people processes across the organisation.

Working closely with the ServiceNow Platform and Enterprise Tools Domain Lead, Product Managers, Solution Architects, and ServiceNow stakeholders, the Platform Manager translates functional priorities into a platform roadmap covering configuration, releases, integrations, data, and technical risk. The role provides technical leadership across platform operations, vendor management, and platform governance, ensuring ServiceNow solutions are operated and enhanced in line with enterprise standards, regulatory requirements, and long-term architectural direction.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own the end-to-end platform lifecycle for ServiceNow systems, including roadmap planning, configuration governance, release management, and platform evolution.
* Translate ServiceNow domain strategy into a platform roadmap, prioritising configuration changes, vendor releases, integrations, and technical improvements across ServiceNow.
* Provide direction to Product Owners and Analysts on what is delivered through platform configuration versus customisation, ensuring alignment with vendor best practice and enterprise architecture guidance.
* Act as the primary technical authority for ServiceNow platforms, ensuring solutions are compliant, secure, supportable, and aligned to enterprise and regulatory standards.
* Oversee vendor and system integrator relationships, managing delivery quality, roadmap alignment, release planning, and contractual obligations.
* Govern platform risk, controls, and compliance, embedding required controls (e.g. security, data protection, audit, payroll regulations) in partnership with Security, Risk, and Compliance SMEs.
* Coordinate platform changes across Product, Architecture, Data, Service Operations, and Change, ensuring operational readiness, documentation, and support models are in place prior to go-live.
* Act as an escalation point for platform stability, release issues, integration failures, and vendor-related risks, driving timely resolution and root cause remediation.
* Ensure effective integration management across ServiceNow, Identity, and downstream systems, working closely with Solution and Data Architects.
* Track and report platform performance KPIs (e.g. stability, release success, defect trends, audit findings, vendor performance), driving continuous improvement across the platform estate.
* Provide financial oversight of the domain, including product budgets and internal/external team resourcing costs, to inform strategic decision‑making and ensure alignment with GSK’s financial objectives.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM)

**Job Experience:**

  

* Typically 18+ years’ experience in ServiceNow technology, platform management, or enterprise systems.
* Experience with AI capabilities in marketplace and ServiceNow Offerings to support GSK Enterprise Automation/AI strategy.
* Proven experience managing vendor-led platforms, including roadmap planning, configuration governance, and release management.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing complex ServiceNow systems in regulated environments, including audit, compliance, and data protection requirements.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across Product, Architecture, Security, Data, Service Operations, and Change.
* Strong ability to explain technical and platform constraints to non-technical ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Experience managing platform dependencies, integrations, and third-party suppliers.
* Proven leadership experience managing small to medium technology teams or platform delivery functions.

**Desirable Requirements:**

  

* End-to-end ServiceNow platform architecture ownership – Broad understanding of the ServiceNow ecosystem, ensuring coherent architecture decisions across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CSM, HR, and custom apps. GxP and Sox experience with risk and compliance to support platform audits.
* Governance of platform architecture board and design standards – Proven ability to run an architecture board, define guardrails and patterns, and enforce reuse, data model consistency, and integration standards across engineering teams.
* Upgrade strategy and technical stewardship for a mature platform – Experience planning and executing annual upgrades, managing breaking changes, deprecated features, and regression risk while maintaining high availability and performance.
* Platform reliability, observability, and performance engineering – Skilled in monitoring and tuning the instance (logs, metrics, error budgets), proactively addressing stability issues, and driving remediation of architectural/technical debt.
* Licensing, entitlement, and cost optimisation for ServiceNow – Strong grasp of licensing models, roles, and entitlements, able to guide product teams on usage patterns that maximise value while controlling cost and compliance exposure.

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Strong platform and commercial acumen, including vendor management and contract awareness.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to align ServiceNow, Finance, and Technology stakeholders.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to assess platform risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Comfortable operating within structured governance, security, and regulatory environments.
* Ability to challenge requirements constructively to protect platform integrity and long-term viability.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Enterprise Application Architecture, Executive Communications, Information Governance, Leadership Planning, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Service Delivery Platforms, Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Senior Global Data AI Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

**Mission of the Role**

Do you enjoy turning real business challenges into working AI solutions? Would you like to do it at a global company that is changing its industry with new technology? ABB is looking for a **hands-on AI/ML Engineer** to join our **Information Systems (IS)**.

This is a **specialist role where you build the solutions yourself**. It is not a coordination or management role. You will work with the business to understand its needs and then find the best answer. That could be a predictive model, an LLM or SLM, an AI agent, a GenAI application, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. You will take that solution from idea to production and keep it running well in operations.

If you have experience with **Azure AI/ML, Snowflake, GenAI and MLOps**, and you want to own solutions from start to finish across both Dev and Ops, this opportunity is for you!

**Work model:** Hybrid #LI-Hybrid

**Responsibilities**

**Business understanding and solution design**

* Work with business stakeholders and Data Analysts to clarify needs, requirements, expected outcomes, success measures, data and context requirements, risks and ownership.
* Decide which approach fits each business problem best: AI/ML, GenAI, analytics, automation or a conventional solution. This includes choosing the right model type (ML, LLM, SLM), the right agent design and the right technology.
* Design scalable solutions that follow enterprise architecture, security and governance standards, with guidance from the Advanced Analytics Architect and platform architects.

**Build and deploy**

* Develop, validate and deploy production-ready AI/ML solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry and other approved technologies.
* Build ML and GenAI applications, including predictive models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, AI agents, APIs, orchestration, retrieval and enterprise data integrations.
* Build and integrate LLM-based solutions and conversational agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI and, where appropriate, Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Support Copilot and other AI platforms, such as Anthropic models.
* Use enterprise data from **SAP and Salesforce** to build predictive models, GenAI applications and AI agents that deliver measurable business value.
* Build secure, reliable data ingestion and processing from **Snowflake** and other enterprise sources, with attention to data quality, lineage, access control and cost efficiency.
* Apply Snowflake AI/ML capabilities, including **Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Search and AI Functions**.
* Develop reusable components and automated pipelines for data preparation, feature engineering, training, inference, evaluation, testing, deployment and retraining, using CI/CD and version control.

**Evaluate, operate and improve (DevOps / MLOps / AIOps)**

* Evaluate model accuracy, explainability, grounding, agent behaviour, safety, business value, performance, reliability and cost.
* Set up and run MLOps/AIOps practices: monitoring, drift detection, **cost monitoring, root-cause analysis**, retraining and continuous improvement. You own both development and operations.
* Contribute to production readiness, operational handover, incident and problem analysis, monitoring design and reliable day-to-day operations.
* Apply Responsible AI, information security, privacy, compliance, identity and access management, secrets management and other ABB requirements within your solution scope.

**Ownership and collaboration**

* Own your deliverables end to end. Estimate effort, manage priorities, report progress and risks, and work independently within the agreed architecture and platform guardrails.
* Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Snowflake Developers, Data Engineers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, platform specialists and domain experts.
* Document solution logic, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results and operational requirements. Contribute reusable assets, engineering practices, knowledge sharing and mentoring.

**Requirements**

**Education and experience**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering, analytics engineering or related roles, including taking AI/ML solutions to production.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions end to end: business requirements, data preparation, development, validation, deployment and monitoring.

**Technical skills**

* Practical Python and SQL skills for data preparation, model development, API integration, testing and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with **Azure Machine Learning and Microsoft Foundry**: pipelines, compute, environments, model deployment, endpoints, agents and evaluation.
* Strong understanding of GenAI patterns: LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt/context engineering, agent design and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, model validation, regression, time series and hypothesis testing.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn and, where relevant, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with automated pipelines and CI/CD, using version control and testing practices, preferably in Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Hands-on experience with **Snowflake AI/ML tools** (Snowpark ML, Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, AI Functions) and Snowflake connectors.
* Experience analysing, modelling and integrating **SAP and Salesforce** data. This means understanding source data structures, business entities, relationships and transformation requirements.

**Operations and governance**

* Understanding of how AI/ML solutions run in production: monitoring, reliability, performance, cost management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Working knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud security, privacy, compliance, data governance and Responsible AI principles.

**Communication and language**

* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions, explain options and trade-offs, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Fluent spoken and written English (minimum C1).

**Nice to Have / Differentiators**

* Experience with LLM frameworks such as the Azure OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent.
* Experience with other AI platforms and models (e.g., Anthropic, SLMs).
* Microsoft certifications: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103), Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) or Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300).
* Snowflake certifications, such as SnowPro Core or relevant GenAI certifications.
* Experience using Azure DevOps for work planning, execution and reporting.
* Experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Streamlit or other data visualisation tools.
* Knowledge of Azure infrastructure for AI/ML workloads: networking, VNets/private endpoints, Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, containers, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
* Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep or Terraform).
* Experience mentoring colleagues or contributing to shared engineering standards and reusable assets.

**What We Offer**

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

**The Opportunity:**

The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer is the senior technical authority responsible for connecting governed enterprise data and business meaning with scalable analytics and artificial intelligence solutions. This role defines the architecture, standards, and engineering patterns for semantic models, governed metrics, AI-ready data products, machine learning operations, and generative AI consumption.

Operating at the intersection of Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science, Governance, and AI Platform Engineering, this role ensures that enterprise data, metrics, models, and knowledge assets can be reliably discovered, understood, deployed, monitored, and reused. The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership, guides complex implementations, and mentors engineers and analysts while remaining an individual contributor**.**

**What you’ll do…**

**Semantic Architecture & Governed Metrics**

* Define enterprise standards and reference patterns for semantic models, dimensional models, business metrics, KPIs, hierarchies, calculations, and reusable analytical assets.
* Architect semantic consumption patterns across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks Gold-layer data, and approved AI applications.
* Partner with business domain owners, analysts, and Data Governance to translate business concepts into consistent, governed definitions and analytical models.
* Lead design reviews for semantic models and analytical data products, balancing usability, reuse, performance, security, and maintainability.

* Guide implementation of feature pipelines, model registries, inference workflows, retrieval pipelines, vectorized knowledge assets, and AI evaluation frameworks.

* Design curated, governed data products and knowledge assets for predictive analytics, generative AI, copilots, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation.

* Collaborate with Architecture and Governance teams on ontology, glossary, metadata, lineage, classification, and policy integration.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Create reference implementations, reusable frameworks, coding standards, and engineering playbooks.
* Mentor Senior Analytics & AI Engineers, Semantic Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists.
* Influence cross-functional roadmaps and communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.

* 10+ years of experience across analytics engineering, business intelligence, semantic modeling, data engineering, machine learning engineering, MLOps, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a principal-level technical leader or architect for enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions.
* Deep expertise in SQL, dimensional modeling, semantic model design, analytical performance optimization, and governed metric implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric semantic models, including DAX and enterprise-scale model design.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data and AI platform, including production data pipelines and model lifecycle capabilities.
* Experience designing or operating CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registries, monitoring, evaluation, and observability for ML or generative AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of generative AI patterns such as embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, prompt and model evaluation, and agent-based solutions.
* Strong understanding of metadata, lineage, data quality, access control, business glossary, and responsible AI principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Accounts & Hierarchy:** Streamline the onboarding and management of client/entity accounts, ensuring robust parent-child account hierarchy models and internal "Books" mapping for accurate downstream reporting.
* **Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI):** Oversee the automation and maintenance of SSIs across custody and clearing networks to mitigate settlement risk and reduce trade fail rates.
* **Pricing & Valuation:** Collaborate with pricing desks and market data vendors to implement or refine instrument valuation models, ensuring the integrity of real-time price feeds, corporate action adjustments, and end-of-day valuations.

**3. Project Management (Adaptive Focus)**

* **Lifecycle Management:** Coordinate project phases through the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using Agile, Scrum, or Hybrid methodologies.

* **Defect Management:** Collaborate with QA teams to prioritize, track, and resolve system defects during the testing phase.

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in a Business Analyst role with progressive project coordination responsibilities within Investment Banking, Asset Management, or Securities Services.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the post-trade lifecycle, settlement processes, instrument master data, account hierarchy structures, internal book mappings, and security pricing.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Job Summary/Objective**

The Senior Systems Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role responsible for the design, administration, and continuous improvement of OEC’s corporate IT environment. Scope spans Windows Server, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, identity and access management, and endpoint management, with active expansion into IaC and AWS. Security is foundational — every system, configuration, and access decision is approached through a security lens. This person operates independently, holds a high standard for documentation, and actively contributes to team growth.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties(essential to the job)**

1. Administer and maintain Windows Server and endpoint environments, including patching, configuration, and root-cause analysis.
2. Manage Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Intune) and maintain Conditional Access posture.
3. Operate endpoint management tooling (Intune, SCCM/Autopatch, Jamf) including policy, enrollment, and compliance enforcement.
4. Maintain DNS, DHCP, SMTP, file services, and Active Directory (GPO, ADUC).
5. Contribute to IaC adoption — reviewing, testing, and authoring configurations as skills develop.
6. Support and expand AWS cloud infrastructure deployments.
7. Read, modify, and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts; AI-assisted authoring (Copilot, Claude) is available and encouraged.
8. Identify access control gaps, configuration risks, and hardening opportunities proactively.
9. Author and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and troubleshooting guides; track work in Jira and JSM.
10. Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours system emergencies.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline. In the absenceof a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

**Experience, Skills and Key Competencies**

At least 10 years in systems engineering or IT infrastructure, with demonstrated experience administering Microsoft 365, Windows Server, enterprise identity platforms (Active Directory, Entra ID), and endpoint management (Intune, SCCM, or Jamf). Ability to read and modify PowerShell is required. Modern Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-102, Azure Administrator) are preferred.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

**Required Skills**

* Windows Server and Active Directory — GPO, ADUC, DNS, DHCP, SMTP, patching, and domain services
* Microsoft 365 — Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access
* Endpoint management — Intune, SCCM/Autopatch, and/or Jamf
* Virtualization — VMware vSphere/ESXi or Hyper-V
* Identity and access management — SSO/IdP, MFA, RBAC, and privileged access concepts
* PowerShell — read and modify scripts; authoring supported by AI tooling
* Mail flow and hygiene — Exchange with platforms such as Mimecast
* Jira and JSM — project tracking and ticketing

**Preferred Skills & Team Growth Areas**

Candidates who bring the following contribute immediately; those who don’t are expected to grow into them.

**Infrastructure as Code (Active Growth Priority)**

* Terraform or equivalent IaC tooling
* Version-controlled infrastructure configuration and change pipelines
* HCL, YAML, or JSON declarative configuration

**AWS Cloud Infrastructure (Active Growth Priority)**

* Hands-on AWS experience for corporate IT or infrastructure workloads
* Networking, IAM, and compute in AWS environments
* AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator) are a plus

**Travel & Other Considerations**

Travel is rare. This position requires availability for after-hours on-call response as part of the team rotation.
