title: Operations Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

OEC is in the middle of a multi-year journey to modernise its infrastructure and applications, transforming how we build, deploy, and operate software at global scale. The Operations Specialist (L2) is a core member of the Monitoring Team within the Enterprise Operations Team, responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of OEC’s observability stack, primarily powered by Datadog.

In this role you will own L2 alert triage, incident response, dashboard development, and service onboarding — contributing to the team’s tooling standards and best practices. You will also handle day-to-day server monitoring, infrastructure support, and service management tasks that keep OEC’s global platforms running reliably.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties (essential to the job)**

**Monitoring & alerting**

* Design, configure, and maintain Datadog monitors, composite alerts, and notification channels for production and non-production environments.
* Own the L2 alert triage process — investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated alerts from L1, ensuring timely root cause identification.
* Tune alert thresholds and suppression rules to minimise noise and reduce false positive rates.
* Manage SLO (Service Level Objective) definitions, tracking, and reporting across assigned services.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

**Dashboards & observability**

* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards covering infrastructure health, application performance, log analytics, and business KPIs.
* Configure and manage Datadog APM (Application Performance Monitoring), distributed tracing, and error tracking for key services.
* Implement and manage log ingestion pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based monitors.
* Develop and maintain Synthetic monitors (API and browser tests) for uptime and user experience validation.

**Service onboarding & integrations**

* Onboard new services and infrastructure components into the Datadog monitoring framework in collaboration with DevOps, Cloud, and Engineering teams.
* Configure and maintain Datadog integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Rackspace), Kubernetes, containerised workloads, and third-party tools.
* Support the migration of legacy monitoring tooling (SCOM, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Pingdom, Apigee, Redgate, IDERA) into Datadog.

**Incident response & runbooks**

* Act as L2 escalation point during incidents — perform deep-dive investigations using metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for common alert scenarios, incident response procedures, and post-incident remediation steps.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews, documenting root cause findings and identifying monitoring gaps to prevent recurrence.
* Alerts system owners, stakeholders, and management of degraded system status and Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents; issues tickets for incident and problem escalation.

**AI & automation**

* Leverage Datadog AI capabilities including Watchdog, anomaly detection, outlier detection, and Bits AI to improve proactive issue detection.
* Implement forecast-based monitors for capacity management (CPU, memory, disk).
* Use AI-based alert correlation and deduplication features to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive monitoring tasks using Datadog’s API and scripting tools.

**Standards & governance**

* Adhere to and actively contribute to monitoring standards, tagging strategies, and naming conventions.
* Participate in regular alert quality reviews, dashboard audits, and SLO compliance checks.
* Maintain accurate documentation of monitoring configurations, integrations, and architectural decisions.
* Creates and maintains knowledge articles to be used internally and/or externally for training, best practices, solutions, or processes relating to applications, environments, and related technologies.

**Infrastructure operations & support**

* Analyses and troubleshoots Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations and processes.
* Performs moderately complex database administration.
* Monitors data centre networks, infrastructure bandwidth, application health, servers, and other infrastructure; coordinates and communicates with vendors.
* Diagnoses and researches (using knowledge base) application incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests; provides assistance and guidance to associate operations specialists.
* Adheres to all incident and service request processes and procedures in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Diagnoses, researches, and resolves Level-2 technical hardware and software incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests.
* Works on ad-hoc projects to support Infrastructure Engineering or other departments, as requested.
* Demonstrates a flexible and adaptable approach to work and adjusts to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.
* Collaborates with DevOps, Cloud, and application teams to align monitoring coverage with service requirements.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

**Experience, Skills and Key Competencies**

At least 5+ years of experience in an infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or monitoring engineering role is required, with hands-on experience in Datadog and working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and containerised environments.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on experience with Datadog — monitors, dashboards, APM, log management, SLOs, and synthetic monitoring.
* Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS required; Azure or GCP a plus) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability concepts: metrics, traces, and logs.
* Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of ITSM concepts and ticketing workflows (Jira, JSM, or ServiceNow).
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations, Active Directory, and internet protocols (HTTP, FTP, DNS, IP, SSH).

**Soft skills & competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to produce runbooks and incident summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively across Engineering, DevOps, and Operations disciplines.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they escalate.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to work; able to adjust to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Datadog Fundamentals or Datadog APM certification (or actively working towards one).
* At least 2 year of experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of network monitoring and distributed systems architecture.
* Exposure to ITIL or ITSM frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
* Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, JSM, Confluence) for documentation and ticket management.

**Special Position Requirements**

* Must be able to read, write, understand, and speak fluent English.
* Must be able to work flexible shifts including holidays and weekends, to provide support across locations and time zones.
* Must be able to participate in an on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

title: Production Support Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**About the Role**

Citi's Securities Services division is seeking a Senior Production Support Analyst to join the Data & Client Platforms (DCP) Production Support team — a globally distributed, 24×6 function supporting business-critical and client-facing data and reporting platforms across Investor & Issuer Services.

This is a senior operational role that sits at the intersection of data platform operations, client service delivery, and technology transformation. The DCP PS team supports an expanding portfolio of platforms serving some of the world's largest institutional investors, across multiple geographies and business lines within Investor & Issuer Services.

The team is actively investing in engineering capability, automation, and AI-assisted operations — making this an opportunity for candidates who want to grow beyond traditional incident management into a forward-looking, engineering-oriented production support function.

**What You Will Be Working On**

The DCP platform underpins Citi's data distribution, client reporting, and operational data services across Securities Services. You will be supporting a portfolio of proprietary and industry-standard platforms spanning:

* **Client data and reporting platforms** — real-time and end-of-day data delivery, client reporting, and operational oversight tools
* **Data lake and cloud-native platforms** — next-generation cloud data infrastructure built on modern technologies including Snowflake, Apache Kafka, Couchbase, Amazon S3, and DataBricks
* **Client-facing digital experience** — platforms delivering data, reporting, and instructions to institutional clients via Citi's digital channels
* **Entitlements and data access management** — infrastructure governing client and user access to data services

The platform is undergoing significant transformation — including migration of applications to modernised digital platforms, consolidation of data services across business lines, and adoption of cloud-native data lake architectures. You will be directly involved in supporting this evolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Operations**

* Provide L2 production support across the DCP application portfolio — incident triage, investigation, escalation, and resolution — operating within a global follow-the-sun support model
* Perform start-of-day checks, continuous platform monitoring, and structured regional handovers to ensure seamless 24×6 coverage
* Manage and resolve user and client-reported incidents via ServiceNow, maintaining SLA adherence and clear communication throughout the incident lifecycle

**Client Service & Communication**

* Act as the internal operational point of contact for client-impacting incidents — providing timely, accurate, and professional communication to client-facing teams including Client Services, Technology Relationship Managers, and Operations
* Proactively identify and escalate data quality and service availability issues — contributing to a detect-first operating model that reduces client-reported incidents
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of a centralised service level inventory — ensuring Citi's commitments to institutional clients are tracked, governed, and met

**Platform Stability & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and drive resolution of recurring incident patterns through structured problem management — reducing manual toil and preventing reoccurrence
* Develop and maintain technical runbooks, support documentation, and operational procedures across the platform portfolio
* Contribute to automation and observability initiatives — using tools including Grafana, ITRS, and GCO — to reduce manual effort and improve platform monitoring coverage
* Participate in change management activities including release preparation, deployment support, post-implementation review, and production risk assessments

**Engineering & AI Enablement**

* Actively engage with and adopt AI-assisted tooling for incident troubleshooting, automated investigation, and resiliency gap detection — aligned to Citi's firm-wide AI-driven production management strategy
* Contribute to operational readiness for new platform migrations and onboarding — ensuring production support capability keeps pace with technology evolution
* Partner with development and platform engineering teams to influence upstream design decisions that improve production operability and resilience

**Transformation & Programme Delivery**

* Participate in continuous improvement workstream items spanning automation efficiency, monitoring uplift, resiliency, and application onboarding
* Support DCP's expansion as the central data services hub across Investor & Issuer Services
* Contribute to business continuity planning, contingency testing, and resiliency exercises across the platform portfolio

**Team & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as subject matter expert (SME) for one or more platforms — owning operational knowledge and serving as escalation point for junior team members
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with Development, Platform Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Audit, Infrastructure, and Vendor/Partner teams
* Contributing to the team's reputation as a value-adding, engineering-oriented function

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience**

* 4 to 8 years in an application support, production management, or platform operations role — preferably within financial services or data-intensive environments
* Hands-on experience supporting data pipelines, reporting platforms, or client-facing financial applications
* Experience working within a global, follow-the-sun support model across multiple time zones
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management processes

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of SQL and data querying — ability to investigate data quality issues across relational and cloud databases
* Experience with Snowflake, Couchbase, Amazon S3, or DataBricks is advantageous
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling such as Grafana or ITRS or GCO
* Experience with automation scripting (Python, Shell, or equivalent) — ability and willingness to build and maintain operational automation
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms for incident and problem management
* Understanding of cloud-native data architectures — data lakes, streaming pipelines, and event-driven architecture — is advantageous
* Interest in and exposure to AI-assisted operations tooling — agentic triage, automated incident investigation, or intelligent monitoring

**Behavioural & Professional**

* Strong analytical and investigative mindset — able to work through complex, ambiguous production issues methodically and under pressure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders including client-facing teams and senior management
* Client-first orientation — understands the impact of production issues on institutional clients and takes ownership of communication and resolution
* Proactive and improvement-oriented — actively looks for ways to reduce toil, improve processes, and uplift team capability
* Collaborative — operates effectively in a geographically distributed team with shared accountability for platform health
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change — the DCP platform is in active transformation and the role requires adaptability as scope, technology, and operating model evolve

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline — or equivalent professional experience

**Why Join DCP Production Support at Citi**

* **Strategic importance** — DCP PS supports Citi's Securities Services data and client experience infrastructure, serving some of the world's largest institutional investors across a platform undergoing major transformation
* **Engineering growth** — the team is actively investing in automation, AI-assisted operations, and engineering capability — this is a role for candidates who want to grow beyond incident management into a technically sophisticated, forward-looking function
* **Global reach** — work within a globally distributed follow-the-sun team across EMEA, NAM, and Asia Pacific with genuine cross-regional collaboration and career mobility
* **Transformation exposure** — direct involvement in major platform programmes including cloud data lake modernisation, client platform migration, and multi-business-line data services consolidation
* **AI-forward environment** — early involvement in AI-assisted production management tooling aligned to Citi's firm-wide intelligent operations strategy

The incumbent solves problems by determining the best architecture, within departmental guidelines, from many existing solutions.

Basic qualifications:

* Expert in implementing security measures for data at rest and in transit and defining access control, encryption, and compliance frameworks

* Expertise and experience in building Large Data Lakes and Data Warehouse (Snowflake Preferred).
* Expertise in building end-to-end near real-time data pipelines for OLTP & OLAP.
* Strong architecture exposure for building robust Data Platforms
* Expertise in SQL and NO-SQL databases, Message brokers and other AWS services such as Kafka/Kinesis, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora, AWS RDS PostgreSQL.
* Test driven development and behaviour driven development.

title: Security GRC Analyst
description:
**Description**
**Information Security Associate – Risk Operations**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Who We Are And Where We're Going**
**Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline.**
Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We're replacing that model with one that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.
  
  
**Our Strategy**
**Risk-informed, control managed.**
We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. This proves trust while delivering risk operations, compliance artifacts, and outputs, and it opens access to new markets through the product we build and the behavior we change.
  
  
**Visibility and invention.**
We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. We equip the Assurance team with a new way of protecting Salesforce, through the invention we create together. We also invest in the people who work here, with room to grow, take on new challenges, and drive excellence.
  
  
**Always in front.**
We turn gaps into signals, alerts, and escalations. When a control fails, it flows into a workflow built to help stakeholders meet their trust obligations. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.
  
  
We're hiring people who want to build this future. You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do …**
Risk Operations provides a centralized approach to identifying, prioritizing, and managing cybersecurity risks, driving accountability, faster decision-making, and measurable risk reduction. The team partners across security, engineering, and business functions to streamline risk management processes, improve visibility into risk exposure, and ensure timely escalation and resolution.
  
  
We're looking for an Information Security Associate who is excited to help build and support a growing Risk Operations function. In this role, you'll be at the center of day-to-day security issue and exception management activities, helping ensure risk cases are accurately documented, efficiently processed, and consistently tracked through resolution. You'll work closely with experienced risk and security professionals while contributing to the development of workflows, processes, and reporting that will help shape how Risk Operations operates at scale.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for an early-career security professional who enjoys solving problems, bringing organization to complex processes, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  
  

* Rapid Decision Management: We work in a business. Predictability and rapid decisions are the core outcomes you’ll bring to the job. Support rapid risk decision-making by coordinating timely reviews, approvals, and escalations, ensuring decision-makers have the information needed to assess risks and take action.
* Support day-to-day security risk operations by managing the intake, triage, and tracking of security issues and exceptions to accelerate risk-based decisions and timely resolution.
* Coordinate issue and exception management activities, including reviewing submissions for completeness, following up with stakeholders, tracking remediation commitments, monitoring exception expiration dates, and supporting timely case resolution.
* Maintain accurate and complete risk records in case management platforms, ensuring consistent documentation, appropriate case status, and reliable data for operational reporting.
* Partner with security, engineering, and compliance teams to gather information, clarify case requirements, resolve operational blockers, and accelerate risk-based decision-making by ensuring stakeholders have the information, context, and visibility needed to take timely action.
* Support timely risk decisions and escalations by monitoring case progress, identifying stalled requests or decision gaps, and coordinating follow-ups to ensure issues and exceptions move efficiently through established governance and approval workflows.
* Assist with operational reporting and metrics, including tracking case volumes, aging, remediation progress, exception renewals, and other key performance indicators to provide visibility into risk operations activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate repetitive tasks, helping streamline case handling, improve data quality, and enhance the overall stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to broader Risk Operations initiatives by supporting ad hoc requests, process improvements, and emerging operational needs as the team establishes and matures its capabilities.

**What You Bring ...**

* You have +2 years of experience in information security or security operations, or a related field.
* You have a foundational understanding of information security concepts, including security findings, risk remediation, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance.
* You have sufficient technical ability to serve as one of many eyes as we assess the certainty of our compensating controls and exposures.
* You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities while maintaining accurate records.
* You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information for completeness, identify inconsistencies, and recognize when issues require additional attention or escalation.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, clarify requirements, and drive timely follow-through.
* You are comfortable learning new tools, navigating workflow or ticketing systems, and working with spreadsheets and data to support operational activities.
* You are adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes and responsibilities are still being established.
* You have a continuous improvement mindset and are eager to learn, contribute ideas, and help build scalable and efficient security risk management practices.

**How We Work**

* Engineering-first culture. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
* Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
* Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
* Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
* Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
* Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.

**Modern Tooling Acumen**
Direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. Must be able to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes.
  
  
Graduates need direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. This is a newer requirement; candidates who have actively experimented with and used tools like Gemini, Cursor, or other agent-based frameworks will be stronger candidates.
  
  
**About Futureforce**
FutureForce is for college students or new grads wanting to experience life at Salesforce, one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies 5-years-running and one of Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” 8- years-running. FutureForce interns work on live projects, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact that they can show to friends, family, and future employers if we don’t hire them first (and, we hire 80% of our eligible interns)!
  
  
They have the chance to collaborate and connect with the Salesforce interns from all over the world. And, like all Salesforce employees, interns also have many possibilities to volunteer, making a lasting impact in the community.
  
  
FutureForce offers a collaborative work environment, which promotes innovation, provides flexibility and most importantly is fun!

title: Assistant Manager, Cybersecurity Architecture
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Assistant Manager, Security Architecture**
As part of the Secure Design team, you will help ensure cybersecurity requirements are embedded throughout the lifecycle of business applications, enterprise platforms, cloud services and technology initiatives, with particular focus on Microsoft 365, collaboration and security platforms, identity services, and enterprise connectors and integrations. You will complete assigned secure design reviews, analyze testing and vulnerability results, document security requirements and risks, and work with business and technology stakeholders to support consistent, risk-based decisions.
  
  
This is primarily a security architecture, risk assessment and design review role. You will not typically execute security testing directly. Instead, you will review evidence and results, assess associated risks, recommend remediation and support governance decisions through the SSDLC and technology change-management processes.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
Key responsibilities include:
  
  
**SSDLC Operations & Delivery**

* Support end-to-end SSDLC activities for assigned Technology pillar applications, platforms and initiatives, tracking agreed actions, deliverables and timelines.
* Perform cybersecurity design reviews and risk assessments for new and existing applications, cloud services, SaaS solutions, enterprise platforms and automation initiatives.
* Define and document functional and non-functional cybersecurity requirements and confirm that applicable requirements are incorporated into solution designs before implementation.
* Apply risk-based analysis to design decisions; clearly document security risks, recommendations and required actions; and support exceptions and remediation activities through established governance processes.
* Provide practical guidance on secure design principles and SSDLC requirements, helping delivery teams embed proportionate security requirements early and throughout the technology lifecycle.
* Review security testing and vulnerability findings, assess business impact and remediation priority, and work with delivery teams to progress appropriate treatment.

**Technology Platform Security**

* Support architecture and configuration reviews across Microsoft 365 capabilities, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Defender.
* Review enterprise connectors, APIs, SaaS integrations, add-ins and low-code or automated workflows for data exposure, authentication, authorization, third-party access, monitoring and resilience risks.
* Assess platform security considerations including tenant configuration, privileged administration, conditional access, information protection, data loss prevention, external sharing, audit logging and secure third-party integration.
* Evaluate security and collaboration platforms for secure integration, data handling, lifecycle management and alignment with enterprise architecture and cybersecurity requirements.

**Governance & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build effective working relationships with business, technology, architecture, engineering, platform, DevSecOps and cybersecurity stakeholders across Deloitte Global and the wider Deloitte network.
* Communicate technical and security issues through clear, business-relevant narratives and escalate material risks or delivery concerns where appropriate.
* Represent Cybersecurity in Change Advisory Board meetings and related governance forums, reviewing proposed changes against cybersecurity policies, standards, identified risks and required security testing.
* Maintain accurate review records, operational metrics, knowledge materials and activity tracking that support consistent Secure Design service delivery.

**Continuous Improvement & AI Enablement**

* Contribute to improvements in Secure Design processes, controls, templates and ways of working.
* Support the responsible use of AI and automation to improve review quality, consistency and efficiency while maintaining appropriate human judgement and governance.
* Review AI-enabled solutions and automated workflows to identify cybersecurity risks and determine applicable security requirements.
* Share knowledge and practical guidance with colleagues and engage specialists to strengthen delivery quality and technical capability.

**The team**
At Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all of their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas: Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM IST**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, another technology-related field, or equivalent education and relevant experience.
* 6-8years’ total experience. Minimum four years of relevant experience in cybersecurity architecture, secure solution design, application security, technology risk assessment, or related discipline.
* Experience working in a complex organization and collaborating across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.

**Required Skills And Abilities**

* A working knowledge of SSDLC or secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Ability to interpret application security and infrastructure testing results and translate findings into risk-based recommendations.
* Understanding of common applications, software, cloud, and infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Familiarity with OWASP guidance and vulnerability-risk concepts, including severity and remediation prioritization.
* Knowledge of security controls used across applications and infrastructure, such as secure coding practices, web application firewalls, application gateways, firewalls, servers, and virtualized technologies.
* Experience with technology change-management or risk-governance processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder-management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred:

**Job Description**
**Job Title**
Command Centre Specialist
  
  
**Department**
IT — Command Centre (DevOps)
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India (On-site for the first 3–6 months; remote thereafter)
  
  
**Reports To**
Senior Manager / Director, Command Centre
  
  
**Employment Type**
Full-time, Permanent
  
  
**Shift Pattern**
24×7 rotational shifts
  
  
**About Insightsoftware**
insightsoftware is a global provider of connected solutions for the Office of the CFO. We empower business leaders with accessible insights and connected solutions to drive actionable business strategy. With operations spanning 40+ countries, we help finance and IT teams work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are establishing a new Command Centre in Hyderabad to provide around-the-clock monitoring, incident response, and operational support for our global multi-cloud infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments. The Command Centre Specialist will serve as an active operator, responsible for system monitoring, incident triage and resolution, execution of runbooks, and escalation of issues in accordance with established procedures. This role is highly execution-oriented and supports DevOps teams worldwide, adhering to ITIL best practices. The initial three to six months require on-site presence in Hyderabad for environment familiarization and team integration, after which the position will transition to remote work.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Incident Response and Troubleshooting
  
  

* Monitor alerts and triage incoming incidents—classify, prioritize, and document in Jira Service Management per ITIL guidelines.
* Troubleshoot issues across multi cloud infrastructure (EC2, VPC, VPN, load balancers), identity and access management (IAM, SSO, directory services), networking (DNS, firewalls, routing), databases, and application layers.
* Execute established runbooks and standard operating procedures to resolve or contain incidents within SLA targets.
* Escalate unresolved or high-severity incidents to senior specialists or engineering teams with clear, accurate context.

Monitoring and Alerting
  
  

* Monitor multi-cloud infrastructure, network, and security tooling 24×7 using enterprise observability platforms.
* Identify anomalies, threshold breaches, and potential security events; take first-response action or escalate per SOPs.
* Flag false positives and noisy alerts to senior specialists for threshold tuning and runbook updates.

Shift Operations
  
  

* Participate in 24×7 rotational shifts; execute clean handoffs with detailed shift logs.
* Follow escalation matrices and communication protocols during all incidents.
* Maintain accurate, real-time operational logs throughout each shift.

Documentation and Knowledge Contribution
  
  

* Update and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and SOPs in Confluence as issues are resolved.
* Document recurring incidents and known workarounds to build the Command Centre knowledge base.
* Log all actions taken during incidents for post-incident reviews and audit trails.

SLA Tracking and Reporting
  
  

* Track incident response and resolution times against defined SLAs; flag breaches or at-risk tickets promptly.
* Contribute to operational dashboards and shift reports as directed by senior specialists.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in a Command Centre, NOC, or equivalent 24×7 operations environment.
* 1–2 years of hands-on exposure to AWS and/or Azure—working familiarity with EC2, VPC, VPN, and IAM basics.
* Practical troubleshooting skills across cloud, identity, network, database, and application layers.
* Awareness of Kubernetes and containerized workloads sufficient to interpret alerts.
* Networking fundamentals—TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and basic routing.
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts (Incident, Problem, Change Management).
* Experience with at least one monitoring/alerting tool—PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, or Azure Monitor.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for shift logs, incident documentation, and escalations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL V4 Foundation certification; any AWS or Azure foundational/associate certification.
* Experience with Jira Service Management and Confluence.
* Basic scripting skills (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for log analysis or simple automation.
* Prior experience in a global, multi-time-zone support environment.

What We Offer
  
  

* Be part of a greenfield Command Centre build in a high-growth global software company.
* Hands-on exposure to a modern multi-cloud tech stack (AWS, Azure, SaaS, enterprise platforms).
* Clear growth path—learn from senior specialists and grow into advanced operational roles.
* Collaborative, results-oriented culture underpinned by our core values of Winning Attitude, One Team, and Disciplined Execution.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities.

****Additional Information****
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Learn more about our high-energy, high-performance global team: Work With Us

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join the Cybersecurity Operations and Intelligence team. * Proven experience in developing Target Operating Models (TOMs), operating strategies, or process transformation initiatives.
* Strong expertise in business requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and solution definition.
* Experience creating use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and process maps.
* Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies, preferably Scrum or SAFe.

Key Competencies

* Ability to manage changing priorities and aggressive delivery timelines.
* Strong ownership and accountability for end-to-end functional delivery.
* Ability to identify risks, remove blockers, and manage uncertainty.
* Confidence in engaging with senior stakeholders and facilitating escalations.
* Ability to coordinate across business teams, technology teams, vendors, project managers, and support functions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and commitment to quality.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in cybersecurity operations, cyber risk, security transformation, or information security technology programmes will be particularly relevant.

**Interested candidates**
with strong business analysis and operating model experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Architect - IAM (Identity and Access Management)
company: Strategy Counsel - Cyber Law & Information Security
description:
We are seeking an experienced and visionary IAM Architect to lead the strategy, design, and implementation of our enterprise Identity and Access Management systems. In this role, you will be the cornerstone of our security infrastructure, ensuring that the right individuals have appropriate access to critical technology resources. You will work closely with security teams, cloud engineers, and business stakeholders to secure our digital ecosystem against unauthorized access while maintaining a seamless user experience.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Architecture Design: Design, develop, and maintain a comprehensive enterprise IAM roadmap and architecture framework encompassing single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), role-based/attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC), and privileged access management (PAM).

Identity Lifecycle Management: Oversee automated user provisioning, de-provisioning, identity governance, and administration (IGA) processes across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

Security & Compliance: Ensure IAM solutions comply with industry regulations and standards (such as GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and internal security policies.

Integration & Implementation: Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to integrate IAM services with enterprise applications, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and SaaS solutions using standard protocols like OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and LDAP.

Privileged Access Security: Implement robust controls for managing and auditing privileged accounts, service accounts, and secrets to mitigate insider threats and credential theft.

Troubleshooting & Escalation: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex IAM-related issues, performing root-cause analysis and guiding remediation strategies.

Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging identity trends, technologies, and zero-trust architectures to continually enhance the organization's security posture.

Qualifications & Requirements

Minimum of 7–10 years of IT experience, with at least 4–5 years specifically focused on designing and implementing enterprise IAM solutions.

Proven track record of delivering large-scale IAM transformation projects in complex enterprise environments.

Technical Expertise:

Deep understanding of IAM protocols and standards (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos).

Hands-on experience with leading IAM and IGA platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Ping Identity, CyberArk).

Solid knowledge of cloud security and IAM implementations in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) and API security best practices.

Certifications

Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM)

title: Specialist , Cybersecurity Operations
description: Job DescriptionThe OpportunityBased in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare. Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.Role OverviewAs part of the Cyber Fusion Center (CFC), the Operational Technology (OT) Cyber Security Analyst identifies, analyzes, and supports remediation of cybersecurity risk across manufacturing and OT environments. The role partners with manufacturing sites, engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, and other stakeholders to strengthen OT cyber resilience, improve cyber hygiene, and advance threat detection capabilities.The analyst independently performs assigned cybersecurity operations, including vulnerability management, OT threat detection and analysis, incident response, security control implementation, and stakeholder coordination. The role also contributes to the ongoing development and improvement of OT cybersecurity processes, platforms, and operational capabilities.Key ResponsibilitiesIdentify, analyze, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of OT vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations in alignment with internal risk and remediation guidelines. Perform vulnerability assessment activities across OT assets, applications, operating systems, and infrastructure, and work with manufacturing sites and technology owners to address identified risks. Operate and support OT threat detection and asset visibility platforms, including Nozomi and Armis, to identify anomalous activity, security risks, asset changes, vulnerabilities, and potential cyber threats. Analyze alerts and network activity from OT security monitoring platforms and perform initial investigation and triage of potential security events. Assist with tuning, optimization, and continuous improvement of OT threat detection capabilities, including alert logic, asset classification, vulnerability data, and monitoring coverage. Conduct OT threat analysis and threat hunting using available network, endpoint, vulnerability, and security telemetry. Investigate potential cybersecurity incidents affecting manufacturing and OT environments and coordinate escalation and response activities with applicable incident response teams. Correlate information across multiple security and operational data sources to identify threats, vulnerabilities, asset risks, and security control gaps. Execute and coordinate cyber hygiene activities across manufacturing environments, including asset inventory validation, patching coordination, backup validation, endpoint hardening, account and access reviews, and identification of unnecessary services or network communications. Support implementation and maintenance of OT security controls, including network segmentation, firewall rule hygiene, secure remote access, endpoint security, and vulnerability management controls. Use enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow to track vulnerability remediation, security issues, and risk reduction activities. Develop reports, metrics, and stakeholder communications related to OT vulnerabilities, threat activity, cyber hygiene, remediation progress, and security posture. *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
**About Futureforce University Recruiting**
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.
  
  
**Job Category**
Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure
  
  
**Job Details**
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Information Security Associate – Risk Operations**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Who We Are And Where We're Going**
**Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline.**
Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We're replacing that model with one that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.
  
  
**Our Strategy**
**Risk-informed, control managed.**
We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. This proves trust while delivering risk operations, compliance artifacts, and outputs, and it opens access to new markets through the product we build and the behavior we change.
  
  
**Visibility and invention.**
We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. We equip the Assurance team with a new way of protecting Salesforce, through the invention we create together. We also invest in the people who work here, with room to grow, take on new challenges, and drive excellence.
  
  
**Always in front.**
We turn gaps into signals, alerts, and escalations. When a control fails, it flows into a workflow built to help stakeholders meet their trust obligations. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.
  
  
We're hiring people who want to build this future. You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do …**
Risk Operations provides a centralized approach to identifying, prioritizing, and managing cybersecurity risks, driving accountability, faster decision-making, and measurable risk reduction. The team partners across security, engineering, and business functions to streamline risk management processes, improve visibility into risk exposure, and ensure timely escalation and resolution.
  
  
We're looking for an Information Security Associate who is excited to help build and support a growing Risk Operations function. In this role, you'll be at the center of day-to-day security issue and exception management activities, helping ensure risk cases are accurately documented, efficiently processed, and consistently tracked through resolution. You'll work closely with experienced risk and security professionals while contributing to the development of workflows, processes, and reporting that will help shape how Risk Operations operates at scale.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for an early-career security professional who enjoys solving problems, bringing organization to complex processes, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  
  

* Rapid Decision Management: We work in a business. Predictability and rapid decisions are the core outcomes you’ll bring to the job. Support rapid risk decision-making by coordinating timely reviews, approvals, and escalations, ensuring decision-makers have the information needed to assess risks and take action.
* Support day-to-day security risk operations by managing the intake, triage, and tracking of security issues and exceptions to accelerate risk-based decisions and timely resolution.
* Coordinate issue and exception management activities, including reviewing submissions for completeness, following up with stakeholders, tracking remediation commitments, monitoring exception expiration dates, and supporting timely case resolution.
* Maintain accurate and complete risk records in case management platforms, ensuring consistent documentation, appropriate case status, and reliable data for operational reporting.
* Partner with security, engineering, and compliance teams to gather information, clarify case requirements, resolve operational blockers, and accelerate risk-based decision-making by ensuring stakeholders have the information, context, and visibility needed to take timely action.
* Support timely risk decisions and escalations by monitoring case progress, identifying stalled requests or decision gaps, and coordinating follow-ups to ensure issues and exceptions move efficiently through established governance and approval workflows.
* Assist with operational reporting and metrics, including tracking case volumes, aging, remediation progress, exception renewals, and other key performance indicators to provide visibility into risk operations activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate repetitive tasks, helping streamline case handling, improve data quality, and enhance the overall stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to broader Risk Operations initiatives by supporting ad hoc requests, process improvements, and emerging operational needs as the team establishes and matures its capabilities.

**What You Bring ...**

* You have +2 years of experience in information security or security operations, or a related field.
* You have a foundational understanding of information security concepts, including security findings, risk remediation, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance.
* You have sufficient technical ability to serve as one of many eyes as we assess the certainty of our compensating controls and exposures.
* You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities while maintaining accurate records.
* You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information for completeness, identify inconsistencies, and recognize when issues require additional attention or escalation.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather information, clarify requirements, and drive timely follow-through.
* You are comfortable learning new tools, navigating workflow or ticketing systems, and working with spreadsheets and data to support operational activities.
* You are adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes and responsibilities are still being established.
* You have a continuous improvement mindset and are eager to learn, contribute ideas, and help build scalable and efficient security risk management practices.

**How We Work**

* Engineering-first culture. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
* Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
* Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
* Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
* Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
* Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.

**Modern Tooling Acumen**
Direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. Must be able to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes.
  
  
Graduates need direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. This is a newer requirement; candidates who have actively experimented with and used tools like Gemini, Cursor, or other agent-based frameworks will be stronger candidates.
  
  
**About Futureforce**
FutureForce is for college students or new grads wanting to experience life at Salesforce, one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies 5-years-running and one of Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” 8- years-running. FutureForce interns work on live projects, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact that they can show to friends, family, and future employers if we don’t hire them first (and, we hire 80% of our eligible interns)!
  
  
They have the chance to collaborate and connect with the Salesforce interns from all over the world. And, like all Salesforce employees, interns also have many possibilities to volunteer, making a lasting impact in the community.
  
  
FutureForce offers a collaborative work environment, which promotes innovation, provides flexibility and most importantly is fun!
  
  
Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
********Posting Statement********
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Cyber Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, Chrome Platform Security
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 5 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a quantitative discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research etc.).
* Proven experience or strong foundational knowledge in broader cybersecurity principles and practices.
* Familiarity with the development lifecycle and security considerations specific to browser extensions or similar technologies.
* Working knowledge in one or more of the following areas: cyber security, threat intelligence, statistical analysis and machine learning libraries (e.g., R), programming languages (e.g., Python), Large Language Models (LLMs) or applied AI.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

**About The Job**
Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
  
  
Trust and Safety has the critical responsibility of protecting Google's users by ensuring online safety fighting fraud and abuse across Google products. We collaborate with anti-abuse teams across the company to identify and resolve the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. More specifically, in the Trust and Safety Chrome Web Store and Extensions Security team, we are responsible for protecting users from harmful extensions, while enabling developers to provide useful and safe experiences in Chrome.
  
  
As a Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, you will apply large-scale data analysis to protect Chrome users from abuse, discover and interpret attack vectors and leverage AI to build scaled protections to keep users safe. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product partners to identify threats, mitigate risks, and launch new protection mechanisms.
  
  
At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct investigations through reverse engineering, enforce our product policies, learn abuse patterns, and establish ground truth data to train automated systems. Identify vulnerabilities and performance gaps in automated and manual review pipelines.
* Design AI-powered and automated solutions that enable scalable identification of malware, and other harmful techniques.
* Collaborate with other teams to develop and deploy new detection methods and signals.
* Understand the abuse landscape and techniques.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Security Researcher II
description: OverviewMicrosoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.Microsoft Security is committed to making the world safer in an era of rapidly evolving digital threats and determined human adversaries. The Microsoft Defender Experts (DEX) team combines deep security expertise with Microsoft security products, telemetry, threat intelligence, and partnerships across the company to help customers detect, investigate, understand, and respond to advanced threats. Within DEX Operations, Threat Researchers operate where customer defense, threat hunting, incident investigation, and detection innovation meet. We are curious, collaborative, and comfortable working through uncertainty. We learn from real-world attacks, turn frontline insights into stronger protection, and continuously improve how we defend customers at global scale. We are looking for an experienced Threat Researcher to join the DEX Operations team. You will investigate suspicious activity across customer environments, hunt for sophisticated adversaries, perform root-cause analysis, and transform complex security data into clear, actionable protection outcomes. You will use broad telemetry across the Microsoft Defender ecosystem and other security platforms to identify attacker behavior, surface detection gaps, and help customers respond quickly and confidently. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact security challenges, explore emerging attacker tradecraft, and build hunting approaches, detections, and automation with experts across security operations, threat intelligence, research, engineering, and data science. The work is technically demanding and constantly evolving. Your discoveries can influence immediate customer protection as well as longer-term product and detection improvements.Responsibilities1 Conduct proactive threat hunts across endpoint, identity, email, cloud, and other relevant security telemetry to identify indicators of compromise and previously unseen attacker behavior.2 Investigate security alerts and suspicious activity, perform root-cause analysis, and develop a clear understanding of attack scope, sequence, impact, and recommended response.3 Analyze and correlate large, complex datasets to produce timely, context-rich findings and actionable insights for customers and internal partners.4 Apply knowledge of attacker tradecraft, identity systems, authentication and authorization protocols, operating systems, and cloud environments to strengthen investigations and customer defenses. 4, Develop and improve high-fidelity hunting queries, detection logic, custom alerts, investigation methods, and response guidance.5 Partner with security researchers, threat intelligence analysts, data scientists, and engineers to convert frontline findings into durable detection and product improvements.6 Document technical findings and communicate complex investigations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.QualificationsBachelor's or master's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 4+ years of cybersecurity experience in one or more areas such as security operations, threat hunting, incident response, digital forensics, malware analysis, threat intelligence, penetration testing, or red teaming. Hands-on experience investigating security incidents and hunting across large security datasets using SIEM, EDR/XDR, or comparable security platforms. Coding or scripting experience with one or more of Python, KQL, SQL, regular expressions, PowerShell, or similar languages. Working knowledge of threat analysis models and frameworks such as the Cyber Kill Chain and MITRE ATT&CK. Understanding of common enterprise attack surfaces, including endpoints, identity, email, cloud services, networks, and authentication systems. Ability to analyze complex technical evidence, form and test hypotheses, and translate findings into clear actions. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to brief investigations and collaborate across teams.Other RequirementsGlobal mission: Help defend enterprise customers around the world against sophisticated and fast-moving threats. Cutting-edge work: Investigate emerging adversary behavior and solve security problems that do not yet have established playbooks. Latest technology: Work with rich Microsoft security telemetry, modern security analytics, threat intelligence, cloud-scale data, automation, and evolving AI-assisted capabilities. End-to-end impact: Connect live customer investigations to better hunting, stronger detections, improved operational workflows, and product feedback. Expert community: Collaborate with specialists across Microsoft Security and learn from diverse perspectives in research, operations, engineering, data science, and incident response. Continuous challenge: Expand your skills across platforms, attack surfaces, and adversary techniques while making decisions in ambiguous, high-impact situations.This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.
