Your Team  
Do you aspire to be a part of a global organization that recognizes security as a critical component in its trust relationship with clients, staff, business partners and shareholders? Do you want to collaborate and learn from like-minded security professionals under the guidance of a former Deputy Director of the FBI in developing an intelligence-driven approach to security? Do you want to work in a highly collaborative and consultative environment that values everyone’s ideas on how to best protect, detect and respond to the latest physical and cyber threats impacting the financial industry? If this sounds like a team you want to be a part of, read on to learn more about the opportunity to join us.  
  
Your Role
  
The Cyber Defense - Senior Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for strengthening the organization's ability to detect and validate cyber threats through SIEM detection engineering, proactive threat hunting, purple teaming, and adversary emulation. The role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of detection content - from requirements and design through testing, deployment, tuning, measurement, and retirement - and uses the MITRE ATT&CK framework to align detections, hunts, and validation activities with relevant adversary behaviors. The Senior Analyst works closely with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and other technology and security teams to identify visibility and detection gaps, validate control effectiveness using CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation tools, and translate findings into measurable improvements. The role also provides technical guidance and mentoring while remaining primarily hands-on.  
  
You Will Be Responsible For:
  

* Conduct hypothesis-driven and intelligence-led threat hunts across large and diverse data sets; document methodologies, evidence, findings, and recommended follow-up actions.

* Map detections, hunts, observed behaviors, and validation results to MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques to assess and communicate coverage and gaps.
* Plan and execute purple-team exercises and collaborative adversary-emulation activities with defensive teams and authorized testing stakeholders.
* Use MITRE CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation tools to safely emulate relevant adversary behaviors, track test scenarios, record defensive outcomes, and validate detection and response controls.
* Expertise in design, development, testing, deployment, tuning, and lifecycle management of high-fidelity SIEM detections across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and other relevant telemetry sources.

  
The Experience You Bring: •
  

* 9-11 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, security operations, detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, security analytics, or related disciplines; experience in a financial-services or similarly regulated environment is preferred.
* Practical experience using MITRE CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation or adversary-emulation tools for test execution, collaboration, evidence capture, and remediation tracking.
* Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft, common intrusion patterns, malware behaviors, identity-based attacks, lateral movement, persistence, command and control, and data-access techniques.
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in SIEM detection engineering, including analytics design, query development, testing, tuning, content deployment, versioning, documentation, and lifecycle governance.

title: Financial Analyst II, Global Payroll Compliance
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to ensure Amazon employees are paid accurately, on time, and in full compliance with local regulations? As a Financial Analyst II on the Payroll Compliance team, you will partner with the Payroll Compliance Manager to build compliance tools, develop metrics, and produce reports that monitor risk across Amazon's countries in the region. You will apply your expertise in international payroll, employment tax, social security legislation, and cross-border worker regulations to directly impact how Amazon discovers, measures, and resolves payroll compliance risks. If you are detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to make a tangible difference, this is the role for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Partner with project teams and stakeholders to embed payroll compliance requirements from day one for new country and entity launches, applying knowledge of local employment tax and social security legislation.
* Develop and maintain management reporting and metrics using Excel and compliance tools, tracking statutory requirements and ensuring effective monitoring of identified risks across multiple countries.
* Identify new risk areas and potential non-compliance issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive resolution through to full compliance while collaborating with Tax, Accounting, Human Resources, and Global Mobility teams.
* Manage and facilitate audits of operational payroll processes and statutory obligations, including Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance activities, and develop remediation plans to close identified gaps.
* Identify opportunities to automate and simplify compliance workflows, partner with technology teams to deploy solutions that reduce processing time and errors, and provide ongoing guidance and training to payroll teams on compliance matters.

  
Basic Qualifications  

* Tax, employment legal, and/or payroll experience with specific exposure to NORM countries.
* Strong knowledge of international payroll, employment tax, and social security legislation.
* Solid understanding of cross-border workers, tax treaties, and international employment legislation.
* Experience with SOX compliance and related responsibilities.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to dive deep into detail while understanding the broader picture.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

  
Preferred Qualifications  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as Finance, Tax, or Accounting.
* US tax knowledge or experience is highly preferable.
* Previous Payroll Compliance management experience across multiple geographies.
* Experience within a control or audit environment.
* Exposure to AI tools, automation platforms, or process simplification initiatives within payroll or finance operations.
* Additional language skills.
* Project management experience.

  
A day in the life  
You start by reviewing compliance dashboards and validating payroll data inputs across countries in the region. From there, you may join a working session with the Payroll Compliance Manager to assess an emerging risk area, then shift to building out a new metric in Excel or your compliance tooling. You regularly connect with Tax, Accounting, Human Resources, and Global Mobility partners to align on statutory deadlines, and you carve out time to document processes and train payroll team members on updated compliance requirements.  
  
About the team  
The Payroll Compliance team sits within Amazon's broader finance organization with a clear mission: pay employees accurately and on time with the highest controllership and compliance standards. We partner with payroll operations, Tax, Human Resources, Global Mobility, and external advisors to monitor and resolve compliance risks across multiple countries. You will join a collaborative team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth as we scale our tools and processes to support Amazon's expanding presence.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of finance, tax or a related analytical field experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Specialist , Cybersecurity Operations
description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As part of the Cyber Fusion Center (CFC), the Operational Technology (OT) Cyber Security Analyst identifies, analyzes, and supports remediation of cybersecurity risk across manufacturing and OT environments. The role partners with manufacturing sites, engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, and other stakeholders to strengthen OT cyber resilience, improve cyber hygiene, and advance threat detection capabilities.
  
  
The analyst independently performs assigned cybersecurity operations, including vulnerability management, OT threat detection and analysis, incident response, security control implementation, and stakeholder coordination. The role also contributes to the ongoing development and improvement of OT cybersecurity processes, platforms, and operational capabilities.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**  

* Identify, analyze, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of OT vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations in alignment with internal risk and remediation guidelines.
* Perform vulnerability assessment activities across OT assets, applications, operating systems, and infrastructure, and work with manufacturing sites and technology owners to address identified risks.
* Operate and support OT threat detection and asset visibility platforms, including Nozomi and Armis, to identify anomalous activity, security risks, asset changes, vulnerabilities, and potential cyber threats.
* Analyze alerts and network activity from OT security monitoring platforms and perform initial investigation and triage of potential security events.
* Assist with tuning, optimization, and continuous improvement of OT threat detection capabilities, including alert logic, asset classification, vulnerability data, and monitoring coverage.
* Conduct OT threat analysis and threat hunting using available network, endpoint, vulnerability, and security telemetry.
* Investigate potential cybersecurity incidents affecting manufacturing and OT environments and coordinate escalation and response activities with applicable incident response teams.
* Correlate information across multiple security and operational data sources to identify threats, vulnerabilities, asset risks, and security control gaps.
* Execute and coordinate cyber hygiene activities across manufacturing environments, including asset inventory validation, patching coordination, backup validation, endpoint hardening, account and access reviews, and identification of unnecessary services or network communications.
* Support implementation and maintenance of OT security controls, including network segmentation, firewall rule hygiene, secure remote access, endpoint security, and vulnerability management controls.
* Use enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow to track vulnerability remediation, security issues, and risk reduction activities.
* Develop reports, metrics, and stakeholder communications related to OT vulnerabilities, threat activity, cyber hygiene, remediation progress, and security posture.
* Partner with manufacturing sites, engineering teams, and cybersecurity teams to investigate security issues and drive assigned remediation activities through completion.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate OT cybersecurity processes, detection capabilities, data integration, and reporting.
* Contribute to the development and improvement of OT cybersecurity procedures, playbooks, standards, and operational processes.
* Provide technical guidance to junior analysts and support knowledge sharing across the OT cybersecurity team.

**Education Minimum Requirement:**  

* Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

* 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT or OT security operations, network security, engineering, or a related technical field.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management, threat detection, incident response, network security, and security monitoring.
* Experience analyzing cybersecurity alerts, network activity, logs, or endpoint telemetry to investigate potential threats.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, network monitoring, endpoint security, vulnerability management, or threat detection platforms.
* Understanding of networking concepts, protocols, firewalls, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Ability to independently analyze technical security issues and coordinate appropriate remediation or escalation.
* Ability to analyze and correlate information across multiple technical data sources.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively across cybersecurity, engineering, infrastructure, and manufacturing organizations.

**Preferred Experience and Skills:**  

* Experience working with Industrial Control Systems (ICS) or OT environments, including PLCs, SCADA, DCS, industrial networks, or manufacturing systems.
* Experience with OT network monitoring, asset visibility, or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks or Armis.
* Understanding of OT and ICS network protocols such as Modbus, OPC, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, or DNP3.
* Experience investigating cybersecurity events involving industrial or manufacturing systems.
* Experience with vulnerability management and remediation platforms such as ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with OT cybersecurity frameworks and guidance such as NIST SP 800-82, IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or MITRE ATTCK for ICS.
* Experience with scripting, automation, data analysis, or querying large security datasets.
* Cybersecurity certifications such as Security, GICSP, GCIH, GCIA, or equivalent.

**Who we are:**  
We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What we look for:**  
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information:**  
**Required Skills:**  
Adaptability, Adaptability, Analytical Thinking, Corporate Security Management, Cybersecurity, Cyber Threat Hunting, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Detail-Oriented, Digital Forensics, Firewall Management, Incident/Breach Triage and Containment, Incident Response Management, Insider Threat Mitigation, Log Analysis, Malware Analysis, Network Security, Network Security Tools, Network Segmentation, Operational Technology (OT) Security, Perimeter Security, Security Controls, Security Fundamentals, Security Incident Response, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) {+ 10 more}
  
  
**Preferred Skills:**  
Collaboration, Information Security, Network Communications

title: Security Consultant-Identity & Access Management Services
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Security Consultant specializing in Identity & Access Management (IAM) services, you help organizations understand and manage the entire identity lifecycle within their enterprise. You utilize commercially available IAM tools to provide Single Sign-On (SSO) and manage user identities effectively.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Implement Identity Solutions: Utilize IAM tools such as ISIM/ISAM, Cloud Identity/Okta/Sailpoint/MS Entra to create a secure and streamlined identity management system for the organization.

* Manage Directory Services: Apply proficiency in directory services like TDI and AD to support effective identity management.
* Support Identity Lifecycle: Provide expertise to manage the entire identity lifecycle within the enterprise, ensuring secure and efficient identity management.
* Apply Security Protocols: Utilize hands-on experience with SAML, OAuth, and scripting to ensure secure identity management practices.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Identity & Access Management Tools: Utilized commercially available IAM tools such as ISIM/ISAM, Cloud Identity/Okta/Sailpoint/MS Entra to provide Single Sign-On (SSO) and manage user identities effectively.
* Scripting Experience: Developed scripts to automate the provisioning and migration of identities across Cloud, OT, IOT, and enterprise IT using languages such as SAML and OAuth.
* Directory Services Knowledge: Applied proficiency in directory services like TDI and AD to support effective identity management.
* Identity Lifecycle Management: Managed the entire identity lifecycle within an enterprise, ensuring secure and efficient identity management practices.
* Security Protocol Implementation: Utilized hands-on experience with security protocols such as SAML, OAuth, and scripting to ensure secure identity management practices.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Proficiency in Cloud Identity: Exposure to Cloud Identity platforms such as Okta, Sailpoint, or MS Entra, including implementing Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions and managing user identities.
* Advanced Scripting Skills: Experience working with scripting languages such as SAML and OAuth to automate identity provisioning and migration across various systems.
* In-Depth Directory Services: Exposure to directory services like TDI and AD, including designing and implementing effective identity management solutions.

title: XSIAM Endpoint Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Cortex XSIAM Endpoint Engineer is a specialized technical role within the Professional Services team. This individual will be a key player in the successful deployment and operationalization of Palo Alto Networks' Cortex XSIAM platform, with a specific focus on the endpoint security components. The role centers on migrating customers from existing Cortex XDR or third-party EDR solutions to XSIAM, managing agent deployment, and tuning endpoint security policies to help customers maximize the value of our AI-driven SOC platform.
  
  
This position requires a deep understanding of endpoint security (EDR/XDR), agent lifecycle management, and security policy configuration, combined with hands-on expertise in the Cortex XSIAM platform.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Endpoint Migration & Deployment:

+ Lead and execute the migration of endpoint agents from Cortex XDR or legacy EDR platforms to Cortex XSIAM.
+ Develop and implement a phased agent rollout plan to ensure a smooth transition with minimal disruption.
+ Create migration plans for moving agents and assist in updating the customer's architecture diagrams to reflect the new XSIAM endpoint traffic flow.
+ Perform agent compatibility checks against various endpoint OS versions and conduct pilot validations before mass rollouts.

* Policy and Configuration Management:

+ Analyze the customer's existing XDR policies, profiles, and configurations to plan a successful migration to Cortex XSIAM.
+ Implement and fine-tune endpoint security policies, profiles, and exception rules within the XSIAM console to align with customer security objectives.
+ Manage global allow/block lists, exceptions, and other endpoint-specific configurations post-migration.
+ Recreate and apply configurations such as tags and exception profiles for different operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux, macOS) in the unified XSIAM tenant.

* Endpoint Health and Operationalization:

+ Ensure endpoint agents are healthy and managed centrally post-migration.
+ Collaborate with the customer's SOC and endpoint teams to tune alerts, validate security posture, and reduce alert fatigue.
+ Provide expert guidance on endpoint security best practices, including threat prevention, device control, and data loss prevention (DLP).

* Customer Enablement and Project Success:

+ Act as the key technical endpoint resource within the project team, working alongside the XSIAM Lead Consultant, SIEM Engineer, and Project Manager.
+ Contribute to key project documents, including the Solution Design and As-Built documents, with a focus on endpoint architecture and configuration.
+ Participate in testing and pre-production activities to ensure a smooth go-live for all endpoint-related functions.
+ Assist in transitioning the customer to Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations and handing over to the appropriate long-term support teams.

**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**

* Technical Skills:

+ Proven experience with endpoint security solutions (EDR/XDR), specifically with agent deployment, policy management, and troubleshooting.
+ Hands-on experience with Cortex XDR is highly desirable.
+ Direct experience with Cortex XSIAM, particularly in agent migration from XDR to XSIAM, is a strong plus.
+ Strong understanding of endpoint operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS) and their security configurations.
+ Familiarity with SOC operations and how endpoint data is used for threat hunting, investigation, and response.
+ Knowledge of scripting for agent deployment and management is an asset.

* Professional Attributes:

+ Experience in a customer-facing, consultative role, such as professional services, technical account management, or solutions architecture.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to navigate complex agent migration and policy-tuning challenges.
+ Excellent communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and collaborate effectively with customer endpoint teams.
+ Ability to work effectively as part of a distributed project team to drive successful customer outcomes.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Requirements:

• Role: CYBERARK ENGINEER-L2

• Location: Mumbai

• Qualification: Any Graduate

• Experience: 2-5 YEARS

• Working days: Rotational Shift

 Role Overview

The CyberArk L2 Implementation & BAU Operations Engineer is responsible for managing the daily operations, support, and maintenance of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. This role ensures the secure handling of privileged accounts, timely resolution of operational issues, efficient onboarding processes, and adherence to compliance and audit requirements. The engineer acts as the second level technical contact for CyberArk-related issues and collaborates with cross-functional teams to maintain a robust PAM environment.

Key Responsibilities

CyberArk Implementation & Configuration

* Design, install, configure, and deploy CyberArk PAM solutions (PAS, PSM, PSMSession, PTA).
* Implement CyberArk Vault (EPV), CPM, PSM, PSM for SSH, and PSM for Web.  Perform onboarding of privileged accounts for Windows, Unix/Linux, Databases, Network devices, and Applications.
* Configure password policies, platforms, safes, dual control, and access workflows.
* Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, and SIEM tools (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).

Daily Operations & Monitoring

* Monitor the CyberArk Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP and PTA components and ensure system health.
* Review password rotation jobs, platform tasks, and CPM activity status.
* Analyze logs and alerts to identify potential issues and security risks.

Incident & Problem Management

* Provide L2 support for CyberArk-related incidents raised through ticketing systems.
* Troubleshoot issues involving password rotation failures, CPM errors, PSM access problems, and platform connectivity.
* Hands on experience on DR drill.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement corrective actions.
* Escalate unresolved or critical issues to L3 or vendor support.

Privileged Account Lifecycle Management

* Onboard privileged accounts across Windows, UNIX, databases, network devices, and applications.
* Configure safes, access control policies, platform settings, and rotation schedules.
* Ensure timely password changes, reconciliations, and compliance with organizational security policies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Hands-on experience with CyberArk components (Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PTA). Hands on experience on DR drill.
* Strong understanding of PAM concepts and privileged account security.
* Experience troubleshooting CPM/PSM issues and account onboarding. Knowledge of Windows, Linux, network devices, and database authentication. Familiarity with ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, etc.).
* Basic understanding of scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python – added advantage).
* Handon experience on Cp or CCP

description:

At Splunk and Cisco, we believe in turning data into answers. We are a team of passionate innovators in the Customer Success & Experience organization, committed to our customers’ success, our product’s evolution, and, most importantly, each other’s growth. Together, we help clients navigate the complex landscape of modern cyber defense and redefine how the world interacts with machine data.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Professional Services Architect (Security), you will be the technical and strategic authority for our Security portfolio and a Trusted Advisor to our customers. You will architect solutions across our SIEM and SOAR ecosystems, including Splunk Enterprise Security, UEBA, and SOAR. You aren’t just deploying software; you are architecting outcomes that protect organizations from the next generation of threats, with the opportunity to take ownership of your work, learn from industry leaders, and play a vital role in a team that celebrates collective success. * Architect Complex Solutions: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of security deployments, from initial strategy and integration to ongoing optimization.

* Empower the Customer: Enable client teams to manage, scale, and solve complex security challenges independently.

**Job Description**
**L3 Support Engineer**
**Location:**
Mumbai

2+ Years
  
  
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you'll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what's possible. Join us in helping leading organizations unlock the value of technology and drive scalable, sustainable growth.
  
  
**Your Role**
As an L3 Support Engineer, you will provide advanced technical support for enterprise retail and POS environments. You will be responsible for troubleshooting complex incidents, supporting critical business applications, and ensuring seamless operations across Windows, networking, cloud, and infrastructure platforms. You will work closely with L1 and L2 support teams while providing escalations and resolutions for high-priority issues.
  
  
**In this role, you will:**

* Provide L3 technical support for Windows-based systems and enterprise applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to networking, operating systems, peripherals, and retail POS devices.
* Investigate issues involving IP Addressing, DNS, DHCP, Domain Controllers, Network Switches, and connectivity.
* Support retail store technologies including POS terminals, payment card readers, handheld POS devices, scanners, printers, and other peripherals.
* Manage incident resolution for escalated tickets from Service Desk teams following established SOPs.
* Analyze logs using Splunk and troubleshoot platform and application issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and coordinate with Tier 3 teams for complex incidents.
* Monitor and support distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-based applications.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads, logs, and containerized environments.
* Support Linux and Windows server environments.
* Utilize PowerShell and Python scripts for automation, diagnostics, and operational efficiency.
* Work in a 24x7 support environment, ensuring service availability and adherence to SLAs.

**Your Profile**
**Must Have Skills**

* Strong Windows troubleshooting and support experience.
* Hands-on experience with Computer Networking concepts including IP Addressing, DNS, DHCP, Network Switches, and Active Directory/Domain Controllers.
* Experience supporting computer peripherals such as printers, scanners, payment card readers, USB, serial and parallel devices.
* Knowledge of computer hardware components including RAID storage, hard drives, and memory troubleshooting.
* Experience with Splunk log analysis and incident troubleshooting.
* Understanding of Linux and Windows operating systems.

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

* Flexible and inclusive work culture.
* Continuous learning and certification opportunities.
* Exposure to enterprise-scale retail and cloud technologies.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and cutting-edge support platforms.

title: Manager, IT Infrastructure
description:
**Manager, IT Infrastructure**

Mumbai

Working at Teach For India

Teach For India is on a journey to reach an India free of poverty and filled with love by ending educational inequity in our country. Fifteen years into our journey we are a movement of ~5000+ Alumni working at all levels of the education system, who are reaching 1 in 10 children across the country. These Alumni have graduated from our two-year Fellowship Program where they taught in under-resourced classrooms to put ~33,500 low-income children on a different life path. Today, we have ~1000 Fellows and are the largest pipeline of driven, skilled talent into the educational ecosystem in India. Over 16,000 Teach For India students have appeared for the 10th grade board examinations till date, with an impressive 95% pass rate across cities as of November 2024.

In 2022, we embarked on
**Phase 4**
, our fourth strategic phase. We have a bold and ambitious ten-year journey ahead of us that aims to
**grow 50,000 leaders**
, who will
**work collectively**
, and
**with love**
, to
**transform the lives of 1 in 10 low-income children in our regions**
, through an
**education that unleashes the potential of self, others and India**
. In this decade, five key priorities will lead us to this vision.

1. **Strengthen**
   our core Fellowship to build strong teacher leaders who provide an excellent and equitable education to our children and continue to do so beyond the Fellowship
2. **Scale**
   our impact by strategically introducing additional Fellowships as alternative pathways for leadership development
3. **Match**
   the Alumni of our programs at an intersection of their interests and the needs of the system and our children
4. **Advocate**
   for key issues that impact educational equity, and engage 3.5% of the population in the movement for educational equity
5. **Act**
   collectively with our Alumni to learn about and address key issues in our regions.

Our work will only be completed when we have built a movement of leaders that is large enough to ensure that every child in India attains an excellent education.

We pride ourselves as being a passionate, idealistic, mission-driven team of individuals. We’re committed to learning and excellence in our roles, and to being deeply rooted in our core values.

What Teach For India Can Offer You

* The opportunity to be part of one of the most established and visionary movements in the education sector in India which is at a pivotal point in terms of expanding its scale and outreach across the nation and working with changemakers across the country.
* A challenging yet flexible workplace in which every individual employee’s Staff journey is tracked for excellence and leadership development.
* A work environment in which employees’ holistic well-being is a core priority, enabling people to be their best selves.
* Access to connections and resources from the global Teach For All network that includes partner organizations spanning 50+ countries across 6 continents.
* Remuneration that is competitive within the top quartile of the Indian NGO pay scales, and a benefits package that includes extensive medical insurance and maternity coverage for both parents.

Position Summary

**Reporting to:**
Senior
Manager, IT Infrastructure

The Manager, IT Infrastructure will be responsible for ensuring each staff member and Fellow has continuous and secure access to IT Infrastructure hardware and enterprise applications for their day-to-day work activities.

Responsibilities

**Primary responsibilities:**

* **System Management:**
  Manage allocation, maintenance, and up-gradation of hardware and enterprise applications, internet connections, their maintenance, and up-gradation of network equipment in all offices.
* **Purchase and Vendor Management:**
  Manage the vendors and purchase IT infrastructure hardware and enterprise software as per the purchase process.
* **Asset Management:**
  Maintain records of all IT assets to plan for maintenance, upgrades, retirements, and future IT investments.
* **Data Backup and Recovery:**
  Responsible for data backup and recovery of deleted or lost data of users.
* **Systems’ Audit:**
  Manage systems audit and assess their outcomes.
* **Implement technology policies:**
  Implement the technology policies approved by the management and train the users about the technology policies.
* **Software Compliance:**
  Ensure timely renewals of all enterprise software application platforms, that the number of software licenses is adequate for each team, and 100% of devices used in Teach For India have genuine software licenses.

Additional Responsibilities

**As Manager Infrastructure at Teach For India**

* Contribute to
  **the team goals and priorities**
  beyond individual goals and priorities
* Serve as an
  **ambassador of the Teach For India brand**
  and an advocate for our work and for educational equity in our country through both internal and external communication after commiting time in our classrooms to understand our work more deeply
* Support with key organizational areas such as
  **Recruitment, Selection, Fundraising, Volunteering, Movement Building**

Minimum Qualifications, Experiences and Expectations

* 2-3 years working experience as IT Manager / Technology Manager in a small to medium enterprise.
* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunication is preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of System Administration with problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Familiarity with various operating systems (Windows, Mac, Android) and platforms.
* Ability to be resourceful, take responsibility and find practical solutions to problems.
* Ability to work in a deadline-based environment.
* Google/Microsoft certification in IT/System Administration is a plus, but not mandatory.
* Experience working with mobile device management tools is a plus, but not mandatory.

***Note:***
*We want to hear your unique voice and perspectives through the process, hence all applicants are expected to personally author statements of purpose/essays in the application form. Sole use of AI or Chat-GPT based tools may lead to disqualification from the process.*

title: EDR Analyst - L1
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their Firewall infrastructure remain operational through proactively identifying, investigating, and routing the incidents to correct resolver group.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions and focuses on first-line support for standard and low complexity incidents and service requests.
  
  
The Security Managed Services Engineer (L1) may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Monitors client infrastructure and solutions.
* Identifies problems and errors prior to or when they occur.
* Routinely identifies common incidents and opportunities for avoidance as well as general opportunities for incident reduction.
* Investigates first line incidents assigned and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Provides telephonic or chat support to clients when required.
* Schedules maintenance activity windows for patching and configuration changes.
* Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.
* Reports and escalates incidents where necessary.

title: Partner Solutions Engineer (Mumbai)
description:
**Meet the Team**
The Solutions Engineering team is responsible for designing, implementing, and driving Cisco's Digital Resilience strategy for some of India's leading enterprises and strategic partners. We help organizations strengthen their cybersecurity posture by delivering innovative security architectures that enable secure connectivity, Zero Trust, cloud security, and cyber resilience.
  
  
As a trusted technical advisor, you'll work closely with Cisco Sales, channel partners, and customers to design, position, and implement Cisco's industry-leading Security portfolio while enabling partners to build long-term technical capabilities and deliver secure business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Partner Solutions Engineer – Security, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor for strategic partners, driving technical strategy, solution development, and partner enablement across Cisco's Security portfolio.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Build and manage trusted technical relationships with strategic partners, serving as their primary security advisor.
* Design and present end-to-end Cisco Security architectures aligned with customer business and cybersecurity objectives.
* Lead technical workshops, customer presentations, demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) focused on Cisco Security solutions.
* Develop Partner Technical Business Plans and drive technical readiness across Cisco's Security portfolio.
* Enable partners through technical training, architectural guidance, and best practices across Cisco Security technologies.
* Collaborate with Cisco Sales, Partner Account Managers, Channel Leaders, and Security Specialists to identify and drive strategic opportunities.
* Stay current on cybersecurity trends, competitive technologies, and emerging threats to influence partner strategy and customer security transformation.
* Support partners throughout the sales lifecycle, from opportunity qualification to post-sales technical guidance.
* Provide product and market feedback to Cisco Business Units to influence future product enhancements and solution positioning.
* Demonstrate business value and ROI by aligning Cisco Security solutions with customers' digital resilience and security transformation initiatives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Pre-Sales, Security Consulting, Network Security, or Security Architecture.
* Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, CCIE Security, or equivalent security certifications are highly preferred.
* Strong hands-on expertise designing, positioning, and implementing Cisco Security solutions, including:
* Cisco Secure Firewall (Firepower/FTD)
* Cisco Secure Access (SASE)
* Cisco Umbrella
* Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)
* Cisco Duo
* Cisco Secure Endpoint
* Cisco Secure Email
* Cisco XDR
* Cisco Secure Network Analytics (Stealthwatch)
* Secure Service Edge (SSE)
* Zero Trust Architecture
* Strong understanding of enterprise security architectures, network security, cloud security, identity and access management, and secure access technologies.
* Experience working with Channel Partners, System Integrators, or Value-Added Resellers (VARs) to drive technical enablement and customer engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering executive presentations, customer workshops, technical demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) focused on cybersecurity solutions.
* Strong understanding of Digital Resilience, Zero Trust, SASE, SSE, Cloud Security, Identity Security, and AI-driven Security architectures.
* Experience integrating Cisco Security solutions with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and security APIs using tools such as Python, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Excellent consultative selling, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and executive decision-makers.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Analyst/Associate – Middle Office Operations (Public Credit)
description:
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra Team: PFS Job Requisition #: R266881 Date posted: Oct. 26, 2026

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

  

Job Description

**Company Description**
-----------------------

**HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for clients. The firm manages strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit, including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high-yield bonds; asset-based finance; and real estate. The scale and breadth of the platform provide flexibility to invest in companies large and small through standard or customized solutions. Intellectual rigor and discipline are central to creating value for clients.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (HCM), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (JPMAM). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM. Following the transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity.

The HPS/BlackRock transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset-owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS formed a new Private Financing Solutions business unit (PFS), led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets. The combined platform includes more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally and offers capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. Scott Kapnick, Scot French and Michael Patterson joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick was appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.

**Team Description**
--------------------

The Middle Office team (MO) within Private Financing Solutions (PFS), BlackRock’s private credit platform, is responsible for ensuring that fund positions and cash balances are accurate and for managing the lifecycle of all trades and investments. Responsibilities include trade capture, trade settlement, loan administration, daily cash and position reconciliations, corporate-action elections and recordings, audit requests, new-mandate onboarding, and PnL break analysis and resolution with fund administrators. The team also handles ad hoc requests from deal teams and separately managed account clients and works closely with Deal Execution, Treasury, Fund Accounting, Fund Finance, Cash Management, Portfolio Analytics, Data Analytics, Valuations and Deal Teams.

**Position Description**
------------------------

HPS is seeking an Analyst to join the Public Credit Middle Office, a subgroup within the broader Middle Office team that focuses on the liquid credit business within PFS.

The individual should be highly organized, with strong attention to detail and effective written and verbal communication skills. The role requires the ability to meet strict deadlines, work independently and collaboratively, and demonstrate excellent critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. The platform is scaling rapidly, making comfort in a fast-paced environment essential.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Research and resolve cash breaks versus custodians.
* Research and resolve position breaks versus custodians, clients, administrators and other systems.
* Perform cash and asset reconciliations between internal systems, including Aladdin, and custodians.
* Play a key role in the daily reconciliation between HPS and BlackRock accounting systems.
* Provide daily oversight of loan and security administration in the firm’s accounting system, including delayed fundings, contracts, coupon payments, factor payments and maturities.
* Investigate transactional or accrual discrepancies.
* Provide full trade-lifecycle operational support for products including fixed- and floating-rate bonds, private placements, ABS, cross-currency swaps, term loans, delayed-draw term loans and revolvers.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of onboarding processes for new investments, including trade lifecycle, cash management, valuation, PnL recognition and reconciliation.
* Work closely with custodians, including responding to questions on how to apply cash.
* Assist with position confirmation and provide support to internal and SMA auditors.
* Interact daily with internal and external groups to troubleshoot booking and position discrepancies, including Front Office, Fund Accounting, Fund Administrators, SMA clients and auditors.
* Collaborate with technology teams on automation and workflow enhancements and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including scenario testing and error resolution before production release.
* Liaise with accounting, product control, valuations, investment data and other internal groups to resolve open queries and support team objectives.
* Participate in cross-functional initiatives and group-level projects.
* Manage transactional data for alternative products by sourcing information from legal documents and third-party notices and entering it into internal systems.
* Assist in trade execution.
* Ensure relevant controls are in place and diligently followed to maintain a risk-controlled environment.
* Provide oversight of daily and ad hoc processes and assist with issues, escalations and complex scenarios.
* Collaborate with external service providers and internal teams to exchange product and asset data and resolve operational issues.
* Maintain and regularly update process documentation and control frameworks.

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------

* Master's degree in Finance or Accounting or relevant field.
* 2+ years of experience in middle office/operations, data management, accounting or administration, with a focus on alternative investment funds.
* Deep understanding of alternative investment products, including hedge funds, structured products and private equity.
* Knowledge of trading and settlement.
* Understanding of lifecycle events, including coupons, factors, amendments, tenders and maturity.
* Experience with cash and position reconciliation.
* Strong Excel and Outlook management skills.
* Enjoys problem solving and critical thinking.
* Ability to resolve complex issues efficiently and independently by applying knowledge from training and past experience.
* Curiosity and a strong desire to learn and build knowledge continuously.
* Ability to use lookups, pivot tables and extensive formulas and to build them from scratch.
Ability to manage a high volume of email without missing important items, respond promptly and escalate when necessary.  

  

**Shift Timings -**

2- 11 PM

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.

Job summary

As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.

Job responsibilities

* Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
* Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
* Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
* Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
* Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
* Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
* Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
* Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
* Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
* Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
* Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
* Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
* Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
* Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
* Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
* Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
* Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
* Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate or Data Engineer Associate (or Generative AI Engineer Associate).
* GitHub certification (for example, GitHub Foundations or GitHub Actions) and/or formal Copilot training or enablement.
* Substitution: 2+ years of production, hands-on experience delivering end-to-end business requirements or testing using Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, and GitHub Copilot Agent Mode in banking.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

description:

--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

  
  

About Citi

RSRU Analyst - C10

  
  

In this role, you will be a part the Regulatory Reporting Recommending Unit (RSRU) team and the core responsibilities are:

  
  

Reviewing Obligor information available in the public domain and recommending the appropriate Basel Counterparty type based on the regulatory interpretive guidance. Counterparty type information is a key attribute consumed in RWA calculations.

Supporting with Audit requests pertaining to Regulatory Segment recommendation.

  
  

Involved in the many diverse activities that the team engages in, to support the overall RSRU’s Book of Work.

  
  
  

Key Competencies

Subject Matter Expertise

* Familiarity and academic knowledge of banking business model including, products, counterparties, risk profile, earning drivers, and macro-economic implications
* Experience with and knowledge of control environment associated with RWA calculations
* Demonstrated history of facilitating and driving initiatives to grow or change the bank in a program or project management capacity
Strong understanding of bank risk and control frameworks  

  

Partnership & Collaborative Success

* Desire to partner with other stakeholders in the firm to drive objectives to delivery
* Strong interpersonal skills to identify and resolve conflict to mitigate roadblocks
  

  

Acumen & Communication

* High degree of self-advocacy, motivation, and development

Creative Problem Solving

title: Security Operations Analyst
description:
The Security Operations Analyst is a key member of the information security team who ensures:
  
  

* Security tools operate effectively.
* Incidents are promptly detected, investigated, contained, and remediated.
* Vulnerabilities are promptly identified and remediated.

**About This Role**
The Security Operations Analyst is a key member of the information security team who ensures:
  
  

* Security tools operate effectively.
* Incidents are promptly detected, investigated, contained, and remediated.
* Vulnerabilities are promptly identified and remediated.

**What You'll Do**

* Monitor and administer a suite of best-of-breed security tools:

+ Web Application Firewall (WAF) and Denial of Service Protection
+ Endpoint Protection
+ Endpoint Detection Response (EDR)
+ Firewall and Network Intrusion Detection/Prevention (IDS/IPS)
+ Identity Protection
+ Brand Protection
+ Cloud Security Posture Management
+ Identity Prote ction
+ Attack Surface Management
+ AI Governance
+ Pentesting

* Contain, remediate, and document reported security incidents.
* Perform threat and vulnerability assessments, maintain vulnerability metrics, and implement remedial actions required, including annual pentests.
* Contribute to Third Party Risk Management security and compliance evaluations of new and existing partners.
* Lead or participate in application and infrastructure security risk assessments and audits.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for security playbooks and tools.
* Recommend and apply system and network hardening best practices.
* Evaluate and recommend new security software and technologies to address new threats.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree or working toward a degree focused on cybersecurity or related experience.
* Knowledge of information security principles, security risk assessment, threat modeling, vulnerability management, incident response, and identity and access management.

* Knowledge of network architecture concepts and protocols.
* Knowledge of Linux, Windows, and AWS infrastructure.
* Knowledge of scripting technologies (Python, Power Shell, Linux Shell).

* Collaborative work style.

* Ability to work under stress and handle multiple high-pressure situations simultaneously.

Occasionally, later hours may be required for meetings with teams in other parts of the world. * Be creative: You don’t have to follow the norm to be successful – we encourage you to think outside the box. Our culture is built on encouraging innovative ideas, communication and joint success.

With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. title: Product Security Engineer
description:
**At Precisely, we're not just building software — we're shaping the future of data integrity.**
As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!
  
  
**Overview**
You will join our global Product Security team to test our products the way an attacker would — finding real, exploitable risk across web applications, APIs, containers, cloud environments and AI-enabled features, and working with engineering and product teams to get it fixed. You will work across a wide range of products and systems, so you will build breadth quickly, and your findings will directly shape how securely we design and ship. We're looking for someone who tests methodically, communicates findings clearly, and keeps building new skills as attack techniques and AI-assisted tooling evolve.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Perform hands-on security testing across web applications, APIs, containers, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and AI-enabled features, using manual techniques and security tooling to validate real, exploitable risk rather than raw scanner output.
* Prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact rather than automated severity score alone, and track them through to verified remediation and retest.
* Contribute to threat modeling, secure design reviews and architecture discussions early in the development lifecycle, so risks are caught before code ships.
* Assess identity and access control weaknesses, authentication and authorization models, and modern application and cloud architectures for privilege escalation and misconfiguration risk.
* Test AI-enabled features and agentic workflows for prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency and other AI-specific failure modes, and frame probabilistic findings as reproducible, actionable reports.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to explain findings clearly, review fixes, and support secure design and development practices.
* Strengthen security across the software delivery lifecycle, including build pipelines, deployment processes and release practices.
* Document findings and recommendations clearly, and support triage of externally reported vulnerabilities alongside the team that owns coordinated disclosure.
* Research emerging attack techniques and AI-assisted testing tools, and apply them to improve testing coverage, consistency and speed without giving up manual validation of what matters.
* Share knowledge across the team to continuously improve how we test, communicate risk and support secure product development.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field; equivalent practical experience accepted in place of formal education.
* Years of experience: 3+ years of experience performing penetration testing or application security.
* Years of experience needed with specific skills Experience testing across web applications, APIs, containerized deployments and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including embedded or agentic AI applications.
* Specific technical or software skills required Demonstrable expertise with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Postman, Git, and Python or similar scripting languages.
* Necessary certifications None required; see Preferred Skills.
* Travel is required: No
* Strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, SANS, and MITRE ATT&CK.
* Experience validating vulnerabilities through manual testing, distinguishing real, exploitable risk from raw scanner output.

**AI Skills/Knowledge**

* Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled features — prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, memory poisoning and insecure model integrations — and how they chain into real attack scenarios.
* Able to evaluate AI-generated content critically, verify technical accuracy, and use sound judgment before applying outputs to security testing, analysis or decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to identify security testing activities that can be automated with AI, and implement practical automation that improves coverage, consistency, speed or reporting quality while maintaining human validation of security decisions.
* Comfort configuring and tuning AI-assisted coding and testing tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code), and staying current with emerging AI attack techniques and testing methodologies.

**Preferred Skills (a Plus But Not Required)**

title: Career Change Senior Data Privacy-Apprenticeship Program
description:
**Job Description**
**Tsaaro Consulting Career Change Program**
**Step into Data Privacy and Cybersecurity**
Are you looking to build a career in Data Privacy and Cybersecurity but do not yet have direct industry experience? Tsaaro Consulting invites applications for its Career Change Program, an Intern-to-Hire pathway designed for individuals who want to transition into privacy, information security, and responsible AI governance roles.
  
  
**Position: Senior Data Protection Apprentice**
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
**Program Duration:**
6 Months
  
  
**Opportunity:**
**Conversion to Full-Time**
**Data Protection Consultant based on performance**
**What is the Career Change Program?**
This is a structured training and apprenticeship program that prepares candidates to work in data privacy, cybersecurity governance, and compliance domains. Participants gain hands-on exposure to real client projects, privacy frameworks, and security standards under the guidance of experienced consultants.
  
  
You’ll receive structured training, real-world exposure, and one-on-one guidance to help you:
  
  

* Work with global privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and India DPDP Act
* Support privacy and security program implementation and risk assessments
* Assist in drafting policies, DPIAs, gap assessments, and compliance documentation
* Contribute to privacy governance, reporting, and regulatory tracking
* Understand privacy engineering and security management concepts

**Requirements**
Who Should Apply
  
  
We are looking for individuals who demonstrate foundational orientation toward both data privacy and cybersecurity through academics, certifications, or relevant exposure.
  
  

* Candidates with academic specialization or certifications in data privacy, information security, cybersecurity, PIMS, ISO 27701, or AI governance such as ISO 42001
* Early professionals or career switchers with interest in privacy and security compliance domains
* Individuals from any discipline who want to build expertise at the intersection of law, technology, and governance
* Candidates with up to 2–5 years experience or strong academic focus in related areas
* Understanding of privacy principles, security basics, or compliance concepts through study or certification
* Working knowledge of MS Office
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* Demonstrated interest in privacy and cybersecurity domains

**Benefits**
**Perks of Joining Tsaaro:**

* Career Growth in a Fast Moving Sector and into one of the most in-demand domains
* Paid Internship + Performance-Based Full-Time Conversion
* Support for Certifications (like CIPP/E, CIPM, PrivacyOps, etc.)
* Exposure on tool like OneTrust, GoTrust, Scrut, Securiti.ai, and more
* Mentorship from certified privacy experts
* Real Client Exposure
* Confidence to navigate consulting, compliance, and tech advisory roles
* Flexible & Remote-Friendly Work Environment

From the Tsaaro Team
  
  
"We created this program for people who have the ambition, curiosity, and commitment not just the traditional qualifications. If you’re looking to reinvent your career and make an impact in privacy and cybersecurity, we want to hear from you."
  
  
**Ready to Change Your Career Path?**
Apply today and take your first step into the
**World of Privacy & Security**
with Tsaaro.
