title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Platform Engineer

**Location:**
Pune (Office-based / Hybrid)

**Experience:**
4+ years

**Education:**
Bachelor’s or Master’s in CS, IT, or related field

**Role Overview**

Responsible for designing, operating, and securing enterprise cloud infrastructure and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) platforms. This role combines hands-on Azure administration, Kubernetes orchestration, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure platform services across distributed enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Azure Platform Administration:**
  Manage subscriptions, resource groups, VMs/VMSS, App Services, Storage, and Recovery Services Vaults.
* **Kubernetes Operations:**
  Design, deploy, upgrade, and operate public and private AKS clusters, including node pools, autoscaling, Ingress (NGINX/AGIC), and CoreDNS.
* **Cloud Networking:**
  Architect and troubleshoot VNets, subnets, NSGs/ASGs, UDRs, Private Link/Private Endpoints, Load Balancers, and ExpressRoute/VPN connections.
* **Identity & Security:**
  Implement Entra ID (Azure AD), RBAC, PIM, managed identities, Key Vault secrets integration via CSI drivers, and Defender for Cloud compliance.
* **Automation & CI/CD:**
  Build and maintain IaC using Terraform or Bicep; automate delivery pipelines with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to enable self-service onboarding.
* **Observability:**
  Monitor platform and workload health using Azure Monitor for containers, Log Analytics, Prometheus, and Grafana, driving SLO/SLA targets.

**Key Requirements**

* **Core Technical Skills:**
  Microsoft Azure, AKS, Terraform/Bicep, Entra ID (Azure AD), PIM, VNet/Private Link, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions, and container security.
* **Certifications (Mandatory):**
  Either Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) OR Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* **Certifications (Preferred):**
  AZ-305, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, or CKS.
* **Domain Advantage:**
  Prior experience in regulated industries (Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Pharmaceuticals) is a plus.

title: Security Automation Lead
description:
**Job Title**
Cyber Security Platform Engineer
  
  
**Location**
India (Pune)
  
  
**Reports to**
Cyber Security Engineering Lead (India) with functional alignment to Head of Cyber Platform Engineering
  
  
****Role Overview****
FNZ is building a global Cyber Platform Engineering function responsible for the operation, reliability, and evolution of the firm’s core security platforms.
  
  
We are seeking a Cyber Security Platform Engineer to join the growing engineering capability in India. This is a hands-on technical role focused on operating and improving FNZ’s production cyber security platforms.
  
  
The successful candidate will help ensure FNZ’s security platforms remain reliable, well-configured, and continuously improving through engineering, automation, and operational excellence.
  
  
This role sits within Cyber Platform Engineering, not the Security Operations Centre (SOC). The focus is on engineering and operating security platforms, rather than monitoring alerts or performing SOC analysis.
  
  
You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC.
  
  
****Core Responsibilities****
Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ’s production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.
  
  
The role combines hands-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms
* Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management
* Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance
* Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms
* Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ’s global security and operational standards
* Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows
* Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems
* Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency
* Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements
* Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms

Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset
**,**
identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time
  
  
Incident Engineering Support
  
  
Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required.
  
  
**This Includes:**

* Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting
* Assisting with root-cause analysis
* Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents

The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation.
  
  
Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ’s security platform environment.
  
  
**This Includes:**

* Identifying recurring operational issues
* Contributing to automation initiatives
* Improving platform observability and operational metrics
* Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities

Working Pattern
  
  
The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations.
  
  
Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out-of-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows.
  
  
****Required Experience****
Candidates should demonstrate hands-on experience operating enterprise security platforms.
  
  
**Typical Background Includes:**

* 3–6 years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles
* Hands-on experience working with enterprise security platforms
* Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls
* Experience working within distributed global engineering teams

Technical Experience
  
  
Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected:
  
  

* Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne
* Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access
* Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application-layer protection platforms
* Security logging and SIEM platforms
* Email security platforms and secure email gateways
* Vulnerability management platforms
* Network security controls, including next-generation firewalls

Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments.
  
  
Engineering & Automation Experience
  
  
**Experience In The Following Areas Is Beneficial:**

* scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar)
* working with APIs for platform integrations
* infrastructure automation or configuration management
* operating security tooling in cloud environments

Nice to Have
  
  
**Experience In The Following Areas Would Be Beneficial:**

* infrastructure-as-code or DevOps practices
* cloud security platform engineering
* integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines
* platform telemetry and observability tooling

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will:**

* support the reliable operation of FNZ’s security platforms
* contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives
* help maintain platform performance and stability
* collaborate effectively with global engineering teams
* grow technical expertise across FNZ’s security platform ecosystem

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ’s global technology infrastructure.
  
  
**The Cyber Platform Engineering Team Ensures These Platforms Remain:**

* reliable
* scalable
* well-engineered
* continuously improving

This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ’s global environment.
  
  
***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: ServiceNow TPRM - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**ServiceNow TPRM - Senior Consultant**
**Enterprise Performance**
Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice helps organizations improve business outcomes through platform-enabled transformation, technology modernization, and operational improvement. Within this space, our teams work across IT operations, service management, workflow automation, and enterprise platforms to deliver large-scale digital transformation programs. As a ServiceNow Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, build, and enhance ServiceNow solutions that help clients streamline processes, improve service delivery, and create long-term business value.
  
  
**Level**
: Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
We are seeking a skilled
**ServiceNow Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Developer**
to design, implement, and support ServiceNow TPRM solutions that strengthen vendor governance, risk visibility, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring. The ideal candidate combines functional knowledge of third-party risk processes with hands-on ServiceNow IRM / GRC platform expertise and can translate business requirements into scalable workflows, assessments, dashboards, and integrations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and configure ServiceNow TPRM / TPRP capabilities, including third-party records, contacts, inherent risk questionnaires, due diligence workflows, issues, and remediation tracking
* Design and maintain risk assessments, scoring models, approval flows, questionnaires, and risk rating logic
* Integrate TPRM with broader IRM / GRC capabilities, vendor management processes, and CMDB where applicable
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Procurement, Security, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and align workflows
* Build dashboards, reports, and monitoring views for third-party risk status, compliance posture, assessment completion, and remediation progress
* Maintain documentation for solution design, configuration, workflows, and operating procedures
* Support continuous improvement of third-party onboarding, reassessment, escalation, and offboarding processes

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-10 years hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform and strong exposure to TPRM, IRM, or GRC modules
* Solid understanding of third-party risk, vendor risk, compliance processes, control frameworks, and risk scoring methodologies
* Experience with ServiceNow configuration and development, including workflows, Business Rules, reporting, dashboards, and preferably JavaScript
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with external vendor, risk, or enterprise platforms using APIs and standard web services
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Third-Party Risk Management (CIS-TPRM)
* ServiceNow CIS in GRC / IRM for broader integrated risk roles
* Industry certifications such as CRISC, CISM, or privacy/risk credentials
* Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or critical infrastructure

Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

24x7 including night shift as per business requirements

title: Sr IT Cyber Defense Analyst
description:
Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead)
  
  
**AI-Enabled Security Operations | 24/7 SOC**
**Location: Remote – Pune/Baroda, India**
**Department: IT Cybersecurity – Security Operations Center (SOC)**
**Reports To: SOC Manager**
**Work Schedule:**
24/7 rotational shifts
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead) to lead day-to-day SOC operations, oversee security investigations, coordinate incident response, and mentor SOC analysts. The ideal candidate will bring strong SIEM/EDR expertise, advanced threat investigation skills, and hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools and automation to improve SOC efficiency and detection capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead SOC shift operations, prioritize alerts, manage escalations, and ensure timely handovers and SLA adherence.
* Investigate complex incidents involving phishing, malware, ransomware, compromised accounts, endpoint threats, and suspicious network activity.
* Conduct threat hunting, correlate security telemetry, and map attacker behavior to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot SIEM queries, analytics rules, and detection use cases using Microsoft Sentinel and KQL.
* Use approved AI/LLM tools for alert triage, investigation assistance, threat intelligence enrichment, KQL development, incident reporting, and workflow automation; independently validate AI-generated outputs.
* Automate repetitive SOC tasks using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR capabilities.
* Mentor analysts, improve investigation quality, reduce false positives, and maintain accurate incident documentation and audit-ready evidence.
* Coordinate with Incident Response, IT, Endpoint, Network, and Cloud teams to support containment, remediation, and recovery.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in SOC, cyber defense, or incident response, including shift leadership, incident coordination, or analyst mentoring.
* Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, incident investigation, and threat detection.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Sentinel and KQL; experience with Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, or similar security platforms.
* Strong understanding of networking, Windows/Linux, identity security, email threats, and MITRE ATT&CK.
* Mandatory practical AI/LLM proficiency, including prompt engineering, AI-assisted investigations, validation of AI-generated queries/scripts, and awareness of hallucinations, prompt injection, and data privacy risks.
* Scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, decision-making, and team leadership skills; willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, GCIH, or relevant SIEM/EDR vendor certifications.
* Experience in proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, cloud security, and SOC process improvement.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Effective shift leadership and timely, high-quality incident handling.
* Improved detection coverage, investigation efficiency, and reduced false positives.
* Practical adoption of AI and automation to reduce repetitive work while maintaining security, accuracy, and human oversight.
* Strong analyst development, documentation, and operational consistency.

title: Junior Cyber Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Junior Cyber Security Engineer**
**Job Description**
The Junior Cyber Security Engineer supports the secure development lifecycle across products by coordinating security activities, driving audits and assessments, and helping embed product security best practices into development and business processes. This role works closely with cross-functional teams and business units to identify, assess, and prioritize product risks, manage vulnerabilities, and support incident response activities. The position is ideal for a security-minded engineer with a strong foundation in electronics or related fields who wants to grow in product and industrial cyber security.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and manage the implementation of secure development lifecycle activities across products and projects.
* Drive audits and assessments for new product development processes to ensure that cybersecurity deliverables are complete and effective.
* Participate in key projects as the product security functional representative, providing guidance on security requirements and controls.
* Collaborate with business units to inventory products and assist in prioritizing product risks based on business impact and threat exposure.
* Organize and manage product risk assessments, including TARA (Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment), vulnerability assessments, and threat modeling efforts.
* Support vulnerability management by helping to identify, track, and remediate security vulnerabilities in products and related systems.
* Create, organize, and participate in cross-functional and business unit communities that promote secure development and product security best practices.
* Maintain and update artifacts, documentation, and a central repository of communications and information related to product security functions and teams.
* Assist in analyzing product security market and technology trends to inform improvements to security processes, controls, and technologies.
* Support training and development efforts for various organizational functions, focusing on product security-related roles and responsibilities.
* Maintain familiarity with relevant industry standards and frameworks, such as IEC standards (including ISA99), ISO/IEC standards, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, and NIST SP 800-218, and apply them in day-to-day work.
* Support the organizational Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) in handling product security incidents and coordinating responses.
* Assist in vulnerability management activities, including monitoring, triage, and coordination of remediation actions.
* Establish and enhance strong working relationships with business unit team members, organizational functions, and external business partners to advance product security objectives.
* Contribute to secure coding practices and code review processes by applying security principles and recognized security standards.
* Support the use and management of software bills of materials (SBOM) to improve transparency and control over software components used in products.

**Essential Skills**

* Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent years of relative experience.
* 3 - 6 years of experience with product security standards and initiatives or practical work experience related to the implementation of products, services, and solutions.
* Hands-on experience with standards and risk management frameworks such as IEC standards (including ISA99), NIST SP 800-218, COBIT, and other NIST guidance.
* Practical experience in risk assessment, including Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA), vulnerability assessments, and gap analysis.
* Experience with threat modeling methodologies and tools for identifying and addressing product security threats.
* Knowledge of the Cyber Resilience Act and related regulatory or industry requirements affecting product security.
* Understanding of technology trends and current product security issues, particularly those specific to control systems and related industrial products.
* Experience with project management and development processes, including working within structured product development lifecycles.
* Experience working with recognized security-related standards and technologies relevant to product and industrial cyber security.
* Experience with software bills of material (SBOM), including their creation, maintenance, and use in vulnerability and risk management.
* Experience with secure coding practices and code review processes, including the ability to identify common security weaknesses in code.
* Prior experience in the industrial, factory automation, or control systems industry, with exposure to operational technology environments.
* Strong ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate security requirements and findings clearly.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

* Familiarity with IEC (including ISA99), IEC, ISO/IEC, and other relevant international standards related to industrial and product cyber security.
* Awareness of emerging product security market and technology trends and their implications for secure product development.
* Experience contributing to or supporting Product Security Incident Response Teams (PSIRT) and vulnerability management programs.
* Ability to develop and deliver training or awareness materials related to product security roles and responsibilities.
* Experience participating in communities of practice or cross-functional working groups focused on secure development and product security.
* Interest in deepening expertise in control systems security, industrial automation, and secure product design.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain comprehensive documentation and centralized repositories of security artifacts.

**Work Environment**
The Junior Cyber Security Engineer works in a collaborative, cross-functional environment that spans engineering, product development, and business units focused on secure product design and lifecycle management. The role involves regular interaction with development teams, product managers, and security specialists to integrate security into product planning, design, implementation, and maintenance. You will use industry-standard frameworks and technologies, including IEC and ISO/IEC standards, NIST SP 800-218, COBIT, and tools that support risk assessment, TARA, vulnerability assessments, threat modeling, SBOM management, and secure coding practices. The work typically follows structured project and development processes, with a focus on documentation, audits, and continuous improvement of security practices. The position is primarily office- or hybrid-based, using standard business productivity and collaboration tools, and does not impose a specific dress code beyond typical professional or business-casual attire appropriate for a technical and corporate environment.
  
  
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
  
  
At Actalent, Diversity And Inclusion Are a Bridge Towards The Equity And Success Of Our People. DE&I Is Embedded Into Our Culture Through
  
  

* Hiring diverse talent
* Maintaining an inclusive environment through persistent self-reflection
* Building a culture of care, engagement, and recognition with clear outcomes
* Ensuring growth opportunities for our people

Actalent is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
**About Actalent**
Actalent is a global leader in engineering and sciences services. For more than 40 years, weve helped visionary companies advance their goals. Headquartered in the United States, our teams span 150 offices across North America, EMEA, and APACwith four delivery centers in India led by 1,000+ extraordinary employees who connect their passion with purpose every day.
  
  
Our Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, and Chennai delivery centers are hubs of engineering expertise, with core capabilities in mechanical and electrical engineering, systems and software, and manufacturing engineering. Our teams deliver work across multiple industries including transportation, consumer and industrial products, and life sciences. We serve more than 4,500 clients, including many Fortune 500 brands. title: Ping Federate - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**

You will collaborate with onsite and offshore teams to understand functional requirements and ensure seamless project execution.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading the technical design, setup, and integration of Ping Identity solutions across cloud and on-premises client environments
* Installing, upgrading, and configuring PingFederate, PingAccess, PingDirectory, and PingOne products in clustered environments
* Gathering business and technical requirements from client stakeholders and translating them into scalable identity and access management solution designs
* Planning and executing integration, performance, and user acceptance testing, and troubleshooting advanced integration issues with internal and vendor support teams
* Creating technical, architectural, administrator, and end-user documentation to support deployment, maintenance, and adoption

**The team**

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24x7 rotational shifts; flexibility for night, weekend, and holiday coverage; on-call support based on project assignment

title: IT Infrastructure & Operations Consultant (Onsite)
description:
**Department:**
IT / Operations

**Employment Type:**
6 months contract

**Location:**
Kharadi, Pune (Onsite)

**Experience:**
3–6 years preferred

**Shift:**
US Eastern Shift (6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST)

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on IT Infrastructure & Operations Consultant to manage and optimize the organization's IT ecosystem, including software applications, cloud platforms, user access, licenses, networking, and hardware assets.

The individual will be responsible for ensuring that employees have access to the right tools, licenses, devices, and permissions to perform their jobs effectively and securely. This person will own the administration and documentation of the company's technology stack, identify opportunities to reduce software costs, evaluate new technologies, and help employees get the most out of the tools they use.

The ideal candidate is organized, technically proficient, security-conscious, and comfortable managing a diverse range of SaaS applications, cloud services, and IT infrastructure in a growing organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. SaaS Application & License Management**

* Manage the organization's software subscriptions, licenses, and user accounts across all business applications.
* Administer tools and platforms including Microsoft 365, Zoho Workplace and other Zoho applications, AWS, Apollo, Tailscale, Cloudflare, Cursor, AI tools, and other current or future company applications.
* Provision, assign, modify, reclaim, and revoke licenses based on employee roles, requirements, and employment status.
* Maintain a centralized inventory of applications, including license counts, assigned users, subscription plans, renewal dates, costs, billing information, and application owners.
* Monitor license utilization and identify unused, duplicate, underutilized, or redundant subscriptions.
* Manage renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and vendor communications.
* Ensure license assignments comply with vendor licensing terms and organizational policies.

**2. User Access, Identity & Permission Management**

* Manage employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across all company applications.
* Configure and maintain role-based access control (RBAC), permissions, and access policies within each platform.
* Create and manage user groups, teams, departments, and permission groups to ensure the right employees have access to the appropriate features and resources.
* Implement least-privilege access principles and ensure access is granted based on business requirements.
* Review access rights periodically and remove unnecessary or outdated permissions.
* Administer multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and related identity and access management features where supported.
* Maintain auditable records of user access, license assignments, access changes, and administrative actions.
* Coordinate with department leads to understand access requirements and approve changes where necessary.

**3. IT Asset & Hardware Management**

* Manage the organization's hardware inventory, including laptops, peripherals, networking equipment, and other IT assets.
* Coordinate with approved vendors for laptop procurement, configuration, shipping, delivery, repairs, replacements, and warranty claims.
* Track device assignments, serial numbers, asset tags, specifications, purchase dates, warranty details, shipping status, and employee ownership.
* Ensure devices are prepared and delivered to employees before their joining dates, including remote employees where applicable.
* Maintain records of device allocation, returns, repairs, replacements, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate secure device setup, software installation, updates, and data removal when devices are issued, reassigned, or returned.
* Track hardware expenditure and identify opportunities to optimize procurement costs and device utilization.

**4. Cloud Infrastructure & Networking**

* Provide basic administration and operational support for cloud services, particularly AWS, including user access, permissions, account organization, resource visibility, and usage monitoring.
* Maintain a working understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, IP addressing, VPNs, routing, firewalls, connectivity, and network troubleshooting.
* Administer and support networking and connectivity tools such as Tailscale and Cloudflare, including relevant access policies, configurations, and user permissions.
* Assist with managing domains, DNS records, SSL/TLS certificates, and other related services where applicable.
* Troubleshoot routine connectivity, access, configuration, and endpoint issues.
* Coordinate with developers, cloud engineers, or external specialists for complex infrastructure changes, outages, or technical issues.
* Monitor cloud and service usage, flag unusual activity, and help identify cost optimization opportunities.

**5. IT Documentation, Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain a centralized and up-to-date IT asset and software inventory.
* Develop periodic reports covering:
* Software applications and subscription plans.
* Total licenses purchased, assigned, available, and unused.
* License costs, renewals, and upcoming contractual commitments.
* Employee access, user groups, roles, and permissions.
* Hardware inventory, assignments, procurement, and warranty status.
* Cloud service usage and relevant expenditure.
* Access reviews, offboarding completion, and outstanding IT issues.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for application administration, access requests, device management, and employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Maintain appropriate records to support internal audits, security reviews, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, accessible to authorized personnel, and updated whenever changes are made.

**6. Technology Evaluation & Cost Optimization**

* Evaluate new software, AI tools, productivity applications, and infrastructure solutions based on business requirements.
* Research alternatives to existing tools and compare features, pricing, security, integrations, scalability, and ease of use.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate applications, eliminate redundant subscriptions, negotiate better pricing, and optimize license allocation.
* Prepare recommendations for management, including cost-benefit comparisons and implementation considerations.
* Assess new AI tools and developer productivity platforms, including tools such as Cursor, against business needs and applicable security policies.
* Coordinate pilots, trials, and rollouts of approved tools.
* Maintain an up-to-date view of the organization's technology stack and recommend improvements as the company grows.

**7. Employee Training & IT Support**

* Help employees understand and use the company's software applications effectively.
* Conduct onboarding sessions, tool demonstrations, training workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Create user guides, FAQs, and documentation for frequently used tools and workflows.
* Assist employees with application access, license issues, permissions, device setup, connectivity, and routine technical problems.
* Promote the effective adoption of existing tools before recommending additional software.
* Track recurring IT issues and recommend process or configuration changes to prevent them.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration, IT operations, systems administration, SaaS administration, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience administering multiple SaaS applications, managing user accounts, and assigning software licenses.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Zoho applications, cloud platforms, and modern business productivity tools.
* Understanding of user provisioning, access controls, RBAC, user groups, MFA, and basic identity management.
* Working knowledge of AWS administration, account permissions, and cloud cost monitoring.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience managing hardware inventory, laptop procurement, vendor coordination, shipping, and asset tracking.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
* Ability to evaluate software products, compare alternatives, and make cost-conscious recommendations.
* Good communication skills and the ability to train employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and coordinate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with identity providers and SSO solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with endpoint management and device security solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools.
* Experience with IT asset management, SaaS management, or license optimization platforms.
* Basic understanding of cloud security, access auditing, backup practices, and incident response.
* Familiarity with AI productivity tools and developer tools, including enterprise account management and data security considerations.
* Experience creating automated workflows or scripts for user provisioning, reporting, and routine IT administration.
* Relevant certifications in Microsoft 365, AWS, networking, or IT service management are an advantage.

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role for an experienced cyber security architect focuses on designing implementing and optimizing secure access solutions centered on Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for a large global enterprise. The architect will ensure resilient secure connectivity align security controls with business objectives and continuously strengthen the organization cyber posture to safeguard data systems and users while supporting day operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and architect secure internet and private application access solutions using Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access to protect enterprise users applications and data while ensuring consistent performance across hybrid work environments.
* Evaluate existing network and security architectures and propose detailed Zscaler based transformation roadmaps that improve threat protection reduce attack surface and streamline secure connectivity for day to day business operations.
* Configure and optimize Zscaler Internet Access policies including secure web gateway controls advanced threat protection and data protection rules to balance risk reduction with user experience and business productivity.
* Configure and optimize Zscaler Private Access architectures including application segmentation granular access policies and integrations with identity providers to deliver secure zero trust remote access without reliance on traditional virtual private network solutions.
* Collaborate with network infrastructure and application teams to integrate Zscaler platforms with routing directory services and logging systems so that secure access controls are consistently applied across on premise and cloud environments.
* Develop and maintain detailed technical design documents standards and configuration baselines for Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access deployments to ensure repeatable implementation and operational stability.
* Conduct security risk assessments focused on internet and private access pathways and translate findings into actionable Zscaler policy changes that close gaps mitigate emerging threats and support regulatory and internal compliance expectations.
* Implement robust monitoring and alerting for Zscaler platforms using integrated logging and analytics tools to quickly detect anomalies investigate security events and support incident response activities.
* Provide technical guidance to operations and support teams on Zscaler features configuration changes and troubleshooting practices so that production environments remain stable and security incidents are handled efficiently.
* Coordinate and execute user access and traffic migration plans to Zscaler solutions with clear communication testing and fallback steps to minimize disruption while enhancing security posture for distributed workforce scenarios.
* Review and refine access control models authentication flows and policy structures to align Zscaler deployments with zero trust principles reducing lateral movement opportunities and strengthening protection for business critical applications.
* Champion secure by design practices in projects that rely on internet and private access by advising on Zscaler capabilities recommending secure patterns and ensuring architecture decisions support long term resilience and innovation.
* Analyze platform metrics and user feedback to identify optimization opportunities in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access usage driving continuous improvement that benefits the company service quality and contributes to safer digital interactions across society.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience designing and implementing large scale Zscaler Internet Access solutions including policy design integration with identity platforms and performance tuning in complex enterprise environments.
* Demonstrate strong practical expertise with Zscaler Private Access including application discovery micro segmentation strategies and secure connectivity patterns for hybrid and cloud hosted workloads.
* Possess deep knowledge of network security concepts such as secure web gateway controls firewalling proxy technologies transport layer security domain name system security and zero trust architectures relevant to secure access design.
* Possess solid understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals including routing switching virtual private network alternatives network address translation and load balancing to integrate Zscaler solutions effectively without degradation of service.
* Apply experience with security monitoring and incident response using logs and analytics from secure access platforms to investigate threats support forensics and recommend durable improvements to policies and configurations.
* Apply familiarity with regulatory and industry security standards and demonstrate ability to translate compliance requirements into practical Zscaler policies and technical controls that support organizational obligations.

description:
**Technical Delivery Manager, Strategic Integrations and Migrations**

Location: Pune, India

Type: Full time

Experience: 10+ years

Travel: 10 to 15%, domestic and international

**About AiStrike**

Security teams drown in alerts, and real attacks hide among the false positives. AiStrike uses AI to

prioritize and automate threat investigation and response. We cut alert volume from 100 to 5, give

analysts the context to investigate what remains, and add workflow and automation to shorten

response time.

**The role**

You will run delivery for complex SIEM migrations and integrations. That means cadence, schedule,

stage gates and sign off. You have been hands on in SIEM implementations and know what decides whether a customer is ready to go live. You have onboarded data into a SIEM. Now you manage timelines, deliverables and executive stakeholders.

**What you will do**

**Program governance**

* Set the delivery cadence with the MSSP partner and AiStrike teams. Run the weekly
* operational forums
* Keep decisions, actions and agreements in writing, with an owner and a due date on every
* open item.
* Own the stage gates and get recorded sign off at each one against the agreed regional
* milestones.

•
**Govern the migration lifecycle:**

Stage 0: Prerequisites and tenant provisioning

Stage 1: Log source ingestion and parser validation

Stage 2: Content, detection rule and playbook migration

Stage 3: Parallel run and user acceptance testing

Stage 4: Cutover and legacy platform decommissioning

Stage 5: Stabilization and handover

**Schedule, risk and dependencies**

* Own the integrated schedule across customer migration waves, including dependencies
* between log onboarding, parsers, content migration and cutover windows.
* When a date slips, name the cause and the fix in the same week.
* Maintain the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies). Escalate only when a stage
* gate is genuinely at risk.
* Run a follow the sun model with the US TAM so partner leadership and the India delivery
* pods work from one plan.

**Technical readiness**

* Review SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, cloud and email sources with the engineering pod. Confirm
* data is connected, normalized and arriving complete, then make the go live call.
* Diagnose blockers fast: missing credential, broken parser, timestamp or schema issue,
* detection gap, or an agent verdict the analyst does not trust. Say which one stops the gate.

**Leadership and reporting**

* Lead architects, data engineers, detection engineers and customer teams through influence.
* They do not report to you, and the schedule still moves.
* Turn technical status into a weekly health report and steering brief for delivery leadership
* and partners. Cover the success KPIs: alert volume, false positive rate, investigation time and
* share of alerts closed by the agent.
* Agree the operating model with the customer SOC: queues, escalation, ticketing and who
* accepts an agent verdict.
* Send Product and Engineering usable field evidence: customer, source, expected result, what
* the agent did and what the analyst did.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years in security service delivery /technical project/program management experience
* driving complex, multi-tenant enterprise software migrations, large-scale systems
* integrations, or IT transformations
* Hands on SIEM implementation experience, including log source onboarding, parsers and
* content migration, on a platform such as Securonix, Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel,
* Google SecOps or Elastic.
* Current experience running programs across multiple customers at once, including timelines,
* deliverables, stage gates and stakeholder sign off.
* A track record of multi tenant or MSSP migrations, or large security platform rollouts,
* delivered to a committed date.
* Experience leading engineers and analysts in a matrix, without direct authority.
* Strong command of schedule and risk tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet or MS
* Project.
* Clear spoken and written English for analyst reviews and partner steering meetings.
* Comfort working across US and India hours, and willingness to travel 10 to 15%.

**Nice to have**

* Experience inside an MSSP, SOC or cybersecurity product company, taking customers live.
* Enough technical depth to read a failed integration or a SIEM query (SQL, KQL or SPL) and tell
* the pod what is wrong.
* SOAR playbook experience on Palo Alto XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Tines or Torq.
* Experience judging AI or automation investigations: where the result is wrong and what the
* analyst should do next.
* A delivery certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an agile credential. Security certifications
* such as Security+, CISSP or CISM help, but do not replace SIEM implementation experience.

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a multi region MSSP migration, based in our Pune office, with global
* counterparts on the same program.
* A role in a high growth company building AI driven security operations.
* Competitive compensation.

  **hardware acceleration**

  **security hardening**

* Own
  **architecture reviews**

**Requirements**

* ****10+ years****

  **SSL/TLS internals**

  **DPI or security service engines**

* Proficiency in
  **multi-core, low-latency C/C++**
  programming — concurrency, memory optimization, and zero-copy techniques.
* Strong
  **debugging and profiling**
  skills across complex, multi-threaded networking environments.

* Familiarity with NGFW security services from leading industry vendors.
* Exposure to modern encrypted protocol standards (HTTP/3, QUIC, DoH, ECH/ESNI).

title: Quality Assurance & Compliance Consultant

title: Sr IT Cyber Defense Analyst
description:
Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead)

**AI-Enabled Security Operations | 24/7 SOC**

**Location: Remote – Pune/Baroda, India**

**Department: IT Cybersecurity – Security Operations Center (SOC)**

**Reports To: SOC Manager**

**Work Schedule:** 24/7 rotational shifts

**About the Role**
==================

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead) to lead day-to-day SOC operations, oversee security investigations, coordinate incident response, and mentor SOC analysts. The ideal candidate will bring strong SIEM/EDR expertise, advanced threat investigation skills, and hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools and automation to improve SOC efficiency and detection capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead SOC shift operations, prioritize alerts, manage escalations, and ensure timely handovers and SLA adherence.

* Investigate complex incidents involving phishing, malware, ransomware, compromised accounts, endpoint threats, and suspicious network activity.

* Conduct threat hunting, correlate security telemetry, and map attacker behavior to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

* Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot SIEM queries, analytics rules, and detection use cases using Microsoft Sentinel and KQL.

* Use approved AI/LLM tools for alert triage, investigation assistance, threat intelligence enrichment, KQL development, incident reporting, and workflow automation; independently validate AI-generated outputs.

* Automate repetitive SOC tasks using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR capabilities.

* Mentor analysts, improve investigation quality, reduce false positives, and maintain accurate incident documentation and audit-ready evidence.

* Coordinate with Incident Response, IT, Endpoint, Network, and Cloud teams to support containment, remediation, and recovery.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
======================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

* 5+ years of experience in SOC, cyber defense, or incident response, including shift leadership, incident coordination, or analyst mentoring.

* Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, incident investigation, and threat detection.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Sentinel and KQL; experience with Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, or similar security platforms.

* Strong understanding of networking, Windows/Linux, identity security, email threats, and MITRE ATT&CK.

* Mandatory practical AI/LLM proficiency, including prompt engineering, AI-assisted investigations, validation of AI-generated queries/scripts, and awareness of hallucinations, prompt injection, and data privacy risks.

* Scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR tools.

* Strong analytical, communication, decision-making, and team leadership skills; willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, GCIH, or relevant SIEM/EDR vendor certifications.

* Experience in proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, cloud security, and SOC process improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Effective shift leadership and timely, high-quality incident handling.

* Improved detection coverage, investigation efficiency, and reduced false positives.

* Practical adoption of AI and automation to reduce repetitive work while maintaining security, accuracy, and human oversight.

* Strong analyst development, documentation, and operational consistency.

title: Digital S/W Eng Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital S/W Engineer Sr Analyst Shape, build, and govern high-impact API solutions as a Senior Systems Engineer, sitting at the intersection of hands-on Apigee development and API design leadership within Citi's Digital Engineering organization. In this hybrid technical role, you will both develop and configure production API solutions on Google Apigee and lead the design and specification of API interfaces and integration patterns — owning mid-size features end-to-end from architecture through deployment, while contributing to larger platform initiatives.

  
  

You will be equally comfortable configuring Apigee proxies and policies as you are producing API design artefacts, leading design reviews, and governing integration standards. This role sits within Citi's Wealth Digital engineering team, where your contributions will directly shape API quality, security posture, and delivery outcomes at scale.

  
  

Responsibilities

  
  

Apigee

* Design and configure API proxies on Google Apigee, including proxy configurations, flow definitions, route rules, and target endpoint setup.

* Define and maintain Apigee policies — including traffic management (quota, spike arrest, rate limiting), mediation (JSON-to-XML, message transformation), and security (OAuth, API key validation, JWT verification) policies.

* Implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) authorization flows natively within Apigee, including authorization code, client credentials, and token introspection patterns.

* Configure and manage Apigee environments, API products, developer portals, and monetization configurations in line with platform governance standards.

* Integrate Apigee with backend services, identity providers, and downstream systems through secure, performant target configurations.

  
  

API Design & Governance

* Lead the design and specification of RESTful APIs, producing OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, API contracts, and integration specifications that engineering teams implement against.

* Apply Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles in both API design specifications and Apigee proxy configurations to protect sensitive financial data exchanges.

* Apply knowledge of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CDR, Section 1033) to design and build compliant, interoperable API interfaces on the Apigee platform.

* Define and enforce API design standards and governance guidelines, governing APIGEE Products and Proxies ,including naming conventions, versioning strategies, error response schemas, and pagination patterns.

* Facilitate and lead API design reviews and architecture walkthroughs, providing well-reasoned recommendations that guide engineering implementation decisions.

* Produce technical diagrams — sequence diagrams, flow diagrams, and system context maps — to document API behavior, data flows, Apigee policy execution, and integration touchpoints.

  
  

Leadership & Collaboration

* Communicate technical progress and risks proactively across engineering and product teams, managing competing priorities and keeping stakeholders aligned.

* Review delivery and API quality metrics regularly, identifying opportunities to improve development workflows, proxy performance, and governance processes.

* Mentor and upskill junior engineers through code reviews, proxy design walkthroughs, and structured knowledge-sharing sessions.

* Evaluate technical and business risk in design and implementation decisions, escalating issues with transparency to protect Citi and its clients.

  
  

Required Qualifications & Skills

* 8–10 years of experience in a product development, engineering, or technology product management environment, including 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and configuring APIs on Google Apigee (proxies, flow configurations, policy chaining, shared flows, and target endpoints).

* Advanced expertise in RESTful API design & architecture, OpenAPI 3.x specification authoring, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Deep knowledge of API security & identity standards, including OAuth 2.0 (OAuthV2 policies, Client Credentials), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles across API contracts and Apigee configurations.

* Strong understanding of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CFPB Section 1033) and global data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) to ensure compliant, interoperable interface design.

* Skilled in vendor and partner management, effectively collaborating with third-party service providers to evaluate tools and drive solution delivery.

* Hands-on delivery in Agile environments, applying Scrum/Kanban practices to lead cross-functional sprint teams from concept through deployment.

* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with a data-driven, results-oriented approach to resolving complex system challenges and optimizing delivery metrics.

* Working familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Devin.AI) and prompt engineering methodologies to improve design velocity and documentation quality.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven capability to influence both senior technical and business stakeholders, articulate technical trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design walkthroughs.

Education

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Data Privacy Consultant
description:
About the job

**Looking for**
:
**Consultant**
- Data Privacy

**About the SARC's DPDP Practice :**

**SARC Global**
is a multidisciplinary advisory firm with
**40+ years of heritage, 100+ partners, and 500+ professionals**
across
**India, UK, USA, Singapore, and UAE**
.

SARC is building India's most comprehensive
**DPDP assessment practice**
not adapted from GDPR but built from the
**DPDP Act upward.**
Our clients are India's largest enterprises:
**Banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, stock exchanges, fintechs, and technology platforms.**

**Experience**

2-5 years

**Location**

New Delhi / Onsite. Client-site travel 40-60% during fieldwork.

**Reports To**

Engagement Partner - SARC Data Protection Practice

**Availability**

Immediate to Max 15 days

**Role**
:

**As Consultant, Data Privacy & Protection,**
you will be responsible for the
**executing assessments and implementation work**

under senior guidance.

You will work directly with
**CISOs, DPOs, Chief Compliance Officers, and Board members**
of listed companies, PSU banks, NBFCs, and mid-market enterprises. This is
**not a back-office compliance role**
. You will be in the room
**conducting stakeholder interviews, presenting findings, defending your analysis**
, and advising leadership on their most sensitive data protection decisions.

You will also contribute to
**practice building:**
refining our assessment methodology, building sector-specific overlays, training junior team members, and supporting business development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct
  **end-to-end DPDP Readiness Assessments**
  for mid-market and large Indian enterprises:
  **Governance, Data Inventory & RoPA, Consent Architecture, Processor Governance, Security Safeguards, Data Principal Rights, Children’s Data, Cross-Border Transfers, Breach Management, Training, Technology Enablement, and Ongoing Compliance.**
* Lead
  **stakeholder interviews**
  with department heads,
  **CISOs, DPOs,**
  legal teams, HR, marketing, IT, and procurement
* Build
  **Records of Processing Activities (RoPAs)**
* Create
  **Data Flow Diagrams (DFDs)**
  for the top 15–20 processing activities, identifying control points, gaps, and cross-border flows.
* Determine
  **legal basis**
  for each processing activity with documented reasoning and statutory references.
* Produce evidence-based
  **DPIA reports**
  with scored findings,
  **DPDP statutory references, risk ratings, and prioritised remediation roadmaps**
  with action owners, timelines, and cost estimates.
* Present findings and remediation recommendations to
  **C-suite leadership, Audit Committees, and Boards of Directors.**
* Support
  **post-assessment implementation**
  across key DPDP workstreams:

**Consent architecture redesign,**

**Privacy notice drafting (Rule 3 compliant),**

**DPA template development and negotiation,**

**DSR workflow design,**

**Breach notification playbook creation, and**

**Training curriculum design.**

* Advise clients on
  **privacy technology selection**
  -
  **OneTrust, Securiti AI, BigID**
  ,
  **Privasapien**
  , or structured manual processes based on their scale, complexity, and budget. Tool-agnostic advisory, not vendor-locked.
* **Map DPDP obligations**
  against sector-specific regulatory requirements
  **(RBI Master Directions, SEBI cybersecurity framework, IRDAI guidelines, CERT-In directions)**
  to produce integrated compliance roadmaps.
* Design
  **consent architecture**
  across three layers:

**Layer 1**
(Notice only — Section 7 legitimate use),

**Layer 2**
(Mandatory consent — Section 6 necessary for service),

**Layer 3**
(Optional consent — Section 6 not necessary, customer can refuse).

**Experience**
:

* **2-5 years**
  of experience in
  **data privacy, data protection, information security, or privacy consulting**
  - assessments, audits and implementation
* **Minimum 1 year**
  in a
  **client-facing advisory or consulting role**
  - Big 4, consulting firm, or specialist privacy advisory. Internal privacy roles (DPO office, compliance team) are valued but must be supplemented with external advisory experience.
* Demonstrated experience conducting
  **DPIAs, PIAs, or privacy gap assessments**
  - not just participating, but owning the assessment
  **end-to-end: scoping, data collection, analysis, findings, and report writing.**
* Experience building
  **RoPAs / data inventories**
  through
  **stakeholder interviews and system mappin**
  g not just tool-based automated discovery.
* Experience with privacy technology platform
  **(OneTrust, Securiti AI, BigID, TrustArc, Exterro)**
  configuration, administration, or implementation.
* **Strong knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025**

**Education and certifications:**

* **B.Tech / B.E.**
  in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline; OR
* **LLB / BA LLB / BBA LLB**
  with technology exposure;
* **MBA**
  with specialisation in Information Systems, Risk Management, or Compliance; OR
* Any graduate degree with 5+ years of relevant privacy/security experience and appropriate certifications.
* **At least one of: CIPP/E (IAPP), CIPM (IAPP), DCPP (DSCI/Nasscom), ISO 27701 Lead Implementer, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.**
* **OneTrust, Securiti AI, or BigID**
  platform certifications are a strong plus.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* **Preference will be given to candidates with an LLB / BA LLB / BBA LLB background.**
* Strong working knowledge of the
  **DPDP Act, 2023 & DPDP Rules, 2025.**
* Hands-on experience in
  **DPDP Gap Assessments**
  and
  **DPDP Implementation.**
* **CIPP/CIPP-E, CIPM, or DSCI DCPP certification is mandatory.**

title: T&T | Cyber: D&R | Assistant Manager | Incident Response & Handling | Delhi
description:
**T&T | Cyber: D&R | Assistant Manager | Incident Response & Handling | Delhi**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 113840
  
• **Location**: Delhi
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**

Deloitte helps organizations prevent cyberattacks and protect valuable assets. We believe in being secure, vigilant, and resilient—not only by looking at how to prevent and respond to attacks, but at how to manage cyber risk in a way that allows you to unleash new opportunities. Embed cyber risk at the start of strategy development for more effective management of information and technology risks. Lear more about Cybersecurity

  

**Your work profile**

The role requires strong hands-on capability across incident response and digital investigations, with experience in multiple evidence domains such as endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and malware-related analysis. You will be expected to identify adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures; conduct structured forensic analysis; perform threat hunts across enterprise telemetry; and translate findings into clear technical and executive-ready outputs. You will also plan and manage assigned investigation workstreams, guide junior analysts, review investigation outputs, contribute to detection improvement, assist in building repeatable investigation workflows, and help clients strengthen their overall cyber response maturity.

  

**Key skills required**

* Lead and support incident response and compromise assessment workstreams across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and enterprise log sources.
* Plan and manage assigned investigation workstreams, including task allocation, timeline tracking, evidence-quality review, issue escalation, stakeholder coordination, and review of client deliverables.
* Conduct advanced threat hunting to identify adversary access, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, command execution, defence evasion, credential access, data staging, and exfiltration activity.
* Perform malware triage and behavioural analysis to identify execution flow, persistence mechanisms, command-and-control indicators, payload behaviour, affected systems, and likely impact.
* Support malware reverse engineering activities where relevant experience is available, including static and dynamic analysis, string analysis, sandbox execution, API review, unpacking support, and behavioural reporting.
* Perform forensic triage of Windows and Linux systems, including review of event logs, registry artefacts, prefetch, Shimcache, Amcache, SRUM, scheduled tasks, services, WMI, PowerShell logs, Shellbags, browser artefacts, and process execution evidence.
* Analyse EDR, SIEM, firewall, proxy, VPN, DNS, email, cloud, and identity logs to reconstruct attacker activity and validate the scope of compromise.
* Investigate suspicious authentication activity, Kerberos abuse, privileged account misuse, token abuse, delegation issues, Active Directory group changes, lateral movement indicators, and identity-based attack paths.
* Conduct network-level analysis using packet captures, Zeek logs, DNS logs, proxy logs, firewall logs, and flow data to identify beaconing, tunnelling, unusual data transfers, and command-and-control activity.
* Develop and refine threat-hunting hypotheses based on threat intelligence, observed indicators, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, suspicious behaviours, and client-specific risk scenarios.
* Develop and tune SIEM or EDR queries, threat-hunting logic, detection rules, and custom analytics. Contribute to the development of Sigma and YARA rules where applicable.
* Use a combination of industry-standard investigation tools, which may include Velociraptor, KAPE, Eric Zimmerman tools, Volatility, Wireshark, Zeek, Timesketch, Plaso, YARA, Sigma, Ghidra, x64dbg, PEStudio, CyberChef, Sysinternals, and comparable utilities.
* Prepare and review structured investigation notes, malware analysis reports, threat-hunt summaries, timelines, evidence maps, root cause analysis inputs, and remediation recommendations.
* Map observed activity to MITRE ATT&CK and support detection engineering, control validation, purple-team outputs, and breach and attack simulation scenarios where relevant.
* Review investigation outputs prepared by junior team members and ensure technical accuracy, evidence traceability, completeness, and clarity of reporting.
* Mentor junior analysts during investigations, evidence review, log analysis, tool usage, and report drafting.
* Support incident response lab development, secure malware analysis environments, telemetry onboarding, investigation automation, and repeatable response workflows.
* Work with client stakeholders to explain technical findings, validate evidence, evaluate containment options, and recommend practical remediation actions, while recognising that final containment and business decisions remain with the client.
* Track investigation risks, dependencies, evidence gaps, and critical decisions, and escalate material issues to engagement leadership in a timely manner.

Required Knowledge

* Four to seven years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including strong hands-on experience in incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, SOC investigations, malware analysis, or compromise assessment.
* Demonstrated experience in leading defined technical workstreams, coordinating investigation activities, reviewing outputs, or guiding junior team members
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques across initial access, execution, persistence, privilege escalation, defence evasion, credential access, discovery, lateral movement, command and control, collection, and exfiltration.
* Practical experience in endpoint investigation using EDR telemetry, forensic artefacts, system logs, process lineage, registry artefacts, scheduled tasks, services, PowerShell activity, WMI, and suspicious binary execution.
* Working knowledge of malware triage concepts, including static and dynamic analysis, sandboxing, persistence mechanisms, suspicious process behaviour, droppers, loaders, fileless techniques, and command-and-control behaviour.
* Experience with malware unpacking, process injection analysis, memory forensics, reverse engineering, and detailed API-level analysis is desirable
* Experience with threat hunting across SIEM, EDR, DNS, proxy, firewall, VPN, email, cloud, and identity telemetry.
* Strong understanding of Windows security events, authentication logs, PowerShell logs, Sysmon logs, Windows artefacts, and common forensic evidence sources.
* Good understanding of Active Directory and identity security concepts, including Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP, delegation, privileged groups, trusts, domain controllers, Active Directory Certificate Services, and lateral movement techniques.
* Experience with network investigation concepts, including DNS analysis, HTTP and HTTPS traffic review, beaconing patterns, unusual egress, protocol misuse, tunnelling, and packet capture analysis.
* Ability to develop or tune SIEM and EDR queries, threat-hunting logic, and detection rules.
* Experience developing Sigma rules, YARA rules, or equivalent detection content is desirable
* Scripting capability using Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or log-parsing methods to support investigations and automation.
* Ability to produce and review clear forensic summaries, malware triage notes, threat-hunt findings, timelines, technical reports, and remediation recommendations.
* Ability to manage evidence gaps, conflicting indicators, investigation dependencies, and technical uncertainties in a structured manner
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Digital Forensics, or a related discipline is preferred

title: NAC Senior Analyst
description:
**Req ID:** 393617
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a NAC Senior Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
In this role, Candidate is expected with an experience in core areas such as Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting, NAC (Network Access Control), and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the administration, upkeep, and upgrade of Cisco ISE solutions and deep understanding of network security concepts, Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols, endpoint profiling, posture assessments, BYOD, Guest, pxGrid, DNAC integration with ISE and network access control (NAC) technologies.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Design and Implementation: Collaborate with infra and security teams to design, implement and customize Cisco ISE solutions, integrate third party solutions to bolster the security posture of the organization and to meet, security business and regulatory requirements.
* AAA Configuration: Review and configure Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols such as RADIUS and TACACS+ on Cisco ISE for secure network access. Ensure to leverage industry best practices to reduce the attack surface areas.
* Endpoint Profiling: Understand, develop, and maintain endpoint profiling policies to classify and manage devices accessing the network based on their characteristics.
* Network Access Control (NAC): Deploy and manage NAC solutions using Cisco ISE to enforce security policies, monitor network access, and ensure compliance.
* Policy Management: Define and manage access control policies, posture assessments, and identity-based access controls within Cisco ISE.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network, security, and IT teams to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions (SIEM and log management), identity providers, and network infrastructure components.
* Troubleshooting and Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to Cisco ISE configurations, authentication failures, load balancer, licensing, and network access problems.
* Documentation and Training: Maintain comprehensive documentation of Cisco ISE configurations, policies, and procedures. Develop method and procedures in alignment with Change management best practices and provide training and knowledge transfer to varied team members.
* Upgrade and Patch Management: Plan and execute upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities for Cisco ISE deployments to ensure system stability and security. Escalate and troubleshoot along with Cisco TAC for identified bugs and potential work arounds.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network engineers, security teams, and IT stakeholders to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions, applications, and network infrastructure components.
* 5+ years Experience Cisco ISE

Preference
  

* Cisco ISE Certification

title: SOC Analyst - Level 2
description:
**About The Role**
EVOCS is hiring
**SOC Analysts at Level 2 (L2)**
to extend a client's security monitoring coverage into North America evening, weekend and public holiday periods, working alongside the client's existing analysts.
  
  
You will work inside the client's established Security Operations Centre: their tooling, their runbooks, their severity criteria and their escalation paths. The job is to catch what matters, work it properly, and hand it over cleanly to the next shift.
  
  
This is a triage and investigation role, not an alert-routing role. You will be expected to form a view on what an alert actually means, and to defend that view with the evidence you gathered.
  
  
**02**
**What You Will Do**

* Monitor security alerts and telemetry across your shift in Adlumin (Security Information and Event Management, SIEM) and SentinelOne (Endpoint Detection and Response, EDR).
* Triage and carry out first-line investigation: validate the alert, enrich it, rule out false positives, and assess severity against the client's criteria.
* Escalate confirmed or suspected incidents through the client's escalation path, with the evidence gathered during triage attached, not simply the alert reference.
* Execute documented client runbooks within the authority those runbooks grant to an L2 analyst.
* Maintain case and ticket records in the client's system of record: actions taken, evidence and outcome for every alert handled.
* Produce a written shift report and a handover to the incoming analyst at the end of every shift, covering open investigations, escalations raised and anything carried forward.
* Join client shift-change and operational calls that fall within your scheduled shift.

**Where the role stops**
Incident command, containment and remediation decisions, digital forensics, threat hunting, detection engineering and platform tuning all remain with the client. You escalate; you do not decide. Being disciplined about that boundary matters more in this role than it would in an internal SOC.
  
  
**03**
**What We Are Looking For**
**Essential**

* Two to four (2-4) years in a Security Operations Centre, of which at least one (1) year at Level 2 performing genuine investigation rather than alert routing.
* Hands-on experience with a SIEM platform and an EDR platform. The specific products matter less
* than your investigative method.
* Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, common attack patterns, and how to distinguish a real detection from noise.
* Disciplined case documentation, and written English strong enough that your handover is usable by someone who was not on your shift.
* Genuine willingness to work the unsocial shift pattern described below. This is the substance of the role, not an occasional request.
* Immediate availability, with no notice period to serve.

**Desirable**

* Direct experience with Adlumin or SentinelOne.
* CompTIA CySA+ or Security+, GIAC GCIA, or Microsoft SC-200.
* Exposure to data centre, critical infrastructure or operational technology environments.
* Experience working inside a client's SOC rather than your own employer's, including the professional judgement that comes with it.

**04**
**Shift Pattern and Engagement Terms**
Five scheduled shifts per week of eight hours each, forty hours per week. Shifts cover North America evening, weekend and public holiday periods, which places them largely in the early-morning to midday India Standard Time (IST) window. Weekend and public holiday shifts are part of the roster, not exceptions to it.
  
  
The roster is fixed before the engagement begins and held for its duration. It is agreed with the client in advance, and shifts are rostered in accordance with applicable working-time and public holiday law.
