title: Product Security Engineer
description:
**At Precisely, we're not just building software — we're shaping the future of data integrity.**
As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!
  
  
**Overview**
You will join our global Product Security team to test our products the way an attacker would — finding real, exploitable risk across web applications, APIs, containers, cloud environments and AI-enabled features, and working with engineering and product teams to get it fixed. You will work across a wide range of products and systems, so you will build breadth quickly, and your findings will directly shape how securely we design and ship. We're looking for someone who tests methodically, communicates findings clearly, and keeps building new skills as attack techniques and AI-assisted tooling evolve.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Perform hands-on security testing across web applications, APIs, containers, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and AI-enabled features, using manual techniques and security tooling to validate real, exploitable risk rather than raw scanner output.
* Prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact rather than automated severity score alone, and track them through to verified remediation and retest.
* Contribute to threat modeling, secure design reviews and architecture discussions early in the development lifecycle, so risks are caught before code ships.
* Assess identity and access control weaknesses, authentication and authorization models, and modern application and cloud architectures for privilege escalation and misconfiguration risk.
* Test AI-enabled features and agentic workflows for prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency and other AI-specific failure modes, and frame probabilistic findings as reproducible, actionable reports.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to explain findings clearly, review fixes, and support secure design and development practices.
* Strengthen security across the software delivery lifecycle, including build pipelines, deployment processes and release practices.
* Document findings and recommendations clearly, and support triage of externally reported vulnerabilities alongside the team that owns coordinated disclosure.
* Research emerging attack techniques and AI-assisted testing tools, and apply them to improve testing coverage, consistency and speed without giving up manual validation of what matters.
* Share knowledge across the team to continuously improve how we test, communicate risk and support secure product development.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field; equivalent practical experience accepted in place of formal education.
* Years of experience: 3+ years of experience performing penetration testing or application security.
* Years of experience needed with specific skills Experience testing across web applications, APIs, containerized deployments and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including embedded or agentic AI applications.
* Specific technical or software skills required Demonstrable expertise with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Postman, Git, and Python or similar scripting languages.
* Necessary certifications None required; see Preferred Skills.
* Travel is required: No
* Strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, SANS, and MITRE ATT&CK.
* Experience validating vulnerabilities through manual testing, distinguishing real, exploitable risk from raw scanner output.

**AI Skills/Knowledge**

* Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled features — prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, memory poisoning and insecure model integrations — and how they chain into real attack scenarios.
* Able to evaluate AI-generated content critically, verify technical accuracy, and use sound judgment before applying outputs to security testing, analysis or decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to identify security testing activities that can be automated with AI, and implement practical automation that improves coverage, consistency, speed or reporting quality while maintaining human validation of security decisions.
* Comfort configuring and tuning AI-assisted coding and testing tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code), and staying current with emerging AI attack techniques and testing methodologies.

**Preferred Skills (a Plus But Not Required)**

* Experience with threat modeling and secure design reviews.
* Familiarity with cloud security concepts and common risks in modern application environments.
* Experience testing APIs, desktop applications, or legacy and mainframe systems (IBM i, z) is beneficial.
* Relevant security certifications such as OSCP, PNPT, GPEN, GWAPT, CEH, or CompTIA Security+; a background in software engineering is also a plus.

**Application and Interview Impersonation Notice:**
Impersonating another individual when applying for employment, and/or participating in an interview process to assist another individual in obtaining employment, with Precisely Software Incorporated (“Precisely”) is unlawful. If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators.
  
  
The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Cyber Security Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a skilled
**Cybersecurity Specialist**
to assess, monitor, and strengthen the security of our existing candidate assessment platforms, onboarding systems, and associated digital tools. The role will focus on identifying security vulnerabilities, evaluating potential risks, conducting authorized penetration testing, and recommending effective mitigation measures to protect candidate data, organizational information, and system integrity.

The ideal candidate will have a strong hands-on background in cybersecurity, ethical hacking, application security, and vulnerability assessment, with the ability to proactively identify security gaps and work with internal IT, development to implement corrective actions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Security Assessment:**
  Evaluate existing online assessment platforms, candidate onboarding tools, HR systems, and related applications to identify security vulnerabilities and potential threats.
* **Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing:**
  Conduct authorized security testing, including web application penetration testing, API testing, authentication testing, and session management assessments.
* **Vulnerability Management:**
  Identify, document, prioritize, and track vulnerabilities based on severity, business impact, and exploitation risk.
* **Risk Mitigation:**
  Recommend and coordinate the implementation of security controls to address identified vulnerabilities and minimize security exposure.
* **Application & Data Security:**
  Assess risks associated with candidate personal information, assessment results, identity verification, document uploads, access permissions, and data storage or transmission.
* **Access Control & Identity Management:**
  Review role-based access controls, administrator privileges, vendor access, authentication mechanisms, and authorization workflows.
* **Security Monitoring:**
  Review available application logs, access logs, suspicious activities, and security alerts to identify potential misuse or unauthorized access.
* **Third-Party Risk Assessment:**
  Evaluate the security posture of assessment and onboarding technology vendors, including their security controls, data handling practices, and vulnerability management processes.
* **Security Configuration Review:**
  Assess application configurations, APIs, integrations, cloud environments, encryption practices, and other relevant security controls.
* **Incident Response Support:**
  Investigate reported security issues, support incident containment and root-cause analysis, and recommend preventive measures.
* **Compliance & Documentation:**
  Maintain vulnerability assessment reports, risk registers, remediation trackers, security recommendations, and evidence of closure.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Establish periodic security reviews and recommend improvements to strengthen the security of existing platforms and future technology implementations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ethical hacking, application security, or penetration testing.
* Practical experience conducting web application and API security assessments.
* Strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, common attack vectors, and secure application design.
* Experience with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Nessus, OpenVAS, or equivalent security testing tools.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorization, session management, access control, encryption, and secure data transmission.
* Experience identifying vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), broken access control, insecure APIs, and security misconfigurations.
* Understanding of vulnerability scoring and prioritization frameworks such as CVSS.
* Ability to translate technical findings into actionable remediation plans for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.

At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. **About The Team**

**Assurance Centre of Excellence (CoE)**
delivers high-quality assurance across OakNorth’s key risk domains, including Financial Crime, Finance, Credit, Operations, Technology and Regulatory Reporting. The CoE is a lean, technically rigorous team that partners closely with Risk, Compliance and business functions to provide risk-based assurance and actionable insights.
  
  
Within the CoE, the Technology Assurance team delivers risk-based assurance across OakNorth’s technology landscape, including core banking infrastructure, digital products, data platforms, cloud, cybersecurity and technology resilience.
  
  
**About The Role**
The SVP, Technology Assurance is a critical role: you will both lead the delivery of the technology assurance plan and personally execute assurance engagements. Reporting to the Assurance COE Lead, you will define the scope and direction of technology assurance coverage, manage a team, and hold the bar for quality and timeliness across all engagements. This role is central to OakNorth's ability to maintain a well-controlled, trusted technology environment as the business scales.

A Lab Administrator is responsible for the closure of a high number of trouble tickets submitted by various individuals throughout the company. Lab Administrators have a firm grasp on concepts within the lab and can perform the following tasks with little or no supervision:
  
  

* Installation of network and/or computer equipment
* Software re-installation of lab devices

title: Network Demand Controller
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
Could you be the full-time Network Demand Controller in Bangalore we’re looking for?
  
  
**Role Overview**
The
**Network Demand Controller**
will serve as the primary liaison between Network Security Design, RUN Operations, Project Teams, Partners, and other stakeholders. The role is responsible for ensuring design governance, technical validation, stakeholder alignment, resource planning, documentation management, and successful delivery of Network Security solutions throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Design Validation and Governance**

* Validate technical parameters, BOMs, hardware specifications, software licensing, and service requirements in partner quotations and order forms against approved Network Security designs.
* Ensure all partner proposals are aligned with approved High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), architecture standards, and security requirements.
* Review and approve implementation sign-offs to ensure alignment between Design, RUN, and Partner teams.

**Process Improvement and Stakeholder Alignment**

* Identify and address process inefficiencies and technical gaps between Design, RUN Operations, Delivery teams, and other stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance collaboration, governance, and operational readiness.
* Facilitate effective communication between Design, Operations, Project, and Vendor teams.

**Demand Management and Resource Planning**

* Manage design demand intake and prioritization across multiple Network Security initiatives.
* Support resource allocation, workload balancing, and capacity planning for Network Security Architecture and Design teams.
* Provide visibility into design delivery commitments and resource utilization.

**Project and Partner Coordination**

* Lead partner meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Track partner execution and design deliverables against agreed project milestones and timelines.
* Escalate risks, dependencies, and issues that may impact successful delivery.

**Documentation Management**

* Ensure all Network Security design documentation is maintained and updated throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Govern architecture artifacts, standards, implementation guides, operational handover documentation, and design repositories.
* Ensure documentation compliance and audit readiness.

**Technology and Hardware Catalogue Management**
Proactively manage and maintain the Network Security technology catalogue.
  
  
Ensure hardware and software standards remain current and valid, including:
  
  

* SD-WAN
* LAN Infrastructure
* Firewalls
* Security Platforms and Services

Track technology lifecycle events, including End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Support (EOL) requirements.
  
  
**Reporting and Management Communication**

* Collaborate closely with Network Security Architects and Design Leads.
* Prepare and present regular status reports highlighting:
* Design progress
* Weekly achievements
* Key risks and dependencies
* Resource utilization
* Delivery performance
* Provide management with visibility into ongoing design initiatives and outcomes.

**Operational Readiness and Training**

* Work closely with RUN Operations teams to ensure readiness for new services and complex architectures.
* Identify training requirements for operational teams and coordinate knowledge transfer activities.
* Track team technical skills, certifications, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Technical Escalation and Change Coordination**

* Act as the primary point of contact for L4 support engagement requiring Design Team involvement.
* Coordinate and manage design-driven change implementations.
* Ensure changes are reviewed, communicated, and executed in alignment with approved designs and operational standards.

**Technical Workshops and Design Clarification**

* Organize and facilitate design clarification sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.

Ensure technical decisions, actions, and outcomes are documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
  
  
**MUST HAVE**
**Communication and Coordination**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to effectively engage with Architects, RUN Teams, Project Managers, Partners, Vendors, and Senior Management.
* Strong stakeholder management and meeting facilitation capabilities.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, workshops, and design clarification sessions.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 5+ years of experience in Network, Network Security, or Network Design-related roles.
* Experience working with enterprise-scale networking and security environments.
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and governance compliance.

Self-motivated with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously.
  
  
**Technical Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of Network Security and Enterprise Networking technologies.
* Good working knowledge of:
* LAN (Local Area Network)
* Wi-Fi/Wireless Networking
* SD-WAN Solutions
* Firewalls
* Network Security (NetSec) technologies and architectures
* Ability to validate technical designs, BOMs, quotations, and implementation plans against approved architecture standards.

**Important to note**
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer LAN
description: Business IntroductionGSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.Job PurposeThe Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's local area network and campus switching platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across local area network and campus switching to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.Key Responsibilities Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.Key Relationships/CustomersBusiness Stakeholders Internal GSK teams consuming the platform as customers of its self-service capability Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activityTech Stakeholders Engineering Director as line manager and owner of the engineering roadmap Platform Architect for reference architectures, patterns and standards Product Owner for backlog order and acceptance of engineering-led items Site Reliability Engineer and Reliability Engineering & Operations for SLOs, observability and incident prevention Other Principal Engineers and platform engineers across the domainOther Managed service partners contributing engineering capacity to the platform. Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of conceptProfessional Qualifications Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).Area of Specialisation Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.Why is this level of Education Required? Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion.Experience Required Overall 15 years typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. Extensive experience engineering enterprise local area networks and campus switching services. Strong knowledge of routing, switching, segmentation, resilience and complex fault diagnosis. Evidence of applying standards and automation to improve deployment quality, reliability or supportability.Desirable Requirements Professional level enterprise networking certification, such as CCNP Enterprise or JNCIP Enterprise Routing and Switching. Experience with application programming interfaces, infrastructure as code or network assurance platforms. Experience supporting manufacturing, laboratory or operational technology networks.Skills/Background Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.#AGTechSkillsAutomation Technology, Cisco Switching, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Network Engineering, Networks, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), SRE Observability, System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust ArchitectureWhy GSK?Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years exp, SP routing platforms, architectural and validation expertise
description:
**Meet the Team**
Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose #1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission-critical networks prior to Go-Live. We help Tier-1 Service Providers, Web/Cloud hyperscalers, and large Enterprises tackle their toughest business and operational challenges through network-centric testing, digital twin lab simulations, and advanced test automation. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next-generation Service Provider Networks
  
  

* Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C-level and senior engineering leadership.
* Solution Validation & Assurance: Lead end-to-end testing of next-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS-XR 64-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness.
* Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full-scale, high-fidelity customer simulations in world-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment.
* Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity.
* Defect Advocacy & Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution.
* Pre-Sales & Scoping Leadership: Partner with SVS Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Account Teams on pre-sales scoping, developing Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) models, and Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR).
* Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence.

**Decision Making & Scope of Impact**

* Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements.
* Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go-Live success, network availability, multi-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier-1 accounts.
* Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards.

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

* Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies.
* Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR).
* Performance & Scale Validation: Synthesize complex traffic profiles and performance benchmarks utilizing industry-standard hardware traffic generators (Spirent TestCenter, Keysight/Ixia IxNetwork) and WAN impairment tools to validate line-rate throughput, QoS behavior, and failover convergence.
* Automation & Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines.
* Advanced Troubleshooting & RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions.
* Knowledge Transfer & Assets: Champion knowledge sharing by authoring best-practice whitepapers, test methodology playbooks, and reusable test suites to scale delivery efficiency globally.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education & Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10–15+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery.
* Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems.
* Consulting & Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior-level decision makers.
* Certifications: Expert-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing & Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired.
* Software & Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML).
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure environments.

**Preferred Technical Qualifications**
Strong architectural understanding and hands-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas:
  
  

* Service Provider Core & Edge Routing Architectures (Converged SDN Transport & RON):
* Cisco SP Platforms
* Operating Systems
* Core Routing Protocols
* Segment Routing & Traffic Engineering
* Multi-Service VPNs & EVPN
* SP Network Timing & 5G Sync
* Routed Optical Networking (RON)
* SP Resiliency & Security
* SP Automation, Orchestration, Observability & Tooling:
* Cisco pyATS & Genie Test Frameworks
* SP SDN Orchestration & Controllers
* Data Modeling & Interfaces
* Streaming Telemetry & Observability
* Scripting & CI/CD Pipelines
* Test Lab Simulation, Traffic Generation & Telco Cloud:
* Hardware Traffic Generation
* Virtualization & Digital Twin Platforms
* SP Cloud & Telco Infrastructure

**Leadership & Autonomy**

* Self-Direction & Initiative: Operates with high autonomy, determining methods and validation frameworks on strategic, high-visibility customer projects.
* Strategic Advisor: Serves as a trusted technical advisor to leadership and customers, translating strategic technology goals into actionable validation programs.
* Team Leadership: Champions innovation, leading internal initiatives to advance SVS testing capabilities, tooling, and delivery best practices.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Director, Global Network & Systems Design - NSD
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
Director, Global Network & Systems Design (NSD)
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Director, Global Network & Systems Design (NSD) provides strategic and technical leadership for the design, architecture, testing, and delivery of secure, scalable, and reliable network and systems solutions supporting Fluence's global utility-scale energy storage portfolio.
  
  
This role leads a global team of Principal Engineers, Architects, and technical experts responsible for network infrastructure, cybersecurity, SCADA, industrial controls, cloud connectivity, and IT/OT systems integration.
  
  
The Director establishes global engineering standards, technical governance, and architecture strategies while partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery from design through commissioning. Following commissioning, the team supports Services through advanced technical escalation, architectural improvements, documentation, training, and fleet reliability optimization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Global Technical Strategy & Leadership**

* Lead and develop global engineering teams, including Principal Engineers, Architects, and senior technical professionals.
* Establish and execute global NSD strategies, technical roadmaps, engineering standards, and governance processes.
* Oversee resource planning, talent development, technical capabilities, and organizational growth.

**Architecture, Standards & Governance**

* Define and maintain global reference architectures, technical requirements, and engineering standards for network and IT/OT systems.
* Establish secure, standardized solutions for industrial networking, cybersecurity, SCADA, controls integration, cloud connectivity, and system validation.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, grid codes, cybersecurity regulations, and regional standards.
* Lead technical design reviews, quality assessments, and governance of project-specific deviations.

**Project Delivery & Commissioning**

* Provide technical oversight from requirements definition and system design through implementation, testing, and commissioning.
* Partner with regional teams to resolve complex technical issues impacting project delivery, performance, and customer acceptance.
* Establish technical readiness criteria and ensure complete documentation and successful handoff to Services.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for critical technical issues requiring engineering intervention or architectural redesign.

**Service Transition & Lifecycle Support**

* Establish effective technical handoff and escalation processes with global 24/7 Services teams.
* Support complex operational issues, network redesign, and system improvements.
* Drive fleet reliability and optimization through documentation, training, SOP development, and lessons learned.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Services, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Translate customer and regional requirements into scalable global solutions.
* Influence product improvements, communicate technical risks, and support critical customer engagements.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 12+ years of experience in network engineering, systems architecture, IT/OT infrastructure, industrial controls, power systems, or related fields.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing senior engineers, architects, or global technical teams.
* Proven experience designing and delivering complex, mission-critical industrial, energy, or critical infrastructure systems.
* Strong expertise in industrial networking, including routing, switching, segmentation, firewalls, secure connectivity, and high-availability architectures.
* Strong understanding of industrial cybersecurity, SCADA, PLCs, industrial communication protocols, and controls integration.
* Experience developing engineering standards, reference architectures, technical governance, and design review processes.
* Experience overseeing technical delivery through design, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff, including system verification, validation, and UAT.
* Ability to resolve complex technical escalations involving reliability, cybersecurity, safety, and project delivery.
* Strong leadership, executive communication, and stakeholder management skills within global matrix organizations.
* Ability to travel internationally as required.

**Additional Skills**

* Advanced degree in a relevant technical discipline.
* Experience with utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), renewable energy, power generation, substations, transmission and distribution, or grid-connected infrastructure.
* Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity frameworks, including IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, or equivalent regional standards.
* Professional certifications in networking, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or industrial control systems.
* Experience building or scaling global engineering Centers of Excellence and implementing standards across multiple regions.

**Our Culture**
At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
  
  
**Unleash Voices**
We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
  
  
**Customer Fluent**
Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
  
  
**Infinite Impact**
We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
  
  
**All In**
We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.
  
  
*Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
At Fluence, we believe great teams are built on a collaborative and connected culture. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome qualified applicants of all backgrounds. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other status protected by law.*
*Work Authorization
  
  
To join our team, you’ll need to be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout your employment, without the need for employer sponsorship. Please note that Fluence does not sponsor work visas for this position.*
*Warning About Fraudulent Job Postings*
*Please be aware of fraudulent job postings and recruitment-related communications that falsely claim affiliation with Fluence. These scams may be used by cybercriminals to obtain personal information, financial details, or payments from job seekers. Fluence will never request payment, fees, or financial information from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. All official communications from Fluence recruiters and representatives will originate from a legitimate Fluence email address.*

title: Professional Services Consultant- EMEA
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Professional Services Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid, Bangalore role , reporting to the Senior Manager, Professional Services. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical authority for our enterprise customers — architecting, deploying, and optimizing solutions across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and increasingly complex hybrid environments, you will be the expert who turns that complexity into clarity. You bring deep technical depth, a strategic consulting mindset, and the ability to engage equally well with hands-on engineering teams and senior business stakeholders — delivering outcomes that are secure, scalable, and built to last.Work Shift: EMEA time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Own the full technical engagement lifecycle for enterprise customers — from discovery and solution design through deployment, adoption, and continuous optimization
* Architect and integrate ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange across complex, multi-cloud and hybrid enterprise environments including AI-driven workload scenarios
* Lead Zero Trust maturity assessments, technical discovery workshops, and migration planning sessions with customer and partner stakeholders at all levels
* Guide customers on securing modern identity frameworks, SaaS ecosystems, and AI-powered workflows — translating evolving threat landscapes into actionable, platform-led security outcomes
* Partner with sales, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact consultancy and deployment services that accelerate customer time-to-value

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* 6+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles — Professional Services, Security or Network Consulting, Technical Account Management, Escalation Engineering, or SOC operations
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating Zscaler solutions — ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX — across large-scale, complex enterprise environments
* Strong command of modern identity and access frameworks — SAML, SSO/IdP integrations, MFA, conditional access, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles
* Solid foundation across networking and security fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, PAC files, GRE/IPSec tunnels, proxies, and next-generation firewalls
* Working knowledge of AI/ML security concepts — including shadow AI risk, data loss prevention in AI-powered environments, and securing LLM and API-driven workloads

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Hands-on experience securing cloud-native architectures on Azure, AWS, or GCP — including AI/ML pipelines — with practical exposure to SASE, SSE, and converged security frameworks
* Understanding of AI governance, data security posture management (DSPM), and the security implications of enterprise GenAI adoption
* Industry certifications: ZDTA / ZDTE, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent cloud and security credentials

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer
description:

**SITA**
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. * Hands-on experience with load balancers and DNS.
* Experience with application web servers.
* Scripting and automation skills for deployment and provisioning.
* Solid release, change and risk management practices.
* Systems thinking, with the ability to see how complex architectures fit together.
* Clear technical writing and the ability to explain complex topics to customers and non-technical stakeholders.

We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

title: Edge and IOT Architect
description:
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Define and own the end-to-end architecture of enterprise IoT solutions covering edge computing, device connectivity, data ingestion, streaming, cloud platforms, data storage, analytics, APIs and user applications.
* Contribute to the architecture and development of reusable IoT platforms and solutions spanning Edge to Cloud.
* Design scalable, distributed and multi-tenant SaaS platform architectures for IoT products and connected applications.
* Develop, test and integrate cloud Platform-as-a-Service services to build applications accessible through web and mobile interfaces.
* Design and guide the implementation of cloud-native applications and microservices on AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Define appropriate edge-processing patterns, device-management approaches, connectivity protocols and offline or intermittent-connectivity strategies.
* Architect real-time data-ingestion and event-streaming solutions using platforms such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis or Apache Pulsar.
* Design secure and high-performing RESTful, event-driven and public APIs for integration with devices, enterprise systems, partner platforms and third-party applications.
* Work across product, engineering, data, security, DevOps and user-experience teams to integrate platform components through well-defined public and internal APIs.
* Define NoSQL and relational database architectures, including data modelling, indexing, partitioning, retention, performance and scalability considerations.
* Provide hands-on architectural guidance for applications developed using .NET, Golang or Python and modern user-interface frameworks such as React or Angular.
* Establish cloud-infrastructure, observability, reliability, security, deployment and operational architecture standards.
* Define modern CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated-testing and release-management practices suitable for SaaS-based product releases.
* Evaluate technology alternatives, undertake architecture trade-off assessments and create reference architectures, solution blueprints and implementation roadmaps.
* Support technical discovery, solutioning, estimations, proposals, client workshops and architecture governance for strategic IoT and edge-computing opportunities.
* Where applicable, design AI-enabled IoT capabilities using retrieval-augmented generation, machine learning and intelligent analytics architectures.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* Extensive experience designing scalable, distributed and cloud-native enterprise solutions or SaaS products.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end IoT architectures, including devices, gateways, edge computing, connectivity, telemetry ingestion, device management, cloud platforms and applications.
* Hands-on experience architecting and building IoT applications and connected-product platforms.
* Strong experience with cloud infrastructure and managed services on at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with IoT services such as AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud-based IoT patterns or equivalent enterprise IoT platforms.
* Strong understanding of edge-computing architectures, local processing, protocol translation, remote management and edge-to-cloud integration.
* Experience with device and industrial communication protocols such as MQTT, AMQP, HTTP, OPC UA, Modbus or similar protocols.
* Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL database design, data modelling, indexing, partitioning and performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with at least one event-streaming or real-time data platform such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis or Apache Pulsar.
* Strong professional experience developing applications using one or more of .NET, Golang or Python.
* Experience designing and implementing APIs for cloud-native applications, including RESTful and event-driven integration patterns.
* Familiarity with building rich web applications using React or Angular and integrating them with cloud-based backend platforms.
* Good understanding of microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless computing and API-management technologies.
* Familiarity with modern CI/CD, DevSecOps, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing and SaaS release-management practices.
* Knowledge of cloud and IoT security, including device identity, certificate management, authentication, authorization, encryption and secure communications.
* Experience defining high-availability, disaster-recovery, observability, monitoring and operational-support architectures.

title: Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description: Application Consulting - E3 - Project Manager (SAP Experience 3+ years) Scope of Services / Deliverables:
  
  

* Design and implement high-throughput collectors and protocol decoders for NetFlow v5/v9, sFlow, and IPFIX telemetry data ingested from multi-site enterprise network infrastructure.
* Build and maintain flow enrichment pipelines that correlate raw flow records with CMDB, IP to-AS mapping (BGP), GeoIP, VLAN, and application classification data.
* Develop real-time analytics and aggregation engines capable of processing millions of flow records per second with sub-second query latency.
* Create scalable REST and GraphQL APIs to expose traffic insights, trend data, and alerting thresholds to downstream consumers and dashboards.
* Integrate with time-series and columnar data stores (ClickHouse, InfluxDB, Apache Druid) for long-term flow retention, roll-ups, and historical analysis.
* Implement anomaly-detection and traffic baselining algorithms to identify deviations in application, site, or user traffic patterns.
* Collaborate with network engineers to validate flow accuracy, debug protocol discrepancies across vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto), and certify new device onboarding.
* Contribute to the design of multi-tenant architecture, ensuring data isolation and role-based access for enterprise customers with hundreds of network sites.
* Champion engineering best practices through code reviews, technical documentation, and participation in architectural decision records (ADRs). Skills:
* Hands-on experience with UDP/TCP socket programming, binary protocol parsing, and high-throughput data ingestion pipelines.
* Demonstrable experience in a production environment handling NetFlow, sFlow, or IPFIX at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals: OSI model, IP routing, BGP/AS paths, VLAN tagging, QoS markings (DSCP), and NAT traversal as they affect flow records.

title: Client Architect Systems Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:**
392811
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Client Architect Systems Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Client Architect – Managed Services**
Senior client-facing architecture role | Global managed services environment
  
  
Role type: Full-time | Client engagement: Multi-year managed services | Reporting: Client CTO / account technology leadership
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
NTT DATA is a global technology services organisation delivering complex managed services for major enterprises. We are strengthening the architecture capability supporting a multi-hundred-million-euro global managed services agreement, with the role connected into our wider global architecture, engineering, operations and technology communities.
  
  
You will act as a senior technical advisor and Technical Design Authority for an assigned area, translating business requirements, commercial goals and cost-saving initiatives into practical technology solutions. The role combines technology roadmap ownership, architecture governance, design assurance and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on solutions that work sustainably in steady-state ("Day 2") operations.
  
  
This is a technical leadership role within a long-term client partnership. You will lead through influence, shape decisions in joint architecture forums and bring together the right specialists across the organisation. Business as Usual (BAU) support, implementation and project management remain with the appropriate delivery teams.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Act as the ongoing Technical Design Authority for your assigned area, maintaining architectural integrity as the managed environment evolves.
* Build trusted relationships with client technology and business stakeholders, understanding business requirements, commercial objectives and cost-saving priorities and translating them into viable technology solutions.
* Maintain current-state and target-state architecture, technology roadmaps, lifecycle plans and visibility of technical debt, dependencies and obsolescence risk.
* Review and assure High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and material changes for security, resilience, scalability, performance, operability, lifecycle and alignment with agreed standards.
* Drive simplification and standardisation through reusable patterns, reference architectures, approved technology choices and the reduction of variants and exceptions that increase support complexity and managed service cost.
* Use service data, monitoring, capacity, performance and incident trends to identify architecture-led improvements that increase resilience, improve service quality and reduce recurring operational workload.
* Set an ambitious automation agenda with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), engineering and operations teams, using Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations (AIOps) and advanced automation to dramatically reduce manual effort and remove avoidable manual triage, troubleshooting, event correlation and repeatable incident resolution.
* Shape new projects, demands and transformation initiatives with the client through architecture forums, ensuring dependencies, ownership, architectural decisions, supportability and the transition into Day 2 operations are designed from the outset.
* Consider the long-term economics of architecture decisions, including infrastructure rightsizing, licence utilisation, platform rationalisation, support complexity, automation potential and cost-to-serve.
* Represent your area in architecture and governance forums, document significant decisions and ensure cross-domain risks and dependencies are surfaced early and resolved through the appropriate technical leadership.
* Coach and guide technical teams while remaining distinct from routine third- and fourth-line operational support and hands-on implementation.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure, cloud, network, platform or application operations within complex managed services, outsourcing or large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience as a Client Architect, Technical Design Authority, Enterprise Architect, Solution Architect or equivalent senior technical authority for a substantial service estate.
* Deep expertise in at least one relevant technology or service area, combined with sufficient breadth to understand dependencies across infrastructure, networks, security, applications, platforms and operations.
* Strong experience creating and assuring architecture documentation, roadmaps, HLDs, LLDs, standards, reference patterns and technical decision records.
* Strong understanding of Day 2 service concerns including monitoring and observability, capacity, availability, performance, resilience, disaster recovery, patching and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrable experience using automation, observability and AIOps to improve operational outcomes, reduce manual intervention and improve the speed and quality of detection, diagnosis and resolution.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how architecture decisions influence operational effort, licensing, technical debt, transformation priorities and long-term service cost.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to connect business objectives and commercial priorities with technical choices and explain trade-offs clearly to senior client leaders and technical teams.
* Relevant professional-level architecture and technology certifications aligned to your area of expertise are expected, but practical experience, sound judgement and the ability to build trust are more important than certification alone.

**Where you could fit**
We are recruiting several senior Client Architects across major technology domains, including infrastructure and cloud platforms, networks and connectivity, data platforms and middleware, enterprise applications and application platforms, SAP, resilience and data protection, and observability, automation and AIOps. Each role combines deep expertise in a primary domain with enough breadth to understand dependencies across the end-to-end managed service and collaborate effectively with specialists in other towers.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Build trusted relationships with client technology and business leaders, understand their business requirements, commercial goals and cost-saving priorities, and translate them into credible technology solutions and roadmaps.
* Drive technology refresh and transformation by maintaining clear roadmaps, identifying lifecycle risks and technical debt early, and proposing practical plans to address them.
* Lead simplification and standardisation across the technology estate, reducing unnecessary variants, exceptions, support complexity and the operational cost of the managed service.
* Improve service stability and operational performance through architecture-led change, with measurable reductions in recurring incidents and tickets, less manual intervention and faster diagnosis and resolution.
* Shape new projects and demands jointly with the client through architecture forums, ensuring architectural decisions, dependencies, ownership, supportability and transition into Business as Usual (BAU) service are designed in from the outset.

**Why this role**
You will combine the depth of a major client environment with the reach of a large global technology organisation. The role gives you space to build trusted relationships over time, shape significant technology decisions and connect across NTT DATA architecture, engineering, operations and partner communities. You will help make large managed services agreements work globally while building a network and experience that extends well beyond a single account.
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About The Team**
Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.
  
  
The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails.
  
  
**About The Role**
You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away.
  
  
We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating.
  
  
As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work.
  
  
**Products you may work on**
Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions
* Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause
* Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams
* Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky
* Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings
* Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts
* Take part in on-call

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering
* Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo)
* Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd
* Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster
* Scripting in Python, Go or Bash
* Basic Git and CI/CD experience
* Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved
* Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code
* Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again
* Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering
* Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

title: Senior OT Systems Onboarding & Migration Lead Role
description:
**Senior OT Systems Onboarding & Migration Lead**
**Role Overview**
We're looking for an experienced OT professional to lead the assessment, onboarding, and migration planning of operational technology systems into the environment. You'll work with site teams, engineering groups, vendors, and infrastructure specialists to develop practical plans for both new and legacy OT systems, while protecting operational continuity and supporting secure, standardized environments.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead OT system assessments and develop onboarding and migration plans for greenfield and brownfield environments.
* Work with system owners, automation engineers, laboratory managers, manufacturing stakeholders, and vendors to understand system architectures, dependencies, constraints, and readiness.
* Advise sites on migration prerequisites, risks, validation impacts, operational readiness, and execution planning.
* Facilitate workshops to agree onboarding approaches, migration strategies, and target-state architectures.
* Explain requirements to technical and non-technical stakeholders, serving as their primary technical contact throughout onboarding.
* Coordinate with service lines and delivery teams on infrastructure and service needs, including secure networks, segmentation, Active Directory, endpoint protection, remote access, servers, virtualization, storage, and file shares.
* Help resolve technical blockers, service requests, and infrastructure dependencies that affect onboarding schedules.
* Support modernization initiatives such as Windows and domain upgrades, hardware refreshes, virtualization, and network redesign.
* Identify opportunities to reduce cyber risk and technical debt while minimizing disruption to manufacturing, laboratory, and other operational environments.

**Requirements**
**What you'll bring**

title: R&D Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Join Nokia’s engineering team and contribute to building and evolving the next generation of Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (NCOM), focusing on Infrastructure Management.
  
  
NCOM Evo is Nokia’s next-generation, cloud-native operations layer that enables telecom software to run and evolve at scale. It simplifies complex network operations—including packages, clusters, sites, and network functions—through a unified platform that supports design, deployment, upgrades, rollbacks, and observability. The platform combines an Operations Portal with Kubernetes controllers, configuration-as-data, and GitOps-based automation.
  
  
As part of the NCOM Infrastructure Management team, you will contribute to managing the end-to-end lifecycle of infrastructure, including hardware, operating systems, and Kubernetes. You will work on infrastructure configuration, networking, and closed-loop automation, helping streamline operations and improve reliability.
  
  
Working in an Agile engineering environment, you will have the opportunity to write clean, maintainable code, develop new features, and automate infrastructure and cluster deployments that support major telecom operators worldwide.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
As a Senior Software Developer, you will...
  
  

* Architect and implement enterprise-grade GitOps strategies, including declarative state models, multi-cluster reconciliation loops, and automated promotion workflows.
* Design and automate Openshift Container Platform (OCP) lifecycle management, including installation, upgrades, and Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (RH ACM).
* Develop and troubleshoot Kubernetes-based applications, leveraging expertise in Openshift, Docker, and service mesh layers like Istio.
* Build and optimize distributed systems and microservices at scale, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Automate container lifecycle management frameworks, covering secure base image governance, dynamic build pipelines, admission control, runtime orchestration, and ephemeral environment provisioning.
* Integrate AI-driven tools into CI/CD pipelines to automate workflows, including code generation, manifest validation, vulnerability patching, and pull request reviews.
* Debug and resolve issues in Kubernetes clusters, containerized applications, and Go-based services.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence technical decisions and drive innovation in cloud-native distributed systems.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**If you have:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Telecom, or equivalent, with 8+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong software development expertise in Go and Python.
* Proven expertise in Openshift, Docker, helm and Kubernetes, including troubleshooting, administration, and lifecycle management.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitOps), Linux administration, networking, and security.
* Experience designing and running cloud-native distributed systems at scale, with hands-on expertise in service mesh architectures (e.g., Istio).

**It Would Be Nice If You Also Had**

* Cloud certifications in Openshift and at least one public cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Experience with hardware management, including Redfish, UEFI, BIOS/eSW upgrades, GPUs, and Linux administration.
* Hands-on experience with workflow design and development, including CI/CD pipelines and AI-based development workflows.

**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
  
  
Learn more about life at Nokia .

Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. title: Switch Software Engineer
description:
