**Department:**
Software R&D

**Location:**
India

**Experience:**
2+ Years for Software Engineers | 5+ Years for Team Leader

**Positions:**
Multiple Openings

**About the Role**

We are looking for creative, talented, and technically strong Software Engineers and a Software Team Leader to join the
**Edgecore Switch Software R&D Team**
.

The team is responsible for the design, development, integration, and optimization of
**SONiC (Software for Open Networking in the Cloud)**
, one of the world's leading open-source network operating systems.

You will work on enabling SONiC across Edgecore's next-generation high-speed Ethernet switches manufactured by
**Accton**
, a leading Taiwan-based networking OEM company.

This role provides an opportunity to work on advanced networking technologies, including high-performance switching, data center infrastructure, and optimization of AI training traffic between NICs and AI servers.

You will also collaborate with the global SONiC open-source community and engineers from leading technology companies such as Microsoft, Google, NVIDIA, and Cisco. This offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to industry-leading open-source networking projects, solve complex engineering challenges, and develop expertise in next-generation networking technologies.

Based on your experience and technical interests, you may work in one or more of the following domains:

* System / Driver
* PHY / Low-Level Networking
* Layer 2 Protocol
* Layer 3 Protocol
* QoS / Security / Layer 4

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Common Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, debug, integrate, and verify software for SONiC-based networking platforms.
* Maintain and enhance software components for existing and next-generation Ethernet switching products.
* Analyze and troubleshoot complex software and system-level issues.
* Develop product specifications, software design documents, test plans, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Hardware, ASIC, System, QA, Bring-up, Technical Support, and Application teams.
* Participate in software integration, system validation, product bring-up, and troubleshooting activities.
* Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.
* Work closely with global engineering teams and open-source communities.
* Stay updated with emerging networking technologies and industry trends.
* Utilize modern development tools, including AI-assisted software development tools, where appropriate.

**Technical Domains**

Depending on your experience and skill set, you may contribute to one or more of the following areas.

**1. System / Driver / PHY Domain:**

**Responsibilities**

* Study, design, develop, debug, and verify Linux-based drivers for platform peripherals such as SFP, fans, CPLD, FPGA, and switching ASICs.
* Develop and integrate low-level software for networking switch platforms.
* Work on PHY, SerDes, and high-speed networking technologies.
* Analyze and troubleshoot Layer 1 and physical-layer issues.
* Work with transceiver modules such as ZR and LPO.
* Troubleshoot and validate DAC, AEC, and AOC cable technologies.
* Work on emerging technologies such as Link Layer Retry (LLR) and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO).
* Develop and verify PTP (Precision Time Protocol) related drivers and functionality.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to understand platform-specific hardware architecture and configurations.
* Work on Linux-based infrastructure functionalities such as systemd and technical support dump generation.
* Study relevant CVE reports, apply applicable security patches, and verify fixes.
* Work on Xsight XISA / P4-like data-plane programmability related development.
* Perform low-level debugging, system bring-up, and hardware/software integration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in PHY, SerDes, or low-level networking technologies.
* Experience with Linux driver development.
* Knowledge of CPLD/FPGA driver development.
* Experience with transceiver modules and high-speed Ethernet interfaces.
* Knowledge of PTP and embedded system programming.
* Experience with networking ASICs such as Broadcom or Marvell.

**2. Layer 2 Protocol Domain:**

**Responsibilities**

* Study, design, develop, debug, and verify Layer 2 networking protocols and features.
* Develop and maintain Ethernet switching software components.
* Work on Layer 2 technologies such as VLAN, ARP, MAC learning, STP, LAG, and related switching functionality.
* Integrate protocol software with switching ASICs.
* Analyze and troubleshoot packet-processing and protocol-related issues.
* Perform feature integration and system-level validation on SONiC platforms.
* Collaborate with ASIC, hardware, system, QA, and application teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience developing Layer 2 networking protocols.
* Knowledge of VLAN, ARP, MAC learning, STP, LAG, and Ethernet switching.
* Understanding of TCP/IP networking.
* Experience with network programming.
* Experience with Broadcom, Marvell, or other networking ASICs.

**3. Layer 3 Protocol Domain:**

**Responsibilities**

* Study, design, develop, debug, and verify Layer 3 networking protocols and routing functionality.
* Develop and maintain routing software components.
* Work on protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IP routing, ARP, IPv4/IPv6, routing tables, and ECMP.
* Integrate L3 protocol functionality with switching ASICs.
* Analyze and troubleshoot complex routing and networking issues.
* Perform feature integration and system-level validation on SONiC platforms.
* Collaborate with ASIC, hardware, system, QA, and application teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with BGP, OSPF, or other routing protocols.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP.
* Knowledge of IPv4/IPv6, ECMP, routing tables, and packet forwarding.
* Experience with network programming.
* Experience with networking ASICs is an advantage.

**4. QoS / Security / Layer 4 Domain:**

* Design, develop, debug, integrate, and verify QoS and network security features.
* Develop QoS functionalities including:
* RoCE
* COS
* DSCP
* Priority Groups (PG)
* PFC
* ECN
* DiffServ

* 802.1X

* TACACS+

* Develop networking utilities and Layer 4 related features such as:

title: Principal Network Developer
description:
**Job Description**
Designs and develops advanced network systems for scalable enterprise, data center, or cloud-based environments, ensuring alignment with existing infrastructure patterns and collaborating with vendors and internal stakeholders for comprehensive validation. Designs and builds advanced modules within automation frameworks to support testing, operations, and service reliability, automating high-impact network tasks and developing proactive monitoring systems. Designs advanced test strategies and reusable test cases, leading cross-functional collaboration, refining validation methods, and ensuring systems meet compliance and deployment standards. Designs advanced systems for network health monitoring, partners with teams to refine anomaly detection, leads incident response and root cause analysis, and builds efficient tools for frontline support teams. Drives milestone achievements with project managers, mentors junior engineers, leads customer engagements and root cause analysis (RCA) documentation, and ensures integration meets technical standards. Leads network performance analysis to drive scalable improvements and forecasts infrastructure needs for growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Network Design, Development, and Validation:**

* Designs and develops advanced network systems that support scalable enterprise, data center, or cloud environments, ensuring alignment with existing infrastructure patterns.
* Validates production networks and develops scaling strategies for diverse and evolving use cases across systems or services.
* Participates in solution architecture discussions, providing technical guidance on network requirements, tradeoffs, and design decisions.
* Identifies and assesses complex risks in network design and recommends mitigation strategies before deployment.
* Collaborates with vendors and internal stakeholders to align on hardware, firmware, software, and cloud network code requirements.
* Designs playbooks for resolving common and uncommon network issues involving moderately complex systems.
* Analyzes network workflows to identify inefficiencies and proposes scalable solutions to improve performance.

**Automation and Scripting:**

* Designs and builds advanced modules within automation frameworks to support testing, operations, and service reliability across multiple environments.
* Automates high-impact network tasks for production and lab environments, and optimizes repetitive, cross-team workflows to improve operational efficiency.
* Develops and maintains advanced dashboards, telemetry tools, and alerting systems to enable proactive monitoring and faster issue resolution.
* Writes, enhances, and documents reusable scripts that streamline routine network operations across teams and product domains.
* Modifies and extends infrastructure pipelines and configuration management tools to meet evolving requirements using existing playbooks and custom logic.
* Independently configures and extends tools to support new products or services, ensuring alignment with platform standards and integration best practices.

**Testing and Quality Assurance:**

* Designs and develops advanced test strategies and reusable test cases that validate complex network systems and enhance long-term network integrity and reliability.
* Leads team-level test practices and cross-functional collaboration, helping define robust testing protocols and ensuring consistency in execution across environments.
* Implements and refines post-incident validation methods, integrating break-fix outcomes and lessons learned into continuous test improvements.
* Reviews and approves L1 and L2 network changes, and presents high-impact changes to cross-team change management boards, ensuring risks are understood and mitigated.
* Partners with cross-functional teams to drive pre-production validation efforts, ensuring systems and environments meet compliance and deployment-readiness criteria.

**Monitoring and Reliability:**

* Partners with monitoring and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to refine alerting systems and enhance early detection of network anomalies and degradation.
* Leads incident response during support rotations, driving root cause analysis and coordinating cross-team resolution for escalated issues.
* Builds and improves internal tools that enable frontline support teams to efficiently respond to network failures and recurring operational issues.

**Cross-Team Collaboration and Leadership:**

* Drives test and deployment milestones in collaboration with project/program managers, adapting plans to address risks and ensure cross-team alignment.
* Mentors junior engineers and acts as a technical SME, providing hands-on guidance in resolving complex issues.
* Leads customer engagements on technical escalations and delivers clear, actionable root cause analysis (RCA) documentation.
* Influences team-level roadmap and architecture decisions, contributing solutions that align with broader engineering goals.
* Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve standards misalignment, ensuring integration meets technical and operational expectations.

**Performance and Capacity Management:**

* Leads analysis of network performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, packet loss) to identify systemic inefficiencies and drive scalable improvements.
* Forecasts infrastructure needs using performance and capacity data, ensuring systems are prepared for anticipated traffic and service growth.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem-solving strategies.

Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
In the
**HPE Hybrid Cloud**
, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Networking Specialist to join our team focused on software solutions for our VM Essentials customers. This role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing Data Plane layer of the Software Defined Networking (SDN) enhancements to VM Essentials customers in highly scalable, enterprise private cloud-based, distributed architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, and development of the HPE SDN Data Plane for VM Essentials, covering Layer 2/3 networking, distributed routing and switching, overlays, tunneling, and high-performance packet forwarding.
* Define scalable interfaces and programming models across configuration, control, and data planes for routes, next hops, interfaces, VRFs, bridge domains, MAC/IP entries, tunnels, multicast state, and related forwarding objects.
* Design state synchronization, reconciliation, reconnect, warm-restart, upgrade, and recovery mechanisms that preserve forwarding consistency and minimize traffic disruption.
* Extend EVPN, VLAN, VXLAN, MPLS, IPv4/IPv6, bridging, MAC/IP learning, integrated routing and bridging, multi-homing, BUM forwarding, and overlay/underlay capabilities.
* Optimize packet processing with DPDK, Linux networking, SR--IOV, hardware acceleration and interfaces such as veth, virtio, vhost-user, and TAP/TUN.

title: Senior System Software Engineer, Software Defined Networking
description:
We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer, Software Defined Networking to design, build, and operate highly performant and scalable SDN solutions for NVIDIA's AI Clouds hosting GPU-accelerated workloads — including hyperscale multi-node training, inference, cloud gaming, and cloud functions. This role spans the full lifecycle of our SDN stack — from designing and developing new control and data plane software to ensuring operational excellence in production through reliability engineering, CI/CD, observability, and incident response.

* Drive upstream contributions to OVN-Kubernetes and related open-source projects; Develop software for network observability — monitoring, telemetry, intelligent metering, and performance analysis
* Operate and support OVS-OVN based SDN solutions in large-scale NVIDIA AI Cloud environments
* Own end-to-end observability for the SDN stack — build and maintain monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, and dashboarding to ensure real-time insight into network health, performance, and tenant SLAs
* Design, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) across Linux host networking, OVS, OVN, and Kubernetes CNIs
* Implement GitOps approaches or related experience for secure, seamless integration with cloud infrastructure; Drive reliability through incident management, resource monitoring, and performance tuning
* Collaborate with SRE, DevOps, and network engineering teams on production readiness and operational tooling

**What We Need To See**

* BS/MS in Computer Science or related technical field, or a comparable blend of education and relevant experience
* 5+ years of proven experience in software development for large-scale distributed environments
* Expert-level knowledge of OVN, OVS, OpenFlow, and modern network protocols
* Strong programming skills in C and Go; advanced scripting in Bash and Python
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, practical experience deploying and supporting CNIs (OVN-Kubernetes)
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and deployment tools (Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Flux)
* Experience designing and operating complex, multi-stage CI/CD pipelines
* Hands-on experience developing secure, high-performance services using gRPC and REST with TLS and strong authentication
* Strong knowledge of datacenter routing, switching, and Linux host/VM networking

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Contributions to open-source projects (especially OVS, OVN, OVN-Kubernetes, or other Kubernetes networking projects)
* Experience with hardware acceleration (GPU, DPU or equivalent experience) for networking
* Practical experience with major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid/multi-cloud deployments
* SRE/DevOps top-level expertise — on-call, incident management, operations focused on service reliability targets, production ownership
* Experience with observability platforms and tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, ELK)

title: Network Architect
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Position Summary**

Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative **Network Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.

The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. This position serves as the highest level of technical authority for enterprise networking and provides guidance for complex projects, strategic investments, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Network Architecture**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise network architecture roadmap.
* Design highly available, scalable, and secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Cloud and B2B Networking and internet edge solutions.
* Create and maintain high-level and low-level network designs, standards, and reference architectures.
* Evaluate existing environments and recommend improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Establish networking standards and governance for all Candescent locations and hosted environments.

**Cloud & Hybrid Networking**

* Design connectivity solutions for Azure, AWS,GCP (Must Have) and hybrid cloud deployments.
* Define architectures for cloud transit networking, DNS, routing, security segmentation, and application delivery.
* Lead cloud networking initiatives on secure multi-cloud connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams on network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

**Security Architecture & Compliance**

* Partner with Information Security teams to design secure network solutions.
* Develop architectures supporting Zero Trust, network segmentation, NAC, SASE, ZTNA, and secure remote access.
* Ensure designs meet regulatory and compliance requirements including FFIEC, PCI-DSS, SOX, and corporate security standards.
* Provide technical leadership during security assessments, audits, and risk reviews.

**Strategic Leadership**

* Provide architectural oversight for major infrastructure projects.
* Lead technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.
* Influence infrastructure direction through innovation and industry best practices.
* Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence**

* Act as the highest escalation point for complex networking issues.
* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.
* Guide disaster recovery and business continuity planning efforts.
* Ensure infrastructure designs align with operational supportability requirements.

**Automation & Modernization**

* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5+ years designing large-scale, mission-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
  + GCP Networking
  + Cloud and B2B Networking
  + Palo Alto Networks firewalls
  + Meraki Wireless networking technologies
  + SD-WAN solutions
* Strong experience designing:
  + Fortigate Network firewalls
  + Corporate office networks
  + Hybrid cloud connectivity
  + Individual Financial Institution Networks
* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale infrastructure transformation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* Experience with:
  + Cisco Wireless / Meraki
  + Palo Alto Networks & SCM
  + Azure networking
  + AWS networking
  + GCP networking (Must Have)
  + Prisma Access
  + Network automation platforms
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code frameworks.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
* Strong written documentation and presentation skills.

**Certifications (Nice To Have)**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Architect (PCNSA/PCNSE)
* Professional Cloud Network Engineer (PCNE)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

**Success Metrics**

The successful Network Architect will:

* Establish enterprise architecture standards and governance.
* Improve network reliability, resiliency, and security posture.
* Reduce operational complexity through standardization and automation.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Support business growth through scalable network design.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for network strategy across Candescent.

title: Power Management Architect - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

Velaura is designing the compute silicon that powers robots, autonomous systems, and intelligent machines that operate in the physical world—where energy is scarce, thermal headroom is limited, and every milliwatt affects range, runtime, and performance. As Power Management Architect for our Physical AI System-on-Chip (SoC), you will own the power architecture of our silicon: defining how the chip delivers, distributes, and manages energy across compute, AI/NPU, memory, and I/O so that our platforms hit their performance targets within tight power and thermal budgets.

This is a foundational, cross-cutting role spanning silicon, firmware, platform software, and product teams. You will set Velaura’s power management strategy from the earliest architecture phase through tape-out and production—shaping power delivery, voltage and frequency scaling, low-power states, and the hardware/software control that keeps Physical AI systems efficient in the field.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the SoC power architecture: define power domains, voltage/frequency (DVFS) strategy, power states, and the power delivery network across Velaura’s Physical AI silicon roadmap.
* Define dynamic and static power management techniques including clock and power gating, adaptive voltage scaling, body biasing, and retention strategies, to maximize performance-per-watt for AI and real-time workloads.
* Establish power and energy budgets and model them across use cases; drive power, performance, and area (PPA) trade-offs with architecture, design, and product teams.
* Architect the on-die power management and control subsystem—PMIC interface, power management controller, sensors, and telemetry—and the firmware/software policies that drive it.
* Partner with silicon design, firmware, thermal, package, and platform software teams to embed power intent (e.g., UPF) into the design flow and validate it through implementation and silicon bring-up.
* Define power and thermal management for sustained real-world operation, including thermal throttling, energy-aware scheduling, and safe operating limits.
* Establish power architecture standards, modeling methodology, and review practices; mentor engineers and raise the power-engineering bar across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8+ years in power management, mixed-signal, or SoC architecture, with significant experience defining power architecture for shipping silicon or embedded platforms.
* Deep expertise in low-power design techniques: multiple power domains, DVFS, clock/power gating, adaptive voltage scaling, retention, and power state management.
* Strong understanding of power delivery networks, PMICs, voltage regulation, and the interaction between power, thermal, and package constraints.
* Hands-on experience with power intent and low-power methodology (e.g., UPF/CPF) and with power modeling and analysis across the SoC design flow.
* Experience working across silicon design, firmware, and platform software to define and validate power management policies from architecture through silicon bring-up.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing technical direction and mentoring engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience optimizing power for AI/ML accelerators or NPUs and for real-time or latency-sensitive edge workloads.
* Familiarity with robotics, automotive, mobile, or other power- and thermally-constrained domains, and with battery and energy-storage considerations.
* Experience with energy-aware software/firmware, thermal management, and silicon power characterization and correlation.
* Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth semiconductor or hardware company, building power architecture and methodology from the ground up.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

At Velaura, we believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional rewards. Compensation for this role includes a base salary and very competitive equity compensation, allowing team members to share in the company’s long-term success.

The base pay listed represents a good faith estimate that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will depend on multiple factors, including the candidate's skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and geographic location.

In addition to base salary and equity compensation, Velaura offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; flexible work arrangements; professional development opportunities; and other benefits designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

Velaura is committed to pay equity and transparency and regularly benchmarks compensation to ensure we remain competitive in the market.

**Why Velaura?**
----------------

Velaura is building next-generation compute technology for cloud, edge, and Physical AI. Our solutions will enable robots, autonomous systems, drones, and other intelligent machines to operate efficiently in the physical world.  
This is an opportunity to help build foundational technology at a time when the industry is undergoing fundamental change. You will work alongside experienced leaders, architects, engineers, and operators who have delivered industry-defining products across mobile, cloud, semiconductor, and AI platforms. If you enjoy solving difficult problems, working across disciplines, and helping shape the future of Physical AI, we would love to hear from you.

**Equal Employment Opportunity and Accommodations**
---------------------------------------------------

Velaura is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. title: Systems Integration Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:** 393048
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Senior Specialist to join our team in Bangalore, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description
  
  
**About this role:**  
Wells Fargo is seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead technical research, design, coding, implementation, and execution for Research and Systems Engineering (RSE). This role is ideal for a senior engineer who can move from strategy and architecture into working code, technical prototypes, test environments, and proof-of-concept solutions. The Principal Engineer will evaluate emerging technologies by building and testing them, determine how they can operate within Wells Fargo’s available platforms, architecture, security, risk, infrastructure, and engineering constraints, and provide expert recommendations grounded in direct technical evidence.
  
  
In this role, you’ll be expected to personally develop prototypes, write and review code, design technical solutions, configure and integrate technologies, execute tests, troubleshoot issues, and document findings. You’ll work closely with architects, platform owners, security and risk partners, and engineering teams to understand what is currently available within Wells Fargo, identify gaps or limitations, and determine whether a technology can be adopted, adapted, integrated, or should not move forward. Success requires strong engineering depth, curiosity, disciplined experimentation, sound technical judgment, and the ability to convert proof-of-concept results into practical implementation guidance.
  
  
**In this role, you will:**  

* Lead hands-on design, coding, configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation for RSE research and proof-of-concept initiatives.
* Build working prototypes and reference implementations that validate technical feasibility, integration requirements, performance, security, resiliency, operability, and enterprise applicability.
* Write production-quality or near-production-quality code, automation, APIs, scripts, infrastructure definitions, test harnesses, and integration components needed to evaluate new technologies.
* Design and execute structured proofs of concept with defined technical questions, success criteria, assumptions, test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and measurable results.
* Install, configure, and test emerging technologies in approved environments using the platforms, tools, services, access models, and infrastructure available within Wells Fargo.
* Evaluate how proposed technologies align with Wells Fargo architecture, engineering standards, security controls, risk requirements, network patterns, identity and access models, data requirements, observability capabilities, and support processes.
* Identify technical gaps, constraints, integration challenges, required exceptions, operational impacts, and dependencies that may affect enterprise adoption.
* Provide expert, evidence-based recommendations on whether a technology should be adopted, adapted, integrated with existing capabilities, further tested, or not pursued.
* Translate proof-of-concept outcomes into implementable designs, reference patterns, reusable code, technical decision records, test evidence, runbooks, and engineering guidance.
* Partner with architects to validate target-state designs and ensure proposed patterns can be implemented within existing enterprise capabilities and constraints.
* Work directly with engineering teams to demonstrate solutions, resolve implementation issues, review code and designs, and guide the transition from experimental work to supported delivery.
* Guide platforms toward standard implementation models by developing reusable components, common APIs, automation patterns, integration approaches, and reference configurations.
* Perform technical comparisons of products, frameworks, platforms, and architectural approaches using repeatable evaluation criteria and hands-on testing.
* Conduct performance, scalability, reliability, failure, security, interoperability, and operational-readiness testing appropriate to the technology being evaluated.
* Prototype and evaluate capabilities across RSE focus areas, including artificial intelligence, accelerated computing, GPU infrastructure, integration services, automation, operating systems, image lifecycle, OpenShift, platform engineering, and modernization technologies.
* Lead technical execution across the full experimentation lifecycle, from research and environment setup through design, build, test, findings, recommendation, and transition.
* Create clear white papers, opinion papers, executive briefs, architecture diagrams, code examples, test results, and technical recommendations based on hands-on findings.
* Mentor engineers through pairing, code and design reviews, technical workshops, demonstrations, and practical implementation guidance.
* Anticipate technical obstacles, lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, and make informed tradeoffs across feasibility, business value, risk, cost, delivery speed, and long-term sustainability.
* Stay current on emerging engineering technologies and continuously test their relevance against Wells Fargo’s current and future enterprise ecosystem.

**Required Qualifications:**  

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
* 7+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience.
* 7+ years of hands-on software development, systems engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or architecture implementation experience.
* 5+ years designing, coding, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting complex enterprise applications, platforms, infrastructure services, or distributed systems.
* 5+ years creating technical prototypes, proofs of concept, reference implementations, automation, or reusable engineering components.
* Experience evaluating new technologies within enterprise architecture, security, risk, infrastructure, operational, and support constraints.
* Experience developing in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent languages.
* Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, APIs, infrastructure automation, observability, and technical documentation.
* In-depth knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies, including cloud, virtualization, containers, operating systems, networking, storage, security, automation, or distributed systems.

**Desired Qualifications:**  

* Demonstrated ability to independently take an emerging technology from initial research through environment setup, coding, integration, testing, evaluation, and documented recommendation.
* Experience building proof-of-concept solutions using Kubernetes, OpenShift, cloud or hybrid infrastructure, artificial intelligence platforms, GPU or accelerated computing, automation frameworks, operating systems, or platform services.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, CI/CD, containers, image pipelines, policy automation, telemetry, and platform integration patterns.
* Experience designing test plans and executing functional, integration, performance, scalability, reliability, failure, security, and operational-readiness testing.
* Ability to assess technical feasibility and enterprise fit using direct evidence rather than vendor claims or conceptual analysis alone.
* Experience producing reusable code, reference designs, technical decision records, implementation guidance, runbooks, white papers, and executive recommendations.
* Ability to explain constraints and tradeoffs clearly to architects, engineers, product partners, risk stakeholders, platform owners, and senior leaders.
* Strong code review, design review, debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Strong mentoring and technical leadership skills, including pairing with engineers and leading practical workshops or demonstrations.
* A hands-on research and engineering mindset with a focus on practical experimentation, disciplined execution, enterprise compatibility, and measurable technical outcomes.

title: Senior Engineer - QA
description:
### **Description**

We are looking for a Senior Automation Test Engineer with strong expertise in test automation, API testing, and performance and load testing to help us build reliable, scalable, and high-quality software.

In this role, you will take ownership of automation and performance testing for assigned product areas. You will design and maintain automated test suites, develop performance test scenarios, analyse system behaviour under different workloads, and work closely with developers to identify bottlenecks and improve application reliability.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong programming skills with practical performance engineering experience. You should be comfortable working independently, investigating complex failures, and translating test results into actionable insights.

The role also requires regular collaboration with our US-based counterparts. Candidates should be comfortable attending meetings during evening hours in India to support cross-functional planning, technical discussions, and project execution.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Test Automation:** Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test suites using Python and frameworks such as Robot Framework, PyTest, and Playwright.
* **API Testing:** Own automation for REST APIs, including functional, integration, contract, negative, authentication, and end-to-end scenarios.
* **Performance and Load Testing:** Design, develop, and execute performance, load, stress, and endurance tests to evaluate application behaviour under varying workloads.
* **Performance Test Scripting:** Build and maintain reusable performance test scripts using tools such as Locust, JMeter, or k6, with a strong emphasis on code-driven performance testing.
* **Performance Analysis:** Analyse response times, throughput, error rates, resource utilisation, and latency percentiles to identify bottlenecks and performance degradation.
* **Root Cause Investigation:** Collaborate with developers and infrastructure teams to investigate performance issues across APIs, services, databases, and distributed systems.
* **Performance Benchmarking:** Establish performance baselines, define measurable acceptance criteria, compare results across releases, and identify regressions before production deployment.
* **CI/CD Integration:** Integrate functional automation and performance smoke tests into CI/CD pipelines, enabling early detection of regressions and faster feedback.
* **Framework Engineering:** Improve automation framework architecture, reusable libraries, test data management, parallel execution, reporting, and test reliability.
* **Test Strategy and Planning:** Define test coverage and approaches for new features, identify quality risks early, and determine appropriate functional and non-functional testing requirements.
* **Troubleshooting and Debugging:** Investigate complex failures using application logs, API traces, monitoring dashboards, and performance test reports.
* **Code Reviews and Mentoring:** Review automation code, promote coding standards, share technical knowledge, and support the development of junior engineers.
* **Quality Reporting:** Communicate test coverage, automation health, performance trends, bottlenecks, and release risks through clear, actionable reports.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with developers, product managers, DevOps, and US-based engineering counterparts to align on quality goals and delivery priorities.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation, including substantial experience with API automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python or Java, with the ability to develop clean, reusable, and maintainable test code.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one automation framework, such as Robot Framework, PyTest, or Playwright.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP protocols, authentication, schema validation, and integration testing.
* **Strong practical experience in performance and load testing**, including designing workloads, executing tests, interpreting results, and investigating performance bottlenecks.
* Hands-on experience with at least one performance testing tool such as Locust, Apache JMeter, or k6.
* Understanding of key performance metrics, including response time, throughput, requests per second, error rate, concurrent users, and p90/p95/p99 latency.
* Experience analysing performance test results and correlating application behaviour with logs, monitoring metrics, database activity, or infrastructure resource utilisation.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Proficiency with Git, including branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to cross-functional stakeholders.
* **Willingness and availability to attend regular meetings with US-based counterparts during evening hours in India**, depending on team and project requirements.
* Ability to work onsite in Bengaluru.

* Experience building or significantly enhancing automation frameworks from scratch.
* Experience with performance testing of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, or cloud-hosted applications.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or equivalent.
* Experience investigating performance issues involving databases, connection pools, caching, queues, or network latency.
* Experience using Docker and Kubernetes for test execution or environment management.
* Experience optimising test execution through parallelisation and reliable CI/CD integration.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical decisions within a QA team.

### **About Brivo**

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.  
  
As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.  
  
With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.  
  
*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 393047
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description
  
  
**About this role:**  
Wells Fargo is seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead technical research, design, coding, implementation, and execution for Research and Systems Engineering (RSE). This role is ideal for a senior engineer who can move from strategy and architecture into working code, technical prototypes, test environments, and proof-of-concept solutions. The Principal Engineer will evaluate emerging technologies by building and testing them, determine how they can operate within Wells Fargo’s available platforms, architecture, security, risk, infrastructure, and engineering constraints, and provide expert recommendations grounded in direct technical evidence.
  
  
In this role, you’ll be expected to personally develop prototypes, write and review code, design technical solutions, configure and integrate technologies, execute tests, troubleshoot issues, and document findings. You’ll work closely with architects, platform owners, security and risk partners, and engineering teams to understand what is currently available within Wells Fargo, identify gaps or limitations, and determine whether a technology can be adopted, adapted, integrated, or should not move forward. Success requires strong engineering depth, curiosity, disciplined experimentation, sound technical judgment, and the ability to convert proof-of-concept results into practical implementation guidance.
  
  
**In this role, you will:**  

* Lead hands-on design, coding, configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation for RSE research and proof-of-concept initiatives.
* Build working prototypes and reference implementations that validate technical feasibility, integration requirements, performance, security, resiliency, operability, and enterprise applicability.
* Write production-quality or near-production-quality code, automation, APIs, scripts, infrastructure definitions, test harnesses, and integration components needed to evaluate new technologies.
* Design and execute structured proofs of concept with defined technical questions, success criteria, assumptions, test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and measurable results.
* Install, configure, and test emerging technologies in approved environments using the platforms, tools, services, access models, and infrastructure available within Wells Fargo.
* Evaluate how proposed technologies align with Wells Fargo architecture, engineering standards, security controls, risk requirements, network patterns, identity and access models, data requirements, observability capabilities, and support processes.
* Identify technical gaps, constraints, integration challenges, required exceptions, operational impacts, and dependencies that may affect enterprise adoption.
* Provide expert, evidence-based recommendations on whether a technology should be adopted, adapted, integrated with existing capabilities, further tested, or not pursued.
* Translate proof-of-concept outcomes into implementable designs, reference patterns, reusable code, technical decision records, test evidence, runbooks, and engineering guidance.
* Partner with architects to validate target-state designs and ensure proposed patterns can be implemented within existing enterprise capabilities and constraints.
* Work directly with engineering teams to demonstrate solutions, resolve implementation issues, review code and designs, and guide the transition from experimental work to supported delivery.
* Guide platforms toward standard implementation models by developing reusable components, common APIs, automation patterns, integration approaches, and reference configurations.
* Perform technical comparisons of products, frameworks, platforms, and architectural approaches using repeatable evaluation criteria and hands-on testing.
* Conduct performance, scalability, reliability, failure, security, interoperability, and operational-readiness testing appropriate to the technology being evaluated.
* Prototype and evaluate capabilities across RSE focus areas, including artificial intelligence, accelerated computing, GPU infrastructure, integration services, automation, operating systems, image lifecycle, OpenShift, platform engineering, and modernization technologies.
* Lead technical execution across the full experimentation lifecycle, from research and environment setup through design, build, test, findings, recommendation, and transition.
* Create clear white papers, opinion papers, executive briefs, architecture diagrams, code examples, test results, and technical recommendations based on hands-on findings.
* Mentor engineers through pairing, code and design reviews, technical workshops, demonstrations, and practical implementation guidance.
* Anticipate technical obstacles, lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, and make informed tradeoffs across feasibility, business value, risk, cost, delivery speed, and long-term sustainability.
* Stay current on emerging engineering technologies and continuously test their relevance against Wells Fargo’s current and future enterprise ecosystem.

**Required Qualifications:**  

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
* 7+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience.
* 7+ years of hands-on software development, systems engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or architecture implementation experience.
* 5+ years designing, coding, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting complex enterprise applications, platforms, infrastructure services, or distributed systems.
* 5+ years creating technical prototypes, proofs of concept, reference implementations, automation, or reusable engineering components.
* Experience evaluating new technologies within enterprise architecture, security, risk, infrastructure, operational, and support constraints.
* Experience developing in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent languages.
* Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, APIs, infrastructure automation, observability, and technical documentation.
* In-depth knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies, including cloud, virtualization, containers, operating systems, networking, storage, security, automation, or distributed systems.

**Desired Qualifications:**  

* Demonstrated ability to independently take an emerging technology from initial research through environment setup, coding, integration, testing, evaluation, and documented recommendation.
* Experience building proof-of-concept solutions using Kubernetes, OpenShift, cloud or hybrid infrastructure, artificial intelligence platforms, GPU or accelerated computing, automation frameworks, operating systems, or platform services.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, CI/CD, containers, image pipelines, policy automation, telemetry, and platform integration patterns.
* Experience designing test plans and executing functional, integration, performance, scalability, reliability, failure, security, and operational-readiness testing.
* Ability to assess technical feasibility and enterprise fit using direct evidence rather than vendor claims or conceptual analysis alone.
* Experience producing reusable code, reference designs, technical decision records, implementation guidance, runbooks, white papers, and executive recommendations.
* Ability to explain constraints and tradeoffs clearly to architects, engineers, product partners, risk stakeholders, platform owners, and senior leaders.
* Strong code review, design review, debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Strong mentoring and technical leadership skills, including pairing with engineers and leading practical workshops or demonstrations.
* A hands-on research and engineering mindset with a focus on practical experimentation, disciplined execution, enterprise compatibility, and measurable technical outcomes.

title: Software Design Engineer - LabVIEW
description:
**Role Summary:**

This position is responsible for software development of new products, with emphasis on user interfaces and device communication for wired and wireless industrial communication networks. The role also develops modular, scalable LabVIEW applications and integrates software with industrial hardware and test systems.

**Principle accountabilities:**

1. Design and code modular, scalable LabVIEW applications using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), state machines, and producer-consumer architectures.

2. Interface LabVIEW software with NI DAQ devices, PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, electronic testers, and laboratory instruments.

3. Implement industrial communication protocols, including Modbus, HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, OPC, FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, and FDI, as applicable.

4. Develop automated test equipment (ATE), functional end-of-line test benches, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems.

5. Develop, test, and debug software code using contemporary tools and techniques.

6. Support the preparation of design documents, artifacts, and work products.

7. Work across all phases of the software development lifecycle.

8. Work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating with senior-level engineers who provide guidance on assigned tasks.

9. Continually update technical knowledge and skills.

**Educational Qualification & Experience:**

1. Bachelor’s degree **in electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Instrumentation Technology.**

2. Experience in software development for the Industrial Automation domain preferred; experience with FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, OPC, and FDI is an advantage.

3. Experience in device description (EDDL) and device type manager (DTM) development.

4. Experience with LabVIEW application development and industrial test/measurement systems is preferred.

**Competencies and Skills:**

1. Knowledge of programming languages and technologies: C++, VC++, C#, JavaScript, SQL, XML, and EDDL.

2. Knowledge of **industrial communication protocols**, including HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, Modbus, and OPC.

3. Knowledge of software concepts and frameworks: OOP, COM (MFC/ATL), and .NET (WPF/WCF).

4. Familiarity with software tools such as TFS, Subversion, MS SQL, and SQL Server.

5. Knowledge of LabVIEW is preferred.

6. Knowledge of distributed control systems and/or programmable logic controllers is an advantage.

7. Knowledge of microprocessor architecture, peripherals, and related analog/digital circuitry is an advantage.

8. Fast learner, able to work independently within a team.

9. Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and respect deadlines.

10. Customer-focused with good analytical and problem-solving skills.

11. Excellent oral and written communication skills.

title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:**  
–Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers.
  
–Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers.
  
–Implement scalability requirements for assigned components.
  
–Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
–Execute performance and load testing, with guidance.
  
**System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:**  
–Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
–Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs.
  
–Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance
  
**System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:**  
–Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures.
  
–Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance.
  
–Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
  
**System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:**  
–Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
  
–Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance.
  
–Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
**Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:**

title: Senior Principal - RTE
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Release Train Engineer is a servant leader and delivery coach for the Agile Release Train delivering GSK's network and connectivity platforms, applying SAFe practices within GSK's Technology operating model to coordinate the flow of value across the teams building and running those platforms. Operating consistently with the BCG platform operating model, the role treats the platform as a product delivered by a durable, cross-functional team, and is accountable for facilitating Programme Increment planning, coordinating dependencies and risks across teams, and driving predictable, high quality delivery through Agile ceremonies, flow metrics and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilitate Programme Increment planning and Agile Release Train execution**

* Plan, prepare and facilitate PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt workshops and other Agile Release Train events for the platform's teams.
* Coordinate Scrum of Scrums, ART sync and cross-team ceremonies to maintain alignment on scope, sequencing and delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Build and maintain the ART's Programme Board, tracking major milestones, cross-team dependencies and feature delivery against the Programme Increment.
* Support Product Management and Product Owners in refining the Programme Backlog and preparing content for Planning Interval events.

**Manage dependencies, risks and impediments across the train**

* Identify, track and resolve cross-team and cross-platform dependencies and risks using ROAM (Resolved, Owned, Accepted, Mitigated).
* Escalate and remove impediments to flow that individual teams cannot resolve themselves, including supplier, platform or portfolio level blockers.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Solution Train Engineers and Platform Managers to sequence work across dependent platforms and domains.

**Drive flow, predictability and continuous improvement**

* Track and report flow metrics including velocity, programme predictability, cycle time and quality trends, and use them to drive improvement actions.
* Coach teams, Scrum Masters and Product Owners in Lean-Agile and SAFe practices, building local capability rather than acting as a single point of control.
* Partner with Portfolio, Solution and Platform stakeholders to continuously improve the ART's ways of working, tooling and use of automation or AI-assisted delivery practices.

**Key Relationships/Customers**

**Business Stakeholders**

* Product teams and business technology groups whose network or platform capability delivery depends on a predictable, well coordinated Agile Release Train.
* Business service owners and key users where delivery sequencing, dependencies or timelines affect service quality or adoption.
* Business service owners and key users where engineering quality, resilience or change risk directly affects business outcomes.

**Tech Stakeholders**

* Product Owners, Scrum Masters/Team Coaches, Principal Engineers and Platform Managers for the teams on the train.
* Solution Train Engineers, other Release Train Engineers, Domain Portfolio Managers and Platform Architects across dependent platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Reliability Engineering and Operations Excellence where dependencies or risks touch their domains.
* Reliability Engineering, Operations Excellence, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Quality and Compliance teams.
* Modern Engineering, DevSecOps, Observability, Automation Acceleration Hub, Automation Acceleration team and Agile/Delivery governance teams.

**Other**

* Strategic partners, managed service providers, system integrators and specialist suppliers whose teams participate in or are coordinated by the Agile Release Train.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience delivering Agile technology programmes.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (or Advanced RTE) certification, or a recognised equivalent, is expected.
* Additional Agile certifications such as SAFe Program Consultant, Certified ScrumMaster or PMI-ACP support the role but do not replace demonstrated RTE experience.
* Relevant examples may include SAFe, Scrum/Agile, ITIL, Lean Portfolio Management or programme and change management qualifications.
* For regulated or GxP-impacting platforms, awareness of applicable quality, validation and compliance expectations is desirable.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Deep knowledge of SAFe practices, including Programme Increment planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt, ART sync and flow based metrics.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled delivery tooling, including responsible use for backlog analysis, reporting and dependency tracking.
* Understanding of platform operating models and product-aligned delivery across engineering teams.

**Related Experience Required**

* Significant experience facilitating Agile Release Trains or large scale agile delivery using the SAFe framework.
* Proven experience coordinating dependencies, risks and impediments across multiple teams, suppliers or platforms.
* Experience facilitating Programme Increment planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt and other core Agile Release Train events.
* Experience using flow metrics such as velocity, predictability and cycle time to drive delivery improvement.
* Experience coaching teams, Scrum Masters and Product Owners in Lean-Agile practices without acting as a single point of control.
* Significant experience coordinating Agile delivery across multiple technology teams or a release train.
* Strong capability in Planning Interval facilitation, dependency and risk management, coaching, and flow metrics.
* Evidence of improving delivery predictability, cycle time, quality or stakeholder alignment.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Release Train Engineer qualification, such as SAFe Release Train Engineer.
* Experience coordinating network or infrastructure transformation delivery.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, portfolio tools or AI assisted delivery practices.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong facilitation and conflict-resolution skills, able to align teams and stakeholders without formal authority.
* Ability to interpret flow, quality and delivery metrics and convert insight into improvement actions.
* Skilled at managing risk and dependency logs (ROAM) and escalating effectively when blockers cannot be resolved at team level.
* Strong stakeholder management across business, technology and supplier organisations.
* Commitment to continuous learning, AI fluency and adoption of modern Agile and delivery tooling.

**Skills**

Agile Coaching, Arts Facilitation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Defense Management, Flow Meter, IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence

* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response

* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect Voice
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's voice and unified communications platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.
