title: Dist Engr-AI Science
description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

We are seeking a visionary **Distinguished Engineer, AI Science** to lead the technical strategy, research, and development of our next-generation AI architecture focused on Customer Base Management (CVM). As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be the foremost technical authority in the organization, driving the evolution from traditional machine learning to advanced Agentic, Predictive, and Prescriptive AI systems.

You will design autonomous, AI-driven engines that maximize the lifetime value of our customer base, architecting systems that not only predict customer behavior but prescribe dynamic, real-time interventions and execute them autonomously via multi-agent frameworks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Visionary Technical Leadership & AI Strategy**

* Serve as the chief technical architect and visionary for all AI science initiatives related to Base Management, Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), churn mitigation, and cross-sell/upsell monetization.
* Define the multi-year roadmap for integrating Agentic AI (autonomous agents, LLM-driven decision engines) into our core base management platforms.
* Bridge the gap between foundational AI research and enterprise-scale commercial impact, advising C-level executives on AI investments and technology bets.

**2. Advanced AI Modeling & Agentic Architecture**

* **Agentic AI:** Architect multi-agent systems and LLM-backed autonomous pipelines capable of executing complex customer lifecycle interventions without human-in-the-loop dependencies.
* **Predictive AI:** Oversee the development of state-of-the-art predictive models (deep learning, sequence modeling, probabilistic models) for extreme-accuracy forecasting of churn, propensity, and customer lifecycle events.
* **Prescriptive AI:** Design large-scale optimization and reinforcement learning (RL) engines that determine the "Next Best Action" (NBA), Next Best Offer (NBO), and dynamic pricing strategies in real-time.
* Pioneer the use of Generative AI for hyper-personalized base communication, ensuring safety, compliance, and brand alignment within agentic workflows.

**3. Base Management Innovation**

* Transform traditional Customer Value Management (CVM) into a continuous, real-time, AI-native discipline.
* Develop scalable algorithms for causal inference and uplift modeling to ensure AI interventions generate true incremental value (A/B testing at scale).
* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations leaders to deploy AI solutions that fundamentally alter the economics of customer retention and growth.

**4. Mentorship & Eminence**

* Act as a technical mentor and sponsor for Principal Scientists, Senior Machine Learning Engineers, and Data Scientists across the organization.
* Drive a culture of engineering and scientific excellence, establishing rigorous standards for model validation, MLOps, AI safety, and ethical AI.
* Represent the company in the broader AI community through conference presentations, whitepapers, open-source contributions, and patent filings.

### **Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a closely related highly quantitative field.
* **Experience:** 12+ years of applied R&D experience in AI/ML, with at least 5+ years in a senior technical leadership role (Principal Engineer, Chief Scientist, or equivalent).
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep understanding of Base Management, Customer Value Management (CVM), algorithmic marketing, and lifecycle optimization.
* **Technical Mastery:**Expertise in **Predictive AI** (Deep Learning, NLP, Time-Series forecasting, Graph Neural Networks).Expertise in **Prescriptive AI** (Reinforcement Learning, Contextual Bandits, Mathematical Optimization, Operations Research).Cutting-edge knowledge of **Agentic AI** (LLMs, LangChain/LlamaIndex, multi-agent frameworks like AutoGen, tool-augmented language models).
* **Engineering Prowess:** Proven track record of architecting and deploying ultra-low latency, high-throughput AI systems into production. Fluency in Python, C++, or similar, and deep familiarity with scalable cloud architectures (AWS/GCP/Azure) and MLOps platforms.
* **Impact:** Demonstrable history of driving hundreds of millions of dollars in enterprise value through the application of AI to customer bases.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Recognized industry eminence (e.g., highly cited publications at NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, ACL, or strong portfolio of impactful patents).
* Experience transitioning legacy rule-based business logic systems into fully autonomous RL or Agentic AI decision engines.
* Deep expertise in Causal ML and Double Machine Learning for uplift modeling.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is expanding across existing and new regions. Our Networking organization builds systems that manage Internet and backbone traffic, mitigate congestion, and reduce customer impact while enabling network operations to scale efficiently.

The Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer mentors engineering teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. This role identifies and eliminates performance and scalability bottlenecks for hyperscale workloads, defines scalability requirements with stakeholders, and designs elastic, high-impact systems while driving innovation in data plane platforms.

We are seeking a Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer to define technical direction and lead the development of highly available, scalable network control, intelligent routing and automation systems. You will combine deep networking knowledge with software and distributed systems expertise to connect real-time observability with safe, automated routing decisions.

Your work will span autonomous traffic management, policy-driven network optimization, and software-based routing infrastructure. You will identify performance and scalability bottlenecks, define requirements with stakeholders, and design resilient services that protect customer connectivity during growth, failures, and infrastructure changes.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad architectural influence. Based in IDC alongside the engineering team, you will lead initiatives from design through production operations, contribute to critical implementations, and establish standards for availability, security, observability, and safe deployment. You will collaborate across engineering and operations teams while mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy and architecture for scalable routing, network control, and automation systems.
* Design algorithms and distributed services for route computation, congestion management, traffic steering, fault isolation, and recovery.
* Correlate network and infrastructure signals to assess customer impact and enable safe automated responses.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize capacity, resource utilization, routing convergence, and behavior under heavy load.
* Architect and build highly available, fault-tolerant systems with reliable state management, replication, automated failover, and recovery.
* Define service-level objectives, operational KPIs, telemetry, monitoring, and alerting for service health and routing outcomes.
* Establish simulation, scale testing, phased migrations, in-service upgrades, verification, and rollback practices.
* Lead production troubleshooting, incident response, and root-cause analysis; establish runbooks and drive reliability improvements.
* Integrate security controls, auditability, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Contribute production-quality code, review designs and implementations, and maintain architecture and operational documentation.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define technical strategy and deliver high-impact initiatives.
* Mentor senior engineers, influence architectural direction, and promote engineering excellence through technical leadership, hiring, and knowledge sharing.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of relevant experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, network control planes, or network automation platforms.
* Strong Linux systems and networking knowledge, including containers, process and memory behavior, network namespaces, resource isolation, and packet-level troubleshooting.
* Experience designing highly available distributed services with reliable state management, observability, overload protection, and failure recovery.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and delivery across teams, resolve ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs, and mentor senior engineers.
* Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking, routing and switching, software-defined networking, traffic engineering, and WAN technologies.
* Strong expertise in BGP and MP-BGP, IPv4/IPv6, route reflection, routing policy, and VPN address families, including practical experience with convergence and reachability troubleshooting.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++, with experience in API design, concurrency, automated testing, and production debugging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production expertise with Junos and Juniper cRPD or comparable virtualized routing platforms.
* Experience with BGP Add-Path, Optimal Route Reflection (ORR), Prefix Independent Convergence (BGP-PIC), route-flap damping, and large-scale routing tables.
* Knowledge of MPLS, RSVP-TE, PCEP, bandwidth reservation, latency-aware routing, and shared-risk link groups.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists

* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

title: Senior Principal - Automation / Prompt / Agent Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Automation Architect owns the technical design of a DPTF platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. Platforms span cloud, network and digital workplace domains, and the specific platform is set on appointment.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Key Relationships/Customers**

Business Stakeholders

* Business stakeholders sponsoring platform capability with architectural consequence
* Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

Tech Stakeholders

  

* Platform Architecture Director as owner of domain target architecture
* Platform engineering teams applying the patterns and standards
* Product Owner and Platform Manager for roadmap and backlog consequence
* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Architects for enterprise alignment
* Information Security and Reliability Engineering for security and resilience standards

Others

  

* Managed service partners whose solution designs must meet platform architecture standards
* Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Job Experience:**

  

* Typically 15 + years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Hands-on experience architecting and building AI/agentic systems — LLMs, evaluation pipelines, ML lifecycle — at production scale.
* Experience assessing data readiness (availability, quality, access, labeling) and flagging risks before builds start.
* Working knowledge of at least one pharma value chain area (R&D, manufacturing, or commercial).
* Background spotting reusable patterns across engagements and turning them into shared, durable technical capability.
* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform

**Skills**

Agentic AI, Architecture Reviews, Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Design Assurance, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, GxPs, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Standards Compliance, Technology Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Operations Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

OEC is in the middle of a multi-year journey to modernise its infrastructure and applications, transforming how we build, deploy, and operate software at global scale. The Operations Specialist (L2) is a core member of the Monitoring Team within the Enterprise Operations Team, responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of OEC’s observability stack, primarily powered by Datadog.

In this role you will own L2 alert triage, incident response, dashboard development, and service onboarding — contributing to the team’s tooling standards and best practices. You will also handle day-to-day server monitoring, infrastructure support, and service management tasks that keep OEC’s global platforms running reliably.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties (essential to the job)**

**Monitoring & alerting**

* Design, configure, and maintain Datadog monitors, composite alerts, and notification channels for production and non-production environments.
* Own the L2 alert triage process — investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated alerts from L1, ensuring timely root cause identification.
* Tune alert thresholds and suppression rules to minimise noise and reduce false positive rates.
* Manage SLO (Service Level Objective) definitions, tracking, and reporting across assigned services.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

**Dashboards & observability**

* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards covering infrastructure health, application performance, log analytics, and business KPIs.
* Configure and manage Datadog APM (Application Performance Monitoring), distributed tracing, and error tracking for key services.
* Implement and manage log ingestion pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based monitors.
* Develop and maintain Synthetic monitors (API and browser tests) for uptime and user experience validation.

**Service onboarding & integrations**

* Onboard new services and infrastructure components into the Datadog monitoring framework in collaboration with DevOps, Cloud, and Engineering teams.
* Configure and maintain Datadog integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Rackspace), Kubernetes, containerised workloads, and third-party tools.
* Support the migration of legacy monitoring tooling (SCOM, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Pingdom, Apigee, Redgate, IDERA) into Datadog.

**Incident response & runbooks**

* Act as L2 escalation point during incidents — perform deep-dive investigations using metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for common alert scenarios, incident response procedures, and post-incident remediation steps.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews, documenting root cause findings and identifying monitoring gaps to prevent recurrence.
* Alerts system owners, stakeholders, and management of degraded system status and Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents; issues tickets for incident and problem escalation.

**AI & automation**

* Leverage Datadog AI capabilities including Watchdog, anomaly detection, outlier detection, and Bits AI to improve proactive issue detection.
* Implement forecast-based monitors for capacity management (CPU, memory, disk).
* Use AI-based alert correlation and deduplication features to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive monitoring tasks using Datadog’s API and scripting tools.

**Standards & governance**

* Adhere to and actively contribute to monitoring standards, tagging strategies, and naming conventions.
* Participate in regular alert quality reviews, dashboard audits, and SLO compliance checks.
* Maintain accurate documentation of monitoring configurations, integrations, and architectural decisions.
* Creates and maintains knowledge articles to be used internally and/or externally for training, best practices, solutions, or processes relating to applications, environments, and related technologies.

**Infrastructure operations & support**

* Analyses and troubleshoots Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations and processes.
* Performs moderately complex database administration.
* Monitors data centre networks, infrastructure bandwidth, application health, servers, and other infrastructure; coordinates and communicates with vendors.
* Diagnoses and researches (using knowledge base) application incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests; provides assistance and guidance to associate operations specialists.
* Adheres to all incident and service request processes and procedures in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Diagnoses, researches, and resolves Level-2 technical hardware and software incidents, monitoring alerts, and service requests.
* Works on ad-hoc projects to support Infrastructure Engineering or other departments, as requested.
* Demonstrates a flexible and adaptable approach to work and adjusts to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.
* Collaborates with DevOps, Cloud, and application teams to align monitoring coverage with service requirements.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

**Experience, Skills and Key Competencies**

At least 5+ years of experience in an infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or monitoring engineering role is required, with hands-on experience in Datadog and working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and containerised environments.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

**Technical skills**

* Hands-on experience with Datadog — monitors, dashboards, APM, log management, SLOs, and synthetic monitoring.
* Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS required; Azure or GCP a plus) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability concepts: metrics, traces, and logs.
* Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of ITSM concepts and ticketing workflows (Jira, JSM, or ServiceNow).
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft and UNIX/Linux server configurations, Active Directory, and internet protocols (HTTP, FTP, DNS, IP, SSH).

**Soft skills & competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to produce runbooks and incident summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively across Engineering, DevOps, and Operations disciplines.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they escalate.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to work; able to adjust to shifts in priorities as the needs of the business change.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Datadog Fundamentals or Datadog APM certification (or actively working towards one).
* At least 2 year of experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).
* Knowledge of network monitoring and distributed systems architecture.
* Exposure to ITIL or ITSM frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
* Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, JSM, Confluence) for documentation and ticket management.

**Special Position Requirements**

* Must be able to read, write, understand, and speak fluent English.
* Must be able to work flexible shifts including holidays and weekends, to provide support across locations and time zones.
* Must be able to participate in an on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Job Summary/Objective**

The Senior Systems Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role responsible for the design, administration, and continuous improvement of OEC’s corporate IT environment. Scope spans Windows Server, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, identity and access management, and endpoint management, with active expansion into IaC and AWS. Security is foundational — every system, configuration, and access decision is approached through a security lens. This person operates independently, holds a high standard for documentation, and actively contributes to team growth.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties(essential to the job)**

1. Administer and maintain Windows Server and endpoint environments, including patching, configuration, and root-cause analysis.
2. Manage Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Intune) and maintain Conditional Access posture.
3. Operate endpoint management tooling (Intune, SCCM/Autopatch, Jamf) including policy, enrollment, and compliance enforcement.
4. Maintain DNS, DHCP, SMTP, file services, and Active Directory (GPO, ADUC).
5. Contribute to IaC adoption — reviewing, testing, and authoring configurations as skills develop.
6. Support and expand AWS cloud infrastructure deployments.
7. Read, modify, and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts; AI-assisted authoring (Copilot, Claude) is available and encouraged.
8. Identify access control gaps, configuration risks, and hardening opportunities proactively.
9. Author and maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and troubleshooting guides; track work in Jira and JSM.
10. Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours system emergencies.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline. In the absenceof a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

**Experience, Skills and Key Competencies**

At least 10 years in systems engineering or IT infrastructure, with demonstrated experience administering Microsoft 365, Windows Server, enterprise identity platforms (Active Directory, Entra ID), and endpoint management (Intune, SCCM, or Jamf). Ability to read and modify PowerShell is required. Modern Microsoft certifications (e.g., MS-102, Azure Administrator) are preferred.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following skills and abilities:

**Required Skills**

* Windows Server and Active Directory — GPO, ADUC, DNS, DHCP, SMTP, patching, and domain services
* Microsoft 365 — Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access
* Endpoint management — Intune, SCCM/Autopatch, and/or Jamf
* Virtualization — VMware vSphere/ESXi or Hyper-V
* Identity and access management — SSO/IdP, MFA, RBAC, and privileged access concepts
* PowerShell — read and modify scripts; authoring supported by AI tooling
* Mail flow and hygiene — Exchange with platforms such as Mimecast
* Jira and JSM — project tracking and ticketing

**Preferred Skills & Team Growth Areas**

Candidates who bring the following contribute immediately; those who don’t are expected to grow into them.

**Infrastructure as Code (Active Growth Priority)**

* Terraform or equivalent IaC tooling
* Version-controlled infrastructure configuration and change pipelines
* HCL, YAML, or JSON declarative configuration

**AWS Cloud Infrastructure (Active Growth Priority)**

* Hands-on AWS experience for corporate IT or infrastructure workloads
* Networking, IAM, and compute in AWS environments
* AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator) are a plus

**Travel & Other Considerations**

Travel is rare. This position requires availability for after-hours on-call response as part of the team rotation.

* Proven experience leading, mentoring and developing teams of Flow Assurance Engineers.
* Strong client engagement, stakeholder management and technical leadership capabilities.
* Experience delivering conceptual engineering, FEED and detailed design projects.

description:

We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Security System Engineer** to design, implement, and operate secure, compliant network segmentation between regional environments and Global networks, using a standardised control stack of Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Cloudflare for DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application protection. This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

**We offer**

* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms

description:

The impact you’ll have in this role
  
  
We are seeking a Messaging Systems Engineer to join our team supporting DTCC's enterprise
  
  
IBM MQ messaging environment. This role is ideal for an engineer looking to build deeper expertise in messaging technologies, production support, automation, platform reliability, and modern infrastructure.
  
  
You will work alongside experienced messaging engineers and partner with support teams, application owners, infrastructure teams, and other technology groups to maintain reliable and resilient messaging services.
  
  
The role provides hands-on opportunities to develop skills across IBM MQ, automation, observability, Linux, containers, cloud technologies, and Site Reliability Engineering practices while contributing to the continued modernization of the messaging platform.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Support IBM MQ and related messaging technologies across production and non-production environments.
* Troubleshoot messaging issues and work with senior engineers and partner teams to resolve incidents and service disruptions.
* Assist with problem management and root cause analysis to identify recurring issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Support MQ operational activities including provisioning, configuration, certificate management, health checks, maintenance, and recovery activities.
* Develop and maintain scripts and automation that reduce manual operational tasks and improve consistency.
* Assist with monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and health indicators used to identify potential messaging platform issues.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks and contribute to knowledge sharing across support teams.
* Participate in incident reviews and reliability improvement activities and help identify opportunities to prevent recurring problems.
* Support platform lifecycle and modernization initiatives, including container, cloud, hybrid infrastructure, and CI/CD technologies.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, and engineering teams to maintain secure, resilient, and standards-compliant messaging services.
* Develop knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering practices and apply automation and engineering principles to improve platform reliability and reduce operational toil.
* Continuously develop technical expertise across messaging, automation, observability, and modern infrastructure technologies.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of related technology experience, preferably supporting infrastructure, middleware, messaging, or enterprise production environments.
* Experience with or working knowledge of IBM MQ and enterprise messaging concepts.
* Familiarity with IBM MQ administration, including queue managers, queues, channels, connectivity, and basic troubleshooting.
* Experience working with Linux/Unix environments.
* Understanding of basic networking, high availability, system reliability, and troubleshooting concepts.
* Exposure to scripting or infrastructure automation technologies such as Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, Chef, or Terraform.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability technologies such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or APM tools.
* Exposure to containers, OpenShift/Kubernetes, cloud technologies, or modern deployment practices is a plus.
* Exposure to IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE), MQ IPT, Native HA, or similar middleware technologies is a plus.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with an interest in understanding how complex systems operate.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical teams.
* Demonstrated interest in automation, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement.
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and develop deeper expertise in enterprise messaging and infrastructure engineering.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
**What are we looking for?**
We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Platform Integrations APAC team, where you'll help expand and maintain direct integrations with payment systems and partners across the region.
  
  
**What is the Platform Integrations APAC (PI-APAC) team?**
The Platform Integrations squad sits within the Platform tribe, which designs, builds and operates the foundational direct integration infrastructure that power the product that moves billions of dollars every month. The Platform Integrations APAC team within PI leads the direct integrations in the APAC region while also supporting integrations all over the world.
  
  
**Here’s how you’ll be contributing to the Team?**

* Design, implement and maintain integrations between Wise and complex financial systems.
* Develop and design scalable and repeatable architecture with complex regulatory requirements.
* Analyse infrastructure to determine inefficiencies and problems, and create automation and optimisation.
* Collaborate with our larger platform engineering team and alongside product engineering on globally impactful projects.
* Communicate with various stakeholders throughout Wise, plan roadmaps with your team, and work through challenges to determine scope and realistic delivery.
* Work with Leads and Engineers to influence the direction and change current technology implementations, as well as advocate for excellence with third parties.

**This Role Will Give You The Opportunity To**

* Work in a modern, cloud heavy environment where remote connectivity is a staple of our tech ecosystem
* Choose your path to impact - we believe people and teams are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls
* Grow as an engineer - understand what problems the business needs to solve and why, then proactively resolve them. We shy away from micro management
* Approach new challenges with the freedom to develop novel and customised solutions
* Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

**Qualifications**
**Desirable Skills and Experience**

* Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals and experience with supporting complex deployments - TCP/IP, routing and switching, traffic load-balancing/ECMP, configuring firewalls, IPSEC, GRE, security policies, Network ACLs, complex routing with BGP
* Experience in SRE and Network automation - IaaC, Python, Ansible, Netconf, CI/CD, telemetry
* Excellent candidates would have JNCIS/CCNP-level knowledge and familiarity with networking on Linux for non-trivial tasks (e.g: running routing protocols on Linux, IPSec tunnels). Strong candidates will also have hands-on-experience with cloud networking concepts, preferably with AWS (e.g. VPCs, transit gateways, direct-connect, VPC peering). We welcome candidates who aspire to this level of knowledge if they don’t yet have it.
* Experience in developing and documenting network designs
* Ability to translate business requirements into explainable technical solutions for internal and external stakeholders
* Leading technical projects or small team of engineers would be a great plus

**The following is a list of some of the technologies and vendors we use. It is not an exclusive list nor do we expect you to know everything. But it gives a flavour.**

* AWS Networking: VPC, VGW, Transit-GW, Direct-Connect, VPC Peering, Cloud WAN
* VPNs (we use IPSec heavily)
* Vendors: Cisco, Juniper and Checkpoints (both Physical & Cloud version)
* L2 Switching
* Routing: BGP
* ISP Peering, DataCenter integrations, cross-connects
* IaaC: Terraform, Ansible, Netconf, Python
* Java Microservices on Kubernetes (Software development experience is nice to have but not essential)
* Git, with Github

**About You**

* You’re a self starter who can run with projects
* Reliability and scalability are paramount in your solutions
* Security and privacy by design mindset
* You think about risks and compliance
* You enjoy looking for where you can have impact and upset the norm
* You’re happy working in a flat organisation structure
* Technical influencer capable of promoting architectural patterns to internal and external stakeholders
* You are comfortable facing new challenges and creating novel and customised solutions
* You’re collaborative, charismatic and have the ability to tailor communication to the audience - both to technical and non-technical people as needed.
* Effective communication between cross-team stakeholders, peers and leads is key

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Infrastructure Engineer III- Network
description:
**Job Description**
You belong to the top echelon of talent in your field. At one of the world's most iconic financial institutions, where infrastructure is of paramount importance, you can play a pivotal role.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you utilize strong knowledge of software, applications, and technical processes within the infrastructure engineering discipline. Apply your technical knowledge and problem-solving methodologies across multiple applications of moderate scope.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Applies technical knowledge and problem-solving methodologies to projects of moderate scope, with a focus on improving data and systems running at scale, and ensures end to end monitoring of applications
* Implement and operate data center network services including builds, migrations, upgrades, expansions, and decommissions in alignment with enterprise standards
* Translate business and technical requirements into implementation plans that meet performance, resiliency, security, and operational goals
* Create and maintain network documentation, including implementation plans, as-built diagrams, standards, and operational runbooks
* Partner with application teams, infrastructure stakeholders, and vendors to plan and deliver network changes safely
* Coordinate and execute cutovers to ensure low-risk changes and successful implementation outcomes
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across routing, switching, and network services
* Drive root-cause analysis and remediation to reduce recurring incidents and improve stability
* Improve processes and contribute to automation and standardization efforts to drive operational excellence
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate monitoring and capacity analysis and documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted approaches to identify recurring capacity risks and improve remediation workflows, ensuring changes are validated and aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience of network engineering and/or implementation experience in a large-scale enterprise environment
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience with routing technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience of implementing or operating Cisco networking solutions (e.g., Nexus, Catalyst) or equivalent experience with comparable platforms (e.g., Arista, Juniper)
* Strong understanding of IP routing fundamentals
* Strong understanding of Ethernet switching fundamentals
* Strong understanding of network security concepts (segmentation, ACLs, firewall integration)
* Working knowledge of enterprise network services and connectivity patterns (e.g., DNS, web proxy patterns, VPN technologies, multicast where applicable)
* Strong knowledge of one or more infrastructure disciplines such as: hardware, networking terminology, databases, storage engineering, deployment practices, integration, automation, scaling, resilience, and performance assessments
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bring low-latency data center networking experience (e.g., Nexus 3K / Arista-class platforms, or similar ultra-low-latency environments)
* Hold relevant networking certifications (e.g., Cisco certifications)
* Leverage scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash/KSH, or similar) to support repeatable implementations and operational efficiency
* Demonstrate experience with load balancing and firewall technologies (e.g., F5, Check Point, Fortinet or equivalent) and working in multi-platform, distributed enterprise environments with strong change management rigor

title: Senior Specialist, Public Cloud Networking
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Public Cloud Automation Software Engineer role will be instrumental in implementing the architecture and the engineering processes and best practices to enable the foundational infrastructure (compute, network, storage, observability) required for application hosting in public cloud. This role will focus on designing, building, and operating automated, secure, and compliant cloud infrastructure at scale. The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure-as-code expertise (Terraform), deep cloud networking knowledge, and practical experience delivering repeatable, auditable automation in highly regulated environments.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (IaC), with Terraform as the primary IaC tool
* Build and operate automated pipelines for provisioning, configuration, testing, and deployment of cloud resources (CI/CD for infrastructure)
* Deliver the tooling and capabilities needed to enable our cloud first strategy
* Drive client satisfaction by identifying and developing process improvement and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance of slutions to operation roadmap
* Develop, document, and maintain reusable Terraform modules, templates, and standards to accelerate secure and compliant cloud deployments across multiple teams and regions
* Develop, document, and maintain reusable Ansible playbooks, templates, and standards to accelerate secure and compliant cloud deployments across multiple teams and regions
* Collaborate with network engineering to design and implement cloud network architectures (VPC/VNet design, subnets, routing, transit/gateway, peering, security zones)
* Implement and manage connectivity solutions including VPN, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, Transit Gateways, NAT, service endpoints, and hybrid connectivity patterns

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Continuous Monitoring: Supervise enterprise network infrastructure, servers, applications, and links via monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Datadog, PRTG).
* Incident Triage & Management: Acknowledge alerts, perform initial analysis, create detailed incident tickets in platforms like ServiceNow or Jira, and assign proper priority levels.
* Basic Troubleshooting: Execute standard runbooks to resolve Tier-1 issues, such as device reboots, interface resets, ISP link flaps, disk space cleanups, and service restarts.
* Escalation & Communication: Escalate unresolved incidents to L2/L3 engineers, vendor support (e.g., ISPs, hardware vendors), or internal stakeholders within defined SLA timelines.
* Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate shift handover logs, document recurring issues, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Networking Fundamentals: Strong grasp of OSI layers, TCP/IP suite, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP basics), and subnetting.
* Operating Systems: Basic command-line troubleshooting skills in Linux/Unix and Windows Server environments.
* Tool Proficiency: Familiarity with network diagnostic utilities (ping, traceroute, mtr, nslookup, tcpdump, netstat) and ticketing systems.
* Communication: Clear verbal and written English communication for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder notifications during outages.
* Shift Flexibility: Participate in 24/7 support with other teams across the globe. Some weekend work may be required.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Telecommunications, or equivalent diploma.
* Experience: 0–2 years of experience in a Network Operations Center, technical support, or IT helpdesk environment.
* Certifications (Preferred): Cisco CCNA, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, or ITIL v4 Foundation.

Physical Demand & Work Environment
  
  

* Must have the ability to perform office-related tasks, which may include prolonged sitting or standing.
* Must have the ability to move from place to place within an office environment.
* Must be able to use a computer.
* Must have the ability to communicate effectively.
* Some positions may require occasional repetitive motion or movements of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Job Summary:**
Seeking an experienced Senior System Administrator to design, manage, and scale mission-critical infrastructure across AWS and Azure. This role involves administering Linux platforms, container orchestration (EKS/AKS), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and automation (Ansible). The ideal candidate will ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing systems through proactive monitoring, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Cloud Infrastructure (AWS & Azure)

+ Manage and optimize AWS services (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, ALB/NLB, CloudWatch, EKS).
+ Support Azure environments (VMs, VNets, NSG, Azure Monitor, AKS, Azure Load Balancer, ).
+ Implement HA/DR strategies, cost optimization, tagging standards, and resource governance.

* Linux Administration

+ Install, secure, patch, and troubleshoot RHEL/Oracle Linux systems.
+ Manage system performance, storage (LVM), filesystems, and SELinux policies.
+ Automate tasks using Bash/shell scripting and Ansible.

* Load Balancing

+ Design and maintain L4/L7 load balancing solutions (ALB/NLB, Azure Load Balancer, Nginx, HAProxy, or F5).
+ Configure SSL/TLS offloading, health checks, routing, and traffic policies.

* Containers & Orchestration (EKS/AKS)

+ Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters, including RBAC, networking, storage, and security controls.
+ Perform cluster upgrades, manage deployments, scaling, and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).

* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

+ Build and manage Terraform-based deployments with modules, version control, and environment segregation.
+ Implement policy-as-code and maintain secure state management.

* Automation (Ansible)

+ Develop and maintain playbooks/roles for provisioning, patching, and configuration management.
+ Integrate Ansible workflows with CI/CD pipelines and secrets management.

* Security, Compliance & SRE Operations

+ Enforce CIS/NIST/ISO hardening standards, patch/vulnerability management, IAM policies, and incident response.
+ Define and track SLIs/SLOs, conduct RCAs and post-mortems, and maintain KB documentation.

* Collaboration & Mentorship

+ Work closely with development, network, and security teams to deliver resilient infrastructure.
+ Mentor junior administrators and contribute to knowledge transfer and documentation.

* Core Competencies

+ Ownership and accountability for production systems.
+ Clear documentation and knowledge sharing.
+ Strong analytical and communication skills.
+ Security-first mindset and attention to detail.
+ Ability to prioritize and perform under pressure with on-call responsibilities
+ 24\*7 shift along with Oncall responsibility

**General Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System
* Comply with Cubic Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures
* Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of the organisations
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures
* Other duties as requested

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

* 7 - 12 years of Linux system administration with strong AWS & Azure experience (core services, networking, IAM, EKS).

Working knowledge of Azure and AKS.
  
  

* Proficiency in Terraform and Ansible.
* Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, firewalls, SSL/TLS).
* Skilled in monitoring/observability (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Azure Monitor).
* Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning abilities; scripting in Bash/Python.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Windows Server Administration (AD, DNS, Group Policy).
* VMware Administration (ESXi, vCenter, vSAN).
* Familiarity with Ivanti, GitOps (Argo CD/Flux), CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
* Experience with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).
* Professional certifications (AWS SysOps/Admin, CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator, RHCSA/RHCE).

Employee

* 10–12 years of hands-on software, API, cloud, platform, or integration engineering experience delivering complex technical solutions independently.

Through our product-driven Agile/Lean DevOps environment, we’ve fostered a culture of innovation and experimentation across our development teams. As a customer-focused organization, we work closely with our end users and product owners to understand and rapidly respond to emerging business needs.
  
  
Collaboration is embedded into everything we do – from the products we develop to the quality service we provide. We’re driven by the belief that diversity of thought, background, and perspective is critical to creating the best products and experiences for our customers.

At Principal, we value connecting on both a personal and professional level. Together, we’re imagining a more purpose-led future for financial services – and that starts with you. title: Senior Linux Platform / Appliance Engineer
description:
About the Role

Seeking a hands-on senior engineer to design, build, secure, release, upgrade, troubleshoot, and support the Linux platform used by the EMS enterprise appliance. EMS is deployed on physical or virtual systems in customer environments. The position requires deep Linux systems engineering combined with appliance lifecycle, containers, networking, security, virtualization, automation, and offline or air-gapped deployment experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and maintain the Linux platform for physical and virtual EMS appliances.
* Build repeatable, version-controlled, and potentially immutable Linux images.
* Own the appliance lifecycle from build and provisioning throughdeployment, validation, upgrade,rollback, recovery, diagnostics, and reimaging.
* Engineer installation and update solutions for on-premises, low-connectivity, offline, and air-gapped environments.
* Design safe OS and application update, rollback, health-validation, and recovery mechanisms.
* Engineer and troubleshoot Linux boot, systemd,networking, storage, filesystems, firewalling, logging, packages, permissions, and services.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Podman, Docker, Kubernetes/MicroK8s, or equivalent technologies.
* Use Podman, Quadlet, and systemd-managed containers where appropriate.
* Support physical hardware and virtual appliances across KVM, VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent platforms.
* Implement Linux hardening, certificate management, vulnerability remediation, package integrity, and platform security controls.
* Automate appliance image creation, testing, packaging, validation, and release.
* Build fielddiagnostics and recoverycapabilities and collaborate with software engineering, QA, cybersecurity, product, infrastructure, and support teams.

Required Experience

* 7+ yearsin Linux platformengineering, Linux systemsengineering, enterprise appliance engineering, embedded or edge Linux, infrastructure engineering, or a similar role.
* Deep hands-on Linux experience, preferably Ubuntu, RHEL, Fedora, or another enterprise Linux distribution.
* Strong knowledge of systemd, Linuxboot and OS lifecycle, networking, firewalling, storage, filesystems, package management, logging, diagnostics, security, permissions, and Bash or Python scripting.
* Experience building image-based, immutable, embedded, edge, or appliance-style Linux platforms.
* Experience creating automated OS images using Packer, custom ISO or image pipelines, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing upgrade, rollback, recovery, and reimaging solutions.
* Experience supporting on-premises, field-deployed, low-connectivity, offline, or air-gapped systems.
* Strong container experience with Podman, Docker, containerd, or equivalent OCI technologies.
* Experience with self-managed or on-premises Kubernetes environments.

* Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, networking, storage, containers, virtualization, and application services.
* Ability to independently design and deliver production-ready, secure, and supportable solutions.

Nice to Have

* Podman, Quadlet, and systemd-based container management.
* MicroK8s, K3s, or another lightweight Kubernetes distribution.
* Immutable Linux technologies such as Ubuntu Core, Fedora CoreOS, OSTree/rpm-ostree, read-only root filesystems, or A/B OS architectures.
* Virtual appliance experience with KVM, VMware, Hyper-V, OVA/OVF, QCOW2, VHD, or VHDX.
* Packer, Ansible, Git, infrastructure automation, and automated testing.
* CI/CD pipeline and build/release automation knowledge.
* Cloud engineering experience, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Infrastructure-as-code practicesand cloud servicessupporting artifact management, security scanning, testing,monitoring, or releases.
* Linux security hardening, CIS Benchmarks, PKI, certificates, trust stores, signed updates, and artifact validation.
* Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, journald, or equivalent observability technologies.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a Linux engineer who builds platforms and products, not simply someone who administers Linux servers. The strongest candidates will have experience with Linux-based appliances, industrial or edge systems, networking or security appliances, embedded platforms, or other long-lived on-premises products where reliability, security, controlled updates, offline operation, and field serviceability are critical.

title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**About This Role**
The Microsoft 365 Engineer is the hands-on technical owner for the day-to-day administration, configuration, and optimization of the KGS Microsoft 365 tenant, covering Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, Bookings, and Microsoft 365 Apps. This individual contributor role reports to the Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace and supports employees across the global KGS tenant from India.
  
  
The role is equally accountable for adoption across the organization, making sure employees at every site and in every function know how to use Microsoft 365 well. Success is measured through usage data, training reach, and reduced support demand. The engineer works within the standards set by the governance and cyber security teams, turning policy into services that are well run and well used.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Microsoft 365 Platform Administration**

* Administer and configure Exchange Online, including mail flow, connectors, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and transport rules.
* Administer SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business, including site provisioning, permissions, storage, and sharing settings.
* Administer Microsoft Teams, including meeting, calling, and messaging policies, app management, and Teams Rooms where applicable.
* Configure and support Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, Planner, Forms, Stream, and Bookings, and manage tenant settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
* Manage Microsoft 365 Apps deployment and update channels in partnership with the endpoint team.
* Automate administration tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph, and maintain configuration documentation and as-built standards.

**Identity, Licensing & Access**

* Manage license assignment through group-based licensing, along with Microsoft 365 groups and membership, within approved access policies.
* Partner with the identity team on Entra ID, conditional access, and MFA as they affect Microsoft 365 services, escalating exceptions to the policy owner.
* Track license consumption and report right-sizing opportunities to the Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery & Digital Workplace.

**Governance, Security & Compliance (Execution)**

* Apply the Teams and SharePoint standards set by the governance and cyber security teams to provisioning, naming, lifecycle and expiration, external sharing, and guest access.
* Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, retention policies, and data loss prevention (DLP) policies as directed by the cyber security and compliance teams.
* Action eDiscovery and legal hold requests as directed by the legal team.
* Review Microsoft Secure Score and recommendations relevant to Microsoft 365 workloads, and remediate findings with approval.

**Adoption & Change Management (Organization-wide)**

* Build and execute the Microsoft 365 adoption plan across all KGS sites and functions, and establish and run a Microsoft 365 Champions program.
* Create training content, including quick-reference guides, short videos, live and virtual sessions, and onboarding content for new hires.
* Run targeted campaigns that move teams from file shares and email attachments to collaboration in OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams, and that introduce tools such as Loop and Planner.
* Use Microsoft 365 usage analytics, Adoption Score, and Viva Insights where available to measure adoption, identify low-usage groups, and target them.
* Maintain an internal Microsoft 365 help and learning hub on SharePoint.
* Communicate Message Center roadmap changes to the business in plain language ahead of rollout.

**Migration & Projects**

* Execute file share and legacy platform migrations into SharePoint Online and OneDrive using the SharePoint Migration Tool, Migration Manager, or third-party tools.
* Support tenant consolidation, merger and acquisition, and divestiture work as required.
* Pilot and roll out new Microsoft 365 features in a controlled, well-communicated way.

**Support, Monitoring & Service Management**

* Serve as the second and third-level escalation point for Microsoft 365 incidents raised by the service desk and IT Field Engineers.
* Monitor Service Health and Message Center, assess the impact of incidents and changes, and manage Microsoft support cases through to resolution.
* Use ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management practices in the ITSM tool.
* Create knowledge base articles that enable the service desk to resolve Microsoft 365 issues at first contact.
* Will be the on-call for critical Microsoft 365 incidents.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 4–5 years' experience administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on administration experience with Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
* PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration, with working knowledge of Entra ID and license management.
* Experience delivering end-user training or adoption activities.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices and hands-on experience with an ITSM tool.
* Able to work onsite at the assigned KGS site in India, with the ability to travel up to 10%.
* Flexible schedule to accommodate overlap with the Americas and Europe and occasional on-call needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, or Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer.
* Experience delivering SharePoint Online migrations at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview, including sensitivity labels, retention, data loss prevention, and eDiscovery.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API, Power Automate, and the wider Power Platform.
* Prosci or other change management certification, with experience running Microsoft 365 champion programs.
* Readiness and rollout experience with Copilot for Microsoft 365.
* Experience with Intune and Microsoft 365 Apps deployment.
* Experience in manufacturing or multi-site global organizations.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong communicator, able to explain technology clearly to non-technical users.
* Trainer and presenter mindset, comfortable leading sessions for audiences of any size.
* Strong customer service orientation, displaying professional standards.
* Analytical and data-driven, using usage data to guide adoption decisions.
* Keen attention to detail in configuration and change control.
* Automation-first mindset, scripting repeatable tasks rather than repeating them by hand.
* Manages conflicting priorities and stays calm under pressure during incidents.
* Able to work autonomously and follow direction as provided.
* Collaborates effectively with peers and stakeholders across time zones.
* Continuously learns and keeps pace as the Microsoft 365 roadmap evolves.
* Challenges the status quo and drives improvement.
* Strong organizational and task management skills in a fast-paced environment.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

title: Cloud Migration Lead Engineer
description:
**Req ID:**
395339
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Migration Lead Engineer to join our team in TG, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud Migration Engineer – AWS / Azure
  
  
**Experience:**
6+ years in IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of hands-on cloud migration or cloud infrastructure experience.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for hands-on Cloud Migration Engineers to execute enterprise workload migrations, primarily to AWS, with Microsoft Azure experience considered an advantage.
  
  
This is an execution-focused engineering position. The successful candidate must have practical experience migrating production servers or applications from on-premises or virtualized environments to public cloud platforms.
  
  
We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Windows/Linux infrastructure backgrounds who have participated directly in migration projects.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Execute server and workload migrations from on-premises, VMware, and other cloud environments to AWS.
* Configure and operate AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and other migration tools.
* Perform source server assessments, agent installation, replication configuration, and migration readiness checks.
* Execute test migrations, validate replicated workloads, and troubleshoot migration issues.
* Participate in migration wave planning and technical cutover preparation.
* Perform production cutovers, post-migration validation, and hypercare activities.
* Troubleshoot operating system, networking, storage, DNS, Active Directory, and application connectivity issues.
* Support migration runbook creation, technical documentation, and rollback procedures.
* Collaborate with Technical Leads, Cloud Foundation Engineers, and customer application owners.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive migration activities and improve migration efficiency.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* Hands-on experience migrating Windows and/or Linux servers to AWS or another public cloud.
* Practical experience with AWS EC2, EBS, VPC, security groups, and basic IAM.
* Experience with AWS MGN, Azure Migrate, VMware HCX, RiverMeadow, or comparable server migration technologies.
* Strong Windows Server and/or Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Knowledge of VMware vSphere or similar virtualization technologies.
* Understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and basic network troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with server replication, testing, cutover, rollback, and post-migration validation.
* Experience troubleshooting infrastructure and operating system issues.
* Ability to follow migration runbooks and execute production changes safely.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Microsoft Azure VM migration experience and Azure Migrate.
* AWS Transform, RiverMeadow, CloudHedge, or other migration accelerators.
* PowerShell, Bash, Python, or automation scripting.
* Terraform, Ansible, or basic Infrastructure as Code experience.
* Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows infrastructure services.
* SQL Server, Oracle, or other database migration exposure.
* AWS networking, VPN, Direct Connect, or hybrid connectivity.
* AWS IAM, cloud security, or operational monitoring.
* Experience with application dependency mapping and migration discovery.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent certification.

Expected Outcomes
  
  

* Independently execute assigned migration tasks and migration waves.
* Deliver successful server migrations with minimal rework.
* Identify and resolve replication, cutover, and post-migration issues.
* Contribute to reusable migration procedures and automation.
* Support predictable, repeatable, high-volume migration delivery.

Candidates must demonstrate direct involvement in real server or workload migrations. General cloud operations, monitoring, or infrastructure support experience alone is insufficient.
