title: Application Support Engineer II
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an Application Support Engineer II to join our 24x7 Follow the Sun support team. You will be the front line for alert response and resolution, collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve technical issues, alerts, and cases. Effective communication with customers and stakeholders is essential, as you will need to relay status updates and escalate issues as necessary. The role demands excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Hybrid work options may be available, offering flexibility while maintaining round-the-clock support.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Work Customer issues in assigned SalesForce queue by troubleshooting application issues, and closing the loop with all parties involved.
* Contribute to the definition and management of application layer technology standards and processes including but not limited to: software version, configuration management, load balancing, database connectivity, and release/maintenance management.
* Monitoring tool administration (ProActiveNet, AlertSite, datadog, cloudwatch, PRTG, PagerDuty, graylog, Kibana, custom scripts).
* Support new customer implementations and the transitions from lower environments to production support.
* Respond to technical application questions and issues raised by customers in support of our Operating Level agreements. Handle escalations using a swarming methodology. Available in Hip Chat and Skype rooms during business hours.
* Respond to off hour's pages and escalations.
* Participates in maintenance, performance testing, operations acceptance testing (OAT) and / or release activities as required.
* Administer assigned JIRA ticket queues and follow up with appropriate parties. Regularly, clearly and effectively communicate pertinent information to team members, management and customers according to Support service level standards.
* Provide feedback to product and development teams to improve usability and functionality of GHX applications.
* Adopt and participate in Knowledge Centered Support (KCS) by creating and modifying articles in SalesForce. Articles should be sufficient to resolve cases and major service disruptions.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of Application Support or related experience.
* Must be able to work from own initiative, learn quickly, and function effectively with team members in a high pressure and dynamic environment.
* Must demonstrate effective listening, verbal and written communication skills.
* Unix or Windows application production/customer support experience.
* Customer-focused attitude.
* Experience with task automation.
* Experience with environment monitoring tools (Cloudwatch/Datadog/PagerDuty/etc...).
* Amazon Web Services (AWS) or cloud based architecture support experience.
* Ability to understand and work with complex enterprise application environments.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.
* Familiarity with ITIL or MOF Change Management concepts (desired)
* Familiarity with Oracle/SQL Server and RDBMS concepts (desired)

**Technical Skills (must have experience with a subset of the following):**

* Windows and/or Unix OS proficiency
* AWS – Amazon Web Services
* Python, Perl, Unix and/or Windows scripting experience
* JBoss Application Server
* JSON and restful API experience
* Apache Tomcat
* IIS Application Server
* Understanding of OSI Model
* JVM monitoring tools (jvmstat, etc.)
* Network monitoring (snoop, NetMon)
* EDI (ANSI/X12), and XML knowledge
* HTTPS, AS2, SFTP protocols
* MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, MSSQL, Oracle

**Education / Certification(s)**

* 4-year degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience (required)

title: Infrastructure Engineer III- Network
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You belong to the top echelon of talent in your field. At one of the world's most iconic financial institutions, where infrastructure is of paramount importance, you can play a pivotal role.
  
  
As an Infrastructure Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you utilize strong knowledge of software, applications, and technical processes within the infrastructure engineering discipline. Apply your technical knowledge and problem-solving methodologies across multiple applications of moderate scope.
  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Applies technical knowledge and problem-solving methodologies to projects of moderate scope, with a focus on improving data and systems running at scale, and ensures end to end monitoring of applications
* Implement and operate data center network services including builds, migrations, upgrades, expansions, and decommissions in alignment with enterprise standards
* Translate business and technical requirements into implementation plans that meet performance, resiliency, security, and operational goals
* Create and maintain network documentation, including implementation plans, as-built diagrams, standards, and operational runbooks
* Partner with application teams, infrastructure stakeholders, and vendors to plan and deliver network changes safely
* Coordinate and execute cutovers to ensure low-risk changes and successful implementation outcomes
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across routing, switching, and network services
* Drive root-cause analysis and remediation to reduce recurring incidents and improve stability
* Improve processes and contribute to automation and standardization efforts to drive operational excellence
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate monitoring and capacity analysis and documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted approaches to identify recurring capacity risks and improve remediation workflows, ensuring changes are validated and aligned to resiliency and security expectations.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience of network engineering and/or implementation experience in a large-scale enterprise environment
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience with routing technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS)
* Demonstrates strong hands-on experience of implementing or operating Cisco networking solutions (e.g., Nexus, Catalyst) or equivalent experience with comparable platforms (e.g., Arista, Juniper)
* Strong understanding of IP routing fundamentals
* Strong understanding of Ethernet switching fundamentals
* Strong understanding of network security concepts (segmentation, ACLs, firewall integration)
* Working knowledge of enterprise network services and connectivity patterns (e.g., DNS, web proxy patterns, VPN technologies, multicast where applicable)
* Strong knowledge of one or more infrastructure disciplines such as: hardware, networking terminology, databases, storage engineering, deployment practices, integration, automation, scaling, resilience, and performance assessments
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bring low-latency data center networking experience (e.g., Nexus 3K / Arista-class platforms, or similar ultra-low-latency environments)
* Hold relevant networking certifications (e.g., Cisco certifications)
* Leverage scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash/KSH, or similar) to support repeatable implementations and operational efficiency
* Demonstrate experience with load balancing and firewall technologies (e.g., F5, Check Point, Fortinet or equivalent) and working in multi-platform, distributed enterprise environments with strong change management rigor

description:

* Being part of an on call for escalation, for engagement on P1/P2/P3 major incidents impacting business

* Proactively handle any incoming issues reported and drive seamlessly within agreed SLA's.
* Demonstrated experience in facilitating virtual, enterprise-level meetings for production events.
* Proficient level experience with incident management, problem management, and change management.
* Demonstrated ability to assess and support complex technical issues and initiatives related to large-scale systems.
* General knowledge of application and infrastructure domains, including Web, Application, Database, and Server technologies. Mentor and guide talent development.
* Lead complex, broad impact initiatives including provision of high-level systems consultation for the technology teams.
* Work as key participant in large scale planning of computer systems and network infrastructure for Systems and Operations functional area.
* Make decisions on technical changes and enhancements.
* Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve goals.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 7 + years’ experience of technology experience
* 7+ years’ experience of technology delivery and relationship management experience with small and large business units in a large corporate environment
* 5+ years’ experience of complex issue resolution experience
* Experience in Systems Engineering and operations.
* Result oriented with excellent skills and conscious of responsibility.
* Ability to retain solution focus under pressure.
* Multi-tasking capability handling all the tasks in the scope of work.
* Time Management & Workload Prioritization and escalate issues as appropriate.
* Practical Decision Making
* Advanced Problem Resolution
* Good Interpersonal & Communication skills (Verbal, email, MS Teams and skype)
* General understanding of bridge etiquette & WebEx
* Customer Centric Focus
* Sense of urgency to handle the issue reported and drive it until closure.
* Ability to influence across all organizational levels, particularly senior management Knowledge/Skills/Ability Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience in facilitating meetings / MIM Bridge leading to resolution.
* Knowledge and understanding of technology production support in a highly critical environment.
* Knowledge and understanding of technology infrastructure data center, network, storage, and compute domains.
* Knowledge/Skills/Ability to exercise independent judgment and creative problem-solving techniques, daily/weekly/monthly reporting and shift schedules.
* Knowledge/Skills/Ability to execute in a fast paced, high demand, environment while balancing multiple priorities collaborating with the leadership and TMIM team.
* Knowledge/Skills/Ability Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Work location based on the business needs and willing to work from office in the base location.
* Willingness to learn and upskill to meet the business needs (infrastructure and applications)
* Act as an excellent team player.
* Flexible to work 24\*7 rotational shifts, willing to work beyond the shift hours / off days to meet business needs as appropriate.
* Adherence to Timely login and logout being part of the Command Center
* Ability to be available at desk throughout the scheduled shift hours and ensure to follow break management coordinating with leads globally.
* Self-learning, development and Knowledge sharing
* Adhere to HR policies, shift availability, team meeting and daily cadence.
* Focus and lead the process improvements in the scope of command center, monitoring and technical teams.
* Willingness to learn regularly in the dynamic changing environment.
* Adhere to the defined KPI’s (SLA/SLO) and performance goals to ensure the performance is at par to meet the individual / team metrics.
* Timely notifications to teams, leadership / executives with quality updates of the incidents adhering to the SLA’s.

title: Customer Delivery Architect
description:
Meet the Team
  
At Splunk and Cisco, we believe in turning data into answers. We are a team of passionate innovators in the Customer Success& Experience organization, committed to our customers’ success, our product’s evolution, and, most importantly, each other’s growth. Together, we help clients navigate the complex landscape of modern cyber defense and redefine how the world interacts with machine data.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As a Professional Services Architect (Security), you will be the technical and strategic authority for our Security portfolio and a Trusted Advisor to our customers. You will architect solutions across our SIEM and SOAR ecosystems, including Splunk Enterprise Security, UEBA, and SOAR. You aren’t just deploying software; you are architecting outcomes that protect organizations from the next generation of threats, with the opportunity to take ownership of your work, learn from industry leaders, and play a vital role in a team that celebrates collective success. This role requires regional travel of up to 30%.
  
  

* Architect Complex Solutions: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of security deployments, from initial strategy and integration to ongoing optimization.
* Drive Innovation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence product roadmaps and develop new strategies that redefine how customers monitor their infrastructure.
* Act as a Trusted Advisor: Engage at all levels, from C-suite stakeholders to technical engineers, to ensure operational success and strategic alignment.
* Empower the Customer: Enable client teams to manage, scale, and solve complex security challenges independently.
* Foster Growth: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, mentoring team members and contributing to a collaborative, high-performance environment.

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* 5+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), security consulting, or security sales engineering.

This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists

* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response

* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

title: Software Development Manager
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line.  
  
Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it.  
  
What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience.  
  
You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates.  
  
Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities.  
  
Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion.  
  
Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them.  
  
Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership.  
  
Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises.  
  
Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases.  
  
A day in the life  
Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1:1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates.

title: Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment & Service India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.  
  
As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.  
  
To be successful in this team, you will also have:
  

* Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
* Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

  
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)  

* Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
* Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
* Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

  
A day in the life  

* Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
* Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
* Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
* Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of critical data center equipment

* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA

title: Senior Control System Engineer
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**Purpose :** We are seeking an experienced Process Control Engineer with deep expertise in materials handling automation, constraint control, and throughput optimisation, capable of translating plant operating objectives into robust control strategies that consistently maximise production while maintaining stable and safe operation. Experience in large-scale mining operations would be highly advantageous.
  
  
The role is responsible for the design, implementation, tuning, and continuous improvement of constraint-based control strategies that maximise plant throughput while maintaining stable and safe operation. The role focuses on coordinating process control systems across the entire materials handling and processing circuit, ensuring production rates are optimised without causing equipment overload, blockages, or spillage.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong advanced process control, automation, and optimisation experience with expertise in bulk materials handling systems. They will have demonstrated capability in developing and commissioning constraint-based control strategies, analysing process performance, and delivering plant-wide throughput improvements through effective application of control theory, process modelling, and data-driven optimisation techniques.
  
  
To design, review, and deliver secure and resilient OT network architectures and engineering solutions that support industrial control systems, telecommunications infrastructure, digital platforms, and production-critical operational services.
  
  
The role ensures that OT network designs are aligned with client requirements, engineering standards, cybersecurity principles, industrial protocols, operational performance expectations, and project delivery objectives.
  
  
**The Role**

***As a Senior Control System Engineer with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

* Design and implement plant-wide constraint control strategies.
* Develop, configure, and commission advanced process control algorithms.
* Optimise materials handling systems to maximise throughput and minimise operational disturbances.
* Coordinate interactions between multiple process areas and control systems.
* Configure and tune PLC/DCS regulatory and supervisory control loops.
* Analyse process data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
* Develop process simulations and material flow models to validate control strategies.
* Support commissioning, performance testing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work closely with operations personnel to establish and maintain production targets.  

**About You**  
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
**Job Specific Skills:**

* Advanced Process Control & Optimisation:
  + Constraint Control Strategy (CCS) design, implementation, and optimisation
  + Advanced Process Control (APC) methodologies
  + Plant-wide throughput optimisation
  + Bottleneck and constraint identification
  + Push-pull control philosophies
  + Production rate optimisation and load balancing
  + Regulatory and supervisory control systems
  + Process performance monitoring and continuous improvement
* Process Control Engineering:
  + Process dynamics and control theory
  + PID control loop design, tuning, and optimisation
  + Model-based control strategies
  + Control system stability analysis
  + Process commissioning and performance testing
  + Statistical Process Control (SPC)
  + Control narrative and functional specification development
  + Alarm management and control system diagnostics
* Materials Handling Systems:
  + Conveyor systems control
  + Crusher, screen, stockpile, and reclaim systems
  + Ore handling facilities and process plants
  + Weightometer-based flow control
  + Bulk materials flow optimisation
  + Throughput and inventory management
  + Overload and spillage prevention strategies
  + Route and equipment coordination
* Control Systems & Automation:
  + PLC programming, configuration, and troubleshooting
  + DCS configuration and optimisation
  + ABB 800xA (highly desirable)
  + SCADA systems
  + Industrial communications and interfaces
  + Control system testing and commissioning
  + Functional design specifications (FDS)
  + Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)
* Process Simulation & Analytics:
  + Process modelling and simulation
  + Material flow modelling
  + MATLAB/Simulink (desirable)
  + Data analysis and visualisation
  + Historian data interpretation
  + Performance analytics and KPI development
  + Production forecasting and scenario analysis
  + Root cause analysis
* Instrumentation:
  + Flow, level, pressure, and weight measurement systems
  + Weightometer calibration and utilisation
  + Process instrumentation selection and application
  + Instrument loop testing
  + Field commissioning and troubleshooting
  + Instrument reliability and maintenance considerations
* Mining & Industry Knowledge:
  + Iron ore processing and materials handling
  + Mining process plants
  + Production management principles
  + Safe and sustainable operations
  + Asset utilisation and operational excellence
  + Brownfield optimisation projects

**Qualifications / Requirements:**  
**Essential:**

* Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Control Systems, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years' experience in process control and automation.
* Strong background in bulk materials handling and plant-wide optimisation.
* Demonstrated experience with Advanced Process Control (APC) and constraint control strategies.
* Strong understanding of process dynamics, instrumentation, and control theory.
* Experience in data analytics and statistical process control.
* Proficiency in PLC and DCS configuration, programming, testing, and commissioning.
* Experience tuning control loops and improving process control algorithms.
* Ability to analyse process bottlenecks and optimise production systems.

**Preferred:**

* Iron ore processing and materials handling experience.
* ABB 800xA experience.
* MATLAB modelling and simulation experience.
* Mining conveyor, crushing, screening, stockyard, and reclaim systems experience.
* Plant-wide throughput optimisation and load-shedding strategies.

**Typical Technologies:**

* ABB 800xA
* PLC platforms (ABB, Rockwell, Siemens, Schneider)
* Advanced Process Control (APC)
* MATLAB/Simulink
* Weightometers and process instrumentation
* Historian and analytics systems
* Conveyor and materials handling control systems

**Other Attributes:**

* Highly organised, reliable, practical, and delivery-focused.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in operationally critical environments.
* Strong relationship-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, and security-related information.
* Proactive, service-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve technical outcomes.
Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, and Worley values.  

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Customer Service Coordinator
description:

**Build Your Career. Learn New Skills. Grow With Us!**

**Company:** Rush Networks LLP  
**Location:** Thane, Maharashtra  
**Industry:** UPS, Power Solutions & Annual Maintenance Services  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years (Freshers with good communication and coordination skills may also apply)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** Best as per experience, skills and industry standards

**Why Join Rush Networks LLP?**

At Rush Networks LLP, we believe that every employee should have an opportunity to learn, perform and grow. We are a UPS AMC and service provider with a PAN-India service support network, helping customers maintain reliable and uninterrupted power solutions.

We are looking for a proactive, organised and enthusiastic **Service Coordinator** who wants to build a long-term career in service operations and customer management.

This is more than a coordination role — it is an opportunity to understand technical service operations, work closely with customers and engineers, develop problem-solving skills, and progress towards higher responsibilities based on performance.

**What Will You Do?**

* **Service Coordination:** Coordinate UPS preventive maintenance (PM) visits and breakdown calls across customer locations.

**Service Coordinator → Senior Service Coordinator → Service Operations Executive / Team Leader → Assistant Service Manager → Service Manager**

You will gain practical exposure to UPS systems, customer management, service planning, breakdown resolution processes, AMC operations and nationwide service coordination.

*Career progression will depend on individual performance, capability, experience and available opportunities.*

**Who Should Apply?**

* Graduates or diploma holders from any suitable stream.

* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email communication and data management.
* Good follow-up, planning, multitasking and problem-solving abilities.
* A responsible and customer-focused attitude with the ability to work in a team.

**Added Advantage:** Experience in UPS, electrical equipment, technical services, AMC operations or field service coordination.

**What You Can Expect From Us**

* An opportunity to build a career in the growing power solutions and technical services industry.
* Practical exposure to real-world service operations and customer management.
* Opportunities to learn technical service processes and develop professional skills.
* Increasing responsibility based on performance and capability.
* A collaborative working environment where initiative and ownership matter.
* A long-term career path for candidates who demonstrate commitment and a willingness to learn.

**Ready to Start Your Career Journey?**

If you are organised, energetic, good at follow-ups and eager to build a successful career in service operations, we would love to hear from you!

The Lead Independent Safety Assessment (ISA) Assessor has the overall authority and responsibility to ensure that all Safety assessment activities under a project are correctly prepared, executed and reported.

The role provides impartial technical judgement on whether safety requirements have been adequately defined, implemented, verified, and justified. Assessing whether risks have been demonstrated to have been reduced to an acceptable level.

* Plan, manage, and coordinate ISA activities across the project lifecycle, including assessment planning, document review, audits, inspections, test witnessing, findings management, and final reporting.

* Identify safety-related issues, observations, and non-compliances, and provide clear recommendations to support timely resolution.
* Prepare high-quality ISA plans, interim assessment reports, findings logs, technical notes, and final ISA reports.
* Maintain impartiality and independence from design, delivery, and implementation activities in accordance with applicable accreditation and governance requirements.

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. * Bachelors degree in engineering, systems engineering or safety engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in railways, metros, or trams.
* Specific experience in developing or assessing complex railway signalling systems.

Leading assessment activities for at least 3 complex rail projects, including multidisciplinary systems and interfaces.

title: Security Automation Lead
description:
**Job Title**
Cyber Security Platform Engineer
  
  
**Location**
India (Pune)
  
  
**Reports to**
Cyber Security Engineering Lead (India) with functional alignment to Head of Cyber Platform Engineering
  
  
****Role Overview****
FNZ is building a global Cyber Platform Engineering function responsible for the operation, reliability, and evolution of the firm’s core security platforms.
  
  
We are seeking a Cyber Security Platform Engineer to join the growing engineering capability in India. This is a hands-on technical role focused on operating and improving FNZ’s production cyber security platforms.
  
  
The successful candidate will help ensure FNZ’s security platforms remain reliable, well-configured, and continuously improving through engineering, automation, and operational excellence.
  
  
This role sits within Cyber Platform Engineering, not the Security Operations Centre (SOC). The focus is on engineering and operating security platforms, rather than monitoring alerts or performing SOC analysis.
  
  
You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC.
  
  
****Core Responsibilities****
Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ’s production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.
  
  
The role combines hands-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms
* Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management
* Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance
* Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms
* Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ’s global security and operational standards
* Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows
* Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems
* Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency
* Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements
* Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms

Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset
**,**
identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time
  
  
Incident Engineering Support
  
  
Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required.
  
  
**This Includes:**

* Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting
* Assisting with root-cause analysis
* Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents

The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation.
  
  
Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ’s security platform environment.
  
  
**This Includes:**

* Identifying recurring operational issues
* Contributing to automation initiatives
* Improving platform observability and operational metrics
* Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities

Working Pattern
  
  
The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations.
  
  
Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out-of-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows.
  
  
****Required Experience****
Candidates should demonstrate hands-on experience operating enterprise security platforms.
  
  
**Typical Background Includes:**

* 3–6 years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles
* Hands-on experience working with enterprise security platforms
* Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls
* Experience working within distributed global engineering teams

Technical Experience
  
  
Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected:
  
  

* Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne
* Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access
* Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application-layer protection platforms
* Security logging and SIEM platforms
* Email security platforms and secure email gateways
* Vulnerability management platforms
* Network security controls, including next-generation firewalls

Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments.
  
  
Engineering & Automation Experience
  
  
**Experience In The Following Areas Is Beneficial:**

* scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar)
* working with APIs for platform integrations
* infrastructure automation or configuration management
* operating security tooling in cloud environments

Nice to Have
  
  
**Experience In The Following Areas Would Be Beneficial:**

* infrastructure-as-code or DevOps practices
* cloud security platform engineering
* integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines
* platform telemetry and observability tooling

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will:**

* support the reliable operation of FNZ’s security platforms
* contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives
* help maintain platform performance and stability
* collaborate effectively with global engineering teams
* grow technical expertise across FNZ’s security platform ecosystem

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ’s global technology infrastructure.
  
  
**The Cyber Platform Engineering Team Ensures These Platforms Remain:**

* reliable
* scalable
* well-engineered
* continuously improving

This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ’s global environment.
  
  
***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

+ Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.

  **Python**
  (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).

+ Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.
+ Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.

* ****Professional Experience:****

+ 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years exp, SP routing platforms, architectural and validation expertise
description:
**Meet the Team**
Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose #1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission-critical networks prior to Go-Live. We help Tier-1 Service Providers, Web/Cloud hyperscalers, and large Enterprises tackle their toughest business and operational challenges through network-centric testing, digital twin lab simulations, and advanced test automation. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next-generation Service Provider Networks
  
  

* Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C-level and senior engineering leadership.
* Solution Validation & Assurance: Lead end-to-end testing of next-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS-XR 64-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness.
* Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full-scale, high-fidelity customer simulations in world-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment.
* Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity.
* Defect Advocacy & Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution.

* Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence.

**Decision Making & Scope of Impact**

* Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements.
* Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go-Live success, network availability, multi-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier-1 accounts.
* Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards.

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

* Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies.
* Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR).

* Automation & Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines.
* Advanced Troubleshooting & RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education & Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10–15+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery.
* Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems.
* Consulting & Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior-level decision makers.
* Certifications: Expert-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing & Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired.
* Software & Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML).
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure environments.

Strong architectural understanding and hands-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas:

title: IT Infrastructure & Operations Consultant (Onsite)
description:
**Department:**
IT / Operations

**Employment Type:**
6 months contract

**Location:**
Kharadi, Pune (Onsite)

**Experience:**
3–6 years preferred

**Shift:**
US Eastern Shift (6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST)

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on IT Infrastructure & Operations Consultant to manage and optimize the organization's IT ecosystem, including software applications, cloud platforms, user access, licenses, networking, and hardware assets.

The individual will be responsible for ensuring that employees have access to the right tools, licenses, devices, and permissions to perform their jobs effectively and securely. This person will own the administration and documentation of the company's technology stack, identify opportunities to reduce software costs, evaluate new technologies, and help employees get the most out of the tools they use.

The ideal candidate is organized, technically proficient, security-conscious, and comfortable managing a diverse range of SaaS applications, cloud services, and IT infrastructure in a growing organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. SaaS Application & License Management**

* Manage the organization's software subscriptions, licenses, and user accounts across all business applications.
* Administer tools and platforms including Microsoft 365, Zoho Workplace and other Zoho applications, AWS, Apollo, Tailscale, Cloudflare, Cursor, AI tools, and other current or future company applications.
* Provision, assign, modify, reclaim, and revoke licenses based on employee roles, requirements, and employment status.
* Maintain a centralized inventory of applications, including license counts, assigned users, subscription plans, renewal dates, costs, billing information, and application owners.
* Monitor license utilization and identify unused, duplicate, underutilized, or redundant subscriptions.
* Manage renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and vendor communications.
* Ensure license assignments comply with vendor licensing terms and organizational policies.

**2. User Access, Identity & Permission Management**

* Manage employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across all company applications.
* Configure and maintain role-based access control (RBAC), permissions, and access policies within each platform.
* Create and manage user groups, teams, departments, and permission groups to ensure the right employees have access to the appropriate features and resources.
* Implement least-privilege access principles and ensure access is granted based on business requirements.
* Review access rights periodically and remove unnecessary or outdated permissions.
* Administer multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and related identity and access management features where supported.
* Maintain auditable records of user access, license assignments, access changes, and administrative actions.
* Coordinate with department leads to understand access requirements and approve changes where necessary.

**3. IT Asset & Hardware Management**

* Manage the organization's hardware inventory, including laptops, peripherals, networking equipment, and other IT assets.
* Coordinate with approved vendors for laptop procurement, configuration, shipping, delivery, repairs, replacements, and warranty claims.
* Track device assignments, serial numbers, asset tags, specifications, purchase dates, warranty details, shipping status, and employee ownership.
* Ensure devices are prepared and delivered to employees before their joining dates, including remote employees where applicable.
* Maintain records of device allocation, returns, repairs, replacements, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate secure device setup, software installation, updates, and data removal when devices are issued, reassigned, or returned.
* Track hardware expenditure and identify opportunities to optimize procurement costs and device utilization.

**4. Cloud Infrastructure & Networking**

* Provide basic administration and operational support for cloud services, particularly AWS, including user access, permissions, account organization, resource visibility, and usage monitoring.
* Maintain a working understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, IP addressing, VPNs, routing, firewalls, connectivity, and network troubleshooting.
* Administer and support networking and connectivity tools such as Tailscale and Cloudflare, including relevant access policies, configurations, and user permissions.
* Assist with managing domains, DNS records, SSL/TLS certificates, and other related services where applicable.
* Troubleshoot routine connectivity, access, configuration, and endpoint issues.
* Coordinate with developers, cloud engineers, or external specialists for complex infrastructure changes, outages, or technical issues.
* Monitor cloud and service usage, flag unusual activity, and help identify cost optimization opportunities.

**5. IT Documentation, Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain a centralized and up-to-date IT asset and software inventory.
* Develop periodic reports covering:
* Software applications and subscription plans.
* Total licenses purchased, assigned, available, and unused.
* License costs, renewals, and upcoming contractual commitments.
* Employee access, user groups, roles, and permissions.
* Hardware inventory, assignments, procurement, and warranty status.
* Cloud service usage and relevant expenditure.
* Access reviews, offboarding completion, and outstanding IT issues.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for application administration, access requests, device management, and employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Maintain appropriate records to support internal audits, security reviews, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, accessible to authorized personnel, and updated whenever changes are made.

**6. Technology Evaluation & Cost Optimization**

* Evaluate new software, AI tools, productivity applications, and infrastructure solutions based on business requirements.
* Research alternatives to existing tools and compare features, pricing, security, integrations, scalability, and ease of use.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate applications, eliminate redundant subscriptions, negotiate better pricing, and optimize license allocation.
* Prepare recommendations for management, including cost-benefit comparisons and implementation considerations.
* Assess new AI tools and developer productivity platforms, including tools such as Cursor, against business needs and applicable security policies.
* Coordinate pilots, trials, and rollouts of approved tools.
* Maintain an up-to-date view of the organization's technology stack and recommend improvements as the company grows.

**7. Employee Training & IT Support**

* Help employees understand and use the company's software applications effectively.
* Conduct onboarding sessions, tool demonstrations, training workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Create user guides, FAQs, and documentation for frequently used tools and workflows.
* Assist employees with application access, license issues, permissions, device setup, connectivity, and routine technical problems.
* Promote the effective adoption of existing tools before recommending additional software.
* Track recurring IT issues and recommend process or configuration changes to prevent them.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration, IT operations, systems administration, SaaS administration, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience administering multiple SaaS applications, managing user accounts, and assigning software licenses.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Zoho applications, cloud platforms, and modern business productivity tools.
* Understanding of user provisioning, access controls, RBAC, user groups, MFA, and basic identity management.
* Working knowledge of AWS administration, account permissions, and cloud cost monitoring.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience managing hardware inventory, laptop procurement, vendor coordination, shipping, and asset tracking.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
* Ability to evaluate software products, compare alternatives, and make cost-conscious recommendations.
* Good communication skills and the ability to train employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and coordinate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with identity providers and SSO solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with endpoint management and device security solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools.
* Experience with IT asset management, SaaS management, or license optimization platforms.
* Basic understanding of cloud security, access auditing, backup practices, and incident response.
* Familiarity with AI productivity tools and developer tools, including enterprise account management and data security considerations.
* Experience creating automated workflows or scripts for user provisioning, reporting, and routine IT administration.
* Relevant certifications in Microsoft 365, AWS, networking, or IT service management are an advantage.

* + 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.

Data Foundations, part of Business & Market Insights, solves shared data problems for Mastercard's analytics products: secure customer data exchange, consistent business definitions and metrics, reference datasets, data quality and AI-assisted customer data onboarding. Engineering and product set direction together, and we own outcomes, not just delivery. Where enterprise platforms fit, we reuse and shape them. Where there is a shared gap, we solve it once.  
  
We are looking for a Manager, Software Engineering to lead a growing Pune-based team that builds and runs shared data capabilities. Your first challenge is reliable ingestion of customer and third-party data, while moving established pipelines from manual effort to cloud automation. You will spend 40-50% of your time hands-on. In your first few months you will baseline what the team runs, close the riskiest gaps and deliver the first measurable cut in manual onboarding work.  
  
Role  
  

* Partner with product management to understand users, shape scope and priorities, and share accountability for outcomes.

* Set and uphold standards for testing, release, data quality and security, with clear owners, monitoring and service-level objectives for production services; lead major incidents through to root cause.
* Plan capacity across employees and contractors, hold vendors to clear deliverables, and work with business operations on customer onboarding.
* Communicate progress, risks and decisions to senior leaders, and help the team use AI tools where they genuinely improve speed or quality.

  
All About You  
  

* Experience managing engineers, including performance management and career development.
* Strong product judgement and a record of shaping what is built, not just delivering it.
* Experience running and improving production data pipelines, including moving legacy workloads to the cloud.
* Recent hands-on experience with Databricks and AWS or comparable cloud data platforms.
* Good knowledge of batch processing, data quality and data governance.
* Clear communication across global technical and senior audiences.

  
Desirable:  

* Experience exchanging data with external customers or partners, including secure transfer and access control.
* Experience with SQL Server, Hadoop or other platforms being migrated.
* Experience in payments, financial services or a regulated data environment.

title: Lead/Senior Security System Engineer - Network Cloud
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Security System Engineer** to design, implement, and operate secure, compliant network segmentation between regional environments and Global networks, using a standardised control stack of Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Cloudflare for DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application protection. This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Laboratory Engineer
description:
**Be part of something bigger!**
--------------------------------

  

As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it’s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy.

  

As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and € 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world!

  

**Purpose and Mission**
-----------------------

**BITC Laboratory Technical Leadership, Operations & Capability Development**

* BITC Laboratory comprises Static & Fatigue Testing, Adhesion Testing, Material Characterization and Tyre Forensic Analysis capabilities supporting product development, customer requirements and technical problem solving across steel cords, filaments, tyre components and other technical samples.
* The role provides technical leadership for laboratory operations and capability development, ensuring timely and reliable testing, sound interpretation of results and technically robust conclusions. The position is responsible for building laboratory expertise, developing and improving test methods, identifying trends and failure mechanisms, and strengthening laboratory capabilities to support product and technology development. The role also develops team capability and ensures high standards of safety, quality and continuous improvement.

**Key Activities and Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

**Lab Management & QMS Implementation**

* Develop and communicate the laboratory strategic roadmap, including capability development, infrastructure and investment priorities, and future growth requirements.
* Establish, implement and maintain laboratory processes in line with the Quality Management System (QMS) and Environmental Management System (EMS) requirements.
* Contribute to BITC and laboratory scorecards by ensuring reliable, timely and high-quality test delivery, while building the pipeline of future testing and capability requirements.
* Analyze and interpret laboratory test results, correlate findings with material/product behavior and failure mechanisms, and provide technically sound conclusions and recommendations for product development and problem solving.
* Drive continuous improvement in laboratory processes, methods and performance using structured approaches such as PDCA and Six Sigma.
* Plan and execute laboratory audits and MRMs, ensuring timely closure of actions and compliance with quality standards.
* Build team competency through training, knowledge sharing and performance dialogues, fostering a culture of safety, quality, collaboration and technical excellence.
* Oversee equipment calibration and verification, and drive the development, validation and standardization of test methods.
  

**Product & Application Technical Expertise**

* Develop and strengthen technical knowledge of steel cord applications in tyres, including product performance and application requirements.
* Contribute to technical and innovation projects that generate insights for new product and technology development, while independently leading assigned sub-projects from planning through execution.
* Support customer projects by developing relevant testing capabilities and new test methods, translating customer requirements into robust technical approaches and actionable test results.
  

**Core Expertise & Lab Projects**

* Develop and maintain specialized technical expertise in Mechanical Testing, Adhesion Testing, Material Characterization, and Tyre Forensics establishing these as core laboratory competencies.
* Build in-depth knowledge in selected technical domains through literature reviews, market and technology research, technical conferences and engagement with external technical networks.
* Independently lead assigned sub-projects related to technical development, problem solving, core laboratory expertise and test method development, from planning and execution through analysis and technical conclusions.

**Essential Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

**Must Have**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline
* Minimum 5 years of experience in an R&D environment, with demonstrated expertise in laboratory testing and capability development
* Strong logical, analytical and data interpretation skills
* Structured and systematic approach to technical problem solving
* Good command of English, both written and spoken
* Strong sense of ownership and responsibility, with the ability to work independently and effectively within a team
* Strong interest in technical investigation, experimentation and research-oriented work
  

**Prefer to have**

* Experience in laboratory management, technical team supervision and capability building
* Strong knowledge of mechanical testing and fundamental principles of mechanics
* Experience in developing or improving testing methods, processes and laboratory capabilities
* Broad technical interests and willingness to explore emerging testing techniques and technologies

**Authorization**
-----------------

* Prioritize and schedule laboratory testing activities based on project, customer and business requirements.
* Define and approve laboratory test methods, testing approaches and technical conclusions within the scope of the role.
* Recommend and initiate improvements to laboratory processes, methods, equipment and capabilities.
* Allocate laboratory resources and assign work to technicians and analysts to ensure timely execution.
* Identify laboratory capability, equipment and investment requirements and recommend priorities to the Head of BITC.
* Stop or escalate testing activities where safety, quality, equipment reliability or test-result integrity is at risk.

**Be bold and take the leap!**
------------------------------

  

We're looking for individuals who are not afraid to take risks and explore new ideas. If you are passionate about personal growth and bringing your authentic self to work, we want you on our team!
  
At Bekaert, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
To learn more about us and our exciting career opportunities, visit Bekaert Careers
