title: Customer Delivery Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
At Splunk and Cisco, we believe in turning data into answers. We are a team of passionate innovators in the Customer Success & Experience organization, committed to our customers’ success, our product’s evolution, and, most importantly, each other’s growth. Together, we help clients navigate the complex landscape of modern cyber defense and redefine how the world interacts with machine data.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Professional Services Architect (Security), you will be the technical and strategic authority for our Security portfolio and a Trusted Advisor to our customers. You will architect solutions across our SIEM and SOAR ecosystems, including Splunk Enterprise Security, UEBA, and SOAR. You aren’t just deploying software; you are architecting outcomes that protect organizations from the next generation of threats, with the opportunity to take ownership of your work, learn from industry leaders, and play a vital role in a team that celebrates collective success. This role requires regional travel of up to 30%.
  
  

* Architect Complex Solutions: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of security deployments, from initial strategy and integration to ongoing optimization.
* Drive Innovation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence product roadmaps and develop new strategies that redefine how customers monitor their infrastructure.
* Act as a Trusted Advisor: Engage at all levels, from C-suite stakeholders to technical engineers, to ensure operational success and strategic alignment.
* Empower the Customer: Enable client teams to manage, scale, and solve complex security challenges independently.
* Foster Growth: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, mentoring team members and contributing to a collaborative, high-performance environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), security consulting, or security sales engineering.
* Proven success implementing and architecting SIEM software.
* Strong background in Cloud IaaS (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and 3+ years of experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes and Docker).
* Proficiency in at least two of the following: Python, Java, .NET, PHP, Ruby, Node.JS, Objective-C; comfortable working across both Unix and Windows command lines.
* Experience with automation/orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or Terraform).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A high sense of urgency and the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical problems into business-value conversations.
* A self-starter mindset with a passion for continuous learning and professional development.
* Experience creating technical documentation (architecture diagrams, white papers, etc.).
* Bonus: Knowledge of Splunk administration or statistical and analytical modeling.

**#WeAreCisco**
(
*This is the Standard and cannot be changed*
)
  
  
#WeAreCisco where every individual brings their unique skills and perspectives together to pursue our purpose of powering an inclusive future for all.
  
  
Our passion is connection—we celebrate our employees’ diverse set of backgrounds and focus on unlocking potential. Cisconians often experience one company, many careers where learning and development are encouraged and supported at every stage. Our technology, tools, and culture pioneered hybrid work trends, allowing all to not only give their best, but be their best.
  
  
We understand our outstanding opportunity to bring communities together and at the heart of that is our people. One-third of Cisconians collaborate in our 30 employee resource organizations, called Inclusive Communities, to connect, foster belonging, learn to be informed allies, and make a difference. Dedicated paid time off to volunteer—80 hours each year—allows us to give back to causes we are passionate about, and nearly 86% do!
  
  
Our purpose, driven by our people, is what makes us the worldwide leader in technology that powers the internet. Helping our customers reimagine their applications, secure their enterprise, transform their infrastructure, and meet their sustainability goals is what we do best. We ensure that every step we take is a step towards a more inclusive future for all. Take your next step and be you, with us!
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: CCNA TRAINER
description:
Job Summary

The Technical Trainer - Network Data, Network Security & Network Voice will deliver structured, hands-on training for new recruits and early-career professionals selected for HCL roles. The trainer will cover core networking, security, collaboration/voice technologies, troubleshooting methods, lab-based learning, assessments, and technology best practices aligned to enterprise network operations.

Location- Noida, Lucknow, Chennai, Madurai

Purpose of the Role

* Support HCL training programs by enabling learners to build employable skills across network administration, network data, network security, and network voice domains.
* Develop and deliver practical training using labs, simulations, real-world scenarios, and guided troubleshooting exercises.
* Assess learner readiness through quizzes, hands-on labs, technical viva, project work, and feedback-driven improvement plans.
* Collaborate with technical teams, program owners, and delivery stakeholders to align curriculum outcomes with business needs.

Required Experience & Qualification

* Overall experience: 7 to 10 years maximum in networking / network operations / network security / voice technologies / technical training.
* Relevant practitioner experience should include enterprise networking, network security operations, voice or unified communications technologies, and hands-on troubleshooting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Networking, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Mandatory: certification in at least one relevant networking/security/voice area such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, CompTIA Network+, Security+, Cyber Security, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco Collaboration, or equivalent.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver instructor-led, virtual, hybrid, and lab-based sessions on network data, network security and network voice topics.
* Create and maintain courseware, presentations, lab manuals, assignments, assessments and remediation plans.
* Design hands-on labs using network simulation, emulation and virtualization platforms for real-world practice.
* Conduct technical evaluations, provide structured feedback, and report learner progress to program stakeholders.
* Guide learners on troubleshooting methodology, root-cause analysis, documentation discipline and operational best practices.
* Stay current with evolving enterprise networking, security and collaboration technologies and incorporate relevant updates into training delivery.
* Work with technical teams to validate lab environments, troubleshoot learner issues, and continuously improve training effectiveness.

Training Delivery Competencies

* Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for mixed-proficiency learner groups.
* Ability to create scenario-based activities, demonstrations, troubleshooting labs and capstone projects.
* Experience in training service delivery environments and understanding of ITSM service delivery concepts is desirable.
* Capability to influence stakeholders, collect feedback, and improve curriculum quality and learner outcomes.
* Good command of English language for classroom facilitation, learner feedback and documentation.

title: Senior Infrastructure Specialist
description:
Overview:

**WELCOME TO** **SITA**

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

**Solution Engineer, Specialist**

The Solution Engineer, Specialist provides customers with professional, timely, accurate, and effective proposals of SITA Network Services based on customer needs and inputs.  
Reporting to the VHF Network Services Manager, the Solution Engineer, Specialist is responsible for triggering all actions required to successfully implement and deliver the contracted solutions.

At SITA, we achieve more, together. Are you ready to join us?

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

Accountable for preparing the final solution for the customer based on working closely with regional teams for internal solutions and commercial managers when designing solutions for external customers, e.g., ANSP’s, Airport Authorities  
Engage with Engineering and other departments to assess the feasibility, the design, and the ability to deliver, transition, operate & support of the solution.  
Understand the products and how they can be deployed to support customer needs.  
Ownership of the supplier’s process regarding quotation and purchase request management and coordination with various entities and 3rd party suppliers during all project phases.  
Gather costs from the various parties to help build the solution and to offer the proposal to internal or external teams  
On approval of a quotation or proposal to order the solution and follow up its delivery progress with Project Managers in weekly meetings and emails where appropriate.  
Work in compliance with the Engineering guidelines (technology, architecture evolution, technical strategy)  
Assist in troubleshooting when requested by Operations and Engineering teams, and to document the findings and suggest required changes/fix in the ITSM platform, ServiceNow.  
Produce technical design drawings in Microsoft Visio for commercial teams to engage with external customers  
Ensure documentation and procedures for deployment and maintenance are updated.

Qualifications:

**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**

5+ years of telecommunications or ATI experience in large scale, 24x7x365, heterogeneous infrastructure RF/Telecommunications systems/ network environment (preferably in VHF Telecommunication field) environment with B. Tech./B.E. degree in Electronics, Telecommunications or Computer Science, e.g., CompTIA Network+, Cisco CCNA or CCNP  
Experience with IP-based telecommunication networks and basic knowledge of CISCO routers, switches, RF/VHF Technology a plus  
Good understanding of Cisco router configuration, knowledge of TCP/IP and routing protocols, e.g., static routing, BGP  
Experience in coordinating hardware/network refresh and spare management programs is desirable.  
Ability to work effectively in a distributed team environment & a matrix-managed organization.  
Be autonomous and agile in changing environments with a sense of initiative and proactivity.  
Strong verbal and written communication & analytical skills.  
Strong time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.  
Solid change management process knowledge.  
Proficiency in English is a must.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

**Flex-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.

title: Senior Consultant | Snowflake | Delhi | Engineering | Data Modernization & Migration
description:
**What impact will you make?**

  

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration, and high performance. As the undisputed leader in professional services, Deloitte is where you will find unrivaled opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

  

**Deloitte is where you will find unrivaled opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.**

  

**The Team**

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact-driven decision-making and generate an insight-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence & visualization, data management, performance management and next-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.

  

**Work you will do**

  

The primary role of practitioners is to make immediate, direct contributions to enhancing our clients’ competitive position and performance in ways that are distinctive, innovative, and sustainable.

To do this, must perform the following activities within the firm:

* 4 - 10 Years of work experience with at least one project implementation leveraging Snowflake – either migration from traditional DWHs or a fresh implementation.

* Be an integral part of large-scale client business development and delivery engagements.

* Play an architect role to architect and design the end-to-end process for the data integration.

* In depth knowledge of Snowflake Data Load processes – Data Loading, Bulk Loading, Snow pipe, Web Interface, Snow sight, Staged Files, Transforming Data During Load etc

* In depth knowledge on Snowflake Unload Data Processes to Azure

* In depth knowledge of Snowflake Architecture – Virtual Warehouse, Monitoring Warehouse, Table Structures, Views, Materialized Views, Cloning, Hierarchical Data etc

* Knowledge on Integration (ETL) and Data Ingestion, Data Conversion, and Data Migration

* Exposure to tools like Jira, Confluence and Agile practices is key

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Good to have Snowflake Certification

* Architect/ Professional Cloud Developer/ Professional Data Engineer.

* Has written Technical specification document

* Has peer reviewed documentation

* Good analytical, problem-solving and synthesizing skills.

* Good Communication and interpersonal skills.

* Client facing experience required

* Has reviewed Functional Specification document and written Technical specification document

* Should have a good understanding of the Functional Processes.

* Well-developed business acumen

  

* Strong problem-solving skills.

* Strong sense of ownership and accountability of tasks with attention to detail

* Willingness to travel for short- and long-term duration.

  

**Educational Qualification**

* BE/ B.tech, BCA, MCA

  

**Your role as a leader**

  

At Deloitte India, we believe in the importance of leadership at all levels. We expect our people to embrace and live our purpose by challenging themselves to identify issues that are most important for our clients, our people, and for society and make an impact that matters.

  

In addition to living our purpose, Analyst/Consultant/Senior Consultant/Manager across our organization:

  

* Develop high-performing people and teams through challenging and meaningful opportunities.

* Deliver exceptional client service; maximize results and drive high performance from people while fostering collaboration across businesses and borders.

* Influence clients, teams, and individuals positively, leading by example and establishing confident relationships with increasingly senior people.

* Understand key objectives for clients and Deloitte; align people to objectives and set priorities and direction.

* Acts as a role model, embracing and living our purpose and values, and recognizing others for the impact they make

  

**How you will grow**

  

At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there is always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help build excellent skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Centre.

  

**Benefits**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

  

**Our purpose**

Deloitte is led by a purpose: *To make an impact that matters*.

  

Every day, Deloitte people are making a real impact in the places they live and work. We pride ourselves on doing not only what is good for clients, but also what is good for our people and the

  

Communities in which we live and work—always striving to be an organization that is held up as a role model of quality, integrity, and positive change. Learn more about Deloitte's impact on the world

  

**Recruiter tips**

We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared and confident. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research: know some background about the organization and the business area you are applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

title: F5
description:
**Company Description**
NS3TechSolutions Private Limited is an expert-led technology and system integration company that helps businesses build secure, reliable, and high-performing IT environments. With over 7 years of industry experience, the team combines deep expertise in networking, cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, cloud, and managed services to solve complex technology challenges for modern enterprises. NS3TechSolutions designs and delivers solutions across enterprise networking, data centers, cloud connectivity, and managed IT operations, working closely with leading OEMs and technology partners. Backed by ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications and experienced professionals, the company focuses on solving the right problem, building the right solution, and earning long-term customer trust. NS3TechSolutions is committed to a culture where technical expertise, accountability, and customer success come first.

**Role Description**
The F5 Engineer will work on-site in Gurgaon in a full-time capacity, focusing on the deployment, configuration, and ongoing management of F5 technologies within enterprise network and security environments. Day-to-day responsibilities may include configuring and maintaining F5 BIG-IP devices, setting up load balancing, SSL offloading, and application security policies, and integrating F5 solutions with existing network, firewall, and application architectures. The role will involve troubleshooting performance and availability issues, optimizing traffic management, and collaborating with networking, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure resilient and secure application delivery. The F5 Engineer will also support implementation projects, document configurations and procedures, and contribute to best practices and standards for application delivery and network security.

* Candidates should possess strong expertise in F5 technologies such as BIG-IP, LTM, GTM/DNS, ASM, APM, and related application delivery and load balancing configurations.
* Candidates should possess solid networking skills, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, and network security concepts relevant to F5 integration.
* Candidates should possess experience with application delivery, web/application security, SSL/TLS, traffic management policies, and performance optimization.
* Candidates should possess practical experience in system integration, including solution design, deployment, configuration, implementation, and documentation of network and security solutions.
* Candidates should possess strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with a focus on diagnosing complex issues across network, application, and security layers.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and stakeholders in enterprise environments.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., F5-CA, F5-CTS, CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent) are beneficial and demonstrate applied technical proficiency.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

title: Senior Network Engineer
description: About UsAt apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/Job DetailsMost network engineering jobs today are configuring someone else's cloud. This one is not. We build, own and operate our own private cloud across our own datacenters, from the fabric up, and you would own the network underneath it. That means Anycast and BGP you design rather than raise a ticket for, and Kubernetes networking at the CNI layer rather than at the console.What You Would OwnKubernetes networking at the CNI layer. Cilium and the eBPF datapath, network policy, and how pod networking meets the physical fabric. This is the part most network engineers never get near, and it is central to this role rather than adjacent to it.The routed core. BGP design and Anycast deployment across our datacenters, including how traffic is steered between sites and how it fails over when one goes away.The perimeter. Firewalls, IDS and IPS, site-to-site connectivity, ISP relationships and WAN resilience.The switching estate. Multi-vendor across Cisco Nexus and Catalyst, Aruba and Ruckus, in both enterprise and datacenter contexts.Hybrid connectivity into Azure, and the design decisions about what stays on our own hardware and what does not.The standard the network is run to. Documentation, topology, change discipline, and the resiliency and security hardening roadmap. You set it, rather than following it.What The First Year Looks LikeBring the Kubernetes network layer under the same operational standard as the physical fabric.Take ownership of the Anycast and BGP design and make its failover behaviour provable rather than assumed.Lead at least one DR exercise end to end, and fix what it exposes.Remove the single points of knowledge, so no part of the network depends on one person being reachable.What We Need You To Have DoneKubernetes networking is a hard requirement for this role. You need hands-on production experience with a CNI, Cilium or Calico, and you should be able to walk us through how a packet reaches a pod and how you debugged it when it did not. Certification without production experience does not meet this bar. If you have not worked at the CNI layer, this is not the right role for you, and we would rather say so here than at interview.Hands-on Kubernetes networking with Cilium or Calico in production. Network policy, the datapath, and the boundary between pod networking and the physical fabric.8+ years in network engineering, with real depth in routing and switching across both enterprise and datacenter environments.BGP in production, and Anycast you have designed or operated. Not familiarity. Design decisions you made and can defend.Firewalls, IDS and IPS, and perimeter design. Barracuda and ASA or FTD are what we run.Multi-vendor switching. Cisco Nexus and Catalyst, Aruba, Ruckus.Azure networking: VNets, VPN gateways, hybrid connectivity. AWS or GCP a plus.Monitoring and root cause analysis in complex environments, with tools such as SolarWinds or Grafana, including the ability to prove where a fault is rather than where it is not.CCNP or equivalent depth. The certificate matters less than being able to walk us through a failure you diagnosed.Two or more DR implementations you took part in, including the testing.Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.How The Team WorksYou would join the IT Infrastructure team and work directly with platform engineering, security and the OEM vendors.On-call is a shared rotation, not a permanent state. Major incidents are escalated to the whole team, and we would rather fix the cause than staff the symptom.We expect ownership rather than ticket-taking. If you find something broken outside your area, we would rather you said so.This role is a step toward network architecture ownership across the estate as the Noida centre grows.Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/BenefitsAt apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.

  
Responsibilities:

Architecture and Design

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

Qualifications:

Required

* 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Security System Engineer** to design, implement, and operate secure, compliant network segmentation between regional environments and Global networks, using a standardised control stack of Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Cloudflare for DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application protection. This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Problem Manager
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About This Opportunity**

We are looking for a proactive and analytical Problem Manager – Core Domain to join our L1 NOC (Network Operations Center) team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and managing recurring network problems within the Core network domain, driving root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes to minimize network disruptions.  
You will work closely with L1, L2, and L3 technical teams, service management stakeholders, and customer teams to ensure problem resolution aligns with SLA commitments and continual service improvement goals. This is a key role in strengthening operational stability and delivering a superior network experience for Ericsson's customers.

**What You Will Do**  
  

* Own end-to-end problem lifecycle management for Core network domain incidents
* Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents
* Identify problem trends through incident data analysis and proactive problem detection
* Raise and manage Problem Records in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow / BMC Remedy / JIRA)
* Drive Known Error identification and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB)
* Collaborate with L1 NOC, L2, and L3 teams to facilitate timely problem investigation and resolution
* Coordinate with Core network engineers, field teams, and vendor support for problem closure
* Escalate critical or unresolved problems to senior technical leads and management as per the escalation matrix
* Interface with the customer / client teams for problem status updates and post-incident reviews
* Prepare and deliver high-quality RCA reports and Problem Management reports to internal and external stakeholders
* Document workarounds, known errors, and resolution steps in the knowledge base
* Maintain accurate problem logs, closure reports, and trend analysis records
* Support audit and compliance activities with relevant documentation
* Analyze problem trends and recurring fault patterns to identify improvement opportunities
* Work with operations and technical teams to implement preventive actions and process improvements
* Contribute to SLA performance improvement initiatives and reduction of repeat incidents
* Participate in service review meetings and provide problem management inputs

**What You Will Bring**  
  

* Good understanding of Core network technologies – IMS, VoLTE, EPC, 4G/5G Core, CS Core, MSS, MGW, HLR/HSS
* Familiarity with telecom network architecture and end-to-end service flow in Core domain
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA
* Understanding of alarm monitoring platforms and NMS/EMS tools
* Working knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes

**Experience & Qualifications**  

* 5-10 years of experience in telecom network operations, with at least 5 years in a Problem Management or senior NOC role
* Hands-on experience in Core domain fault management, incident analysis, or network support
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns across large incident datasets
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder reporting and RCA documentation
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science) or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) preferred
* Exposure to 24x7 NOC operations environment
* Prior experience in Managed Services / Network Operations for a telecom operator or OEM

**All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.**

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

description:
**Req ID:** 393617
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a NAC Senior Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
In this role, Candidate is expected with an experience in core areas such as Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting, NAC (Network Access Control), and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the administration, upkeep, and upgrade of Cisco ISE solutions and deep understanding of network security concepts, Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols, endpoint profiling, posture assessments, BYOD, Guest, pxGrid, DNAC integration with ISE and network access control (NAC) technologies.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Design and Implementation: Collaborate with infra and security teams to design, implement and customize Cisco ISE solutions, integrate third party solutions to bolster the security posture of the organization and to meet, security business and regulatory requirements.
* AAA Configuration: Review and configure Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols such as RADIUS and TACACS+ on Cisco ISE for secure network access. Ensure to leverage industry best practices to reduce the attack surface areas.
* Endpoint Profiling: Understand, develop, and maintain endpoint profiling policies to classify and manage devices accessing the network based on their characteristics.
* Network Access Control (NAC): Deploy and manage NAC solutions using Cisco ISE to enforce security policies, monitor network access, and ensure compliance.
* Policy Management: Define and manage access control policies, posture assessments, and identity-based access controls within Cisco ISE.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network, security, and IT teams to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions (SIEM and log management), identity providers, and network infrastructure components.
* Troubleshooting and Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to Cisco ISE configurations, authentication failures, load balancer, licensing, and network access problems.
* Documentation and Training: Maintain comprehensive documentation of Cisco ISE configurations, policies, and procedures. Develop method and procedures in alignment with Change management best practices and provide training and knowledge transfer to varied team members.
* Upgrade and Patch Management: Plan and execute upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities for Cisco ISE deployments to ensure system stability and security. Escalate and troubleshoot along with Cisco TAC for identified bugs and potential work arounds.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network engineers, security teams, and IT stakeholders to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions, applications, and network infrastructure components.

* Cisco ISE Certification

title: On-site Technology Senior Support Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**On-site Technology Senior Support Specialist**
**(Senior Associate)**
**Enterprise Technology (ET)**
Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world-class technology infrastructure.
  
  
Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As part of Enterprise Technology, the On-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.
  
  
The On-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).
* Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents.
* Resolve complex incidents associated with firm-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.
* Acts as a lead to less experienced specialists
* Provide after-hours service for escalated issues or tasks from the Service Desk or supervisor.
* Perform asset management activities (procurement, receipt, inventory, tracking, distribution, etc.) as assigned and in accordance with firm policy and EY Technology process.
* Anticipates technology support issues and acts to creatively to prioritize tasks, interpret solutions and apply knowledge to facilitate the development and implementation of technical business solutions to complex customer technology needs and issues
* Works independently on small projects and assesses the local needs of area offices and responds appropriately
* Document and track the status of enquiries, coordinate appropriate responses and follow-up to ensure customer satisfaction
* Work effectively as “remote hands” for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology’s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents.
* Understand the Firm’s business and organization sufficiently to anticipate and resolve end user technology issues that affect productivity of Firm personnel
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Advanced analytical skills are required to address end-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk-up issues.
* Decision making responsibilities can be made to address issues impacting large numbers of customers within the supported geography and communicate effectively to customers as necessary.
* Experience in leading projects and overseeing contribution and performance of project members
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is desirable.

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, organizational, project and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service attitude.
* Demonstrated multitasking abilities in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 4-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support

**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: PAM Specialist
description:

mispa Technologies is an innovative IT security services and solution provider with head office in Langenfeld (Rhineland), Germany and Dev & Operations Center in Cochin (India), established in 2014.

We focus on IT consulting, and managed services that use Innovative Technologies. You will have the opportunity to work in a collegial and diverse environment that is uniquely inspiring and respectful, where employees develop and share experiences, insights, perspectives, and creative solutions in cross-functional teams. mispa Technologies offers you the opportunity to become part of an international team and improve the service we provide to our customers. Don't just build a career, Love IT.

To further strengthen our managed Services team, we are looking for you as a Senior Infrastructure Specialist PAM & IAM to ensure the seamless delivery of client services.

We rely on strong teamwork, flat hierarchies, agile innovation, and a strong customer focus and are looking for people who are team players, want to make a difference, enjoy and are interested in IT security.

**Your Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, engineer and manage PAM solutions from
  **BeyondTrust**
  to secure critical systems and infrastructure.
* Configure and maintain privileged account vaults, password rotation policies, and access workflows
* Troubleshoot PAM issues including credential vault failures, session recording errors, and access request failures
* Integrate PAM solutions with other enterprise systems, such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and ticketing systems.
* Manage Azure privileged access using Entra PIM and Conditional Access
* Utilize scripting languages like PowerShell or Python to automate routine tasks and reporting.
* Conduct periodic audits, access reviews, and compliance reporting
* Administer
  **Active Directory, LDAP, and Entra ID environments**
* Enforce MFA, adaptive access policies, and RBAC across hybrid environments
* Monitor authentication logs, failed login attempts, and security threats

title: QA Engineer (Automation + Manual)
description:
**Hiring JD QA Engineer**

**Job Title**
QA Engineer (Automation + Manual)

**Overall experience:**
3-6 years

**Location - Bangalore - Work from Office**

**Role Overview**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer plays a vital role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products and customer satisfaction. This role involves planning, implementing, and automating various testing strategies throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). QA Engineers work closely in cross-functional teams, including stakeholders, developers, and delivery team members, to ensure that the product meets stakeholder expectations and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Planning & Execution**

* Design and implement comprehensive test plans to verify functional requirements, performance, and usability of both new and existing software products.
* Perform regression, integration, functional, performance, manual, and exploratory testing to identify unexpected issues and gain a deeper understanding of the system.
* Perform regression testing of the system to ensure new functionality does not impact existing functionality.
* Assist business stakeholders or end users in conducting user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the software meets business requirements.
* Document test results, analyze findings, and recommend corrective actions.
* Apply knowledge of accessibility standards and guidelines (such as WCAG, ADA, and Section 508) in software testing.

**Test Automation & Integration**

* Plan, create, execute, and automate test cases using specialized tools and scripts to ensure thorough testing of the software.
* Identify opportunities to reduce testing time and effort by automating repeatable tests, and enhance and maintain the test automation framework.
* Work with CI/CD pipelines to integrate automated tests into the build process.
* Ensure test environments are set up for optimal testing conditions.

**Collaboration & Defect Management**

* Collaborate with delivery team members, product management, and other stakeholders to integrate testing into the development process and provide valuable input on potential quality issues early in the SDLC.
* Manage defect (bug) tickets, including clear steps to reproduce and expected results, and advocate for the resolution of found defects.
* Utilize Agile/Scrum practices to enhance the development process.

**Quality Advocacy**

* Contribute and promote quality and testing best practices throughout the organization.
* Collaborate and share information with other software QA engineers by participating in a community of practice.
* Stay updated with the latest testing methodologies and tools, and research, recommend, and implement new testing technologies and practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 3-6 years of development and/or QA testing experience.
* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Experience writing test automation scripts, and designing and implementing test plans.
* Familiarity with test automation frameworks, specifically Playwright.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python).
* Experience with SQL, and familiarity with RESTful API testing using tools like Postman or REST Assured.
* Experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools (e.g., New Relic, Dynatrace).
* Experience with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) tools.
* Strong knowledge of agile practices.
* High attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and take ownership of tasks.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are advantageous.

title: Software Engineer - Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing, Scale & Performance, Python | 4-8 years
description:
**Meet the Team**
The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments.
  
  
You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution.
  
  

* You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness.
* Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane,subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements.
* Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load.
* Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios.
* Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution.
* Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles.
* Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios.
* Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity.
* Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior.
* Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites.
* Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis.
* Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions.
* Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads.
* Validate subscriber QoS, accounting, lawful intercept, policy enforcement, and other service-provider features under functional and scale conditions.
* Validate CLI, YANG models, model-driven telemetry, gRPC/NETCONF/gNMI, and operational data required for managing and troubleshooting large cnBNG deployments.
* Debug sophisticated solution-level issues using IOS-XR logs, traces, telemetry, packet captures, core dumps, IXIA/Spirent statistics, and platform/NPU diagnostics.
* Perform detailed root-cause isolation, determining whether failures originate in the Control Plane, User Plane, forwarding infrastructure, Silicon One NPU, automation environment, traffic generator, or external network components.
* Partner closely with development, platform, system architecture, and customer-facing engineering teams to reproduce defects and drive them to closure.
* Define measurable test exit criteria and provide data-driven release-quality and readiness recommendations based on functional, scale, performance, and resiliency results.
* Use Git and modern software-development practices for automation code, test reviews, defect management, and CI/CD integration.
* Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for automation development, test generation, log analysis, failure clustering, defect analysis, and troubleshooting while responsibly validating AI-generated output.
* Mentor junior engineers and help improve solution-testing methodology, automation architecture, scale infrastructure, and overall engineering quality.

**Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering,
* Telecommunications, or a related field. Strong experience in system, solution, scale, performance, and resiliency testing of networking products or carrier-grade networking solutions.
* Strong understanding of test methodologies covering functional, integration, system, regression, scale, performance, stress, longevity, failover, and high-availability testing.
* Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
* protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis.
* Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
* Genie or equivalent frameworks.
