title: T&T-Customer - CS&D - | Financial Services PM/BA| Delhi Senior Consultant
description:
**T&T-Customer - CS&D - | Financial Services PM/BA| Delhi Senior Consultant**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 116171
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Customer is about much more than just the numbers. It’s about attesting to accomplishments and challenges and helping to assure strong foundations for future aspirations. Deloitte exemplifies the what, how, and why of change so you’re always ready to act ahead. Learn more about Customer

  

**Your work profile**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented **Business Analyst / Project Manager (BA/PM) Hybrid** to join our Market Security Services (MSS) team. This role sits at the intersection of business operations and technology, with a primary concentration on business analysis and a complementary focus on project management. You will specialize in the MSS domain—specifically targeting **Accounts, SSIs, Books, Hierarchy, and Pricing**. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between stakeholders and technical teams to drive process improvements, implement system enhancements, and ensure the integrity of our security data, financial workflows, and account structures.

  

**1. Business Analysis & Requirement Engineering (Core Focus)**

* **Domain Expertise:** Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Market Security Services, specifically focusing on Accounts management, Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI), Books architecture, Account Hierarchy, and Pricing models.
* **Requirement Gathering:** Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document complex business requirements for post-trade and static data systems.
* **Documentation:** Create high-quality business requirement documents (BRD), functional specification documents (FSD), user stories, and process flow diagrams (UML/BPMN).
* **Gap Analysis:** Perform detailed gap analysis between current "As-Is" processes and desired "To-Be" states to identify automation opportunities in data setup and trade routing.

**2. Domain-Specific Focus Areas**

* **Accounts & Hierarchy:** Streamline the onboarding and management of client/entity accounts, ensuring robust parent-child account hierarchy models and internal "Books" mapping for accurate downstream reporting.
* **Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI):** Oversee the automation and maintenance of SSIs across custody and clearing networks to mitigate settlement risk and reduce trade fail rates.
* **Pricing & Valuation:** Collaborate with pricing desks and market data vendors to implement or refine instrument valuation models, ensuring the integrity of real-time price feeds, corporate action adjustments, and end-of-day valuations.

**3. Project Management (Adaptive Focus)**

* **Lifecycle Management:** Coordinate project phases through the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using Agile, Scrum, or Hybrid methodologies.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary point of contact for business heads, technology teams, and external vendors to align operational priorities.
* **Delivery & Tracking:** Define project scope, create detailed project plans, manage timelines, track sprints, and mitigate risks/impediments to ensure on-time delivery.

**4. Testing & Quality Assurance**

* **User Acceptance Testing (UAT):** Lead the design, execution, and sign-off of UAT scripts, ensuring that system enhancements meet complex business logic and regulatory requirements.
* **Defect Management:** Collaborate with QA teams to prioritize, track, and resolve system defects during the testing phase.
  

**Key Skills Required :**

  

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in a Business Analyst role with progressive project coordination responsibilities within Investment Banking, Asset Management, or Securities Services.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the post-trade lifecycle, settlement processes, instrument master data, account hierarchy structures, internal book mappings, and security pricing.
* **Tools:** Proficiency in agile project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) and visual modeling software (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart).
* **Data Analysis:** Strong ability to write SQL queries and manipulate complex data structures in Excel to support data profiling and business logic validation.

**Soft Skills:**

* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for presenting technical and operational roadmaps to senior leadership.
* **Problem-Solving:** A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks in financial workflows and proposing scalable architecture solutions.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to balance deep-dive business analysis with project delivery timelines in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

**Education & Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* CBAP, CSPO, CSM, PMP, or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

title: SR SPECIALIST, DIGITAL OPERATIONS & WEB EXPERIENCE
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary:**

Northern Trust is seeking a Senior Digital Operations & Web Experience Analyst to help build, operate and continuously improve how digital content and experiences are delivered across our owned digital ecosystem.

This is not a traditional web-publishing role. The position combines digital operations, workflow and process optimization, governance, hands-on publishing, quality assurance, performance improvement and cross-functional enablement.

The initial and largest focus will be our global public web ecosystem, where the opportunity to improve operational consistency, scalability and performance is greatest. The broader mandate extends across the owned digital channels and platforms managed by Digital Marketing. You will help establish common workflows, standards and operating practices so content can be created, approved, published, distributed, measured and optimized consistently—regardless of platform or destination.

You will work as an integral member of a global Enterprise Digital organization, partnering with Marketing, Content, Digital Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility, Compliance and business teams.

**Major Duties:**

**Digital workflow and process excellence**
-------------------------------------------

* Own and continuously improve workflows spanning intake, requirements, prioritization, production, approvals, publishing/distribution, QA, measurement and optimization.
* Map current-state processes and identify bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, duplication, control gaps and sources of rework.
* Create and maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, checklists, service expectations, decision criteria and escalation paths.
* Use operational data to improve cycle time, throughput, quality and predictability.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work through process redesign, automation and platform integration.

**Owned digital publishing and delivery**
-----------------------------------------

* Independently manage complex digital requests and releases from intake through post-launch validation.
* Author, maintain and publish content in Adobe Experience Manager or a comparable enterprise CMS.
* Support enterprise websites, landing pages, insights and thought-leadership experiences, product and solution content, localized experiences and other owned digital destinations.
* Manage content and asset requirements including metadata, taxonomy, tagging, approvals, localization and lifecycle.
* Promote approved templates, reusable components and structured-content practices that enable scale.

**Standards, governance and risk reduction**
--------------------------------------------

* Help define, document, operationalize and maintain digital publishing and delivery standards.
* Translate UX, design-system, accessibility, SEO, analytics, content, privacy, compliance and technology requirements into practical procedures.
* Establish and apply QA and release-readiness practices.
* Identify inconsistent practices, unnecessary customization and workarounds that create operational risk, technical debt or fragmented experiences.
* Coordinate exceptions with the appropriate Product, Technology, Design or control owner.

**Quality and experience assurance**
------------------------------------

* Perform and improve pre- and post-publication QA.
* Validate content accuracy, page structure, responsive behavior, links, imagery, documents, metadata, accessibility, SEO, analytics and experience requirements.
* Coordinate defect remediation and support regression testing and production validation.
* Analyze recurring defects to identify root causes and preventive improvements.

**Performance and optimization**
--------------------------------

* Partner with Analytics, SEO, UX and Digital Product teams to understand operational, site-health and experience performance.
* Translate insight into prioritized opportunities that improve discoverability, accessibility, usability, engagement and conversion where applicable.
* Support audits, testing and experimentation; validate whether changes deliver the intended result.
* Create a closed loop from publish to measure, learn, optimize and standardize.

**Automation, integration and productivity**
--------------------------------------------

* Identify repetitive tasks and workflow bottlenecks suitable for automation.
* Translate operational problems into requirements for Product, MarTech and Technology teams.
* Support integrations connecting work management, CMS, DAM, analytics and related platforms.
* Participate in implementation, testing, adoption and benefits measurement for workflow and platform enhancements.
* Evaluate responsible AI-enabled improvements where they solve a defined operational problem and preserve quality and controls.

**Cross-functional partnership and enablement**
-----------------------------------------------

* Serve as an operational bridge between business requirements and digital execution.
* Coordinate dependencies across Marketing, Content, Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility and control teams.
* Explain standards, platform constraints and operating requirements in clear business terms.
* Support onboarding, training and change adoption for publishers, contributors and stakeholders.
* Surface systemic problems and improvement opportunities to Digital leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Digital Marketing, Marketing Technology, Information Systems, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in digital operations, web operations, digital production, content operations, marketing operations or digital-experience delivery.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise websites, content-management platforms or complex digital ecosystems; Adobe Experience Manager strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning or improving end-to-end digital workflows.
* Experience developing or improving SOPs, governance practices, QA standards or operational controls.
* Experience coordinating complex work across business and technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of accessibility, SEO, analytics, UX, content lifecycle and web-performance fundamentals.
* Experience using operational or performance data to identify problems and improve outcomes.
* Strong prioritization, documentation, facilitation, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a global, matrixed organization.

**Preferred**

* Adobe Experience Manager Sites and Assets; Adobe Workfront or a comparable work-management platform.
* Adobe Analytics and/or Google Analytics 4.
* Global, multilingual or multisite content operations; localization, translation or MSM experience.
* WCAG accessibility, technical/on-page SEO and Core Web Vitals knowledge.
* Workflow automation, systems integration, structured-content or content-supply-chain experience.
* Agile delivery, experimentation, personalization or conversion-optimization exposure.
* Financial services or another regulated enterprise environment.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Digital Content Experience Analyst
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

**Summary of the role:**

The Digital Content Experience Analyst is responsible for the quality, consistency and commercial effectiveness of content on Levi.com across East Asia Pacific. The role leads content strategy and experience design for the site, including the homepage, landing pages, product detail pages and campaign content, so that every market delivers accurate, localised and compelling brand storytelling that attracts, engages and converts consumers.

Working from the Global Talent Hub in India, the role acts as the content partner to country eCommerce teams. It translates campaign plans, product launches and consumer insight into content roadmaps, templates and standards that Site Operations can publish at scale, leads localisation, on-site SEO, content testing and CMS governance, and works with Creative, Marketing and Global teams to ensure timely and accurate asset hand-off.

**About the role:**

**Content strategy, roadmap and storytelling**
----------------------------------------------

* Develop and own the regional Levi.com content strategy and roadmap, aligned with brand direction, seasonal product launches, promotional moments and market priorities.
* Build campaign and storytelling plans for product launches, site refreshes and platform activities, including editorial or blog content, adapting global content to the needs of each market.
* Maintain the content calendar across supported markets, co-ordinating inputs, approvals and delivery dates with country teams, Marketing, Creative and Site Operations.
* Use consumer insight, market study and performance data to identify content gaps and prioritise the highest-impact content opportunities.
* Ensure content reflects the brand voice and presents product in a way that builds brand equity and supports conversion.

**Landing page, product detail page and campaign content experience**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Define the content experience for the homepage, landing pages, campaign pages and product detail pages, including layout, modules, imagery, video, copy and calls to action.
* Design and standardise reusable page templates and content modules that let markets launch faster and more consistently, while allowing approved local variation.
* Provide Site Operations with complete, approved content briefs and specifications, with clear acceptance criteria and publishing windows.
* Own the standard for product detail page content, including descriptions, imagery, video and product storytelling, working with Creative, Merchandising and Product teams.
* Take a mobile-first approach to content, and review the live site regularly to prioritise fixes, refreshes and improvements.

**Localisation, content governance and CMS standards**
------------------------------------------------------

* Lead translation and localisation with agencies and local teams, setting quality standards for second-language and market-specific content, tone and terminology.
* Establish and maintain content standards, style guides, brand and compliance guidelines and quality checklists for consumer-facing content.
* Act as the CMS subject matter expert, defining content models, template rules, permissions and release practices, and mitigating risks within the platform.
* Partner with Creative and Global teams to ensure timely, accurate asset hand-off and consistent use of global assets, naming and metadata.
* Validate content quality and business acceptance of new templates, modules and CMS changes, working with Site Operations and Digital Product on UAT.

**SEO, testing and content performance optimisation**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Define and apply on-site SEO best practice for page structure, metadata, copy, taxonomy and product listing content, working with SEO and traffic-management agencies.
* Plan and run A/B and multivariate content tests with Digital Product and Data & Analytics, interpreting results and scaling winning experiences.
* Track content KPIs, including conversion rate, engagement, search visibility and average order value, and share insight and recommended actions with markets.
* Turn business questions into analyses that show the impact of content on sales, engagement and profitability, and maintain content reporting and dashboards.
* Use behavioural analytics tools (e.g. Content Square) to understand how consumers interact with content and prioritise optimisations.

**Customer engagement, retention and lifecycle content**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Develop content experiences that attract new consumers and encourage repeat purchase, loyalty participation and ongoing engagement on Levi.com.
* Partner with CRM and Marketing to align on-site content with email, SMS and lifecycle programmes so messaging is consistent across touchpoints.
* Support loyalty and member-experience content on the site in line with programme priorities.
* Explore content formats that raise engagement, such as editorial, video, live streaming and influencer or creator content, with Marketing and agencies.
* Use consumer feedback and Customer Service insight to improve content clarity and the consumer journey.

**Cross-functional partnership, vendor and capability leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead the regional content practice by expertise, coaching coordinators, content specialists and agency resources on standards, tools and best practice.
* Manage content-creation, translation and SEO agencies on quality, responsiveness and capacity, and escalate performance issues early.
* Document playbooks, templates, checklists and training to reduce key-person dependency and enable consistent execution across markets.
* Communicate content priorities, risks and performance clearly to eCommerce leadership and market stakeholders.
* Maintain effective working rhythms across India and EAP time zones so market teams receive responsive, reliable support.

**About you:**

**Experience and qualifications**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, digital or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of eCommerce experience, ideally within apparel, retail or brand contexts.
* Experience producing and managing content for digital channels (site, landing pages, product detail pages, email, blog) in a CMS or back-office platform.
* Experience delivering localisation and translation across markets and co-ordinating content refreshes with agencies and local teams.
* Experience with site QA, troubleshooting and user acceptance testing alongside development teams.
* Experience with Shopify or another enterprise commerce platform and CMS tools.
* Working knowledge of on-site SEO, A/B testing and web analytics (e.g. Google Analytics) and BI dashboards.

**Core capabilities**
---------------------

* Strong storytelling and content-planning skills, with an eye for how content shapes perception and conversion.
* Understanding of UX and UI principles with a consumer-focused, commercial mindset.
* Strong understanding of eCommerce KPIs and the conversion funnel, and ability to turn analytics into optimisations.
* Ability to turn campaign requirements into clear content briefs, specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Strong attention to detail and quality management across languages, formats and devices.
* Ability to work effectively across commercial, creative and technical teams in different markets and time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with confidence managing agencies and competing priorities.

**Leadership attributes**
-------------------------

* Consumer-focused, detail-oriented and calm under pressure.
* Balances brand expression with performance, clarity and commercial outcomes.
* Balances speed with quality and regional consistency with legitimate local needs.
* Builds trust and influence across locations and functions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Curious and eager to learn; shares knowledge and helps raise content capability across the team.

**Benefits:**  
We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.

Here's a small snapshot:

* Complimentary preventive health check-up for you & your spouse
* OPD coverage

* Counselling sessions to prioritize mental well-being

We actively seek and encourage applications from diverse candidates, including those with disabilities, and offer accommodations throughout the selection process upon request.*

title: Market Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Market Intelligence Analyst joins GE HealthCare’s Global Marketing Analytics team to build the Power BI dashboards and data models that marketing leaders use to make decisions, and to help develop AI agents that make those insights easier to access. Working on the delivery side, the role turns requirements and KPIs defined by business partners into working analytics products. The analyst works alongside an experienced technical lead who sets standards and reviews work, making this a strong early-career opportunity to build engineering discipline.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology, pharmaceutical diagnostics and digital solutions innovator. In India, we operate through a multi-entity structure spanning manufacturing, R&D, sales and service, and a long-standing joint venture, Wipro GE Healthcare.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Builds Power BI dashboards and reports from approved requirements through to release. Develops reusable semantic models, DAX measures, Power Query transformations and SQL components, applying agreed KPI definitions and visualization, accessibility and usability standards consistently.
* Builds and iterates on AI agents, including agent logic, prompts, data connections and integrations to governed data. Tests agent accuracy and behavior and fixes defects raised during evaluation.
* Follows repeatable QA, documentation and release practices and helps improve deployment and version management. Monitors refresh failures, defects and performance issues and resolves them promptly.
* Participates in stakeholder workshops, demonstrations and user-acceptance testing, and turns feedback into build changes. Works to defined standards under the guidance of a technical lead, accepts peer review, and develops technical depth through hands-on delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing or a related quantitative field. , with minimum 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics or a comparable data discipline.
* Strong internships, academic or personal projects are considered relevant experience.
* Hands-on Power BI skills including report building, DAX, Power Query and dimensional modeling (star schema). Working SQL skills including joins, aggregations, filtering and window functions, with the ability to profile and validate source data.
* Practical exposure to building with AI and large language model tools such as agents, copilots, chatbots or retrieval-augmented prototypes, using platforms like Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure OpenAI.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Clear oral and written communication skills, with the ability to explain a chart, metric or agent response to a non-technical audience. Comfortable working to defined standards, documenting work and accepting peer review.
* Familiarity with marketing data sources such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Salesforce (SFDC), Marketo, LinkedIn, Meta, Sprinklr or Meltwater. Experience with the Power BI service, including workspaces, deployment pipelines, row-level security, gateways and refresh scheduling.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms. Awareness of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation methods and responsible-AI practices.

title: Senior Supplier Quality & Development Engineer
description:
Rotork is the market-leading global flow control and instrumentation company, helping our customers manage the flow or liquids, gases and powders across many industries worldwide.
  
  
Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.
  
  
**Job Description**
Senior Supplier Quality & Development Engineer (SQDE) is responsible within India for approval and development of assigned suppliers in line with Rotork group standards. The role provides local support, for export to international Rotork sites.
  
  
The SQDE supports global Category strategies by working with the Category Manager to deliver procurement projects. The SDQE will assess potential suppliers, complete onboarding, support development and sample approval activities at the supplier to ensure purchased products meet the requirements of any Rotork sites, and Rotork’s global sustainability objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a key member of the Supplier Quality team within the India Procurement team, the Supplier Quality & Development Engineer will be responsible for:
  
  

* Evaluating the H&S, ESG, technical process capabilities and management systems of new suppliers during supplier selection.
* Plan, organize supplier audits - audit quality management system to verify that quality systems and plans consistently deliver conforming materials. Develop and implement improvement strategies to close identified gaps.
* Partner with Suppliers, Engineering, and Operations to lead new part development & ensure rapid resolution of technical problems and quality issues. Support suppliers to complete tooling and process “Design For Manufacture” (DFM), and Rotork’s “Sample Approval” (PPAP) process. Implement statistical supplier quality program and yield reporting as required.
* Use supplier scorecards and data to drive ongoing enhancements in supplier process capability, directly supporting Rotork’s H&S, sustainability, cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Play a pivotal role in Catergory team success, achieving cost targets, quality goals, and supplier base optimization.
* Lead supplier quality activities for assigned commodities, set and monitor technical/quality metrics, and ensure continuous improvement targets are met.
* Regular report to management on suppliers quality performance, includes incoming rejection rate, suppliers’ process yield, quality system maintenance, results of on site audit, etc
* Lead structured problem-solving initiatives to achieve sustainable corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

**Qualifications**
The ideal candidate will be a proactive, analytical thinker with strong communication skills and the following qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering (or related discipline).
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Supplier Quality Engineering or Supplier Development, with proven success in driving cost and quality improvements.
* Hands-on experience with Casting (Al, Steel, Cast Iron), forgings, Fabrication and machining supplier processes.
* Applied expertise in Statistical Process Control (SPC), measurement systems, and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
* Exposure to different global material standards such as ASTM, ISO, BS & API
* Hands-on experience in NDE processes – Visual inspection, Radiography, Ultrasonic testing & Pressure testing.
* Experience in metallurgical and mechanical testing of materials including tensile, hardness testing, tensile testing and microstructure examination.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional team and manage supplier/process changes effectively.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally, with regular travel across the India supply base.
* Preferred candidates with experience operating within a Matrix organizational structure
* Lean Six Sigma experience is desirable; Six Sigma certification (Green/Black Belt) is preferred

title: SAP PP-PI Consultant (with QM)
description:
**SAP PP-PI Consultant (with QM)| SRM Tech | Chennai/Bangalore - Hybrid**

**About SRM Tech**

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services.

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale.

As a Great Place to Work®-certified organization, we are committed to creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and thrive. We believe empowered individuals drive innovation, deliver value to customers, and play a meaningful role in shaping our collective success.

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

**Position**

SAP PP-PI Consultant (with QM)

**Module**

SAP PP-PI (Production Planning for Process Industries) with QM

**Experience**

5-7 years (relevant SAP experience)

**Industry**

Pharmaceutical / Biotech - process manufacturing (GMP)

**Engagement**

Production support for 24x7 manufacturing operations

**Work schedule**

Rotational shifts / on-call; weekend and holiday support for critical incidents

**Location**

Chennai or Bangalore – Hybrid work

**About the Client**

Our client is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and manufacture of biosimilar medicines. SAP is their enterprise ERP platform, covering manufacturing, quality management, planning, production scheduling, warehouse management, finance and HR. Their GMP manufacturing plants operate 24x7, and the SAP landscape supporting them must be available and stable around the clock.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an SAP PP-PI consultant with strong Quality Management (QM) knowledge to provide 24x7 functional support for process manufacturing at a biopharmaceutical client. The consultant will keep production orders, batch execution and quality processes running smoothly on the plant floor, resolve incidents quickly, and drive continuous improvements in a GMP-regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L1.5, L2/L3 functional support for SAP PP-PI and QM, resolving incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs
* Support process order lifecycle: creation, release, material staging, confirmation, goods movements, settlement and TECO
* Maintain and troubleshoot master data: master recipes, resources, BOMs, production versions, control recipe destinations
* Support PI sheets / XSteps and integration with MES and shop-floor systems
* Support batch management: batch classification, batch determination, shelf life / expiry, batch where-used and genealogy
* Handle QM processes: inspection plans, inspection lots (incoming, in-process, final, stability), results recording, usage decisions, quality notifications and certificates of analysis
* Support release and quarantine processes in coordination with QA and the warehouse
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues and implement permanent fixes through the GxP change-control process
* Prepare functional specifications, test scripts and validation evidence (IQ/OQ/PQ, UAT) for changes and enhancements
* Work closely with PP-DS, EWM, MM and FI/CO consultants on cross-module issues

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5-7 years of SAP experience with hands-on PP-PI in a process industry (pharma, biotech, life sciences, chemicals, food or similar)
* Strong working knowledge of SAP QM integrated with PP-PI
* At least one production support engagement and preferably one full-cycle implementation
* Solid understanding of batch management, process orders, master recipes and goods movements
* Working knowledge of GMP and GxP, computer system validation (CSV), 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11
* Ability to read and debug basic configuration, user exits and IDocs with technical teams

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Pharma or biotech manufacturing experience
* Exposure to MES integration and SAP ME/MII
* Working knowledge of PP-DS, EWM or MM
* Experience on SAP S/4HANA in addition to ECC

**Work Conditions**

* This is a 24x7 production support role for live manufacturing operations. The candidate will work in a rotational shift / on-call model as agreed with the client.
* Must be flexible to work on weekends and public holidays when a critical (P1/P2) incident affecting manufacturing needs to be resolved.
* Must follow ITIL-based incident, problem and change management, and the client's GxP change-control procedures.
* Must be able to work with global, multi-time-zone teams including business users, IT, QA/compliance and other SAP module consultants.

**Soft Skills**

* Clear written and spoken English; able to explain issues and fixes to shop-floor, QA and business users
* Calm, structured approach under pressure during production-down situations
* Strong root-cause analysis and documentation discipline (RCA, KEDB, SOPs, test evidence)
* Ownership mindset: follows an incident through to closure and permanent fix

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
* SAP certification in the relevant module is preferred
* Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites for short periods if required

*SRM Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, without bias or discrimination, in line with applicable laws.*

title: Firmware Engineer
description:

We are seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to join our automotive engineering team. * CAN, UDS, SOME/IP, and TCP/IP
* RTOS (FreeRTOS / Zephyr / AUTOSAR)

* Static Code Analysis (MISRA-C / Klocwork / CLang)
* Unit testing (GTest / VectorCAST)
* Integration testing (CANoe)

* Work with platforms like FreeRTOS and AUTOSAR, contributing to protocol stacks and driver development.
* Develop Python-based automation scripts and test frameworks for validation.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, and debugging to ensure reliability and compliance with coding standards.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Adnova**

Adnova is a creative workflow and ad operations platform used by 5000+ DTC brands and performance marketing agencies, mostly in the US and UK. Our products, including Creative Analytics, Ad Launcher, Inspo and Creative Hub, plug into ad accounts and help teams find winning ads, launch faster and research competitors. We’re bootstrapped and profitable.

**The role**

We’re hiring someone to own it end to end. You’ll be the person customers rely on when something breaks, and the person engineering trusts to only escalate what’s actually a bug.

**What you’ll do**

* Own technical support across Slack Connect channels, Intercom and email, with clear response and resolution times
* Debug issues yourself: check logs, inspect API responses, query the database, reproduce bugs, and find the root cause before escalating
* Troubleshoot Meta integrations: ad account connections, permissions, token expiry, Business Manager setup, and data sync gaps
* Write clean Jira tickets for real bugs, with steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual behaviour, and impact, then follow up until they’re fixed
* Spot recurring issues and push for fixes, so the same ticket doesn’t come up 20 times
* Build and maintain help docs, macros and saved replies
* Help set up support automation and AI-assisted replies
* Run onboarding and troubleshooting calls with customers when needed
* Help customers using our API and MCP server

**What we’re looking for**

* 2–4 years in technical support, support engineering or QA at a SaaS company
* Comfort with REST APIs, JSON, browser dev tools and reading logs
* Basic SQL or MongoDB querying
* An understanding of how web apps work: auth, OAuth, webhooks, and frontend vs. backend issues
* Clear, calm written English for US/UK customers. You can explain a technical problem to a non-technical marketer
* Ownership. You close the loop and don’t just pass tickets along
* Willingness to work hours that overlap with US/UK customers

**Bonus**

* Experience with the Meta Ads API, Business Manager, or any ad tech or martech product
* Scripting in Python or JavaScript for quick checks and automations
* Experience with Pylon, Intercom, Jira or similar tools
* Experience writing help-centre documentation

**Why join**

* Take full ownership of support at a fast-growing, profitable SaaS company
* Work directly with the CTO and founder, with real influence over the product
* A clear path to Support Lead as the team grows
* Competitive salary based on experience

title: Mainframe Developer-Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Product Specialist
  
  
As a Senior Product Specialist you will drive large-scale legacy modernization by transforming complex mainframe environments into modern, cloud-ready application ecosystems. This role blends deep mainframe engineering experience with hands-on capability in AI-assisted business rule extraction, automated code transformation, and modern architecture design. You will help accelerate migration outcomes, reduce delivery risk, and improve maintainability across critical enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Product Specialist on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Mining and documenting business rules from COBOL, PL/I, Assembler, and JCL codebases using static analysis and AI-assisted extraction techniques
* Leading transformation of legacy mainframe applications into Java, Python, or .NET solutions using automated conversion tools and manual remediation approaches
* Rewriting IBM utilities, batch processes, and control logic into modern implementations while preserving functional integrity, restart capability, and error-handling behavior
* Designing and modernizing interface patterns across batch, messaging, transaction, and API-based ecosystems to support phased migration and target-state architecture
* Supporting regression validation, traceability, and modernization governance through testing, documentation, and collaboration with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders

**The team**
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements**
**Qualifications: BE/BTech**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; alternatively, 6+ years of experience in software engineering, application modernization, or mainframe transformation
* 6+ years of experience with mainframe technologies including COBOL, PL/I, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2, IMS, and Assembler
* Experience with DB2 and VSAM in a mainframe environment, including data structures, access methods, SQL, embedded SQL, or migration activities
* Experience using AI-assisted or automated business rule extraction tools on legacy codebases
* Experience using mainframe-to-Java, Python, or .NET transformation tools and modernization methodologies
* Experience rewriting IBM utilities such as SORT, IDCAMS, IEBGENER, or IEBCOPY using modern languages or frameworks
* Experience modernizing integration patterns across batch, message queue, transaction, API, or event-driven architectures

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with modernization tools such as IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z, Micro Focus Enterprise Suite, Blu Age, AWS Mainframe Modernization, TSRI, or Astadia
* Experience with LLM-based code understanding or prompt engineering workflows for legacy code analysis
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform for target-state hosting
* Experience with microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, or API management platforms
* Experience with Business Rules Management Systems such as Drools, IBM Operational Decision Manager, or Blaze Advisor
* Experience supporting modernization programs in banking, insurance, government, or healthcare

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

title: Test Engineer
description:
**About Cerebre**
cerebre is on a mission to build the data foundation of the physical world. We offer a live intelligence map of a facilities – built from schematics to power AI. Often called the “brain” of the digital twin, cerebre helps engineers, data scientists, and business teams understand data within the context of the plant.
  
  
We collaborate with the world’s largest companies and most innovative partners who are transforming the industrial sector.
  
  
cerebre is a global team of engineers, scientists, innovators, and explorers united by a mission to help the world’s largest manufacturing facilities build and use intelligence.
  
  
Our development team is made up of world-class engineers who design and deliver novel solutions. This is an opportunity to join a market-leading team that is changing how the industrial world works.
  
  
If you love building and creating value in the “white space,” if you thrive with the freedom and flexibility to think outside the box, if you are passionate about working with critical thinkers who challenge the status quo, and if you aspire to work in a fast-paced environment – we would love to meet you!
  
  
We believe flexibility drives creativity and that our team should live and work where we can be our best selves. We’re 100% remote and offer a competitive time-off package to ensure time for rest and recharge.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Test Engineer to elevate our software quality to the next level. As a member of our technology team, you will work daily with our world-class engineers. You will think broadly to create and execute test plans that ensure our products meet the highest standards. You will apply your engineering logic and keen attention to detail to solve some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry. You will have the freedom to design and implement your testing strategies with some of the brightest minds in the space.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning and Execution: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for our software products, ensuring that they meet the highest quality standards. This includes functional, regression, and performance testing.
* P&ID Documentation Review: Work closely with P&ID technical documentation to create relevant and accurate test cases. Ensure that all aspects of the engineering design are tested and validated. Defect Identification and Management: Identify, document, and track software defects using defect management tools. Work with developers to reproduce and resolve issues, ensuring timely fixes and improvements.
* Web Application Testing: Focus on testing web applications, ensuring they function correctly across different browsers, devices, and environments. Validate that the application meets user requirements, provides a smooth user experience, and performs reliably under different conditions.
* SDLC Integration: Integrate testing processes into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), ensuring that testing is an integral part of the development and deployment process. Tool Utilization: Utilize test design tools to create efficient and effective test cases. Employ defect management tools to track and report issues, providing clear and actionable feedback to the development team.
* Continuous Improvement: Continuously seek to improve testing processes, methodologies, and tools. Stay up to date with the latest testing trends and technologies to enhance testing effectiveness and efficiency.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to understand requirements, discuss testing strategies, and ensure alignment on quality goals.
* Technical Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of test plans, test cases, and test results. Provide clear and concise reports to the team, highlight areas of concern, and recommend improvements.
* Automation: Where applicable, identify opportunities for test automation to increase testing efficiency and coverage. Collaborate with the development team to implement automated tests as part of the CI/CD pipeline.
* Problem-Solving: Apply strong problem-solving skills to identify root causes of defects and propose solutions. Analyze test results to identify trends and prevent recurring issues.
* Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Mentor junior team members and share knowledge and best practices within the team. Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
* Global Team Collaboration: Work effectively within a globally distributed remote team, communicating effectively across time zones and cultural differences. Participate in regular team meetings and contribute to the overall success of the team

**Required Skills**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Test Engineer or in a similar role
* Experience in software testing, including test design, test case creation, and defect management
* Experience testing web applications
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g., TypeScript, Python, C#, or similar)
* Professional experience involving test automation
* Experience with Playwright or other test automation tools and frameworks
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving skills
* Desire to learn and continuously improve technical skills
* Ability to work effectively within a globally distributed remote team
* English proficiency at a minimum B2 level

**Preferred Skills**

* Graph Theory: Advanced knowledge of graph theory.
* TestMo: Experience using TestMo or similar test management tools.
* CAD Diagrams: Ability to read and create CAD diagrams.
* Startup Experience: Previous experience in a startup environment.
* Certification: ISTQB certification

**More About Cerebre**
**We are cross-functional collaborators.**
We blend manufacturing process knowledge with software and big data engineering expertise to create value in physical settings
  
  
**We Are Experienced.**
We are armed with industry-leading experts in numerical simulation, combustion, power, computational fluid dynamics, and chemical process modeling
  
  
**We are serious builders.**
We develop our platforms using leading practices in IT/OT architecture, OT security, AI architecture, ML Ops, and Platform engineering

**About The Role**
Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate
**Quality Engineer -Specialist**
focused on test automation for the Eclipse Intelligence Platform (EIP). If innovation and quality drive you forward, this is the place for you!
  
  
As a Quality Engineer Specialist, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team, ensuring the quality and reliability of critical data solutions for financial markets around the globe. You will work with cutting-edge technologies including Java, AWS, Kubernetes, and modern microservices architecture to build comprehensive test automation frameworks and strategies.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in a strong experienced team delivering complex technology solutions to our external clients. You will work with and learn from subject matter experts and have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and progress within the quality engineering team.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing (Role Responsibilities)**

* Continuous Learning: Passion for learning new testing tools, technologies, and methodologies
* Adaptability: Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced agile environment with changing priorities
* Quality Advocacy: Drive to promote quality practices and improve overall software quality

**Education:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience

**It Would Be Great If You Have (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Infrastructure-as-Code Testing: Experience validating Terraform or CloudFormation templates
* Observability Tools: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and tracing tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, etc.)

description:

**About Business Line/Function**
The Global Markets (GM) business of BNP Paribas helps its Corporate and Institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it.

The successful candidate will be able to – contribute or design high quality, innovative and fully performing test automation framework in compliance with coding standards and technical design. Participate in the testing process through test review and analysis. Good collaboration with Onshore and Offshore teams. BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. title: FS - RC - FSRM - CSTC - CREDIT RISK MGMT _Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance- SENIOR_MUM
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting –**
**Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) –Senior**
**Description**
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
  
  
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**:**
We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves:
  
  

* Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
* Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
* Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
* Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence
* Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence.
* Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
* Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols.
* Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
* Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement.
* Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues.
* Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks.
* Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution.
* Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations.
* Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership.
* Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols.

**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must-have:**

* CA or Bachelor’s/master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
* 5-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
* Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
* Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage

title: Compliance Auditor – Product Advisor
description:
**About the Company**

Seclodian is building a compliance assessment and remediation platform that helps organizations conduct structured, evidence-based audits and move findings through to closure.

We are looking for an experienced auditor or compliance professional to work with our product team on a fractional contract basis. You will bring the practitioner’s perspective into product design: helping us ensure that our workflows reflect how audits actually operate, testing new features, and telling us candidly whether they solve a meaningful problem.

This is not a daily operational role. We expect approximately five hours of contribution per week, arranged flexibly around agreed product reviews and testing cycles.

**What You Will Help Us Build**

You will advise and test an end-to-end audit lifecycle covering:

**Audit planning → Control testing → Evidence requests → Evidence submission → Evidence review → Sampling → Auditor comments → Exceptions and findings → Remediation → Re-testing → Audit conclusion and reporting**

Responsibilities

* Review product requirements, workflows, prototypes, and terminology from an auditor’s perspective.
* Help define realistic audit states, roles, permissions, decision points, and approval steps.
* Recommend what evidence, sampling records, reviewer notes, and audit trails should be maintained.
* Test product features using realistic audit scenarios and sample evidence.
* Identify workflow gaps, confusing interactions, missing controls, and risks to audit traceability.
* Assess whether proposed features provide genuine value to auditors, auditees, and compliance teams.
* Provide clear, prioritized feedback that product, design, engineering, and QA teams can act upon.
* Help define acceptance criteria and practical test scenarios.
* Participate in occasional product walkthroughs or feedback discussions.
* Support re-testing after improvements are implemented.

**Expected Deliverables**

Depending on the product stage, deliverables may include:

* Annotated workflow or prototype feedback.
* Audit lifecycle and control-testing recommendations.
* Evidence and sampling requirements.
* Realistic audit scenarios and test cases.
* Feature validation notes: valuable, needs improvement, or not valuable, with reasons.
* Identified exceptions, usability issues, and product gaps.
* Re-testing results and release recommendations.

**Ideal Background**

* Hands-on experience conducting or managing compliance, privacy, information security, internal, or technology audits.
* Strong understanding of control testing, evidence evaluation, sampling, findings, remediation, and audit reporting.
* Experience with one or more relevant frameworks or areas, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, privacy compliance, data protection, third-party risk, internal controls, or regulatory assessments.
* Ability to distinguish between sufficient evidence, incomplete evidence, management representations, and unsupported claims.
* Comfortable reviewing early-stage product designs and giving direct, constructive feedback.
* Strong written communication and the ability to translate audit practices into clear product requirements.
* Willingness to test workflows personally rather than providing only high-level advice.

**Particularly Valuable**

* Experience with privacy or data-protection assessments, including India’s DPDP framework.
* Experience using governance, risk, compliance, audit-management, or evidence-management software.
* Previous involvement in product discovery, user research, user acceptance testing, or SaaS product design.
* Relevant credentials such as CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CIA, CIPP, CIPM, or equivalent practical experience.

Certifications are helpful, but strong hands-on experience and product judgment are more important.

**Engagement**

* Independent contractor engagement.
* Approximately five hours per week.
* Remote and flexible, with mutually agreed meeting times.

**Why Work With Seclodian?**

This is an opportunity to shape an audit and compliance product while it is being built. Your recommendations will directly influence workflows, evidence requirements, testing behavior, and the experience of future auditors and compliance teams.

We value honest practitioner feedback. We are looking for someone who will challenge assumptions, demonstrate how audits work in real situations, and help us build features that are useful rather than merely impressive in a demonstration.

**How to Apply**

Please send the responses of the following questions to
**geetika.tiwari@seclodian.ai**
:

* A short summary of your relevant audit experience.
* The types of audits or assessments you have performed.
* Any experience with audit, GRC, privacy, or compliance software.
* Your preferred hourly rate and general weekly availability.
* An example of a workflow, control, or product feature you helped improve.

Please do not include confidential client reports or evidence.

title: Junior QC Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Junior QC Engineer**
Company: Küche7 Manufacturing Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
Department: Quality Control (QC)
  
  
Location: Bhiwandi, Maharashtra
  
  
Experience: 0–2 Years
  
  
Qualification: Diploma / BE in Mechanical Engineering
  
  
**Job Summary**
To perform technical quality inspections of raw materials, sheet metal components, fabricated parts, assemblies, and finished modular kitchen products to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, specifications, and quality standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Incoming Quality Inspection (IQC)

Inspect incoming SS sheets, hardware, hinges, channels, fasteners, glass, ceramic panels, and other purchased components.
  
  
Verify material grade, thickness, dimensions, surface finish, quantity, and supplier specifications.
  
  
Record inspection results and identify non-conforming materials.
  
  

* In-Process Quality Control (IPQC)

Conduct stage-wise inspections during laser cutting, bending, fabrication, bonding, painting, and assembly.
  
  
Verify component dimensions, hole positions, bend angles, flatness, squareness, and alignment against approved engineering drawings.
  
  
Check weld quality, joint finishing, burrs, scratches, dents, and surface defects.
  
  
Inspect ceramic and glass shutters for dimensions, edge finishing, bonding quality, and visible defects.
  
  

* Final Quality Inspection (FQC)

Inspect completed kitchen cabinets, shutters, drawers, wardrobes, and vanity units before dispatch.
  
  
Verify overall dimensions, diagonal measurements, door gaps, alignment, leveling, and fitment.
  
  
Check smooth operation of hinges, drawer channels, soft-close mechanisms, and other hardware.
  
  
Ensure product finish, appearance, assembly, and functionality meet approved specifications.
  
  

* Technical Tools & Measurement

Use vernier calipers, micrometers, measuring tapes, height gauges, try squares, feeler gauges, and angle gauges as applicable.
  
  
Interpret 2D engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and GD&T symbols at a basic level.
  
  
Maintain measurement records and ensure measuring instruments are calibrated as per schedule.
  
  

* Quality Documentation & Corrective Actions

Prepare incoming, in-process, and final inspection reports.
  
  
Maintain rejection, rework, and non-conformance records.
  
  
Support root cause analysis using 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and basic 7 QC tools.
  
  
Coordinate with Production, R&D, Purchase, and Dispatch teams to implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  
  
Support first-piece inspection, sample approval, and process improvement activities.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**
Knowledge of sheet metal manufacturing, laser cutting, bending, fabrication, and assembly processes.
  
  
Understanding of engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, and inspection methods.
  
  
Basic knowledge of 7 QC tools, 5S, Kaizen, and ISO 9001 quality systems.
  
  
Proficiency in MS Excel for inspection reports and quality data.
  
  
Ability to identify defects, analyze deviations, and communicate technical observations.
  
  
**Preferred Background**
Experience or training in sheet metal fabrication, stainless steel products, modular kitchens, furniture manufacturing, or precision engineering will be an advantage.
  
  
Suitable Candidates: Diploma / BE Mechanical freshers or candidates with 0–2 years of relevant manufacturing QC experience.
  
  
Skills: 5 why,engineering drawings,metal,excel,bending,iso 9001,5s,be mechanical,manufacturing,7 qc tools,dimensional tolerances,fishbone diagram,quality control,fabrication,qc,kaizen

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to test a cloud-based, distributed SaaS platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with 7–8+ years of experience. You should have broad technical knowledge and be able to think at the system level. You will own the quality of the product areas assigned to you. That means testing features, integrations, cloud behavior and complete customer workflows, and making sure test coverage leaves no critical risk untested. The right person has strong functional and system testing skills, knows cloud and microservices architecture well, and takes an investigative approach to finding complex defects that affect customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Test design and coverage*

* Design and run comprehensive functional, system, integration, end-to-end and regression tests for the areas you own.
* Build and maintain coverage for those areas (requirement traceability, risk-based coverage maps, mind maps) so that critical workflows, configurations and integrations are all validated.
* Find gaps in test coverage and close them proactively across releases.
* Design detailed test matrices covering permutations and combinations of configurations, user roles, deployments and data variations.

*System and cloud testing*

* Test across microservices, APIs, event streams, databases and third-party integrations.
* Validate application behavior in cloud environments (AWS, Azure or GCP), including scalability, failover, resiliency, multi-tenancy and behavior that depends on configuration.
* Find and investigate intermittent, concurrency, timing and distributed-system defects using logs, monitoring and observability tools.
* Check data integrity and transaction consistency with SQL/NoSQL queries and log analysis.

*Exploratory and customer-focused testing*

* Apply advanced exploratory, heuristic-based and risk-based testing to find edge cases, negative scenarios and hidden integration failures.
* Simulate real customer workflows under complex enterprise configurations and data volumes.
* Run impact analysis and sanity, regression and cross-functional checks for releases, patches and hotfixes.

*Collaboration*

* Work closely with Product, Development, DevOps and Architecture teams to clarify requirements and question assumptions early.
* Write clear defect reports that cover root cause, reproduction steps, business impact and troubleshooting details.
* Take an active part in Agile ceremonies, release readiness reviews and quality risk discussions.

**Mandatory Skills And Experience**
*Technical*

* 7–8+ years in software QA, with strong depth in functional, system, integration and end-to-end testing of enterprise SaaS or cloud products.
* Hands-on experience testing distributed, microservices-based applications on AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Strong ability to design tests and plan coverage, including test matrices, scenario combinations and risk-based prioritization.
* Hands-on REST API testing (Postman or similar) and backend validation with SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Strong debugging skills using logs, APIs, databases and monitoring tools (e.g. Kibana, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog).
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, containers and cloud infrastructure concepts as they affect testing.
* Experience in Agile/Scrum teams with fast release cycles.

*Soft skills*

* Strong ownership of and accountability for product quality.
* Ability to work independently on complex, loosely defined problems and turn them into clear test plans.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, and willingness to think beyond documented requirements.
* Clear communication and good collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to handle several testing activities in parallel and work under pressure.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Contact Center, CCaaS, Unified Communications, CX or telephony platforms.
* Exposure to omnichannel workflows such as voice, chat, email, routing, reporting and agent or supervisor workflows.
* Exposure to test automation (Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured or similar).
* Experience with performance, load or resiliency testing (JMeter, k6, chaos testing).
* Basic knowledge of security testing.
* ISTQB Advanced or an equivalent certification.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A seasoned, hands-on QA professional who sees the whole system rather than individual features. They understand how cloud infrastructure, services, data and customer workflows fit together, and their test coverage reflects that. They are technically curious, very good at exploratory testing, and focused on delivering stable, high-quality releases.
  
  
**Work Location and Hours**

* Work from Office, Monday to Friday, at Magarpatta, Pune.
* General shift, with flexibility to coordinate with global stakeholders across time zones when needed.

title: Principal Test Engineer
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Principal Test Engineer (Test PE) / QA Lead**
to partner directly with the Sonicwall Firewall development team. In this high-impact technical role, you will lead feature testing, complex defect reproduction, test plan architecture, and automation development across critical Sonicwall Firewall networking and security components.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* ****Dev Partnership & Defect Triage:****
  Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes.
* ****Test Strategy & Planning:****
  Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites.
* ****STLC & Quality Governance:****
  Drive the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)—identifying, filing, prioritizing, and tracking defects to closure in an Agile environment.
* ****Test Automation Engineering:****
  Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, and system) using Python to integrate into continuous testing pipelines.
* ****Component & Feature Qualification:****
  Deep-dive into Sonicwall Firewall  subsystems to validate new feature requirements, performance limits, and edge-case handling.
* ****Technical QA Mentorship:****
  Guide and mentor team members on test methodologies, test tool development, and network security validation.

**Core Skills & Requirements**

* ****Domain & SQA Experience:****
  10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.

* ****Domain & Network Security Expertise:****

+ Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.
+ Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules.

* ****Test Automation & Scripting:****

+ Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in
  **Python**
  (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).
+ Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e.g., IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay).

* ****Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction:****

+ Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump).
+ Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors.

* ****Methodologies & Processes:****

+ Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.
+ Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.

* ****Professional Experience:****

+ 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.
* Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
