title: Software Quality Assurance, Senior
description:
**Location:** Hybrid - Pune  
**Position Summary:**

At Bentley Systems, our software forms the digital back

bone for the world's most critical infrastructure projects. The integrity of that backbone rests on the quality of our products, and we are looking for a professional who shares that commitment.

We are seeking a meticulous and proactive **Software Quality Analyst** to join our industry-leading ProjectWise team. In this role, you will hold a pivotal position, responsible for validating the functionality, performance, and stability of software used to design and manage everything from nuclear power plants to international airports.

This is an opportunity to move beyond standard testing. You will be a key contributor to the development lifecycle, acting as a crucial advocate for quality and ensuring that our solutions meet the rigorous demands of the engineers who rely on them. If you are a QA professional driven by a sense of ownership and a desire to work on complex, high-impact products, we encourage you to apply.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Partner with Development, Product Management, and other stakeholders to define quality goals, assess risks, and develop comprehensive test strategies, test scenarios, and validation plans for complex features and releases.
* Lead defect management activities by identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and driving resolution of software defects, ensuring timely communication of quality risks and impacts.
* Own validation efforts for new features and releases, performing and guiding regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and risk-based testing activities to ensure product quality.
* Champion quality engineering best practices across the software development lifecycle, driving continuous improvements in processes, testing approaches, and release readiness.
* Analyze quality metrics, test results, and product trends, providing actionable insights and quality recommendations to engineering and product leadership.
* Drive adoption of emerging QA technologies, AI-assisted testing practices, and quality engineering tools, while mentoring team members and sharing best practices across teams.
* Own the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of complex test environments, ensuring they accurately represent customer deployments and support effective testing.
* Define and drive the test automation strategy, identify opportunities for AI-assisted and automated testing, and lead initiatives to improve test coverage, reliability, efficiency, and overall product quality.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM engineering discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics).
* 8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including ownership of complex testing initiatives and release validation.
* Deep understanding of QA principles, methodologies, and risk-based testing approaches across the software development lifecycle.
* Strong quality ownership mindset, with a proven ability to identify quality risks early, drive resolution, and influence quality outcomes across teams.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to define test strategies, test plans, and test scenarios for complex features, even when requirements are evolving, incomplete, or ambiguous.
* Advanced technical knowledge of test environment architecture, configuration, troubleshooting, and environment readiness management.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve test design, quality analysis, productivity, and testing effectiveness.
* Experience working with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and quality engineering practices, with the ability to identify automation opportunities and guide adoption.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers, promoting testing best practices, and helping drive a culture of quality within engineering teams.
* Ability to analyze quality trends, define quality metrics, and provide data-driven recommendations to support release readiness decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

This is a Hybrid role.  

**What We Offer:**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
* Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

**Who We Are:**

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
**Project Description:**

We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our team working on a cloud based high performance analytics platform used in the Capital Markets domain for validating, transforming, and analyzing large volumes of financial data.

Ideal candidate can own both manual functional testing and test automation (UI + E2E) across our front-end interfaces, analytics workflows, and API layers. You will contribute to quality strategy, build automation frameworks, and help the team deliver a highly reliable platform used by financial analysts and enterprise clients.

**Responsibilities:**

Manual Testing

* Analyze requirements, acceptance criteria, and specifications for new features.
* Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scenarios across UI, API, and data workflows.
* Perform functional, regression, exploratory, and integration testing.
* Validate correctness of data transformation, analytical workflows, and large dataset processing.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Developers, and Data/AI Engineers to clarify expected behavior.

Automation

* Develop and maintain UI automation using Java, Selenium
* Implement E2E scenarios covering cross-service workflows.
* Build reusable test utilities, fixtures, and Page Object patterns.
* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab / Jenkins / AWS CodeBuild).
* Configure test runs in AWS environments (dev/stage/prod).
* Participate in root-cause analysis of defects and quality incidents.

Quality Engineering

* Contribute to QA strategy and test automation roadmap.
* Improve test stability, reduce flakiness, optimize runtime.
* Define KPIs for coverage, quality, and regression scope.
* Support test data preparation and environment setup.

**Mandatory Skills Description:**

* 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer (Manual + Automation).
* Strong experience testing client-server applications and understanding of web technologies.
* Experience testing Agentic AI workflows.
* Java
* Selenium
* Solid understanding of testing methodologies, QA lifecycle, and Agile processes.
* Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman).
* Good understanding of CI/CD, Git, test execution pipelines.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS ideally).
* Ability to analyze complex workflows and large datasets.
* Strong communication skills and a proactive mindset.

**Nice-to-Have Skills Description:**

* Experience with Capital Markets, trading, market data, or financial analytics.
* Exposure to AI/ML-based systems and their validation approaches.
* Knowledge of modern test reporting systems (Allure).
* Experience with performance testing (JMeter).

title: Governance & Control Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**Responsibilities**
Joining in as “Governance & Control Quality Assurance Analyst” a member of the Governance & Controls team responsible for completing defined Quality Assurance (post-processing completeness checks) across a range of CDD and EDD-based financial crime prevention activities within the CIB Financial Crime Execution (FCE) Team. Working within established procedures and with support from more experienced colleagues, the role will:
  
  
  

* Complete allocated QA checks accurately and within agreed timescales, following documented methodologies and procedures
* Identify and clearly record errors, control observations and potential issues, escalating them to the appropriate colleague where required
* Provide clear feedback to support risk awareness and “Right First Time” performance across FCE
* Contribute to the consistent operation and continuous improvement of the quality assurance framework
* Provide evidence and support for issues, reviews and audits as requested

Key Accountabilities
  
  
Quality Assurance coverage (c.60%) – including but not limited to:
  
  
  

* High-risk forums
* Financial Crime (FC) Exits
* Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) Checks (including Global PEP Register accuracy)
* PEP Alerts
* AML Watchlist Alerts
* RAU Risk Assessments
* Financial Crime Remediation activity
* RAU Sampling (Business Activity Reviews (BARs) – Nature of Business / Source of Funds (NoB/SoF))
* Financial Institutions QA of QC checklist
* Forum Admin / Forum Secretariat QA
* Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Post Office SARs
* All Alerts and Investigations.

Stakeholder Management and Leadership
  
  
  

* Communicate clearly and professionally with immediate colleagues and relevant stakeholders across FCE and partner teams, seeking guidance for complex, sensitive or disputed matters.

Decision-making and Problem Solving
  
  
  

* Apply an analytical and methodical approach to QA checks and straightforward problem solving
* Recognise potential issues or risks, gather the relevant facts and escalate in line with agreed procedures
* Suggest practical opportunities to improve the efficiency or clarity of QA processes for consideration by more senior colleagues

**Risk and Control Objective**
Manage risk and strengthen controls in relation to allocated work by following established procedures, maintaining accurate records and promptly escalating concerns.
  
  
Person Specification
  
  
  

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when recording assurance outcomes
* Well organised, with the ability to plan and prioritise allocated tasks to meet agreed deadlines
* A positive approach, willingness to learn and readiness to take responsibility for the quality of own work
* Able to work independently on defined tasks while collaborating effectively with colleagues and seeking guidance when needed

**Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications**

* Experience of providing support to QA teams, and/or completing quality checks, assurance activity or other detail-focused operational reviews is preferred
* Ability to apply documented policies and procedures consistently and seek guidance where requirements are unclear
* Good document management skills and confidence using standard Microsoft Office tools

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* An understanding of Financial Crime
* A good understanding of the Corporate Banking business and the various Client types
* Working knowledge of Microsoft tools including Excel and Powerpoint.

This role will be based out of Gurgaon.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To provide support to the Chief Risk Officer(S) in the implementation and ongoing effectiveness of the bank's risk management framework across various business units and functions.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Implementation support of risk management policies, standards, procedures, and controls across the bank.
* Asessment and promotion of risk management awareness and risk controls and culture.
* Review, challenge and monitoring of the effectiveness of existing risk management practices and identifying areas for improvement.
* Identification of new and emerging risks, and assessing the likelihood and impact of identified risks, and recommending appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Management and operation of associated committees, forum and meetings.
* Maintenance of risk inventories and governance documentation.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior UAT & Rollout Governance Specialist - SAP S/4HANA
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
You start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
In short, we are looking for a professional who can independently coordinate stakeholders, drive delivery follow-ups, identify risks and dependencies, and provide program-level visibility across multiple rollout workstreams, rather than primarily performing administrative project support.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience, including relevant experience in IT project/program coordination, enterprise transformation, rollout management, or testing governance.
* Proven experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing activities, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple projects or rollout workstreams.
* Strong capabilities in project governance and performance management, including status reporting, KPI tracking, risk and dependency management, and proactive escalation of delivery issues.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, drive follow-ups, resolve coordination gaps, and ensure timely completion of agreed actions.
* Experience coordinating internal IT and business stakeholders, project managers, and external IT service delivery partners in a complex enterprise environment.
* Understanding of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test planning, testing governance, and rollout delivery processes. Experience with SAP/S/4HANA implementations or rollouts is an advantage.
* Knowledge of IT operations, enterprise IT systems, service management structures, and service delivery performance frameworks.
* Ability to consolidate information from multiple workstreams, identify delivery risks and performance gaps, and provide clear, structured reporting to support decision-making.
* Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work proactively in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Business-fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners

description:

With more than

and decades of experience in critical infrastructure technology, the company provides advanced metering, network intelligence and digital solutions to utilities and infrastructure operators primarily across Europe, Middle East and Africa. As a standalone organisation, Landis+Gyr EMEA builds on long-standing customer relationships and proven technology capabilities, backed by experienced regional teams.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Purpose and Objective
  
  
To ensure firmware and software products are developed and released with the highest levels of quality, reliability, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
  
  

* Embed quality requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
* Work collaboratively with engineering, project, manufacturing, and supplier teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate quality and project risks before they impact customers or schedules.
* Ensure compliance with customer, industry, regulatory, and company quality standards.
* Drive defect prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to improve product performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance development processes, product quality, and team effectiveness.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide independent quality oversight at key project milestones.
* Ensure products meet customer expectations and are fit for purpose before release.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  
**Firmware/Software PQE Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Escaped Defect Rate: Percentage of defects discovered after release, measuring effectiveness of defect prevention and verification activities.
* Defect Detection Efficiency (DDE): Percentage of defects identified before release versus total defects found.
* Quality Gate Compliance: Percentage of projects passing phase/gate reviews on schedule with no major quality findings.
* Requirements Traceability Coverage: Percentage of requirements traced through design, testing, and validation to release.
* High-Risk Closure Rate: Percentage of critical risks mitigated or closed before project milestones and release.
* Customer-Reported Defects: Number of software/firmware defects reported by customer’s post-release.
* CAPA Effectiveness: Percentage of corrective and preventive actions successfully implemented without recurrence.
* Continuous Improvement Delivery: Number and impact of implemented quality improvements resulting in reduced defects, improved compliance, or increased development efficiency.

**Overview Of The Role**
The Firmware/Software Project Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring software and firmware products are developed, verified, validated, and released in compliance with customer, regulatory, safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.
  
  
The role provides independent quality governance throughout the development lifecycle, driving risk mitigation, defect prevention, process compliance, root cause analysis, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Core Areas of Responsibility/Accountability**

* Lead quality planning and governance throughout the firmware/software development lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Drive risk management, including FMEA, CTQ identification, and mitigation activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed quality, reliability, and compliance into product development.
* Review and approve key quality deliverables, design documentation, and validation plans.
* Facilitate quality reviews, design reviews, and release readiness assessments.
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and defect prevention activities.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide project quality reporting and oversight.
* Support audits, supplier quality activities, NPI, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the independent quality representative, ensuring products meet requirements and are delivered right first time.

We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone.

**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**

  

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.

  
  

As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.

  
  
  

**Job Purpose**

The Associate Technical Specialist is responsible for technical ownership of complex modules, subsystems, and product functionalities. The role translates business requirements into robust technical solutions while driving design quality, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  
  
The Associate Technical Specialist serves as the technical lead within a Scrum team, mentoring engineers and guiding technical decisions to ensure successful product delivery.  
  
  

The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in enterprise application development, software architecture, engineering best practices, and technical leadership, with a focus on building scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

  
  
  
  

**What You’ll Do**

  

**Technical Design & Ownership**

* Own the design and implementation of complex modules and product subsystems.
* Translate business and functional requirements into detailed technical designs.
* Drive solution architecture decisions within the Scrum team.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and reliability requirements.
* Lead estimation and technical design activities for complex enhancements.

  

**Technical Leadership & Mentorship**

* Act as one of the go-to technical experts within the Scrum team.
* Mentor Developers and Senior Developers on engineering best practices and design approaches.
* Lead technical discussions, design reviews, and solution evaluations.
* Provide guidance on coding standards, architecture principles, and quality expectations.

**Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex production issues.
* Drive improvements in application performance, maintainability, and system stability.
* Identify technical debt and recommend remediation strategies.
* Proactively identify risks and propose alternative technical approaches**.**

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA teams, and Technical Specialists to ensure successful delivery.
* Support technical planning and roadmap discussions at feature and module level.
* Contribute to software releases, deployments, and post-release support activities.
* Ensure engineering deliverables align with established architectural standards.

**Quality & Engineering Excellence**

* Promote adoption of coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Drive implementation of code quality best practices.
* Review critical code changes and technical designs.
* Ensure robust technical documentation is maintained.
* Lead and contribute to the development of AI-Driven SDLC use cases.

  
  

**Unleash your potential**

  

To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:

* 7-9 years of software development experience.
* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex enterprise applications.
* Experience leading technical delivery within Agile/Scrum teams.
* Preferably experience in Financial Services or Wealth Management product development.
* Advanced expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Microservices, REST APIs, and database technologies.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, system decomposition, and software architecture principles.
* Experience with performance tuning, scalability, security, and resiliency practices.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud-native development concepts.
* Advanced troubleshooting and production support capabilities.
* Hands-on experience in efficiently using AI-Powered Tools for AI-assisted development practices.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence technical decisions within a Scrum team.
* Strong ownership mindset with focus on balancing delivery and technical excellence.
* Proven ability to anticipate risks and drive proactive solutions.

**Education**
  

* **B.E./B.Tech/MCA.**

**Preferred:** Experience in developing Artificial Intelligence based products, Generative AI applications, utilities, including Agentic AI.

  

**Working at Bravura**

  

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.

  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme
* Insurance Benefits
* Parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Meals and transportation

  

**So, what’s next?**

  

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

  
  

Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.

title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build, and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications, built with modern technology stacks and increasingly with AI-assisted and agent-assisted development, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior individual contributor role that reports to the Engineering Manager. The role can independently handle a software module/function, which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management, and communication, and is accountable for the delivery outcomes of the wider team. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for role modeling, and for coaching and mentoring of the team from a technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise-scale applications at Bain, and help drive the overall delivery outcomes of the team.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting, and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades, primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Project/Product Managers.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI agents responsibly to improve team productivity and code quality, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Champion secure software development practices, including secure use of AI-generated code, review of AI output, and protection of data and prompts.
* Own both development and testing: create the end-to-end test plan, execute it, and ensure zero-defect delivery.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support, and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills, e.g. creating automation tests, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing, etc., through internal/external trainings to be a T-shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies, especially in Gen AI, LLMs, and AI agents, beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts, e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, and Product Owner to improve team performance.
* Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with zero defects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T-shaped behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience providing technical leadership to a group of developers.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* AI and Gen AI: understanding of large language models (capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns), Gen AI application development, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vectors, vector databases, machine learning fundamentals
* Secure development: secure software development practices, including for AI-driven development
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, .NET and .NET Core, Java, or equivalent; C#, T-SQL, etc.
* Web frameworks/libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design; microservices, API design, and cloud-native patterns
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure services or equivalent
* Unit testing: xUnit, Jasmine, pytest, Jest, etc.
* Testing and quality: end-to-end test planning and execution, AI-enabled test automation, zero-defect delivery
* DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos DB, etc.
* Caching: Redis, Memcached

title: Technical Compliance Engineer I

Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5-meter resolution and 135+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.
  
  
Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI-powered analytics.
  
  
Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high-frequency imagery with AI-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.
  
  
Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.
  
  
Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG)**
**:**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Performance Management Engineer is responsible for analyzing wind turbine operational data to identify areas for performance improvement. This role uses advanced data analytics tools to assess turbine efficiency, power output, and reliability, conducting root cause analysis on performance deviations and implementing corrective actions. The Engineer participates in testing and validation of performance enhancements, such as control system updates and aerodynamic optimizations, and manages SCADA systems to ensure accurate data collection and monitoring. This role also involves supporting predictive maintenance initiatives by analyzing condition-based data and implementing maintenance strategies that reduce downtime. The Performance Management Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals and contributes to continuous improvement by proposing new methodologies and tools to optimize turbine performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring**

* Analyze operational data from wind turbines to assess performance against expected benchmarks, including power output, efficiency, and availability.
* Use advanced data analytics software (e.g., MATLAB, Python, R) to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement in turbine performance.

**Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Conduct performance optimization studies, focusing on areas such as blade aerodynamics, control system tuning, and power curve adjustments.
* Assist in troubleshooting performance issues on-site, using diagnostic tools to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective measures.

**Testing and Validation of Performance Improvements**

* Participate in the testing and validation of performance enhancement initiatives, including prototype testing and field trials.
* Collect and analyze test data to validate improvements, providing feedback to engineering teams for further refinement.

**SCADA and Data Acquisition System Management**

* Manage SCADA systems and other data acquisition tools, ensuring accurate and reliable data collection for performance analysis.
* Set up alarms, thresholds, and monitoring parameters to track key performance indicators in real-time.

**Predictive Maintenance and Condition Monitoring**

* Implement predictive maintenance strategies using data analytics to forecast potential failures and schedule proactive maintenance.
* Monitor condition-based data, such as vibration and temperature readings, to detect early signs of component wear and prevent performance drops.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain detailed records of performance analysis, tests conducted, and optimization measures implemented.
* Prepare performance reports, highlighting key findings, improvement opportunities, and corrective actions taken.

**Compliance with Standards and Procedures**

* Ensure all performance management activities comply with relevant industry standards and internal procedures, maintaining high data integrity and accuracy.
* Support the preparation of compliance documentation for certification and audits.

**Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with product improvement, R&D, and operations teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals.
* Provide technical support and performance insights during the design and testing phases of new turbine components.

**Training and Continuous Learning**

* Engage in continuous learning and professional development to stay updated on the latest performance optimization techniques and tools.
* Participate in internal training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance skills and contribute to team development.

**Adherence to Ethical Standards**

* Adhere to organizational ethical standards in data handling, analysis, and reporting, ensuring transparency and objectivity in performance assessments.
* Participate in training on corporate policies, ethics, and compliance to uphold high professional standards.

**Key Stakeholders - Internal**

* Lead - Performance Management
* QA Teams
* Manufacturing Teams

**Key Stakeholders - External**

* Performance Monitoring Equipment Vendors
* Data Analytics Consultants

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**

* BE in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.

**Work Experience**

* 5+ years in performance analysis and optimization, focusing on operational data, efficiency improvements, and maintenance strategy development.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Proficient in data analytics, SCADA data interpretation, and applying continuous improvement methodologies to enhance turbine performance.

title: Sr./Lead QA Automation Engineer – AI Agent
description:
Are you a quality engineer who wants to build confidence in a fast-evolving AI agent — not just execute manual test cases? At SimCorp, we are developing an internal AI agent that supports the software development lifecycle (SDLC): a production-grade, distributed agent hosted in Azure — running 24/7, accessible to everyone in the company, and spanning deep integrations with our engineering systems, secure code execution, and remote development capabilities on user machines.
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve the quality strategy for this product. The product's risk sits in cross-service behavior — where agent runs, tool calls, external integrations, and cloud infrastructure meet. The role blends hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features and AI behavior with designing and building the automated test system — acceptance, integration, contract, and post-deployment validation — that lets the team ship quickly without breaking critical engineering workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a QA Automation Engineer on this team, you will:
  
  
**Test strategy and hands-on testing**

* Define and own the product's test strategy across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, post-deployment, and exploratory testing.
* Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features, AI-agent behavior, and edge cases before and alongside automation.
* Design approaches for testing non-deterministic AI/LLM behavior, tool-use correctness, and prompt regressions.

**Automated coverage**

* Build browser-level acceptance tests that cover key user journeys end to end, from the UI down to persistence and background processing.
* Create validation for MCP endpoints, including authentication flows, client compatibility, and tool schemas.
* Design contract and replay-based tests for critical external integrations where live systems are slow, expensive, or unstable.
* Strengthen test coverage for the highest-risk execution surfaces: sandboxed code execution and the agent's remote sessions on user machines.

**Release confidence and test infrastructure**

* Add post-deployment smoke tests that catch environment, configuration, and identity failures, giving rollback confidence.
* Introduce failure-injection scenarios — service restarts, network loss, expired tokens, rate limits — to prove the product degrades gracefully.
* Improve test data, fixtures, fake connectors, and CI test categorization; manage flaky tests and keep pipelines fast and trustworthy.

**Collaboration and quality leadership**

* Partner with engineers to make features testable and define acceptance criteria before implementation; mentor the team in testing practices.
* Monitor quality signals from CI, static analysis, telemetry, production incidents, and user feedback, and build release-readiness reporting.

**What We Value**

* Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We expect you to be strong in several of the following and interested in learning the rest:
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in quality engineering / test automation for complex web and API platforms.
* Strong C#/.NET test development skills: xUnit/NUnit-style frameworks, mocks and fakes, test fixtures, and CI integration.
* Solid experience with API and integration testing, including authentication and distributed-system failure modes.
* Experience with browser automation such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent.
* Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, and the ability to design test strategies rather than only execute predefined cases.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, test categorization, flaky-test management, and post-deployment smoke testing.
* Ability to investigate failures using logs, traces, telemetry, screenshots, and reproducible minimal scenarios.
* Experience testing AI/LLM products, agentic workflows, streaming responses, or other non-deterministic behavior is a strong advantage.
* At least 1 year of hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex in your daily work.
* Familiarity with open-source agents (e.g., OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, or similar) and how they behave in practice.
* Passion for the AI space and the flexibility to try new technologies: you stay on top of market trends and bring the ecosystem's best practices — better memory, context management, and agent autonomy — into how we build and test the product.
* Working knowledge of Linux and containerized environments (Docker), enough to test and investigate sandboxed code execution, is a strong advantage.
* Experience with Test containers, contract testing, Azure identity, or Windows automation is a plus.
* Proven ability to lead quality direction, influence engineers, and raise the testing bar across a team.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Our development team is made up of world-class engineers who design and deliver novel solutions. This is an opportunity to join a market-leading team that is changing how the industrial world works.
  
  
If you love building and creating value in the “white space,” if you thrive with the freedom and flexibility to think outside the box, if you are passionate about working with critical thinkers who challenge the status quo, and if you aspire to work in a fast-paced environment – we would love to meet you!
  
  
We believe flexibility drives creativity and that our team should live and work where we can be our best selves. We’re 100% remote and offer a competitive time-off package to ensure time for rest and recharge.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Test Engineer to elevate our software quality to the next level. As a member of our technology team, you will work daily with our world-class engineers. You will think broadly to create and execute test plans that ensure our products meet the highest standards. You will apply your engineering logic and keen attention to detail to solve some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry. You will have the freedom to design and implement your testing strategies with some of the brightest minds in the space.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning and Execution: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for our software products, ensuring that they meet the highest quality standards. This includes functional, regression, and performance testing.
* P&ID Documentation Review: Work closely with P&ID technical documentation to create relevant and accurate test cases. Ensure that all aspects of the engineering design are tested and validated. Defect Identification and Management: Identify, document, and track software defects using defect management tools. Work with developers to reproduce and resolve issues, ensuring timely fixes and improvements.
* Web Application Testing: Focus on testing web applications, ensuring they function correctly across different browsers, devices, and environments. Validate that the application meets user requirements, provides a smooth user experience, and performs reliably under different conditions.
* SDLC Integration: Integrate testing processes into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), ensuring that testing is an integral part of the development and deployment process. Tool Utilization: Utilize test design tools to create efficient and effective test cases. Employ defect management tools to track and report issues, providing clear and actionable feedback to the development team.
* Continuous Improvement: Continuously seek to improve testing processes, methodologies, and tools. Stay up to date with the latest testing trends and technologies to enhance testing effectiveness and efficiency.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to understand requirements, discuss testing strategies, and ensure alignment on quality goals.
* Technical Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of test plans, test cases, and test results. Provide clear and concise reports to the team, highlight areas of concern, and recommend improvements.

* Problem-Solving: Apply strong problem-solving skills to identify root causes of defects and propose solutions. Analyze test results to identify trends and prevent recurring issues.
* Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Mentor junior team members and share knowledge and best practices within the team. Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
* Global Team Collaboration: Work effectively within a globally distributed remote team, communicating effectively across time zones and cultural differences. Participate in regular team meetings and contribute to the overall success of the team

**Required Skills**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Test Engineer or in a similar role
* Experience in software testing, including test design, test case creation, and defect management
* Experience testing web applications
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g., TypeScript, Python, C#, or similar)
* Professional experience involving test automation
* Experience with Playwright or other test automation tools and frameworks
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving skills
* Desire to learn and continuously improve technical skills
* Ability to work effectively within a globally distributed remote team
* English proficiency at a minimum B2 level

**Preferred Skills**

* Graph Theory: Advanced knowledge of graph theory.
* TestMo: Experience using TestMo or similar test management tools.
* CAD Diagrams: Ability to read and create CAD diagrams.
* Startup Experience: Previous experience in a startup environment.
* Certification: ISTQB certification

We blend manufacturing process knowledge with software and big data engineering expertise to create value in physical settings
  
  
**We Are Experienced.**
We are armed with industry-leading experts in numerical simulation, combustion, power, computational fluid dynamics, and chemical process modeling
  
  
**We are serious builders.**
We develop our platforms using leading practices in IT/OT architecture, OT security, AI architecture, ML Ops, and Platform engineering

**About Business Line/Function**

This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. description:

**Quality Engineer -Specialist**
focused on test automation for the Eclipse Intelligence Platform (EIP). If innovation and quality drive you forward, this is the place for you!
  
  
As a Quality Engineer Specialist, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team, ensuring the quality and reliability of critical data solutions for financial markets around the globe. You will work with cutting-edge technologies including Java, AWS, Kubernetes, and modern microservices architecture to build comprehensive test automation frameworks and strategies.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in a strong experienced team delivering complex technology solutions to our external clients. * Debugging & Analysis: Analyze logs, metrics, and traces using observability tools to identify root causes of test failures and production issues

* Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance standards
* Continuous Learning: Passion for learning new testing tools, technologies, and methodologies
* Adaptability: Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced agile environment with changing priorities
* Quality Advocacy: Drive to promote quality practices and improve overall software quality

**Education:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience

**It Would Be Great If You Have (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Event-Driven Architecture: Experience testing Kafka, SNS/SQS, or other messaging systems
* Data Platform Knowledge: Understanding of Data Lakes, Data Warehousing, and big data technologies
* Infrastructure-as-Code Testing: Experience validating Terraform or CloudFormation templates
* Observability Tools: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and tracing tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, etc.)

As the selection process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. We will get back to you in 2-3 weeks.

Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.
  
  
Nasdaq is a leading global provider of trading, clearing, exchange technology, listing, information, and public company services. As the creator of the world's first electronic stock market, its technology powers more than 100 marketplaces in 50 countries. * ****Dev Partnership & Defect Triage:****
  Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes.

  Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites.

  Deep-dive into Sonicwall Firewall  subsystems to validate new feature requirements, performance limits, and edge-case handling.
* ****Technical QA Mentorship:****
  Guide and mentor team members on test methodologies, test tool development, and network security validation.

**Core Skills & Requirements**

* ****Domain & SQA Experience:****
  10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.

* ****Domain & Network Security Expertise:****

+ Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.
+ Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules.

* ****Test Automation & Scripting:****

+ Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in
  **Python**
  (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).
+ Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e.g., IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay).

* ****Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction:****

+ Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump).
+ Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors.

* ****Methodologies & Processes:****

+ Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.
+ Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.

* ****Professional Experience:****

+ 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.
* Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.

title: Job Requisition for Executive Referrals only
description:
**Introduction**
India Systems Development Lab (ISDL)
  
  
IBM Systems division builds Servers, Storage and Systems Software which are the building blocks for next-generation IT infrastructure of enterprise customers and data centers. IBM Servers provide best-in-class reliability, scalability, performance, and end-to-end security to handle mission-critical workloads and provide seamless extension to hybrid multicloud environments.
  
  
India Systems Development Lab (ISDL) is part of word-wide IBM Systems division. Established in 1996, the ISDL Lab is headquartered in Bengaluru, with presence in Pune and Hyderabad as well. ISDL teams work across the IBM Systems stack including Processor development, Firmware, Operating Systems, Systems Software, Storage Software, Cloud Software, Performance Engineering, System Test etc. The ISDL teams also ushered in new development models such as Agile, Design Thinking and DevOps.
  
  
****Your Role And Responsibilities****
As a Software Engineer at IBM India Systems Development Lab (IBM ISDL), you will get an opportunity to work on all the phases of product development (Design/Development, Test and Support) across core Systems technologies including Operating Systems, Firmware, Systems Software, Storage Software & Cloud Software.
  
  
**As a Software Developer At ISDL:**

* You will be focused on development of IBM Systems products interfacing with development & product management teams and end users, cutting across Geos.
* You would analyze product requirements, determine the best course of design, implement/code the solution and test across the entire product development life cycle. One could also work on Validation and Support of IBM Systems products.
* You get to work with a vibrant, culture driven and technically accomplished teams working to create world-class products and deployment environments, delivering an industry leading user experience for our customers
* You will be valued for your contributions in a growing organization with broader opportunities.

At ISDL, work is more than a job - it's a calling: To build. To design. To code. To invent. To collaborate. To think along with clients. To make new products/markets. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought was possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the most challenging problems in Systems Software technologies? If so, let's talk.
  
  
Regular Job opportunities across ISDL teams are in the following areas.
  
  
Systems and Cloud Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM Systems and Cloud Software teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in all the phases of software development and work with technically accomplished teams. The responsibilities comprise of design new enhancements, coding (including test automation), problem determination and bug fixing, performance analysis, and solving client problems. You could also work on IBM Compute and Storage Systems including Virtualisation, I/O and Reliability Availability & Serviceability thereby, enabling the creation of a seamless software user experience across the stack delivering to IBM's Hybrid Cloud and AI clients. As an engineer you will be responsible for enhancing and maintaining the key components of the Software stack, Platform enablement and an opportunity to work on closed and Open source development communities.
  
  
AI Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM AI on Z Solutions teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in delivering best-in class Enterprise AI Solutions on IBM Z and support IBM Customers while adopting AI technologies / Solutions into their businesses by building ethical, secure, trustworthy and sustainable AI solutions on IBM Z.You will be part of end to end solutions working along with technically accomplished teams. You will be working as a Full stack developer starting from understanding client challenges to providing solutions using AI.
  
  
**IBM Spectrum Fusion SW Engineer:**
IBM Spectrum Fusion container-native storage solution for OpenShift is designed for enterprise customers who need global hybrid cloud data access. As a Software Engineer with IBM Storage Spectrum Fusion team, you will work with the Dev/Test team to develop and support features for Spectrum Fusion product roadmap.
  
  
**Linux Developer:**
As a Linux developer, you would be involved in design and development of advanced features in the Linux OS for the next generation server platforms from IBM by collaboration with the Linux community. You collaborate with teams across the hardware, firmware, and upstream Linux kernel community to deliver these capabilities.
  
  
**Hardware Management Console (HMC) / Novalink Software Developer:**
As a Software Developer in HMC / Novalink team, you will work on design, development, and test of the Management Console for IBM Power Servers. You will be involved in user centric Graphical User Interface development and Backend for server and virtualization management solution development in Agile environment.
  
  
**AIX Developer:**
AIX is a proprietary Unix operating system which runs on IBM Power Servers. It's a secure, scalable, and robust open standards-based UNIX operating system which is designed to meet the needs of Enterprises class infrastructure. As an AIX developer, you would be involved in development, test or support of AIX OS features development or open source software porting/development for AIX OS
  
  
**Performance Engineer:**
As a performance Engineer , you will get an opportunity to conduct experiments and analysis to identify performance aspects for operating systems and Enterprise Servers. where you will be responsible for advancing the product roadmap by using your expertise in Linux operating system, building kernel , applying patches, performance characterization, optimization and hardware architecture to analyse performance of software/hardware combinations. You will be involved in conducting experiments and analysis to identify performance challenges and uncover optimization opportunities for IBM Power virtualization and cloud management software built on Open stack.
