title: Founding Member, Senior Innovation Engineer (Delhi NCR - Hybrid)
description:
**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.

J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Rapid Prototyping & Solution Development**

* Build functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users.
* Translate business problems, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria into practical technical solutions in close partnership with Digital Solution Consultants.
* Use rapid, iterative development methods to incorporate user feedback and improve functionality, reliability, and usability.
* Select fit-for-purpose technologies and patterns for each experiment while considering speed, security, supportability, reuse, and the likely path to scale.
* Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable.
* Demonstrate working solutions to business and technical stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs in clear, decision-oriented language.

**AI, Agents & Automation Engineering**

* Design and build AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure services, and other approved technologies.
* Develop and evaluate AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation patterns, prompt and orchestration logic, knowledge grounding, tool use, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Integrate solutions with enterprise data, content, APIs, applications, and identity services while following approved access and security patterns.
* Evaluate solution quality, grounding, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and failure modes using test cases appropriate to the use case.
* Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions.
* Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

* Design and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Conduct technical discovery and feasibility assessment covering architecture, data, integrations, identity and access, security, privacy, performance, scalability, observability, support, and cost.
* Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early and recommend whether an initiative should proceed, be redesigned, transition to an enterprise team, or stop.
* Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions.
* Ensure prototypes use representative data responsibly and do not create unsupported production dependencies or unmanaged technical risk.

**Engineering Foundations & Delivery Practices**

* Partner with IT to help establish the development technology stack, source-control approach, environments, infrastructure patterns, deployment methods, and engineering guardrails for the Foundry.
* Help define and mature CI/CD practices for prototypes and solutions, recognizing that these capabilities are still being established rather than assuming mature pipelines already exist.
* Apply sound software engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, dependency management, secrets management, and secure configuration.
* Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk.
* Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability.
* Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks.

**Collaboration, Reuse & Scale**

* Work closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff.
* Collaborate with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to incorporate enterprise requirements at the appropriate stage.
* Provide initiative-level technical progress, feasibility findings, risks, cost considerations, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and investment decisions.
* Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model.
* Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions.
* · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, solution engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering working solutions.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure AI services, or closely comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with experience building APIs, services, integrations, and user-facing applications.
* Hands-on cloud development experience in Microsoft Azure is required; experience across multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, is strongly preferred.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, event-driven or serverless patterns, identity and access management, data stores, enterprise integrations, monitoring, and secure application design.
* Experience with AI application patterns such as agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model and prompt orchestration, grounding, evaluation, tool use, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Experience establishing or improving development foundations, including source control, branching, automated testing, environments, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Ability to prototype rapidly while making clear distinctions between experimental code and production-ready solutions, including the risks and work required to transition between them.
* · Working knowledge of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, resiliency, performance, cost management, observability, and production support considerations.
* · Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain architecture choices and technical trade-offs to business leaders, subject-matter experts, architects, engineers, and risk partners.
* · Experience in professional services, consulting, or another expert-led, knowledge-intensive environment is beneficial.
* · Self-directed builder mindset with the ability to create structure in an evolving environment, partner constructively with enterprise IT, and balance delivery speed with reusable and supportable engineering practices

**Additional Information**

We welcome applications from individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable adjustment in relation to any of the above, please email jobs@jsheld.com and include “Applicant Adjustment” within the subject line with your request and contact information.

**Some of the Benefits We Have Include**

J.S. Held understands all of our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

* Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely when needed
* Comprehensive Medical Insurance

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

description:
**Description**
AI first platform development
  
  
**Requirements**
About the Role
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Test Architect/Consultant to lead the quality engineering strategy for our next-generation applications, with a heavy emphasis on intelligent agents, AI-driven workflows, and complex data ecosystems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional quality assurance (automation, performance, security) and cutting-edge AI validation.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing comprehensive test strategies that address both functional and non-functional requirements (NFRs). Your mandate includes evaluating emerging test tools, building robust test harnesses, and ensuring the contextual accuracy, data security, and operational reliability of our AI agents and core platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test Strategy & Planning: Design and author end-to-end test strategies and test plans covering all architectural concerns (functional, non-functional, security, and performance) for complex systems, specifically focusing on autonomous agents and AI-driven platforms.
  
  
AI Agent & Outcome Validation: Develop methodologies to test agentic behaviors, ensuring the accuracy of outcomes, contextual relevance of responses, and proper handling of edge cases/hallucinations.
  
  
Test Data Engineering: Architect strategies for test data creation, management, and synthetic data generation. Ensure rigorous data security, privacy compliance, and strict multi-tenant data separation within testing environments and LLM contexts.
  
  
Tool Evaluation & Harness Development: Continuously evaluate and onboard modern testing tools and frameworks. Build custom test harnesses and sandboxes specifically designed to interact with and evaluate intelligent agents and APIs.
  
  
Automation, Performance, & Security: Oversee the architecture of traditional test automation pipelines. Drive performance testing (load, stress, scalability) and security testing (vulnerability scanning, penetration testing integrations) to ensure enterprise-grade reliability.
  
  
Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a consultant and technical leader, collaborating closely with developers, data scientists, product managers, and security teams to embed quality engineering principles early in the software development lifecycle (Shift-Left).

Experience & Background:
  
  
10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Engineering, Test Architecture, or QA Consulting.
  
  
Proven track record in designing and implementing enterprise-level test strategies and master test plans from scratch.
  
  
Recent hands-on experience testing AI models, LLMs, or intelligent autonomous agents.
  
  
Technical Competencies:
  
  
AI & Agent Testing: Deep understanding of testing methodologies for contextual accuracy, prompt injection vulnerabilities, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, and non-deterministic outcomes.

description:

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
Experience3–5 years
  
  
Compensation₹8–12 LPA CTC
  
  
The role
  
  
At Trendwick, you lead testing for our trading tools and AI assistant, and make sure they work correctly before every release.
  
  
You plan the testing, automate it, and guide a small team of about three junior testers.
  
  
Open to any graduate or post-graduate with 3–5 years of software testing experience, including automation. No trading knowledge is needed; we teach you our products and the markets.
  
  
Skills for this role: Automation testing (Selenium or Playwright), Python or Java, API testing (Postman, REST Assured or PyTest), SQL, Performance testing (JMeter), CI/CD (Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Jira, Test planning and strategy, Mentoring.
  
  
At Trendwick, everyone also keeps company and client information private, never gives investment advice or promises profits, checks anything an AI tool gives before using it, joins the short daily team meeting, and keeps learning through the training we give.
  
  
How we hire: 1. Apply on this page. 2. A short testing task. 3. A friendly interview with our team. 4. HR discussion and offer. Tip: add your GitHub or project link in the Portfolio URL box.
  
  
Growth path: Associate Quality Analyst → Quality Analyst → Senior Quality Analyst → QA Lead.
  
  
Please note: we only build software. We do not handle anyone's money or give investment advice, and you will never be asked to trade or invest your own money.
  
  
Trendwick is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome everyone, whatever their gender, background or ability. Beware of fraud: we never ask for money for applications, training, joining or equipment. Report any such request to hr@trendwick.co or WhatsApp +971 58 307 6101.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Plan testing: plan the testing for every release and decide when it is ready to go live.
* Automate tests: build automated tests with Selenium or Playwright using Python or Java.
* Test APIs: automate API tests with Postman, REST Assured or PyTest.
* Check trading logic: make sure indicator values and EA trades are correct, including tricky cases like price gaps and fast markets during big news.
* Test the AI: check the AI chat assistant and AI agents for wrong answers, unsafe advice and misuse.
* Test speed: run speed and load tests with tools like JMeter.
* Check security: do basic security checks on login, licences and data.
* Guide your team: review your juniors' test cases and bug reports, and teach them.
* Lead bug meetings: discuss bugs with developers and Product Owners and agree what to fix first.
* Share reports: share simple quality reports with the team.

**Requirements**

* 3–5 years in software testing, including at least 1 year of automation.
* Python or Java for automation, with Selenium or Playwright.
* API testing and SQL.
* Experience guiding junior testers is a plus.
* English and any Indian language.

**Benefits**

* Full training: learn our products, trading platforms and tools step by step.
* Mentoring: guide a small team of about three junior testers.
* Work on AI: test our new AI chat assistant and AI agents.
* Real products: build our TradingView, MetaTrader and cTrader tools from the start.
* Skills for the future: fintech, trading technology and AI experience stays valuable in any company.

title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build, and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications, built with modern technology stacks and increasingly with AI-assisted and agent-assisted development, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior individual contributor role that reports to the Engineering Manager. The role can independently handle a software module/function, which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management, and communication, and is accountable for the delivery outcomes of the wider team. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for role modeling, and for coaching and mentoring of the team from a technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise-scale applications at Bain, and help drive the overall delivery outcomes of the team.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting, and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades, primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Project/Product Managers.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI agents responsibly to improve team productivity and code quality, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Champion secure software development practices, including secure use of AI-generated code, review of AI output, and protection of data and prompts.
* Own both development and testing: create the end-to-end test plan, execute it, and ensure zero-defect delivery.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support, and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills, e.g. creating automation tests, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing, etc., through internal/external trainings to be a T-shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies, especially in Gen AI, LLMs, and AI agents, beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts, e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, and Product Owner to improve team performance.
* Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with zero defects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T-shaped behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience providing technical leadership to a group of developers.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* AI and Gen AI: understanding of large language models (capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns), Gen AI application development, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vectors, vector databases, machine learning fundamentals
* Secure development: secure software development practices, including for AI-driven development
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, .NET and .NET Core, Java, or equivalent; C#, T-SQL, etc.
* Web frameworks/libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design; microservices, API design, and cloud-native patterns
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure services or equivalent
* Unit testing: xUnit, Jasmine, pytest, Jest, etc.
* Testing and quality: end-to-end test planning and execution, AI-enabled test automation, zero-defect delivery
* DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos DB, etc.
* Caching: Redis, Memcached

title: Senior Product Manager – AspireBooks
description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
AspireBooks is Aspire's accounting product: the layer that turns Aspire from a financial operations platform into the system of record for a business's finances. It is Aspire's biggest product bet, a 0→1 accounting platform targeted to the thousands of businesses already running their finances on Aspire.
  
  
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to take AspireBooks to mid-market customers. This is a builder-PM role: you won't just write specs, you'll ship working features yourself using AI coding tools, working inside the actual codebase alongside engineers. The role exists because mid-market accounting is won on depth and speed of execution, and we need someone who can deliver both.
  
  
You'll join a small, autonomous pod of product, design and engineering that ships at startup speed inside a scaled, profitable fintech, working daily with Engineering, Design and accounting domain experts, plus GTM teams in our key markets.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Own the mid-market roadmap for AspireBooks, from customer discovery with finance teams and accountants through to shipped features.
* Build and ship production features hands-on using AI-assisted development (Claude Code or similar), end to end.
* Write clear specs for the features the engineering pod builds, and make the build-vs-delegate call feature by feature.
* Define and track success metrics: activation, records created, reconciliation depth and retention.
* Work with Sales and CX to land mid-market customers and turn their feedback into product.
* Shape how AI agents earn the trust of accountants inside the product.

**We would love to get to know you if you have the following**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years on B2B SaaS.
* A background in fintech or B2B SaaS serving finance teams.
* Experience with workflow-heavy B2B products: invoicing, AP/AR, payments or reporting.
* A builder-PM track record: you ship working features with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), not just specs, and own discovery → delivery → code.
* Hands-on technical skills: you can read and understand code, and you implement AI in how you and your team work.

**Nice to have**

* 6+ years of product experience, including time as a lead or senior PM owning a product line end to end.
* Accounting or ERP software background (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, Odoo or similar), or close work with accountants and CFOs.
* Working knowledge of double-entry accounting (chart of accounts, journals, reconciliation, close), multi-entity and multi-currency, migration and onboarding flows, or accountant and partner channels.
* A former engineer or technical background; you have shipped production code in a scale-up.
* Experience with mid-market customers, not only SMB self-serve.
* Built end-to-end features solo (frontend + backend); pricing and packaging work; integration experience (bank feeds, tax engines, APIs).

**Why this role?**
Build the accounting product of the future, the way product will be built from now on. You'll be one of the first builder-PMs at Aspire: shipping code, not just decks, with the autonomy of a startup and the distribution of a platform.
  
  
**What You Get**

* Direct access to Aspire's product teams and founding team.
* An AI-native way of working, where every PM builds.
* A front-row seat on a 0→1 product inside a profitable, scaled fintech.
* Structured onboarding with engineering and accounting domain experts.

**By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Aspire. title: Sr. Product Manager, Progression Intelligence
description:

This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.
  
  
You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.
  
  
This is a deeply technical role that requires equal comfort with ML systems, API architecture, and product strategy. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and marketing stakeholders to ship systems that directly delight millions of customers.

* Own the multi-year product roadmap for Progression Intelligence, including the phased migration of core ML models and decisioning systems onto a unified orchestration platform
* Define technical requirements and integration specifications for connecting rewards optimization, propensity modeling, causal incrementality measurement, and promotion configuration systems into a cohesive, real-time decisioning layer
* Partner with applied scientists to translate model outputs into actionable product features - including reward denomination optimization, next-best-action recommendations, and personalized campaign triggers
* Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact

title: Platform Product Manager - Cloud Common Services (Atmos)
description:
**Summary**
Cloud Common Services (CCS) builds the essential cloud infrastructure and platform services that power the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP). At the heart of this is Atmos, Guidewire's "PaaS within SaaS" layer — built on AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker — that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized core applications, cloud-native services, and associated workloads.
  
  
As Platform Product Manager, you'll own the roadmap and delivery for a defined set of platform capabilities within CCS/Atmos that internal engineering teams and external insurer customers rely on every day. Working closely with senior product leaders, engineering, and SRE, you'll help shape how Guidewire delivers infrastructure as a product — with a focus on developer experience, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone with a solid technical foundation in cloud infrastructure who is building their product management career and wants to grow into platform strategy ownership.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for candidates with 6–10 years of overall work experience, including a minimum of 1–2 years in Product Management (or a product-adjacent role such as technical program management, solutions engineering, or platform engineering with product responsibilities).
  
  

* Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more platform service areas within CCS/Atmos — such as deployment tooling, observability, Kubernetes-based compute, networking, or shared platform services — in alignment with the broader CCS product strategy.
* Develop a working understanding of the Guidewire Cloud ecosystem, the multi-tenant/hybrid-tenancy architecture, and the needs of both internal developer teams and external customers.
* Treat platform infrastructure as a product: identify friction in developer workflows and define capabilities that improve productivity, self-service, and time-to-value.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE/Operations, UX, and Enablement to discover, test, refine, and prioritize solutions.
* Write clear feature requirements and user stories with well-defined use cases and acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by bringing customer insight, usage data, and operational feedback to prioritization discussions.
* Support the launch of new platform services and features; define success metrics, measure adoption and performance, and iterate.
* Be a power user of the platform capabilities you build.
* Communicate progress, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.
* Embrace a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI — using emerging tools and data-driven insights to improve how you and your teams work.

We're looking for someone who
  
  

* Has experience working on platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — as a product manager, or in a technical role (engineering, SRE, DevOps, solutions/technical program management) with a demonstrated interest in moving into product management.
* Has a solid understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (AWS Cloud Practitioner certification is a plus).
* Understands containerization and container orchestration (Docker & Kubernetes) and the basics of running services at scale.
* Is familiar with core platform concerns such as CI/CD, observability/monitoring, networking, multi-tenancy, reliability (SLO/SLA), and cost awareness.
* Can translate customer and developer needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Is comfortable managing and prioritizing a product backlog and working in agile delivery cycles.
* Collaborates effectively with engineering and operations teams through design, development, testing, release, and maintenance.
* Uses data and customer feedback to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Is eager to learn, take ownership, and grow into broader product strategy responsibilities.

Nice to have
  
  

* Exposure to identity and access management concepts — SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SSO, SCIM — and how they apply to platform services.
* Experience with load balancing and networking in cloud environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner (or higher) certification.
* Familiarity with Aha! and JIRA.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Ability to travel up to 5% as needed.

Role-specific competencies
  
  

* Customer Need: Comfortable engaging with internal developer teams and external customers to understand their needs and document use cases.
* Product Execution: Ability to turn prioritized needs into well-specified, deliverable increments and see them through to launch.
* Collaboration: Works well across cross-functional teams and builds trust with engineering partners.
* Results Driven: Tracks adoption and outcomes, learns from data, and iterates.
* Communication: Able to explain both the technical detail and business value of platform work to the appropriate audience.
* Motivation: A genuine interest in the craft of product management and in platform/infrastructure as a product.

**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. title: Engineering Product Manager :: AI & Customer Experience (Webex Customer Experience Solutions) | 5-9 years
description:

Webex Customer Experience Solutions is shaping the future of customer experience by helping organizations deliver connected, intelligent, and trusted interactions at scale. We build modern, intuitive, and efficient experiences for agents, supervisors, operators, and analysts by bringing together AI, automation, data, and human-centered design.
  
  
Across the United States, Europe, and Asia, we partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and Operations. We are customer-obsessed, collaborative, curious, and high ownership: we move with urgency, learn continuously, challenge the status quo, and support one another in turning ambitious ideas into meaningful products.

You will work with your manager and senior product partners to understand customer problems, translate priorities into requirements and success measures, and coordinate delivery with Engineering, UX, and other teams. You will monitor results after launch, share customer and usage insights, recommend improvements, and escalate risks early.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

* Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

* Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

* Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

* Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

* Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

* Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

* Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

title: Software Design Engineer - LabVIEW
description:
**Role Summary:**

This position is responsible for software development of new products, with emphasis on user interfaces and device communication for wired and wireless industrial communication networks. The role also develops modular, scalable LabVIEW applications and integrates software with industrial hardware and test systems.

**Principle accountabilities:**

1. Design and code modular, scalable LabVIEW applications using Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), state machines, and producer-consumer architectures.

2. Interface LabVIEW software with NI DAQ devices, PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, electronic testers, and laboratory instruments.

3. Implement industrial communication protocols, including Modbus, HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, OPC, FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, and FDI, as applicable.

4. Develop automated test equipment (ATE), functional end-of-line test benches, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems.

5. Develop, test, and debug software code using contemporary tools and techniques.

6. Support the preparation of design documents, artifacts, and work products.

7. Work across all phases of the software development lifecycle.

8. Work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating with senior-level engineers who provide guidance on assigned tasks.

9. Continually update technical knowledge and skills.

**Educational Qualification & Experience:**

1. Bachelor’s degree **in electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Instrumentation Technology.**

2. Experience in software development for the Industrial Automation domain preferred; experience with FDT 1.2, FDT 2.0, OPC, and FDI is an advantage.

3. Experience in device description (EDDL) and device type manager (DTM) development.

4. Experience with LabVIEW application development and industrial test/measurement systems is preferred.

**Competencies and Skills:**

1. Knowledge of programming languages and technologies: C++, VC++, C#, JavaScript, SQL, XML, and EDDL.

2. Knowledge of **industrial communication protocols**, including HART, Foundation Fieldbus, PROFIBUS, Modbus, and OPC.

3. Knowledge of software concepts and frameworks: OOP, COM (MFC/ATL), and .NET (WPF/WCF).

4. Familiarity with software tools such as TFS, Subversion, MS SQL, and SQL Server.

5. Knowledge of LabVIEW is preferred.

6. Knowledge of distributed control systems and/or programmable logic controllers is an advantage.

7. Knowledge of microprocessor architecture, peripherals, and related analog/digital circuitry is an advantage.

8. Fast learner, able to work independently within a team.

9. Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and respect deadlines.

10. Customer-focused with good analytical and problem-solving skills.

11. Excellent oral and written communication skills.

title: Market Research & Intelligence Manager - APAC
description:
**About the Role**

The Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager will independently lead high-impact qualitative and quantitative market research and competitive intelligence initiatives that inform critical business decisions.

The Market Research & Intelligence (MR&I) team is a strategic thought partner that helps the business make smarter, faster decisions by translating customer, market, competitor, industry, and broader external signals into clear insights, strategic direction, risk awareness, and growth opportunities. The team combines primary market research, competitive and market intelligence, and AI-enabled research capabilities to help Resmed anticipate change, reduce uncertainty, and maintain a competitive advantage in a dynamic global market.

  

**What You’ll do**

As a Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager, you will partner with cross-functional leaders to translate business questions into rigorous research and intelligence approaches, synthesize evidence from multiple sources, and shape clear, objective recommendations for different stakeholders and business needs.

The role requires integrating insights across consumers, patients, physicians and other healthcare professionals, payers, customers, competitors, partners, and broader market forces. You will monitor current and emerging developments, connect disparate signals, distinguish meaningful change from market noise, and develop a well-supported point of view on what is changing, why it matters to Resmed, what remains uncertain, and what the business should consider next.

The ideal candidate combines deep market research expertise, strong investigative instincts, strategic business acumen, executive communication skills, and an experimental mindset toward AI and automation. The role will primarily support APAC - with emphasis on China and Japan and secondary support for Australia - while contributing to global MR&I priorities.

**What You'll Bring**

Market Research & Strategic Insights

* Independently lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative market research projects from business-question definition through research design, vendor selection, questionnaire/discussion guide development, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and executive presentation.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into clear research questions, hypotheses, methodologies, and decision-oriented learning plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Integrate perspectives from consumers, patients, physicians and other HCPs, payers, customers, channels, and other stakeholders to uncover behaviors, needs, perceptions, barriers, and opportunities.
Interpret research findings and synthesize them into clear insights, implications, and strategic and tactical recommendations that enable action.  

Market & Competitive Intelligence

* Create and maintain comprehensive industry, competitor, customer, and market analyses, including market share, growth projections, market forces, landscape evolution, and emerging risks and opportunities.
* Proactively monitor and investigate competitor activity and broader external developments across healthcare policy and reimbursement, regulatory change, economics and demographics, technology and AI, consumer behavior, channel evolution, partnerships, and other forces that may materially impact the sleep and respiratory markets.
* Leverage secondary research, financial and company information, industry publications, news, conferences, expert sources, and market intelligence platforms to develop objective, evidence-based analyses.
* Provide situational analysis and intelligence support for quarterly business reviews, new product launches, portfolio and brand initiatives, strategic planning, market and landscape mapping, and ad-hoc executive priorities.
Prepare and/or oversee executive-ready intelligence briefs, presentations, landscape reviews, customized alerts, and other decision-support deliverables.  

AI, Automation & MR&I Innovation

* Leverage generative AI and agentic workflows to automate intelligence gathering, monitoring, synthesis, and knowledge retrieval, while maintaining human validation and source traceability.
Develop and continuously improve AI-enabled intelligence systems, including prompts, watchlists, taxonomies, knowledge bases, and governance practices, in partnership with MR&I and technology teams.  

Strategic Partnership, Communication & Execution

* Act as a trusted thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders, building strong relationships and aligning research and intelligence priorities to business decisions.
Craft and tailor recommendations for different stakeholder needs and levels of leadership, balancing analytical rigor with clear, concise storytelling.  

**Qualifications and Experience Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Market Research, Business, Economics, a related business or technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of market research, market intelligence, insights, strategy, consulting, or related experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex projects from definition through recommendation.
* Strong business acumen, critical thinking, facilitation, executive communication, and data storytelling skills.
* Ability to build trust quickly, work independently with stakeholders, and operate effectively in a cross-cultural, global environment.
Advanced PowerPoint and Excel capabilities; experience with market intelligence platforms (such as AlphaSense) and survey/research platforms.  

**Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, medical devices, digital health, or adjacent industry experience.
* Familiarity with the healthcare landscape in China and Japan, with additional understanding of Australia preferred.
* Existing relationships with or experience managing Asian market research and intelligence firms.
* Bilingual Mandarin capability preferred; Japanese language capability is advantageous but not required.
    
    
  #LI-APAC

Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. title: Product Manager - Generalist
description:
### **ABOUT REO**

**Who we are**

Reo.Dev is a modern revenue stack for Developer focused companies. We help Developer Tool companies identify which Engineering Teams have an Urgent need for their product and the highest likelihood of conversion. We capture and analyze a wide array of developer activity data from Github, Docs, Docker Installs, Communities, other dev specific sources and convert them to sales signals.

Read more here: https://app.notion.com/p/roverly/About-Reo-Dev-18c33e0c3ba2808280f8e4235365a052

**Great! Now let’s talk about You and this Role!**

### **What will you be working on?**

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our early team and work directly with the founders to shape the future of Reo.Dev.

This role will focus on improving the onboarding and self-serve journeys within the product — specifically the first 90 days of user experience and early customer success — while also owning broader product initiatives across the platform.

Some of your work will include:

* Own end-to-end product development for key product areas — from discovery to launch
* Drive onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention initiatives across the product journey
* Work closely with founders, engineering, and design to ship fast, iterate continuously, and improve user experience
* Deeply understand user workflows, friction points, and customer needs through user conversations and product analytics
* Translate business and user problems into clear product requirements and execution plans
* Prioritize ruthlessly and focus on initiatives that create maximum customer and business impact
* Define product requirements, write detailed specs, manage sprint execution, and maintain strong documentation
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and customer-facing teams
* Drive product decisions using data, experimentation, and customer insights
* Contribute to product strategy, roadmap planning, and long-term product vision
* Work on complex AI and data-driven workflows powering developer and GTM intelligence

**Skills we are looking for in this role**
------------------------------------------

This is a key role at Reo.Dev and we are looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company through its next phase of growth.

We are specifically looking for candidates who:

* Have **5+ years** of Product Management experience in **early-stage tech startups**
* Have strong experience in **B2B SaaS** products, ideally with exposure to **PLG/self-serve product journeys**
* Have worked on onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, or product growth initiatives
* Have experience working on complex systems and not just linear workflow products
* Are highly analytical and comfortable using product and usage data to drive decisions
* Can operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments
* Have strong product thinking, prioritization, communication, and execution skills
* Are highly hands-on and comfortable working closely with engineering and design teams
* Have exposure to AI products, developer tools, data products, or intelligence systems
* Have independently driven product initiatives from ideation to launch

**Preferred backgrounds:**

* B2B SaaS
* PLG SaaS
* Developer tools
* AI products
* Bottom-up SaaS products
* Growth/onboarding-focused PM roles

**What qualities we look for in our team members?**
---------------------------------------------------

While there is no stencil for the type of people we like, there are a few traits that might make Reo.Dev a better fit for you.

**Reo.Dev** **might be a good fit if you:**

* Work hard, **hands-on** (that’s very important to us!) and want to grow really fast.
* Care about your work a great deal, find it highly unsettling if the quality of work is even slightly sub-par.
* Execute fast.
* Are hands on (we will not have elaborate reporting structures for the foreseeable future and hopefully ever).
* Are someone people like to work with, low on ego, high on humility.
* Have the ability to fail, learn and keep trying till you win. Start-ups are tough and we will not get everything right the first time.
* Have a longish view of your career growth and not optimising for the next 1-2 years.

title: BI Tech Lead, Data products, YouTube
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in analytics and analytics development.
* 5 years of experience with relational databases including SQL queries, database definition, and schema design.
* 5 years of experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, etc.).
* Experience in system architecture and coding in at least one general purpose programming language (e.g., Java, C++, Python, etc.).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience in SQL database manipulation, advanced data analysis, and dashboard creation.
* Experience converting ambiguous business requests into technical requirements to develop insightful data products.
* Experience deploying data products cross-functionally and tailoring stakeholder communications to drive user adoption.
* Experience with Python, Java, C++, and Python-based APIs to manage data pipelines.
* Experience presenting complex solutions to senior stakeholders and building data tools with conversational or generative AI elements.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.  
  
You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.

Biz Data and Analytics (BIZ D&A) drives robust business decisions through expert analysis, data democratization, and actionable insights. The Users, Partnerships, and Creators Data Products team enhances the experience of front-line strategic partner managers and support operations. This is achieved by developing scalable data products and delivering cogent insights for partner engagement, creator and consumer support, and go-to-market strategies across YouTube's various relationships with creators, brands, media companies, and distributors.

In this role, you will lead the development of our centralized reporting and analytics solutions. You will partner with Partnerships, Support, and Go-to-Market teams to translate business needs into data products, driving better decision-making at scale. You will own the delivery of these solutions while advocating technical best practices among the community of business intelligence (BI) analysts and data engineers.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and deploy centralized dashboards, models, and single source of truth reports to optimize partner management and creator/consumer support.
* Partner with Partnerships, Support Operations, and GTM teams to identify business pain points and translate ambiguous requests into technical requirements.
* Collaborate with Data Infrastructure and Engineering teams to deliver a prioritized feature roadmap that enhances YouTube's support outcomes.
* Define and implement key metrics using the D&A maturity framework, providing strategic recommendations to achieve YouTube business organization's goals.
* Foster analyst community best practices across pipelines, code reviews, and dashboards while leading technical training for business analysts.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate Engineering team plays an important part in connecting advertisers with the hundreds of millions of customers that visit Zillow websites each month. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. We love it!
  
  
We are a dynamic team that makes a significant impact with its contributions. Members of this team have the opportunity to:
  
  
Work on products and initiatives that directly generate revenue
  
Collaborate with multiple teams across our consumer brands and corporate operations
  
Have their ideas heard and often implemented as new products, features or solutions
  
Use and evolve best-in-breed technology
  
Showcase leadership (and be appreciated for it!)
  
Develop a career path in new and relevant ways
  
Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Development Engineer (P3) at Zillow, you are a key contributor to your team’s success. You independently deliver non-trivial features and improvements, design solutions to well-scoped problems, and help teammates succeed. You are respected for the quality of your work and your thoughtful participation in team discussions. This role is about mastering your craft, deepening your technical impact, and building the foundation for future growth. In this role you will:

  

* Work on revenue-generating features that make a real impact on the business, while growing your technical expertise.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Be trusted to take ownership of meaningful projects, contribute to system design discussions, and strengthen the reliability and performance of our advertising platforms.
* Work across the stack: React/TypeScript micro-frontends, GraphQL federation, and backend services, plus ad-tech integrations (Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid, viewability and identity vendors).
* Ship experiments safely through A/B trial platforms with clear guardrail metrics, rollback paths, and data-informed decisions.
* Use AI coding assistants to amplify your expertise while exercising judgment on when to trust, revise, or set aside generated output.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technical Program Managers, Ad Ops, and page-owner teams (Search, Home Detail Page, Rentals, iOS/Android) to adapt and extend solutions for advertising use cases.
* Help refine team processes through agile ceremonies; support growth of the team through interviewing and onboarding.
* Continuously learn: seek feedback, and deepen your knowledge of ad technology, front-end performance, and distributed systems

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 4+ years designing, coding, and debugging production web applications and backend services.
* Strong proficiency in modern front-end development with React and TypeScript; experience with micro-frontend architectures, server-side rendering, and web performance optimization.
* Solid backend experience in Node.js/TypeScript and/or Java (Spring Boot); comfortable designing and consuming GraphQL APIs (federated graphs a plus).
* Experience with AWS and container/Kubernetes-based platforms, CI/CD (GitLab or similar), and observability tooling such as Datadog.
* Rigorous about quality: unit and integration testing (Jest, Playwright or equivalent), code review, monitoring.
* A track record of independently delivering well-scoped features with quality; communicates clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and seeks guidance when facing ambiguity .
* BS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

  

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

title: Senior Commercial Loan Closing Representative
description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Commercial Loan Closing Representative to support the successful execution of commercial lending transactions within Global Operations. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring complex loan closings are completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with established risk and control standards. Working closely with business partners, clients, and internal stakeholders, you will help deliver a seamless lending experience while contributing to operational excellence, process efficiency, and strong customer outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity to build expertise in commercial lending operations, collaborate across teams, and make a meaningful impact in a dynamic and highly visible environment. Based on the Chief Operating Office mission, the role supports effective and efficient delivery of services while helping strengthen Wells Fargo’s operational and control infrastructure.

**In this role, you will:**

* Support performance of less experienced staff and overall effectiveness of team
* Provide feedback and present ideas for improving or implementing processes and tools within Commercial Loan Closing
* Evaluate and upload data into the systems of record to ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Perform complex legal activities for loan documentation that may also include documentation purchased from a third-party source, internal staff and the Corporate Legal Group
* Provide subject matter expertise and interpretation of procedures to less experienced individuals
* Work collaboratively with Credit, Sales and Legal regarding proper procedures and documentation requirements necessary to ensure accuracy with negotiated terms and ensure alignment with appropriate compliance standards
* Interact with immediate team and Commercial Loan Closing

* 2+ years of Commercial Loan Closing support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

* Strong working knowledge of Loans IQ, with experience in loan booking, maintenance, payment processing, and transaction management.
* Hands-on experience in Commercial Loan Closing, ensuring accurate documentation review, funding coordination, and adherence to operational procedures.
* Exposure to the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle, including loan onboarding, servicing, amendments, and payoff activities.
* Proven ability to support syndicated and commercial loan operations while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and service level expectations.

**Desired Qualifications:**

1 Nov 2026
