title: Director - Automation Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Engineer, Product Manager leads the design, build and adoption of AI and agentic solutions in the Automation Acceleration Hub, combining hands-on AI engineering with product management to turn high-value opportunities into solutions that change how GSK runs technology. It identifies, shapes and prioritises AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, owns the AI product roadmap and backlog, and stays hands-on in design and delivery where that is what moves the work forward. Reliability and responsible-AI guardrails are built into solutions from the start, with explicit service levels for AI services.

The role is deliberately dual: engineering depth and product ownership sit together rather than being split across two people. AI platform architecture sits with the Director, AI Platform Architect, hands-on AI and agent engineering also sits with the Principal AI Engineer / Architect and the Principal AI / Prompt / Agent Engineer, process design sits with the Principal AI Process Architect, and adoption enablement sits with the Principal AI Enablement Lead. Solutions transition to the owning domain as they mature rather than remaining in the Hub indefinitely.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Identify, shape and prioritise high-value AI and automation opportunities across DPTF, linking each to strategy and to a measurable outcome rather than to a technology.
* Lead the design and delivery of AI and agentic solutions that accelerate delivery and operations, staying hands-on where that is what moves the work forward.
* Own the AI product roadmap and backlog, steering with OKRs and value metrics under lean portfolio principles.
* Build reliability and responsible-AI guardrails into solutions from the start, with clear service levels for AI services rather than best-effort operation.
* Partner with the platform domains to embed solutions in their operations, and transition ownership to them as solutions mature.
* Champion AI-native ways of working across DPTF, and treat adoption rather than deployment as the point at which a solution has landed.
* Measure and report the value and efficiency delivered by AI solutions, including where a solution did not deliver and has been stopped.
* Work with AI platform suppliers and model providers, holding them to performance and safety standards rather than accepting vendor assurance.
* Maintain a visible pipeline of assessed opportunities, so that Hub capacity is directed by value rather than by whoever asked most recently.
* Assess where agentic approaches are appropriate and where they are not, and record the reasoning so the judgement is reusable.
* Work within GSK information security, data and quality requirements, including GxP where a solution touches regulated activity, engaging those functions during design rather than at approval.
* Hold the boundaries with the Director, AI Platform Architect on AI platform architecture, the Principal AI Process Architect on process design, and the Principal AI Enablement Lead on adoption enablement.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology, engineering, mathematics or computer science discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* AI, machine learning or cloud certifications desirable, together with product or agile credentials.

**Experience Required**

  

* Typically 20+ years in engineering or technology delivery, including at least three years building AI, machine learning or automation solutions in production rather than in pilots.
* Strong hands-on experience with AI and agentic solutions, including large language model and agent frameworks.
* Product management experience, covering opportunity assessment, roadmap and backlog ownership and value measurement.
* Track record taking an opportunity through to delivered and adopted value, not to proof of concept.
* Practical responsible-AI awareness, including where a use case should not proceed.
* Experience with machine learning operations, or an automation or robotic process automation background.
* Experience holding technology suppliers and model providers to performance and safety standards.
* Practical awareness of AI patterns and judgment for where AI adds genuine value

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* List any licenses, certificates, registrations, or any relevant job skill or abilities not covered in Educational Background or Job-Related Experience sections above that are required for the job.
* Combination of engineering credibility and product judgement, since the role needs both at once.
* Discipline to stop a solution that is not delivering value rather than continuing to invest.
* Judgement about where agentic approaches genuinely fit and where a simpler method is better.
* Ability to transition ownership to domains rather than retaining solutions in the Hub.
* Comfort engaging security, data and quality functions during design rather than at approval.
* Scepticism toward vendor and model provider claims, with the means to test them.

**Skills**

AI Frameworks, Algorithm Optimization, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Computer Programming, Deep Learning, Feature Engineering, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) for Machine Learning, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Operations, Microsoft Azure Data and AI, ML Frameworks, Model Evaluation, Model Training, Model Validation, Performance Optimizations, Product Management, Robotics, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solutioning, Technical Delivery

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - Cloud
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Senior Product Owner - Cloud owns the backlog and roadmap for the Cloud platform, and all Cloud services translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output. Products span cloud, network, digital workplace and AI Hub domains, and the specific product is set on appointment.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering. This is an insourced role under the DPTF sourcing decisions, so it is not delivered through a managed service partner.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Experience delivering Cloud Services as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Experience using Jira or a similar backlog management tool.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Backlog Prioritization, Backlogs, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, Data Discovery, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Financial Operations Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Product Ownership, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

title: Product Management Principal Specialist
description:
**Job Title**

Product Management Principal Specialist

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Principal Product Manager will lead priority Front Office / SECO transformation initiatives from problem definition and MVP development through launch, adoption and scale. The role translates customer needs into clear product decisions and outcome-driven roadmaps, selecting the right mix of product, enablement and commercial levers to accelerate adoption.

Working across product, engineering, UX, marketing and customer-facing teams, the role will align delivery with go-to-market readiness and own outcomes beyond feature release—including activation, sustained usage, workflow migration and customer value realization. Central to this mandate is evolving Selling Platform Connect to improve how travel sellers shop, book and service content across graphical, cryptic and hybrid workflows.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own the Product Vision, Strategy and Roadmap**
------------------------------------------------

* Own the vision, strategy and outcome-driven roadmap for priority Front Office / SECO initiatives, translating customer needs, user behavior, market insights and business priorities into clear hypotheses, adoption goals and measurable milestones.
* Develop compelling value propositions, product narratives and investment cases that connect customer value with revenue, cost, adoption and strategic impact.
* Define the path from MVP to scale through target segments, phased rollouts, readiness criteria and adoption measures, balancing existing workflow continuity with graphical and AI-led modernization and clear decisions to continue, adapt, reposition or stop.

**Lead Adoption from MVP to Scale**
-----------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end adoption strategy from customer validation and pilots through launch, activation, usage growth, workflow migration and sustained value realization, aligned with product strategy.
* Develop segment-specific adoption playbooks combining in-product guidance, defaults, incentives, enablement, advocacy and targeted campaigns, with clear criteria for voluntary or firmer migration approaches based on customer impact, prerequisites, risks and expected outcomes.
* Define success measures and use product analytics, customer evidence and business indicators to assess performance, remove friction across the user journey and refine the proposition, experience or adoption approach.
* Partner with Product Marketing, launch and customer-facing teams on positioning, readiness and enablement, turning successful pilots into repeatable go-to-market and adoption approaches that scale across customers, segments and related workflows.

**Define and Use Adoption Metrics**
-----------------------------------

* Define an end-to-end adoption measurement framework covering eligibility, enablement, activation, usage depth and frequency, retention, workflow migration and value realization, with clear baselines, targets and leading indicators tied to product and business decisions.
* Combine quantitative analytics with customer research and frontline feedback to understand adoption drivers and barriers, embedding instrumentation and analytics requirements into the roadmap before launch.
* Establish regular performance reviews to diagnose gaps, prioritize interventions and communicate progress and trade-offs to leadership.

**Drive Cross-Functional Programs**
-----------------------------------

* Lead complex cross-functional programs, aligning related roadmaps, dependencies and product decisions while preserving individual product managers’ ownership of execution.
* Establish shared outcomes, accountabilities, decision points, risks and success measures, ensuring launch timing reflects product, commercial, operational and customer readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders, resolve misalignment and sustain momentum amid ambiguity and competing priorities, building reusable methods, governance and assets to scale adoption across markets, customer segments and related capabilities.

**Engage Customers and Shape the Product**
------------------------------------------

* Monitor competitors, technology trends and evolving travel seller needs to identify opportunities and inform product strategy and positioning.
* Build lasting customer and internal partnerships through discovery and co-creation, adapting product and adoption approaches to the workflows, constraints and operating models of TMCs, leisure agencies, online travel agencies and other seller segments.
Represent the product in executive discussions, roadmap reviews, pilots and launches, translating feedback into scalable product decisions and clearly communicating workflow value and successful transition paths.  

**Strengthen Product Excellence**
---------------------------------

* Champion outcome-based planning, disciplined discovery, prioritization and post-launch learning across the product area.
* Coach product managers and cross-functional partners on adoption thinking, product analytics, experimentation and value realization.
* Make clear trade-offs between feature breadth, experience quality, operational readiness and adoption impact.
Ensure accessibility, performance, reliability and usability are treated as adoption enablers within the product definition.  

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Significant product management experience with evidence of leading complex B2B or enterprise initiatives from problem discovery and MVP definition to broad, sustained adoption across multiple teams, customer segments or product areas.
* A strong record of owning product strategy and roadmaps while making difficult trade-offs across customer value, business outcome, adoption potential, delivery complexity and long-term product direction.
* Deep practical knowledge of adoption levers, including segmentation, onboarding, enablement, in-product interventions, incentives, workflow defaults, experimentation and migration approaches.
* Experience defining adoption funnels and using product analytics, customer insight and operational data to guide decisions.
* Proven leadership of complex cross-functional programs without relying on direct authority.
* Strong customer-facing and executive communication skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous product problems into clear choices, decisions and next steps.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and detailed levels, from portfolio choices and senior alignment to user journeys, blockers and metric definitions.
* Experience in travel technology, travel selling, servicing, shopping, desktop workflows or large-scale workflow transformation is highly valuable; the stronger requirement is the ability to understand complex domains quickly and turn them into clear product choices, adoption paths and measurable outcomes.
A collaborative, pragmatic and outcome-oriented leadership style with the courage to challenge assumptions and make difficult trade-offs.  

**What we can offer you**  
A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose

  
  

#LI-KA1

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Web Growth Manager
description:
**About the role**

JuliaHub is hiring a Web Growth Manager to own juliahub.com end-to-end: design an engaging, on-brand site, build and ship it in Framer, instrument every visit, and prove which web activity turns into sales opportunities.

JuliaHub builds Dyad, an agentic, Julia-native platform for engineering modeling and simulation, alongside the JuliaHub platform. Our buyers are engineers and technical leaders evaluating us against established dynamic modeling and control systems simulation tools. They research deeply, through search engines and increasingly through AI assistants, before they talk to sales.

You will be the single owner of the marketing site: its visual design, user experience, build, and measurement stack. You'll report to marketing leadership and work daily with the marketing team, application engineers, sales, and the development teams behind our products.

**What you'll do**

**Own the site's creative and experience**

* Own the look and feel of juliahub.com: apply and evolve the JuliaHub brand across typography, color, layout, imagery, and motion.
* Design page layouts, UI components, and a reusable design system directly in Framer.
* Create web graphics, illustrations, diagrams, product visuals, and simple animations that make technical products easy to grasp.
* Shape the UX: information architecture, navigation, page flow, and calls to action that pull engineers from first visit to trial or demo.
* Keep every product site and subdomain visually consistent, and set brand and style guidance others can follow.

  

**Own the site in Framer**

* Build, publish, and maintain pages, landing pages, and CMS collections (use cases, verticals, comparisons, FAQs, proof points) in Framer.
* Turn content into responsive, accessible, on-brand pages within days, designing directly in Framer.
* Run site governance: QA checklists, publishing workflow, redirects, navigation, forms, and a change log.
* Coordinate with engineering on DNS, CDN, and subdomains (help.juliahub.com, platform.juliahub.com, product docs).

  

**Drive organic and AI search growth**

* Own technical SEO in Google Search Console: indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, redirect chains, crawl errors, and Core Web Vitals.
* Maintain structured data (JSON-LD for Organization, Product/SoftwareApplication, FAQ, Article) and AI-readiness files such as llms.txt.
* Track how JuliaHub and Dyad appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) and optimize pages to be cited.

  

**Measure and attribute everything**

* Own GA4 and Google Tag Manager: event taxonomy, conversions, consent mode, and cross-domain tracking.
* Enforce UTM standards across campaigns, email, social, events, and partners.
* Connect web activity to Salesforce: form-to-lead routing, campaign membership, and offline conversion import.
* Build and maintain attribution reporting (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch) that ties web sessions to sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Publish a weekly web dashboard and a monthly growth readout with clear recommendations.

  

**Optimize conversion**

* Run A/B tests on headlines, CTAs, forms, and page layouts; report lift with sample sizes.
* Use heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix drop-off on trial, demo, and contact paths.

  

**Required qualifications**

* 4+ years designing and managing a B2B marketing website, ideally for a SaaS or technical product.
* A portfolio of live websites you designed and built, showing strong visual design, layout, and UX judgment.
* AI search optimization (AEO/GEO) experience, with tools that track brand visibility in AI answers.
* Hands-on Framer experience: you have designed and shipped production pages, components, and CMS collections in Framer itself.
* Experience applying AI technologies to accelerate and transform marketing workflows.
* Brand and visual design skills: typography, color, composition, and creating web graphics with tools such as Canva.
* Deep Google Analytics 4 experience: custom events, conversions, explorations, audiences, and BigQuery export or Looker Studio reporting.
* Deep Google Search Console experience: diagnosing indexing and coverage issues, sitemap management, and Core Web Vitals.
* Proven experience attributing web-based marketing activity to sales pipeline.
* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, UTM governance, and consent management.
* Experience connecting web forms and tracking to a CRM (Salesforce strongly preferred), including lead source and campaign attribution.
* Technical SEO fluency: redirects, canonicals, schema markup, site structure, and page speed.
* Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript for embeds, custom code, and tracking snippets.
* Clear writer and communicator who can turn data into a recommendation for non-analysts.

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Framer Expert certification.
* Experience turning complex technical concepts into clear diagrams and product visuals.
* SEO tooling experience: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse.
* Marketing automation and attribution tools experience.
* Experience marketing to engineers, scientists, or developers; familiarity with simulation, scientific computing, or developer tools is a plus.
* Experience in a venture-backed, high-growth environment.

title: Manager, Vendor Consultant, AVS-NOP
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon.com
  
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
About the Role
  
Team Manager, Vendor Consultants Team - RBS AVS  
As a Vendor Consultants Manager in Retail Business Services (RBS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on the strategy for managing Amazon vendors.
  
RBS team is looking for a customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Vendor Consultants responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all operational aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships.  
You will lead the team that looks into strategic and operational aspects of vendors business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.  
  
  
  
A day in the life  
Responsibilities Include:
  

* Lead a team of Vendor Consultants, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience.
* Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience, in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams.

title: Platform Product Manager - Cloud Common Services (Atmos)
description:
India - Bangalore

Product Development and Operations/Full time/Onsite

Cloud Common Services (CCS) builds the essential cloud infrastructure and platform services that power the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP). At the heart of this is Atmos, Guidewire's "PaaS within SaaS" layer — built on AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker — that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized core applications, cloud-native services, and associated workloads.
  
  
As Platform Product Manager, you'll own the roadmap and delivery for a defined set of platform capabilities within CCS/Atmos that internal engineering teams and external insurer customers rely on every day. Working closely with senior product leaders, engineering, and SRE, you'll help shape how Guidewire delivers infrastructure as a product — with a focus on developer experience, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone with a solid technical foundation in cloud infrastructure who is building their product management career and wants to grow into platform strategy ownership.

**Job Description**

We are looking for candidates with 6–10 years of overall work experience, including a minimum of 1–2 years in Product Management (or a product-adjacent role such as technical program management, solutions engineering, or platform engineering with product responsibilities).

  
  
Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more platform service areas within CCS/Atmos — such as deployment tooling, observability, Kubernetes-based compute, networking, or

* d platform services — in alignment with the broader CCS product strategy.
* Develop a working understanding of the Guidewire Cloud ecosystem, the multi-tenant/hybrid-tenancy architecture, and the needs of both internal developer teams and external customers.
* Treat platform infrastructure as a product: identify friction in developer workflows and define capabilities that improve productivity, self-service, and time-to-value.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE/Operations, UX, and Enablement to discover, test, refine, and prioritize solutions.
* Write clear feature requirements and user stories with well-defined use cases and acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to roadmap planning by bringing customer insight, usage data, and operational feedback to prioritization discussions.
* Support the launch of new platform services and features; define success metrics, measure adoption and performance, and iterate.
* Be a power user of the platform capabilities you build.
* Communicate progress, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.
* Embrace a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI — using emerging tools and data-driven insights to improve how you and your teams work.
  

  

**We're looking for someone who**
---------------------------------

* Has experience working on platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — as a product manager, or in a technical role (engineering, SRE, DevOps, solutions/technical program management) with a demonstrated interest in moving into product management.
* Has a solid understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (AWS Cloud Practitioner certification is a plus).
* Understands containerization and container orchestration (Docker & Kubernetes) and the basics of running services at scale.
* Is familiar with core platform concerns such as CI/CD, observability/monitoring, networking, multi-tenancy, reliability (SLO/SLA), and cost awareness.
* Can translate customer and developer needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Is comfortable managing and prioritizing a product backlog and working in agile delivery cycles.
* Collaborates effectively with engineering and operations teams through design, development, testing, release, and maintenance.
* Uses data and customer feedback to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Is eager to learn, take ownership, and grow into broader product strategy responsibilities.
  

  

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Exposure to identity and access management concepts — SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SSO, SCIM — and how they apply to platform services.
* Experience with load balancing and networking in cloud environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner (or higher) certification.
* Familiarity with Aha! and JIRA.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Ability to travel up to 5% as needed.
  

  

**Role-specific competencies**

title: Marketing Manager – STPT
description:
The Marketing Manager – STANLEY & BLACK+DECKER will play a pivotal role in shaping category strategy and executing marketing initiatives that enhance brand visibility, drive profitable growth, and strengthen market position. This role will be responsible for developing and delivering innovative marketing programs, identifying market opportunities, supporting new product launches, enabling sales teams, and managing the overall business performance of the assigned category/portfolio.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial acumen with strategic marketing capability, and brings a proven ability to translate market insights into actionable growth plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Planning**

* Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies for the assigned portfolio, aligned with overall business and brand objectives.
* Build annual and quarterly marketing plans to drive revenue, market share, and brand strength across priority channels and customer segments.

**Business and P&L Management**

* Own and manage the category’s commercial performance, including revenue, margin, pricing, and profitability.
* Monitor business results against targets and take corrective actions to improve topline growth and margin delivery.
* Partner with finance and sales teams on planning, budgeting, and performance reviews.

**Market and Consumer Insights**

* Conduct ongoing market analysis to understand customer needs, channel trends, category dynamics, and competitor activity.
* Translate insights into actionable strategies for portfolio expansion, pricing, positioning, and go-to-market execution.

**New Product Development and Launch**

* Lead the development and launch of new products in collaboration with regional teams, R&D, sourcing, and sales.
* Define product propositions, positioning, pricing, and launch plans to ensure strong market entry and adoption.
* Track post-launch performance and optimize plans based on customer and channel feedback.

**Demand Forecasting and Portfolio Planning**

* Develop and refine demand forecasts for new and existing products in partnership with sales, supply chain, and finance teams.
* Improve forecast accuracy to support inventory planning, reduce stock-outs, and minimize excess inventory.
* Drive SKU productivity and portfolio rationalization

**Competitive Benchmarking**

* Conduct regular benchmarking on competitor products, pricing, promotions, and channel strategies.
* Use competitive insights to sharpen value propositions and maintain market competitiveness.

**Campaign Management**

* Plan and execute impactful marketing campaigns across relevant online and offline channels.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and optimize future investments based on performance data and ROI.

**Content and Brand Communication**

* Oversee the development of compelling marketing assets, including brochures, POSM, digital content, sales tools, and promotional materials.
* Ensure all communication is aligned with brand guidelines and tailored to local market needs.

**Sales Enablement**

* Partner closely with the sales team to develop tools, programs, and channel activation plans that support sell-in and sell-out objectives.
* Provide market intelligence, product training inputs, and customer-facing materials to strengthen commercial execution.

**Budget Management**

* Manage the marketing budget effectively, ensuring disciplined allocation of resources and strong return on investment.
* Track spending against plan and ensure timely, efficient deployment of funds.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including sales, finance, supply chain, product, and regional/global marketing teams.
* Build strong working relationships with external agencies, channel partners, and other key stakeholders to ensure aligned execution.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The success of this role will typically be measured through a combination of business, brand, and execution metrics, including:

**Business Performance**

* Achievement of net sales / revenue targets
* Delivery of gross margin and profitability targets
* Category market share growth
* Price realization and pricing discipline
* Portfolio contribution to overall business growth

**Product and Portfolio Management**

* New product launch success rate
* % of sales from new products / innovation pipeline
* Time-to-launch for new products
* SKU productivity and portfolio optimization outcomes

**Forecasting and Supply Alignment**

* Forecast accuracy
* Reduction in stock-outs and excess inventory
* Inventory health across key SKUs and channels

**Marketing Effectiveness**

* Campaign ROI
* Brand visibility and awareness growth
* Lead generation / channel activation effectiveness, where applicable
* Performance of promotions and marketing programs against objectives

**Sales and Channel Support**

* Improvement in sell-in / sell-out performance
* Quality and adoption of sales enablement tools
* Channel engagement and execution effectiveness

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business administration from a reputed institute.
* 10+ years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in marketing and/or product management.
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing and category growth strategies.
* Strong understanding of market analysis, brand management, product development, and go-to-market execution.
* Experience in demand forecasting, P&L management, competitive benchmarking, and pricing strategy.
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to convert data into actionable business insights.
* Creative thinker with a passion for brand building, innovation, and storytelling.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence a diverse set of stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

***We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.***

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.

**Who We Are**

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

**Global Benefits & Perks**  
You’ll be rewarded with a competitive salary plus receive entitlements and benefits unique to your country of hire.

**What You’ll Also Get**

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

**Learning & Development:**  
Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).

**Diverse & Inclusive Culture:**  
We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.

**Purpose-Driven Company:**  
You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

title: Senior Software Engineer - C++
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team responsible for one of X-Rite's strategically important desktop software products. This product plays a critical role in our customers' workflows and has a large installed base worldwide.

The role combines maintenance and enhancement of an established Windows desktop application built primarily in C++. This position is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys working with complex software systems, understands the challenges of maintaining and evolving long-lived commercial products, and can balance short-term business needs with long-term technical improvements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Application Support, and engineering teams across multiple geographies to deliver high-quality software solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality C++ with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Working extensively with Qt libraries, and multi-threaded programming to build robust and efficient applications
* Configuring, building, and troubleshooting applications using CMake build systems and Visual Studio IDE.
* Identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex issues using debugging tools and performance profilers.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment using tools such as JIRA and similar tracking systems.
* Analyzing customer and business requirements and translating them into clear technical designs and formal software specifications
* Conducting code reviews, providing technical feedback, and mentoring junior developers to improve overall code quality
* Communicating technical concepts clearly through documentation, design discussions, and presentations
* Continuously learning and adapting to new technologies, tools, and technology stacks as project needs evolve
* Develop and expand automated unit and integration test coverage.
* Contribute to long-term roadmap activities aimed at improving the sustainability of the product platform.

**Required Qualifications & Professional Knowledge**

* 4 - 8+ years of professional software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in modern C++ and object-oriented software design.
* Experience maintaining and evolving long-lived commercial software products.
* Experience working with large and complex codebases in production environments.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, multithreading, and performance optimization.
* Experience debugging complex software issues across multiple layers of an application.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Visual Studio, CMake, and Windows application development.
* Familiarity with source control systems, automated builds, testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking tools.
* Experience participating in Agile software development processes (Scrum and/or Kanban).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively within globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience maintaining and extending mature or legacy software products.
* Experience modernizing existing software systems while maintaining backward compatibility.
* Experience with dependency management solutions such as vcpkg, Conan, or NuGet.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and software quality engineering practices.
* Experience working in geographically distributed engineering organizations.
* Experience in Windows desktop application development.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working with hardware-connected desktop applications.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong ownership mindset and accountability for delivering reliable, high-quality software.
* Pragmatic approach to balancing feature delivery, product stability, and technical improvement.
* Ability to understand and work effectively within existing software architectures before introducing changes.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for improving long-standing systems through incremental modernization.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Collaborative and effective communicator in cross-functional and globally distributed teams.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across multiple time zones.
* Appreciation for the business value and customer impact of mature software products with large installed customer bases.
* Ability to balance short-term delivery priorities with long-term platform sustainability

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.

### **We Offer**

* A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment.
* Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field.
* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department.
* Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career.
* The opportunity to work on business-critical data platforms that support decision-making across the company.
* Be part of building products that address real-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value.
* Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America.
* A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.
* The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction.

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. * Design end-to-end product and interaction experiences for enterprise AI applications, agentic workflows, and AI platform capabilities from problem framing through production delivery.
* Translate complex AI capabilities and technical workflows into intuitive experiences for conversational AI, intelligent workflows, autonomous and semi-autonomous agents, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Design AI-native interaction patterns for uncertainty, recommendations, generated content, citations, evidence, agent progress, planned actions, permissions, trust, transparency, and user control.
* Design human-in-the-loop experiences that allow users to review, approve, modify, reject, pause, resume, correct, escalate, or override AI and agent actions.
* Create user journeys, workflow models, information architectures, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes, and reusable design patterns for AI experiences.
* Build functional prototypes using modern design tools, frontend technologies, AI-assisted coding tools, LLM APIs, agent APIs, or representative AI behavior to validate interaction concepts before production engineering.
* Conduct user research, usability testing, design experiments, and product validation, and use findings and product feedback to continuously improve the experience.
* Partner closely with AI Application Engineers, Applied AI Engineers, AI Platform Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to move validated concepts into production.

* How AI changes product design when systems are probabilistic, dynamic, context-dependent, and capable of acting on behalf of users.
* How to design effective human-agent collaboration across approvals, delegated actions, uncertainty, evidence, feedback, correction, and failure recovery.
* How enterprise AI applications and platforms expose concepts such as agents, models, tools, permissions, traces, evaluations, deployments, and observability to users.
* How to rapidly prototype with real AI capabilities and use AI-assisted design and development tools to move from concept to testable experience faster.
* How user experience, engineering, security, Responsible AI, and enterprise governance considerations come together in AI-native product design.

A Bachelor's Degree in Product Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science.  
Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, or an Advanced Degree in a related field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience.

* Demonstrated experience designing complex digital products, enterprise applications, B2B SaaS, developer tools, workflow products, or similarly sophisticated software.

* Demonstrated ability to simplify complex technical workflows and ambiguous problems into coherent, intuitive user experiences.
* Experience creating interactive or functional prototypes, not only static mockups, using modern prototyping technologies or AI-assisted development approaches.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to explain design decisions and work effectively with engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, and globally distributed teams.

Qualifications We Prefer

* Experience designing Generative AI, conversational AI, agentic AI, AI-powered enterprise applications, or developer-facing AI products.
* Experience designing AI-native patterns involving human-agent collaboration, approvals, uncertainty, feedback, citations, provenance, trust, transparency, agent control, and failure recovery.

title: Director - Automation Engineer / Product Manager
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose:**

  

Serve as the quality, governance and product authority for Cyber Architecture & Solutions. You are accountable for ensuring every security solution Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds meets the required quality, compliance and operational standard before it reaches the global managed service vendor — the independent quality gate between what Cyber Architecture and Solutions produces and what the vendor is asked to operate. You own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance framework, the security product portfolio, vendor governance for the managed service as a whole, and the programme capability that delivers all Cyber Architecture and Solutions change. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining accountability while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles, and the primary Cyber Architecture and Solutions interface to internal audit, regulators and the second and third lines of defence.

About the team. Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

**What makes this role different. The defining tension is that you assure against standards you do not own. Architecture writes them; you verify independently and make binding pass-or-fail calls on vendor handover readiness — and that separation has to survive pressure from programmes with deadlines and from architects who will not welcome the finding. You are also the executive accountable for a vendor operating more than 30 platforms, where the operational risk is real but the levers are contractual rather than direct. Expect audit and regulatory scrutiny of the governance framework you own, and be ready to evidence a governance function of yours that withstood it.**

**Key responsibilities:**

  

* This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
* Define, own and continuously improve the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance and quality framework — the assurance process, the pass or fail criteria for vendor handover and the exception regime — applying the design standards owned by the Architecture function rather than authoring them.
* Own and operate the independent design assurance process, making binding pass or fail determinations on vendor handover readiness with no compromise on quality.
* Lead a 17-role function spanning Design Assurance, Security Product Management, and vendor and portfolio governance, sustaining a culture of rigour, independence and delivery.
* Own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions security product portfolio: product roadmaps for every capability under Cyber Architecture and Solutions's remit, full lifecycle management from introduction through evolution to decommission, prioritised against GSK's cyber risk appetite.
* Hold ultimate commercial accountability for vendor governance across the managed service — performance, SLA, escalation and commercial levers, and oversight of platform support as it transitions to the OTO model — with day-to-day governance delegated to the Associate Director for vendor governance.
* Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions security risk and exception management at the most senior level: assess complex architectural risk exceptions, maintain the Cyber Architecture and Solutions risk register, and escalate material unmitigated risk with unambiguous clarity.
* Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions-wide metrics and security posture reporting, and present authoritative performance evidence to the CISO, ExCo and Board-level risk committees.
* Lead Cyber Architecture and Solutions engagement with internal audit, external regulators and the second and third lines of defence, evidencing design quality and governance effectiveness.
* Own portfolio intelligence and investment analytics so prioritisation decisions are evidence-based rather than loudest-voice.
* Protect the independence of assurance when it is commercially or politically inconvenient.
* Own the function's budget and the security tooling spend envelope it governs, and defend the consolidation savings committed in the annual plan against the renewal calendar.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 15+ years in cyber security, including 7+ in senior leadership in a regulated environment leading leaders across geographies — domain focus: function head for cyber security product management and Design Assurance across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions portfolio
* End-to-end product management of cyber security products — threat-led use-case definition, business case and investment, roadmap, vendor evaluation and selection, onboarding, adoption and value tracking, renewal and decommission — running capabilities as products with outcome KPIs (coverage, adoption, efficacy, cost per capability)
* Building and leading a cyber security product management practice with domain product owners for each domain group, each mirrored to a Security Solution Engineering squad working in parallel, and technical deep dives proving product efficacy and integration
* Leading an independent Design Assurance practice and governing a security managed service — binding pass or fail decisions on handover readiness made against standards owned by the Architecture function and never by you, supported by drift detection, QBRs and EBCs.
* Leading AI adoption across the portfolio and assurance — AI-enabled tool evaluation, assurance of agentic solutions and AI-driven lifecycle automation from intake to decommission

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Architecture literacy to make binding quality judgements on expert architecture output they do not own, expressed as non-conformance to a specific standard clause
* Delivering enterprise security tool rationalisation with quantified savings, sequenced against renewal dates, with automated utilisation and renewal analytics
* Evidencing design and product governance to internal audit, external audit and regulators, producing decisions, approvals and exceptions on demand
* Credibility with Board-level risk committees, presenting assurance outcomes, portfolio performance and residual risk directly
* Commercial acumen — multi-year vendor contracts, TCO and cost-to-serve modelling
* Typical tools and technologies: Product portfolio and roadmap platforms, vendor performance, SLA and commercial governance, design assurance methodology and assurance register, AI-assisted and agentic lifecycle automation, ServiceNow, Power BI for portfolio and assurance analytics, GxP-compliant documentation and audit evidence management.

**Skills**

AI Adoption, Asset Life Cycle Management, Cyber Security Architecture, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Product Management, Product Portfolios, Risk Awareness, Service Portfolio, Standards Compliance

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Staff Technical Product Manager
description:
Technical Product Manager Role will:
  
  
Act as liaison between process owners and solution stakeholders and become the official solution advocates where required. Key person in determining when, how a solution needs to be developed, upgraded, or dropped.
  
Guides project teams and customers for planning of sprints and Iterations of delivery of solutions.
  
A Product manager will have to deal with “Systems of Systems” scenarios, must be concerned not just with how the solution will operate in its own context, but how it will function in the context of the larger IT ecosystem. A successful candidate is expected to question assumptions and drive change to mitigate potential risks, envision or evaluate new technology or solutions and to move towards it.
  
  
The successful candidate will gain and understand business process relevant to the problem, defining the AS-IS process, identify gaps that needs to be addressed, define the To-Be Process and convert them into IT requirements, solutions. This position will give you an opportunity to be part of an innovation team in a greenfield area to help define new process improvements, solutions in automation, data challenges to help GE Power Conversion to continuously drive innovation and maximize businesses outcomes along with user experience.

**Job Description**
===================

1. Business Analyst

Meets with business and IT stakeholders to translate business challenges into a business case for automation.

Writes business case documentation, which includes documentation of as-is process, business process modelling, identification of automation areas, and return on investment (ROI) benefits analysis.

Writes the Business Requirements document which includes a detailed overview of the as-is process and outlines the challenges that could be solved through an IT and/or automation solution.

Actively engages with key stakeholders and goes to the place of work to observe the business processes in actions to effectively provide ideas for automation.

Maintains strong relationships with key stakeholders by gaining trust of stakeholders and respect through technical leadership.

2. Technical Solution Architect

Looks at business processes to identify potential automation solutions that can be automated using RPA, AI, or similar technologies.

Partners with business and application solution architects to understand how processes are implemented in IT systems and provides automation solutions to drive productivity and simplification.

Writes Solution Design document and holds session with business and IT stakeholders to ensure full understanding of technical approach for solution delivery.

3. Product Management

Manages the full lifecycle of the solution, including initial problem definition, solution design, development, postproduction support, and eventual solution retirement.

Evaluates the active solution portfolio and upgrade and improve existing solutions as required based on evolving business needs.

Works with ITO, Project Management and/or Services processes and IT owners to identify automation opportunities.

Writes and maintains product specifications, which includes the solution configuration guide and operations guide.

4. Vendor Management

Manages vendor relationship to drive delivery, including providing effort estimation, evaluation of proposals, and overseeing delivery of third-party resources.

Manages Development &Testing, Deployment and Maintenance.

  
  

**Qualifications / Requirements**

* At least 8 years related experience in IT Industry as Business Analyst, Solution Architect, or equivalent role.
* Provided solutions for cross functional IT Systems, with a significant part of the experience in Business Applications and/or ERP solutions.
* At least 4-5 years of experience in a Business Analyst role in at least one of the business domains ITO, Project Management or Services etc..
* Atleast 3-4 years expereince in leading Automations using tools like UiPath, n8n, blue prism, power automate, automation anyware
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Quick learner of functional process and how it influences IT applications and solutions with Problem Solving mind set.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes
* Thinker with focus on big picture, root cause while driving discussions, solution design and tools required to solve the problems.
* Technical Experience: ERP in one of more modules, RPA, Chat-BoT Automation and or BI/Data Analytics experience.
* Good presentation and Communication skills
* Have had experience in evaluation of tools and s/w
* Work expereince in AI/GenAI, Agents will be added advantage
* Experience working in remote / global teams.

==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

**The Opportunity**
===================================================================================

Nutanix is looking for a passionate and talented UX Writer/Content Designer. Nutanix, a leader in hybrid multicloud computing, is a diverse organization. More than 6,000 of us work across geographies and time zones to help businesses of the future embrace multicloud solutions.

**About Nutanix**
-----------------

Nutanix provides an enterprise cloud platform that gives organizations a single hyperconverged infrastructure combining virtualization, storage, and networking for all their apps and data across clouds.

With Nutanix, organizations can reduce complexity and simplify operations. As a pioneer of hyperconverged infrastructure, Nutanix is trusted worldwide to power hybrid multicloud environments consistently and cost-effectively. Incorporated in 2009, Nutanix is headquartered in San Jose, California. Learn more at www.nutanix.com

**About the role**

As a UX Writer/Content Designer, you’ll join our Research & Design team and work closely with designers, researchers, and engineers. You’ll help us shape our product experiences by informing content strategy, information architecture, and language.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

You are a strong copy editor/writer with experience defining and realizing a content strategy across a sizable product portfolio. You possess a “makers” mentality and are equally comfortable “pitching in” as an individual contributor as you are at developing strategy and pitching to stakeholders.

The Content Strategy role at Nutanix is a terrific opportunity to define and build a mission-critical function within a successful, growing, market-leading company. The UX Writer/Content Designer role is a critical component of the Nutanix strategy to leverage design to revolutionize the cloud infrastructure experience. "Design" and "Customer delight" are embedded in every step of our product cycle. Nutanix has a design-first philosophy that combines consumer-grade design with web-scale engineering to create an amazing user experience.

We’re looking for a UX Content Designer to shape intuitive, consistent, and user-centered experiences across our products. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Engineers, and subject matter experts to simplify complex concepts, design effective product experiences, and ensure content is an integral part of the product development process.

This role goes beyond writing UI copy. It involves understanding user needs, solving content and usability challenges, establishing consistent terminology, and creating scalable content patterns that help users navigate complex products with confidence.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Putting our users first, your work will be grounded in empathy, drawing upon user research and feedback.
* Design clear, user-centered content for product interfaces, including labels, buttons, forms, tooltips, notifications, and error messages, and simplify complex technical concepts and workflows through effective content design.
* Contribute to content guidelines, terminology resources, and design systems.
* You’ll remove critical assumptions from our user data, design patterns, and communication style to help improve our product delivery.
* You’ll collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure consistency, voice, tone, and brand appeal.
* You’ll explore AI-assisted content workflows to improve efficiency while maintaining quality, accuracy, and consistency.
* You’ll frequently plan and educate peers, managers, and stakeholders on the importance of communication, processes, methods, tools, and your work impact.
* You’ll identify goals and metrics you plan to achieve at frequent intervals.
* Use user research, feedback, and usability insights to improve product experiences.
* Review implemented experiences to ensure content quality and consistency.

The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.

**Role requirements:**
----------------------

* Native or C2 level proficiency in English.
* Minimum of five years of experience in a similar role
* Experience in enterprise UX
* Experience in publishing or editing
* Experience working with content and design toolsets and workflows
* Familiarity with tools such as Figma

**Preferred for this role:**

* A degree in a writing-intensive major.
* Strong writing, editing, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Extensive knowledge of best practices for content design, information

architecture, and support content.

* Writing portfolio including, but not limited to, user interface copy, microcopy, and user education.
* Previous experience creating and maintaining UX content design systems.
* Working knowledge of design tools.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted content workflows, accessibility, usability testing, and product analytics.

**Things we’re looking for in a resume and portfolio.**

* Language skills
* Exposure to a wide variety of topics and publication formats.
* Quantification of your work impact
* Involvement in the product/project lifecycle
* Exposure to other disciplines and collaboration work style.
* Evidence of editorial experience

**Work Arrangement**

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
