title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
**About Exotel:**

Exotel is a leading cloud communications platform that helps businesses transform how they engage with their customers. Our solutions power enterprise conversations across voice, messaging, and digital channels, enabling businesses to deliver seamless, reliable, and scalable customer experiences.

We work with enterprises across industries, helping them solve complex communication challenges through cloud technology, APIs, and innovative communication solutions.

At Exotel, we operate at the intersection of communications, technology, and customer experience, helping businesses build better customer interactions at scale.

  

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to manage and grow relationships with some of Exotel’s largest enterprise customers.

In this role, you will own the customer relationship across the post-sales lifecycle - from implementation and solution launches to product adoption, renewals, and account expansion. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to ensure successful deployments, resolve escalations, and identify opportunities to grow revenue from existing accounts.

This is a customer-facing, commercially accountable role that combines technical understanding, relationship management, project coordination, and revenue ownership.

The ideal candidate will have experience in SaaS customer success, technical account management, or enterprise account management, with a strong understanding of APIs and integrations. Experience managing customers in banking, financial services, or insurance (BFSI) will be an added advantage.

  

**What will you do:**

1. Revenue Ownership and Account Growth

* Own monthly and quarterly revenue targets for assigned accounts, driving renewals, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to expand product adoption and increase revenue within existing customer accounts.
* Collaborate with Sales teams to develop account growth strategies and convert expansion opportunities into revenue.
* Lead commercial discussions, negotiate pricing and contract terms, and manage subscription renewals.
* Proactively identify renewal risks and develop plans to protect and grow existing revenue.

  

2. Customer Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned enterprise customers, building strong relationships with business, technology, and leadership stakeholders.
* Understand customer objectives, business challenges, and success criteria, translating them into actionable plans.
* Drive customer engagement, satisfaction, retention, and long-term value realization.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to demonstrate value, review progress, and identify growth opportunities.
* Manage customer expectations proactively and address concerns before they escalate.

  

3. Technical Account Management

* Develop a strong understanding of Exotel’s platform, APIs, integrations, and product capabilities.
* Explain technical concepts and solution capabilities effectively to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Work with customer engineering teams and Exotel’s internal Product, Engineering, and Support teams to facilitate integrations and resolve technical challenges.
* Conduct product demonstrations and solution discussions to showcase how Exotel’s capabilities address customer requirements.
* Help customers diagnose technical issues and coordinate with internal teams to drive resolution.

  

4. Implementation and Project Management

* Coordinate customer implementations and solution launches, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, milestones, and responsibilities.
* Work across customer teams and internal stakeholders to manage dependencies, track progress, and mitigate delivery risks.
* Manage multiple customer projects simultaneously, prioritising activities based on urgency, business impact, and customer commitments.
* Ensure smooth transitions from implementation to ongoing account management and product adoption.
* Track project outcomes and help customers realise the intended business value from Exotel’s solutions.

  

5. Escalation Management and Cross-functional Collaboration

* Own customer escalations and drive timely resolution by coordinating with Support, Engineering, Product, Finance, and other relevant teams.
* Communicate issues, risks, progress, and resolution plans clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Partner with Finance and Accounts Receivable teams to resolve billing, payment, and commercial queries.
* Represent the voice of the customer internally, sharing feedback and recurring pain points to improve products and service delivery.

  

6. Reporting and Account Governance

* Maintain accurate customer, commercial, renewal, and engagement information in the CRM.
* Track account health, revenue performance, renewal timelines, product adoption, and expansion opportunities.
* Prepare account updates and business reviews that communicate progress, risks, outcomes, and next steps.
* Use account data to identify risks early and drive continuous improvement.

  

**What are we looking for:**

* 3-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company.
* Demonstrated experience owning revenue targets, including renewals, upselling, cross-selling, or account expansion.
* Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and technical solutioning, with the ability to work effectively with engineering teams.
* Experience managing enterprise customers and coordinating multiple stakeholders across business and technology teams.
* Commercial acumen, including experience with pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and renewals.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise competing demands, and handle high-stakes customer situations.
* Proficiency in CRM systems for managing customer information, commercial opportunities, and account engagement.

  

**Good to have:**

* Experience managing customers in banking, financial services, or insurance (BFSI).
* Familiarity with cloud telephony, CPaaS, CCaaS, contact centre technology, or communication APIs.
* Experience supporting enterprise integrations and technology-led customer deployments.
* Exposure to customer health tracking, churn prevention, and account expansion strategies.

  

**Success Metrics:**

* Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Renewal performance and revenue growth within existing accounts.
* Increased adoption of Exotel’s products and solutions.
* Successful customer implementations and timely resolution of escalations.
* Customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term account health.
* Identification and conversion of upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Effective account governance and cross-functional collaboration.

description:

title: Implementation Manager
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of over 200+ passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.tners India, and super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg, etc.

**What will you do? (Role Overview)**

You’ll run discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-lives with a strong consultative voice. You’ll guide customers toward best practices, manage escalations when needed, and ensure they get value—fast. This is a high-ownership role designed for our future
**AI-first Professional Services org**
, where problem-solving, adaptability, and technical depth are essential.

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle for enterprise customers—from kick-off to go-live.
* Lead requirement-gathering sessions and translate business workflows into Rocketlane configurations.
* Design and guide customers on best-practice implementations, even when that means pushing back or course-correcting.
* Work with customer teams (IT, HR, Finance, PMO, Ops) to design integrations with systems like HRMS, CRM, NetSuite, and fintech platforms.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Solutions) to unblock complex implementations.
* Manage risks, escalations, and tough conversations with clarity and calm.
* Adopt and shape AI-driven workflows to automate routine tasks and improve customer value delivery.
* Serve as the customer’s trusted advisor on onboarding processes, data flows, and integration patterns.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Technical & Integration Skills**

* **Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Webhooks**
  (reading API docs, testing endpoints, and understanding auth flows).
* Experience building or supporting
  **custom integrations**
  between SaaS platforms and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of SaaS concepts: data models, webhooks, API limits, auth, and typical enterprise integration patterns.
* Comfortable working with tools like
  **Postman, Workato, Boomi, Zapier, Make, or other iPaaS solutions**
  .

**Implementation Expertise**

* 5+ years in a
  **customer-facing role at a SaaS company**
  (Implementations / Onboarding / Technical Consulting).
* Proven ability to
  **run enterprise onboarding projects**
  end-to-end with minimal supervision.
* Skilled in conducting discovery, documenting workflows, and translating requirements into system configurations.

**AI-First Aptitude**

* Strong curiosity and a builder mindset—someone who experiments, prototypes, and learns independently.
* Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development or scripting tools (e.g.,
  **Cursor, Replit, Lovable**
  or similar) to automate tasks, validate data, test APIs, or streamline workflows.
* Driven to “own your destiny” by building small scripts, utilities, or workflows that make onboarding faster, cleaner, and more scalable.

**Consultative & Communication Skills**

* Ability to
  **be assertive**
  —advise customers on the best approach rather than simply taking requirements.
* Experience navigating escalations and difficult conversations with professionalism.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to simplify technical concepts.

**Problem-Solving & Ownership**

* Strong analytical skills with a bias for action—thrives in ambiguity.
* High ownership mentality: independently unblocks, drives outcomes, and keeps projects moving.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience implementing or supporting systems like
  **Salesforce, Workday/BambooHR, NetSuite, ERP/CRM/Finance tools**
  .
* Background in Professional Services, Customer Success, or PSA tools (Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, Jira, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA).
* Understanding of SSO/SAML, enterprise IT processes, or data migration.
* Familiarity with SQL for basic data validation.
* Project Management certifications (PMP, CSM) or equivalent mindset.
* Experience in high-growth SaaS environments.

**You should apply if you:**

* Love owning customer outcomes end-to-end.
* Are technically curious and enjoy solving integration and workflow problems.
* Thrive in customer conversations—even the tough ones.
* I want to help shape the future of an
  **AI-first Professional Services org**
  .
* Are energized by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**
  : You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**

* **Celebrate wins**
  : Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From
  rap videos
  to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**
  : We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**
  : While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pyjamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING
description:
Position Summary...
  
  
Drives the execution of multiple business plans and projects by identifying customer and operational needs; developing and communicating business plans and priorities; removing barriers and obstacles that impact performance; providing resources; identifying performance standards; measuring progress and adjusting performance accordingly; developing contingency plans; and demonstrating adaptability and supporting continuous learning. Provides supervision and development opportunities for associates by selecting and training; mentoring; assigning duties; building a team-based work environment; establishing performance expectations and conducting regular performance evaluations; providing recognition and rewards; coaching for success and improvement; and ensuring diversity awareness. Promotes and supports company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity by training and providing direction to others in their use and application; ensuring compliance with them; and utilizing and supporting the Open Door Policy. Ensures business needs are being met by evaluating the ongoing effectiveness of current plans, programs, and initiatives; consulting with business partners, managers, co-workers, or other key stakeholders; soliciting, evaluating, and applying suggestions for improving efficiency and cost-effectiveness; and participating in and supporting community outreach events.
  
  
**About The Team**
Walmart's Global Tech Platforms team, also known as GTP, helps thousands of developers save time and code better, so that millions of Walmart associates can help hundreds of millions of customers to save money and live better.
  
  
We sustain millions of transactions per second, process petabytes of data, and enable tens of thousands of production deployments per day. We simplify the complexities of scale and unify the software development for all aspects of business, digital and physical.
  
  
We are developer’s developers. We provide and foster the cloud native culture to our organization. Our team has the whole gamut of platforms, services, libraries, tools and frameworks on some of the cutting-edge technologies to solve hard, complex and high scale business problems. The Infrastructure as a Service team provides private and public cloud infrastructure - compute (VMs, CPUs, GPUs and Bare metals), storage (CEPH), SDN and container platform. The Software Development Environment – SDE team – provides world class CI/CD pipelines, workflow automation, repositories and OneOps deployment tool providing ultimate DevOps power to developers for continuous delivery. The application foundation team provides multi-tenant managed services for authz, messaging (JMS, Kafka), caching, externalized gateways, cloud configuration, massive centralized log search farm, telemetry, Cassandra/Oracle/MySql/MS-QL/Cloud RDBMS for the developer community of Walmart. All of the developer-productivity tools provided by GTP are continuously enhanced through recent advancements in GenAI. These solutions are frequently revamped to capitalize on the latest progress in both AI and GenAI, ensuring that teams always benefit from the most modern capabilities.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Our ideal candidate is an energetic, self-motivated individual focused on solving customer problems. He/she is a responsive team player who can proactively contribute for building technical strategies for applications and systems by promoting an understanding of the technology and business roadmap. When you add the numbers, you will realize that this role will probably help influence the largest pool of customers anywhere in the world. If that gives you goose bumps - then you are the kind of candidate, we want.
  
  
You will be responsible for development of developer facing applications that are used to boost the developer productivity and experience of Walmart developers.
  
  
Lead a team of top-notch engineers to successfully build and deploy cutting edge platforms. Lead and direct large-scale, complex, cross-functional projects by reviewing project requirements; translating requirements into technical solutions; directing and reviewing
  
  
Design artifacts (for example, proof of concepts, prototypes); write and develop code; oversee software design; review unit test cases; communicate status and issues to team members and stakeholders; direct project team and cross functional teams; enhance design to prevent recurrences of defects; ensure on-time delivery and hand-offs; interact with project manager to provide input on project plan; and provide leadership to the project team.
  
  
You will work in our own internal open stack cloud, Azure, GCP, using several technologies including but not limited to JAVA, Spring, Kafka, Cosmos DB, REST APIs, GraphQL, Python, data solutions etc.
  
  
Focus on goal completion and support teams to overcome the challenges in implementation
  
  
Work with senior leadership to chart out the roadmap of the products
  
  
Improve, optimize and identify opportunities for efficient software development processes
  
  
Work very closely with different product and business stakeholders at various locations in US and India to drive the execution of multiple business plans and technologies
  
  
Exhibit strong leadership and communication skills to collaborate with product, engineering and management teams across different geographic locations
  
  
Improve, optimize and identify opportunities for efficient software development processes
  
  
Hire, Develop and Retain a strong team of software engineers.
  
  
Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech community
  
  
Promote and support company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
Deep expertise in architecture and design patterns, cloud-native microservices, and building resilient, reliable, high-quality software.
  
  
Strong technical mindset with hands-on product development experience and the ability to deep-dive into complex technical issues.
  
  
Exposure to program management practices, including dependency management and cross-team development tracking.
  
  
Hands-on experience with developer platforms is a strong advantage.
  
  
Proven ability to build, lead, and mentor high-performing engineering teams.
  
  
Thought leadership and the ethos of a people-first leader.
  
  
Demonstrated success working effectively with distributed, global teams in a collaborative and productive manner.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and a consistent track record of delivering outcomes in complex, fast-paced environments.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership with a focus on quality, responsiveness, efficiency, and continuous innovation.
  
  
Ability to guide teams through technical challenges and drive clarity during execution.
  
  
Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across teams, functions, and geographies.
  
  
Ability to influence, align, and collaborate with diverse partners and stakeholders.
  
  
Passion for quick learning and adapting in a dynamic global environment.
  
  
An Engineering Degree - B.E/B.Tech/MS in any stream – Computer Science preferred.
  
  
14+ years of relevant experience, Minimum of 5 years of experience with agile principles and practices. Experience in leading Scrum teams.
  
  
Hands on experience in building scalable cloud native software platforms/applications
  
  
Very strong understanding and experience in the area of software development lifecycle.
  
  
Strong Java/J2EE, React skill ( good to have)
  
  
Strong understanding of architecture, database, messaging , (Kafka services)
  
  
SQL/Cosmos/Azure database proficiency
  
  
Experience in leading and delivering full-stack developer platform applications would be desirable
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**

description:
**Company Description**
PRSsemicon Technologies, a PRSGroup company, is one of India’s fastest-growing fabless semiconductor engineering firms, delivering advanced digital IPs, custom ASIC/SoC solutions, and turnkey spec-to-chip programs for global customers. Its capabilities span digital IP development, mixed-signal design, and end-to-end chip programs, supported by specialized group entities such as Spec2Chips Semiconductor and Quantisys Semiconductor. PRSsemicon’s vision is to build India’s largest semiconductor engineering and IP innovation ecosystem, partnering with global OEMs, IDMs, automotive and consumer electronics companies, and deep-tech startups.

**Role Description**
The Analog Director: Program and Technical Lead, High-Speed Interface and PHY IP role is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. This role oversees specification-to-first-pass-silicon execution for high-speed interface and PHY IP, providing technical leadership across architecture definition, analog/mixed-signal design, verification, and silicon validation. The individual will drive program planning, milestones, and risk management, coordinating cross-functional teams including digital design, physical design, packaging, test, and firmware to ensure robust integration and timely delivery. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing and approving specifications, design reviews, simulation and sign-off criteria, guiding design teams on high-speed analog techniques, and ensuring adherence to quality, reliability, and performance targets. The role also involves mentoring engineering talent, collaborating with customers on technical requirements and design reviews, and contributing to IP roadmap and innovation initiatives within the high-speed interface portfolio.

**Qualifications**

* Deep expertise in high-speed interface and PHY IP design (e.g., PCIe, USB, MIPI, SerDes, DDR, LVDS) with proven track record from specification to first-pass silicon.
* Strong analog and mixed-signal design skills, including PLLs, CDRs, clocking, equalization, termination schemes, and high-speed I/O circuits.
* Experience with analog/mixed-signal verification methodologies, modeling (Verilog-A/AMS), behavioral models, and correlation of simulations with silicon measurements.
* Proficiency in relevant EDA tools for circuit design, simulation, layout, and sign-off (Spectre, HSPICE, AMS simulators, layout and extraction tools) and familiarity with advanced process nodes.

title: Program Management
description:
**Job Title: Program Management Specialist**
**Job Description**
This role leads end-to-end program change management, with a strong focus on post-FDJ program changes, Bill of Materials (BoM) structuring, and P-Release governance. You will coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, drive data accuracy and process compliance, and develop analytical tools that enhance visibility of program status, costs, and risks. The position suits a detail-oriented program professional with strong analytical skills, advanced Excel capabilities, and experience in product development, release management, and data analysis.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the tracking, analysis, and implementation of all post-FDJ program changes through defined processes and cadences, ensuring timely and controlled execution.
* Participate in and support relevant governance and review meetings, such as Change Management Meetings, to present status, issues, and recommendations.
* Develop and implement BoM structuring strategies that ensure accurate modularity and bailment, and maintain alignment across all build phases.
* Partner with HWIM and CVS teams to perform BoM audits and validation, ensuring data integrity and consistency across systems.
* Collaborate with the Dunton program management lead to guide programs through a successful P-Release phase, leading and participating in review meetings and workshops.
* Lead cross-functional alignment meetings covering Change Management, BoM structuring, and P-Release, ensuring all stakeholders understand status, issues, and required actions.
* Consolidate and present BoM and cost status reports to stakeholders and leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and variances.
* Identify and implement process improvements in change management, BoM structuring, and P-Release activities to enhance efficiency and data quality.
* Support delivery of Change Control and BoM key performance indicators (KPIs), challenging assumptions and ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* Represent the team in management reviews and stakeholder engagements, clearly communicating progress, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Generate and maintain daily and ad hoc Concern and Notice trackers, ensuring information is up to date and accurately reflects program status.
* Coordinate launch team tracker requests with Dunton LL6, ensuring alignment of priorities and timely delivery of requested information.
* Follow up offline on open engineering changes with stakeholders such as Engineering, Finance, HWIM, and Purchasing to drive closure.
* Liaise with PVT on running changes, ensuring effective communication and alignment between program and production teams.
* Perform financial audit control activities, including uploading 2-pagers and linked Change Requests (CRQs) to SharePoint and EDMS to support ISO compliance.
* Resolve Concern and Notice issues with affected functions in a timely manner, ensuring corrective actions are identified and implemented.
* Perform Concern quality checks in collaboration with HWIM, Dunton program management, and Engineering to ensure robust issue definition and resolution.
* Lead colour releasing work with PPM, ensuring correct and timely release of colour-related items.
* Identify and escalate misalignments between Product Definition Letters (PDL) and releasing strategy in collaboration with the program management change management analyst.
* Investigate BoM errors using PPM Empress reports to establish root cause and recommend corrective actions.
* Populate Concerns on behalf of Engineering to support fast-track processes and ensure issues are captured and managed effectively.
* Support P-Release meetings and workshops by preparing data, tracking actions, and ensuring decisions are documented and implemented.
* Check service releases for correct authority, part class, and service indicator accuracy, ensuring compliance with defined standards.
* Develop change management tools, such as Change Request quality and ageing analysis dashboards, to improve visibility and decision-making.
* Provide ageing, churn, and NTEI (Non-Tooling Engineering Investment) analysis for leadership to inform strategic decisions.
* Build new tools for BoM error detection and WERS data analysis, including the development of macros and automation to improve efficiency and data quality.

**Essential Skills**

* Proven experience in program management, with a focus on change control, BoM management, or release governance.
* Experience in product development, release management, and data analysis, preferably within complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate insights into actions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical and analytical information clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office packages, with particular strength in Advanced Excel, including complex formulas, data analysis, and reporting.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and deadlines.
* Ability to lead cross-functional meetings and drive alignment across Engineering, Finance, HWIM, Purchasing, PVT, and other stakeholder groups.
* Attention to detail and a high standard of data quality, especially in BoM structuring, cost tracking, and change documentation.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience developing analytical tools and dashboards for change management, including CR quality and ageing analysis.
* Experience building tools for BoM error detection and WERS data analysis, including the use of macros and automation.
* Familiarity with BoM structuring strategies, modularity concepts, and bailment processes.
* Experience working with systems such as PPM, Empress, SharePoint, and EDMS or similar platforms for data management and documentation.
* Exposure to financial audit controls and ISO-compliant documentation processes.
* Experience liaising with cross-functional teams across engineering, finance, purchasing, and production environments.
* Knowledge of AI and large language models (LLMs) is advantageous, particularly where they can support data analysis or process automation.

**Work Environment**
The role operates in a structured, process-driven environment that emphasizes data accuracy, governance, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with engineering, finance, purchasing, HWIM, PVT, and program management teams, participating in regular review meetings, workshops, and change management forums. The position relies heavily on digital tools and platforms, including Microsoft Office (with extensive use of Advanced Excel), SharePoint, EDMS, PPM, and reporting systems such as Empress for BoM analysis. Work typically involves managing multiple concurrent changes and initiatives, maintaining detailed trackers, and preparing clear, concise reports and presentations for stakeholders and leadership. The environment values continuous improvement, encouraging the development of new tools, macros, and analytical methods to enhance BoM accuracy, change control effectiveness, and overall program visibility.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

Job Description: Technical Program Manager

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.

You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.

Responsibilities:

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives
* Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership
* Build roadmaps that balance near-term deliverables with the longer-term technical direction of each program
* Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets
* Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines
* Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations
* Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post-launch reviews
* Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling
* Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role
* A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs
* Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus
* Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations
* Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong relationship-building skills: you know how to align people with different priorities, make sure every voice is heard, and gain commitment to a shared plan
* A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, OKRs, and tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

* Begin structured renewal planning well in advance of the contract end date, confirming stakeholders, decision criteria, procurement steps, and timeline.
* Create a value and outcome summary that connects achieved results and future priorities to the renewal recommendation.
* Partner with Sales and renewal teams to confirm scope, forecast status, expansion potential, approvals, and customer actions through closure.

* Support customers in evaluating architecture considerations, workload migration strategies, resiliency requirements, and operational readiness.

* Help identify capability gaps and improvement opportunities through a structured feedback process.
* Share knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to internal initiatives as a subject matter expert.

**Experience**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Typically, 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, customer support, service delivery, presales, professional services, or another customer-facing technology role.
* Practical experience supporting customers across onboarding, adoption, usage reviews, issue coordination, or value-realization activities.
* Exposure to cloud, hybrid cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, or as-a-Service environments, with the ability to learn the assigned solution portfolio.
* Experience using customer data, CRM or customer-success tools, dashboards, and standard reporting to track activities, risks, health, and follow-up actions.
* Comfort managing a defined portfolio of customers or workstreams with guidance, escalating complex commercial or technical matters when required.
* Experience working through remote and virtual engagement models is preferred.

**Technical & Business Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of cloud, hybrid cloud, enterprise infrastructure, SaaS, and as-a-Service concepts, including compute, storage, networking, virtualization, backup, and data protection.
* Basic familiarity with one or more public cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud, and how they connect with enterprise data-centre environments.
* Ability to understand common customer workloads and use cases—including virtualization and containers, SAP, AI and analytics, VDI, backup and data protection, and high-performance computing—without requiring deep architectural expertise.
* Understands foundational concepts related to workload migration, availability, resiliency, security, capacity, consumption, support lifecycle, and operational readiness.

* Can connect customer goals and operational challenges to relevant solution benefits and explain technical information in clear business language.
* Ability to develop and maintain basic success plans, adoption actions, risk logs, and customer outcome summaries using established templates and playbooks.
* Recognizes when specialist, sales, services, support, or partner expertise is required and coordinates the appropriate follow-up.

**Customer Success Capabilities**

* Ability to manage a portfolio of customers efficiently through scalable digital engagement strategies.
* Strong virtual communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to deliver customer success at scale through digital programs, automated campaigns, webinars, and virtual workshops.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the customer organization, including executives, business leaders, architects, developers, and IT administrators.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into business value and actionable customer success plans.

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.

This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.

Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.

The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.

  
  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application

* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.

* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.

* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.

* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.

* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.

* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.

* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.

* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.

* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.

* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.

* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.

* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.

* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.

* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Role: Product Manager, Trading Infrastructure**

You will own the professional and algo trading surface of Arrow: the products where latency, data depth and execution quality are the whole point. Five areas sit in your remit, and each one is a product in its own right.

* TBT charts: In-house tick-by-tick charting: sub-second candles, order-flow and footprint views, replay, with chart latency held close to feed latency
* HFT algos: In-house algos and a strategy marketplace retail traders can deploy on co-located infrastructure, with risk guardrails and exchange approvals built in
* API latency: The trading and market-data APIs: round-trip order latency at p50/p95/p99, WebSocket feed delivery, SDK ergonomics, rate limits, sandbox
* Colocation access: Productizing exchange co-lo for clients: rack and VM offerings, provisioning, cross-connects, pricing and compliance
* Tick-level data: Dissemination of full-depth, tick-by-tick market data: live feeds, snapshots, historical tick archives, entitlements and fan-out at scale

This is the first dedicated Product Manager on the Arrow team. You will work directly with the CTO, the HFT desk, the quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers, and you will set the product process as much as run it. Expect to spend as much time with latency histograms and order-book data as with roadmap documents.

**You'll do:**

* Own the TBT charting roadmap. Define what a tick-by-tick chart must do for a scalper that a one-second chart cannot: sub-second aggregation, order-flow and footprint views, volume-at-price, replay, and multi-instrument sync. Set and track the chart-update latency budget against the raw feed.
* Bring in-house HFT algos to retail. Scope the first algos and the strategy marketplace: which strategies ship first, how traders discover, configure and deploy them on co-located infrastructure, what the kill switches and position limits look like, and how each algo clears SEBI and exchange approval before launch.
* Own API latency as a product metric. Define the order round-trip and feed-delivery SLOs at p50, p95 and p99, instrument them end to end (client, gateway, OMS, exchange), publish them transparently, and drive the engineering backlog that moves them.
* Run the developer experience for the trading API: Go and Python SDKs, WebSocket market-data streams, docs, sandbox, rate limits, static-IP and algo-tagging requirements, and onboarding for API clients from first key to first live order.
* Productise colocation access. Turn exchange co-lo into something a professional client can buy: rack, VM and managed-server tiers, provisioning SLAs, cross-connects, pricing, and the compliance and audit trail each exchange requires.
* Own tick-level data dissemination. Define the market-data products: full-depth live feeds, TBT versus snapshot tiers, historical tick archives, entitlements and billing, and the fan-out architecture needed to serve thousands of clients without adding latency.
* Talk to professional traders every week: scalpers, option market-makers, quants and API users. Turn what they say and what their order flow shows into specs engineers can build from without a second meeting.
* Write crisp PRDs with success metrics, latency budgets, failure modes and exchange-rule constraints (algo approval, order-to-trade ratios, throttles, circuit limits, square-off timings) spelled out.
* Partner with the CTO, the HFT desk and exchange-connectivity engineers on trade-offs between latency, throughput, reliability and features; a feature that adds 200 µs to the hot path is a product decision, not just an engineering one.
* Define and track the metrics that matter: order latency and feed latency by percentile, API uptime, active API clients, algo deployments and their P&L distribution, co-lo utilisation, and tick-data subscriptions.

**What we're looking for:**

* 4-8 years in product, trading-systems engineering or quant/HFT trading, with at least 3 years owning a technical or fintech product end to end.
* You understand market microstructure. Order books, tick data, matching-engine behaviour, order-to-trade ratios, what co-lo buys you and what it does not. You know why a scalper cares about the difference between 1 ms and 3 ms.
* Hands-on with trading APIs. You have built or run something against a broker or exchange API, understand REST versus WebSocket versus binary protocols, and can read a latency histogram and say where the time went.
* Fluent with data. You can write SQL, pull your own latency and order-flow data, and argue a prioritisation call with numbers rather than opinions.
* Shipped in a regulated environment. You can read a SEBI or exchange circular on algo trading, API access or market data and turn it into a product requirement.
* Clear writer. Your PRDs, SLO definitions and API docs get read and acted on by engineers and traders alike.
* Bias for shipping. You have taken a feature from a trader complaint to production in weeks, not quarters, and iterated after launch.

**Nice to have:**

* Worked at an HFT or prop firm, an exchange, a market-data vendor or an algo trading platform.
* Familiarity with NSE/BSE TBT and snapshot feeds, exchange co-lo offerings and the NNF/API order-tagging framework.
* Have run a live strategy through a broker API, even a small one.
* Options knowledge beyond the basics: Greeks, market-making, hedged-position margin.
* Python or Go, enough to prototype an API call, parse a tick file or build your own latency dashboard.

**What we Offer:**

* A real execution edge to build on: co-located infrastructure and a 17-year HFT track record that no other retail broker in India starts with.
* First dedicated PM in the seat. You define the role, the process and the roadmap, and you report to the CTO.
* Direct access to the HFT desk, quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers; the people who built the engine sit a few desks away.
* Offices in Mumbai (Andheri East); market hours mean an early start and a clear end to the day.

* Identify, evaluate and negotiate with manufacturers, suppliers and production partners.
* Manage product development from initial concept through prototyping, sampling, refinement and final production.
* Coordinate product specifications, materials, packaging, quality standards and production timelines.
* Develop product costing, pricing structures, margins and minimum order quantity (MOQ) strategies.
* Work with external designers, branding agencies and creative partners to bring products to life.
* Coordinate the setup and launch of D2C sales channels, including Shopify and relevant marketplaces.
* Manage external vendors across packaging, logistics, fulfilment and launch activities.
* Research consumer trends, competitor products and opportunities for new product categories.
* Build practical execution plans, manage budgets and ensure projects move from idea to launch.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in consumer product development, sourcing, merchandising, category management or brand launches. More experienced candidates are welcome.
* Demonstrated experience working with manufacturers and suppliers to develop or commercialize physical products.
* Strong understanding of product costing, margins, MOQs, packaging and production processes.
* Experience in consumer categories such as lifestyle, stationery, accessories, gifting, homeware, beauty or related products.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of how consumer brands are positioned, priced and brought to market.
* Ability to manage multiple external partners and execute independently.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and genuine interest in building new brands from scratch.

**Direct experience taking physical products from concept through sampling, manufacturing and commercial launch matters more to us than total years of experience.**

**What Makes This Opportunity Different**

You'll work directly with the founder, helping shape and launch original consumer brands rather than simply managing an established product portfolio.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building things, solving practical problems and seeing their work go from an idea to a real product in customers' hands.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have personally been involved in developing and launching new physical products, not solely managing existing e-commerce operations or marketplace accounts.

title: Application Manager – Business Applications & AI
description: About Station Satcom: Station Satcom is a maritime satellite communications managed-service provider supporting around 8,000 vessels from offices in Singapore, India, the UAE and the Netherlands. The business runs on a portfolio of applications — Zoho One (Desk, CRM, Books and others), our billing and purchasing platform, partner portals — and a growing set of AI workers built into those systems. About the Role: We are looking for an Application Manager to own the business applications Station Satcom runs on, and to lead how we build AI into them. You will keep critical systems such as our billing and purchasing platform stable, secure and well documented, while running the projects that put AI to work across the business: AI agents inside Zoho, API-based integrations with large language models, and automation that removes manual work from Support, Finance and Operations. You are the bridge between users, vendors and technical teams, and the person accountable for making our applications do what the business needs. RequirementsKey Responsibilities: Application ownership Own the full lifecycle of core business applications: requirements, selection, implementation, configuration, upgrades and retirement. Act as system owner for the billing and purchasing platform (currently IBIS), covering purchasing and billing workflows, rate plans, month-end runs, and data consistency between billing, CRM and finance systems. Lead evaluation, data migration, parallel running and cut-over when an application is replaced. Serve as the escalation point for application issues; manage vendors to their SLAs and hold them accountable for fixes, patches and releases. Analyse user needs and translate them into clear requirements, enhancements and integrations. AI capability and integration Run AI projects end to end: define the use case, build the business case, choose the approach (platform-native, API-based or custom build), deliver, and measure the result. Understanding how AI workers and agents running inside our applications (for example Zia agents in Zoho Desk and CRM), including their configuration, prompts, knowledge sources, guardrails and performance. Design and manage integrations between our applications and AI services through APIs (for example OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI and Zoho Zia), including authentication, rate limits, cost control, logging and error handling. Direct external AI developers and vendors: set requirements, review deliverables, and ensure all code, prompts, credentials and data flows are documented and owned by Station Satcom. Track AI cost, accuracy and adoption; report outcomes to management and retire what does not deliver value. Maintain a prioritised roadmap of AI opportunities across Support, Finance, Sales and Operations. Governance, security and documentation Protect application data integrity, access control and security, working with IT Security on access reviews, API key and secret management, and vendor security assessments. Apply the company’s AI governance and data-privacy policy: what data may be sent to AI services, human review of AI output, and audit trails. Maintain controlled documentation of configurations, integrations, procedures and workflows in line with our ISO 9001 quality management system. Work with the Training team to train and support end users on applications and AI tools. Requirements: Essential Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years managing business applications, including hands-on system ownership of a billing, purchasing, ERP or finance application. Proven delivery of at least one AI project into production (not only a pilot), such as an LLM-based assistant, AI agent, or document or email automation. Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and common integration patterns; able to read API documentation and test integrations independently. Practical understanding of how large language models behave: prompting, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context limits, hallucination risk, output evaluation and cost per call. Project management capability: planning, vendor management, risk tracking and stakeholder reporting. Strong troubleshooting skills and clear written and spoken English. Ability to work across time zones with teams in India, Singapore, the UAE and Europe. Desirable Billing Applications administration Scripting in Python or JavaScript. Experience in telecoms, satellite communications or the maritime industry. Familiarity with data-privacy law (India DPDP Act, Singapore PDPA, GDPR) and AI management standards such as ISO/IEC 42001. Certification in project management (PMP, PRINCE2) or in cloud or AI platforms. What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months: Billing and purchasing platform fully handed over, documented, and running without unresolved billing or data-integrity incidents. 1 or more AI use cases live in production, each with measured time or cost savings. Every API and AI integration recorded with its owner, data flow, credential location, running cost and fallback procedure.

title: Senior Lead - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
  
  
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
  
  
**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**

* Lead/Senior Lead, Business Strategy and Operations position will be responsible for partnering closely with functional leaders across Marketing and GTM to develop a shared set of priorities, growth strategy and operational plan. You will ensure our strategy is coordinated and cohesive, and supports our company objectives. As a key partner to Marketing leaders, you will act as a liaison between Marketing and the wider GTM teams, including Sales, GTM Strategy & Planning, and Financial Planning teams.
* In this role you will be required to meet our goals of supporting & optimizing all operations & technology to enable effective marketing at BrowserStack. This role will be a critical partner to the Marketing organisation for leading strategic planning and generating insights that drive Marketing performance.
* You will also conduct and support primary and secondary research projects and create relevant insights on market trends, market sizing, market forecasting, company bench- marking, customer needs, and competition that inform product, customer, and go-to-market strategies.

* Competitive Intelligence: Monitor and analyse competitor activities, market positioning, and product offerings to help the organisation maintain a competitive edge.
* Marketing Database Hygiene: Should be able to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured marketing database/information for maintaining data accuracy by conducting regular data checks/cleansing and should also work on collecting and populating the accurate info for all the missing fields using secondary research, data mining and profile techniques
* Integrate data from multiple sources into a unified intelligence platform, and adjust database management to reflect changes, including adding new contacts and correcting inaccuracies

Conducting quality checks for the data/information collected by the team members before up- loading into salesforce. Preparing reports to ensure all the data is correctly mapped and accurate.
* Own the account, contact and lead enrichment activities along with its reporting and insights

**Desired Experience**

* 6 - 8 years of experience, with a minimum of 5 years in Strategy or Management Consulting, preferably with a leading global consulting firm or in a high-impact Corporate Strategy role within a leading B2B SaaS or technology company.
* At least 5 years experience in Marketing/Sales Strategy, Research roles for Marketing/Sales teams, using secondary and tertiary research methods.
* Must have exposure in SQL to create reports, analyses & insights Knowledge of working with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo,Rocket Reach, Lusha, Traxcn, etc.
* Proven experience in working with ICP identification across different segments and product portfolios.
* Advanced ability to analyze data and summarize information from multiple sources, including large and complex data sets to perform market, industry, financial and economic analyses. Structured thinking, strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* Proficient in analytics and be able to develop actionable insights using data. Be able to multitask, prioritize, rapidly iterate, and manage communications with different functions in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Excellent project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, often with non-congruent timelines.
* An MBA from a class A institution and an IIT or technology qualification will be a strong plus.

**Benefits**
In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
  
  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents-in-law

title: Product Manager 2
description:
**Product Manager | TrustStack | Mumbai**
**Function:**
Product – TrustStack
  
  
**Level:**
Product Manager 2
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
At IDfy, TrustStack isn't a back-end utility — it's the trust and data platform that sits underneath every IDfy product. It verifies people and businesses against authoritative sources, reads and checks documents, confirms that a face is real and belongs to the right person, and detects fraud and tampering. Every IDfy product, and hundreds of banks, NBFCs, and fintechs, rely on it every day.
  
  
This role owns the roadmap for a set of areas within TrustStack and takes them to their next stage — from what to build and why, to how it reaches customers and whether it moved the needle. You'll spend real time with clients, lead Engineering, DevOps, and Data Science without formal authority, and build prototypes yourself when that's the fastest way to an answer. This is an individual-contributor role: hands-on, high ownership, high impact.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
You'll own the roadmap and outcomes for areas within TrustStack, matched to your strengths:
  
  

* Fraud Intelligence — detecting fraud and tampering across documents, faces, and identities, and turning those signals into products clients rely on
* AI-Native Access — making our capabilities easy for developers, partner platforms, and AI agents to discover and use
* Model Quality & Reliability — knowing how our models and data sources perform in production, and acting before a client feels a problem
* Document Intelligence — helping clients and internal teams read, understand, and verify any document faster
* Global Coverage — taking capabilities to new markets and cross-border use cases, and building geography-specific capabilities

**We're The Right Match If You**

* Have a B.Tech from a Tier-1 engineering institute (IIT / NIT / BITS)
* Have 4–5 years of experience, with hands-on product management on technical, integration-heavy, or data-centric B2B products — developer platforms, data infrastructure, ML-powered products, or B2B SaaS (product and consulting backgrounds both welcome)
* Have worked on implementing GenAI or agentic models — and have built something with AI tools yourself: a prototype, an internal tool, an agent, or a script you actually used. Bring it to the interview.
* Are strongly analytical — comfortable crunching data, working with SQL, logs, dashboards, and model evaluation metrics, and making a call from evidence
* Have built 0→1, or genuinely want to — you're comfortable starting from a blank page and shaping the answer
* Have high agency and a bias for action — you'd rather ship a version on Friday and learn than debate it for a month, and you can show us examples
* Speak Engineering, DevOps, and Data Science fluently — engineers trust your judgement on integrations, data pipelines, and trade-offs
* Are client-facing by instinct — you can run a discovery session with a client team and present a roadmap to its leadership with equal ease
* Have led without authority — you've rallied engineers and data scientists who didn't report to you around a shared deadline and outcome
* Write clearly — your specs, updates, and decision notes are short, sharp, and actually get read

**Bonus Points If You've**

* Worked on B2B integrations (at any point in your career — not necessarily in your current role)

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
**Job Description**
We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
* Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
* Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
* Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
* Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
* Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
* Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
* Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
* Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
* Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
* Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
* Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
* Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
* Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
* Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
* Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
* Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
* Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate or Data Engineer Associate (or Generative AI Engineer Associate).
* GitHub certification (for example, GitHub Foundations or GitHub Actions) and/or formal Copilot training or enablement.
* Substitution: 2+ years of production, hands-on experience delivering end-to-end business requirements or testing using Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, and GitHub Copilot Agent Mode in banking.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.
