title: Founder's Office - EIR
description:
**Founder's Office - EIR**

**Function:**
Founder’s Office

**Location:**
Mumbai & Pune

**Employment Type:**
Full Time

**Reports To:**
Founders

**About RINGS & I**

RINGS & I is a
**seven-year-old made-to-order diamond jewellery brand**
, founded by engineers with a belief that jewellery does not need to be built around inventory.

We are building a technology-led jewellery experience where customers can:

* Access
  **live, dynamic pricing**
* **Personalize designs live in 3D**
* Build and configure jewellery through
  **Build Your Own**
  experiences
* Choose across multiple materials, diamonds and specifications without being restricted by stocked inventory
* Make informed decisions with
  **education and transparency at the centre of the buying journey**

Over the last year, RINGS & I has scaled rapidly, and we have an
**aggressive three-year growth plan across multiple cities.**

**Role Summary**

Founder’s Office is for people who enjoy
**figuring things out from zero**
.

You may have tried building something of your own before. You may have always wanted to. Or you may simply know that you are not someone who wants to spend years waiting for the next designation before taking on bigger problems.

This role will work directly with the founders on high-priority growth problems, initially across Marketing, Ops, Fulfilment, RevOps.

You will pick up a problem, understand it deeply, build the playbook, test it on ground and take it far enough that it can become a repeatable business function.

You can go ahead and pick the next problem or lead the vertical you solved for.

**Why this role exists?**

RINGS & I is scaling fast.

Founders cannot personally figure out every new market, channel, partnership, activation or growth opportunity as the organisation expands.

We therefore need people who can
**think like founders without needing to be founders immediately**
.

People who can take an ambiguous problem and move it from:

**Nothing → Hypothesis → Pilot → Learning → Repeatable Playbook**

The role exists to create that additional problem-solving capacity around the founders.

**What will you own?**

You will take ownership of
**one high-priority growth area at a time**
and be expected to create measurable progress within approximately six months.

Assignments may include:

* Achieving EBITDA % for the studio
* Increasing throughput of a single studio
* Test a new audience set
* Test and set a new marketing channel
* Help build LTV
* Set up fulfilment systems

The objective is not merely to coordinate these activities.

The objective is to
**figure out what works, prove it, and build something the organisation can scale.**

**What does success look like?**

Success in Founder’s Office is simple:

**Can you take an undefined business problem and turn it into a working, measurable playbook?**

The specific KPIs will depend on the problem you own.

**Who should join Founder's Office?**

This role is likely to work for you if:

* You have
  **relentless grit**
  and do not give up easily.
* You enjoy problems where the answer does not already exist.
* You naturally ask,
  **“How can we make this happen?”**
* You are comfortable getting your hands dirty and executing, not only strategising.
* You move fast and learn through doing.
* You want responsibility to grow much faster than your designation.
* You would rather build something meaningful in one organisation than repeatedly change companies for the next title.
* You take ownership even when multiple teams or external partners are involved.
* You do not restrict yourself to job role, location but marry outcome
* You have been Head Girl/Boy, Student or General Secretory at School/College and you are a natural leader

Having attempted entrepreneurship, built a side project, led something from zero, or shown similar evidence of a
**founder mindset**
would be highly valued.

**What is in it for you?**

Founder’s Office offers unusually high exposure early in your career.

You will get:

* **Direct strategic exposure to the founders & cross-functional aspect of Business**
* Freedom to test, learn and build
* Opportunities to work across functions rather than inside a narrow job boundary
* First-hand experience of scaling a consumer retail business across cities
* The opportunity to build a function or capability from zero
* A fast growth path when you demonstrate the ability to own larger outcomes

The intent is not for someone to remain in Founder’s Office indefinitely.

**Build something → prove it → own a larger mandate.**

Your next role should emerge from what you successfully build.

HSBC Data & Architecture Office (DAO) promotes a data-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:
  
  

* Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations.
* Connect: Move to a data-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers.
* Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercializing our data, optimizing capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs.

The
**Data Management Lead**
primarily supports all the
**Protect and Connect**
pillars of the strategy.
  
  

* This role will work across all Business/Functions to ensure governance and alignment to the Group Data Strategy.

**Key Priorities In Scope For The Incumbent Would Include**

* Implementation of data programs and controls in alignment with country regulatory requirements
* Participate in country industry forums (USIBC, IBA) for common understanding of country data policies
* Owner and executor of RCA of DAO owned country data risks
* Data Controls Implementation covering including DMOV, DUSE and DSTO (ILM)
* Supporting the market in the adherence and compliance to Data Privacy (DPRIV) controls
* Data risk management oversight and oversight of related audit, regulatory and compliance activities

**Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities**

* Operating in a high performing, valuable and scalable data management team to meet customer demand
* Lead collaboration and engagement with the multiple lines of business in HSBC India as well as the CIO, CCO and 2LOD teams, to communicate the Group Data Strategy and key regional and global Data & Analytics Office initiatives
* Lead in delivering the data strategy roadmap for HSBC India
* Act as a trusted advisor to HSBC India by becoming a subject matter expert in the Data Management practices, policies and procedures of the Group
* Manage Stakeholder engagement and expectations by supporting demand into the Global DAO utilities and driving transparency of backlogs and prioritisation
* Manage and monitor the Data Quality process, remediation, issues and reporting
* Accountable for reporting of progress, issues, dependencies, and risks to stakeholders, Country Data Executive Council and/or steering committees for programs led by DAO
* Become a trusted advisor, manage stakeholder’s expectations and build strong working relationship with local, regional and global Data & Analytics Office teams
* Champion the needs, priorities and regulatory requirements of India DAO in Regional and Global forums
* Manage and oversight control implementation across initiatives in India
* Accountable to ensure deliveries remain within agreed budgets.
* Act as SME on adhoc data projects as required, inc regulatory requests
* Support the uplift of data literacy in India
* Hosts country growth enablement forum

**Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To**

* Support the implementation of HSBC data governance and quality guidelines, procedures, methods etc.
* Ensure good practices in the management of data tools, standards, frameworks and templates
* Manage and monitor operational risk in the field of data management

**Collaboration**

* Generate strong and realistic business cases using business knowledge and ability to question and challenge etc.
* Develop and maintain effective stakeholder relationships across streams

* Engage the participants to deliver according to the plan irrespective of their reporting departments.

**Execution**

* Derive approach and prepare plan in a cost effective/efficient manner
* Providing timely and accurate status reporting to key stakeholders and sponsors.
* Ensure all activities are compliant with HSBC business standards

**Monitoring/ Transparency**

* Effectively manage all dependencies and interactions across associated and complimentary projects / activities.
* Monitor and track progress of all deliverables within the stream and ensure benefit realisation.
* Provide accurate and effective cost monitoring.

* For Risk and Issue management, detect and report risk and issue at timely manner, coordinate and identify solution with relevant parties and monitor progress to achieve the closure.

**Leadership & Teamwork**

title: Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution Senior Manager, Vice President
description:
At Citi, we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day. And we've been doing it for more than 200 years. We do this through our unparalleled global network. We provide a broad range of financial services and products to our clients – whether they be consumers, corporations, governments or institutions – to help them meet their biggest opportunities and face the world's toughest challenges.
  
  
We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as Vice President, Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution Senior Manager, Hybrid based in Mumbai, India. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decision and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future. For instance:
  
  

* Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.
* We believe all parents deserve time to adjust to parenthood and bond with the newest members of their families. That’s why in early 2020 we began rolling out our expanded Paid Parental Leave Policy to include Citi employees around the world.
* We empower our employees to manage their financial well-being and help them plan for the future.
* Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.
* We have a variety of programs that help employees balance their work and life, including generous paid time off packages.
* We offer our employees resources and tools to volunteer in the communities in which they live and work. In 2019, Citi employee volunteers contributed more than 1 million volunteer hours around the world.

The Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution (PACE) organization is Citi’s internal consulting and program execution team. Operating from Finance with a firmwide mandate, PACE serves as a strategic internal partner delivering management consulting, program advisory, and end-to-end execution support for Citi’s high-value initiatives and business transformation priorities. The organization partners closely with functional and business leadership to deliver significant, measurable business outcomes while retaining critical knowledge and reducing reliance on external consulting firms.
  
  
The PACE team is a global, interdisciplinary team comprised of seasoned professionals with deep financial services, program advisory, and management consulting expertise. With team members located in eight cities across five countries—Canada, Costa Rica, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States—PACE provides continuous global support, accelerated delivery, and rapid mobilization to solve the firm's most critical challenges.
  
  
**Summary**

* Lead the end-to-end execution of high-impact workstreams in cross-fun- ctional programs, driving process transformation, and operational improvements across the firm.
* Act as a subject matter expert in program and project management, leveraging structured PM practices to guide execution and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build and manage strong partnerships with senior project stakeholders and clients, serving as a key liaison to ensure alignment and facilitate collaboration.
* Drive accountability for project performance, holding both yourself and the team responsible for the quality of deliverables and adherence to established procedures.
* Operate effectively within a matrix management structure, reporting to senior leadership while collaborating closely with day-to-day engagement managers.
* Serve as an example of program management excellence, leveraging your experience to influence outcomes.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Drive analysis of complex data and business processes, developing initial hypotheses and turning ambiguous inputs into actionable, data-driven solutions.
* Support target operating model and process transformation initiatives by partnering with stakeholders to define business requirements and target states
* Work closely with Technology teams throughout delivery, helping teams apply business requirements in solution design, implementation, and testing.
* Define program requirements, objectives, and plans, establishing the structure and controls necessary to ensure successful delivery and mitigate ambiguity.
* Lead direct cross-functional teams within a complex global matrix environment, mobilizing diverse stakeholders toward a common goal. May assist on the program with training and coaching of junior staff with development needs.
* Collaborate and consult with executive leadership, stakeholders, project leads, executive leadership, sponsors, and business partners to clarify and define project requirements.
* Provide objective review and challenge for program deliverables, plans and other requirements.
* Prepare and deliver clear, impactful communications for project sponsors and senior stakeholders regarding analyses, project outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
* Act as a change catalyst by identifying opportunities for improvement and helping stakeholders understand how new ideas and solutions can benefit program objectives.
* Build and manage relationships with all key stakeholders, collaborating closely to define scope, manage expectations, and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Continuously develop re-usable intellectual capital, contributing relevant content and research to the team’s knowledge base to be leveraged across the organization.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* A minimum of 10 years of experience in management consulting and financial services, with a proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end projects and programs using a structured methodology.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience is required; PMP or PRINCE2 certification is also preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in the MS Office Suite, including Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for creating compelling, data-driven presentations.
* Experience working with complex financial services organizations delivering operating model and process transformation initiatives, authoring business requirements across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies, and defining future-state operating models.
* Experience working with Technology teams across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements development, solution implementation, and testing support.
* Expertise in a range of analytical and project management competencies, including hypothesis generation, root cause identification, process mapping & improvement, operating model design, and business case development, applied within an Agile or similarly structured delivery framework.
* Strong familiarity with digitalization concepts, emerging technology trends including AI, and their practical application to transform business processes within a financial services context.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence a team-based, collaborative model, effectively guiding diverse stakeholders and project teams toward common goals in a complex, matrixed environment.
* A self-starter with a strong ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and solve complex problems by structuring analyses and turning incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively distill complex information and impactfully present analyses, plans, and recommendations to all levels of the organization.
* An innovative and curious mindset with a passion for improving the employee and customer experience.
* Able to act with a high sense of urgency and a detail-oriented approach to achieving goals.

*This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.*

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
Ecommerce Specialist

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Experience:**
Min 3 years

**Industry:**
FMCG / D2C / Consumer Brands / E-commerce

**About Plush**

Plush is a women-first wellness and personal care brand, building a portfolio across menstrual hygiene, intimate wellness and personal care. We are looking for a
**Marketplaces Specialist**
to drive our growing presence across India's leading quick commerce platforms.

Key Responsibilities

**Quick Commerce Management**

* Own day-to-day operations and business performance across
  **Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other quick commerce platforms**
  .
* Manage assortment, product listings, pricing, promotions and platform visibility.
* Ensure products are live, correctly mapped, competitively priced and available across relevant dark stores/locations.
* Monitor stock availability, fill rates, OOS and inventory health and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues.

**Business & Performance**

* Track daily/weekly/monthly sales, orders, GMV, ASP, conversion and other key platform metrics.
* Analyse SKU-level and platform-level performance and identify opportunities for growth.
* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards for management.
* Identify underperforming SKUs/locations and recommend corrective actions.

**Promotions & Visibility**

* Coordinate with platform teams on
  **campaigns, promotions, visibility placements and brand activations**
  .
* Support planning and execution of platform-specific offers and promotional calendars.
* Track ROI and incremental sales from campaigns and promotions.
* Work with the marketing/brand team to ensure effective execution of platform visibility initiatives.

**Catalogue & Content**

* Ensure accurate product content, images, pricing, pack information and claims across platforms.
* Coordinate new product launches and ensure timely onboarding and visibility.
* Monitor competitor pricing, assortment, promotions and visibility.

**Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with
  **Sales, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance and Warehouse teams**
  to ensure smooth platform operations.
* Coordinate with account/category managers at quick commerce platforms.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as stock-outs, listing issues, pricing discrepancies and order/inventory gaps.

What We're Looking For

* 2–4 years of experience in
  **Quick Commerce, E-commerce, Marketplace Management or FMCG**
  .
* Hands-on experience with platforms such as
  **Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart**
  or similar.
* Strong analytical skills with good command of
  **Excel/Google Sheets**
  .
* Comfortable working with large datasets and translating numbers into actionable insights.
* Strong understanding of online retail metrics, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to take ownership and independently drive execution.

title: Product Marketing Lead - iPhone, Wearables & Home
description:
**Summary**
As a member of our Product Marketing group, you’ll represent the customer throughout a product’s journey from concept through development and launch. You’ll develop and apply insights to help infuse innovative features into our product-development process. Together with our team, you’ll work to craft groundbreaking ideas into tangible products that excite the world.
  
  
At Apple, we combine product management/development and product marketing responsibilities into a single, cross functional Product Management role that collaborates with design, engineering, finance, legal, marketing communications, public relations, market research, sales and support for maximum impact across the organization.
  
  
**Description**
Apple is looking for a dynamic and highly motivated Product Marketing Manager who will be responsible to lead Product Marketing for iPhone, Wearables and Home products in India. In this role, you will lead a team of product managers and have product line responsibilities for iPhone. The lead will own and drive Apple's product-centric marketing strategy for the iPhone, Wearables and Home portfolio of products, articulating the market ambition to deliver growth and category leadership. You will also lead the Technical Product Marketing Manager to provide technical support to the launch and momentum activities of all the Apple products. This role is an active member of the Product Marketing and Geo Leadership teams.
  
  
Key attributes of this role include the continuous improvement of product launches, comprehensive business and market analytics across categories, instinctive insights and the discipline to focus and deliver excellent results. In this role you will partner closely with the local PR, Marcom, Sales, Finance, Developer Relations, Services, Engineering and WW stakeholders in Cupertino to shape the opportunity ahead and to define and communicate country unique requirements for current and future products.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a proven leader with a strong passion for Apple products, desire to win, curiosity to be better, ability to navigate ambiguity, finesse and craft for product storytelling, creative and innovative problem solving, motivation to inspire others, and to build strong and lasting relationships throughout the organisation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Articulate the product opportunities in the market and provide product insight and leadership to both the Marketing and Sales organisations
* Own and drive the annual Marketing plan for products in the remit, outlining opportunity and actions that lead growth and category leadership, instilling quarterly and half-yearly reviews to evaluate deliverables, performance and learnings
* Lead the team to deliver product launches and momentum activities with excellence every time; be the guardian of product messaging and positioning at every customer touchpoint
* Act as the primary liaison between the market, Worldwide teams and Engineering for all local business needs and feature requirements, shaping strategies and contributing to global initiatives and programs
* Influence product feature roadmaps, and make clear recommendations that improve the customer experience
* Devise and craft a singular market narrative that enables clear understanding of market dynamics, customer voice, and opportunity, setting actions that all key stakeholders understand
* Create competitive and breakthrough strategies that show a clear connection between vision and action
* Introduce new ways of looking at problems and encourage diverse thinking to promote and nurture innovation
* Plan and prioritise work to align with broader organisational goals; use knowledge of business drivers and how strategies/tactics play out in the market to guide actions
* Build high-performing teams through coaching and developing talent. Actively foster an inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and cultures, and develop a strong bench of product marketing managers

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 15+ years experience in product management and marketing
* Experience working for/or with a global organisation in technology or related fields

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Business analytics and strategic product management experience with deep knowledge of the the India mobile and wearable space as a plus
* Strategic planning expertise
* Technical fluency, with the ability to translate features into customer benefits and vice versa
* Curiosity, a passion for excellence, ability to ask the right questions, and the love of working as part of a team
* Experience leading and developing a team of product marketeers
* Ability to continually prioritise and multi-task in a dynamic, creative, fast paced environment
* Strong storytelling, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a track record of aligning partners and internal teams around a shared plan
* Highly collaborative with exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building skills
* Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail
* Superior storytelling capabilities
* Instinctive ability to be the voice of the customer
* Depth of technical awareness
* Travel is required (20-25% estimated)
* BS/BA or equivalent experience; MS/MA/MBA a plus

description:
**Who We Are**
Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  
  
Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.
  
  
**What We Value**
We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

**Who You Are**
You are a seasoned, execution-focused Technical Program Manager who thrives in fast-paced environments and brings structure to ambiguity. You are comfortable operating across time zones and functions, partnering with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to drive high-quality delivery—ideally within financial services or retail-facing platforms.

You ensure work is clearly defined, appropriately scoped, and consistently progressing. You have the technical depth to understand how systems connect and where risks emerge. While not hands-on coding, you can engage in architecture discussions, navigate dependencies, and confidently represent technical progress to both engineers and business stakeholders.
  
  
You are equally comfortable leading complex, multi-team initiatives and diving into execution details, operating with urgency and independence, and can confidently represent globally distributed teams at the executive level.
  
  
Based in India you play a key role in bridging teams across New York and India, enabling consistent communication and execution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as a key execution partner to the India-based Head of Galaxy Retail (G1) and NY-based Head of Data supporting multiple engineering teams (20–30 developers across New York and India)
* Serve as the central point of accountability for execution across both Retail Engineering and Data Engineering, aligning business priorities with technical delivery
* Ensuring requests are captured, clearly defined, scoped, and prioritized

* Leverage AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and output quality in your day-to-day work
* Contribute to improving delivery standards and operational maturity across the Technology organization

**What We’re Looking For**

* 7+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, with direct involvement in engineering-led delivery
* Strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple engineering teams and time zones
* Proven ability to manage intake, triage requests, and define scope and priorities with technical stakeholders
* Experience tracking resource allocation across teams and proactively identifying capacity risks or gaps
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution—organizing work, following through, and unblocking teams
* Ability to engage deeply with technical systems, architecture, and dependencies without being hands-on coding
* Experience in digital assets and financial markets, including experience delivering technology initiatives in retail finance environments
* Prior experience as a software engineer or in a hands-on technical role using databricks is a plus

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
* Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees and their eligible dependents
* Free virtual coaching and counseling sessions
* Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
* Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
* Employee Resource Groups
* Benefits may vary depending on location.

description:
#### **At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

#### **Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are seeking an experienced Structured Lending Specialist to support and enhance our structured lending services. This client-facing role focuses on margin lending, conducting preliminary risk analysis, and providing exceptional client service. The ideal candidate will act as a trusted liaison between clients and internal teams, ensuring efficient and smooth lending processes.

  

#### **Your AMINA To-Do List**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding structured lending solutions, including margin lending.
* Conduct preliminary risk assessments of client portfolios and analyze collateral quality to ensure compliance with bank policies and regulations.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including underwriting and risk management, to streamline loan processing and documentation.
* Monitor market trends, collateral valuations, and margin calls, and proactively communicate with clients about potential risks and actions required.
* Provide tailored solutions to meet client needs while adhering to bank policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all client interactions are well-documented and maintain confidentiality and accuracy in all communications.
* Assist in the preparation of loan proposals and credit summaries for internal review

#### **Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in structured lending, margin lending, or a related field within banking or financial services.
* Strong knowledge of margin lending processes, financial instruments, and collateral management.
* Experience in conducting preliminary risk analysis and understanding loan-to-value (LTV) ratios.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a client-focused mindset.
* Proficient in financial systems and tools with an ability to manage data accurately and efficiently.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple tasks and priorities.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).

#### **Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!**

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Senior AI/DS Engineer
description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

title: Lead - Infrastructure Testing Governance & ServiceNow Test Management Product
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and strategic
**Infrastructure Testing Governance & ServiceNow Test Management Product Lead**
to drive the evolution of enterprise infrastructure testing practices and own the ServiceNow Test Management platform roadmap.
  
  
This role is responsible for defining and governing infrastructure testing processes, ensuring testing controls and quality gates are consistently applied across technology changes, and driving continuous improvement through incident analysis and lessons learned. The individual will serve as the Product Lead for the ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM), partnering with stakeholders and ServiceNow development teams to translate business requirements into scalable solutions that improve testing effectiveness, traceability, compliance, and operational resilience.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines expertise in testing governance, process design, requirements management, ServiceNow product ownership, and cross-functional leadership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
ServiceNow Test Management Product Ownership
  
  

* Own the vision, roadmap, and continuous enhancement of the ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM).
* Gather, document, and prioritize business requirements from testing, engineering, infrastructure, and application teams.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements and user stories.
* Partner closely with ServiceNow developers, architects, and platform teams to design and implement solutions.
* Manage product backlog, feature prioritization, and release planning.
* Drive user adoption and ensure platform capabilities align with evolving organizational needs.
* Establish metrics and reporting to measure platform value and effectiveness.

Infrastructure Testing Governance
  
  

* Define, implement, and maintain enterprise infrastructure testing standards, processes, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure testing requirements, controls, and process gates are consistently applied across infrastructure changes.
* Drive adherence to testing policies, validation standards, and governance requirements.
* Establish testing readiness criteria and approval processes for infrastructure changes.
* Partner with change management, engineering, and operational teams to improve testing quality and change success rates.
* Monitor testing compliance and identify areas for process improvement.

Testing Process Leadership
  
  

* Lead the development and continuous improvement of testing methodologies, workflows, and operating procedures.
* Standardize testing practices across infrastructure and platform teams.
* Define testing requirements, traceability expectations, and quality metrics.
* Promote automation and efficient validation practices to increase testing coverage and reduce operational risk.
* Ensure testing processes support risk-based decision making and production stability objectives.

Incident Review and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Facilitate post-implementation reviews and incident analysis related to infrastructure changes.
* Identify testing gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions resulting from production incidents and testing failures.
* Leverage incident trends and metrics to enhance testing standards, controls, and platform capabilities.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, application teams, platform teams, quality engineering, risk, audit, and change management stakeholders.
* Lead governance discussions and provide recommendations to leadership on testing strategy and process improvements.
* Communicate testing risks, readiness, compliance status, and improvement opportunities to senior stakeholders.
* Influence adoption of enterprise testing standards and best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 9+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Management, Infrastructure Testing, Change Management, or related disciplines.
* Experience defining and governing enterprise testing processes and controls.
* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.
* Experience partnering with development teams to deliver technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, testing methodologies, and change management practices.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving organizational change.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM) experience.
* ServiceNow Product Owner or Platform Owner experience.
* Experience with infrastructure change testing and validation.
* Knowledge of enterprise governance, risk, and compliance practices.
* Experience implementing process improvement programs.
* Familiarity with testing automation platforms and reporting solutions.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise technology environments.

Success in This Role
  
  
**A Successful Candidate Will**

* Establish a scalable and effective infrastructure testing governance framework.
* Drive adoption and maturity of the ServiceNow Test Management platform.
* Improve testing compliance, traceability, and operational consistency.
* Reduce production risk through stronger testing controls and processes.
* Use incident learnings to continuously improve testing effectiveness.
* Serve as the trusted leader for enterprise testing governance and ServiceNow test management capabilities.

This description should attract candidates who can function as a
**Product Owner, Business Analyst, Process Owner, Governance Lead, and Testing Strategist**
all within a single role. That's likely the profile you need given the breadth of ownership you're describing.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services use our unique and proprietary data, technology, insights and expertise to deliver solutions that meet the needs of our customers. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.
  
  
Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.
  
  
Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases & agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the definition and execution of the AI product roadmap for Payment Performance Intelligence, contributing to strategy and investment discussions led by senior product leadership.
* Own delivery of assigned AI product areas end to end, from discovery and requirements through development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Help identify and validate high-value use cases for GenAI, chatbots, agentic services, predictive insights, and self-service analytics.
* Translate customer needs, market inputs, and business objectives into clear user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Work day to day with Data Science, Engineering, and Platform teams to groom the backlog, unblock dependencies, and maintain sprint velocity.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance partners to ensure products meet regulatory and responsible AI requirements.
* Recommend prioritization based on customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and effort, escalating trade-offs where needed.
* Define and track success metrics for owned features, reporting progress, risks, and adoption to stakeholders.
* Prepare and present roadmap updates, demos, and release communications to internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.
* Mentor junior product managers and associates, and contribute to improving agile practices and product documentation standards across the team.

**All About You**

* Solid experience in agile product management for analytics, data insights, AI-enabled, or financial services products.
* Working knowledge of GenAI use cases, predictive insights, self-service analytics, and the data foundations required to support them.
* Demonstrated ability to convert customer problems into requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience mentoring or guiding peers and junior team members is preferred; formal people management experience is not required.
* Highly organized and analytical, with strong attention to detail in backlog management and delivery tracking.
* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience required; technical background, payments experience, or product certification preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Program Analyst II
description:
Come join our growing team as Program Analyst II leading our team of Shop Floor Scheduling experts and our FST Finite Scheduling solution. You will play a pivotal role in the continuous transformation of our plant detailed scheduling capabilities and supporting technology. You will be responsible for driving product vision, strategy, and execution to meet the evolving needs of our supply chain and customers.
  
  
**Job Description**
: As a Program Analyst II in our Planning & Logistics COE, you will play a pivotal role in the continuous transformation of our planning & scheduling processes and technology. You will be responsible for driving product vision, strategy, and execution to meet the evolving needs of our supply chain and customers. This role requires a deep understanding of supply chain processes including Planning, Scheduling, and interaction with other Supply Chain and business functions, and a strong ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional solutions.
  
  
**Education / Work Experience**
: Degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or related field of study.  6+ years of Planning and/or Manufacturing experience & 1+ years leading others.
  
  
**Independence Level / Reports to**
: Limited managerial or supervisory support required from manager. Provide advanced input to the creation of strategic roadmap and responsible for being change agent. Normally reports to Senior Manager or Director.
  
  
**Additional Description:**
Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 300 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantages while earning and keeping customers' trust.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* Opportunity for a long-term career path that allows for exposure into all areas of Ecolab’s supply chain
* Access to best-in-class resources, tools, and technology
* Thrive in a company that values sustainability, drives a safety-focused culture and has been recognized as one of the most ethical companies in the world

**What You Will Do**

* Define and communicate the product vision and strategy for our Shop Floor Scheduling solution, aligning it with company goals and customer needs.
* Develop and maintain a clear product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on customer feedback, trends, and business objectives.
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and internal teams to gather and prioritize requirements for product features and improvements.
* Collaborate with technical Product Team on detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and product backlogs that guide the team in building out our planning solutions.
* Work closely with development teams to ensure that product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to make informed decisions about product direction.
* Support testing and validation of product features to ensure they meet team’s expectations.
* Coordinate product releases, including communication plans, training materials, and support.
* Build strong relationships with business partners, seeking their input and feedback to continuously improve the product.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering or related field of study
* 6 years of Planning, Manufacturing, or other Supply Chain & technology experience
* Experience improving business process & technology
* Proficiency with an APS, Shop Floor Scheduling, ERP, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, analytical system or equivalent
* Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to drive decisions and build consensus among stakeholders
* Ability to create, clearly articulate and execute on a strategic vision
* Strong business acumen and experience collaborating with Operations, Marketing and Customers
* Skilled in resolving conflict situations effectively

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced technical or business degree, MBA preferred
* Experience in operational excellence and project management such as TPM, Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, Green Belt, etc.
* APICS Certification
* Planning and/or Shop Floor Scheduling system experience – BlueYonder, APO, Kinaxis, OPM, etc.
* Direct people management experience
* Product Owner or Product Manager experience, preferably in the supply chain or logistics domain.

We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. title: Head of AI Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About TVARIT**
TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving
  
  
advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).
  
  
With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most
  
  
innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.
  
  
We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior leader to head TVARIT’s Metals Division, owning customer relationships, solution delivery, and the growth of our industrial AI business with steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and other metal producers and processors. The role calls for an engineer who combines first-hand manufacturing plant experience, ideally in metals, with strong data science and AI expertise and a proven record of leading software delivery with a team
  
  
The Head of AI Solutions & Delivery will be the senior face of TVARIT to metals customers, from the first discovery workshop through deployment and scaled adoption, and will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on
  
  
quality, yield, uptime, and energy consumption. The role leads a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, and turns successful deployments into reusable, scalable offerings for the metals sector.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Division Leadership & Growth:**

* Lead the Metals Division end to end, including strategy, customer portfolio, revenue and delivery targets, and division-level planning and reporting.
* Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and metallurgy/process domain experts; set clear goals, hiring plans, and standards of technical excellence.
* Define the division’s solution and product roadmap together with product and business teams, prioritizing use cases with recurring demand across steel, aluminum, and other metal processes.
* Grow existing accounts and win new business through solution design, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concept planning, and commercial discussions.

**Customer Engagement**

* Act as the senior technical and executive point of contact for metals customers, building trusted relationships with plant managers, process and quality engineers, IT/OT teams, and senior decision makers.
* Lead discovery discussions and requirements workshops, on the shop floor and in the boardroom, to understand manufacturing processes, operational challenges, existing systems, and business priorities.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, solution concepts, highlevel architectures, implementation scope, and measurable success criteria.
* Present TVARIT’s capabilities through relevant project examples, demonstrations, and workshops, communicating methodology, technical differentiation, limitations, and expected business value credibly to technical and executive audiences

**Delivery Excellence**

* Own delivery of all Metals Division projects, from scoping and data onboarding through model development, deployment, user adoption, and value realization, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
* Establish delivery governance across projects: plans and milestones, risk and dependency management, customer status reporting, and escalation handling.
* Assess feasibility before commitment, considering data readiness, integration with PLC/SCADA, MES, and historians, deployment constraints, effort, and business impact; align customer commitments with team capacity and technical readiness.
* Track and demonstrate realized value (e.g., scrap reduction, yield, first-pass quality, energy per tonne, unplanned downtime) and use proven results to drive renewals and expansion.

**Technical, Data Science & AI Leadership**

* Provide hands-on technical direction on data science and ML approaches for metal processes, including time-series modeling, predictive quality, predictive maintenance, process optimization, and hybrid physics-informed models.
* Review solution architectures and engineering practices for robustness, scalability, and maintainability; set standards for software delivery, MLOps, and model monitoring.
* Identify reusable intellectual property across projects, including models, algorithms, software components, and process expertise, and guide its development into configurable, scalable products for the metals sector with minimal incremental development where feasible.
* Stay current on industrial AI, including generative AI and industrial copilots, and evaluate where they add real value for metals customers.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Computer Science, or a related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science is an advantage.
* 10+ years of professional experience, including substantial experience leading teams and customer engagements in industrial AI, manufacturing technology, industrial software, or technology-led solution delivery.
* Mandatory manufacturing exposure: direct experience working in or closely with manufacturing plants and their operations teams. Metals experience (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, foundry/casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment) is strongly preferred; automotive, heavy engineering, or process manufacturing is also considered
* Software delivery leadership: must have led the delivery of software products or solutions with a team, with a solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance) and agile delivery practices. Hands-on coding exposure (e.g., Python) is mandatory; professional software development experience is an advantage.
* Mandatory AI modeling experience: strong understanding of AI/ML modeling (problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment considerations) and hands-on involvement in AI/ML modeling projects, ideally on industrial, sensor, or time-series data.
* Proven customer-facing leadership, including requirements gathering, technical presentations, executive stakeholder management, and managing customer expectations through delivery
* Proven delivery track record: leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects to successful deployment, with accountability for timelines, scope, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience in solution architecture, presales, technical proposals, or productizing project work into reusable offerings.
* Strong people leadership, with experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams; excellent written and verbal communication, structured problemsolving, and the ability to represent TVARIT confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**
**Strong Haves**

* Data science and AI: Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive and prescriptive analytics, optimization, and hybrid physics-informed modeling, with a clear view of their practical applications and limitations.
* Metals process understanding: Ability to relate process parameters in melting, casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment to quality, yield, scrap, energy consumption, equipment health, and operating cost.
* Software development lifecycle: Working understanding of how industrial software is planned, built, tested, released, and supported, including agile practices, CI/CD, code quality, and testing, sufficient to lead engineering teams and make sound delivery trade-offs. Hands-on coding exposure in Python is required, along with working familiarity with SQL.
* Solution architecture and productization: Translating business and operational requirements into functional specifications, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps; reusable components, configurable solutions, model generalization, and validation across plants.

Familiarity Needed
  
  

* Industrial data and integration: Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, sensors, lab and quality data, and manufacturing data platforms, including data quality, contextualization, and OT/IT integration
* Deployment and MLOps: Cloud, edge, and on-premises deployment, MLOps, model monitoring and retraining, security, and reliability. Familiarity with Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
* Emerging AI: Awareness of generative AI, LLMs, and industrial copilots, including their practical applications and limitations in manufacturing

title: Senior product sofware engineer
description:
About the Role:
  
  
Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead Software Development: Take the lead in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements.
* Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives.
* Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members.
* Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process.
* Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency.
* Application Design: Lead the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards.
* Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications.
* Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects.
* Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development.
* Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications.
* Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries.

Skills:
  
  

* Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues.
* Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
* Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
* Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
* Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
* Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
* Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
* Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
* Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a relational database, a type of database that stores and organizes data in a structured way and where data is logically interrelated. This skill often requires proficiency in SQL, database management systems, and an understanding of database design principles.
* APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other.
* Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
* Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding.
* Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency.

Competencies:
  
  

* Analytical Skills
* Inclusive Collaboration
* Drive to Perform
* Accountability
* Functional Expertise
* Operational Expertise

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

:

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Experience as a Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role in financial services or payments technology.
* Working knowledge of credit and debit card transaction lifecycles and card processing platforms.
* Strong requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, modelling, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
