title: GM - Multi Cloud Platform Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology leader to own and govern a diverse portfolio of technology products, multi-cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role combines Technology Portfolio Management, Strategic Account Management, Product Leadership, and Enterprise Transformation responsibilities to deliver business value, accelerate modernisation, enhance service excellence, and strengthen VOIS as a trusted strategic technology partner.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as the primary technology engagement lead between Vodafone markets and VOIS, collaborating with senior stakeholders including Product Managers, IT Leaders, Architects, Engineering Leaders, and CIO-level decision-makers. They will drive strategy, governance, cloud adoption, transformation programmes, and portfolio execution across complex technology environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and govern a portfolio of technology products, cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and transformation initiatives aligned to strategic business objectives.
* Lead strategy, governance, and lifecycle management of multi-cloud platforms across Azure, AWS, OCI, and future cloud service providers.
* Act as the primary engagement interface between Vodafone markets and VOIS, building trusted and collaborative stakeholder relationships.
* Lead multiple Agile delivery teams to achieve portfolio objectives, customer outcomes, and strategic priorities.
* Contribute to business growth by supporting pre-sales activities and identifying opportunities across existing and new customers.
* Drive enterprise-wide transformation, cloud migration, cloud adoption, platform engineering, automation, resilience, and operational excellence programmes.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate objectives into roadmaps, epics, features, and user stories.
* Champion SAFe Agile, Portfolio Management, DevOps, and modern engineering practices.
* Govern delivery performance, budgets, risks, dependencies, escalations, and stakeholder communications.
* Lead executive governance forums, service reviews, steering committees, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
* Identify opportunities to expand technology services and increase business value delivery

**Who You Are**

* Extensive experience in Technology Delivery, Product Management, Cloud, Infrastructure, Transformation, or Service Leadership roles.
* Strong programme management expertise delivering large-scale transformation initiatives across multiple teams and business functions.
* Proven experience leading cloud migration, cloud adoption, and modernisation programmes in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple Agile engineering teams within SAFe delivery models.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platform governance across Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, and related cloud ecosystems.
* Experience managing platform lifecycle, resilience, security, performance, and cost optimisation.
* Strong understanding of cloud financial management, cloud efficiency, and value realisation principles.
* Proven ability to influence and engage CIOs, Product Leaders, IT Heads, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience defining technology roadmaps, governance frameworks, investment priorities, and portfolio strategies.
* Strong capability in:
* Multi-cloud strategy and governance
* Growth planning
* Capacity planning
* Product and platform management

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to lead strategic, global-scale technology portfolios and transformation programmes.Exposure to senior executive stakeholders and enterprise technology leadership forums.Ability to influence cloud strategy, platform modernisation, and technology investment decisions.Opportunity to work across multiple markets, functions, and technology domains.A highly collaborative environment focused on innovation, customer value, and continuous improvement.Experience shaping the future direction of cloud, infrastructure, and platform services within a global organisation.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Advanced portfolio governance and strategic technology planning.Executive stakeholder management and strategic account leadership.Enterprise-scale cloud transformation and multi-cloud governance.SAFe Agile portfolio execution and large-scale delivery management.Cloud financial management, optimisation, and value realisation.Service excellence, resilience, and platform engineering best practices.Business growth identification and technology consulting capabilities.Enterprise transformation leadership across global teams and markets.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Technical Program Manager II
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Technical Program Manager II
  
  
**Who Is Mastercard**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Payment Networks organization is seeking a Technical Program Manager II to join the Authorization team. The successful candidate will partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Operations and other cross-functional teams to drive delivery of strategic and operational initiatives supporting Mastercard's Authorization platform.
  
  
This role is responsible for planning, coordinating and governing the execution of complex technical programs spanning multiple engineering teams and stakeholder groups. The Technical Program Manager II will drive delivery excellence through strong program management practices, proactive risk management, dependency coordination, stakeholder communication and release governance.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical acumen with exceptional communication and organizational skills and is passionate about delivering high-quality solutions in a fast-paced payments environment.
  
  
Role
  
  
**The Technical Program Manager II Will**
Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex technical initiatives across multiple teams.
  
  
Drive program governance, execution tracking and delivery reporting for strategic authorization platform initiatives.
  
  
Facilitate PI Planning, release planning, sprint governance and cross-team execution reviews.
  
  
Manage dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and blockers to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
  
  
Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Operations and supporting organizations.
  
  
Proactively identify, track and mitigate program risks, issues, assumptions and constraints.
  
  
Collaborate with Engineering Managers and Product Managers to prioritize work, secure resources, establish milestones, and optimize delivery sequencing.
  
  
Ensure alignment between business objectives, product priorities and engineering execution plans.
  
  
Drive stakeholder communication and provide executive-ready status reporting.
  
  
Partner with engineering leadership to improve predictability, transparency and delivery efficiency.
  
  
Support release readiness activities, production implementation planning and operational readiness reviews.
  
  
Ensure program execution aligns with Mastercard technology and governance standards.
  
  
Promote continuous improvement and delivery excellence across engineering teams.
  
  
**All About You**
Required Qualifications
  
  
Experience managing medium-to-large technical programs in software engineering organizations.
  
  
Demonstrated success coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and teams.
  
  
Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies and software delivery lifecycles.
  
  
Experience managing program schedules, milestones, dependencies and risks.
  
  
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational capabilities.
  
  
Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority.
  
  
Experience using Jira, Confluence and Agile planning tools.
  
  
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience within payments, financial technology or transaction processing environments.
  
  
Knowledge of authorization processing, card payments, payment networks, acquiring or issuing ecosystems.
  
  
Experience supporting large-scale distributed systems and highly available platforms.
  
  
Experience with SAFe, PI Planning or large-scale Agile delivery frameworks.
  
  
Experience with release management, production readiness and operational governance practices.
  
  
Understanding of software engineering metrics and delivery analytics.
  
  
Prior experience managing programs across globally distributed teams.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: FM Transformation Global Business Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and collaborative
**FM Transformation Global Business Analyst**
to support the design and delivery of global Facilities Management (FM) transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions by translating complex operational requirements into clear, actionable deliverables. You will work closely with global stakeholders, Product teams, Process Owners, Technology teams, Data specialists, and Change leads to ensure solutions are aligned with business objectives and successfully adopted across the organization.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in large-scale business transformation, driving process standardization, operational efficiency, and technology-enabled change across multiple regions.

**What You'll Do**

**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process analysis activities.
* Gather, analyze, prioritize, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
* Translate requirements into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and supporting documentation.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability of requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.

**Process Transformation**

* Document and analyze current-state and future-state processes.
* Identify process gaps, improvement opportunities, risks, and dependencies.
* Support the development and adoption of global standard processes while evaluating legitimate localization needs.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with global, regional, and local stakeholders to align on requirements, priorities, and business outcomes.
* Facilitate discussions across cross-functional teams to resolve conflicts, clarify requirements, and drive decision-making.
* Build strong relationships with Product, Technology, Data, Change Management, and Deployment teams.

**Agile Delivery Support**

* Participate in backlog refinement, solution reviews, demonstrations, and sprint activities.
* Support Agile delivery teams by ensuring requirements remain clear, prioritized, and aligned with business objectives.
* Assist in managing requirement changes and assessing impacts on scope, processes, integrations, and deployment plans.

**Testing & Business Readiness**

* Define business scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, and business validation activities.
* Contribute to deployment readiness, training requirements, operational procedures, and transition-to-support planning.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain analysis artifacts, decisions, approvals, and documentation repositories.
* Support business case development, benefits realization, and transformation governance activities.
* Promote best practices, standards, templates, and continuous improvement across the FM Transformation organization.

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst within digital transformation, enterprise technology, or complex process improvement programs.
* Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.
* Demonstrated success supporting requirements management from discovery through deployment.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders preferred.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

* Strong expertise in:
* Requirements elicitation and management
* Process mapping and process improvement
* Gap analysis and impact assessment
* User stories and acceptance criteria development
* Requirements traceability and governance
* UAT and business acceptance processes
* Understanding of:
* Data quality, migration, and integration requirements
* Enterprise technology implementations
* Change management and operational readiness activities

**Tools**

Experience with one or more of:

* Azure DevOps
* Jira
* Microsoft Visio
* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft PowerPoint
* Microsoft 365 Suite

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Certification in Business Analysis (IIBA, BCS, CBAP, CCBA or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience within Facilities Management (FM), CMMS, Asset Management, Work Order Management, Field Service, or Service Management platforms is advantageous.

**Key Competencies**

* Communicates Effectively
* Collaborates Across Boundaries
* Manages Ambiguity
* Business Insight
* Decision Quality
* Stakeholder Influencing
* Problem Solving
* Analytical Thinking
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Why Join Us?**

You'll be part of a global transformation team shaping the future of Facilities Management through process excellence, technology innovation, and operational transformation. You'll work with international stakeholders and have the opportunity to influence solutions that drive meaningful business impact at scale.

title: AI UX/UI Designer/Researcher
description:
- - - - - - - - - - - -
  
  
Experienced or senior profile, reporting directly to the Chief Design Officer. Cross-functional role serving a community of sixty designers across France, India, the United States and China.
  
  
**Why this role -**
Our teams have been experimenting with AI for more than two years. The need is not to start the movement, but to turn these local initiatives into reliable, reusable and shared practices.
  
  
The person will start from real work: identify the uses that matter, improve them on live projects and enable other teams to adopt them. AI is the field of action; DesignOps is the lever; the quality of the user experience remains the compass.
  
  
**Mission**

* Move AI uses from individual experimentation to collective practices that hold up in production.
* The scope covers user research, interface design, content and the design system. The person works alongside the teams, without replacing UX Leads or imposing a single tool on everyone.

**Understand And Build On What Already Exists**

* Go into the hubs, observe practices and collect concrete examples. Identify what delivers real value, what remains fragile and what is duplicated.
* Expected deliverables: a map of current uses, documented examples and a shortlist of topics to pool first.

**Build and harden the workflow**
s
  
  

* Work on real projects to design repeatable ways of working: inputs, steps, tools, human checks, expected outputs and limits.
* A workflow must be usable by someone other than its author, at a verifiable level of quality.
* Expected deliverables: tested workflows, reusable templates and explicit validation criteria.

**Organise their day-to-day use**

* Make practices easy to find, understand and maintain. Clarify who owns them, how they evolve and when they should be retired. Align uses with the design system and with internal frameworks governing tools and data.
* Expected deliverables: a maintained reference space, clear ownership and a lightweight process for flagging issues.

**Work with the teams and pass it on**

* Support designers on their deliverables, pair with them, make trade-offs visible and help local champions become autonomous.
* Training can help, but it is not the purpose of the role. Success shows in the practices that remain once the person has left the room.

**Measure the real contribution**

* Assess the impact on working time, rework, deliverable quality and team autonomy. Tell an impressive demo apart from a lasting gain.
* Expected deliverables: before/after comparisons and reasoned decisions to continue, adapt or stop a use.

**What The Role Is Not**

* This is not a trend-watching or evangelism role disconnected from projects, nor a job producing training courses or prompt libraries. The person is not expected to build every technical integration alone, nor to approve every team experiment.
* They must be technical enough to understand, prototype and engage with IT, without losing their product design expertise.

**First expected results: three-month proposal**

* Month one: understand the hubs' practices, identify champions and select a few use cases based on observed problems.
* Month two: test two or three workflows on projects, with a baseline and quality criteria defined with the teams.
* Month three: have at least one workflow adopted by another team, document the conditions for success and set up its maintenance.

***he first sign of success is not the number of people trained: it is a useful practice, adopted elsewhere, with no permanent dependence on its author**
.*

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

It is a client-facing, problem-solving, project ownership role for someone who understands technology well enough to bridge the gap between engineering and the business. If you are someone who loves working with enterprise clients, can manage a project timeline, and wants to see how technology transforms financial operations at scale — this role is for you.

• Understand each prospect's accounts-receivable process, ERP landscape, and pain points; translate these into a tailored solution narrative.

• Prepare pre-call briefs, solutioning notes, objection-handling material, and follow-up communication for internal stakeholders and clients.

• Support the pipeline by qualifying prospects, contributing to sales collateral and audits, and moving accounts through the funnel.

**Implementation & Delivery**

● Lead end-to-end onboarding of enterprise clients onto the Global PayEX platform, working with bank partners and corporate treasury teams.

● Configure and test platform workflows based on client-specific requirements.

● Prepare implementation plans, training materials, and status reports for client and internal stakeholders. ● Identify and resolve implementation blockers quickly, escalating where needed.

● Build trusted relationships with client contacts throughout the implementation lifecycle.

● Support continuous improvement of our implementation playbooks and documentation.

**Operations, Onboarding & Adoption**

• Monitor throughput and adoption metrics for your accounts; identify drop-offs and act on them. • Own the client relationship post go-live for at least the stabilisation period.

● 1–2 years of full-time work experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or a finance/treasury function within a corporate.

. ● Strong understanding of basic finance concepts — accounts receivable, invoicing, reconciliation, collections, working capital, DSO.

● Comfortable being client-facing: confident in demos, meetings, and presentations with senior finance stakeholders.

● Proactive by default — able to spot what needs doing next and drive it without being asked.

● Strong written and verbal communication in English.

Why Global PayEX

● Work with Fortune 500 clients from day one.

● Founded and led by a CMU alumnus — you will have direct access to senior leadership

title: Product Manager
description:
We are looking for a dynamic, data-driven, and execution-focused Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and continuous evolution of Mirchi Digital's consumer-facing digital products. The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking, strong product intuition, technical understanding, and a customer-first mindset to build scalable, intuitive, and engaging digital experiences.

This role will involve end-to-end ownership of the product roadmap, from identifying customer needs and defining opportunities to collaborating with cross-functional teams, launching features, and driving measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligned with organizational goals and customer needs.
* Identify new product opportunities through market research, competitive benchmarking, customer insights, and data analysis.
* Translate business objectives into clear product requirements, feature priorities, and actionable development plans.
* Define and track product KPIs related to user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.

**2. Product Development & Execution**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and conceptualization to development, launch, and optimization.
* Work closely with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and business teams to deliver high-quality product experiences.
* Create detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, wireframes, and user journeys.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, prioritization, and release timelines using Agile/Lean methodologies.
* Identify dependencies, manage risks, and proactively resolve execution challenges to ensure timely delivery.

**3. User Experience & Customer Engagement**

* Champion a customer-first approach across product planning and decision-making.
* Collaborate with UI/UX teams to create intuitive, seamless, and engaging experiences across mobile applications and web platforms.
* Analyze user behavior, customer journeys, conversion funnels, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Drive initiatives focused on improving user engagement, customer satisfaction, retention, and overall product experience.

**4. Analytics, Growth & Optimization**

* Leverage product analytics and customer insights to make informed decisions and measure feature performance.
* Design and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments to continuously improve user experience and business metrics.
* Monitor critical metrics such as DAU/MAU, conversion rates, feature adoption, churn, and retention.
* Partner with growth and marketing teams to optimize user acquisition, onboarding, and activation journeys.
* Develop a strong understanding of digital growth channels, including App Store Optimization (ASO) and organic discovery.

**5. Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the central point of ownership for assigned products and initiatives.
* Communicate product priorities, progress, outcomes, and challenges effectively to key stakeholders.
* Influence cross-functional teams through clear thinking, data-backed recommendations, and strong collaboration.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and technical feasibility to deliver maximum product impact.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5-10 years of relevant Product Management experience, preferably building and scaling B2C digital products.
* An MBA from a Tier 1 institution. Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong understanding of the digital consumer ecosystem; experience in OTT, music streaming, entertainment, media, or subscription-led platforms will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Agile product development, sprint management, backlog prioritization, and cross-functional execution.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product decisions.
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Figma, Balsamiq, or equivalent product analytics and design tools.
* Working knowledge of APIs, mobile and web technologies, experimentation frameworks, and product performance monitoring.

**Key Competencies**

* **Product Ownership:**
  Strong accountability for product decisions, execution, and measurable outcomes.
* **Customer Obsession:**
  Deep understanding of customer needs, behavior, and pain points.
* **Analytical Thinking:**
  Ability to make structured, data-informed decisions.
* **Innovation Mindset:**
  Curiosity to explore emerging technologies, trends, and product opportunities.
* **Technical Acumen:**
  Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and understand technical trade-offs.
* **Execution Excellence:**
  Ability to prioritize effectively, solve problems, and consistently deliver results.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills.

**What We're Looking For**

Someone who doesn't just manage features but thinks like a product owner, acts like a problem-solver, and delivers like an entrepreneur.

A professional who is equally comfortable discussing customer experiences, analyzing conversion funnels, defining product strategy, and working alongside engineers to bring impactful products to market.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Principal Product Manager - Agentic Investigation & Reliability Experiences
  
  
Sumo Logic is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead how engineers and operators investigate incidents, understand reliability risk, and act on their operational and security telemetry.
  
  
The observability category was built around collecting telemetry and giving people tools to navigate it: dashboards, queries, monitors, traces, and alerts. Customer expectations are now shifting. Teams don't just want more dashboards; they want help getting from a signal to a resolution, understanding what's broken, why, what's impacted, and what to do next. As AI agents move into production operations, this role owns how Sumo Logic brings intelligent, agent-assisted investigation and reliability workflows to customers, grounded in evidence, context, and enterprise governance.
  
  
This is a senior, high-ownership role. It requires genuine observability domain background. You should have lived in this space and understand how monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability actually work, combined with the ambition to define a new category of experience on top of it.
  
  
What You Will Own
  
  
**The current data experiences.**
Log Search, Live Tail, query and query optimization, Metrics Search, Tracing, Dashboards, and the data-experience UI. This is a live, revenue-generating product with real customers, and keeping it strong is part of the job. You own its health, roadmap, and competitiveness today while steering it toward an AI-native future, focusing new investment where it strengthens investigation, speed, and value for both new and power users.
  
  
**The reliability and alerting surface.**
Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent-assisted detection and investigation.
  
  
**The agentic investigation experience.**
You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. This means productizing investigation workflows that reason across logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards, and related context, and evolving them from reactive troubleshooting toward more proactive detection over time.
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  

* Set the multi-quarter vision for Sumo Logic's investigation and reliability experiences, and turn it into a roadmap engineering can execute against.
* Own the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of the current data and reliability product surfaces.
* Define how search, metrics, tracing, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs evolve from human-navigated tools into more intuitive, AI-assisted experiences.
* Productize investigation workflows that reason across telemetry and related operational context, and surface findings customers can act on.
* Own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals.
* Shape how skills, tools, and agents are built on top of the data surfaces, and ensure they respect enterprise controls such as RBAC, audit, cost limits, and approvals.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, performance, and reliability at enterprise scale.
* Translate strategy into clear PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.
* Use telemetry to understand how customers search, investigate, and configure alerts, and where they hit friction, latency, false positives, or cost.
* Create leadership-facing proposals that frame tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, performance, cost, and long-term architecture.

What You Bring
  
  

* 8+ years of product management experience with real observability or monitoring domain background. You have owned products in observability, monitoring, incident response, APM, or a closely adjacent operational-telemetry space. This is a hard requirement.
* Deep, first-hand understanding of the observability surface area including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs, and of how engineers and operators actually investigate incidents and decide what to trust.
* Proven ability to run a live, at-scale product, owning the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of shipping surfaces while driving a larger transformation.
* A track record of owning broad, technically deep surfaces and setting direction that other teams build on.
* Familiarity with how AI and agents are changing data interaction, including natural-language investigation, tools, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop action, or the ability to ramp quickly.
* Strong technical instincts around query engines, time-series and trace data, and alerting systems, plus the judgment to know where an AI-assisted experience should replace a manual flow and where depth must stay.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, reliability, and cost.
* Excellent communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write clear proposals, decision docs, PRDs, and acceptance criteria.
* High ownership and drive to make progress across a large, ambiguous, fast-moving surface.

Must-Have Qualities
  
  

* Runs today, builds tomorrow. Keeps a live product healthy and competitive while reinventing it, and knows what to sustain and what to rebuild.
* Deep observability judgment. Understands search, metrics, tracing, and alerting well enough to make hard architecture and tradeoff calls with engineering.
* Operator empathy. Knows what makes an alert trustworthy, an investigation fast, and a recommendation credible enough to act on.
* Governance-minded. Treats RBAC, audit, cost, and approvals as part of the product.
* Sets direction. Defines a vision for a broad area and rallies teams around it.
* Analytical. Uses data to prioritize, validate, and refine decisions.
* High drive and ownership. Pushes through ambiguity across a large surface and drives execution to conclusion.
* Tradeoff thinker. Frames options and recommendations clearly for leadership.

**About Us**
Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. title: AI Solutions Consultant & Client Delivery Lead
description:
About Nectar Innovations

Nectar Innovations helps businesses turn AI opportunities into practical solutions that improve operations, enhance customer experiences, and drive measurable business outcomes.

We work with US businesses to identify opportunities for AI adoption, design AI-powered solutions, build intelligent applications, and automate business processes. Our capabilities span AI agents and agentic workflows, generative AI, conversational AI, business process automation, AI-native applications, CRM solutions, and digital transformation.

We believe successful AI implementation requires more than technology. It takes a deep understanding of business problems, thoughtful solution design, strong client partnerships, and disciplined execution.

We're looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Consultant who can connect business objectives with technical possibilities and help our US clients move from ideas to implementation.

About the Role

As an AI Solutions Consultant & Client Delivery Lead, you will serve as a primary point of contact for clients, taking ownership of engagements from discovery and solution design through implementation, delivery, and continuous improvement.

You will work directly with US clients to understand their business goals, evaluate existing processes, identify opportunities for AI and automation, and translate requirements into clear solution architectures, technical roadmaps, project plans, and measurable outcomes.

You will collaborate closely with AI engineers, software developers, product teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that solutions are technically sound, commercially viable, and aligned with client expectations.

This role is ideal for someone who combines consulting and communication skills with practical experience in AI projects. You should be equally comfortable leading a client workshop, discussing an AI agent architecture with engineers, presenting a project roadmap, and resolving an implementation roadblock.

**We are looking for a problem solver and trusted client advisor, not someone who only creates presentations and strategy documents.**

Key Responsibilities1. Client Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned US clients and build trusted, long-term relationships.
* Lead client discovery calls, requirement-gathering sessions, workshops, solution reviews, and project status meetings.
* Understand client business objectives, operational challenges, existing systems, and desired outcomes.
* Communicate project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and next steps clearly to client stakeholders.
* Manage expectations, resolve concerns, and maintain alignment between client requirements and delivery commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing engagements through additional AI use cases, automation initiatives, and technology improvements.

2. AI Consulting and Solution Design

* Identify and evaluate business processes that can benefit from AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered applications.
* Translate business requirements into solution concepts, functional specifications, use cases, and implementation plans.
* Design AI solution approaches involving AI agents, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational AI, workflow automation, and system integrations.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy options, technology choices, feasibility, implementation complexity, and business impact.
* Work with engineering teams to define solution architecture, integration requirements, data dependencies, security considerations, and technical roadmaps.

3. Project and Delivery Management

* Own the day-to-day coordination and successful delivery of client projects from initiation through deployment.
* Translate approved scopes into milestones, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across AI engineering, software development, product, QA, and other relevant functions.
* Monitor project progress, identify delivery risks, remove blockers, and drive timely resolution of technical and operational issues.
* Manage scope changes, dependencies, resource requirements, and client approvals.
* Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards and business requirements.
* Lead project reviews, demonstrations, user acceptance testing, deployment coordination, and post-launch improvement discussions.
* Maintain clear project documentation, decision logs, action items, and status reports.

4. Technical Collaboration and Problem-Solving

* Engage in meaningful technical discussions with engineers and architects to evaluate proposed solutions.
* Understand AI application architectures, APIs, data flows, integrations, model selection, and deployment considerations.
* Challenge assumptions, investigate implementation issues, and help teams identify practical solutions to technical roadblocks.
* Participate in proof-of-concept development, solution validation, and technical feasibility assessments where required.

5. Business Cases and Measurable Outcomes

* Develop business cases that connect AI initiatives to operational efficiency, revenue growth, customer experience, cost reduction, or risk mitigation.
* Define success metrics and baseline measurements before implementation.
* Estimate implementation costs, expected benefits, potential ROI, and ongoing operational requirements.
* Track post-deployment performance and identify opportunities to improve adoption, accuracy, efficiency, and business value.
* Help clients prioritize AI initiatives based on business impact, feasibility, risk, and implementation effort.

6. Presales and Solution Advisory

* Support sales conversations by participating in discovery calls, technical discussions, and solution presentations.
* Help translate client challenges into compelling proposals, statements of work, solution approaches, and effort estimates.
* Present technical concepts in clear business language to executives and non-technical stakeholders.
* Help clients understand what AI can realistically accomplish, where human intervention remains necessary, and how to approach implementation in phases.

Required Qualifications

* 5–10 years of relevant professional experience in technology consulting, solution consulting, business analysis, technical project management, AI implementation, or digital transformation. Candidates with exceptional hands-on AI delivery experience may be considered with fewer years.
* Demonstrated involvement in at least two AI, generative AI, AI automation, or intelligent application projects, preferably taken beyond proof of concept into production or live deployment.
* Experience working directly with clients to understand requirements, recommend solutions, manage expectations, and coordinate delivery.
* Strong understanding of AI applications, including LLM-based solutions, AI agents, RAG, conversational AI, or AI-enabled business workflows.
* Ability to translate business problems into technical requirements and actionable implementation roadmaps.
* Experience coordinating developers, engineers, architects, QA teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Understanding of project planning, scope management, risk identification, effort estimation, and delivery governance.
* Ability to discuss technical trade-offs and implementation challenges with engineering teams.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to lead professional discussions with US clients.
* Ability to manage multiple engagements, prioritize competing demands, and take ownership of outcomes.

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be an advantage:

* AI agents and agentic workflows.
* Generative AI applications, LLM integrations, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
* Frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or equivalent technologies.
* Workflow automation tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.
* Conversational AI and voice-enabled applications.
* CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho.
* APIs, webhooks, system integrations, databases, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Web and mobile application development, SaaS products, or enterprise application architecture.
* Data analytics, reporting, process intelligence, or business workflow automation.
* AI evaluation, testing, monitoring, governance, and production deployment practices.

**Important:**
You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed. We value strong technical fundamentals, hands-on project exposure, and the ability to learn and evaluate new technologies quickly.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 60 days, you should be able to:

* Take ownership of assigned client relationships and lead discovery and project meetings independently.
* Understand client workflows and identify practical AI implementation opportunities.
* Work with engineering teams to develop clear solution approaches, technical roadmaps, and delivery plans.
* Establish effective project governance, communication, and risk management.
* Help move projects forward by resolving blockers and keeping clients and internal teams aligned.

Who Should Apply?

We welcome candidates from different professional backgrounds, including:

* AI consultants who have delivered real client projects.
* Technical project managers with hands-on AI implementation experience.
* Solution architects who enjoy client interaction and business problem-solving.
* Business analysts or management consultants who have transitioned into AI and can demonstrate implementation experience.
* Software engineers or AI engineers who want to combine technical expertise with consulting, solution design, and client ownership.

The ideal candidate is curious, commercially aware, technically credible, organized, and comfortable taking responsibility when projects become challenging.

title: AGM- Product Manager
description:
**ABOUT US:**

BYLD Group is committed to making a difference to people and their organizations through its decades of excellence in business solutions, diverse corporate exposure, and skilled workforce. Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.

Founded in the year 1998, BYLD is the largest group in the South Asian region, offering technology-enabled HR and business productivity solutions. We have served 5,00,000+ individuals, worked with more than 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 60% of the Business World top 1000 companies.

Please read about us – http://byldgroup.com

**Designation -** AGM / GM - Product Manager

**Experience -** 6-8 years

**Location -** Gurgaon, Haryana

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* **Product ownership:** Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
* **AI and workflow architecture:** Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
* **Efficiency and automation:** Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
* **New features and adoption:** Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
* **Product opportunities:** Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
* **Stakeholder management:** Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
* **Requirements and PRDs:** Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
* **Sprint execution:** Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 6–8 years in Product Management or Product Operations, ideally in staffing, recruitment tech, HR-tech or other operations-heavy B2B platforms.
* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.
* **AI coding tools:** Active working knowledge of Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to prototype, debug or ship small changes independently.
* **Architecture basics:** APIs, databases, queues and how web and mobile applications are built, enough for informed conversations with engineering.
* **Product and project management:** Jira, Linear, Asana, Trello or similar; Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace.
* **Design and prototyping:** Figma (or similar) and AI design tools such as Figma AI or Uizard.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics dashboards; strong Excel / Sheets.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with ATS, CRM or VMS platforms and the staffing lifecycle.
* Experience building or launching AI agents or AI-powered product features.
* Familiarity with data privacy and statutory compliance in Indian staffing (e.g. DPDP Act, onboarding documentation).
* Exposure to no-code / low-code tools for internal tooling.

**Why join BYLD:**

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Learn directly from industry experts with 20+ years of experience
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Gain experience in world class management practices
* Insurance Benefits (Medical and Accidental) for all employees
* Multi-level Rewards programs for all employees

**Follow us:**

– https://linkedin.com/company/byld-group

– https://facebook.com/BYLDGroup

– https://twitter.com/BYLDGroup

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**Our Culture and Impact**

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

*Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams – Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official ‘name@cvent.com’ email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit:
https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud*

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Consultation & Strategic Delivery**

* Provide high-level consultation to clients on applying Cvent technology to meet their meetings and events program goals.
* Analyze current-state processes and map future-state workflows to Cvent solutions, identifying opportunities for automation along the way.
* Serve as a product specialist — deeply knowledgeable across Cvent products, able to demonstrate, consult, configure, test, train, and deploy solutions.
* Cultivate strong advisory relationships with key client stakeholders who influence adoption and long-term account health.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Apply structured project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID logs, milestone tracking, and change control — to manage simple-to-complex implementations, keeping timelines on track and proactively escalating barriers to success.
* Translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (e.g., adoption rate, time-to-value, process cycle time, cost savings, ROI) rather than relying on subjective or anecdotal measures of progress.
* Define and track KPIs and success metrics with clients at project kick-off, and report progress against them throughout the engagement so success is data-driven, not just directional.
* Oversee and/or configure client accounts, including testing, refining, and directing the contributions of other team members.
* Track time and profitability of implementation projects, providing recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign.
* Coordinate and conduct virtual user training sessions for client teams.

**Technical Configuration & Product Expertise**

* Configure, test, and refine Cvent product instances to match documented client requirements.
* Diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Interface with the Product Development team to define and convey client feature requests.

**AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation**

*This is where the role has evolved most. AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done, not an optional add-on:*

* **Use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot)**
  to draft, summarize, and refine requirements documents, process maps, and configuration workbooks — cutting documentation time and improving consistency across projects.
* **Apply AI-assisted meeting summarization and transcription tools**
  during discovery calls and configuration workshops to speed up note-taking, action-item tracking, and follow-up communications.
* **Identify and build lightweight automations or AI-agent workflows**
  for repetitive project tasks — status updates, test-case generation, training material drafts, and client FAQs — freeing up time for higher-value consulting.
* **Maintain quality and accuracy**
  as a human-in-the-loop reviewer: validating AI-generated configurations, documentation, and communications before they reach the client.
* **Model and mentor AI tool adoption**
  to junior team members and peers, helping the broader team adopt AI-first ways of working.
* **Use AI-powered analytics**
  on data such as usage patterns, support tickets, or historical project data to proactively flag risk and improve implementation quality.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Account Management to support sales activities where implementation expertise is a differentiator.
* Ensure client objectives and requirements are clearly conveyed and tracked throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Serve as a mentor to new team members, including on best practices for using AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Present internally as a subject-matter expert on implementation topics, lead conversations in team meetings, and participate in team committees, at times in a leadership capacity.

**Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications**

* 8 to 14+ years of external work experience in a project or customer management role — preferably in the corporate meetings, software, or broader high-tech industry — or a minimum of 5 years of Cvent experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.
* Experience implementing technology or automation, ideally within an organization responsible for managing meetings or events.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a positive, confident, and outgoing presence; strong presentation skills.
* Highly articulate and detail-oriented, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for clients of varying technical fluency.
* Strong project management skills — able to build and manage project plans, timelines, RAID/risk logs, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer goals into objective, quantifiable outcomes and hold projects accountable to measurable results rather than subjective impressions of progress.
* Ability to comprehend and diagram intermediate process flows, identifying opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Proficiency in core productivity tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio/Draw.io.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, and for applying general and industry-specific business knowledge in a fast-paced, analytical, team-oriented environment.
* Strong time-management and organizational discipline; ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.
* A solutions-first mindset — comfortable proposing fixes rather than simply surfacing problems to management.

**Adaptability & Resilience Under Pressure**

* Ability to pivot quickly on customer situations — reworking scope, timelines, or approach mid-project when client needs, priorities, or constraints shift unexpectedly.
* Comfort operating through significant change management within a project (new stakeholders, revised requirements, shifting priorities) with flexibility rather than resistance to the change.
* Proven ability to multitask and stay effective under pressure — juggling competing deadlines, client escalations, and internal priorities without losing quality or composure.
* Willingness and ability to manage through non-ideal or ambiguous situations — messy data, incomplete requirements, tight timelines — rather than waiting for perfect conditions to make progress.

**AI & Technology Fluency (New)**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate day-to-day work — documentation, research, communications, or analysis.
* Comfort working in a human-in-the-loop capacity: reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they go to clients.
* Curiosity and adaptability toward emerging AI-powered workflow and automation tools, with a willingness to experiment and share learnings with the team.
* Basic understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows can be applied to client onboarding, configuration, or reporting tasks (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Azure, Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Prior exposure to no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP) good to have, not required.
* Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher) or equivalent process-improvement certification.
