title: GDS Microsoft Co-Innovation Marketplace Certification Manager - Associate Director - India
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Title: GDS Microsoft Alliance Marketplace Certification Manager / Strategist**
**The opportunity**
Microsoft is one of EY’s most strategic ecosystem relationships, enabling clients to accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. Within this alliance, the Co-Innovation team brings together EY’s industry experience and Microsoft’s technology capabilities to shape scalable, market-relevant solutions that support client transformation, marketplace readiness and growth across global priority markets.
  
  
We are looking for a highly collaborative, commercially minded and execution-oriented Marketplace Certification Manager / Strategist to support the Microsoft Alliance Co-Innovation team globally. This role will help lead and build the marketplace solution readiness, certification and publication lifecycle, strengthen submission governance, guide readiness across priority solutions and enable disciplined execution across the global co-innovation portfolio.
  
  
The role is designed for a senior professional who can connect solution development, certification strategy and commercialization readiness. You will work closely with global alliance leadership, Microsoft stakeholders, regional teams, solution owners, architects, engineering teams, sales, marketing and GDS teams to ensure co-innovation solutions are certification-ready, marketplace-aligned and positioned for scalable activation across markets.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of Microsoft marketplace operations, certification governance, AI-enabled innovation, solution commercialization, stakeholder management and go-to-market execution.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Shape global marketplace certification strategy, governance and operating rhythm**

* Lead and build the structured solution intake, certification and publication lifecycle process for the global Co-Innovation portfolio, providing senior-level visibility into readiness, submissions, review status, risks, dependencies, decisions and publication outcomes.
* Shape certification review meetings, leadership updates, business reviews and marketplace readiness forums with clear, consistent and decision-oriented materials.
* Maintain a structured view of marketplace certification activities across solution stages, submission status, ownership, evidence requirements, remediation actions and publication milestones.
* Drive execution discipline by helping stakeholders track actions, owners, timelines, dependencies and follow-through against agreed certification priorities.
* Identify and advance opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows, automation, reusable templates and structured data capture to accelerate intake, evidence development, certification readiness, publication preparation and reporting.
* Ensure certification decisions and updates are supported by accurate data, clear documentation and well-aligned next steps.

**Define Microsoft marketplace readiness and certification focus**

* Provide strategic guidance on certification readiness for Microsoft-powered solutions across Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud & AI Platforms, Security, data, automation and emerging technology priorities.
* Partner with solution owners, architects and technology stakeholders to capture certification requirements, readiness gaps, technical evidence, client applicability and commercialization considerations.
* Build senior-level visibility into marketplace-ready solution assets, including offer narratives, demos, supporting documentation, solution artifacts, client-zero examples and go-to-market readiness materials.
* Promote responsible AI adoption by ensuring marketplace submissions appropriately consider value, risk, governance, data requirements, privacy, security and adoption needs.
* Translate Microsoft marketplace, certification and technology requirements into business-friendly narratives for global leadership, regional teams, sales and stakeholder groups.

**Strengthen certification compliance, submission quality and technical assurance**

* Lead marketplace certification reviews, submission walkthroughs and operational checkpoints across prioritized global co-innovation initiatives.
* Assess certification readiness across offer positioning, solution scope, technical documentation, security considerations, data flows, implementation approach, support model and customer-facing content.
* Coordinate with alliance, technology, solution, delivery, marketing and commercial teams to maintain visibility across certification decisions, dependencies and required remediation actions.
* Help assess whether solutions are progressing toward intended outcomes, including certification readiness, publication readiness, activation potential, adoption feasibility and global market relevance.
* Prepare concise leadership summaries covering certification status, marketplace risks, remediation needs, required publication decisions and recommended actions.

**Influence global stakeholder alignment and collaboration**

* Serve as a senior connector across global alliance leadership, Microsoft marketplace stakeholders, regional teams, solution owners, architects, engineering teams, service line leaders, sector stakeholders, sales, marketing and GDS support teams.
* Support alignment across business, technology, delivery, marketing and go-to-market stakeholders so global priorities are translated into executable marketplace certification actions.
* Coordinate certification readiness workshops, marketplace forums and leadership check-ins to ensure progress is visible and decision points are clear.
* Proactively identify stakeholder gaps, ownership ambiguities and cross-team dependencies that could affect certification readiness, publication timelines or market activation across regions.
* Build trusted relationships across a matrixed global and regional stakeholder network.

**Shape marketplace reporting, insights and readiness tracking**

* Develop and maintain certification trackers, publication readiness summaries and executive views that provide clear visibility into global co-innovation certification health and progress.
* Monitor key indicators related to certification stage, readiness gaps, submission quality, remediation status, publication progress, asset completeness, activation readiness and business outcomes.
* Analyze trends across certification activities and provide practical recommendations to improve submission quality, governance and go-to-market impact.
* Prepare materials for leadership reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews and other global governance forums.
* Use data and stakeholder input to tell a clear story on where certification activity is progressing well, where support is required and where leadership decisions are needed.

**Advance global marketplace activation readiness and market outcomes**

* Work with sales, marketing, regional and solution teams to support activation planning for certified and marketplace ready co-innovation solutions.
* Track readiness of marketplace and solution assets, including offer descriptions, demos, architecture diagrams, credentials, case studies, sales collateral, enablement materials, marketplace content and client-facing narratives.
* Help identify opportunities to scale successful marketplace-certified Microsoft-powered solutions across priority accounts, sectors, service lines and regions.
* Support coordination of global and region-specific enablement activities so client-facing teams understand the marketplace offer, value proposition, certification status and activation pathway.
* Ensure certification insights and lessons learned are fed back to solution teams to strengthen commercialization, adoption and governance discipline.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
We are looking for someone who brings a strong balance of strategic marketplace judgment, governance discipline, structured execution, stakeholder influence and commercialization mindset. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior stakeholders, interpreting evolving Microsoft marketplace requirements and guiding multiple global solution initiatives while maintaining a practical focus on certification readiness, submission quality and measurable outcomes.
  
  

* Strong experience in marketplace certification strategy, operational governance, reporting and execution management.
* Ability to translate global business priorities and solution requirements into structured certification strategy and marketplace readiness actions.
* Comfort working with AI, cloud, data, automation, Microsoft solution areas and emerging technology themes at a business level.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex certification, marketplace and technical requirements for leadership audiences.
* Ability to influence without authority and build alignment across matrixed alliance, technology, delivery, regional, marketing and commercial teams.
* Strong analytical capability, including experience developing certification trackers, readiness dashboards, marketplace narratives, status summaries and decision papers.
* Practical curiosity about AI-enabled operating models, including how automation, agents, workflow tools and structured knowledge repositories can improve solution intake, certification tracking, evidence management, publication readiness and lifecycle reporting.
* High attention to detail, strong follow-through and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Curiosity, adaptability and a genuine interest in marketplace-led innovation and Microsoft ecosystem growth.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience in marketplace strategy, certification governance, program leadership, alliance operations, technology commercialization, product operations, consulting or strategic operations.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional marketplace, certification or technology commercialization initiatives across regional or global stakeholder groups.
* Experience with governance models, submission tracking, evidence management, certification processes, marketplace readiness reviews and performance management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience preparing executive-ready materials and structured status updates.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, proactively identify certification risks and drive structured follow-through in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience working with technology-enabled transformation, cloud, AI, automation, data or digital solution portfolios.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience supporting global, multi-region or cross-market business priorities.
* Exposure to Microsoft ecosystem programs, including Azure Marketplace, Microsoft AppSource, Azure, Copilot, AI Business Solutions, Cloud & AI Platforms, Security or related solution areas.
* Experience in alliance management, co-sell motions, co-innovation programs, marketplace certification, marketplace offerings or technology partner ecosystems.
* Experience in a Big Four, professional services, consulting or technology-led environment.
* Understanding of solution commercialization, go-to-market activation, marketplace operations, certification governance and innovation lifecycle management.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that will support your career growth.
  
  

* Continuous learning: Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
* Transformative leadership: Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Digital Supply Chain Implementation, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
At A&M GCC, Supply Chain and Manufacturing professionals assist our clients in analyzing manufacturing operations, supply chain and distribution channels, procurement, SG&A operations and Operating model effectiveness for potential value creation opportunities and to help drive them during our client’s ownership. From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of current operations, identify performance improvement opportunities and quantify potential EBITDA improvement areas across plan, source, make and deliver functions
  
  
Our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team under Performance Improvement vertically is growing significantly and hence we are seeking techno-functional experts who can roll up the sleeves and deliver large, complex client engagements, working closely with leadership to identify, design, and implement creative business solutions
  
  
This role involves working closely with clients to identifytheir operations pain points and design & implement digital solutions across Supply chain planning, procurement, manufacturing, and logistics functions. Individuals should be able to translate business requirements into the right solution and map those with the vendor’sCOTS functionalities along with required customizations for end-to-end digital transformation programs (Design, Build/Configure, Test, Go Live and Hypercare)
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
As Manager for Digital supply chain at A&M GCC PI team, you will contribute across the key areas below:
  
  
**Supply Chain Solutions Design & Implementation**

* Evaluate supply chain technologies, platforms, and solution providers and support the development of fit-for-purpose solution architectures and implementation roadmaps
* Define end-to-end digital supply chain strategy, roadmap and target operating model across ERP, planning, procurement, MES, WMS and TMS
* Define and validate data architecture, governance, cloud hosting and API/integration architecture across supply chain platforms
* Conduct “As-is” Assessment for gap analysis to design “To-be” state organization
* Translate business needs into functional & Technical specs and configure processes
* Create Design specifications for planning, procurement, production, Order management, Logistics, distribution
* Support end-to-end ERP implementation life cycle across supply chain modules (e.g., MM, PP, SD, WM, APO/IBP)
* Experience in integration with existing enterprise systems through APIs, middleware, cloud platforms, and cross-functional business process workflows
* Build RICEFW templates as per design specifications to support the solution
* Work with platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, Blue Yonder, SAP IBP, Coupa, SAP Ariba, Tulip, IRIS/MES, SAP EWM/TM etc.

**Testing & Deployment**

* Own the end-to-end implementation lifecycle from requirements through configuration, integration, testing, go-live and post-go-live stabilization
* Design and execute test scenarios: Unit Testing, Integration Testing, UAT
* Assist to validate configurations through business scenarios
* Support data migration, cut-over planning, go-live and hyper-care activities
* Collaborate with IT to troubleshoot and resolve issues post-deployment
* Project Management to track the issues through MS Project and JIRA

**Change Management & Training**

* Prepare SOPs, training materials, and user manuals; drive business-user adoption
* Support role – based user training sessions and drive functional adoption
* Conduct process workshops and knowledge-transfer sessions to build functional capabilities
* Highlight change impacts and ensure user readiness

**Continuous Improvement & Enhancements**

* Identify post-implementation improvements and process automation opportunities
* Support digital supply chain reporting needs (MPS, inventory, OTIF, cycle time etc.)
* Assist in system upgrades and rollouts across new plants or warehouses
* Evaluate emerging technologies like generative AI, Agentic AI and continuously enhance digital solutions through automation and process optimization

**Client Delivery & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead day-to-day project workstreams and contribute to overall project delivery
* Prepare executive-ready presentations, reports, and recommendations
* Facilitate client discussions, workshops, and stakeholder engagements

**Firm & Practice Contribution**

* Develop thought leadership, industry perspectives, benchmarks, and reusable tools / frameworks to strengthen the firm's Digital Supply Chain proposition
* Contribute to proposal development and business development activities
* Support internal knowledge development and training initiatives

**Qualifications**

* 6-11 years of experience in digital supply chain transformation, supply chain planning, logistics, operations excellence, or digital supply chain technology implementation programs
* Previous advisory and consulting experience from a top-tier strategy firm, leading specialist / niche advisory firm, or Big-4 consultancy preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, logistics, supply chain, manufacturing or a related field
* MBA / master’s degree in supply chain & Operations, Logistics, Business Administration, or similar discipline
* Strong functional knowledge across the end-to-end supply chain, including demand & supply planning, manufacturing, procurement, production scheduling, inventory, logistics, distribution, and order fulfilment
* Strong knowledge of supply chain operating models, process re-engineering, business process mapping, and target-state design
* Experience supporting or leading implementation of supply chain planning, logistics, warehouse management (WMS), transportation management (TMS), procurement, or manufacturing execution solutions (MES)
* Familiarity with enterprise data models, cloud platform architectures, data migration lifecycle, API/integration frameworks, and business process integration across supply chain functions
* Hands-on experience with ERP and supply chain platforms such as SAP ECC/S4HANA, SAP IBP, SAP EWM/TM, Oracle SCM Cloud, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, Microsoft Dynamics, o9, WMS / TMS or similar solutions
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills with the ability to drive adoption across business and technology teams
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and coordination skills in dynamic, operationally complex environments
* Experience in managing cross-functional stakeholders during implementations
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and root-cause problem-solving skills
* Exposure to AI/ML-powered supply chain solutions, generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision intelligence platforms, would be a plus
* Tools knowledge on Alteryx, Power BI, python, Linear programming platforms, etc. would be a plus

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. title: Founder's Office - Operations Lead
description:
Founder's Office – Operations Lead

Location: Noida (on-site, 6 days a week) · Experience: 5–8 years · Reports to: CEO / Founders

**The role:**

SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Lead in the Founder's Office. You will work directly with the founders to find the problems that slow our business down, design practical solutions, and put them into practice on the ground, across a mapping operation of 120+ cartographers serving customers in the US and Canada.

This is not an advisory role. You will spot a problem in the data or on the floor, work out the fix, get Team Leads, Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Sales behind it, roll it out, and prove with numbers that it worked. Then you will move to the next one.

This role suits someone who thinks like a problem-solver, executes like an operator, and knows how to bring people along through change.

About SiteRecon

SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech.

Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

**What you'll do:**

Find the problems that matter

* Dig into operations data, customer escalations and floor-level workflows to find what is hurting delivery, quality, cost or customer experience.
* Separate symptoms from root causes, size each problem by business impact, and agree priorities with the founders.
* Track the metrics that show where operations are slipping: productivity, TAT, SLA adherence, rework, backlog and capacity.

**Design and implement solutions**

* Turn each problem into a clear solution with an owner, a plan, a timeline and a success metric.
* Pilot changes with one team or shift, measure the results, and scale what works across the operation.
* Redesign SOPs, quality checks, workflows and team structures where needed, and make sure they hold on the floor after launch.

**Lead technology and process change**

* Work with Product and Engineering to define tool and workflow improvements for mapping and QA, and own their rollout to the floor.
* Identify manual, repetitive work that can be automated or simplified, and drive it through to implementation.
* Make sure operations can absorb significant growth in volume without the same growth in headcount or complexity.

**Drive change management**

* Win buy-in from Team Leads, QA Supervisors and cartographers for new ways of working, and handle resistance with clarity and patience.
* Plan communication, training and handholding for every change so adoption sticks across shifts.
* Align Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on changes that affect customers, delivery timelines or capacity.

**Track and report improvements**

* Build a simple tracker of every initiative: baseline, target, current result and owner.
* Set up daily, weekly and monthly dashboards that show the impact of changes on operational KPIs.
* Run regular reviews with the founders on what has improved, what has stalled, and what comes next.

Support the founders

* Take on high-priority operational projects directly from the founders, from capacity planning for a large new customer to setting up a new team or process.
* Act as the bridge between the founders' priorities and day-to-day execution on the floor.

**You must have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in operations excellence, process improvement, business transformation, founder's office or strategy-to-execution roles.
* Hands-on exposure to large, metrics-driven operations, such as GIS or mapping, data annotation, KPO, BPO or digital operations.
* A track record of finding a business problem, designing the solution and implementing it yourself, with measurable results you can show.
* Experience leading a technology or tool rollout with Product or Engineering teams and getting it adopted by the people who use it.
* Strong change-management and people skills. You can influence Team Leads and floor teams without direct authority.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You build your own analysis, trackers and dashboards.
* Clear, structured communication with founders, cross-functional teams and frontline staff.

**Good to have**

* Lean, Six Sigma or similar continuous-improvement training.
* Experience at a startup, SaaS or product company.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Job description:**

Marketing Manager

**Location:** Sovabazar, Kolkata

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 4+ years preferred

**About IND:**

The Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND) is a mission-driven organisation working to transform the developmental journeys of children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences.

Our work spans child development, parent education, assessments, therapy, research, digital education, community engagement, professional training and other initiatives aimed at improving outcomes for children and their families.

As IND grows, we are building a strong marketing function that can understand our audiences deeply, build trust, communicate our value effectively, create demand for our programmes and services, and establish IND as a trusted and differentiated organisation.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a Marketing Manager who fundamentally understands marketing, rather than someone who is primarily a salesperson or a digital-platform operator.

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies across both online and offline channels.

**The role requires a strong understanding of-**

i) customer psychology, market positioning, segmentation, value propositions, brand building, demand generation, content marketing, campaign development, customer journeys and conversion funnels.

ii) Digital channels will form an important part of the role, but technology and platforms are means of executing marketing strategy, not substitutes for marketing thinking.

iii) The ideal candidate should be able to understand an audience, identify what matters to them, formulate the right proposition and message, develop campaigns around those insights, coordinate execution across teams and measure whether the marketing is actually producing meaningful outcomes.

iv) This is a hands-on leadership role. The candidate should be capable of developing strategy while also getting into the details required to make it work.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Marketing Strategy**

Develop and execute marketing strategies for IND's various offerings, including:

\* Consultations

\* Assessments

\* Webinars

\* Bootcamps

\* Parent programmes

\* Therapy and developmental services

\* Educational programmes

\* Professional training

\* Publications

\* New products and services as they are developed

For each offering, determine:

\* Target audience

\* Audience segment

\* Customer need

\* Market opportunity

\* Positioning

\* Value proposition

\* Core message

\* Offer structure

\* Customer journey

\* Appropriate channels

\* Campaign approach

\* Measurement framework

**2. Audience & Consumer Understanding**

Develop a deep understanding of IND's audiences, particularly parents and families.

Understand:

\* Their existing beliefs

\* Their concerns and fears

\* Their aspirations

\* Their unmet needs

\* Their information-seeking behaviour

\* Their objections

\* Their decision-making process

\* Their trust barriers

\* What motivates them to act

\* What prevents them from acting

Translate these insights into practical marketing strategies and campaigns.

**3. Positioning & Messaging**

Develop and refine the positioning of IND and its individual offerings.

The candidate will work on:

\* Brand positioning

\* Product and programme positioning

\* Value propositions

\* Campaign messages

\* Communication themes

\* Differentiators

\* Offers

\* Calls to action

The objective is to communicate clearly why IND's approach, programmes or services are relevant and valuable to the intended audience.

All communication should remain responsible, evidence-informed and appropriate to the sensitive nature of our work with children and families.

**4. Campaign Development**

Conceptualise, develop and lead marketing campaigns from beginning to end.

A typical campaign may involve:

Audience insight

→ Marketing objective

→ Campaign concept

→ Positioning & message

→ Content & creative

→ Distribution

→ Lead capture

→ Nurturing

→ Conversion

→ Measurement & learning

The Marketing Manager should be capable of owning this entire chain and coordinating the specialists responsible for individual components.

**5. Content Marketing**

Work closely with the Storyteller/Scriptwriter, Content & Creative team and other content contributors to develop:

\* Content pillars

\* Editorial themes

\* Educational content

\* Awareness campaigns

\* Parent education content

\* Thought leadership

\* Long-form content

\* Short-form content

\* Video campaigns

\* Podcast-related content

\* Webinar content

\* Lead magnets

\* Campaign-specific content

The candidate should be able to distinguish between content that generates attention and content that contributes meaningfully to marketing objectives.

**6. Digital Marketing**

Lead the marketing strategy across relevant digital channels, including:

\* Search

\* Social media

\* YouTube

\* Email

\* WhatsApp

\* Websites and landing pages

\* CRM

\* Online communities

\* Digital advertising

The candidate should understand platforms such as Meta and Google and be able to evaluate their effectiveness.

They do not necessarily need to personally execute every technical aspect of every campaign, but they must understand how digital channels fit into the broader marketing system.

**7. Demand & Lead Generation**

Develop systems for generating qualified demand through:

\* Organic content

\* Paid campaigns

\* Search

\* Referrals

\* Partnerships

\* Webinars

\* Events

\* Communities

\* Email

\* WhatsApp

\* Existing parent and professional networks

\* Other relevant channels

Work closely with the Digital Growth Manager to improve the quantity and quality of demand generated.

The focus should be on qualified prospects and meaningful business outcomes rather than lead volume alone.

**8. Customer Journey & Funnel Development**

Map and continuously improve the customer journey:

Awareness

→ Interest

→ Engagement

→ Lead

→ Trust Building

→ Consultation / Webinar / Assessment

→ Programme / Service

→ Retention

→ Referral

Identify points at which prospective clients lose interest or fail to progress and determine what marketing intervention may improve the journey.

**9. Marketing & Sales Alignment**

Work closely with the Sales and Community Engagement teams to understand:

\* Lead quality

\* Common objections

\* Reasons for non-conversion

\* Customer feedback

\* Competitive alternatives

\* Pricing concerns

\* Messaging gaps

\* Reasons for withdrawal or drop-off

Use these insights to continuously improve marketing.

The Marketing Manager is not primarily a salesperson, but must understand how marketing ultimately influences customer decisions.

**10. Brand Development**

Contribute to building IND as a trusted and differentiated brand among:

\* Parents and families

\* Professionals

\* Educators

\* Schools

\* Healthcare professionals

\* Organisations

\* Researchers

\* The wider public

Maintain consistency in:

\* Positioning

\* Brand voice

\* Communication

\* Visual identity

\* Public messaging

**11. Marketing Analytics & ROI**

Measure marketing based on meaningful outcomes rather than vanity metrics.

Track and analyse, as applicable:

\* Qualified leads

\* Cost per qualified lead

\* Lead-to-consultation conversion

\* Consultation-to-programme conversion

\* Customer acquisition cost

\* Marketing-attributed revenue

\* Campaign ROI

\* Channel contribution

\* Organic demand

\* Referral contribution

\* Audience growth

\* Engagement quality

The Marketing Manager should continuously ask:

> Are we reaching the right people, with the right message, through the right channel, at the right point in their journey?

**12. Team & Partner Management**

Provide marketing direction and coordinate with:

\* Digital Growth Manager

\* Content & Creative team

\* Storytellers and Scriptwriters

\* Community Engagement team

\* Sales team

\* Designers

\* Video editors

\* External agencies

\* Freelancers

\* Other marketing partners

The Marketing Manager should establish the marketing direction and priorities, while ensuring that specialists have the clarity and resources required for execution.

**What We Are Looking For-**

We are looking for someone who:

\* Is genuinely passionate about marketing.

\* Thinks deeply about customers and consumer behaviour.

\* Understands marketing beyond digital platforms.

\* Enjoys figuring out why people make decisions.

\* Can develop positioning and value propositions.

\* Can turn audience insights into campaigns.

\* Understands both brand and performance marketing.

\* Can connect marketing activity to business outcomes.

\* Is comfortable working across online and offline channels.

\* Can lead specialists while remaining hands-on.

\* Is comfortable testing ideas and learning from results.

\* Has strong analytical and strategic thinking.

\* Can work in an evolving organisation where the marketing system is still being built.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not primarily:

\* A Business Development role

\* A Sales role

\* A Telecalling role

\* A Performance Marketing-only role

\* A Social Media Manager role

\* An Ads Operations role

Someone who can operate Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads but cannot explain the target customer, customer motivation, positioning, value proposition and campaign logic would not be considered a strong fit.

Similarly, someone whose primary experience is outbound sales or lead conversion should not be considered a marketing candidate merely because their previous designation was "Business Development Executive".

**Required Experience-**

\* Minimum 4 years of relevant marketing experience preferred.

\* Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing campaigns.

\* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and customer psychology.

\* Experience with content marketing.

\* Experience with digital marketing channels.

\* Understanding of lead generation and conversion funnels.

\* Experience analysing marketing performance.

\* Experience coordinating teams, agencies or external partners.

\* Demonstrated ability to take a marketing initiative from concept to execution.

**Preferred Background-**

Candidates with experience in the following environments may be particularly relevant:

\* Consumer marketing

\* FMCG

\* D2C

\* Healthcare

\* Education

\* Advertising

\* Brand management

\* Consumer Internet

\* EdTech

\* HealthTech

\* Media

Experience in healthcare, child development, education or parent-focused businesses will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

**Key Competencies-**

* Marketing Thinking
* Ability to understand markets, customers, positioning and demand.
* Consumer Psychology
* Ability to understand why people notice, trust, engage and make decisions.
* Strategic Thinking
* Ability to translate business objectives into marketing strategy.
* Creativity
* Ability to develop differentiated ideas rather than simply replicate competitors.
* Analytical Thinking
* Ability to use data and evidence to improve marketing decisions.
* Digital Fluency
* Strong understanding of modern digital channels without confusing technology with marketing.
* Execution
* Ability to convert strategy into actual campaigns and measurable outcomes.
* Leadership
* Ability to direct and coordinate specialists and external partners.
* Experimentation
* Willingness to test hypotheses, learn from results and change course when required.
* Ownership
* Ability to take responsibility for marketing outcomes rather than merely completing assigned activities.

**Key Performance Indicators-**

The Marketing Manager will be evaluated on:

i) Marketing Effectiveness

\* Qualified demand generated

\* Marketing-attributed conversions

\* Cost per qualified lead

\* Lead-to-consultation conversion

\* Consultation-to-programme conversion

\* Marketing ROI

ii) Brand & Demand

\* Growth of relevant audience

\* Organic demand

\* Quality of engagement

\* Direct enquiries

\* Referral contribution

\* Brand reach among relevant audiences

iii) campaign Performance

\* Campaigns delivered against agreed objectives

\* Campaign performance against targets

\* Conversion-rate improvement

\* Number and quality of marketing experiments

\* Learning incorporated into subsequent campaigns

iv) Strategic Contribution

\* Quality of marketing strategy

\* Clarity of positioning

\* Effectiveness of campaigns

\* Quality of customer insights

\* Improvement in the overall marketing funnel

v) Growth Opportunity

The role offers significant scope for growth as IND's marketing function develops.

Potential progression:

Marketing Manager

↓

Senior Marketing Manager

↓

Head of Marketing

↓

Chief Marketing Officer

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to help build the marketing function itself, rather than simply operate within an already-established marketing department.

**Why Join IND?**

You will have the opportunity to build marketing for an organisation working on a meaningful problem affecting children and families.

You will work at the intersection of:

Marketing + Consumer Psychology + Healthcare + Education + Content + Digital + Community + Emerging Technology

The role offers considerable scope for experimentation, ownership and professional growth while contributing to a mission-driven organisation.

**Application Requirements-**

Please submit:

\* Updated Resume

\* Portfolio or examples of marketing campaigns you have personally worked on

\* Details of 2-3 significant marketing initiatives you have led or contributed to

\* Brief description of your specific contribution to each initiative

\* Relevant campaign results, where available

For queries regarding the position or application process, please contact the HR Team at 9147711360/9073442666

**Benefits:**

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

**Work Location:** In person

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Growth Associate
description:
**Growth Associate**

Help CricHeroes Store grow by understanding users, discovering opportunities, and turning insights into action.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a curious and proactive Growth Associate who enjoys talking to users, understanding their behaviour, and testing ideas to improve their experience. You’ll work across user research, feedback collection, growth experiments, and campaign execution to help CricHeroes Store grow.

**The Challenge**

Growth starts with understanding users. You’ll connect with cricketers, uncover their needs and pain points, test new ideas, and help turn user insights into meaningful improvements for CricHeroes Store.

**What You’ll Do**

**User Discovery & Insights**

• Call users and conduct interviews to understand their buying behaviour, needs, and expectations.

• Collect feedback, testimonials, and product reviews.

• Document user insights and identify patterns that can help improve the product and user experience.

**Growth Experiments**

• Run small scale experiments to test ideas and improve user engagement and conversions.

• Support A/B tests and behavioural experiments using internal tools.

• Track results, identify learnings, and suggest improvements.

**Campaigns & Coordination**

• Coordinate with designers and developers to execute the experiments end-to-end.

• Coordinate with the marketing team to provide insights which can help them run better campaigns for stores.

**Reporting & Process Ownership**

• Maintain an experiment calendar and track success metrics.

• Combine user feedback with basic data to identify trends and opportunities.

• Share insights and recommendations with the Growth Lead and product team.

**What We’re Looking For**

• 6 months to 2 years of experience in growth, user research, customer success, or a similar role.

• Strong communication skills and comfort with calling users.

• Ability to ask the right questions, listen actively, and understand user needs.

• Basic understanding of data, tracking, and reporting.

• Good writing skills for user communication and campaigns.

• Strong coordination, ownership, and follow through.

• Creative thinking with a structured approach to execution.

• Familiarity with tools like Clarity, Firebase, Mixpanel, or similar platforms is a plus.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role?**

Someone who is curious about user behaviour, enjoys talking to people, takes ownership, and likes combining creativity with data. You should be comfortable managing multiple initiatives and excited about cricket, products, and growth.

**About CricHeroes**

CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network with 40+ million users worldwide. We help grassroots cricketers showcase their talent, gain recognition, and improve their game through data and technology.

We believe in fewer rules, more ownership, and loads of candour. You’ll join a young, collaborative team that loves building products that make grassroots cricket unforgettable.

**Ready to help CricHeroes Store grow?**

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today’s data-rich world.
  
  
ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Director of Operations serves as a force multiplier who ensures that the technology organization executes with clarity, alignment, and urgency. Acting as Chief of Staff, this leader drives cross-functional workstreams, translates the CTO's strategic priorities into actionable plans, and holds the organization accountable to outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor and organizational leader role for someone with exceptional operational acumen, executive presence, and a systems-thinking mindset.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Strategic Planning & Prioritization: Partner with the CTO to define quarterly and annual priorities; translate strategy into roadmaps and OKRs that the technology organization can execute against.
* Workstream & Portfolio Oversight: Maintain a master view of all technology workstreams; identify bottlenecks, dependencies, and risks; escalate proactively and remove blockers.
* Operating Cadence: Design and lead the CTO's operating rhythm — weekly leadership team meetings, monthly business reviews, quarterly planning cycles, and all-hands meetings.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Own cross-functional initiatives that span engineering, product, data, security, and business teams on behalf of the CTO.
* Executive Communications: Prepare executive-level communications including board materials, investor briefings, and internal strategy memos.
* CTO Proxy: Act as a trusted proxy for the CTO in internal meetings when appropriate; represent the CTO's perspective with authority and accuracy.
* Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement of team operating processes, tools, and norms across the technology organization

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in technology strategy, operations, consulting, or program leadership
* Proven ability to drive large, complex cross-functional initiatives from planning through delivery.
* Experience in healthcare IT, SaaS, or regulated technology environments strongly preferred.
* Exceptional executive communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with the ability to influence at the C-suite level.
* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with data, metrics, powerpoint presentations and building business cases.
* High EQ and political acumen; skilled at building relationships and navigating organizational dynamics.
* Familiarity with Agile, OKR frameworks, and enterprise program management practices.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree in a relevant field preferred.

For more information on our company, visit www.ELLKAY.com.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About ENEG Mobility**

ENEG Mobility is building an electric car for Shared Mobility. Engineered for cost efficiency, reliability & to fuel the mass adoption of EVs.

The company is currently in its earliest stage, working on government partnerships, OEM/fleet conversations, supplier ecosystem building, factory planning, and strategic fundraising.

This will be one of the first few core team hires and will work directly with the Founder across every important function of the company.

**About The Role**

The Founder's Office hire will be the Founder’s execution partner across strategy, business development, government relations, investor communication, operations, and company-building.

This is not a narrow desk role. You will help convert a large vision into structured execution — from preparing government proposals and investor decks to managing partner conversations, tracking factory planning, building financial models, and coordinating with suppliers, consultants, legal advisors, and potential customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**1. Founder Support & Strategic Execution**

Work directly with the Founder on the highest-priority initiatives of the company. Convert ideas, discussions, and strategy into clear documents, action plans, timelines, and execution trackers.

**2. Government & Policy Work**

Support communication with the Gujarat Government, industrial bodies, policy consultants, and ecosystem stakeholders. Help prepare MoU proposals, land requirement briefs, incentive analysis, subsidy applications, and policy comparison documents.

**3. Business Development**

Assist in identifying and approaching OEMs, fleet operators, component suppliers, battery companies, technology partners, and potential strategic investors. Prepare pitch decks, meeting notes, follow-ups, and partnership proposals.

**4. Factory & Project Planning**

Help coordinate early-stage factory planning for a greenfield EV assembly facility, including land requirements, supplier mapping, capex planning, vendor shortlisting, timelines, and consultant coordination.

**5. Research & Market Intelligence**

Conduct deep research on EV manufacturing, battery supply chains, contract manufacturing models, government incentives, fleet economics, ride-hailing EV demand, and competitor strategies in India and globally.

**6. Investor & Fundraising Support**

Prepare investor materials, financial projections, business plans, market sizing, unit economics, and update documents. Maintain clean data rooms, trackers, and investor follow-up systems.

**7. Internal Systems & Operations**

Set up early company operating systems — task trackers, meeting notes, CRM sheets, vendor databases, document repositories, dashboards, and reporting formats.

title: Client Experience Program Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Discipline**
Client Experience
  
  
**Role Type**
CX Program Lead
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for CX Program Lead – Supervising Associate who can oversee Client Experience program within the Region. The focus is on embedding regular, robust client feedback that delivers insights that results in executed actions across the client life cycle to continually improve the experience for our clients. Build strong relationships with leadership and work with account teams to embed client experience into Account management activities. Equip our client serving teams with a continuous improvement mindset and the capability to conduct highly effective CXM (ASQ)/CXE (ESQ) and WLRs. Provide regular ‘voice of the client’ insight to leadership which will assist development of go-to market strategies, minimize the risk of client losses, and maximize revenue growth opportunities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide quality service delivery, maintaining the focus on exceptional client service through quality management and operational rigor
* Manage workload and work under minimal supervision and prioritize tasks effectively
* Become a subject matter expert and go to person on CX program and tools/systems
* Develops relationships with business teams in the Region to embed client feedback
* Responsible for driving increased feedback and high-quality feedback across account portfolio
* Monitors trends and insights from Client feedback and shares best practice with CX leadership
* Provides regular ‘voice of the client’ reporting to leadership which will assist development of go-to market strategies, minimize the risk of client losses, and maximize revenue growth opportunities
* Drive innovation, automation and process streamlining of with strong focus on building efficiencies with Region’s requirements in mind
* Ensure compliance with the KPIs, SLAs and Region priorities

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Demonstrated success in building internal and external relationships at a senior level with a proven track record of success in business development and client interactions.
* Establishes procedures to monitor the progress of the client relationship and ability to address any concerns about satisfaction.
* Makes stakeholders and their needs a primary focus; initiates, builds and sustains productive relationships resulting in delivering quality service and client satisfaction
* Ability to identify and resolve complex problems with creative solutions
* Excellent project management, interpersonal and team building skills
* Strong executive presence (perceived as equal in status to CEO/CFO)
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills
* Ability to provide constructive criticism and coaching
* Ability to coordinate multiple complex initiatives at any time
* Excellent logic and thinking capabilities with an ability to understand, source, and profile data.
* Client Interviewing skills (good to have)
* Strong influencing skills are required to work with other departments or Business Unit Leaders
* Expert hands-on experience on data visualization tools – PowerBI, MS Excel, PPT, etc
* Excellent oral & written communication
* Prior knowledge on generating insights
* Market research preferred
* Excellent in Project management

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* University/Master’s degree
* Approximately 8+ years plus of previous customer experience, program management, consulting or marketing experience
* Experience managing complex client relationships
* Worked in a large Global organization
* Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* This role might expect to also interface with C-level executives at EY clients through client feedback interviews. Must have commercial mindset and the ability to influence and drive change in the behaviours needed to enhance client interactions.
* This position is responsible for setting and accomplishing Regional goals related to Client experience, with a focus on effective penetration of accounts and sufficient quality of feedback to drive action that improves client experience. The individual shall work with account teams to drive consistent adoption and activate accounts to establish and execute strategic client experience plans.
* Strategic leader with client facing experience. Must be able to make decisions and overcome obstacles with minimal supervision. This person must have strong influencing skills to work with business teams.

**Technologies and Tools**

* Expert hands-on of data visualization tools like PowerBI, MS Excel, PPT, etc
* Exposure to data visualization tools like Tableu, Qualtrics will be preferred.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

Designation: Assistant General Manager (AGM) – Sales & Marketing Department: Sales and Marketing Reporting To: General Manager / CEO / Managing Director Industry: Solar Energy, Solar Distribution and Renewable Energy Experience: Extensive experience in the solar sector, with a proven track record in sales, marketing, dealer development, and team leadership.

Job Objective

To lead and strengthen the company's sales and marketing operations in the solar energy sector by expanding market presence, developing dealer and distributor networks, achieving sales targets, improving profitability, and driving sustainable business growth across assigned territories.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. Sales Strategy and Business Development

\* Set individual and team sales targets and monitor performance.

\* Conduct regular sales review meetings and performance evaluations.

\* Recruit, train, motivate, and develop the sales team.

\* Ensure effective coordination between sales, marketing, purchase, logistics, and technical departments.

D. Marketing and Brand Development

\* Plan and execute marketing campaigns to improve brand visibility and product sales.

\* Coordinate digital marketing, social media promotions, exhibitions, dealer meetings, and customer awareness programmes.

\* Develop promotional strategies, product presentations, and sales materials.

\* Analyse competitor activities, pricing, market demand, and emerging solar industry trends.

\* Strengthen the company's brand presence in the renewable energy market.

E. Revenue, Profitability and Collections

\* Achieve sales revenue and gross profit targets.

\* Monitor product-wise margins, discounts, sales incentives, and promotional expenses.

\* Coordinate with the finance department to ensure timely dealer payments and customer collections.

\* Monitor outstanding balances and control credit risks in coordination with management.

\* Recommend strategies to improve profitability and reduce sales-related costs.

F. Solar Industry Expertise

\* Maintain a strong understanding of solar products, system configurations, applications, and market requirements.

\* Understand on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar systems and their commercial applications.

\* Coordinate with technical teams regarding product selection, quotations, project proposals, and customer requirements.

\* Maintain awareness of applicable MNRE schemes, government subsidies, and relevant solar policies.

\* Support the team in identifying solar project opportunities and developing institutional and commercial customers.

G. Reporting and Business Analysis

\* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.

\* Prepare territory-wise sales forecasts and market development reports.

\* Analyse sales conversion rates, dealer productivity, and target achievement.

\* Report market feedback, competitor pricing, and customer requirements to management.

\* Recommend corrective actions to address underperformance and improve business results.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.

\* Growth in revenue and gross profit.

\* Number of new dealers and distributors appointed.

\* Dealer productivity and territory coverage.

\* Sales team target achievement.

\* Timely collection of outstanding payments.

\* Improvement in market share and brand visibility.

\* Successful launch and promotion of new products.

\* Customer satisfaction and retention.

Qualifications and Experience

\* Experience in Solar Sector as advantage

\* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; MBA in Marketing is an advantage.

\* Significant experience in sales and marketing, preferably in the solar energy or renewable energy industry.

\* Proven experience managing sales teams, dealer networks, and regional or multi-state sales operations.

\* Strong knowledge of solar products, distribution channels, market development, and commercial negotiations.

\* Experience in target setting, sales forecasting, profitability analysis, and MIS reporting.

\* Proficiency in MS Excel, CRM software, and sales reporting systems.

Required Competencies

\* Strong leadership and team-building capabilities.

\* Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.

\* Strategic thinking and business development expertise.

\* Ability to achieve targets in a competitive market.

\* Strong dealer relationship management and problem-solving skills.

\* Willingness to travel for dealer development, market visits, and business expansion.

Authority and Accountability

The AGM – Sales & Marketing shall be accountable for the performance of the assigned sales territories and teams, achievement of business targets, dealer network expansion, marketing effectiveness, and profitable sales growth. Pricing exceptions, credit approvals, major dealer appointments, and exceptional incentive commitments shall be subject to management approval.

Overall Expectation

The AGM must function as a business leader who can independently manage sales operations, develop new markets, strengthen the dealer network, lead the sales team, and contribute directly to the company's growth and profitability in the solar industry.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
About Publicis Production

Publicis Production is a global production platform within Publicis Groupe, enabling brands to deliver high-quality creative and digital content at scale. We bring together creativity, technology, production expertise, and operational excellence to deliver efficient, consistent, and impactful brand experiences across channels.

Role Purpose

The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end project delivery across creative, digital, and content production. The role requires strong project governance, planning, resource management, stakeholder coordination, and delivery oversight to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with quality standards and client expectations.

The individual will work closely with creative, production, operations, technology, quality, and client-facing teams to drive seamless execution, manage risks, and continuously improve delivery processes.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Project Delivery

* Own projects from initiation and planning through execution, quality checks, delivery, and closure.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.
* Ensure all project outputs meet agreed scope, quality standards, and client requirements.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, resolve bottlenecks, and manage changes in scope and priorities.

2. Project Governance and Reporting

* Establish and maintain robust project governance frameworks, review mechanisms, and escalation processes.
* Track project progress against agreed timelines, budgets, resource plans, and delivery milestones.
* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and management updates for senior stakeholders.
* Monitor key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, productivity, quality, resource utilisation, and project profitability.
* Maintain project documentation, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies), action trackers, and decision logs.

3. Stakeholder and Client Management

* Act as the central point of coordination between internal teams, clients, and external partners.
* Manage stakeholder expectations through clear communication, regular reviews, and transparent reporting.
* Lead project kick-offs, status meetings, governance reviews, and post-project evaluations.
* Translate client briefs into actionable plans, ensuring clarity on scope, timelines, priorities, and deliverables.
* Manage escalations effectively and drive timely resolution of issues.

4. Creative and Digital Production Management

* Manage projects involving creative adaptation, digital content, design, video, artwork, campaign assets, and other production deliverables, as applicable.
* Coordinate creative, production, quality assurance, technology, and operations teams to ensure smooth workflow execution.
* Ensure briefs, assets, feedback, and approvals move efficiently through the production lifecycle.
* Monitor revisions, rework, approval cycles, and delivery dependencies to minimise delays.
* Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, production specifications, quality standards, and client-specific requirements.

5. Resource and Financial Management

* Work with resource managers and functional leads to plan capacity, allocate resources, and balance workloads.
* Track project budgets, estimates, actuals, and resource utilisation.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, optimise costs, and enhance delivery efficiency.
* Support forecasting, financial reporting, invoicing milestones, and profitability tracking, where applicable.
* Manage third-party vendors and production partners when required.

6. Process Improvement and Operational Excellence

* Identify gaps in existing workflows and implement process improvements to enhance speed, quality, and consistency.
* Standardise project management practices, templates, reporting, and governance processes.

title: Technical Programme Manager (Cyber).
description:
**About the role**
Technical Programme Managers (TPMs) deliver complex, cross functional technology programmes that support colleagues and help serve our customers better. In this role, you will operate as a Cyber Programme Manager, leading the delivery of high-impact cyber security initiatives across Tesco’s organisation.
  
You will work across multiple Cyber domains, partnering with security engineering, operations, product and infrastructure teams to translate cyber strategy into delivered, measurable outcomes. While you may align to a specific domain, you will be expected to flex and support broader Cyber priorities where business needs require.
  
This role requires hands on experience managing cyber delivery, navigating complex technical and organisational dependencies, operating confidently in environments shaped by risk, threat context and regulatory expectations.
  
  
**You will be responsible for**
While responsibilities will evolve with business needs, the core accountabilities include:
  
• Deliver complex cyber security programmes with multiple technical, operational and risk dependencies that directly improve Tesco’s security posture and business resilience.• Lead cross functional initiatives spanning Cyber, Technology, Product and operational teams.• Translate cyber strategy, risk priorities and security objectives into clear programme outcomes, milestones and measurable value.• Shape and lead programmes with evolving scope, emerging threats, and uncertain delivery paths.• Establish and continuously improve delivery approaches suited to cyber environments (combining agile, iterative and structured delivery models where appropriate).• Create, own and maintain integrated delivery plans covering technical implementation, operational readiness and change impacts.• Act as the central point of coordination across Cyber teams, Product, Engineering, and Operations.• Proactively identify delivery risks and issues, facilitate informed trade off discussions, and manage escalations with clarity and confidence.• Understand cyber and security architectures sufficiently to anticipate dependency, sequencing, and integration risks.• Support planning cycles, financial forecasting and budget management for cyber programmes.• Build strong relationships with stakeholders, suppliers, and partners, holding them accountable for delivery outcomes.• Support vendor selection and management activities, including tendering, SLAs, and delivery assurance.• Contribute to the wider TPM and Cyber delivery community, sharing good practice and continuously raising the bar for programme execution.Your role is to enable and accelerate delivery, ensuring complex cyber initiatives are well sequenced, outcomes focused, and sustainably embedded.
  
  
  
  
**You will need**
An ideal candidate will demonstrate the following experience and skills:
  
Essential• Proven experience managing cyber security delivery, programmes or portfolios within a Cyber, Security or Technology Risk environment.• Strong track record delivering complex technology or security initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.• Excellent programme, project, and stakeholder management capability, including senior leadership engagement.• Experience operating in environments shaped by cyber risk, threat context, or regulatory obligations.• Ability to understand and navigate cyber and security architectures well enough to manage dependencies and delivery risk.• Strong reporting, planning, and financial forecasting skills.• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear delivery narratives.Desirable• Experience working with a range of Cyber domains (e.g. Identity & Access Management, Cloud Security, Threat Detection, Security Engineering).• Familiarity with threat informed defence, detection led security, or risk-based prioritisation approaches.• Experience delivering programmes that involve security tooling, automation, or platform integration.
  
Why This RoleThis is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering Tesco’s cyber security outcomes. You will work at the intersection of strategy, intelligence, engineering, and operations helping ensure that cyber initiatives are not only well designed, but successfully delivered and embedded where it matters most.
  
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**

**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**

**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. title: Lead - Everest engine production
description:
**About Astrobase Space Technologies**
Astrobase Space Technologies is an early-stage Bengaluru company building a two-stage orbital launch vehicle. Our engine is a LOX–methane full-flow staged-combustion engine. The Astrobase Propulsion team is looking for experienced and passionate professionals who turn engine plans into flight engines delivered on time and within budget.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the engine integrated master schedule, from long-lead orders through acceptance firing to delivery to the stage team; re-baseline it when plans change.
* Keep the critical path and a six-week look-ahead in front of every team lead, and step in early when a task starts to slip.
* Build the work breakdown and budget for hardware, tooling, and operations; track spend against plan and forecast cost at completion.
* Work with supply chain on make-or-buy calls, long-lead orders, supplier contracts and recovery of late deliveries.
* Run the weekly program review across design, production, quality, supply chain and test; chase the shortages, open NCRs and test anomalies that hold up deliveries.
* Keep the risk and opportunity register with the chief engineer; fund and follow up mitigation for the top risks.
* Cost every engineering change in time and money and optimise the engine delivery
* Plan headcount, tooling and facility capacity with the functional leads as production ramps.
* Give leadership a monthly view of schedule, cost, risk and the decisions needed from them.

BASIC QUALIFICATION
  
  

* B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
* Min. 10+ years in aerospace, defence or space hardware, including 5+ years running the schedule and budget of a hardware program.
* Has taken a hardware program through manufacturing, test and delivery, not only through design.
* Builds integrated schedules with critical-path logic in MS Project or Primavera P6.
* Has managed suppliers of machined, cast, forged or additively manufactured parts, including long-lead buys and late-delivery recovery.
* Has worked inside an AS9100D or equivalent quality system: change control, NCR and MRB, configuration baselines.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Liquid rocket engine, aero-engine or gas-turbine program experience.
* Earned value management to EIA-748: control accounts, cost and schedule variance.
* Has taken a product from first build to series production: production readiness reviews, APQP and PPAP to AS9145.
* Space program practice per NPR 7120.5 and the NASA Systems Engineering Handbook (NASA/SP-2016-6105).
* PMP or PgMP certification.
* Has set up a program office or a production line from scratch.

**What We Offer**

* Salary: ₹36–50 LPA fixed CTC, based on experience.
* Early-stage stock options (ESOPs).
* Group health insurance: employee, spouse, children and parents.
* Insurance: term-life and personal-accident cover.
* Work environment: Challenging, stimulating, research-driven work solving rocket problems every day with a great team. We have a good time, and unlimited coffee.

WHY WORK WITH US?
  
  
At Astrobase, We Believe In The Power Of Human Ingenuity And Collaboration To Push The Boundaries Of Space Exploration. As a Team Member, You’ll Be
  
  

* Creating History: Join us in developing cutting-edge launch vehicles, playing a pivotal role in transforming space access and shaping the future of space exploration.
* Collaborating with Experts: Work alongside ISRO scientists and industry veterans with decades of experience in designing India’s iconic space missions like Chandrayaan 3
* Growth Opportunities: As Astrobase scales, you’ll have the chance to take on leadership roles and be part of an expanding organization driving change in the Indian space sector.
* Pioneering Space Technology: Your contributions will not only impact Astrobase but also influence the global space ecosystem. Be part of something larger than yourself.

Astrobase is an equal-opportunity employer; we hire on skills, merit and experience. Apply with your CV and a short note on a hardware program you delivered.
