title: Associate Project Manager
description:
##### **Lyzr, in a minute**

Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day-to-day use. Today, 500+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.

###### **About the role**

As Associate Project Manager on Lyzr's Platform team, you will make sure platform work ships on time and everyone knows where it stands. You'll plan sprints, track delivery, clear blockers and keep engineering, Applied AI and leadership aligned.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes structure, follows through and is comfortable in a fast-moving AI company.

###### **What you'll do**

* Plan and run sprints for the Platform team: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives
* Turn platform priorities into clear project plans with scope, milestones, owners and timelines
* Track delivery in Jira, keep boards and dashboards current, and report progress every week
* Spot risks, dependencies and blockers early, and drive them to resolution with engineering and DevOps
* Coordinate with the Applied AI team and client-facing project managers so platform work lines up with customer commitments
* Keep senior stakeholders updated on status, risks and decisions
* Document processes, release notes and decisions so the team works from one source of truth
* Use AI tools to automate status reporting and routine project tasks

###### **What we're looking for**

* 2–3 years of project management or delivery experience in a software, SaaS or AI company
* Hands-on Agile and Scrum experience running sprints for engineering teams
* Strong Jira skills: boards, workflows, dashboards and reporting
* Working understanding of cloud platforms (GCP, Azure or AWS) and how platform and DevOps teams work
* Clear written and verbal communication, with experience managing several stakeholders
* Everyday fluency with AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar
* Strong ownership: you follow through on what you commit to

###### **Good to have**

* Experience at an AI implementation or AI platform company
* A project management certification such as CSM, PSM or PMP
* Exposure to CI/CD, release management or infrastructure projects

title: Senior Customer Project Engineer - Gas Turbine
description:
As a member of the Project Engineering team, you will provide input and make decisions that influence major technical and financial outcomes for GEV and/or the customer and customer representatives.
  
  
Serve as the technical point of contact for the project’s External customer. Represent voice of customer to internal teams and voice of engineering to external teams.
  
Communicate the requirements of the project contract to GEV Internal Engineering Teams.
  
Reduce or eliminate risk on projects by resolving conflicts of interest between internal and external stakeholders.
  
Manage changes to hardware, software and contractual scope by quantifying technical impact to cost and cycle.
  
Accountable for project schedule, engineering response to customer and site during installation for engineering defects, comments or ambiguities etc., support other PEs as needed.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* The Senior GT Project Engineer provides technical project management, technical direction, and drives coordination of engineering activities and critical issue resolution for OTR-related issues for all assigned GT projects. The Senior GT Project Engineer functions as the technical liaison for the Customer and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) representatives to ensure that the supplied design documentation and equipment fully complies with the contract requirements and drives continuous improvement in project execution. This position reports to the Project Engineering Leader (Asia)

Essential Responsibilities:

This position will require coordination with customers, Engineering, Procurement, and Construction firms (EPCs), Project Management, multiple engineering organizations, Centers of Excellence (COEs), Commercial Operations, Business Associates (BAs), Global Supply Chain (GSC), Power Service Engineering (PSE) and installation/field personnel by:

* Actively own, support and analyze Pre-COD ER case trends to identify systemic design or installation risks. Translate site-learned insights into concrete engineering process improvements, transforming reactive site troubleshooting into proactive, long-term design excellence

* Participating in constructability reviews, driving systematic lessons learnt back to engineering teams.

* Driving lessons learned back into the design engineering organizations to avoid repeating issues via ERS, NCR, etc.

* Providing technical guidance to Project Management and Applications/Regional Customer Applications Engineering

* Conducting Customer Kick-Off Meetings (CKOMs), Site Kick-Off Meetings, and/or Design Liaison Meetings (DLMs) with customers and/or their design representatives (EPCs)

* Reviewing contract documentation and communicating project requirements to all design functions, utilizing internal documentation systems and regular communication with internal engineering organizations

* Evaluating the financial/schedule impacts of customer-requested scope changes via Cost & Cycle Estimates (CCEs) and implementing changes agreed to by Change Orders via the Change Management Process

* Supporting resolution of cross-functional design complexities and working to resolve technical issues

* Mitigating engineering schedule issues and taking preventative action to avoid delivery delays or late customer deliverables

* Managing the Engineering Budget and providing quarterly Estimate at Completions (EACs) to Finance with monthly risk and opportunities visibility in Live Cost Visibility (LCV).

* Providing technical support to engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, suppliers, and installation personnel to ensure equipment meets all customer requirements and business objectives until handover to services / COD.

* Help establish and execute new project engineering process for handing pre-COD site queries / issues via ER case in ServiceNow tool.

* Presenting project issue resolutions periodically to upper management, highlighting risks, and creating action plans to remedy the risks

* Taking robust handover from application teams (ITO), performing comprehensive handoff to design team in OTR and ensuring project closure with clean handoff to services team

* Executing assigned projects with an ITR mindset.

* Demonstrate AI adaptation for simplification, speed and accuracy of day to day PE tasks.

  
  

**What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited college or university.

* Minimum 10 years of experience in engineering and /or project management, preferably within the Power Plant Industry in an international project environment, out of which 5 years of working with direct customer interface.

**Eligibility Requirement:**

* Ability and willingness to travel, as required ~10%

* Ability and willingness to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* Leadership-quality communication skills, both verbal and written

**What will make you stand out**

* Customer-facing experience

* Experience in managing installation and commissioning technical support and Engineering Response (ER) workflows.

* Proven ability to translate field-based technical feedback into scalable design solutions.

* Demonstrated commitment to Zero-Defect Framework principles, with experience in managing complex technical change control in high-pressure project environments

* Demonstration and adherence to Vernova Way Behavior

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO | Project Management, Marketing & Execution.

This is a role for someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity, connecting people and making things happen.

You will work closely with the CEO on projects spanning digital marketing, content strategy, social media, brand building and broader business initiatives. You will coordinate with stakeholders across teams, translate discussions into actionable plans, track progress, resolve bottlenecks and ensure that priorities move forward.

You are not expected to be the subject-matter expert in every function. You are expected to understand the work, ask the right questions, coordinate the right people and ensure that commitments turn into outcomes.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Management & Execution**

* Convert ideas, discussions and strategic priorities into clear project plans with defined deliverables, owners and deadlines.
* Maintain project trackers, monitor milestones and proactively follow up with stakeholders.
* Identify dependencies, delays and bottlenecks, and work with the relevant teams to resolve them.
* Ensure that decisions made in meetings translate into documented action items and completed tasks.
* Provide regular updates to the CEO on project progress, priorities, risks and pending decisions.
* Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while ensuring that important priorities do not fall through the cracks.

**2. Digital Marketing, Content & Social Media**

* Coordinate the execution of marketing and content plans across Toehold's brands and the CEO's personal brand.
* Work with content creators, designers, video editors, social media managers and digital marketing teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Track content calendars, campaign schedules, creative approvals and publishing commitments.
* Coordinate digital marketing initiatives, including campaign execution, lead generation and performance reporting.
* Help translate content and marketing strategies into briefs, assignments and actionable workflows.
* Monitor key performance indicators and ensure that insights and recommendations are followed through.

**3. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Act as a coordination point between the CEO and relevant internal teams, ensuring clarity on priorities and expectations.
* Liaise with marketing, creative, technology, sales, operations and other stakeholders as required.
* Ensure that team members understand their responsibilities, timelines and dependencies.
* Follow up firmly but professionally to maintain accountability and momentum.
* Facilitate collaboration between teams and help resolve execution gaps.
* Escalate issues that require the CEO's attention, along with context and potential solutions.

**4. CEO's Office & Executive Support**

* Help the CEO organise priorities, manage action items and maintain visibility over ongoing initiatives.
* Prepare meeting agendas, capture decisions and circulate concise follow-up notes.
* Organise information, briefs, presentations and reports to support decision-making.
* Research topics, evaluate options and prepare preliminary recommendations when required.
* Anticipate upcoming requirements and ensure that the CEO has the information and preparation needed for important discussions.
* Handle sensitive business information with discretion and professionalism.

**5. Process Improvement & Operational Efficiency**

* Identify recurring execution gaps and introduce simple, effective systems to address them.
* Establish and maintain workflows, documentation and reporting mechanisms.
* Use project management, collaboration and AI tools to improve productivity and reduce manual follow-ups.
* Continuously look for ways to improve coordination, communication and execution across the organisation.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who combines strong organisational skills with an understanding of marketing and a genuine bias for action.

You may come from project management, digital marketing, content operations, an agency environment, a founder's office or a similar role where you have coordinated people and projects across functions.

**Essential skills and attributes**

* Strong project management, planning and organisational skills.
* A working understanding of digital marketing, content marketing and social media.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and follow through on commitments.
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
* Comfort working with ambiguity, shifting priorities and tight timelines.
* The ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and know when to escalate.
* A proactive mindset: you identify what needs to happen rather than wait to be told every next step.
* Professionalism, discretion and the ability to work closely with the CEO.

### **Experience & Qualifications**

* Approximately 3–7 years of relevant professional experience in project management, marketing operations, content operations, executive support or a related field.
* Demonstrable experience coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Practical familiarity with social media workflows, content calendars and digital marketing campaigns.
* Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools such as Notion, Google Workspace, spreadsheets and project management platforms.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research, documentation, planning and workflow automation is an advantage.

Relevant experience and demonstrated execution ability matter more than a specific degree.

### **What Success Looks Like**

In this role, success means:

* Projects move forward consistently, with clear ownership and fewer missed deadlines.
* The CEO has better visibility into priorities, progress and roadblocks.
* Marketing and content initiatives are executed on time and to the required standard.
* Teams have clarity on what needs to be done, by whom and by when.
* Meetings lead to action, and follow-ups do not depend on the CEO remembering everything.
* Recurring problems are converted into better processes rather than repeatedly handled as exceptions.
* The CEO gains more time to focus on strategy, leadership and high-value decisions.

### **What We Offer**

* Direct exposure to the CEO and the workings of a growing travel and photography business.
* The opportunity to work across strategy, marketing, content and business operations.
* Significant ownership and scope to improve how work gets done.
* A varied role with opportunities to develop project management, marketing and leadership skills.
* A collaborative environment where initiative, accountability and thoughtful execution are valued.

### **How to Apply**

* Send us your CV along with a brief note explaining why you would be a good fit for this role. Write to careers@toehold.in
* Please also share one example of a project you helped coordinate from planning to completion. Tell us what your role was, how you handled stakeholders and what the outcome was.
* We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate how they turn plans into results.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of over 200+ passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.tners India, and super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg, etc.

**What will you do? (Role Overview)**

You’ll run discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-lives with a strong consultative voice. You’ll guide customers toward best practices, manage escalations when needed, and ensure they get value—fast. This is a high-ownership role designed for our future
**AI-first Professional Services org**
, where problem-solving, adaptability, and technical depth are essential.

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle for enterprise customers—from kick-off to go-live.
* Lead requirement-gathering sessions and translate business workflows into Rocketlane configurations.
* Design and guide customers on best-practice implementations, even when that means pushing back or course-correcting.
* Work with customer teams (IT, HR, Finance, PMO, Ops) to design integrations with systems like HRMS, CRM, NetSuite, and fintech platforms.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Solutions) to unblock complex implementations.
* Manage risks, escalations, and tough conversations with clarity and calm.
* Adopt and shape AI-driven workflows to automate routine tasks and improve customer value delivery.
* Serve as the customer’s trusted advisor on onboarding processes, data flows, and integration patterns.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Technical & Integration Skills**

* **Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Webhooks**
  (reading API docs, testing endpoints, and understanding auth flows).
* Experience building or supporting
  **custom integrations**
  between SaaS platforms and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of SaaS concepts: data models, webhooks, API limits, auth, and typical enterprise integration patterns.
* Comfortable working with tools like
  **Postman, Workato, Boomi, Zapier, Make, or other iPaaS solutions**
  .

**Implementation Expertise**

* 5+ years in a
  **customer-facing role at a SaaS company**
  (Implementations / Onboarding / Technical Consulting).
* Proven ability to
  **run enterprise onboarding projects**
  end-to-end with minimal supervision.
* Skilled in conducting discovery, documenting workflows, and translating requirements into system configurations.

**AI-First Aptitude**

* Strong curiosity and a builder mindset—someone who experiments, prototypes, and learns independently.
* Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development or scripting tools (e.g.,
  **Cursor, Replit, Lovable**
  or similar) to automate tasks, validate data, test APIs, or streamline workflows.
* Driven to “own your destiny” by building small scripts, utilities, or workflows that make onboarding faster, cleaner, and more scalable.

**Consultative & Communication Skills**

* Ability to
  **be assertive**
  —advise customers on the best approach rather than simply taking requirements.
* Experience navigating escalations and difficult conversations with professionalism.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to simplify technical concepts.

**Problem-Solving & Ownership**

* Strong analytical skills with a bias for action—thrives in ambiguity.
* High ownership mentality: independently unblocks, drives outcomes, and keeps projects moving.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience implementing or supporting systems like
  **Salesforce, Workday/BambooHR, NetSuite, ERP/CRM/Finance tools**
  .
* Background in Professional Services, Customer Success, or PSA tools (Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, Jira, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA).
* Understanding of SSO/SAML, enterprise IT processes, or data migration.
* Familiarity with SQL for basic data validation.
* Project Management certifications (PMP, CSM) or equivalent mindset.
* Experience in high-growth SaaS environments.

**You should apply if you:**

* Love owning customer outcomes end-to-end.
* Are technically curious and enjoy solving integration and workflow problems.
* Thrive in customer conversations—even the tough ones.
* I want to help shape the future of an
  **AI-first Professional Services org**
  .
* Are energized by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**
  : You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**
  : We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**
  : Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From
  rap videos
  to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**
  : We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**
  : While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pyjamas optional (at least outside the office).

**Job Description**
We are looking for a
**Transition Manager**
who leads complex global and cross-functional transitions from planning through implementation, go-live, stabilization and successful operational handover. The role ensures people, processes, technology, data and controls are operationally ready, while minimizing business disruption. Working with Global Process Owners, cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, the Transition Manager drives coordinated execution, accountability and sustainable operational outcomes.
  
  

* Transition Planning & Execution
* Lead end-to-end transitions across global functions, countries and business units.
* Define transition scope, deliverables, milestones, resources, governance and success criteria.
* Manage integrated transition plans, risks, dependencies, issues and key decisions.
* Develop deployment strategies, readiness criteria, cutover plans and go/no-go requirements.
* Coordinate go-live, hypercare, stabilization and handover with minimal business disruption.
* Operational Readiness & Handover
* Assess readiness across people, processes, technology, data and controls.
* Coordinate SOPs, process documentation, training, knowledge transfer and support arrangements.
* Lead readiness reviews, transition acceptance and go/no-go decision preparation.
* Resolve implementation and post-go-live issues, ensuring operational stability.
* Confirm operational ownership, performance measures and handover criteria before closure.
* Process Standardization & Improvement
* Partner with Global Process Owners to align transitioned processes with global standards and operating models.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce unnecessary complexity or local variation.
* Support process improvement, automation and AI-enabled solutions where they improve transition outcomes.
* Embed appropriate process controls, documentation and governance into operations.
* Stakeholder & Change Management
* Coordinate global, regional and local stakeholders throughout the transition lifecycle.
* Facilitate workshops, governance meetings, decision forums and readiness reviews.
* Identify change impacts, adoption risks and organizational dependencies and drive mitigation.
* Provide concise progress, risk, issue and decision reporting to senior management.
* Drive alignment and accountability without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Performance & Continuous Improvement
* Define transition KPIs, success criteria and stabilization measures.
* Monitor post-go-live performance and drive resolution of outstanding issues.
* Conduct post-transition reviews, capture lessons learned and support benefits realization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business, Finance, Operations, IT, Supply Chain or a related field.
* Proven experience managing complex transitions, migrations or transformation initiatives in an international organization.
* Experience within Global Business Services, Shared Services, Global Process Ownership, Transformation and Center of Excellence environment.
* Strong project and transition management skills covering planning, governance, risk and execution.
* Hands-on experience with operational readiness, cutover, go-live, hypercare, stabilization and handover.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and stakeholders across countries and cultures.
* Understanding of end-to-end business processes, operational controls and change management.
* Experience in GBS, Shared Services or Transformation environments preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Lean Six Sigma or Prosci/ADKAR certification preferred.
* ERP implementation or migration experience (SAP, ERP LN or similar) and familiarity with automation or AI preferred.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; experience with project tools, dashboards and operational KPIs.
* Strong communication, stakeholder influence, problem-solving and executive reporting skills.
* Fluent professional English; additional languages are an advantage.

**Your Profile**
A hands-on Transition Manager who brings structure to complexity, anticipates risks and takes ownership from transition planning to successful operational handover. Success is measured by smooth transitions, minimal business disruption, clear operational accountability and stable, sustainable business-as-usual operations.

title: Junior Project Coordinator
description:
Junior Project Coordinator

Hexr Factory is a next-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real-time digital experiences.

We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high-impact solutions. From cutting-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.

At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading-edge software engineering, design thinking and high-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.

This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Project Coordinator with 1–3 years of relevant experience to support the day-to-day execution of cross-functional projects. The role is focused on keeping work organised, maintaining accurate project information, coordinating reviews and handovers, and helping leads identify risks early. This is a hands-on coordination role, not a Project Manager position.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain project plans and trackers with clear tasks, owners, priorities, due dates, dependencies and current status.
* Follow up on progress and verify updates against available files, versions, review comments or approvals before reporting completion.
* Coordinate daily stand-ups, reviews and internal checkpoints; record decisions, actions, blockers and unresolved questions.
* Convert requirements and feedback from meetings, email and chat into clear, trackable actions.
* Monitor deadlines and dependencies, flag risks early, and communicate the likely impact and required decision to the relevant lead.
* Prepare concise project updates covering confirmed progress, at-risk items, blockers and decisions required.
* Maintain meeting notes, action logs, change records and other project documentation in the agreed source of truth.
* Coordinate handovers between teams only after required review, approval, version and file-link checks are complete.
* Support resource and capacity visibility, including planned leave and competing priorities, while working with project leads on practical schedule changes.
* Help improve tracking, reporting and follow-up routines using spreadsheets, project tools, automation or carefully verified AI assistance.
* Handle client and internal project information with discretion and confidentiality.

Required Skills and Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, production coordination, PMO support or a comparable delivery-focused role.
* Practical experience using spreadsheets and at least one project or task-management tool.
* Working knowledge of task planning, dependencies, risks, status reporting, reviews, approvals and handovers.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to work with creative and technical teams, ask precise questions and escalate issues with useful context.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience is acceptable. An MBA or project-management certification is welcome but not required.
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum routines and basic reporting or automation workflows is an advantage.

* Working knowledge of ERP systems, preferably SAP, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash processes, including order entry, fulfillment, shipping, invoicing, receivables, and collections.
* Excellent stakeholder-management, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced proficiency with Excel and reporting tools; experience with Power BI is an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in engineered products, manufacturing, industrial equipment, or project-based business environments.

* Customer focus and commercial acumen
* Ownership and accountability
* Planning, prioritization, and execution discipline
* Financial and cash-flow awareness
* Risk management and issue resolution
* Cross-functional collaboration

* Continuous improvement mindset

* On-time order fulfillment and delivery performance
* Milestone achievement and project schedule adherence
* Invoice accuracy and timeliness
* Order backlog aging and dispute-resolution cycle time
* Customer satisfaction and project closeout quality

title: Senior Project Scheduler / Project Planning Engineer
description:
**Company presentation**  

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate-neutrality. thyssenkrupp nucera successfully made an IPO in July and is a member of the SDAX of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since September 2023.

www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

  
**Your responsibilities**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Project Scheduler / Project Planning Engineer** to support the planning, monitoring, and control of a complex EPC / industrial project. The role is responsible for developing and maintaining integrated project schedules, coordinating interfaces across disciplines and partners, and providing reliable schedule analysis to support project decision-making.

The position requires strong planning expertise, confident stakeholder coordination, and excellent English communication skills for working with international project teams, clients, consortium partners, contractors, and suppliers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop, maintain, and control integrated project schedules covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, logistics, erection, commissioning, and related project activities.
* Review contractual and execution requirements, including milestones, assumptions, constraints, interfaces, planning obligations, approved baselines, and re-baselining processes.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consortium partners, vendors, subcontractors, and client representatives to collect progress data and maintain accurate schedule updates.
* Perform critical path, float, risk, delay impact, forecast, and what-if analyses to identify schedule deviations and support project decisions.
* Propose mitigation, acceleration, or recovery measures in coordination with project management.
* Prepare schedule and progress reporting, including schedule updates, milestone tracking, look-ahead schedules, variance analyses, S-curves, dashboards, forecasts, and management summaries.
* Support project controls, risk management, cost control, performance monitoring, change management, and contractual schedule reporting by providing reliable schedule input and impact assessments.

  
**Your profile**  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Over ten years of experience in project planning, scheduling, and project controls, preferably in EPC, industrial, energy, hydrogen, oil & gas, petrochemical, power generation, or other capital-intensive projects.
* Hands-on experience with Primavera P6 is obligatory, additionally Microsoft Project would be beneficial.
* Strong understanding of project scheduling and project controls, including critical path methodology, baseline and schedule control, progress measurement, earned value management, schedule risk analysis, and recovery planning.
* Experience in forecasting, performance reporting, change management, contractual schedule reporting, and assessing schedule impacts, including Extension of Time (EoT) requirements arising from contractual or project-related changes.
* Proven experience coordinating schedules in consortium, joint venture, or multi-contractor EPC environments with complex interfaces between partners, contractors, suppliers, and client representatives.
* Experience preparing management reports, S-curves, milestone reports, look-ahead schedules, dashboards, forecasts, and executive progress summaries.

**Language and Communication Requirements**
-------------------------------------------

* Excellent written and spoken English is mandatory.
* Ability to prepare clear schedule reports, planning inputs, presentations, and management summaries in English.
* Ability to communicate confidently with international project teams, clients, consortium partners, contractors, and suppliers.
* Strong facilitation skills for planning meetings, schedule reviews, and guide peers and progress discussions across organizational and cultural interfaces.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in hydrogen, electrolysis, renewable energy, process plants, industrial manufacturing, or modular package delivery projects.
* Additional exposure to large-scale international EPC projects with complex partner and subcontractor interfaces would be advantageous.
* Hands-on involvement in delay analysis, claims support, or forensic schedule review would be an advantage.
* PMP®, PMI-SP®, or similar project management / scheduling certification would be an advantage.
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP or Microsoft Dynamics would be beneficial.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable in handling large volumes of project data.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across different management levels and ability to drive alignment without direct authority.
* Confident communicator who can challenge schedule inputs constructively.
* Able to work in a fast-paced project environment with multiple priorities and under pressure.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally when required and able to stay abroad for particular period as per project and company demands.

  
**We value diversity**

The company is committed to strengthening diversity and inclusion at the workplace. It strives to create an inclusive work environment where employees can develop to achieve their full potential and a culture that welcomes differences and creates a sense of belonging.

description:

title: Project Manager - E Fleet
description:
**Reports to**

[CEO / Director]

**Experience**

12+ years (minimum)

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Automotive or a related engineering discipline. A PMP or similar certification, or a relevant postgraduate qualification, is an advantage.

**Preferred Background**

Indian Railways, Metro Railways, rolling stock, railway electrification, electric traction, or heavy engineering for railways.

BMPL is setting up its E-Fleet Division from scratch to build an electric rail freight fleet for cargo and material transport. The General Manager (Projects) will lead planning, estimation, coordination and execution of complex engineering projects, including the construction and operation of elevated freight corridors using the latest technologies.

* Lead end-to-end planning, scheduling, resource allocation, execution, monitoring and delivery.

* Coordinate engineering, procurement, production, quality, testing and commissioning teams.

* Apply in-depth knowledge of Indian Railways and Metro networks, operating procedures, technical systems and engineering standards.
* Evaluate technical specifications, drawings, equipment requirements and project feasibility.

* Lead cross-functional teams and define clear responsibilities and deliverables.
* Liaise with customers, railway authorities, consultants, vendors and contractors.
* Conduct project reviews and report progress, cost, risk and performance to senior management.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans.

**5. Quality, Safety and Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to engineering specifications, quality standards, contractual requirements and safety procedures.
* Coordinate inspection, testing, commissioning, documentation and project handover.
* Ensure compliance with applicable railway, electrical and regulatory requirements.

**6. Division Building**

* Establish project management processes, SOPs and reporting systems for the new division.
* Build and mentor the project team as the division scales.

* 12+ years in project management, railway operations, engineering, estimation or costing.
* Strong knowledge of railway network operations, technical systems and engineering specifications.

* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, BOQs and contract documents.

* Strong planning, analytical, commercial, communication and problem-solving skills.

* Build collaboration across offshore and onsite teams, including effective handoffs and overlapping working hours.

* 15+ years of experience in IT services, Salesforce/CRM consulting, project delivery, or enterprise application services.

* Excellent communication, structured problem-solving, and executive reporting skills.

* Salesforce certifications relevant to delivery or architecture.
* Experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industry Clouds, or Data Cloud.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience delivering in a fixed-price or managed-services commercial model.
* Experience supporting US-based clients and coordinating across time zones.

**Success Measures**

* Predictable, on-time delivery within agreed scope and budget.
* Customer satisfaction, stakeholder confidence, and effective escalation management.
* Project margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and operational compliance.
* Improved delivery quality, reduced defects, and proactive risk mitigation.
* Successful identification and support of qualified account expansion opportunities.
* Team stability, capability growth, and effective onsite/offshore collaboration.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
**Technical Delivery Manager, Strategic Integrations and Migrations**

Location: Pune, India

Type: Full time

Experience: 10+ years

Travel: 10 to 15%, domestic and international

**About AiStrike**

Security teams drown in alerts, and real attacks hide among the false positives. AiStrike uses AI to

prioritize and automate threat investigation and response. We cut alert volume from 100 to 5, give

analysts the context to investigate what remains, and add workflow and automation to shorten

response time.

**The role**

You will run delivery for complex SIEM migrations and integrations. That means cadence, schedule,

stage gates and sign off. You have been hands on in SIEM implementations and know what decides whether a customer is ready to go live. You have onboarded data into a SIEM. Now you manage timelines, deliverables and executive stakeholders.

**What you will do**

**Program governance**

* Set the delivery cadence with the MSSP partner and AiStrike teams. Run the weekly
* operational forums
* Keep decisions, actions and agreements in writing, with an owner and a due date on every
* open item.
* Own the stage gates and get recorded sign off at each one against the agreed regional
* milestones.

•
**Govern the migration lifecycle:**

Stage 0: Prerequisites and tenant provisioning

Stage 1: Log source ingestion and parser validation

Stage 2: Content, detection rule and playbook migration

Stage 3: Parallel run and user acceptance testing

Stage 4: Cutover and legacy platform decommissioning

Stage 5: Stabilization and handover

**Schedule, risk and dependencies**

* Own the integrated schedule across customer migration waves, including dependencies
* between log onboarding, parsers, content migration and cutover windows.
* When a date slips, name the cause and the fix in the same week.
* Maintain the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies). Escalate only when a stage
* gate is genuinely at risk.
* Run a follow the sun model with the US TAM so partner leadership and the India delivery
* pods work from one plan.

**Technical readiness**

* Review SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, cloud and email sources with the engineering pod. Confirm
* data is connected, normalized and arriving complete, then make the go live call.
* Diagnose blockers fast: missing credential, broken parser, timestamp or schema issue,
* detection gap, or an agent verdict the analyst does not trust. Say which one stops the gate.

**Leadership and reporting**

* Lead architects, data engineers, detection engineers and customer teams through influence.
* They do not report to you, and the schedule still moves.
* Turn technical status into a weekly health report and steering brief for delivery leadership
* and partners. Cover the success KPIs: alert volume, false positive rate, investigation time and
* share of alerts closed by the agent.
* Agree the operating model with the customer SOC: queues, escalation, ticketing and who
* accepts an agent verdict.
* Send Product and Engineering usable field evidence: customer, source, expected result, what
* the agent did and what the analyst did.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years in security service delivery /technical project/program management experience
* driving complex, multi-tenant enterprise software migrations, large-scale systems
* integrations, or IT transformations
* Hands on SIEM implementation experience, including log source onboarding, parsers and
* content migration, on a platform such as Securonix, Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel,
* Google SecOps or Elastic.
* Current experience running programs across multiple customers at once, including timelines,
* deliverables, stage gates and stakeholder sign off.
* A track record of multi tenant or MSSP migrations, or large security platform rollouts,
* delivered to a committed date.
* Experience leading engineers and analysts in a matrix, without direct authority.
* Strong command of schedule and risk tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet or MS
* Project.
* Clear spoken and written English for analyst reviews and partner steering meetings.
* Comfort working across US and India hours, and willingness to travel 10 to 15%.

**Nice to have**

* Experience inside an MSSP, SOC or cybersecurity product company, taking customers live.
* Enough technical depth to read a failed integration or a SIEM query (SQL, KQL or SPL) and tell
* the pod what is wrong.
* SOAR playbook experience on Palo Alto XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Tines or Torq.
* Experience judging AI or automation investigations: where the result is wrong and what the
* analyst should do next.
* A delivery certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an agile credential. Security certifications
* such as Security+, CISSP or CISM help, but do not replace SIEM implementation experience.

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a multi region MSSP migration, based in our Pune office, with global
* counterparts on the same program.
* A role in a high growth company building AI driven security operations.
* Competitive compensation.

title: Survey Coordinator
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Survey Coordinator**
, you will be the operational engine behind ERM's UK survey programmes — coordinating access, scheduling, logistics, and compliance across a portfolio of capital projects. Working within the Capital Project Delivery (CPD) — Projects Feasibility, Planning & Consents pillar, you will partner with Land Access Managers, Land Access Coordinators, technical survey leads, project managers to ensure surveys are delivered on time, safely, and in line with landowner permissions. This role is critical to de-risking survey programmes, maintaining CDM and H&S compliance, and enabling CPD's UK Land Services and technical teams to grow through reliable, well-run field campaigns.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Survey programmes are delivered on schedule and within budget, with access, resource, and equipment aligned to landowner permissions and site constraints.
* Access windows are actively managed and re-planned in response to weather, ecology seasons, landowner availability, and construction interfaces — protecting critical path.
* Clients and Internal stakeholders receive clear, timely progress updates on survey status, blockers, and completion, supported by accurate trackers and reporting.
* Cross-team coordination, with issues escalated early and resolved collaboratively.
* Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS), permits, and post-survey reinstatement records are complete, auditable, and stored in line with ERM's quality and assurance standards.

**What will you bring?**

* Demonstrable experience (typically 3+ years) coordinating multi-discipline surveys, fieldwork, or site logistics on UK infrastructure, energy, utilities, environmental, or development projects.
* Strong programme and logistics management skills — able to juggle multiple concurrent survey campaigns, teams, and access windows.
* Working knowledge of UK H&S and compliance frameworks relevant to fieldwork.
* Confident communicator with landowners, surveyors, subcontractors, and clients — both written and verbal.
* Strong Microsoft 365 skills (Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint) with the ability to build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and resourcing plans.
* Familiarity with GIS platforms and the ability to interpret land plans, constraint mapping, and access routes.
* Commercial awareness of utilisation, chargeability, and cost control on survey workstreams.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills & Competencies**

* Background or qualification in ecology, environmental science, geography, land management, or a related discipline.
* Prior experience coordinating surveys.
* Familiarity with resource management and forecasting tools used in consultancy (e.g., Workday, resource trackers).
* Experience supporting DCO, TWAO, planning, or ESIA-driven survey programmes.
* Exposure to global delivery or shared service environments, working alongside offshore/CDH delivery teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the planning, scheduling, and mobilisation of UK survey campaigns across disciplines.
* Work closely with Land Access Managers and Coordinators to align survey programmes with landowner permissions, access windows, and any site-specific conditions or restrictions.
* Maintain the master survey tracker, resource plan, and access matrix — ensuring visibility of status, blockers, and forecast completion across projects.
* Ensure all surveyors and subcontractors have the required competencies, certifications, and inductions before deployment.
* Provide clear, timely progress updates to project managers, technical leads, and clients on survey delivery, and escalate risks or delays early.
* Support the Land Access Manager with post-survey close-out, including reinstatement checks, damage claims, and landowner thank-you communications.
* Contribute to continuous improvement — refining trackers, templates, competency matrices, and process documentation for CPD's UK Land Services and technical teams.
* Uphold ERM's health, safety, quality, and ethics standards on all fieldwork, ensuring the safety and wellbeing of every team member deployed to site.

title: Fleet Manager - Last Mile(Delhi) - Contractual
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.As Fleet Coordinator – Last Mile, you will own day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across our hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR — making sure passengers move smoothly between buses and cabs, cab operators deliver to standard, and your ground team runs like clockwork.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Lead and manage day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across designated hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR.
* Ensure smooth, timely dispatch and coordination of last-mile cabs against bus arrival and departure schedules.
* Act as the on-ground escalation point, resolving operational disruptions (delays, no-shows, route changes, demand surges) quickly and calmly.
* Work closely with last-mile cab operators and drivers to drive app adoption, improve punctuality metrics, and elevate customer experience.
* Coach and support drivers on FlixBus standards, app usage, and service expectations.
* Manage the roster, shift planning, and day-to-day working of ground operations associates and last-mile associates.
* Allocate manpower against demand patterns and peak windows; track attendance, performance, and productivity of the ground team.
* Own last-mile cab operator governance — share performance reports regularly, run periodic review meetings, and manage the day-to-day partner relationship.
* Track operator SLAs and KPIs, flag underperformance, and drive corrective action plans.
* Be the owner of last-mile passenger experience, ensuring a smooth transition from buses to cabs and cabs to buses.
* Monitor passenger feedback and complaints related to the last mile, close the loop, and drive continuous improvement.

**About You**

* 3–6 years of experience in ground operations, last-mile logistics, fleet coordination, transport operations, or a similar field (mobility, ride-hailing, e-commerce delivery, or aggregator platforms preferred).
* Proven experience managing frontline teams and third-party vendors or operators.
* Strong grasp of punctuality/SLA-driven operations and comfort working with real-time, on-ground decision-making.
* Data-literate — comfortable working with dashboards, spreadsheets, and reporting; able to turn numbers into action.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to hold operators accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
* Customer-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.
* Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.
* Willingness to work in shifts, be on-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; proficiency in English and Hindi.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up .
* Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, ground operational excellence, data analysis and vendor management processes.
* Hone your stakeholder management skills by interacting with international stakeholders.

**Why Join Flix**
At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.
  
  
If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Associate Implementation Manager
description:
**About Global PayEX**

Global PayEX is a leading AI-powered FinTech SaaS company specializing in Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) automation. Our cloud-based platform helps businesses optimize working capital by automating invoice processing, payments, collections, reconciliation, and financial workflows. Leveraging advanced AI and machine learning, we enable organizations to improve cash flow, reduce manual effort, and enhance operational efficiency. Global PayEX serves enterprises, financial institutions, and mid-market businesses worldwide, partnering with leading banks and Fortune 500 companies to deliver intelligent finance automation solutions

**Role Overview**

As an Associate Implementation Manager, you will be at the center of how Global PayEX goes live with major bank and enterprise clients. You will work directly with client teams — CFO offices, treasury teams, and bank implementation leads — to configure, deploy, and onboard our AR/AP automation platform. This is not a coding role. It is a client-facing, problem-solving, project ownership role for someone who understands technology well enough to bridge the gap between engineering and the business. If you are someone who loves working with enterprise clients, can manage a project timeline, and wants to see how technology transforms financial operations at scale — this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Solutioning**

• Run product demos for corporate finance teams, treasury heads, and CFOs.

• Understand each prospect's accounts-receivable process, ERP landscape, and pain points; translate these into a tailored solution narrative.

• Prepare pre-call briefs, solutioning notes, objection-handling material, and follow-up communication for internal stakeholders and clients.

• Support the pipeline by qualifying prospects, contributing to sales collateral and audits, and moving accounts through the funnel.

• Represent the product with credibility in front of senior finance stakeholders.

**Implementation & Delivery**

● Lead end-to-end onboarding of enterprise clients onto the Global PayEX platform, working with bank partners and corporate treasury teams.

● Coordinate between client stakeholders, internal product teams, and technical teams to ensure smooth go-lives.

● Configure and test platform workflows based on client-specific requirements.

● Prepare implementation plans, training materials, and status reports for client and internal stakeholders. ● Identify and resolve implementation blockers quickly, escalating where needed.

● Build trusted relationships with client contacts throughout the implementation lifecycle.

● Support continuous improvement of our implementation playbooks and documentation.

**Operations, Onboarding & Adoption**

• Work with the Operations team on end-user onboarding once a client is live.

• Design and run training programs, adoption campaigns, and refresher sessions for the client's finance users and their downstream users.

• Monitor throughput and adoption metrics for your accounts; identify drop-offs and act on them. • Own the client relationship post go-live for at least the stabilisation period.

**What We're Looking For**

● 1–2 years of full-time work experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or a finance/treasury function within a corporate.

● Educational background in finance, commerce, or business (B.Com, BBA, BMS, MBA-Finance, CA Inter/CA, CFA L1+, or equivalent)

. ● Strong understanding of basic finance concepts — accounts receivable, invoicing, reconciliation, collections, working capital, DSO.

● Comfortable being client-facing: confident in demos, meetings, and presentations with senior finance stakeholders.

● Proactive by default — able to spot what needs doing next and drive it without being asked.

● Strong written and verbal communication in English.

● Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment.

● Familiarity with tools like Excel, JIRA, Claude, Confluence, or project management platforms is a plus.

Why Global PayEX

● JPMorgan-backed and JPMorgan channel-distributed — direct exposure to how Tier-1 banks adopt enterprise FinTech.

● Work with Fortune 500 clients from day one.

● Founded and led by a CMU alumnus — you will have direct access to senior leadership

. ● Competitive USD compensation with performance incentives.

● Real ownership from day one — this is not a support role.

**How to Apply Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to hr@globalpayex.com with the subject line: "Associate Implementation Manager | [Your Name]"**

description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: UN Women National Consultant - Documentation and Research, New Delhi, India
description:
**Job Description**

* Background

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls, the empowerment of women, and the achievement of gender equality. UN Women supports Member States and partners in advancing women’s leadership and participation, ending violence against women, promoting women’s economic empowerment, and integrating gender equality into national planning, budgeting, and development processes.
  
  
In India, UN Women works with government institutions, civil society organisations, development partners, and other stakeholders to advance gender equality and women’s empowerment. A key area of its work is Gender-Responsive Budgeting (GRB), which seeks to ensure that policies, plans, public expenditure, and resource allocation respond effectively to the different needs, priorities, and realities of women and men. Through its GRB programme, UN Women India supports efforts to strengthen institutional capacities, improve gender analysis in planning and budgeting, promote evidence-based decision-making, and enhance accountability for gender equality commitments. This work includes engagement with relevant Union Ministries and State Governments, strengthening technical capacities and institutional mechanisms, and facilitating dialogue among stakeholders to promote the effective integration of gender perspectives into public financial management.
  
  
As part of these efforts, UN Women India facilitates multi-stakeholder engagement and advocacy to strengthen gender-responsive public financing, including through the Annual Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation. The consultation provides a platform for civil society organisations, feminist economists, researchers, practitioners, development partners, and other relevant stakeholders to deliberate on emerging budgetary priorities and fiscal policies from a gender equality perspective. It seeks to bring evidence, field-level experiences, and feminist perspectives into discussions on the Union Budget, identify gaps in resource allocation and implementation, and generate actionable recommendations for more equitable and inclusive public expenditure. The consultation also creates opportunities to consolidate stakeholder inputs, strengthen collective advocacy, and communicate key recommendations to relevant policymakers and other decision-makers in the budget process.
  
  
In this context, UN Women India envisages engaging a consultant to support the planning, coordination, and documentation of the Annual Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation. The consultancy will contribute to the effective organisation of the consultation, including the preparation of the concept note and agenda, stakeholder and speaker coordination, participant management, documentation of deliberations, consolidation of key recommendations, and development of communication materials. The assignment will help ensure that the consultation’s discussions and outcomes are systematically captured and disseminated to inform ongoing advocacy and engagement on gender-responsive budgeting and public financing for gender equality in India.
  
  
Within this context, UN Women Inda seeks the services of consultant to coordinate the organizing of a feminist pre-budget consultation. The Consultant will work under the guidance and supervision of the Coordinator, Gender Responsive Budgeting, UN Women India Office.
  
  

* Roles and Responsibilities

Under the guidance of UN Women, India and in close coordination with relevant stakeholders, the Consultant will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, communication, and documentation of the Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation. The responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Stakeholder Coordination
* Organize and facilitate planning meetings with concerned stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication, circulation of meeting materials, and follow-up on agreed action points.
* Participant Management
* Manage the registration process for all participants.
* Maintain updated participant records, including contact details, travel requirements, and confirmations.
* Agenda and Concept Note
* Draft the Concept Note and Agenda based on inputs from UN Women and key partners.
* Revise and finalize documents in consultation with stakeholders.
* Invitations and Speaker Engagement
* Prepare and issue invitations to speakers, panelists, and participants.
* Follow up on confirmations, bios, and session requirements.
* Session Documentation and Event Reporting
* Coordinate notetaking and documentation of all Consultation sessions.
* Compile and prepare the complete event report, including participant list and key recommendations.
* Communications & Social Media Outreach
* Develop a social media and communications outreach plan with relevant teams.
* Support at least 10 social media posts to amplify visibility of the Consultation.
* Knowledge Sharing
* Share the final list of recommendations and the event report with all participants and relevant stakeholders.

* Deliverables
* Deliverable 1: Concept Note and Agenda for the Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation, finalized in consultation with UN Women and relevant stakeholders.

+ Timeline: November 15
+ Payment: 20%

* Deliverable 2: Comprehensive Event Report, including session summaries, participant list, and consolidated key recommendations.

+ Timeline: November 27
+ Payment: 40%

* Deliverable 3: At least 10 social media posts drafted and/or coordinated for posting to enhance the visibility of the Consultation.

+ Timeline: November 28
+ Payment: 20%

* Deliverable 4: Complete set of documentation files, meeting notes, and consolidated records, including dissemination of the final recommendations and event report to relevant stakeholders.

+ Timeline: December 2
+ Payment: 20%

Total payment: 100%
  
  
(Please note that payment will be processed upon completion of deliverables as per timeline and upon submission of requisite payment documents.)
  
  

* Evaluation Criteria of submissions

domains

initiative

interactions

difficulty levels

Project Management programs

program

title: Project Manager - SCG India
description:
**Job Summary**

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing business and operational projects in India, particularly in areas related to building materials, manufacturing, supply chain, and business development.

The role requires strong project management capabilities, commercial awareness, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, business partners, and regional stakeholders to drive successful project outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

* Plan, coordinate, and manage projects from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with business objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Develop project plans, milestones, resource requirements, and performance indicators to monitor project progress.
* Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation plans, and resolve issues to ensure timely and effective execution.
* Monitor project performance and prepare regular progress reports for relevant stakeholders.

**Cross-functional & Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with internal teams, business partners, suppliers, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth project implementation.
* Coordinate with local and regional stakeholders, including teams in India and Thailand, to align project objectives, deliverables, and expectations.

**Business Development & Strategic Projects**

* Support the evaluation and implementation of new business initiatives, strategic partnerships, and potential business expansion projects in India.
* Conduct project feasibility assessments, including preliminary cost, resource, operational, and risk considerations, as required.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure effective execution of approved business initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. A Master's degree is an advantage.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in project management, project execution, or business operations, preferably within the building materials, manufacturing, industrial, construction-related, or supply chain sectors.
* Proven experience managing cross-functional projects, including project planning, budgeting, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and performance monitoring.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.
* Good understanding of business operations and the ability to translate business requirements into actionable project plans.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multicultural environment.
* Proficiency in project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Excel, or other relevant platforms.
* Willingness to travel within India as required by business or project needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with multinational companies or collaborating with regional or international teams.
* Experience in the building materials, manufacturing, infrastructure, or industrial sectors.
* Exposure to project feasibility studies, business expansion initiatives, joint ventures, or strategic partnerships.
* Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an advantage.

**About SCG**

SCG is a leading business conglomerate headquartered in Thailand, with operations across ASEAN and international markets.

In India, SCG operates through SCG International India Private Limited, with business activities spanning building materials, international sourcing, and supply chain solutions. SCG also participates in a joint venture with BigBloc Construction Limited in the manufacturing of autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) building materials.

SCG is committed to sustainable growth, innovation, and building strong partnerships to support long-term business development.

title: Project Manager (BA)
description:
Digital Minds is an award-winning marketing agency working with some amazing brands including Challenger Group, Servcorp, BigW, FedEx, BridgeClimb and Kennards Storage to name a few. We're growing our team and looking for a Project Manager 'digital mind' who knows how to keep big things moving to join us.

**The Role:**

As our Project Manager (BA), you'll be the main point of contact for one of our key global enterprise clients and the person who makes sure work moves from idea to published without losing momentum.

Day to day, you'll run the account: leading weekly client calls and monthly planning sessions, managing quotes, timelines and budgets and keeping every job moving through the client's workflow. You'll work hand in hand with our Head of SEO & GEO and SEO & GEO Manager, as well as our content partners, to turn strategy into delivery. Our clients value velocity over admin, so we need someone who keeps things simple, structured and moving.

On the BA side, you'll help scope new work, gather requirements and support discovery and business cases when an idea needs more than a brief.

As the role grows, you'll bring the same pragmatic, structured approach to project delivery across the wider SEO team.

**Responsibilities:**

●      Acting as the main point of contact for the client, building trust with stakeholders at every level

●      Running weekly status calls and monthly planning sessions, with clear agendas, actions and follow-ups

●      Building quotes and timelines, and managing budgets, credit tracking and final cost reports

●      Keeping project trackers, content calendars and client workflows (e.g. SharePoint, Teams) up to date

●      Coordinating internal teams, content partners and the client to keep every job on schedule

●      Scoping new work: gathering requirements, flagging complex ideas early and supporting discovery and business cases

●      Tracking and reporting hours and effort against each project

●      Spotting risks, bottlenecks and process gaps, and fixing them before they slow work down

●      Clear, proactive communication with clients, partners and our Australia & India teams across time zones

●      Supporting the SEO team with structured project management across other clients as capacity allows.

**What We’re Looking For:**

●      Minimum 5 years experience in project management, ideally in an agency, consultancy or client-facing role

●      Experience managing enterprise or large corporate clients, with multiple stakeholders and approval layers

●      Excellent written and spoken English. This is non-negotiable; you'll be the voice of the account

●      Confident stakeholder management. You can lead meetings, manage expectations and push work forward while protecting the relationship

●      Commercial awareness across quoting, budget tracking and scoping

●      Business analysis skills: gathering requirements, documenting processes and building simple business cases

●      A watertight approach to process, documentation and follow-up

●      Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Excel) and project tools (e.g. Asana)

●      Comfortable working across time zones, with good overlap with Australian and Asian business hours

●      Exposure to digital marketing, SEO or content production would be looked on favourably

●      Reliable, proactive and comfortable owning the outcome, not just the task

●      Professional, on the ball and hungry for results!

﻿

**Ready to be part of a winning team? Apply Now!**

description:
**Description**

From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of current operations, identify performance improvement opportunities and quantify potential EBITDA improvement areas across plan, source, make and deliver functions
