This role involves working closely with clients to identifytheir operations pain points and design & implement digital solutions across Supply chain planning, procurement, manufacturing, and logistics functions. Individuals should be able to translate business requirements into the right solution and map those with the vendor’sCOTS functionalities along with required customizations for end-to-end digital transformation programs (Design, Build/Configure, Test, Go Live and Hypercare)
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
As Manager for Digital supply chain at A&M GCC PI team, you will contribute across the key areas below:
  
  
**Supply Chain Solutions Design & Implementation**

* Evaluate supply chain technologies, platforms, and solution providers and support the development of fit-for-purpose solution architectures and implementation roadmaps
* Define end-to-end digital supply chain strategy, roadmap and target operating model across ERP, planning, procurement, MES, WMS and TMS
* Define and validate data architecture, governance, cloud hosting and API/integration architecture across supply chain platforms
* Conduct “As-is” Assessment for gap analysis to design “To-be” state organization
* Translate business needs into functional & Technical specs and configure processes
* Create Design specifications for planning, procurement, production, Order management, Logistics, distribution
* Support end-to-end ERP implementation life cycle across supply chain modules (e.g., MM, PP, SD, WM, APO/IBP)
* Experience in integration with existing enterprise systems through APIs, middleware, cloud platforms, and cross-functional business process workflows
* Build RICEFW templates as per design specifications to support the solution
* Work with platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, Blue Yonder, SAP IBP, Coupa, SAP Ariba, Tulip, IRIS/MES, SAP EWM/TM etc.

**Testing & Deployment**

* Own the end-to-end implementation lifecycle from requirements through configuration, integration, testing, go-live and post-go-live stabilization
* Design and execute test scenarios: Unit Testing, Integration Testing, UAT
* Assist to validate configurations through business scenarios
* Support data migration, cut-over planning, go-live and hyper-care activities
* Collaborate with IT to troubleshoot and resolve issues post-deployment
* Project Management to track the issues through MS Project and JIRA

**Change Management & Training**

* Prepare SOPs, training materials, and user manuals; drive business-user adoption
* Support role – based user training sessions and drive functional adoption
* Conduct process workshops and knowledge-transfer sessions to build functional capabilities
* Highlight change impacts and ensure user readiness

**Continuous Improvement & Enhancements**

* Identify post-implementation improvements and process automation opportunities
* Support digital supply chain reporting needs (MPS, inventory, OTIF, cycle time etc.)
* Assist in system upgrades and rollouts across new plants or warehouses
* Evaluate emerging technologies like generative AI, Agentic AI and continuously enhance digital solutions through automation and process optimization

**Client Delivery & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead day-to-day project workstreams and contribute to overall project delivery
* Prepare executive-ready presentations, reports, and recommendations
* Facilitate client discussions, workshops, and stakeholder engagements

**Firm & Practice Contribution**

* Develop thought leadership, industry perspectives, benchmarks, and reusable tools / frameworks to strengthen the firm's Digital Supply Chain proposition
* Contribute to proposal development and business development activities
* Support internal knowledge development and training initiatives

**Qualifications**

* 6-11 years of experience in digital supply chain transformation, supply chain planning, logistics, operations excellence, or digital supply chain technology implementation programs
* Previous advisory and consulting experience from a top-tier strategy firm, leading specialist / niche advisory firm, or Big-4 consultancy preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, logistics, supply chain, manufacturing or a related field
* MBA / master’s degree in supply chain & Operations, Logistics, Business Administration, or similar discipline
* Strong functional knowledge across the end-to-end supply chain, including demand & supply planning, manufacturing, procurement, production scheduling, inventory, logistics, distribution, and order fulfilment
* Strong knowledge of supply chain operating models, process re-engineering, business process mapping, and target-state design
* Experience supporting or leading implementation of supply chain planning, logistics, warehouse management (WMS), transportation management (TMS), procurement, or manufacturing execution solutions (MES)
* Familiarity with enterprise data models, cloud platform architectures, data migration lifecycle, API/integration frameworks, and business process integration across supply chain functions
* Hands-on experience with ERP and supply chain platforms such as SAP ECC/S4HANA, SAP IBP, SAP EWM/TM, Oracle SCM Cloud, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, Microsoft Dynamics, o9, WMS / TMS or similar solutions
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills with the ability to drive adoption across business and technology teams
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and coordination skills in dynamic, operationally complex environments
* Experience in managing cross-functional stakeholders during implementations
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and root-cause problem-solving skills
* Exposure to AI/ML-powered supply chain solutions, generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision intelligence platforms, would be a plus
* Tools knowledge on Alteryx, Power BI, python, Linear programming platforms, etc. would be a plus

**Your journey at A&M**

Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Team Size : 10 -15

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to tulika.hr@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

Subject line: Application — Strategic Research & Business Analyst

title: Head of Supply Chain Management
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Company Name:**
Client of Birchtree Consulting (Retail)

**Location:**
Kolkata, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 to 45 LPA

Role Purpose

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Fragrance business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

Key Responsibilities

Demand & Production Planning

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

End-to-End Vendor Management

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the fragrance supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

Production & Component Coordination

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

Inventory & Availability

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

Cost & Process Optimisation

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

International Supply Chain

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

Key Deliverables / Success Metrics

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

Ideal Candidate

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, luxury, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.
* Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management and production scheduling.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong analytical and Excel capabilities.
* Comfortable working in a start-up/0-to-1 environment where processes need to be built from scratch.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for vendor management where required.

Preferred Background

Candidates from fragrance, cosmetics, beauty, luxury packaging, premium consumer goods, fashion accessories, jewellery or other businesses involving complex vendor and component ecosystems may be considered.

title: Rooftop PV Site Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Vyomaa Energy is a reputed renewable energy services company based in India, delivering clean, affordable power to commercial, institutional, and industrial clients. The company executes Build, Own, Operate, and Transfer (BOOT) projects for commercial buildings, educational institutions, hospitals, warehouses, and industries. Vyomaa Energy also designs and installs small rooftop PV systems for residential homes and provides electrical storage solutions for decentralized electricity generation. The organization is committed to expanding access to sustainable energy while maintaining competitive pricing and reliable service. More information and updates are shared through its official Twitter channel.
  
**Role Description**
The Rooftop PV Site Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The role involves conducting site surveys, assessing rooftop suitability, and coordinating the structural and civil aspects of PV system installation. The Site Engineer will oversee installation activities, monitor quality and safety compliance, verify alignment with engineering designs, and support commissioning of rooftop solar systems. Responsibilities also include collaborating with project managers, contractors, and clients to ensure timely execution, resolving site-level issues, and preparing daily/weekly site reports. The role requires regular interaction with stakeholders, adherence to local regulations and standards, and contribution to continuous improvement of installation practices.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to work effectively in on-site project environments, including active construction and installation sites.
* Strong communication skills for coordinating with clients, contractors, internal teams, and other stakeholders.
* Experience in quality control for solar or electrical installations, with a focus on safety, compliance, and performance standards.
* Knowledge of structural engineering principles relevant to rooftop solar mounting systems and load calculations.
* Background as a civil engineer or similar technical discipline with exposure to building structures and site work.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in civil engineering, electrical engineering, renewable energy, or a related field.
* Familiarity with rooftop PV system design, basic electrical concepts, and relevant codes and standards.
* Proficiency in site reporting, basic project documentation, and use of common engineering tools and software.
* Ability to travel within the Kolkata metropolitan area and work safely at heights and in outdoor conditions.
* Prior experience in solar rooftop projects or renewable energy installations is an advantage.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
**The Group**
Generac is a total energy solutions company that empowers people to use energy on their own terms. Founded in 1959, Generac is a leading global designer, manufacturer, and provider of a wide range of energy technology solutions. The Company provides power generation equipment (i.e. diesel and gas generator), energy storage systems, energy management devices and solutions, and other power products serving the residential, light commercial, data & telecom, and industrial markets.
  
  
Generac is a global company with approximately USD 4.4 billion in annual revenues and direct subsidiaries in more than 18 countries worldwide. The Company continues to expand its energy technology offerings in pursuit of its mission to Power a Smarter World and to lead the evolution toward more resilient, efficient, and sustainable energy solutions.
  
  
In India, Generac entered the market in 2019 through the acquisition of Captiva Energy Solutions, a bespoke generator manufacturer. Since then, significant investments have been made to scale operations and fully integrate the business into Generac’s global platform. The local headquarters and manufacturing facility are based in Kolkata, supported by regional and remote offices across India. Generac has ambitious growth plans for India, positioning the country as a strategic market within its global footprint.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
This is a high-impact operational leadership role reporting to the Chief Executive Officer of Generac Captiva Pvt. Ltd. The selected candidate will have end-to-end responsibility for manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, quality, project execution, service operations, and Environment, Health and Safety, ensuring that operational capabilities support the Company’s commercial strategy and growth objectives in India.
  
  
The role requires strong manufacturing leadership, disciplined execution, and the ability to build scalable processes and teams aligned with Generac’s global standards. A key objective will be to elevate the Kolkata manufacturing operation to full global quality, safety, delivery, and productivity standards, while developing the capability to support exports to other Generac subsidiaries worldwide.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end operations of the Indian subsidiary, including manufacturing, supply chain, sourcing, quality, project execution, service operations, and Environment, Health and Safety.
* Translate the Company’s commercial strategy and demand plan into an integrated operational plan covering capacity, production, materials, resources, inventory, projects, and service delivery.
* Drive manufacturing performance through clear operating routines and key performance indicators focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer satisfaction.
* Upgrade the Kolkata manufacturing facility, processes, and quality systems to meet Generac’s global standards and enable the site to support export requirements and intercompany demand.
* Lead Sales and Operations Planning in coordination with the CEO, Sales, Finance, Product Management, and other relevant functions, ensuring alignment between market demand, production capacity, working capital, and delivery commitments.
* Strengthen supply chain resilience and supplier performance, including sourcing strategy, supplier qualification and development, material availability, inventory optimization, logistics, and cost competitiveness.
* Ensure robust project execution from order handover through engineering, procurement, production, installation, commissioning, and final customer acceptance, with disciplined management of scope, timing, cost, quality, and risk.
* Build an effective service operating model that supports installation, commissioning, warranty, preventive maintenance, spare parts availability, and responsive field support.
* Partner with global and local Engineering and R&D teams to industrialize products, improve manufacturability, standardize solutions, manage technical changes, and align the product portfolio with operational capabilities.
* Establish and continuously improve quality management systems, root-cause problem solving, product and process controls, non-conformity management, and corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across the organization, using structured problem solving, lean principles, process standardization, digital tools, and data-based performance management.
* Own the operations budget and operating cost base in partnership with Finance, including productivity plans, capital expenditure priorities, make-or-buy evaluations, cost reduction, and working capital improvement.
* Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, environmental, health, safety, product, and operational requirements, as well as Generac policies and internal control standards.
* Identify and manage operational risks, business continuity priorities, capacity constraints, supplier dependencies, and execution issues, providing timely visibility and mitigation plans to the CEO and relevant stakeholders.
* Build, lead, and develop high-performing operational teams, strengthening accountability, succession, technical capability, cross-functional collaboration, and a culture of safety, quality, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with the CEO and Generac global leadership, providing transparent reporting on operational performance, priorities, risks, investments, and transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Proven senior operational leadership experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment, with responsibility for complex, cross-functional operations.
* Experience in technology-driven capital equipment businesses, such as diesel or gas generators, HVAC, commercial and industrial pumps, or comparable engineered products; knowledge of the power generation industry is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain, sourcing, quality systems, project execution, service operations, and Environment, Health and Safety.
* Demonstrated success in improving safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory, and customer service through structured operational excellence initiatives.
* Experience in scaling or transforming manufacturing operations and aligning local processes with global standards; exposure to export-oriented operations is a plus.
* Solid financial and commercial acumen, with experience managing operations budgets, capital expenditure, product cost, working capital, and productivity programs.
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, develop management teams, and create strong cross-functional accountability.
* Strategic vision combined with a hands-on, execution-focused leadership style and strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, Operations, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and international environment.

**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a highly skilled SAP DRC Specialist with extensive experience in E-invoicing & E-Reporting.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing end to end implementations of SAP Digital Compliance and E-invoicing solutions to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements.
  
  
This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to streamline invoicing processes and enhance overall efficiency

* SAP DRC Implementation: Lead the implementation and maintenance of SAP Digital Compliance solutions, ensuring compliance with local and international regulations.
* E-invoicing Solutions: Develop and manage E-invoicing and E-Reporting solutions, integrating them seamlessly with SAP systems. Facilitate design workshops and perform DRC specific configurations on S4 and ECC instances
* Compliance Monitoring: Continuously monitor and update compliance requirements, ensuring the company meets all regulatory obligations.
* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to streamline and automate invoicing processes, improving accuracy and efficiency.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with finance, IT, and other relevant departments to ensure successful implementation and operation of E-invoicing solutions.
* Training and Support: Provide training and support to end-users, ensuring they are proficient in using SAP DRC and E-invoicing systems.
* Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to SAP DRC and E-invoicing, minimizing downtime and disruptions.
* Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of processes, configurations, and compliance requirements

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree
* Minimum of 4-5 years of relevant experience in SAP domain in either SD, FI or MM modules
* Proven experience in atleast 3-4 SAP DRC e-Invoicing and/or e-Reporting implementation projects across SAP ECC and S4HANA instances
* Familiarity with regulations related to e-Invoicing and good knowledge of EDI is a plus
* Hands-on experience with BTP integration modules
* Proficiency with external bolt-on solutions such as Edicom, Pagero, Vertex, Sovos, etc.
* Preference for relevant SAP Certification
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Self-driven, detail-orientation
* Ability to work effectively in a team and independently

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Project Manager – Industrial Automation & AI Deployment
description:
# We’re Hiring |
**Project Manager – Industrial Automation & AI Deployment**

\*Company:\* GreenAI Services Pvt. Ltd.

\*Location:\* Kolkata, with regular site visits to steel and process plants

\*Experience:\* Preferably 4–7 years

\*Monthly Salary:\* ₹40,000–₹60,000, depending on experience and expertise

GreenAI is seeking a hands-on professional to manage the on-site execution and deployment of an AI-based Intelligent Dispatch and Synchronization project at a major steel plant in West Bengal.

###
**Your Responsibilities**

- Conduct site surveys and coordinate engineering drawings, equipment specifications, and installation and commissioning plans.

- Coordinate the installation and integration of industrial cameras, edge computing devices, operator displays and wireless communication systems.

- Manage equipment procurement, vendors, contractors and site activities.

- Coordinate daily with GreenAI’s internal AI and software team regarding deployment progress, PLC interfaces, system integration, troubleshooting and necessary implementation changes.

- Report to the designated plant authority and communicate site updates, operational requirements and changes to the internal team.

- Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, documentation, operator training and project progress reporting.

- Ensure compliance with plant safety procedures.

###
**What We’re Looking For**

- Degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation or a related discipline.

- Practical experience with industrial automation, PLC interfacing, industrial networking, site supervision and commissioning.

- Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, diagnose field issues and coordinate execution independently.

- Strong project coordination and communication skills, with willingness to undertake regular site visits.

Experience in steel plants, machine vision, industrial IoT or NVIDIA Jetson systems will be an advantage.

**\*Role Clarification:\***
This is a project management and site execution role, not a software development position. AI model development, coding and software development management are not required.

### To Apply

Send your CV, current location, notice period and details of two relevant projects to \*\*careers@greenai.services\*.

\*Subject:\* Application – Project Manager, Industrial Automation

Master's Degree

title: Assistant General Manager
description:

**The Spirit of the Position**
As an Assistant General Manager, you are a strategic leader, operational expert, and people developer.
  
  
You understand that successful transportation operations require strong leadership, disciplined execution, exceptional customer service, and an unwavering commitment to safety. Through your leadership, business acumen, and operational expertise, you help create an environment where employees can perform at their best while ensuring the organization delivers outstanding service, financial results, and operational performance.
  
  
You bring professionalism, accountability, innovation, and a solutions-oriented mindset to every challenge.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Partner with the General Manager to develop and execute operational and business strategies.

* Develop and measure key performance indicators (KPIs) related to service, safety, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Support organizational change initiatives and operational transformation efforts.

* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, inclusion, and service excellence.
* Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives.
* Conduct performance evaluations, coaching conversations, and talent development activities.
* Promote employee engagement, retention, and workforce development programs.
* Build high-performing teams focused on achieving organizational goals.

**Safety, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable DOT, OSHA, federal, state, local, airport, and company regulations.
* Lead safety initiatives and reinforce a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
* Support audits, inspections, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Identify operational risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Maintain accurate records, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support incident investigations and corrective action efforts when necessary.

**Customer Experience & Stakeholder Relations**

* Champion a customer-first culture that promotes exceptional service delivery.
* Support the development of customer experience initiatives and service enhancements.
* Serve as a key partner to clients, airport stakeholders, vendors, government agencies, and community partners.
* Assist with escalated customer concerns and service recovery efforts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships that support long-term operational success.

**Financial & Administrative Leadership**

* Assist with budget development, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Monitor labor, operational, maintenance, and administrative expenses.
* Analyze financial and operational performance metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining service standards.
* Support revenue growth, cost management, and profitability objectives.
* Oversee vendor relationships and support procurement activities when necessary.

**Team & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with the General Manager to align operational objectives with organizational strategy.
* Support market growth, new business opportunities, transitions, and special projects.
* Promote LAZ Parking's mission, values, and culture throughout the operation.
* Drive innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Perform other duties and leadership responsibilities as assigned.

**Who You Are**
**Strategic Thinker**
You can translate organizational goals into actionable plans and measurable results.
  
  
**Operational Leader**
You understand complex transportation operations and can balance efficiency, service, safety, and financial performance.
  
  
**People Developer**
You enjoy coaching leaders, developing talent, and building high-performing teams.
  
  
**Business-Minded**
You understand financial performance, operational metrics, budgeting, and long-term business sustainability.
  
  
**Collaborative Communicator**
You build strong relationships across all levels of an organization and with external stakeholders.
  
  
**Customer Advocate**
You are passionate about delivering exceptional service and creating positive customer experiences.
  
  
**Qualifications Required**

* Valid driver's license and ability to maintain company-approved driving qualifications and motor vehicle record (MVR) standards.
* Minimum of 3 years of progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, shuttle operations, parking operations, or a related industry.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership experience managing supervisors, managers, or large operational teams.
* Strong knowledge of transportation operations, fleet management, safety programs, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience managing operational performance metrics and business objectives.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coaching, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational reporting systems.

**Preferred**

* Commercial Driver's License (CDL).
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Transportation Management, Logistics, or a related field.
* Airport transportation or shuttle operations experience.
* Experience managing large-scale or multi-site transportation operations.
* Experience supporting collective bargaining agreements or unionized workforces.
* Experience with fleet management systems, transportation technologies, and data analytics tools.
* Experience leading organizational change and operational transformation initiatives.

**Physical Requirements**
**This Position Requires The Ability To**

* Work both indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Stand and walk for extended periods.
* Travel throughout transportation facilities, operational locations, and airport environments.
* Lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds.
* Bend, stoop, squat, and move frequently throughout the workday.
* Safely enter and exit transportation vehicles when operational support is required.
* Occasionally operate shuttle vehicles when business needs require, provided the employee possesses the appropriate licensing and qualifications.
* Communicate effectively in person, by phone, radio, video conference, and email.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.
  
  
**Lead People. Drive Performance. Shape the Future.**
If you are passionate about transportation leadership, operational excellence, employee development, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Join LAZ Airport Services and help lead a world-class transportation operation while developing the next generation of operational leaders.**

Exempt

title: Zoho Systems Lead
description:
**About Pravegh**

Pravegh is a full-service offshore operations management and product development company headquartered in Ahmedabad. We run core business operations for companies across the globe: customer experience, technical support, revenue operations, finance and accounting, and sales operations. Alongside operations, we design and build digital products.

Our operations run on Zoho One, and we are hiring the person who will own it.

**The role**

As Zoho Systems Lead, you will own Pravegh's Zoho systems end-to-end: how they are designed, built, connected, secured and used. You will decide what gets built and how, be the in-house authority on Zoho, and bring in outside partners when the work needs them. You will report to the COO and work closely with the Operations Manager and the team leads.

This is a leadership role for someone who has designed and built Zoho systems, not only administered them.

**Key responsibilities**

**Systems ownership**

* Own Pravegh's Zoho One estate, including CRM, Books, Desk, Analytics and Creator, and the way the apps work together.
* Set the design standards every build follows, and decide what is built where.
* Keep a current system map and change log, so anyone can see what exists and what changed.
* Manage licences, editions and outside Zoho partners against agreed scope.

**Process design and automation**

* Turn how the sales, finance, support and operations teams work into clear, connected processes in Zoho.
* Automate them with workflows, blueprints, Deluge functions and custom modules where standard settings fall short.
* Connect Zoho to other business tools through APIs and webhooks.
* Build and test every change in a sandbox before it reaches live users.

**Data, reporting and security**

* Set data standards so records are complete, consistent and free of duplicates.
* Build dashboards and reports in Zoho Analytics that leadership can rely on without manual work.
* Own access control and data security in Zoho, aligned to standards such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2.

**People and delivery**

* Train each team on the systems they use, and write the SOPs and guides they work from.
* Give the team a fast way to raise system problems, and see each one through to a fix.
* Plan builds with clear owners, deadlines and test cases, and report progress every week.

**What success looks like in your first year**

* Every team works in one connected Zoho system, without side spreadsheets.
* Core processes run from start to finish in the system, with nothing re-keyed between apps.
* Leadership gets the reports it needs straight from the system.
* Every change is tested before release and recorded in the change log.
* The system is documented well enough that any part of it can pass to a trained backup.

**What you bring**

* 5 or more years of hands-on Zoho work, including at least 2 years leading implementations end to end.
* Deep working knowledge of Zoho CRM, Books and Desk, and how they connect.
* Strong Deluge, and hands-on experience with APIs and webhooks.
* Reporting experience in Zoho Analytics or SQL.
* Experience building systems for US businesses.
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain system decisions to people who are not technical.
* The habit of documenting what you build and training users yourself.

**Good to have**

* Zoho certifications.
* Hands-on experience building in Zoho Creator.
* Working knowledge of accounting and inventory processes.
* JavaScript or Python.

**What we offer**

* Full ownership of the Zoho systems our operations run on, with the scope to design them.
* Direct work with the founders, and decisions made in days, not quarters.
* Room to grow as the operation scales.
* Fair and competitive compensation.

**Working hours and location**

Ahmedabad, on-site/hybrid, full-time. Evening shift, 6:30 pm to 3:30 am IST, working US business hours with the operations team.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note on a Zoho system you designed and built end-to-end: what problem it solved, and what changed after. Email: dishant@pravegh.com.

title: Sr. Production Engineer

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Engineer / Assistant Manager – Production

Specialization: Automotive Manufacturing | Rubber Moulding | Shop-Floor Operations

Company: Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Chhatral, Gandhinagar, Gujarat

Experience: 3–7 Years

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or a relevant discipline

Industry Preference: Automobile / Automotive Components Manufacturing

About Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Schilthorn Precision Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturing and engineering company specializing in precision-engineered components and manufacturing solutions. With a focus on quality, productivity, automation, and continuous improvement, we serve demanding industrial and OEM customers through reliable manufacturing capabilities and process-driven operations.

Visit us: https://www.schilthornprecision.com/

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineer – Production with experience in the automobile or automotive components industry, particularly in rubber moulding and related manufacturing processes.

The ideal candidate should have strong shop-floor exposure, a practical understanding of production processes, and the ability to manage manpower, machines, productivity, quality, and delivery commitments. The candidate must be capable of identifying production bottlenecks, resolving process-related issues, reducing rejection and downtime, and driving continuous improvement.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who can take ownership of daily production performance and deliver measurable improvements in manufacturing efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Planning & Shop-Floor Execution

Execute daily and monthly production plans in line with customer requirements and dispatch schedules.

Monitor production output against targets, identify bottlenecks, and take corrective action to achieve planned productivity.

Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machines, tools, moulds, raw materials, and other production resources.

Coordinate with Planning, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Dispatch teams to ensure smooth production flow.

Monitor shift-wise production, work-in-progress, downtime, rejection, and pending orders.

2. Rubber Moulding & Manufacturing Process Control

Manage and monitor rubber moulding operations, where applicable, including process parameters, mould condition, cycle time, and output.

Understand critical moulding parameters such as temperature, pressure, curing time, material preparation, and demoulding.

Identify and troubleshoot process defects such as flash, short moulding, air traps, dimensional variation, and other moulding-related rejections.

Ensure correct machine setup, mould changeover, process settings, and first-piece approval before starting production.

Maintain process consistency and work with Quality and Maintenance teams to minimize mould-related issues and unplanned downtime.

Support process validation, trial runs, new product introduction, and process stabilization.

3. Exposure to Other Manufacturing Processes

Coordinate and control production activities involving relevant processes such as CNC machining, turning, drilling, cutting, fabrication, assembly, or other component-manufacturing operations, depending on product requirements.

Understand process flow, machine capability, tooling requirements, cycle time, and quality checkpoints.

Ensure standard operating procedures and approved process parameters are followed.

Identify opportunities to simplify operations, improve machine utilization, and reduce material wastage.

4. Quality & Rejection Control

Ensure production conforms to approved drawings, specifications, control plans, and customer quality requirements.

Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, and process deviations; initiate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Apply problem-solving tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and 8D, in coordination with the Quality team.

Ensure adherence to in-process inspection, first-piece approval, traceability, and process documentation requirements.

Support customer complaint resolution and corrective/preventive action implementation.

5. Productivity & Continuous Improvement

Track and improve key production KPIs, including output, cycle time, rejection percentage, machine downtime, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Drive initiatives to reduce cycle time, improve yield, minimize changeover time, and eliminate production losses.

Implement 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and other practical shop-floor improvement initiatives.

Analyze recurring production problems and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Support cost reduction through improved process efficiency, manpower utilization, and material consumption.

6. Manpower & Team Management

Allocate operators and workers according to production plans, machine requirements, and skill levels.

Monitor operator performance, attendance, discipline, and adherence to standard work practices.

Train operators on machine operation, process parameters, quality requirements, and safe working practices.

Ensure shift handovers are effective and production issues are communicated clearly.

Build a culture of accountability, productivity, quality ownership, and teamwork.

7. Maintenance, Safety & Documentation

Coordinate with Maintenance for preventive maintenance, breakdown resolution, and reduction of machine downtime.

Ensure proper handling and maintenance of machines, moulds, tools, fixtures, and production equipment.

Enforce shop-floor safety, PPE compliance, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.

Maintain production reports, shift reports, rejection records, downtime logs, and process documentation.

Ensure compliance with applicable work instructions and the company's quality management system.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on measurable shop-floor performance, including:

Achievement of daily and monthly production targets.

Reduction in rejection, rework, and material wastage.

Improvement in machine utilization and production efficiency.

Reduction in machine breakdowns and unplanned downtime.

Adherence to customer delivery schedules.

Improvement in cycle time and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).

Compliance with quality, safety, 5S, and production documentation requirements.

Required Skills & Competencies

Practical knowledge of automotive manufacturing and shop-floor production management.

Hands-on exposure to rubber moulding and mould-related production activities is strongly preferred.

Understanding of manufacturing process parameters, cycle time, tooling, and machine utilization.

Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.

Ability to manage production teams and coordinate across departments.

Knowledge of production planning, rejection control, and continuous improvement techniques.

Working knowledge of Excel and ERP/MRP systems.

Strong ownership, discipline, communication, and execution skills.

Qualification & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.

3–7 years of relevant experience in production, preferably in automotive or automotive component manufacturing.

Candidates with direct experience in rubber moulding, polymer/rubber components, or similar process-driven manufacturing environments will be preferred.

Experience in managing shop-floor manpower, production targets, quality issues, and process improvements is essential.

Familiarity with IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, and MSA will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive, technically sound, and execution-oriented production professional who is comfortable working on the shop floor and taking ownership of production performance.

The candidate should be able to independently handle day-to-day production challenges, troubleshoot process issues, lead operators, improve productivity, and ensure consistent quality and on-time delivery.

Preference will be given to candidates currently working with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, or Tier-2 automotive component manufacturers who have hands-on production experience rather than purely planning or documentation-based experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV mentioning current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and relevant manufacturing-process experience.

Manage the Formation team on the Pilot Line to execute trial builds and chemistry changeovers (e.g., LFP to NMC or other emerging chemistries), achieving trial-run SQDC KPIs. Greenfield

Strong knowledge of Formation operations (Electrolyte Injection, HT Baking, Ageing, Laser welding, EOL Testing) and how parameters shift across chemistries. skilled in exception/NG/CAPA handling and problem-solving tools (8D, Six Sigma, 7 QC, 5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, DOE). title: Director - SLED Proposals & Pursuit Excellence
description:
**What Are We Looking For**
We are not looking for someone whose idea of proposal leadership is reviewing documents after everyone else has finished writing them. We are looking for a builder, problem solver and owner. The right person will see an ambiguous RFP, a fragmented team and an aggressive deadline and instinctively create structure around it. They will ask the difficult questions early, push teams to make decisions, challenge weak assumptions, refuse to submit mediocre work and take personal ownership of the quality of every major pursuit. This person should be comfortable recommending a No-Bid when the facts do not support pursuit, and equally comfortable mobilizing a cross-functional team when Dash decides to compete.
  
  
Pursuit Leadership & Win Strategy
  
  

* Own the proposal lifecycle from qualified opportunity through final submission, clarification, oral presentation and post-award handoff.
* Lead structured Bid/No-Bid decisions based on strategic fit, contract access, customer knowledge, incumbent position, competition, past performance, technical capability, delivery feasibility, economics and probability of win.
* Establish win themes, differentiators, competitive positioning and evaluator-focused response strategies.
* Challenge teams when the solution, evidence or value proposition is not strong enough to win.
* Participate in strategic capture planning for high-value pursuits before RFP release.

Proposal Governance
  
  

* Establish and enforce a repeatable Dash proposal methodology covering kickoff, compliance matrix, proposal outline, writing assignments, solution reviews, executive reviews, production and submission.
* Run a daily or near-daily pursuit war room covering pipeline, active capture, proposal status, risks, dependencies and next actions.
* Ensure every submission is compliant, responsive, persuasive and delivered on time.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation paths so issues are identified early rather than discovered near the deadline.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead the Capture, Proposal Development and Technical Bid/Solution functions in India.
* Coach proposal writers and capture professionals to become stronger strategic contributors rather than task executors.
* Set quality standards and provide direct editorial and strategic feedback.
* Build a culture where people take ownership, communicate risks early and solve problems rather than simply escalating them.

Content & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Develop and govern Dash's reusable public-sector proposal content library.
* Maintain high-quality reusable content for corporate qualifications, technical capabilities, management approaches, transition, staffing, past performance, resumes, security, quality, cloud, data, AI and application modernization.
* Create templates, checklists, review criteria and pursuit playbooks; retire outdated or weak content.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Work closely with U.S. business development, account leaders, solution architects, delivery leaders, finance, legal/compliance, recruiting and executive leadership.
* Convert SME input into a cohesive customer-facing story and hold owners accountable for timely inputs.
* Support oral presentations, demonstrations, clarification responses and negotiations when required.

Continuous Improvement & Metrics
  
  

* Track opportunities reviewed, go decisions, submissions, compliance defects, shortlist/interview rate, awards, win rate, cycle time and reasons for loss.
* Conduct structured win/loss reviews and convert lessons learned into process improvements.
* Identify responsible uses of AI and proposal technology to improve research, content reuse, compliance checking and productivity without compromising confidentiality or accuracy.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in proposals, bids, capture, presales or government contracting.
* Significant direct experience supporting U.S. government opportunities; strong SLED experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex IT services or professional-services proposals.
* Strong understanding of RFP/RFQ/RFI requirements, compliance matrices, evaluation criteria and public-sector procurement processes.
* Exceptional written and spoken business English and strong executive-level editing skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams under aggressive deadlines and challenging senior stakeholders constructively.
* Experience developing proposal processes, templates, content libraries and quality standards.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* APMP certification or meaningful Shipley-style proposal/capture experience.
* Experience with IT services, application development, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, staffing or digital transformation.
* Experience with U.S. state contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, MSP/VMS programs or large government IDIQ-style vehicles.
* Experience managing an India-based proposal/capture team supporting U.S. operations.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Takes ownership even when the problem technically belongs to someone else.
* Hates surprises and surfaces issues before they become emergencies.
* Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Can be demanding without becoming difficult to work with.
* Cares deeply about winning but is disciplined enough to recommend a No-Bid.
* Asks how the team can make the process better after both wins and losses.
* Does not need constant supervision or detailed instructions.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first six months, this leader should have established a predictable capture-to-submission operating model, clear pursuit gates, reusable proposal assets, consistent review practices and measurable visibility into why Dash is winning or losing government pursuits.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Etech Global Services delivers customer experience solutions and proprietary AI technology to Fortune 500 organizations in telecommunications, healthcare, financial services, and retail. Since its founding in 2003, Etech has grown from a single Texas facility with 400 employees to nearly 4,000 team members across seven locations in three countries, managing over 200 million customer interactions annually. Through its ETS Labs division, Etech operates as an AI technology developer, processing more than two billion conversations each year via quality analytics and handling one million voice AI interactions per month. Its core technology product, QEval™, is a quality management platform providing 100 percent interaction coverage and was recognized by ICMI in 2025 as Best New Technology Solution. Etech maintains SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and HIPAA certifications and is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise, reflecting its commitment to security, compliance, and inclusion.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Instructional Designer role based in Gandhinagar. The Instructional Designer will design, develop, and update training programs and learning materials for contact center teams and corporate functions, aligning content with business goals and performance metrics. Daily responsibilities include conducting needs assessments, defining learning objectives, creating curricula, and building digital and instructor-led training modules using appropriate instructional design methodologies. The role involves collaborating with operations, quality, and technology teams to gather requirements, integrate AI-driven insights, and ensure training content remains current and accurate. The Instructional Designer will also support implementation in learning management systems, track learner progress, measure training effectiveness, and recommend improvements based on data and stakeholder
The Instructional Designer designs, builds, and delivers engaging, effective learning experiences — including simulations, e-learning content, and tool/systems training — that improve agent performance and support business outcomes across BPO, enterprise, and other customer programs. This role turns raw source material of almost any kind — a concept raised in a meeting, an idea, an audio or video recording, a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), a QA form/scorecard, or existing training content — into fully built, production-ready learning assets, whether that’s an interactive simulation, an e-learning module, a job aid, or a live tool-training session. The role combines learning science, instructional strategy, content development, and quality assurance to ensure every asset accurately reflects real agent workflows and is calibrated to the learner it’s built for — a brand-new agent, a tenured agent, a job candidate, or an emerging leader.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Learning & Simulation Strategy**

•    
Conduct needs analyses with customers, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to identify performance gaps and define learning objectives for each program.

•    
Apply adult learning principles, cognitive psychology, and instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM, Agile Learning Design) to plan the right mix of simulation, e-learning, and tool training for each request.

•    
Sit in on or review customer and internal meetings to capture a simulation- or course-worthy concept directly from conversation, translating a spoken idea into a structured build plan without needing a formal script.

•    
Identify gaps, ambiguities, or missing steps in source material (recordings, SOPs, QA forms, etc.) and proactively follow up with stakeholders before build begins.

•    
Design storyboards, scripts, and prototypes across delivery methods — digital, classroom, blended, and simulation-based.

**2. Simulation Design & Build**

•    
Convert varied input formats (audio, video, text, SOP, QA form) into a structured simulation flow: scenario, learning objectives, branching logic, prompts, and scoring criteria.

•    
Build simulations end-to-end — call-flow, chat/email, screen-based system, role-play formats, and tool training.

•    
Tailor the build approach to the intended audience and use case: New Hire Onboarding, Ongoing Coaching for tenured agents, Pre-Hire Assessment for candidates, or Leadership Development (coaching conversations, performance reviews, escalation handling).

•    
Integrate emerging technologies and interactive methods such as scenario-based learning and gamification where they improve outcomes.

**3. Content & Course Development**

•    
Develop high-quality learning materials beyond simulations, including e-learning modules, instructor-led (ILT) and virtual instructor-led (vILT) training, microlearning, facilitator guides, job aids, and assessments.

•    
Use authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, or similar to produce polished content.

•    
Ensure accessibility (Section 508/WCAG) and mobile optimization across all materials.

•    
Write clear, concise, engaging instructional copy matched to the audience’s tone and complexity.

**4. Tool & Systems Training**

•    
Design and deliver training on the software tools and systems agents use day to day (e.g., CRM, order management, knowledge base, or client-proprietary systems), in addition to process- and conversation-based simulations.

•    
Build simulations and job aids that accurately replicate real tool workflows and screens, so practice time transfers directly to the live environment.

•    
Support new-program and new-client launches by building the tool-specific training agents need alongside process and soft-skills content.

**5. Quality Assurance & Validation**

•    
QA every simulation and content asset prior to release: test all paths/branches, validate scoring logic against the source QA form or SOP, and confirm accuracy against the real-world process or tool it models.

•    
Confirm difficulty, pacing, and complexity are calibrated correctly for the target learner — new agent vs. tenured agent vs. candidate vs. leader.

•    
Partner with stakeholders during pilot/UAT to gather feedback and revise before go-live.

•    
Maintain a QA checklist/tracker for all builds and manage version control as content is updated.

**6. Measurement & Evaluation**

•    
Define success metrics and design evaluations based on models such as Kirkpatrick or Phillips ROI.

•    
Analyze learner feedback, performance data, and business outcomes to continuously improve simulations and learning programs.

•    
Recommend revisions or new approaches to improve learning effectiveness and retention.

**7. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Management**

•    
Work closely with request owners, support department, learning technologists, graphic designers, and multimedia specialists to produce cohesive learning experiences.

•    
Understand each account’s use case, agent population, and business goals for every request — whether the customer is a BPO, an enterprise team, or another program type.

•    
Collaborate with Product and Engineering to flag platform gaps or feature requests that would improve build efficiency or fidelity.

•    
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines and quality standards; maintain organized documentation and version control in the LMS or project platform.

•    
Support Sales and Pre-Sales with example or demo simulations/content as needed.

**8. Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

•    
Maintain a library of templates, build standards, and reusable components across simulations, e-learning, and tool-training assets.

•    
Document build decisions and QA outcomes for audit and handoff purposes.

* •    
  Contribute to evolving best practices for converting each content type (audio, video, SOP, QA form, freeform concept) into finished learning assets.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:** Project Coordinator

**Reporting to:** Vice President

**Technical Experience:** 2-4 Years, Field Experience: Water & Wastewater treatment industry/relevant industry

**Job Location:** Ahmedabad

**Educational Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech or Diploma Engineer in Mechanical/Electrical/Chemical/Environmental

The **Project Coordinator** plays a key role in the successful planning, execution, and coordination of projects, ensuring that all tasks are completed on time, within scope and within budget. This position requires collaboration with the sales, service, and project management teams to ensure effective communication, timely project delivery, and efficient use of resources.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Assist Sales Team and Management:**

* Support the sales team in project planning and execution, ensuring that all project goals are clearly defined and understood.
* Coordinate the flow of information between the sales and service teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Act as the liaison between the sales team and service team, regularly updating both sides on project progress, timelines, and any potential delays.
* Regularly review the efficiency and effectiveness of service delivery, ensuring that all aspects of the project are on track.

**Coordination from Inception to Completion:**

* Oversee all phases of the project, from the initial planning stages to final delivery, ensuring all deadlines, resources, and deliverables are met.
* Ensure that projects are moving according to established timelines and budgets.
* Assist in managing project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.

**Manage Project Activity Records:**

* Keep comprehensive and organised records of all project activities, ensuring all project tasks are documented and tracked.
* Oversee the timely processing of required materials, documentation, and communication across teams to maintain project flow.

**Coordination with Internal and External Contacts:**

* Maintain and manage internal and external contacts, ensuring timely and effective coordination between all project participants, vendors, and clients.
* Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to maintain open communication channels and mitigate any issues.

**Work Process:**

* Once the work order is received via email, the project coordinator will fill in the necessary data regarding the project in the Project Excel Sheet. This data includes work order value, Payment terms, tentative dispatch date, etc.
* After entry in the Project sheet, the Project coordinator will follow up with Accounts and the respective salesperson for advance payment and bill against advance to be made or not.
* Once the Engineering Team submit the drawings to the client, the project coordinator shall follow up for the bill and payments against submission of the drawings if the payment terms permit the same.
* After approval of the detailed drawing, the Engineering team shall prepare the Main Equipment BOQ and enter it in Tally. The project coordinator shall take follow-up for the same. He shall coordinate and expedite the process if there is any hindrance in BOQ preparation.
* After the drawing submission, the project coordinator shall visit the site and meet the Client on various occasions to build a rapport with the customer.
* Once the site progresses, He shall be in continuous follow-up with the client for dispatch planning as per the tentative dispatch date mentioned in the work order. Also, he shall ask for the necessary store or Plant room with a lock & Key arrangement for material storage at the site after delivery of material.
* The project coordinator shall enforce client takes delivery as per the committed date in the work order. And it is necessary to take email approval from the client regarding material delivery.
* Once the client confirms delivery. The project coordinator will inform the same to purchase Sales and Engineering Team regarding Procurement.
* As the procurement starts, the project coordinator will be in continuous follow-up with the purchase team and the client regarding the delivery date. And also make sure that, as per the payment terms of the work order, the Client will make the payment against the Delivery or intimation of Delivery.
* The project coordinator shall follow up with the Account teams regarding the bill generation against the delivery.
* After delivery of the material, the project coordinator shall be in communication with the Engineering team regarding the completion of installation. As the installation is completed, he will collect the installation report.
* In between the progress of the Site, the Project coordinator will ask the Client to give a review about the Design Engineer, Project engineer & Technician. So that the team can serve the client in a better way.
* The project coordinator shall make sure that the invoice is raised against the completion of installation. And, in parallel, follow up with the client regarding the payment for the installation.
* As the installation progresses, the project coordinator communicates this with the Service team regarding installation and informs them to offer the O&M services of the company to the Client. If necessary, he shall arrange a meeting with the client and the Engineering & service team to introduce the service team.
* If installation is not started due to various reasons from the client side, the project coordinator will ask for the payment against installation as per the work order terms, keeping the respective salesperson informed.
* After installation, the project coordinator shall follow up with the client and the Engineering or Service team regarding commissioning of the project. Once the commissioning starts, He will make sure that all the necessary documents are ready from the engineering team.
* If commissioning is not started due to various reasons from the client side, the project coordinator will ask for the payment against commissioning as per the work order terms, while keeping the respective salesperson informed.
* Once the handover letter is received by email from the Engineering / Service team, the Project coordinator will ask for the final payment from the Customer.
* The project coordinator shall arrange a dispatch planning meeting every 10 days with all respective persons in the meeting from Purchase Engineering, Sales & Accounts team, along with the Vice President.
* The project coordinator shall arrange the Outstanding Payment meeting every week with all respective persons being in the meeting from Sales, Accounts, Service & Engineering Team.
* As and when require Project coordinator will visit the site and meet the Client various times to build rapport with them.
* The project coordinator shall maintain the project sheet on a day-to-day basis.
* This Status Progress Sheet shall be highly accurate, as based on the different team members.

**Working Conditions:**

* Full-time, office-based position with occasional visits to project sites as needed.
* Some travel may be required to coordinate with clients, vendors, and project teams.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously.

**Skills Required:**

* Excellent Interpersonal Skills.
* Excellent Communication Skills (Written & Verbal).
* Problem-Solving & Conflict Resolution.
* Ethical & Confidential Approach.
* Good Communication Skills.
* Efficient decision-making skills.
* Should be a Go Getter & have a Pro Active Approach.
* Good Judgemental Ability about people & Situation.
* Should Possess a Positive Attitude.
* Should Have Clarity of Thoughts

title: Business Transformation Consultant-Supply Chain Planning
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Supply Chain Planning, you will help clients optimize their supply chain operations to achieve better advantaged pricing, greater efficiency, and improved service levels. This role involves identifying and implementing supply chain improvements, transforming operations, and refining or developing business strategies.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Identify Supply Chain Improvements: Analyze existing supply chain operations to identify areas for improvement, and develop strategies to implement changes that drive efficiency and effectiveness.
* Transform Operations: Work with clients to transform their supply chain operations, from suppliers to the ultimate client, to achieve better advantaged pricing and improved service levels.
* Refine Business Strategies: Collaborate with clients to refine or develop business strategies in targeted areas or across the whole supply chain, driving strategic change and competitive advantage.
* Drive Operational Improvements: Recognize operational improvements across various value chain areas, and implement changes to drive next-generation supply chain operations.
* Implement Supply Chain Solutions: Apply knowledge and expertise to implement supply chain solutions that meet client needs and drive business results.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Supply Chain Operations: Experience working with supply chain operations, including analyzing existing processes to identify areas for improvement and developing strategies to implement changes.
* Understanding of Business Strategy Development: Exposure to refining or developing business strategies in targeted areas or across the whole supply chain, driving strategic change and competitive advantage.
* Familiarity with Operational Improvement Initiatives: Experience working with initiatives that drive operational improvements across various value chain areas, including implementing changes to drive next-generation supply chain operations.
* Knowledge of Supply Chain Solution Implementation: Exposure to implementing supply chain solutions that meet client needs and drive business results, including applying knowledge and expertise to drive efficiency and effectiveness.
* Experience with Value Chain Analysis: Experience working with value chain analysis to recognize operational improvements and drive strategic change.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Next-Generation Supply Chain Knowledge: Exposure to next-generation supply chain operations, including recognizing operational improvements across various value chain areas.
* Strategic Change Implementation: Experience working with initiatives that drive strategic change and competitive advantage in supply chain operations.
* Value Chain Analysis Skills: Exposure to value chain analysis to identify areas for improvement and drive business results.

title: Project Manager

* Coordinate with clients and understand project requirements.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:
