Test Lead will manage end to end quality assurance for Adobe Experience Manager implementations within a hybrid work model focusing on user management and experience driven solutions. The role requires five to seven years of testing experience strong AEM technical expertise and the ability to design and execute robust test strategies that enhance product reliability improve customer experience and support the company mission of delivering trusted digital solutions without travel requiremen
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead comprehensive test planning and execution for Adobe Experience Manager implementations to ensure high reliability and seamless digital experiences for end users.
* Coordinate test activities across hybrid onsite and remote teams to maintain consistent quality standards and smooth communication throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Design detailed test strategies and scenarios for AEM components including templates workflows and integrations to validate functional and non functional requirements.
* Develop and maintain reusable test cases and regression suites focused on user management flows and experience personalization to support ongoing product evolution.
* Oversee defect management including logging prioritization and tracking to closure while collaborating with developers and business stakeholders to prevent recurrence.
* Provide clear test progress reports and risk assessments that support timely decision making and help safeguard release schedules and business outcomes.
* Analyze requirements and solution designs to identify testability gaps and propose improvements that strengthen the overall quality of AEM based platforms.
* Guide the adoption of test automation for critical AEM journeys by partnering with automation engineers to increase coverage and reduce manual effort over time.
* Collaborate closely with product owners and business analysts to ensure that test coverage reflects real user management scenarios and experience expectations.
* Validate AEM content authoring workflows and publishing processes to help business teams manage digital content efficiently and safely.
* Conduct root cause analysis on recurring defects and recommend actionable improvements in development and testing practices to enhance long term stability.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives in the quality organization by sharing best practices and lessons learned from AEM testing engagements.
* Ensure that test activities align with company standards regulatory expectations and industry good practices to protect user trust and brand reputation.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate five to seven years of hands on software testing experience with a strong focus on enterprise digital platforms and content management solutions.
* Possess solid practical expertise in Adobe Experience Manager including component validation workflow testing and integration checks across environments.
* Bring experience in testing user management features such as authentication authorization role management and profile handling within digital ecosystems.
* Show familiarity with experience driven design principles and be able to translate them into meaningful test scenarios that reflect real user journeys.
* Apply strong analytical and problem solving skills to interpret requirements create detailed test conditions and identify potential quality risks early.
* Utilize effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross functional teams in a hybrid setup and ensure shared understanding of quality goals.
* Exhibit awareness of modern testing practices including test automation frameworks for web applications and be willing to support their integration into AEM projects.
* Maintain a structured approach to documentation including test plans cases and reports that provide transparency and traceability for audits and reviews.
* Adapt quickly to changing project priorities and evolving AEM features while keeping focus on delivering dependable releases in a day shift environment.

title: Lead Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Lead Consultant – Software Implementation
  
  
As a Lead Consultant, you will lead the successful implementation of software solutions for clients across multiple geographies. You will combine strong SQL and software implementation expertise with consulting, stakeholder management, and customer-facing skills to deliver projects from discovery through go-live and post-production support.
  
  
This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, client-focused professional who can understand business requirements, configure and deploy product solutions, conduct testing and training, and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with customers and internal teams, including Product Development, Support, Pre-Sales, Sales, and Technology.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end software implementation projects from kickoff through go-live, hypercare, and transition to the support team.
* Conduct business requirements workshops to understand customer needs, assess product fitment, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Design, configure, develop, test, and deploy software package solutions based on client requirements.
* Use SQL for data analysis, configuration, troubleshooting, validation, and implementation support.
* Collaborate with customers to define and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and resolve identified issues.
* Support production-readiness planning, go-live activities, and post-production support for escalated issues.
* Deliver customer training on product functionality, configuration, and effective system usage.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships and manage key stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including requirements, solution designs, test plans, training materials, and handover documents.
* Deliver projects within agreed scope, budget, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Apply quality assurance processes, including unit testing, regression testing, system integration testing, and UAT.
* Partner with Pre-Sales and Sales teams on proposals, high-level solution designs, demonstrations, prototypes, and proof-of-concept activities.
* Participate in consulting engagements such as solution health checks, roadmap workshops, and advisory sessions, as needed.
* Collaborate with internal teams across Product Development, Technology, Support, Pre-Sales, Sales, and Product teams to resolve issues and improve solutions.
* Support the handover of implemented solutions to product support teams after production deployment.
* Travel to client locations for implementation, workshops, product demonstrations, and related customer-facing activities, as required.
* Contribute to practice development, knowledge sharing, competency-building initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Use AI-enabled development and testing tools, where appropriate, to improve delivery efficiency and quality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, with strong exposure to Information Technology and/or Business Management.
* 4–10 years of relevant experience in SQL programming, software implementation, product development, technical support, or a related technology consulting role.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including data analysis, querying, troubleshooting, and supporting software implementations.
* Experience in at least one of the following areas:Software or enterprise product implementationProduct developmentApplication or product supportTechnology consulting
* Experience gathering and analyzing business requirements and translating them into practical product or solution configurations.
* Experience supporting testing activities, including UAT, system integration testing, regression testing, or unit testing.
* Strong customer-facing consulting, influencing, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong planning, organization, documentation, and time-management skills, with close attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver work within defined scope, timelines, and budgets.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Working knowledge of project and issue-management tools such as JIRA.
* Ability and willingness to travel to customer locations as business needs require.
* Positive, collaborative mindset and a strong willingness to learn.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Global Trade, trade compliance, supply chain processes, or related business domains.
* Experience implementing or supporting large enterprise systems, such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Thomson Reuters products or relevant competitor products.
* Experience supporting customers in Japan, China, or other Asia-Pacific markets.
* Proficiency in additional languages, particularly Japanese and/or Chinese.
* Experience assisting Pre-Sales or Sales teams with proposals, solution design, demonstrations, prototypes, or proof-of-concept engagements.
* Experience conducting consulting engagements such as system health checks, solution assessments, or roadmap workshops.
* Familiarity with AI tools used for software development, testing, documentation, data analysis, or delivery productivity.
* Experience working in a globally distributed delivery environment.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
  
  
Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
  
  
More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

title: Senior Team Lead
description: Who we areBorn in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings. From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.Our dedication to our mission and our team is why Yoti was proudly named one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026 in the UK. About the roleYou will manage two squads of 5-7 engineers, delivering across several Yoti products. There are a number of additional critical responsibilities aside from general engineering management.The first is security. You own secure by design practice for the services your teams run: threat models, review discipline, dependency and secrets hygiene, and the unglamorous work of closing findings before an auditor asks about them.The second is AI, and we mean something specific by it. This is not a role about training models. It is about how software gets built here. We are standardising on an AI native SDLC, and we are building it now.We measure outcomes and we expect a Senior Team Lead to have a view on what should be built and how much of it, not just how fast it can ship. If a spec asks for six months of work to reach a result you could test in three weeks, we want you to say so before our time investment.What AI native means hereOur engineers work with coding agents daily, mostly Claude Code, and the standard is written to work across Codex and Copilot too. Three things sit underneath it:Work is spec driven. A change is described as a spec before it is built, and a verification gate scores that spec and checks it against a short engineering constitution before anyone starts implementing.Capabilities are skills, not prompts people keep in a scratch file. Commands and agents are committed as SKILL and files in a shared repository, so a skill written once works in every assistant the team uses.Context is shared, not copied. Project context lives in AGENTS and company knowledge lives in one knowledge repository that both humans and agents read.So thinking in agents and skills is a real part of the job. When a task keeps recurring, the answer is usually a skill in the shared repository or a variant of an existing one, not another private workflow that nobody else can find.What you'll doLead the teamsManage a team lead and engineers across two squads: hiring, onboarding, growth, performance and retention.Coach and develop team leads and engineers, and build the bench beneath you.Set how the teams work day to day, including planning, review, on call and postmortems.Make it safe to raise a security concern or say an agent's output is wrong, even when it slows a release down.Scope and ship productsPartner with product managers as a peer. Push back on scope, propose smaller versions that answer the same question, and know which requirements really matter.Hold the teams to the outcome behind the work. Be able to say what a release was supposed to change for a customer, and whether it did.Own delivery end to end for your squads: scope, sequencing, dependencies, quality and a release cadence people can plan around.Arbitrate between products competing for the same shared platform work, and be honest with everyone about the trade offs.Keep reliability, security and compliance work funded alongside features instead of parked behind them.Represent your teams to stakeholders in the UK and other Yoti locations, and to customers when it helps.Own security engineeringMake threat modelling, secure review, dependency and supply chain management, secrets handling and least privilege access normal practice rather than a checklist.Drive remediation from penetration tests, bug bounty reports and internal reviews, with named owners and dates.Lead your teams' part in incident response, including out of hours escalation and postmortems that name causes rather than people.Treat biometric and identity data with the retention and minimisation discipline it needs.What we're looking forEssentialExcellent written and verbal communication skillsSubstantial engineering management experience, typically 7 years or more, including managing senior engineers or tech leads, on top of a strong hands on background.Building or scaling an engineering team in India inside a globally distributed company.Salesforce experience, working with it or on it directlyExperience with one or more of the following languages, Javascript, Typescript, Golang or Apex Experience with postgresA Harness experience like claude code, codex or Cursor.Experience running more than one team or workstream at once, across multiple products.You use a coding agent daily and have opinions about it. You can say what you delegate, what you read line by line, and where agents reliably let you down.You have built reusable AI capability, not just had good chats: skills, subagents, prompts or tooling that other people went on to use.A real track record of shipping and running secure production software. You can talk about threat models you wrote, findings you prioritised and incidents you led.A product instinct. You have shaped scope, cut features that were not earning their place, and can point at outcomes your teams moved rather than a list of things they shipped.Comfort with written specs and design docs as the way decisions get made, since the verification gate depends on it.Solid modern backend engineering, CRM experience, cloud experience and containers and CI/CD.Clear writing, and the patience to work with colleagues several time zones away.Judgement about risk. You know when to block a release and when the right answer is to ship with a mitigation and a date.Nice to haveClaude Code in particular: subagents, MCP servers, plugins, or packaging skills for a team to install.Spec driven development with OpenSpec, Spec Kit or something similar.Identity, biometrics, age assurance, fintech or another regulated and privacy sensitive domain.Exposure to audit and certification work, and to the security questionnaires that come with enterprise customers.Interview Process Stage 1 - Call with a Talent acquisition Team member (30 minutes)Stage 2 - Screening TestStage 3 - Take Home TestStage 4 - Call with Tech Lead and Senior QA Engineer (75 minutes)Stage 5 - Call with Product Manager and Director of Engineering (120 minutes)What’s in it for you? Flexible working (Core working hours, Hybrid working)Performance based discretionary annual bonusLTIP (Long term incentive plan)Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhsLife Insurance / Accidental coverGratuity as per law PF as per law18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Annually) 10 declared holidays (Annually) 5 fully paid days of Selfie Time - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etcQuarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs. Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc) This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. We value a positive attitude and people who have a collaborative, creative and transparent approach to solving problems.AI Usage during the recruitment processPlease read our AI Usage in Recruitment policy to know more about how Yoti uses AI in the recruitment process and our stance on how candidates can use AI during the interview process. We believe in equal opportunitiesIt takes a diverse community of passionate, talented and committed people to build a simpler, more secure way of proving identity. We’re an equal opportunity employer, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, with different outlooks and experiences. We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible. If you have a disability or long-term condition and need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’ll do everything we can to support you and to enable you to bring your best self to our hiring process.Pre-employment checksIf your application is successful please be aware that as part of our pre-employment checks, we will check identity and proof of education. If you have previously been employed elsewhere, we will also carry out - Employment, Credit and Database Checks. For more information about how we manage your data please read our Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Technology Delivery Manager
description:
Software/Technology Delivery Manager (Portal)

Exp - 15+ years

Location -
**Bengaluru / Hyderabad**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Lead end-to-end delivery of Java-based Group and Individual Life Insurance portal applications, ensuring successful

project execution, stakeholder satisfaction, engineering quality and operational excellence. The role owns delivery

across development, enhancement and support, coordinating cross-functional teams and aligning technology outcomes

with client and business objectives.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Manage end-to-end delivery of development, enhancement and production-support initiatives for insurance portals built using

Java/J2EE and React.

• Lead cross-functional teams including Java developers, React developers, QA engineers, Business Analysts, solution

architects and support teams.

• Drive project planning, estimation, scheduling, resource and capacity allocation, dependency management, risk mitigation and

status reporting.

• Partner with client and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage scope and priorities, resolve delivery issues and

maintain alignment with business objectives.

• Ensure adherence to Agile/Scrum and SDLC practices, including requirements traceability, design reviews, code quality, test

strategy, release controls and deployment readiness.

• Oversee production support, service-level agreement (SLA) compliance, incident/problem management, root-cause analysis

and continuous improvement.

• Manage project budgets, forecasts, utilization, delivery metrics and resource plans; provide transparent reporting on cost,

quality, schedule and risk.

• Coordinate integration across portal applications, REST APIs, microservices, databases and relevant policy administration,

enrolment, billing and premium-administration systems.

• Drive quality engineering, regression automation, CI/CD, DevOps collaboration and controlled releases to improve reliability

and delivery speed.

• Lead and coach delivery managers, technical leads and team members; foster accountability, collaboration, stakeholder

confidence and continuous learning.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

• Strong experience with Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, microservices and REST APIs.

• Working knowledge of React and modern web-portal development.

• Knowledge of SQL and database-driven enterprise applications.

• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, release automation and production monitoring.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum; ability to operate within Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.

• Strong understanding of SDLC, software quality assurance, testing, release management and production support.

**INSURANCE DOMAIN EXPERTISE**

• Group Life Insurance and Individual Life Insurance.

• Group Benefits and Voluntary Benefits.

• Policy administration and policy servicing.

• Enrolment and member portals; digital journeys for members, employers and other authorized users.

• Billing, premium administration and related insurance operations.

• Preferred: delivery of digital transformation and modernization programs for US life-insurance clients.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

• 15+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 5 years in delivery management.

• Experience in Life Insurance, Group Benefits, Group Life or Voluntary Benefits domains.

• Proven track record of managing large-scale application development and support engagements.

• Experience with Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.

• Strong understanding of SDLC, release management and quality assurance processes.

• Excellent communication, client and stakeholder management, people leadership and problem-solving skills.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

• End-to-end delivery management and execution discipline.

• People leadership, team development and cross-functional collaboration.

• Client relationship management and executive stakeholder communication.

• Project risk, financial management, forecasting and resource planning.

• Strategic planning, prioritization and continuous improvement.

• Clear communication, transparent escalation and evidence-based decision-making.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

• On-time delivery of committed milestones and releases.

• Client satisfaction, SLA attainment and timely closure of escalations.

• Production stability, incident trends, defect leakage and mean time to restore.

• Budget and forecast accuracy; effective capacity and resource utilization.

• Quality of releases, adherence to delivery methods and continuous improvement outcomes.

• Portal usability, integration reliability and support for member/employer journeys.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

• Experience delivering digital transformation and modernization programs for US Life Insurance clients.

• Experience with Group and Individual Life Insurance portals, policy administration integrations and digital enrolment journeys.

• Experience leading distributed teams and collaborating with North American clients.

title: AI Test Architect
description:
**About The Job**
As a specialist in electronics and software for the past 20 years, in-tech is a dynamic, fast-growing engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany, employing around 2,350 employees globally across 20 project locations in 8 countries. in-tech develops innovative engineering solutions for the automotive, rail, aerospace, defence, and industrial sectors.
  
  
We are committed to a flexible, modern work culture and work-life balance. Our colour orange stands for liveliness, warmth, and dynamism. We value a strong team spirit, fresh ideas, and a positive work culture. We call it the “Orange Spirit”!
  
  
Since 2024, in-tech has been a subsidiary of Infosys Ltd. This strategic partnership enables us to offer our customers more comprehensive development and digitalisation services, along with greater offshore capability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**AI-Enabled Test Architect**
to join our team. In this role, you will define and implement modern test architecture, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled quality engineering strategies for enterprise software products and platforms. If you are passionate about software quality, test automation, and emerging AI technologies, we would love to connect with you!
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Define and implement test architecture and quality engineering strategies for enterprise software products, platforms, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
  
  
Design comprehensive testing approaches covering functional, API, UI, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  
  
Develop scalable and reusable test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, or equivalent tools.
  
  
Design test orchestration solutions covering parallel execution, test environments, test data, cross-browser testing, and automated reporting.
  
  
Integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines, supporting shift-left and continuous testing practices.
  
  
Apply GenAI and LLM-assisted testing, including prompt and context engineering for test generation, test data creation, test automation, and test documentation.
  
  
Use AI for test-result summarization, test failure analysis, defect triaging, defect classification, and root-cause analysis.
  
  
Establish quality metrics, automation standards, governance practices, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring engineering and testing teams.
  
  
**Requirements**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical field.
  
  
8+ years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, test automation, or test architecture.
  
  
Proven experience designing test strategies and architectures for enterprise applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, or equivalent test automation technologies.
  
  
Experience building scalable automation frameworks and integrating automated testing into CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.
  
  
Strong understanding of functional, API, UI, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing, including test orchestration and test data management.
  
  
Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM-assisted testing, prompt and context engineering, AI-generated test artifacts, test-result analysis, defect triaging, and root-cause analysis.
  
  
Proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, along with strong English communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.
  
  
**Apply with us**
If you have experience and team spirit and are looking for a great place to work, then start your job with us.
  
  
As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, in-tech is committed to equal employment opportunity without regard for age, race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion
  
  
We develop technologies that make the future possible: As an engineering and digitalization partner, we support our customers in developing intelligent, connected, and software-based systems. Through engineering excellence, innovative technologies, and global collaboration, we create sustainable value and accelerate innovation. At the same time, we foster an environment where people take pride in helping to shape the technologies of tomorrow.

Fuelled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are integral to innovation at scale. You will work with technologists and business specialists, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. We are advancing Finance with digital proficiencies and tools to become an informative partner that accelerates decision-making, optimizes resources, and fuels innovation. Our focus is on identifying what matters most, prioritizing initiatives with real impact, sequencing change strategically, and bringing discipline to our transformation efforts.
  
  
As a member of IMFT, you’ll be at the heart of delivering an integrated, multi-functional transformation that optimizes resources, investment allocation, and value creation across the organization.
  
  
**We are searching for the Best talent for IMUAM Deployment Manager**
The IM UAM Deployment Manager provides leadership and delivery accountability for UAM deployment activities within the J&J Innovative Medicine (IM) UAM team. This role is responsible for managing individual Transcend S/4HANA releases and other UAM projects from PI execution through testing, cutover preparation and execution, go-live, hypercare, and transition to steady state. The role combines people leadership, stakeholder management, project governance, issue resolution, and functional expertise in authorization design, Segregation of Duties (SoD), access governance, and compliance within a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
  
  
**You will be responsible for**

* Manage UAM deployment delivery for individual Transcend SAP S/4HANA releases in a regulated pharmaceutical environment, ensuring execution of the global UAM deployment strategy in line with deployment milestones, quality expectations, and program governance requirements.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 3-5 Security Analysts, setting priorities, providing guidance, supporting performance and development discussions, and aligning team activities with J&J and UAM talent development expectations.
* Own UAM deployment readiness across all deployment phases, ensuring persona design, testing, cutover/provisioning, and hypercare activities are planned, resourced, monitored, and completed in line with release milestones and entry/exit criteria.
* Drive planning, prioritization, and execution control across UAM deployment activities, including progress tracking, dependency management, risk and issue escalation, and integration with broader program plans.
* Oversee role design quality and compliance health checks before build, before cutover, and after go-live to confirm alignment with authorization principles, SoD controls, and applicable compliance expectations.
* Manage cutover planning for access deployment activities, including role transport sequencing, user provisioning readiness, emergency access planning, business validation steps, issue escalation, and stakeholder alignment.
* Manage hypercare support and transition to steady state, ensuring access issues are prioritized, root causes are understood, remediation actions are tracked, and ownership is clearly handed over to operational teams.
* Provide oversight of SoD risks, sensitive access, and mitigation actions during deployment, ensuring risks are visible, appropriately escalated, and managed to support compliant access enablement in regulated environments.
* Establish, monitor, and communicate UAM deployment KPIs and management reporting, including defect volumes, role readiness, cutover completion, provisioning accuracy, open risks, and hypercare stabilization trends.
* Drive continuous improvement of the UAM deployment framework by applying lessons learned from releases to strengthen methodology, controls, templates, deployment efficiency, taxonomy, governance, and the operating model.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or university-level qualification in a relevant field, such as Finance, Supply Chain, IT, or Engineering.
* Minimum of 8 years’ relevant experience in international companies, including at least 5 years of people management or team leadership experience.
* Expertise in business role design and SAP security concepts.
* Demonstrable experience managing ERP deployment programs and project delivery in sophisticated, multi-functional environments.
* Solid understanding of sophisticated system landscapes and global template design.
* Good knowledge of SAP S/4HANA authorization concepts and familiarity with compliance requirements such as SOX, GxP, IT, and Privacy.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation projects.
* Specialist knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control, Process Control, and identity management tools.
* Good understanding of SoD, mitigation, and remediation concepts.
* Good knowledge of risk matrix and rule set maintenance.
* Specialist knowledge of data analysis, data conversion, and migration.
* Solid project management, planning, prioritization, and execution leadership skills.
* Ability to lead and empower teams in a virtual or remote working environment.
* Strong collaborator management, communication, collaboration, presentation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written English skills.
* Experience influencing and collaborating across large business, IT, security, and compliance organizations.
* Collaborative, value-based, and outcome-oriented leadership style with the ability to manage teams, develop talent, and drive accountability.
* Experience establishing or operating UAM governance frameworks, including standards, policies, decision forums, and performance metrics to supervise progress and accountability.
* Experience managing compliance requirements, change impacts, and stakeholder expectations during technology or process transformation programs.

These products enable critical internal capabilities across the firm, supporting operational excellence and technology modernization objectives.

* Develop metrics to assess the success of products and features and resolve vital enhancements

A technically fluent, outcome-driven product leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to engage deeply in delivery detail. Someone who can coach teams, manage complex technical dependencies, and drive clarity between business intent and engineering execution
  
  
A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition and passion!

title: Quality Assurance Lead - Automation/Manual Testing
description:
**Job Description**
**Role :**
QA Lead (Automation + Manual).
  
  
**Location :**
Bengaluru.
  
  
**Experience :**
8+ Years.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for a hands-on QA Lead with 8+ years of experience in manual and automation testing to own quality for the platform, including HiApp (the Optometrist-facing operations application), the Customer Portal, the Operations Portal, and the AI chatbot engine.
  
  
You will set the test strategy, build and maintain automation, guide a small team of QA engineers, and act as the quality gate for every release in a healthcare, patient-facing environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the test strategy, test plans, and quality metrics across web applications, APIs, and AI-driven conversational features.
* Lead and mentor QA engineers; allocate work, review test assets, and raise the overall quality bar of the team.
* Design, build, and maintain UI and API automation frameworks and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
* Plan and execute functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing, balancing manual and automated coverage.
* Own release readiness and sign-off, acting as the quality gate within the release control process.
* Test integrations with CRMs, messaging channels, and third-party services, including webhook and API behavior.
* Validate AI/chatbot behavior for accuracy, consistency, and regressions alongside product and AI engineering teams.
* Support performance and load testing of critical user journeys.
* Lead defect triage and root cause analysis; track defect trends and report quality status to stakeholders.
* Maintain traceable test documentation suitable for a regulated healthcare environment.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, DevOps, and support teams for timely and quality delivery.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software quality assurance, with strong depth in both manual and automation testing.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and owning test strategy for a product.
* Hands-on experience building automation frameworks for web UI and REST APIs using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Postman.
* Strong understanding of test design, regression strategy, defect lifecycle, and risk-based testing.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
* Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to validate data across APIs and databases.
* Experience working in Agile teams with frequent releases.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including clear defect and status reporting.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in healthcare, medtech, or another regulated environment (e.g., awareness of IEC 62304 or ISO 13485).
* Experience testing AI/LLM-based or conversational applications.
* Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or k6.
* Exposure to Azure-hosted applications and log analysis tools.
* ISTQB or equivalent certification.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* A team player who adapts quickly and works well in cross-functional teams.
* Proactive in identifying issues, suggesting solutions, and driving them to closure.
* Committed to quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.

title: UX Designer
description:
**The Opportunity**
As part of the Global Design organization, the design team is seeking a designer for our Bangalore office. We are looking for someone who is skilled at solving design problems in a highly complex domain. The right candidate will enjoy working on enterprise-level products and might have some familiarity with the market space Nutanix operates in.
  
  
"Design" and "Customer delight" are embedded in every step of our product cycle. Nutanix has a design-first philosophy that brings consumer-grade design and web-scale engineering together to create an amazing user experience that has only been seen in the consumer world with the likes of Apple and Tesla. Visit our career page to find out more about life at Nutanix.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Nutanix, you will be part of the dynamic Design Team, comprising creative and innovative professionals spanning India, the US, and Berlin. Our team thrives on collaboration and out-of-the-box thinking, ensuring that we not only meet design standards but also push the boundaries of what's possible in technology. We celebrate diversity and encourage unique perspectives, allowing us to create cutting-edge solutions together.
  
  
You will report to the Director of Design, who fosters an environment of guidance and mentorship. Our work setup is hybrid, allowing for flexibility while promoting team synergy—with a requirement to be in the office 3 days a week. This balance ensures that you can collaborate closely with your teammates while also enjoying the benefits of remote work.
  
  
Your Role
  
  

* Ramp up quickly on the Nutanix product domain, processes and culture.
* Take ownership of features or product areas and work collaboratively with PM, Engineering and other stakeholders to discuss requirements and constraints.
* Understand problems with medium complexity and create simple and elegant design solutions.
* Produce high-quality UX designs based on first principles and data, while meeting schedules and deadlines.
* Present designs to key stakeholders with the rationale for design decisions with the goal of building consensus and improving the product experience.
* Proactively facilitate teamwork to accomplish common goals.
* Plan, conduct, document and present research work related to their product areas.
* Work with UI development and backend engineering teams to ensure effective execution of designs

What You Will Bring
  
  

* Strong interaction design skills with an ability to look beyond pixels, and look at workflows in the context of the user’s life.
* Have an ability to challenge the status quo, focus conversations on the user, and produce UX designs with attention to detail, down to the micro-interactions.
* Willingness to take feedback and learn from designers and other stakeholders.
* Work effectively in a fast-moving environment, juggle multiple projects, and prioritize work.
* Strong presentation and communication skills
* Be a strong team player valuing collaboration.
* Bias towards being organized and thinking about repeatability and scale.
* Passion for improving our product users' lives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Have a strong UX design portfolio showing examples of consumer-grade design of products in complex domains
* Proficiency with Figma and /or Sketch.
* Familiarity with user research & usability testing techniques.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively and concisely.
* Experience working across multiple phases of design (interaction, visual design, and prototyping).
* 5+ years of experience in user experience design for web applications with a Bachelor’s degree in Interaction / UX design; or a bachelor's degree in engineering with a Master’s degree in design.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated proficiency in at least 1 of (with an interest in 1 more of) :
* UX research (qul, quant, remote etc.)
* Design sprints / workshops

title: Senior Software Engineer II - AI
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
This is more than a full-stack role — it's your chance to build the AI layer of the platform the world's infrastructure runs on. Sitetracker is building Scout, our AI product line: production LLM systems and agentic workflows embedded in the software companies like Cox, Telefónica, and EVgo use to deploy critical infrastructure. As a Product Engineer, you'll take AI capabilities from idea to production agent orchestration and model integration on the backend, and the web and mobile experiences that put them in customers' hands.
  
  
This is shipping real, customer-facing AI , not prototypes or research demos. You'll own features end-to-end, work with frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI), and see your work land in the hands of enterprise users deploying telecom networks, EV chargers, and renewable energy around the world.
  
  
What You’ll do:
  
  
As a Product Engineer on Scout, you'll hit the ground running and ship customer-facing AI from day one. You'll design, build, test, deploy, and monitor AI product features end-to-end , building agentic LLM systems with multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering over frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI.
  
  
You'll work across the full stack: backend services in Python, Java, Node.js, or Go, and TypeScript/React frontends spanning both web and mobile app experiences. You'll make AI dependable by building automated evaluation pipelines, guardrails, and testing strategies for non-deterministic outputs — and running it on production infrastructure: scalable, fault-tolerant services on AWS and Kubernetes.
  
  
You'll think like a product engineer, not a ticket-taker: dig into user needs, absorb the problem space, make smart calls about what to build, keep stakeholders informed, and find ways to unblock yourself.
  
  
The Skills You’ll Have:
  
  
**Full-Stack Product Engineering**

* Build production backend services in one or more of Python (FastAPI or similar), Java, Node.js, or Go
* Ship production web interfaces in TypeScript and React; mobile app development (React Native or similar) is a plus
* Design REST APIs and data models across relational and NoSQL databases
* Own features end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring

**AI / LLM Engineering**

* Build with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI): agentic workflows, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering. Production experience preferred; substantial personal or open-source projects considered
* Write evaluation pipelines and testing strategies for non-deterministic AI outputs
* Bonus: agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI), Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMOps tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse), vector databases, or model serving (vLLM, GPU inference)

**Production Systems & AI Infrastructure**

* Deploy and operate services on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (Scout runs on AWS)
* Instrument systems with observability and handle customer data securely in AI systems
* Design fault-tolerant, scalable services that serve AI workloads reliably
* Salesforce platform and Apex — Scout integrates with the Sitetracker Salesforce platform

**Product Thinking & Communication**

* Dig into user needs and use that context to decide what to build and how
* Explain technical decisions and AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
* Break challenges into iterative solutions, keep stakeholders informed, and unblock myself

**Within 90 Days, You’ll:**

* Ramp up on Scout's architecture, codebase, and AI tooling
* Ship your first AI-driven product features with support from senior engineers
* Build a working knowledge of our evaluation pipelines and deployment workflow on AWS

**Within 180 Days, You’ll:**

* Independently deliver AI product features end-to-end, with increasing complexity
* Contribute to design discussions and team best practices for secure, scalable AI development
* Own the quality of your features in production: monitoring, evals, and iteration

**Within 365 Days, You’ll:**

* Consistently deliver well-crafted, end-to-end AI product capabilities that increase velocity and throughput
* Elevate team quality through strong technical work, thoughtful code reviews, and knowledge sharing
* Serve as a go-to contributor for agentic systems on Scout

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Product Owner- Client Due Diligence, CLM
description:
**Job Summary**
The Product Owner, WRB Client Due Diligence is accountable for defining, prioritising, and governing the change backlog for WRB client due diligence capabilities across onboarding, periodic review, trigger-based review, and associated control journeys. The role translates regulatory, policy, client, operations, and market needs into a clear product roadmap and execution backlog, ensuring that due diligence journeys are effective, efficient, auditable, and aligned to risk and control requirements.
  
  
The role partners with business, operations, risk, compliance, technology, data, and journey teams to deliver a product that improves client and frontline experience while maintaining strong due diligence, screening, evidence, and decision-control outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* The Product Owner (PO) is a sole person (not a committee), who is responsible for owning the end-to-end customer journeys and product vision & lifecycle. They have a delegated authority and empowerment to prioritize the product backlog to maximize the value of our products or services for both our customers and our business. Their core ethos is to make informed decisions to ensure each investment decision results in the maximum (as measured by OKRs) outcome balancing both short-medium- and long-term horizons.

**Strategy**

* Own the WRB Client Due Diligence product backlog, roadmap, and prioritisation across onboarding, maintenance, periodic review, trigger review, and remediation journeys.
* Translate business objectives, policy requirements, control needs, and user pain points into clearly defined epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Define target outcomes for the due diligence product, including control effectiveness, turnaround-time improvement, rework reduction, and user experience simplification.
* Set clear release priorities and make trade-off decisions across value, risk reduction, regulatory need, operational impact, and delivery capacity.

**Business**

* Work with frontline, operations, and service users to understand pain points, workflow bottlenecks, evidence needs, and improvement opportunities in WRB due diligence journeys.
* Work with journey, design, and service teams to improve staff and client experience across due diligence journeys, including hand-offs, alerts, case actions, and status visibility.
* Ensure delivered backlog items address genuine user needs while preserving required control points and operational clarity
* Manage dress rehearsals with end users, technology teams for successful completion of user verification and conversion verification tests
* Co-ordinate and manage the various stages of end user testing such as UAT [User acceptance testing), UVT & CVT (User Verification Test & Conversion Verification Test)
* Serves as the SME for dress rehearsals and conversion related activities
* Supports pre- & post Implementation activities in countries as business champion

**Processes**

* Drive alignment between business process, policy interpretation, data capture, document collection, case management, exception handling, and evidence retention requirements.
* Ensure the backlog reflects market, segment, and risk-tier considerations for WRB client due diligence while maintaining maximum standardisation where possible.
* Requirement gathering, analysing and documenting it in Azure DevOps(ADO)
* Write the corresponding user stories and provide ongoing clarification to delivery teams during sprint execution and accept completed scope against agreed business outcomes and acceptance criteria.
* Manage change requests with respect to scope and timeline by following change control process and maintain the product backlog in Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Manage conversion & user acceptance testing with respect to execution, defect management with technology teams for timely closure

**People & Talent**

* Build strong working relationships across business, operations, risk, compliance, technology, data, and journey teams to support effective delivery of the due diligence product.
* Promote a culture of clear accountability, constructive challenge, and continuous improvement across the cross-functional delivery and user community.
* Support knowledge sharing and change readiness so impacted teams understand new process, data, and control requirements introduced through product changes

**Risk Management**

* Responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling, mitigating, Escalating Risks to management as appropriate

**Governance**

* Display awareness, understanding and adherence to the organization’s operational Risk Frameworks
* Support governance, stakeholder forums, and programme checkpoints with clear updates on scope, dependency, risk, issue, and decision status.
* Ensure product decisions, scope changes, and prioritisation outcomes are documented clearly and communicated to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Contribute to release readiness, acceptance, and post-implementation review processes to ensure delivery quality and accountability.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Ensure the product roadmap and backlog reflect applicable regulatory, policy, screening, evidence, and auditability expectations relevant to retail client due diligence.
* Balance client and user experience improvements with sound judgement on regulatory obligations, business conduct expectations, and control effectiveness.
* Escalate ambiguities, control risks, or policy interpretation issues promptly so that product outcomes remain aligned with approved conduct and compliance standards.
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the WRB to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.] \*
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* ITO
* Process teams
* Group & Country stakeholders comprising of
* Products
* Operations
* Operations Risk
* Legal and compliance
* Audit
* Credit and Risk Operations
* Policy
* Finance

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for Good and Group’s brand and values in Team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures

**Skills And Experience**

* Agile / Scrum product ownership certification is preferred
* CBAP, CSPO/ Agile certification preferred
* Strong Product Owner or Business/Product Analyst experience in banking, client lifecycle management, onboarding, KYC, CDD, remediation, or regulated operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritise complex backlogs across multiple stakeholder groups and competing deadlines.
* Good understanding of retail banking operating models and the practical realities of due diligence, case management, operational controls, and auditability.
* Experience defining clear user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and outcome measures for change delivery teams.
* Ability to balance regulatory/control intent with client experience, operational simplicity, and delivery pragmatism.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and decision-making capability across business and technology audiences.
* Comfort working with delivery metrics, issue logs, dependency tracking, and governance reporting.
* Experience supporting agile delivery, sprint ceremonies, release readiness, and post-implementation improvement cycles

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or business or related field or an MBA

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

title: Senior Principal - Atlassian + Tooling Product Owner
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Atlassian & Tooling Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value of Enterprise Tooling (i.e. Atlassian) by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Atlassian & Tooling Product Owner guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, Confluence etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
* Lad the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.

**Key Relationships/Customers**
**Business Stakeholders**

* Business Process Owners
* Business Users / Power Users / Key Users

**IT Stakeholders**

* Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
* Solution Architect
* Product teams

**Other**

* Third-party providers

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

**Area of Specialisation**
Knowledge of functional domains within Global Functions (e.g., HR, Finance, Legal, etc) and familiarity with the technology platforms that enable them (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian).
  
  
Understanding of product performance measures and KPIs, with the ability to drive improvements in product adoption, cycle time, stability, support effort, and overall user experience.
  
  
**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 and Typically 5+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working within Enterprise HR Technology, Service Management, Corporate Systems, Legal & Compliance etc)
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.

* Experience working with Agile teams (writing stories, managing sprints, translating business needs).

title: Senior Software Technologist - C++
description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Software Technologist - C++

### **Job Description**

**Job Description**

In this role, you are responsible for the design and implementation and test of software for use within medical systems.

**Key Responsibility Area:**

* Design and implementation of software (on component or module level)—understand and communicate consequences of your design on the architecture and influence design specification.
* Design software based on design specifications in accordance, to ensure that the software will be reliable, efficient, user-friendly, easy to maintain and meet the (medical) quality and coding standards.
* Implement class, unit integration and unit tests for the designed modules or components.
* Contribute to the quality and maintainability of our software stack which has to be maintained for a long time (10+ years).
* Perform work in-line with processes/quality system.
* Contributing to the unit interfaces (SW), in close consultation with relevant disciplines.
* Initiatives and active participation for continuous improvement and Agile / Safe / Scrum process.

**Key Skills/Competencies**

* Bachelor/Master of Engineering in the field of Computer Science/ Electronics and Communication or equivalent
* At least years’ experience in software design and development
* **Strong working experience of C++**
* **Experience object-oriented programming, GIT / ADS / SOLID principles and (unit) testing**
* Experience with software development methodologies such as agile (SAFE), scrum and the V-model
* Experience with all aspects of the software development lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, test, and integration
* Ability to analyze the root cause of a problem and deliver evidence for the root cause and it side effects.
* Ability to find existing (legacy) code a positive challenge.
* Ability to think in risks for the proposed solution (including where to solve it)
* Design and implementation of software (on component or module level)—understand and communicate consequences of your design on the architecture and influence design specification.
* Design software based on design specifications in accordance, to ensure that the software will be reliable, efficient, user-friendly, easy to maintain and meet the (medical) quality and coding standards.
* Implement class, unit integration and unit tests for the designed modules or components.
* Affinity and interest in SW/HW integration
* Good communication in English (both written and verbal)
* Personality skills to collaborate with colleagues from different teams/levels and think across functional borders
* A lean/pragmatic attitude who can drive change and continuously seeks improvements and ways to reduce ‘waste’
* Interest in development of software in a controlled regulated environment
* Experience in working in a healthcare product development environment is an advantage

**How we work at Philips**  
Our newly-adopted hybrid work concept fuses flexibility with collaboration to deliver great outcomes for our people and our customers. We are embracing an approach wherein we spend more time together than apart – which for full-time employees translates to an average of at least 3 days working from the office and up to 2 days from home – for our hybrid roles.
  
Hybrid work flexibility means people can meet the changing demands of work and home in the most balanced, productive, and healthy way.

Our hybrid working model is defined in 3 ways:
  
*We believe in the importance of impactful collaboration:* There's a certain energy when everyone’s in the same room that can heighten idea generation and creative friction needed for problem-solving.
  
*We embrace flexibility:* Choosing where, when and how to work can vary according to task and team schedules. Flexibility isn’t office or online, it means choosing the space that works best for you, your teams and our customers on a case-by-case basis.
  
*We want to be at our best:* The way we work and our workspaces are designed to support our well-being, offer career advancement opportunities, and enable us to be at our best.

**Why should you join Philips?**  
Working at Philips is more than a job. It’s a calling to create a healthier society through meaningful work, focused on innovative, customer-first health technology solutions. Help us improve the health and well-being of billions of people, every year. Ultimately creating a career that no one could have planned for. Even you.
