title: Director - SN & Ent. Tools Operations Excellence
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Service Operations Lead is responsible for ensuring the stable, compliant, and reliable operation of core systems and platforms within the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools domain. The role oversees day-to-day platform operations and ensures that processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely. It maintains the operational performance of multiple platforms (e.g. ServiceNow), ensuring they meet agreed service levels and adhere to security and compliance expectations.

Operating at a senior level, the role provides leadership across operational teams, acts as the primary escalation point for platform issues, and partners with Product/Platform Owners, architects, engineering teams, and IT service functions to maintain platform stability and drive continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Provide operational leadership across core platforms, ensuring system stability, availability, and adherence to service levels, acting as the primary internal escalation point for product and domain teams on service performance and major incidents.
* Govern incident, problem, change, configuration, and release processes for domain platforms, ensuring operational compliance with ITSM policies and control frameworks, and defining measurable outcomes for problem management (e.g., RCA closure time, recurrence prevention, defect trend reduction).
* Define and maintain service readiness and runbook quality standards (e.g. ServiceNow Knowledge), ensuring escalation paths, support tasks, data handling, continuity steps, and deployment impacts are captured and validated before go-live.
* Create and oversee service plans for new and enhanced products, coordinating with Product Owners, third-party partners, and platform/service teams to define SLAs, performance expectations, and support handover criteria.
* Monitor platform performance, proactively identifying risks, trends, and recurring issues, and implement improvement actions to strengthen stability and user experience.
* Coordinate with Platform Owners, engineering squads, solution architects, and service teams to ensure changes, integrations, upgrades, and releases are deployed safely and meet operational readiness standards.
* Lead operational readiness assessments, ensuring documentation, support models, monitoring coverage, and non-functional controls are in place prior to deployment.
* Own operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for the platforms, ensuring performance, risks, and issues are communicated to senior stakeholders.
* Oversee root cause analysis for major incidents, ensuring sustainable fixes, clear remediation actions, and preventative measures are identified and delivered.
* Maintain and continuously improve operational documentation, including runbooks, support procedures, configuration inventories, and architectural operational views.
* Manage relationships with third-party vendors and managed service providers to ensure high-quality operational support and fulfilment of contractual obligations.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Systems Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g., ITIL, Agile/Scrum, Service Management, DevOps Foundations)

**Job Experience**

  

* Typically 18+ years of experience in platform operations (e.g. ServiceNow), system administration, service management, or technical delivery roles within complex environments.
* Significant experience overseeing operational performance for multiple platforms or systems within a complex environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management.
* Proven ability to diagnose operational issues, lead root cause analysis, and drive sustainable improvements.
* Experience coordinating with engineering, architecture, and product teams to ensure operational readiness and safe deployment of changes.
* Experience producing and maintaining operational artefacts such as runbooks, support procedures, and readiness assessments.
* Familiarity with operational KPIs, risk indicators, monitoring dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Experience operating in Agile and/or DevOps environments supporting continuous delivery and operational stability.

**Desirable Requirements**

  

* Operational oversight and ITSM governance for ServiceNow platforms – Provides senior oversight of day-to-day ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools operations run by third parties, ensuring processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely so platforms remain stable, compliant, reliable, and within agreed service levels and security expectations.
* Service readiness, runbook quality, and major incident management – Skilled at defining and enforcing standards for knowledge, runbooks, escalation paths, and support tasks, leading major incident response and ensuring safe deployments and service continuity.
* Performance monitoring, RCA, and continuous improvement – Strong capability in owning operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting, diagnosing recurring issues, leading root cause analysis, and driving sustainable remediation and trend reduction.
* Cross-functional coordination for operational readiness and change – Proven ability to work with Platform Owners, architects, engineering squads, service teams, and third-party providers to ensure integrations, upgrades, and releases meet operational readiness standards.
* Vendor and MSP relationship management for high-quality operations – Experienced in managing third-party vendors and managed service providers, ensuring contractual obligations, support quality, and operational performance expectations are met.

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, especially in complex operational scenarios.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clarity during incidents and complex change cycles.
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, and operational risk controls.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and promote operational discipline.
* Effective organisational skills, able to balance multiple priorities and manage time-sensitive escalations.

**Skills**

Capacity Planning, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure Capacity Planning, IT Service Management (ITSM), Network Configurations, Network Troubleshooting, Operations Analysis, Performance Tuning, Platform Operations, Service Level Agreement (SLA), Services Management, System Administration, System Monitors, Technical Delivery, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. 29 Oct 2026 11:59pm

**Job Summary**

Provide and lead specialist analysis, design, development and deployment in network specific technology domains, including developing platform specific technology roadmaps and making technology investment recommendations to deliver products and infrastructure to defined service level standards

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Who We Are**

Telstra is Australia’s leading telecommunications and technology company spanning over a century with a footprint in over 20+ countries. In India, we’re building a platform for innovative delivery and engagement that will strengthen our position as an industry leader. We’ve grown quickly since our inception in 2019, now with offices in Pune and Bangalore  

  

Focus of the role:

  

The Senior Solution Designer / Lead Software Engineer will provide architecture, technical design, and hands-on engineering leadership for the TNI mission. The role requires deep telecommunications OSS and physical network inventory expertise, strong knowledge of the Inventory Platform, and proven capability in designing scalable, resilient, graph-based enterprise solutions. The successful candidate will translate complex business requirements into pragmatic technical designs, implementation roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes while building effective relationships with stakeholders at all organisational levels.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture and technical design for TNI capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, security, resilience, and delivery standards.
* Design high-performance Neo4j graph solutions covering graph data models, schemas, relationships, indexing, query optimisation, versioning, migration, and operational performance.
* Translate complex business and platform requirements into scalable solution designs, implementation roadmaps, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and modern enterprise application frameworks.
* Design and deliver enterprise APIs and integrations using OData, REST, and GraphQL.
* Apply deep Inventory Platform knowledge to solution decisions involving business processes, architecture, APIs, and the underlying data model.
* Drive application modernisation, platform resilience, automation, and adoption of AI-enabled and emerging technology solutions.
* Perform business analysis and gap assessments, recommending system and process improvements that increase efficiency and deliver business benefits.
* Collaborate with business, architecture, engineering, data, operations, and delivery stakeholders to manage dependencies, risks, and design decisions.
Provide technical governance, design assurance, documentation, and mentoring throughout the solution lifecycle.  

  

**Mandatory Requirements**
==========================

* Significant experience in software design and delivery, including demonstrated experience in solution architecture, technical design, and enterprise application development.
* Strong practical experience with Neo4j graph database technologies, including graph data modelling, performance optimisation, and enterprise-scale implementation.
* Extensive capability in Neo4j solution design and graph data architecture, including graph modelling, schema design, query optimisation, indexing strategies, relationship modelling, versioning approaches, data migration, and high-performance graph solution implementation.

**Your work profile**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented **Business Analyst / Project Manager (BA/PM) Hybrid** to join our Market Security Services (MSS) team. This role sits at the intersection of business operations and technology, with a primary concentration on business analysis and a complementary focus on project management. You will specialize in the MSS domain—specifically targeting **Accounts, SSIs, Books, Hierarchy, and Pricing**. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between stakeholders and technical teams to drive process improvements, implement system enhancements, and ensure the integrity of our security data, financial workflows, and account structures.

  

**1. Business Analysis & Requirement Engineering (Core Focus)**

* **Domain Expertise:** Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Market Security Services, specifically focusing on Accounts management, Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI), Books architecture, Account Hierarchy, and Pricing models.
* **Requirement Gathering:** Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document complex business requirements for post-trade and static data systems.
* **Documentation:** Create high-quality business requirement documents (BRD), functional specification documents (FSD), user stories, and process flow diagrams (UML/BPMN).
* **Gap Analysis:** Perform detailed gap analysis between current "As-Is" processes and desired "To-Be" states to identify automation opportunities in data setup and trade routing.

**2. Domain-Specific Focus Areas**

* **Accounts & Hierarchy:** Streamline the onboarding and management of client/entity accounts, ensuring robust parent-child account hierarchy models and internal "Books" mapping for accurate downstream reporting.
* **Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI):** Oversee the automation and maintenance of SSIs across custody and clearing networks to mitigate settlement risk and reduce trade fail rates.
* **Pricing & Valuation:** Collaborate with pricing desks and market data vendors to implement or refine instrument valuation models, ensuring the integrity of real-time price feeds, corporate action adjustments, and end-of-day valuations.

**3. Project Management (Adaptive Focus)**

* **Lifecycle Management:** Coordinate project phases through the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using Agile, Scrum, or Hybrid methodologies.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary point of contact for business heads, technology teams, and external vendors to align operational priorities.
* **Delivery & Tracking:** Define project scope, create detailed project plans, manage timelines, track sprints, and mitigate risks/impediments to ensure on-time delivery.

**4. Testing & Quality Assurance**

* **User Acceptance Testing (UAT):** Lead the design, execution, and sign-off of UAT scripts, ensuring that system enhancements meet complex business logic and regulatory requirements.
* **Defect Management:** Collaborate with QA teams to prioritize, track, and resolve system defects during the testing phase.
  

**Key Skills Required :**

  

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in a Business Analyst role with progressive project coordination responsibilities within Investment Banking, Asset Management, or Securities Services.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the post-trade lifecycle, settlement processes, instrument master data, account hierarchy structures, internal book mappings, and security pricing.
* **Tools:** Proficiency in agile project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) and visual modeling software (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart).
* **Data Analysis:** Strong ability to write SQL queries and manipulate complex data structures in Excel to support data profiling and business logic validation.

**Soft Skills:**

* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for presenting technical and operational roadmaps to senior leadership.
* **Problem-Solving:** A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks in financial workflows and proposing scalable architecture solutions.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to balance deep-dive business analysis with project delivery timelines in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

**Education & Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* CBAP, CSPO, CSM, PMP, or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

title: SAP Application Development (AD) & Application Management Services (AMS) Manager
description:
**SAP Application Development (AD) & Application Management Services (AMS) Manager**

**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**

Responsible for leading and governing SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across the enterprise SAP landscape, ensuring the successful delivery of enhancements, and support services aligned to business objectives.

The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, SAP functional and technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers to ensure effective planning, prioritization, execution, and support of SAP solutions. The candidate will be accountable for driving service excellence, managing vendors and delivery teams, overseeing execution, and ensuring stable SAP operations across all business-critical processes and modules.

**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Lead the delivery and governance of SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across multiple SAP modules and business functions.

* Act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers.

* Manage SAP continuous improvement initiatives from inception through deployment and stabilization.

* Ensure effective delivery of AMS services, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, and Release Management.

* Establish and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, ticket backlogs, aging incidents, customer satisfaction metrics, and vendor performance.

* Drive prioritization and governance of project demands, enhancement requests, and production support activities to ensure alignment with business priorities.

* Collaborate with business process owners across functions including Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics and Customer Service to identify and deliver technology solutions.

* Coordinate cross-functional solution delivery involving SAP modules such as SD, MM, PP, PM, FI/CO, EWM, BRIM, and other integrated solutions as applicable.

* Manage SAP AMS provider, ensuring contractual commitments, service quality, and delivery expectations are consistently achieved.

* Lead major incident management activities, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

* Support budget planning, resource management, capacity planning, risk management, and project portfolio governance activities.

* Provide regular communication and status reporting to business leadership, IT management, and project governance boards.

* Build and maintain high-performing SAP support and delivery teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and a customer-focused culture.

**SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* Minimum 12-15 years of SAP experience with strong understanding of end-to-end enterprise business processes.

* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience managing SAP Application Development (AD) and/or Application Management Services (AMS) teams.

* Proven experience managing SAP projects, enhancements, support services, and vendor delivery engagements.

* Deep functional expertise in Quote-to-Cash (Q2C), with sufficient understanding of adjacent business processes and modules.

* Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Service Level Management.

* Experience managing managed-service providers, offshore delivery teams, and external implementation partners.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, competing demands, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex global environment.

* Experience in SAP S/4HANA environments.

* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills.

* Experience managing project plans, budgets, resource forecasting, and delivery governance.

**Desirable**

* Experience managing both Application Development and AMS functions within a global SAP landscape.

* SAP certification in any functional, technical, or project management discipline.

* ITIL Foundation or equivalent IT Service Management certification.

* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or SAP Activate.

* Basic understanding of ABAP, interfaces, workflows, forms, and SAP development lifecycle.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**

* Office-based / Remote working model.

* Responsible for ensuring compliance with company Health, Safety, Security, and Risk Management policies.

* Operates within a global support and delivery model supporting business users across APAC, Europe, and the Americas.

* Flexibility to support major incidents, critical project milestones, go-live activities, and leadership escalations outside standard business hours when required.

* Regular engagement with senior business stakeholders, technology leadership teams, implementation partners, and managed service providers.

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  
Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Risk Analytics (GRA) and Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) are sub-lines of business within Global Risk Management (GRM). Collectively, they are responsible for developing a consistent and coherent set of models, analytical tools, and tests for effective risk and capital measurement, management and reporting across Bank of America. GRA and EIT partner with all the Lines of Business and Enterprise functions. GRA and EIT include vertical (i.e., business or risk-specific) functions and horizontal functions that cut across business and risk-types. A core pillar of our horizontal strategy is developing common, reusable, and scalable components that can be used across GRM. Quantitative engineers will be responsible for executing on this strategy.
  
  
**Job Description\***
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to lead Agile delivery teams within the Global Risk Analytics organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Agile methodologies, software delivery lifecycle, and banking risk management processes. The Scrum Master will partner with Product Owners, Technology Leads, Quantitative Engineers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to drive predictable delivery of regulatory, risk, and strategic technology initiatives while ensuring adherence to Agile best practices and enterprise governance standards.

* Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies.
* Partner with Release Management teams to ensure smooth Build-Test-Deploy lifecycle execution.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise SDLC, governance, and control requirements.
* Provide transparent reporting on delivery progress, risks, and milestone status.
* Facilitate collaboration among global teams across multiple regions and time zones.

**Education\***

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a closely related field, or a degree from a program where software engineering was a key focus or equivalent work experience

**Experience Range\***
7+ years
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Scrum Master.
* Strong knowledge of Agile Scrum principles and practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to lead and facilitate Scrum ceremonies
* Able to learn software functionality and complex processes quickly

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Role Summary**

The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **1. Delivery Execution (MANAGE)**
  Own delivery commitments, including SLA tracking and quality assurance, for assigned accounts.
* Lead Agile sprint planning, execution, and demos in coordination with COEs, Solution Architects, and QA teams.
* Ensure hypercare stability (2–4 weeks post go-live) and transition to managed services.
* Manage resource allocation (onshore, nearshore, offshore) based on complexity and cost efficiency.
* Host weekly client delivery status meetings and internal syncs.
* Own major incident resolution, recovery planning, and corrective actions, including leading technical triage and root cause analysis (RCA) with engineering teams.
* Identify and implement process improvements to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
* **2. Technical Leadership & Quality**
  Review solution designs, technical approaches, and estimates with architects and tech leads; challenge assumptions and flag technical risk early.
* Understand code, branching, CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes well enough to unblock teams and validate delivery status.
* Drive engineering quality practices: definition of done, technical debt tracking, and release readiness.
* Translate technical issues into clear business impact for client leadership, and client needs into clear technical direction for teams.
* Evaluate and promote the use of AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve team productivity and quality.
* **3. Risk & Opportunity Monitoring (MONITOR)**
  Continuously monitor client leadership changes, operational shifts, and market dynamics.
* Flag risks early using the
  **Account Health Dashboard (Green/Yellow/Red)**
  .
* Escalate delivery disputes or commercial risks to Delivery Director when thresholds are breached.
* Conduct continuous risk management and quality assurance checks.
* **4. Account Growth Support (MINE)**
  Partner with Account Executive (AE) and Client Success Team to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
* Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for key or at-risk accounts.
* Provide delivery health summaries and expansion recommendations to AEs.
* **5. Governance & Reporting**
  Produce
  **weekly status reports**
  rolled up to Delivery Director.
* Use PMO tools, playbooks, and dashboards per organizational standards.
* Co-run internal kickoffs with AE within
  **5 business days**
  of contract signing.
* Lead external client kickoffs within
  **1 business day**
  of tier/PM assignment.
* **6. Peer Collaboration (Global Delivery Model)**
  Operate as a peer with US and India Delivery Managers (no hierarchical silos).
* Participate in
  **weekly delivery health reviews**
  led by Delivery Director.
* Share best practices and resources across the global delivery organization.
* Provide a clean handover and clear escalation path for the hours you are offline, so clients are always covered.
* **7. Availability & Business Needs**
  Provide live support and be reachable for PST clients until approximately 1:00–2:00 AM IST, including client calls, release windows, and urgent escalations.
* Be available to attend the office on short notice when called upon by the business.
* Travel to client sites, delivery centers, or other locations as the need arises.
* **Success Metrics (KPIs)**
  Client satisfaction (CSAT / NPS) for assigned accounts
* Operational stability (missed SLAs < 5%, zero critical incidents without hypercare plan)
* Early risk identification (minimum 2 weeks before client escalation)
* Contribution to account growth (% of identified opportunities converted)
* Adherence to Tiered Model rules (no unauthorized dedicated PM for Tier 2/3)
* Weekly reporting compliance (100% on time)
* Responsiveness during PST coverage hours and quality of handovers
* Release and defect quality (escaped defects, on-time release rate, RCA closure)

Must-Have Skills

Required • 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years • Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines • Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects • Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model) • Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models • Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP) • Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients • Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?**

  

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

  

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

  

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

  

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

**Role Purpose**
  

Matillion is built around small development teams with responsibility for specific themes and initiatives. Each team is a mix of engineers with various levels of skills and experience.

  

As a Senior Quality Engineer you will bring technical guidance and demonstrable experience in integrating quality checks throughout our development cycle. The ambition is to deliver our services in the most efficient, controlled and high quality way possible. Outside of day to day delivery you will also support the overall quality journey within Engineering.

**What will you be doing?**
  
  

  
* As a Senior Quality Engineer at Matillion, you will spend significant time testing our software products, ensuring quality throughout the development process.
  
* You will help maintain and improve existing quality frameworks while promoting a shift-left approach to testing.
  
* You'll work with a variety of tools for automation, security, accessibility, and performance testing, while also honing your automation skills.
  
* As part of a cross-functional team, you will drive the focus on quality, always keeping the customer’s needs in mind.
  
* You will also contribute to identifying and improving areas in the overall quality journey, whilst also assisting in mentoring team members in developing their skills.
  
* Assist in recruitment and mentoring team members in developing their skills
  
  

  
  
**What are we looking for?**
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

Essential

  

  
* Proficiency in managing end-to-end testing of SaaS applications, using various testing approaches (e.g., rapid, risk-based, exploratory, regression, security, usability, performance) suitable for distributed systems, with a strong understanding of the Test Pyramid and automation.
  
* Experience developing and maintaining test automation tools (e.g., contract, integration, accessibility, performance, security) for applications and services, with coding skills in Java/JavaScript to implement frameworks like Cypress, Playwright and Pact.
  
* Solid understanding of the full software development lifecycle using CI/CD tooling, agile methodologies (e.g., Kanban, Scrum), and a strong focus on ensuring quality from business, customer, and technical perspectives.
  
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure) and good knowledge of databases and SQL.
  
* A collaborative team player with a QA mindset, eager to challenge and improve practices, and committed to continuous learning and personal development in quality engineering.
  
* Matillion has fostered a culture that is collaborative, fast-paced, ambitious, and transparent, and an environment where people genuinely care about their colleagues and communities.
  
  

  
  
  
  
  

Personal Capabilities

  

  
* Inquisitiveness- asks questions to explore and understand the underlying technology, with the intent of leading to the most appropriate solutions.
  
* Autonomy - ability to work on tasks and solve problems independently, seeking assistance as needed.
  
* Motivation - sets personal challenges and constantly looking to stretch themselves.
  
* Problem-solving - recognition of problems with the intent to find solutions.
  
* Integrity - honest and transparent in dealings, open to voice and accepting criticism, and builds credibility through actions.
  
* Detail-focused - pays attention to the details and can make a conscious effort to understand causes instead of just the effects.
  
* Big picture-aware - understands the scope and impact of a problem or solution.

  

**More about Matillion**

  
  

We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:

  

  
* Company Equity
  
* 27 days paid time off
  
* 12 days of Company Holiday
  
* 5 days paid volunteering leave
  
* Group Mediclaim (GMC)
  
* Enhanced Parental leave policies
  
* MacBook Pro
  
  

  
  

**Your Safety**

  
  

Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to 
matillion.com/careers
to verify open roles or reach us at
talent@matillion.com
.

  
  
  

**Want to know more?**

  
  

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
  
  
Cannot find a suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at 
talent@matillion.com.

  

Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.

  
  
  

*Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description:

As our Senior UI Developer, you'll architect scalable frontend systems, mentor team members, and collaborate across global teams to deliver impactful products.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior UI Developer, you'll be the technical cornerstone of our product development lifecycle. You'll collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and UX teams to architect, implement, and maintain sophisticated user interfaces that meet business needs while delivering exceptional user experiences.
  
  
Key Responsibilities

title: Salesforce CLM Data Migration Testing Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce CLM Data QA Testing Engineer with 5+ years

of experience in software quality assurance, Salesforce application testing, contract

lifecycle management, and data validation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on

experience testing Salesforce-integrated CLM platforms, validating contract data,

performing data migration testing, and ensuring data integrity across Salesforce and

connected enterprise applications.

The candidate will be responsible for validating contract records, metadata, document

associations, contract lifecycle workflows, data mappings, business rules, and

integrations between Salesforce and CLM platforms such as Conga CLM, Icertis,

DocuSign CLM, Sirion, or equivalent solutions.

The role requires strong experience in functional testing, data quality testing, source-

to-target reconciliation, SQL/SOQL-based validation, API testing, System Integration

Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing. The candidate

should understand Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, automation, security, and

data models, along with CLM processes covering contract creation, review, approval,

execution, amendments, renewals, and termination.

The successful candidate will collaborate with Salesforce developers, CLM consultants,

business analysts, data engineers, integration teams, and business stakeholders to

identify data discrepancies, validate system behavior, investigate defects, and ensure

accurate and reliable contract information throughout the contract lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. Salesforce CLM Functional Testing

1. Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, process

flows, and acceptance criteria related to Salesforce CLM implementations.

2. Prepare and execute test cases for contract creation, drafting, review,

negotiation, approval, execution, amendment, renewal, and termination.

3. Validate Salesforce-integrated CLM functionality, business rules, application

configurations, and end-to-end workflows.

4. Test Salesforce standard and custom objects, fields, record types, page layouts,

and relationships used for contract management.

5. Validate contract request initiation, contract record creation, document

generation, approval routing, and contract status transitions.

6. Test Salesforce Flow automation, validation rules, approval processes,

notifications, and automated field updates relevant to contract processes.

7. Validate contract templates, clause selection, document generation, merge

fields, and document associations.

8. Perform functional, smoke, sanity, regression, and end-to-end testing across

Salesforce and CLM applications.

9. Validate user access, contract visibility, document permissions, and role-based

access controls.

10. Maintain test cases, execution evidence, defect reports, and requirements

traceability.

2. Salesforce CLM Data Quality Testing

1. Validate contract data stored in Salesforce and integrated CLM platforms for

accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and validity.

2. Verify contract attributes such as contract ID, contract type, account, customer,

counterparty, contract owner, effective date, expiration date, renewal date,

contract value, currency, and status.

3. Validate Salesforce field mappings, mandatory fields, default values, picklist

values, formula fields, and business-specific data rules.

4. Verify relationships between Salesforce Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities,

contract records, CLM documents, and related business entities.

5. Identify duplicate contracts, missing records, invalid field values, inconsistent

metadata, and orphaned relationships.

6. Validate contract status synchronization and lifecycle data consistency between

Salesforce and the CLM platform.

7. Test cross-field validations, date dependencies, contract renewal rules, notice

periods, and approval thresholds.

8. Validate parent-child contract relationships, amendments, renewals, historical

versions, and associated documents.

9. Perform data profiling, record count checks, null checks, duplicate checks, and

field-level data comparisons.

10. Document data quality defects, investigate root causes, and coordinate

remediation with Salesforce, CLM, and data engineering teams.

3. Salesforce CLM Data Migration & Reconciliation

1. Validate migration of legacy contract data into Salesforce and the integrated

CLM platform.

2. Review source-to-target mapping documents, migration specifications,

transformation rules, and business validation requirements.

3. Compare source and target contract records to verify data completeness and

accuracy after migration.

4. Validate record counts, field mappings, mandatory attributes, default values,

and transformed data values.

5. Test migration of contract metadata, contract relationships, document

attachments, contract status, amendment history, and renewal information.

6. Validate legacy identifiers, Salesforce record IDs, external IDs, lookup

relationships, and reference data mappings.

7. Perform record-level and field-level reconciliation using SQL, SOQL, Salesforce

reports, Excel, and approved data validation tools.

8. Test full data loads, incremental migration, delta loads, and migration reruns

where applicable.

9. Validate migration error logs, rejected records, duplicate handling, data

cleansing, and exception resolution.

10. Prepare reconciliation reports, migration defect logs, data quality summaries,

and migration sign-off evidence.

4. Salesforce Data Validation Using SOQL, SQL & Data Tools

1. Write SOQL queries to retrieve and validate Salesforce contract records,

Accounts, Opportunities, Contacts, and related objects.

2. Use SQL queries to validate source databases, staging tables, target databases,

and downstream reporting datasets.

3. Compare Salesforce records with corresponding records in CLM and other

integrated systems.

4. Validate record relationships, lookup fields, external IDs, formula fields, and

cross-object dependencies.

5. Perform null checks, duplicate detection, record count reconciliation, and field-

level comparisons.

6. Validate Salesforce data loads and updates using Data Loader, Salesforce

reports, Workbench, or equivalent utilities.

7. Test bulk insert, update, upsert, and delete operations where applicable and

authorized.

8. Verify that data transformations and mappings preserve expected values across

connected systems.

9. Investigate discrepancies between Salesforce UI results, SOQL query results, API

responses, and downstream data stores.

10. Collaborate with Salesforce developers and data engineers to resolve data-

related defects.

5. Salesforce CLM Application Testing

1. Test integration between Salesforce CRM and CLM platforms such as Conga

CLM, Icertis, DocuSign CLM, or equivalent solutions.

2. Validate contract creation from Salesforce Accounts, Opportunities, contract

requests, or other configured business processes.

3. Test contract template selection, clause libraries, conditional clauses, document

generation, and metadata population.

4. Validate contract review, negotiation, approval, execution, and renewal

workflows.

5. Verify synchronization of contract status, contract dates, counterparty details,

contract values, and document references.

6. Test amendments, renewals, terminations, and historical contract version

management.

7. Validate electronic signature integrations with DocuSign or Adobe Acrobat Sign

where applicable.

8. Verify document upload, download, versioning, repository association, and

executed document availability.

9. Test error handling for failed contract creation, document generation, approval

routing, and synchronization.

10. Work with Salesforce and CLM functional teams to investigate and resolve

application defects.

6. API & Integration Testing

1. Perform API testing for integrations between Salesforce, CLM, ERP, document

management, procurement, and finance systems.

2. Validate REST APIs and SOAP APIs using Postman, Salesforce Workbench, or

equivalent tools.

3. Verify request and response payloads, HTTP status codes, headers,

authentication, authorization, and error messages.

4. Validate JSON and XML structures, mandatory attributes, field mappings, and

data transformation rules.

5. Test contract creation, updates, approval status, execution status, amendments,

and renewal synchronization.

6. Validate API authentication and authorization, including OAuth 2.0

fundamentals.

7. Test positive and negative scenarios involving invalid payloads, missing fields,

duplicate requests, unauthorized access, and service failures.

8. Validate asynchronous integrations, batch processing, retry mechanisms, and

failed-message handling where applicable.

9. Perform end-to-end validation of contract data across Salesforce, CLM, and

downstream enterprise applications.

10. Document integration defects and collaborate with developers to resolve data

mismatches and interface failures.

7. Salesforce Security & Access Validation

1. Validate Salesforce profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and field-level

security relevant to contract management.

2. Test contract record visibility based on ownership, account relationships,

organizational roles, and business unit requirements.

3. Verify that confidential contracts and supporting documents are accessible only

to authorized users.

4. Validate access permissions for contract creation, modification, approval,

execution, and document download.

5. Test negative scenarios involving unauthorized record access and restricted field

visibility.

6. Verify security behavior across Salesforce and the connected CLM platform.

7. Validate user access provisioning and deprovisioning where applicable.

8. Test audit trails, field history tracking, contract approval history, and document

version history where supported.

9. Identify security-related data exposure and access control defects.

10. Maintain test evidence and coordinate remediation with Salesforce

administrators, CLM teams, and security stakeholders.

8. Test Planning & Defect Management

1. Prepare test plans, test scenarios, detailed test cases, test data, expected

results, and execution schedules.

2. Design test cases covering Salesforce functionality, CLM workflows, contract

data quality, migration, and integrations.

3. Maintain requirements traceability matrices and ensure adequate functional

and data validation coverage.

4. Identify test dependencies, environment requirements, migration prerequisites,

and data quality risks.

5. Log defects with reproduction steps, expected and actual results, affected

records, query outputs, and supporting evidence.

6. Classify defects according to severity, priority, business impact, and release risk.

7. Participate in defect triage meetings with Salesforce developers, CLM

consultants, data engineers, and business analysts.

8. Retest resolved defects and perform regression testing to ensure fixes do not

introduce new issues.

9. Maintain defect dashboards, test execution summaries, data reconciliation

reports, and test completion metrics.

10. Support release readiness and go/no-go decisions through accurate test results

and quality risk assessments.

9. SIT, UAT & End-to-End Testing

1. Participate in System Integration Testing, User Acceptance Testing, functional

testing, regression testing, and end-to-end testing.

2. Validate end-to-end business processes spanning Salesforce CRM, CLM, and

connected enterprise applications.

3. Test contract generation from Salesforce Opportunities, contract requests, or

other configured business events.

4. Validate the complete contract lifecycle, including drafting, review, approval,

execution, amendment, renewal, and termination.

5. Verify consistency of contract data and documents across Salesforce and

integrated systems.

6. Coordinate with business users to prepare UAT scenarios, test data, execution

schedules, and acceptance criteria.

7. Support business stakeholders during UAT and assist with functional

clarification and defect resolution.

8. Validate migrated contract data against agreed business acceptance criteria.

9. Prepare UAT completion reports, reconciliation summaries, outstanding issue

logs, and sign-off documentation.

10. Perform post-deployment smoke testing and confirm that critical contract

processes remain operational.

10. Agile Delivery & Release Validation

1. Work within Agile/Scrum teams and participate in sprint planning, daily stand-

ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

2. Collaborate with Salesforce developers, CLM consultants, data engineers, and

business analysts to clarify requirements.

3. Review solution designs, data mappings, integration specifications, and user

stories to identify test scenarios early.

4. Validate new features, enhancements, configuration changes, and defect fixes

delivered during each sprint.

5. Support regression testing, release planning, migration rehearsals, deployment

validation, and production readiness.

6. Validate changes across development, QA, SIT, UAT, pre-production, and

production environments as applicable.

7. Investigate environment-specific defects, data refresh issues, and configuration

inconsistencies.

8. Maintain test status reports, defect metrics, reconciliation results, and release

quality summaries.

9. Ensure test evidence and artifacts are maintained for auditability and release

governance.

10. Contribute to continuous improvement in Salesforce CLM testing, data quality,

and test automation practices.

Required Qualifications

1. Functional Testing Expertise

1. Minimum 5+ years of experience in software QA, functional testing, data

testing, or enterprise application testing.

2. Strong hands-on experience in manual testing, functional testing, regression

testing, smoke testing, and end-to-end testing.

3. Experience in test case design, test execution, defect reporting, and test

documentation.

4. Strong understanding of STLC, defect management, and QA methodologies.

5. Experience in SIT, UAT, integration testing, and business process validation.

6. Ability to analyze requirements and create positive, negative, boundary, and

exception-based scenarios.

7. Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, Xray, or equivalent tools.

8. Understanding of test coverage, traceability, defect severity, and release quality.

9. Experience with root cause investigation and defect triage.

10. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

2. Salesforce Testing Expertise

1. Strong functional knowledge of Salesforce CRM and its data model.

2. Experience testing standard and custom objects, fields, relationships, record

types, and page layouts.

3. Understanding of Salesforce Flow, validation rules, approval processes, and

automation.

4. Experience validating Salesforce reports, dashboards, record visibility, and

business process workflows.

5. Understanding of profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and field-level

security.

6. Familiarity with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Visualforce from

a functional testing perspective.

7. Understanding of Salesforce sandboxes, test environments, and release

processes.

8. Hands-on experience validating Salesforce data using SOQL, Data Loader,

reports, or Workbench.

9. Ability to troubleshoot Salesforce data and functional defects.

10. Familiarity with Salesforce releases and regression testing of impacted

functionality.

3. Salesforce CLM Domain Expertise

1. Hands-on experience testing Salesforce-integrated CLM platforms is highly

desirable.

2. Knowledge of Conga CLM, Icertis, DocuSign CLM, Sirion, or equivalent solutions.

3. Understanding of contract creation, authoring, approval, negotiation, execution,

amendment, renewal, and termination.

4. Experience validating contract metadata, contract templates, clause libraries,

and document associations.

5. Knowledge of contract hierarchies, parent-child relationships, amendments, and

renewal processes.

6. Experience testing document generation and e-signature integrations.

7. Understanding of contract status synchronization between Salesforce and CLM

applications.

8. Experience validating contract-related data migration and reconciliation.

9. Knowledge of contract approval routing, renewal notifications, and expiration

alerts.

10. Ability to investigate CLM workflow, document, and data integrity defects.

4. Data Quality & Migration Testing

1. Strong experience in data validation, data integrity testing, and data quality

assurance.

2. Hands-on experience with source-to-target reconciliation and data migration

testing.

3. Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with SOQL for data validation.

4. Experience with record count validation, duplicate checks, null checks, and

field-level comparisons.

5. Understanding of data mapping, data transformation, and business rule

validation.

6. Experience validating data across Salesforce, CLM, and downstream

applications.

7. Familiarity with relational databases, staging tables, and target data

structures.

8. Ability to investigate missing records, incorrect mappings, duplicate data, and

transformation errors.

9. Experience preparing data quality reports and reconciliation evidence.

10. Knowledge of data governance, data privacy, and confidential information

handling.

5. API & Integration Testing

1. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and SOAP APIs.

2. Proficiency in Postman or equivalent API testing tools.

3. Understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, headers, and request/response

payloads.

4. Experience validating JSON and XML structures.

5. Understanding of API authentication and authorization, including OAuth 2.0.

6. Experience testing Salesforce integrations with CLM and other enterprise

applications.

7. Ability to validate field mappings, transformation logic, synchronization, and

error handling.

8. Familiarity with asynchronous integrations, batch processing, and retry

mechanisms.

9. Experience documenting integration test cases and test evidence.

10. Strong troubleshooting skills for API and data-related defects.

6. Test Management & Technical Tools

1. Jira, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, Xray, or TestRail.

2. Salesforce Developer Console, Workbench, SOQL, reports, and Data Loader.

3. Postman or equivalent API testing tools.

4. SQL clients and relational database tools.

5. Microsoft Excel for data analysis, comparisons, and reconciliation.

6. Familiarity with ETL tools and data integration platforms is desirable.

7. Python or scripting for data validation and reconciliation is an advantage.

8. Selenium, Playwright, or API automation experience is desirable.

9. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and release validation processes is an advantage.

10. Strong test documentation, reporting, and defect tracking skills.

Certifications

1. ISTQB Certified Tester – Foundation Level (CTFL).

2. ISTQB Advanced Level certification, where applicable.

3. Salesforce Certified Administrator.

4. Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder.

5. Relevant Salesforce or CLM platform certifications, where available.

6. SQL, database, or data quality testing certifications.

7. API testing or software QA certifications.

8. Agile/Scrum certification.

9. Data migration, ETL testing, or data engineering certifications.

10. Test automation or test management certifications.

Certifications are preferred; practical Salesforce testing, CLM application testing, and

data validation experience are essential.

Technical Skills & Tools

1. Salesforce: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, standard and custom objects, fields,

relationships, Salesforce Flow, validation rules, approval processes, and reports.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Do you want to advance your career with the world’s first cloud company? Since 1998, Oracle NetSuite has been on a mission to deliver an agile, unified application suite that gives leaders a complete view into their business. Our team is growing, and we’re looking for people like you to help us make a global impact.
  
  
As the leading cloud business system, NetSuite includes financials, inventory management, HR, professional services automation, commerce, and more. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world trust NetSuite to give their businesses the visibility, agility, and control needed to make data-informed decisions quickly. NetSuite is a place where you can build your career and have fun while doing so! We’re invested in our people, our customers, and the community. As part of Oracle, our benefits are second to none. Joining our passionate team means that you’re ready to take your career to the next level. With priceless learning opportunities, strong support, incredible innovation, and volunteer opportunities, NetSuite is committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered and set up for success.
  
  
**Our company culture:**

* We help each other and foster collaboration across roles and teams.
* We lift each other up. We know how to celebrate our successes and learn from our failures.
* Ideas are fragile and we consider them no matter how simple or outlandish.
* We always try to do the right thing – for ourselves, for the product and ultimately for our customers.

**How will you crush it?**
You'll work with awesome people that care about their craft and what they deliver. Your efforts will contribute to making things better for thousands of our customers.
  
  
You will collaborate strongly with our partners in Product Management, Security and Compliance – we’re all pulling in the same direction to deliver the secure, reliable software our customers want and need.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**You will fit perfectly if you share these values**

* People first.
* Manage a team of 7+ Engineers.
* Being open-minded for discussions and promoting team collaboration.
* Taking initiative, responsibility, and ownership of the projects.
* Driving continuous improvement of the team's productivity, product, and processes.
* Provide career growth and development opportunities for the team and build effective backup/succession plan to handle unanticipated attrition.
* Interact with product management and other engineering teams ( XD, Devops, Tech support, Release teams etc.) to develop / release software products which fulfill the requirements defined by the product owner.
* Provide technical leadership to the team for design, architecture, code reviews and incorporate engineering best practices into feature development, refactoring work and product maintenance.
* Determine the staffing required for scrum teams to complete assigned tasks. Facilitate the required trainings for the team to help them to complete their tasks.
* Experience working with Quality Leads.
* Responsible for hiring of software engineers for agile development teams.
* Mentor, train and motivate software engineers to increase overall technical skillsets and stay current with technology trends.
* Drive the annual performance reviews and appraisal process for the team.
* Participate in the campus / Industry hiring drives.
* Work with team to resolve customer issues as per defined service level agreements.
* Able to successfully deliver committed features on time and meeting project objectives/deadlines.
* Participate in various scrum ceremonies such as Daily scrum calls , Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospection

**Qualifications/Skills**

* Bachelor/Master degree in computer engineering or equivalent.
* 12+ years of software development experience in a technical capacity and minimum 3 years of managerial experience.
* Expertise in any of the development technologies : Java or C#.
* Expertise in designing complex solutions, code reviews, providing architectural input on team-wide/cross-location projects, defining branching strategies and able to drive cross-team initiatives.
* Good familiarity with testing pyramid, test plans, automation, code coverage, continuous integration, performance and security testing.
* Monitoring the team productivity and maximizing utilization across various projects / initiatives.
* Keep up-to-date with technology trends & processes while driving adoption of the same , encourage innovation and lead knowledge sharing strategies. Should be able to pick up and deliver stories/tasks based on the project needs.
* Expertise in agile methodology and handling of scrum teams.
* Assist the team to unblock issues by providing effective resolutions.
* Delegate to engineers with clearly defined responsibility and empowerment.
* Expertise in dealing with performance management which includes regular 1-1's, performance /appraisal discussions with the engineer.
* Ensuring team is adhering to the organizational policies and guidelines.
* Proven ability to drive and enhance team engagement, fostering a collaborative and motivated work environment.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Experienced in managing high performance teams , understanding their feedback and guide them in their career path.
* Ability to attract/recruit/retain talent
* Be a coach, mentor and employee champion.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to abstract functional requirements.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Bangalore, Karnataka, India, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Job Description**
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything—and that includes the health, well-being, and everyday experiences of our employees.
  
  
**About IMFT**
IMFT is the transformation program within Innovative Medicine Finance, dedicated to enabling Finance and its business partners to deliver outstanding value and balanced competitive advantage for our organization, partners, and patients.
  
  
We are advancing Finance with digital proficiencies and tools to become an informative partner that accelerates decision-making, optimizes resources, and fuels innovation. Our focus is on identifying what matters most, prioritizing initiatives with real impact, sequencing change strategically, and bringing discipline to our transformation efforts.
  
  
As a member of IMFT, you’ll be at the heart of delivering an integrated, multi-functional transformation that optimizes resources, investment allocation, and value creation across the organization.
  
  
**We are searching for the Best talent for IMUAM Deployment Manager**
The IM UAM Deployment Manager provides leadership and delivery accountability for UAM deployment activities within the J&J Innovative Medicine (IM) UAM team. This role is responsible for managing individual Transcend S/4HANA releases and other UAM projects from PI execution through testing, cutover preparation and execution, go-live, hypercare, and transition to steady state. The role combines people leadership, stakeholder management, project governance, issue resolution, and functional expertise in authorization design, Segregation of Duties (SoD), access governance, and compliance within a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
  
  
**You will be responsible for**

* Manage UAM deployment delivery for individual Transcend SAP S/4HANA releases in a regulated pharmaceutical environment, ensuring execution of the global UAM deployment strategy in line with deployment milestones, quality expectations, and program governance requirements.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 3-5 Security Analysts, setting priorities, providing guidance, supporting performance and development discussions, and aligning team activities with J&J and UAM talent development expectations.
* Own UAM deployment readiness across all deployment phases, ensuring persona design, testing, cutover/provisioning, and hypercare activities are planned, resourced, monitored, and completed in line with release milestones and entry/exit criteria.
* Drive planning, prioritization, and execution control across UAM deployment activities, including progress tracking, dependency management, risk and issue escalation, and integration with broader program plans.
* Oversee role design quality and compliance health checks before build, before cutover, and after go-live to confirm alignment with authorization principles, SoD controls, and applicable compliance expectations.
* Manage cutover planning for access deployment activities, including role transport sequencing, user provisioning readiness, emergency access planning, business validation steps, issue escalation, and stakeholder alignment.
* Manage hypercare support and transition to steady state, ensuring access issues are prioritized, root causes are understood, remediation actions are tracked, and ownership is clearly handed over to operational teams.
* Provide oversight of SoD risks, sensitive access, and mitigation actions during deployment, ensuring risks are visible, appropriately escalated, and managed to support compliant access enablement in regulated environments.
* Establish, monitor, and communicate UAM deployment KPIs and management reporting, including defect volumes, role readiness, cutover completion, provisioning accuracy, open risks, and hypercare stabilization trends.
* Drive continuous improvement of the UAM deployment framework by applying lessons learned from releases to strengthen methodology, controls, templates, deployment efficiency, taxonomy, governance, and the operating model.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or university-level qualification in a relevant field, such as Finance, Supply Chain, IT, or Engineering.
* Minimum of 8 years’ relevant experience in international companies, including at least 5 years of people management or team leadership experience.
* Expertise in business role design and SAP security concepts.
* Demonstrable experience managing ERP deployment programs and project delivery in sophisticated, multi-functional environments.
* Solid understanding of sophisticated system landscapes and global template design.
* Good knowledge of SAP S/4HANA authorization concepts and familiarity with compliance requirements such as SOX, GxP, IT, and Privacy.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA implementation projects.
* Specialist knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control, Process Control, and identity management tools.
* Good understanding of SoD, mitigation, and remediation concepts.
* Good knowledge of risk matrix and rule set maintenance.
* Specialist knowledge of data analysis, data conversion, and migration.
* Solid project management, planning, prioritization, and execution leadership skills.
* Ability to lead and empower teams in a virtual or remote working environment.
* Strong collaborator management, communication, collaboration, presentation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written English skills.
* Experience influencing and collaborating across large business, IT, security, and compliance organizations.
* Collaborative, value-based, and outcome-oriented leadership style with the ability to manage teams, develop talent, and drive accountability.
* Experience establishing or operating UAM governance frameworks, including standards, policies, decision forums, and performance metrics to supervise progress and accountability.
* Experience managing compliance requirements, change impacts, and stakeholder expectations during technology or process transformation programs.

Johnson & Johnson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Release Delivery Lead
description:
About the job:
  
  
We are seeking to construct a best in class digital organization, where the ERP will be a solid, adaptive backbone of our systems and our supporting functions applications are innovation technology solutions that give our business the (digital) wings to fly everyday! Interested to know more? Contact us!
  
  
We are looking for Release Delivery Lead profile who ensures that the SAP system remains robust, secure, and aligned with business objectives while facilitating smooth system evolutions with releases and minimizing disruptions during changes.
  
  
Main responsibilities:
  
  
Lead SAP Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and Cross-Digital CAB ensuring change controls adherence and improvement of the release framework.
  
  
Coordinate release windows and annual calendar with business units, IT teams, and infrastructure teams to minimize operational disruption.
  
  
Define, maintain and communicate SAP release calendar across landscape.
  
  
Manage transport requests and ensure proper sequencing across SAP system landscapes.
  
  
Act as Release Delivery Manager to bring package of functionalities from scoping to delivery communicating with stakeholders, identifying risks and addressing them until resolution.
  
  
Continuous improvement of Release management ways of working from ideation to adoption, end to end without disruptions in the operation, and in cooperation with AMS, SAP experts and other stakeholders.
  
  
Ensure the sustain, evolution and governance of Release supporting toolset such as Solution Manager, JIRA, Confluence with strong emphasis in innovation and adoption of emerging technologies such AI and automation.
  
  
Establish and maintain the right level of governance, leading the Global Release meeting, conducting quality gates, milestone reviews and Business Go/No-Go reviews. Proactively report any releases risks and come with necessary mitigation plans.
  
  
Communicate with stakeholders to identify any issues or risks that may affect the release schedule or quality of the ERP platform.
  
  
Ensure the release notes are always set up and communicated with digital and business stakeholders as a part of release management process.
  
  
Perform post-release analysis to identify any issues that occurred during the release process and develop plans to prevent similar problems in future releases.
  
  
Organize recurrent alignment with major rollouts and live country projects (sharing changes to methodology, outages, etc..).
  
  
About applicant:
  
  
8+ years work experience as ERP Release Manager in complex landscape, preferably in a FMCG and/or FMCH context.
  
  
Solid experience in SAP release management, with a deep understanding of SAP S4HANA architecture and its modules, integrated systems and with technical knowledge to handle technical dependencies and conflicts.
  
  
Good understanding of S4HANA upgrade process and supporting toolset such SAP Readiness Check with at least one contribution to the delivery of a Major release with upgraded systems in scope.
  
  
Contributed in the design and adoption of retrofit, freeze and downtime strategies.
  
  
Hands on in related supporting tools such Jira, Solution Manager, Confluence, Service-now to support application lifecycle activities.
  
  
Experience in Focused Build or SAP Cloud ALM is a plus.
  
  
Familiar with SAP activate methodology is a plus.
  
  
Solid understanding of project management methodologies, software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies and agile practices.
  
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  
  
At ease with Microsoft Office tools, and in general with IS tools.
  
  
Experience with multi-geography, multi-tier service design and management.
  
  
Conceptual and analytical thinking – ability to extract, analyse, and document complex business and technical requirements or strategies.
  
  
Soft skills:
  
  
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  
  
Demonstrated conflict resolution & problem-solving skills in a global environment
  
  
Strong appetite to learn and discover, entrepreneur mindset
  
  
Adaptable and open to change
  
  
Team player, service-oriented
  
  
Analytical and synthetic, able to formalize solutions, good writing skills
  
  
Strong oral and written communication skills
  
  
With leadership attitude, autonomy and results driven
  
  
Role model our 4 values: teamwork, integrity, respect, courage
  
  
Education: Bachelor’s Degree (B.A.) or equivalent in Information Technology or Engineering
  
  
Languages: Fluent spoken and written English

* governor limits, security, and platform constraints.

* integration frameworks.
