* sprint planning, development, QA, and deployment.
* Collaborate with business SMEs, product owners, and cross-functional teams to
* translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Oversee release management, environment strategy, DevOps pipelines, and
* change management processes.
* Manage project risks, dependencies, budget, stakeholders, and release
* timelines.

**Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Lead, mentor, and support Salesforce developers, admins, consultants, and QA engineers.
* Conduct technical capability assessments and drive continuous learning in areas like Apex, LWC, integrations, and Salesforce certifications.
* Guide junior team members on troubleshooting, performance tuning, design decisions, and platform best practices.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the technical liaison between business teams and the engineering team.
* Run design workshops, solution walkthroughs, and architecture discussions with customers/stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales, effort estimation, solution demonstrations, and project scoping.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure high-quality documentation for architecture, integrations, data flows, and technical builds.
* Drive improvement initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, testing automation, and org optimization.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and integration failures.
* Maintain compliance with Salesforce security, data governance, and architectural guidelines.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8–15 years of overall IT experience with a minimum of 5+ years leading
* Salesforce projects.

**Deep technical expertise in:**

* Apex, Triggers, SOQL/SOSL
* Lightning Web Components (LWC) & Aura
* Flows, Process Builder (retirement-ready), and declarative tools
* Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP), Platform Events, Integration Patterns
* Data modeling, large datasets, and performance optimization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, multi-org strategy, governor
* limits, sharing/security model, and deployment processes.
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and
* ideally field service or CPQ.
* Strong experience with Agile/Scrum, backlog management, user stories, and sprint planning.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and leadership skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect (highly preferred)
* Salesforce Administrator / Advanced Administrator
* Project management certifications (PMP, CSM, SAFe) are an added advantage.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, Azure DevOps, Git).
* Experience working with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Kafka.
* Experience managing multi-cloud Salesforce implementations.
* Exposure to enterprise integration patterns, security standards, SSO, OAuth, and Identity.
* Experience guiding org consolidation, technical debt remediation, and modernization initiatives.

* Design escalation paths from Support to Engineering, with clear severity definitions and response expectations.
* Use AI to classify, summarise and route incoming tickets so Engineering gets clean, actionable issues.
* Run a lean bug triage cadence so issues are prioritised, assigned and closed.
* Coordinate releases so Support knows what’s shipping, when, and what changes for patients, with release notes drafted automatically.
* Drive post-incident reviews and track follow-up actions to closure.

***Lead the move to the new platform***

* Plan and run the onboarding of a large Customer Support team onto the new platform: training, new workflows, updated runbooks and a smooth cutover.
* Keep service levels steady during the transition, with readiness checks, go-live sign-offs and clear rollback plans.
* Capture feedback from Support during rollout and turn it into prioritised input for Engineering.
* Lead the change: help people confidently adopt new tools and ways of working.

***Structure and cadence***

* Set up a lightweight operating rhythm: stand-ups, weekly delivery and support reviews, and monthly business reviews with Eden US leadership.
* Replace manual status reporting with automated updates pulled from Jira, Zendesk and other tools.
* Surface risks and dependencies early through automated signals and live dashboards.
* Build simple, reusable delivery standards: templates, dashboards and a single source of truth.

***Performance and governance***

* Define and track SLAs and KPIs across both teams: response and resolution times, escalation volume, bug turnaround and sprint predictability.
* Give Eden US and Softobiz leadership real-time visibility of delivery health.
* Manage capacity planning, resourcing, onboarding and offboarding, and utilisation.
* Track headcount and costs against budget.

**Must have**

* 10+ years of experience, including 4+ in service delivery or PMO in an offshore, GCC or managed services setup.
* Experience working across both Support or Operations teams and Engineering teams.
* A track record of moving teams onto new systems, tools or processes, and bringing structure where there was little.
* Hands-on use of AI tools and automation platforms in delivery work, with examples to show.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Zendesk or similar tools, and dashboards.
* Confident handling VP and C-level US stakeholders.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Healthcare or telehealth experience.
* Experience with platform migrations or go-lives that affected large support or operations teams.
* Low-code or no-code automation builds (n8n, Zapier, Power Automate).
* ITIL, PMP or PRINCE2 certification.

**What success looks like in your first 6 months**

* Support and Engineering run on agreed escalation paths, severity definitions and triage cadence.
* A clear plan for moving Support onto the new platform is in motion, with service levels holding steady.
* Status reporting is largely automated, and SLA and KPI dashboards are live.
* Escalations and repeat incidents are visibly down.

**Why join**

* Lead one of the most important moves in Eden’s growth: taking a live operation onto its next-generation platform.
* Be part of the founding team of Eden’s India Engineering and Product Hub, and shape how it operates from the ground up.
* Build a modern, AI-driven delivery function from day one.
* High visibility and a clear mandate.

**How we’ll assess you**

* Walk us through a time you moved a team onto a new system or way of working: what you changed and what improved.
* Show us a workflow, report or process you automated with AI or automation tools.
* Expect a scenario exercise where you design an escalation and triage model for a Support and Engineering setup, using AI where it helps.
* Expect a conversation with leadership about how you handle stakeholders and report on delivery.

Core Skills & RequirementsDomain & SQA Experience: 10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.Domain & Network Security Expertise:Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules.Test Automation & Scripting:Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in Python (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e.g., IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay).Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction:Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump).Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors.Methodologies & Processes:Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.Professional Experience:8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).Key CompetenciesStrong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams. title: Lead - Infrastructure Testing Governance & ServiceNow Test Management Product
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and strategic
**Infrastructure Testing Governance & ServiceNow Test Management Product Lead**
to drive the evolution of enterprise infrastructure testing practices and own the ServiceNow Test Management platform roadmap.
  
  
This role is responsible for defining and governing infrastructure testing processes, ensuring testing controls and quality gates are consistently applied across technology changes, and driving continuous improvement through incident analysis and lessons learned. The individual will serve as the Product Lead for the ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM), partnering with stakeholders and ServiceNow development teams to translate business requirements into scalable solutions that improve testing effectiveness, traceability, compliance, and operational resilience.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines expertise in testing governance, process design, requirements management, ServiceNow product ownership, and cross-functional leadership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
ServiceNow Test Management Product Ownership
  
  

* Own the vision, roadmap, and continuous enhancement of the ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM).
* Gather, document, and prioritize business requirements from testing, engineering, infrastructure, and application teams.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements and user stories.
* Partner closely with ServiceNow developers, architects, and platform teams to design and implement solutions.
* Manage product backlog, feature prioritization, and release planning.
* Drive user adoption and ensure platform capabilities align with evolving organizational needs.
* Establish metrics and reporting to measure platform value and effectiveness.

Infrastructure Testing Governance
  
  

* Define, implement, and maintain enterprise infrastructure testing standards, processes, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure testing requirements, controls, and process gates are consistently applied across infrastructure changes.
* Drive adherence to testing policies, validation standards, and governance requirements.
* Establish testing readiness criteria and approval processes for infrastructure changes.
* Partner with change management, engineering, and operational teams to improve testing quality and change success rates.
* Monitor testing compliance and identify areas for process improvement.

Testing Process Leadership
  
  

* Lead the development and continuous improvement of testing methodologies, workflows, and operating procedures.
* Standardize testing practices across infrastructure and platform teams.
* Define testing requirements, traceability expectations, and quality metrics.
* Promote automation and efficient validation practices to increase testing coverage and reduce operational risk.
* Ensure testing processes support risk-based decision making and production stability objectives.

Incident Review and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Facilitate post-implementation reviews and incident analysis related to infrastructure changes.
* Identify testing gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions resulting from production incidents and testing failures.
* Leverage incident trends and metrics to enhance testing standards, controls, and platform capabilities.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Collaborate with infrastructure engineering, application teams, platform teams, quality engineering, risk, audit, and change management stakeholders.
* Lead governance discussions and provide recommendations to leadership on testing strategy and process improvements.
* Communicate testing risks, readiness, compliance status, and improvement opportunities to senior stakeholders.
* Influence adoption of enterprise testing standards and best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 9+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Management, Infrastructure Testing, Change Management, or related disciplines.
* Experience defining and governing enterprise testing processes and controls.
* Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.
* Experience partnering with development teams to deliver technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, testing methodologies, and change management practices.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving organizational change.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow Test Management Module (TMM) experience.
* ServiceNow Product Owner or Platform Owner experience.
* Experience with infrastructure change testing and validation.
* Knowledge of enterprise governance, risk, and compliance practices.
* Experience implementing process improvement programs.
* Familiarity with testing automation platforms and reporting solutions.
* Experience working in large-scale enterprise technology environments.

Success in This Role
  
  
**A Successful Candidate Will**

* Establish a scalable and effective infrastructure testing governance framework.
* Drive adoption and maturity of the ServiceNow Test Management platform.
* Improve testing compliance, traceability, and operational consistency.
* Reduce production risk through stronger testing controls and processes.
* Use incident learnings to continuously improve testing effectiveness.
* Serve as the trusted leader for enterprise testing governance and ServiceNow test management capabilities.

This description should attract candidates who can function as a
**Product Owner, Business Analyst, Process Owner, Governance Lead, and Testing Strategist**
all within a single role. That's likely the profile you need given the breadth of ownership you're describing.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Software Engineering, Manager

Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

description:

Development

ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.
  
  
Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and - through our product SIMS - collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.

Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced
**Senior QA Engineer**
to join our Agile product development team. The ideal candidate will ensure high-quality software delivery through strong manual testing, automation, API validation, and end-to-end testing practices.
  
  
This role requires a balance of
**hands-on manual testing expertise and automation capabilities**
, along with strong collaboration across cross-functional teams. You will play a key role in identifying quality risks early and driving continuous improvements in testing processes.
  
  

* Understand business and technical requirements and convert them into detailed test scenarios and test cases.
* Design, develop, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scripts for web, mobile, and API-based applications.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Validate end-to-end workflows across UI, API, and database layers.
* Conduct UI testing to ensure functionality, usability, and cross-browser compatibility.
* Perform API testing using tools like Postman or Swagger (validate requests, responses, status codes, and data integrity).

title: Senior Full Stack GenAI Developer
description:
**About Position:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack GenAI Developer to build and deliver enterprise-grade AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in full-stack development using Java and/or Python, modern frontend frameworks, AWS cloud technologies, and Generative AI frameworks. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying end-to-end GenAI solutions, including user interfaces, APIs, retrieval pipelines, LLM integrations, and cloud-native services while following secure and scalable engineering practices.

* **Role: Senior Full Stack GenAI Developer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: Between 6 to 10 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Java, Python, React, Angular, and modern development frameworks.
* Build and integrate Generative AI capabilities into enterprise applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search solutions.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs, backend services, and microservices architectures.
* Integrate foundation models and AI services into business applications using industry-standard frameworks and tools.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, designers, and engineering teams to define requirements and deliver business value.
* Develop automated testing strategies across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing layers.
* Implement AI guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure reliable AI system performance.
* Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS using containerized and serverless architectures.
* Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable automated deployments and efficient software delivery.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design sessions.
* Apply secure coding practices and compliance controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues, and continuously improve system reliability and scalability.
* Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, cloud technologies, software engineering practices, and enterprise architecture patterns.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* 6 to 10 years of experience in Full Stack Development, Software Engineering, or Enterprise Application Development.
* Strong backend development experience using Java (Spring Boot) and/or Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Hands-on experience with frontend development using React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, and modern UI frameworks.
* Expertise in designing and developing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Hands-on experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Embeddings, Vector Databases, and Agentic AI workflows.
* Experience implementing AI guardrails, model evaluations, LLM monitoring, and governance controls.
* Proficiency with GenAI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Strands, or similar technologies.
* Strong working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native design principles.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and microservices-based architectures.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, observability, and resilience engineering.
* Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps concepts, including prompt versioning, model versioning, evaluation automation, monitoring, and optimization.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and distributed application design.
* Strong problem-solving, debugging, performance optimization, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Experience within Banking, Financial Services, Payments, or highly regulated industries will be an added advantage.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.

title: Senior .NET Software Engineer – Tieto Banktech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics’ most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who is both hands-on and strategic, to play a pivotal role in modernizing and leading the development of our Equity post-trade platform. Working closely with the Product Manager, you will spend the majority of your time coding while shaping the architecture, mentoring the team, and driving the transition from legacy monolithic systems to modular, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-on Development: Architect, design, and implement robust solutions, with a focus on RESTful APIs, microservices, and domain-driven design.
* Legacy Modernization: Lead the refactoring of monolithic, DB-driven systems, lifting business logic out of stored procedures into modular and maintainable components.
* Technical Leadership: Mentor and guide a distributed engineering team (Stockholm & Pune), promoting best practices, clean code, and technical excellence.
* Architecture Strategy: Collaborate with Product Manager to define and implement a technical roadmap aligned with business goals.
* Quality & Resilience: Drive initiatives to improve code quality, reliability, and maintainability in complex systems.
* Business Collaboration: Translate complex business workflows into technical solutions while balancing speed, scalability, and risk.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong programming experience in SQL, C#, and .NET, with a track record of hands-on coding in production systems.
* Proven experience in API design, microservices architecture, and domain-driven design.
* Track record of driving technical transformation in legacy systems.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy, DB-heavy systems, refactor monolithic codebases, and implement modular architectures.
* Experience leading and mentoring distributed teams, fostering knowledge sharing and technical growth.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms (Azure), Git, and DevOps practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience in Equity post-trade or Capital Markets systems.
* Understanding of equity trading workflows and complex business scenarios.
* Minimum 7 years of experience working on enterprise-level solutions.
* Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker/Kubernetes) and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in a product organization with strong collaboration between tech and business.

**We Offer**
We offer a unique opportunity to shape the architecture of a critical banking platform, work on meaningful projects, and influence a growing, distributed team. You will have the freedom to be hands-on while also driving modernization, supported by an open culture, flexible hybrid work model, and a focus on continuous learning.
  
  
Interested?
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application! Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today. For more information or questions, please contact Krishna.kumari@tieto.com
  
  
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
  
  
Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
  
  
Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. to lead Quality Engineering and Testing initiatives for enterprise-scale Azure cloud platforms and cloud-native applications. Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Scrum Master - AVP
description:
Date live: 10/26/2026

Business Area: Cards Platform

Area of Expertise: Change

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000130420

  

Join us as a “Scrum Master - AVP" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job-specific skillsets.

To be successful as a “Scrum Master - AVP", you should have experience with:

  
  

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications:**

* Agile Delivery & Ceremonies.
* Facilitate and time‑box all Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Ensure ceremonies are value‑driven, outcome‑focused, and aligned to MCP ways of working.
* Support teams in defining Sprint Goals, managing commitments, and avoiding spill‑overs.
* Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria, are estimated with team consent, and follow Agile best practices.
* Coach teams on Agile and Scrum principles, fostering ownership, accountability, and self‑organisation.
* Create a psychologically safe environment that enables honest reflection and continuous improvement.
* Identify and remove impediments and blockers to maintain delivery momentum.
* Promote strong Agile hygiene including Jira updates, correct status/labels, and transparent reporting.
* Act as a bridge between delivery teams and Product Owners, Tech Leads, Architects, Release/Integration teams, and other Scrum Masters.
* Proactively manage cross‑team dependencies, risks, and delivery constraints.
* Represent the team in MCP forums (e.g. design reviews, sprint demos, governance touchpoints).
* Escalate risks and issues with clear context and data‑backed insights.
* Track and report delivery health using Agile metrics (e.g. sprint predictability, carry‑over, team capacity).
* Support compliance with Barclays governance, risk, and control expectations.
* Ensure transparency on delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.
* Contribute to Quarterly / PI objectives and Scrum Master OKRs for MCP teams.

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**

* Proven experience as a Scrum Master in complex technology delivery environments.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Agile, and Lean principles.
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM).
* SAFe or large‑scale Agile exposure.
* Experience working with cross‑functional engineering teams (Dev, QA, Architecture).
* Hands‑on experience with Jira / Agile tooling.
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict‑resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across business and technology.

This role will be based out of Pune.

.

**Purpose of the role**

Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.

**Accountabilities**

1.Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
  
2.Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
  
3.Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
  
4.Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
  
5.Build High-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high-performing team attributes
  
6.Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
  
7.Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  
OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  
Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  
Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  
Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  
Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  
Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  
Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  
Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

  

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

The role requires a hands-on engineer with strong technical knowledge, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to operate in a high-dependency environment where reliability, ownership, knowledge sharing, and Agile ways of working are essential.

  
  

**Key Relationships:**

Senior Software Engineer and AS400 Team, Technology Leadership in Egypt and EMEA, Business Product Owners and Stakeholders, Agile Release Train (ART) Teams, Scrum Master, Product Owner, Infrastructure and Platform Teams, and external vendors and partners where applicable.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain COBOL-based applications on AS400 / IBM i-Series platforms.

* Ensure high availability, performance, and stability of business-critical production systems.

* Take ownership of assigned tasks and system components, including incident analysis, root cause identification, and continuous improvement, working closely with the Senior Software Engineer where required.

* Collaborate with business, product, engineering, and Agile team members to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.

* Support end-to-end delivery, including development, testing, deployment, and post-production support.

* Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and architectural decisions as part of the AS400 team.

* Support production deployments and critical releases, helping ensure minimal disruption to business operations.

* Drive knowledge documentation and transfer to reduce single points of failure within the organization.

* Contribute to modernization initiatives, integration efforts, and optimization of legacy systems.

* Work as part of Agile teams, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, estimations, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and delivery of user stories.

  
  

**Operating Model & Working Conditions:**

* This role supports the Egypt business and follows Sunday to Thursday working days, with standard working hours aligned to Egypt business hours.

* Production deployments and critical releases are typically scheduled during weekends, Friday and Saturday.

* Flexibility is required, as working hours may vary depending on project needs, releases, and production support activities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* 4-6 years of hands-on software engineering and production experience.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

* Strong hands-on experience in COBOL programming and IBM AS400 / IBM i-Series platforms.

* Proven experience in production support and incident management for critical systems.

* Solid understanding of application design, architecture, system integration, and data flows.

* Experience working as part of Agile teams and following Agile ways of working.

* Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and collaboration tools is a plus.

* Prior experience in the insurance or financial services domain is highly preferred.

  
  

**Technical Capabilities:**

  

* AS400 / IBM i-Series ecosystem, including CL and RPG as required capabilities.

* COBOL development and maintenance.

* Batch processing and job scheduling.

* System performance tuning and optimization.

* Integration with external systems and platforms.

* Understanding of cloud and hybrid architectures is an advantage.

* Application design and architecture.

* DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and collaboration tools.

  
  

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.

* Clear and effective communication skills.

* High level of accountability and ownership.

* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within the AS400 team and Agile delivery teams.

* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.

* Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

  
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Stable and reliable operation of AS400-based critical systems.

* Reduced dependency on single individuals through proper documentation and knowledge sharing.

* Efficient handling of incidents with minimal business disruption.

* Continuous enhancement and optimization of legacy platforms.

* Strong alignment with business needs, Agile team commitments, sprint goals, and delivery timelines.

  
  
  

**About MetLife**  
  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.  
  

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

  

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s #AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

title: Facilitator- Technical Project Management
description:
**Job Description**

Role: Facilitator – Technical Project Management

(TPM)

Location: Remote (India)

Position Overview

The Facilitator – Technical Project Management plays a critical role in delivering

high-quality academic support and learning experiences to students enrolled in the

Technical Project Management program. The Facilitator is responsible for conducting live

instructional sessions, supporting students through on-demand tutoring and video

explanations, performing quality assurance reviews, and actively contributing to learner

engagement initiatives.

This role requires strong learner empathy, structured feedback capability, and the ability to

simplify complex project management and technical concepts for beginner and

intermediate learners. The Facilitator will collaborate closely with mentors and academic

teams to improve delivery quality, strengthen curriculum effectiveness, and support newly

onboarded experts (MNEs).

Candidates with a strong academic background and research orientation, or those currently

pursuing a PhD in Engineering Management, Information Systems, Operations

Management, Computer Science, or related disciplines, will be given preference.

Eligibility Criteria

* Minimum 4+ years of industry and/or teaching experience in Technical Project

Management, IT Project Management, or Software Delivery Management

* Strong track record of delivering technical projects end to end, from initiation to

closure

* Preference for candidates currently pursuing a PhD in Engineering Management,

Information Systems, Operations Management, Computer Science, or related

domains

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering / Technology / Management / related

disciplines preferred

* Prior experience in EdTech, mentoring, or online instruction is an added advantage

* Strong communication skills with the ability to teach US-based learners

* Experience conducting sessions using Zoom or similar virtual learning platforms

* Strong grasp of modern project management tools and workflows

* Ability to provide structured, actionable learner feedback

* Ability to mentor junior experts and contribute to academic quality improvement

initiative
  
Primary Responsibilities

* Perform all core academic support activities, including:

o Live Lessons

o Weekly Video Tutoring

o On-Demand Tutoring Support

o QA Review

* Maintain a minimum QA score of 80% or above across all assigned activities

* Deliver high-quality responses aligned with academic standards during live support

interactions

* Review mentor session content based on updated internal guidelines

* Provide structured feedback on externally sourced academic content across all

difficulty levels

* Support students through on-demand video explanations

* Conduct interactive Q&A sessions to enhance conceptual clarity

* Participate in community engagement initiatives to support learner success

* Identify learner knowledge gaps and escalate insights to Leads

* Train and mentor MNEs during their first 90 days of onboarding

* Provide continuous process support to MNEs in their day-to-day academic activities

* Collaborate with mentors and academic teams to strengthen delivery quality

* Suggest improvements to:

o Activity guidelines

o Internal processes

o Learning workflows

* Contribute recommendations for curriculum updates and new course additions

aligned with market demand

* Monitor incoming academic workload and recommend shift redistribution when

required

* Prepare contribution reports on:

o SME academic effectiveness

o Live support engagement quality

* Curate emerging tools, methodologies, and technologies relevant to Technical

Project Management programs

Secondary Responsibilities

* Evaluate video support interactions, live lesson delivery quality, and on-demand

tutoring responses as per defined QA standards

* Present structured insights and recommendations to support process improvement

initiatives and academic delivery effectiveness

* Assist in strengthening instructional delivery frameworks, learner engagement

strategies, and overall academic support quality across facilitator activities

* Support curriculum alignment with evolving industry project management practices

and hiring expectations

* Assist in identifying opportunities to improve overall learner experience across the

program

Subject Expertise Requirements – Technical Project

Management

Project Management Foundations

Candidates should demonstrate strong working knowledge of:

* Project lifecycle (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure)

* Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies

* Scope, schedule, cost, and resource management

* Work breakdown structures (WBS), estimation techniques, and Gantt/timeline

planning

* Dependency mapping and critical path method (CPM)

* Stakeholder identification, engagement, and communication planning

* Project charter, requirements gathering, and acceptance criteria

* Release and deployment planning

Technical Acumen

Strong understanding of:

* Software development lifecycle (SDLC) and DevOps/CI-CD fundamentals

* System architecture basics (APIs, databases, microservices, cloud)

* Technical trade-off analysis and technical debt management

* Cloud and infrastructure fundamentals (AWS / Azure / GCP)

* Testing and QA processes (UAT, regression, release readiness)

* Security, privacy, and compliance considerations

* Incident management and postmortems

Tools & Platforms

Hands-on experience with:

* Jira

* Confluence

* MS Project / Asana / Smartsheet / Trello (good to have)

* Miro / Lucidchart (collaboration and diagramming tools)

* Dashboards and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)

* Basic SQL or data querying (good to have)

Risk, Metrics & Governance
  
  
Working knowledge of:

* Risk identification, assessment, and mitigation planning (RAID logs)

* Project health metrics, KPIs, and status reporting

* Velocity, burndown/burnup charts, and earned value management (EVM)

* Change control and escalation processes

* Retrospectives and lessons learned

Bonus Skills (Preferred)

Exposure to:

* PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, CSM, PSM, or equivalent certifications

* Scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe) and multi-project coordination

* Distributed and cross-functional team leadership

* Vendor and contract management

* Budgeting and resource forecasting

* Project management office (PMO) practices and templates

Education Requirements

* B.E. / B.Tech / MBA / M.Tech / BSc / MSc or equivalent qualification

* Certification in Project Management, Agile, or Technical Project Management

(PMP, CAPM, CSM, PRINCE2, etc.) preferred

* Minimum 15 years of full-time education

Key Competencies

Ideal candidates should demonstrate:

* Strong learner empathy

* Structured feedback ability

* Project plan and case study critique skills

* Capstone project evaluation capability

* Communication clarity for live instruction

* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical learners

* Collaboration with mentors and SMEs

* Continuous learning mindset

Why do we exist?

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: Senior Engineer, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This position works as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

A senior engineer is a senior role in Software Agile delivery team. The person is responsible for managing and executing the complex software modules almost independently. Additionally, the indvidual is responsible of guding and mentoring junior engineers in the team from technology standpoint.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Work with teams developing and updating enterprise applications.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Work on tasks supporting the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the technical interdependencies between stories and support Engineering Manager and Product Owner with sequencing.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of business and domain. Supports Engineering Manager and Product Owner in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule.
* Demonstrate good understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure and suggest improvements to optimize the infrastructure.
* Participate in the design, architecting and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades working with more senior agile team members and Engineering Manager.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components with minimal support from senior team members.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, support unit testing by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills e.g. creating automation tests using selenium, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/ load testing etc. through internal/ external trainings to be a T-Shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Follow Bain development project process and standards in completing committed tasks and modules and contribute to the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write technical documentation as required.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Contribute to the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Help and possibly lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.

**Communication (10%)**

* Ability to present the technical findings and recommendations to the leadership and Software Development team in general.
* Clearly communicates impediments to completing a story and ensures clear understanding of definition of ‘done’.
* Provide input during sprint retrospective to improve team experience.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during cucial conversations.

**Technical mentoring (5%)**

* Provide technical guidance to junior members. Help create a culture of transparency and sustainability.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions,
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Ability to deliver assigned module/ work with much support from senior engineers with Zero D.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
* Experience developing enterprise scale applications
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated record of T shape behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/ contingencies
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree
* 5-8+ years of relevant experience

  

**Software Engineering - Technical skills:**

* Frameworks: .NET & .NET Core

* Languages: C#, Python, T-SQL
* Web frameworks/ Lib: React, Angular, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos, etc.
* Vector databases: Azure AI Search, Pinecone, pgvector, etc.
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure Services
* GenAI & ML: Azure OpenAI, LLM integration and prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, embeddings, machine learning model development and deployment
* AI coding assistants: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code
* Search engine: Elasticsearch, Coveo, etc.
* Caching: Redis, MemCache
* Unit testing: XUnit, Jasmine, etc.
* DevOps: GitActions

title: Senior UAT & Rollout Governance Specialist - SAP S/4HANA
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
You start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
In short, we are looking for a professional who can independently coordinate stakeholders, drive delivery follow-ups, identify risks and dependencies, and provide program-level visibility across multiple rollout workstreams, rather than primarily performing administrative project support.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience, including relevant experience in IT project/program coordination, enterprise transformation, rollout management, or testing governance.
* Proven experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing activities, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple projects or rollout workstreams.
* Strong capabilities in project governance and performance management, including status reporting, KPI tracking, risk and dependency management, and proactive escalation of delivery issues.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, drive follow-ups, resolve coordination gaps, and ensure timely completion of agreed actions.
* Experience coordinating internal IT and business stakeholders, project managers, and external IT service delivery partners in a complex enterprise environment.
* Understanding of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test planning, testing governance, and rollout delivery processes. Experience with SAP/S/4HANA implementations or rollouts is an advantage.
* Knowledge of IT operations, enterprise IT systems, service management structures, and service delivery performance frameworks.
* Ability to consolidate information from multiple workstreams, identify delivery risks and performance gaps, and provide clear, structured reporting to support decision-making.
* Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work proactively in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Business-fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Staff Engineer I, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build, and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications, built with modern technology stacks and increasingly with AI-assisted and agent-assisted development, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior individual contributor role that reports to the Engineering Manager. The role can independently handle a software module/function, which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management, and communication, and is accountable for the delivery outcomes of the wider team. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for role modeling, and for coaching and mentoring of the team from a technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise-scale applications at Bain, and help drive the overall delivery outcomes of the team.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting, and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades, primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Project/Product Managers.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI agents responsibly to improve team productivity and code quality, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Champion secure software development practices, including secure use of AI-generated code, review of AI output, and protection of data and prompts.
* Own both development and testing: create the end-to-end test plan, execute it, and ensure zero-defect delivery.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support, and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills, e.g. creating automation tests, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing, etc., through internal/external trainings to be a T-shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies, especially in Gen AI, LLMs, and AI agents, beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts, e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, and Product Owner to improve team performance.
* Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with zero defects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T-shaped behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience providing technical leadership to a group of developers.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* AI and Gen AI: understanding of large language models (capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns), Gen AI application development, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vectors, vector databases, machine learning fundamentals
* Secure development: secure software development practices, including for AI-driven development
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, .NET and .NET Core, Java, or equivalent; C#, T-SQL, etc.
* Web frameworks/libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design; microservices, API design, and cloud-native patterns
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure services or equivalent
* Unit testing: xUnit, Jasmine, pytest, Jest, etc.
* Testing and quality: end-to-end test planning and execution, AI-enabled test automation, zero-defect delivery
* DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos DB, etc.
* Caching: Redis, Memcached

title: Associate-Digital Product Operations
description:
**Job Description**
At American Express, we know that with the right backing, people and businesses have the power to progress in incredible ways. Whether we’re supporting our customers’ financial confidence to move ahead, taking commerce to new heights, or encouraging people to explore the world, our colleagues are constantly redefining what’s possible — and we’re proud to back each other every step of the way. When you join #TeamAmex, you become part of a diverse community of over 60,000 colleagues, all with a common goal to deliver an exceptional customer experience every day.
  
  
**Function Description**
With a focus on digitization, innovation, and delivery , Enterprise Communications & Martech Experiences (ECMX) team creates central, scalable platforms and customer experiences to help markets across all of these priorities. Charter is to drive scale for the business and accelerate innovation for both immediate impact as well as long-term transformation of our business. A unique aspect of ECMX is the integration of diverse skills across all of its remit. ECMX has a very broad range of responsibilities, resulting in a broad range of initiatives around the world
  
  
The American Express Enterprise Communication Martech Experiences team centralize web, mobile and push digital product management activities to support our businesses across the enterprise. The focus of this collaborative team is to drive growth via digital user experiences, marketing, strategy, and analytics. The team specializes in using data around digital product usage to drive improvements in the customer experience to deliver higher satisfaction and business value.
  
  
We are seeking a motivated, strategic individual to for Associate-Digital Product Operations position,who is ready to put the customer first and demonstrate mastery of end-to-end customer journeys and how to design experiences and products that people love and that also deliver clear business outcomes.
