The person in this role is expected to maintain & groom the backlog with the help for business stakeholders. The Analyst has to act as a link between stakeholders, and Teams (like scrum, Kanban, testing& Technologies) to support the business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage the Lean Portfolio management model to meet the enterprise Business agility
* Partner with stakeholders to understand the prioritization
* Maintain Product roadmap/backlog for the business unit
* Appropriately identify and raise risks, challenges, opportunities to advance the team
* Enable cross-functional collaboration with relevant teams within the product scope
* Translate product roadmap into well-defined product requirements/user stories and acceptance test criteria

**Qualifications**

* 3-4 years of experience in Product Management and/or Product Development
* Experience with Servicing or Digital Experiences a plus
* Agile SAFe experience (preferred not mandatory)
* Highly motivated and passionate for creating best-in-class products and customer experiences
* A proven ability to define clear customer needs and features and gain buy-in and confidence at multiple levels of the organization
* Experience delivering new experiences and business metrics with a customer-first mindset
* Experience working with Engineering and process teams to evaluate and create clarity in asks
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive decision making, collaboration and alignment
* Ability to build strong relationships with key business partners and stakeholders and take a proactive approach to collaboration

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Staff Engineer - Salesforce/ nCino
description:
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
  
  
**About The Role**
nCino on Salesforce is the platform our lending teams use to originate, approve and manage commercial loans in the UK and US. As Staff Engineer you will be the technical lead for the Salesforce / nCino engineering team in Gurugram. You will own the technical direction of the platform, lead the team's most complex work hands-on, and be the main engineering contact for Lending, Credit and CRM stakeholders.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Integration modernisation: Lead the move of nCino integrations with our core lending platform off MuleSoft onto direct, well-tested integrations, and retire the old flows safely.
* Platform upgrades: Plan and lead nCino release upgrades across the team, including impact analysis, regression testing and rollout.
* Production support: Own production stability for the lending platform. Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and fixes so loans keep booking without disruption.
* Regulatory change: Deliver regulatory changes in nCino, such as Basel 3.1 requirements, with the audit trail and change control a regulated bank needs.
* Integrations: Design and build integrations between nCino and our CRM, customer portal, customer due diligence (KYC) and credit bureau services, including via our data warehouse.
* Data privacy and access: Lead data privacy work such as record anonymisation, and standardise access rights and the security model across the org.
* Standard features first: Enable standard nCino features (for example product packages) instead of building custom code, and reduce existing customisation where possible.
* Test automation and delivery: Work with QA to grow automated test coverage and improve CI/CD for Salesforce deployments.
* Documentation and debt: Keep technical documentation current, and tidy up technical debt and deprecated components.

What you should know
  
  

* 12+ years of Salesforce engineering experience, including at least 3 years on nCino (Commercial Banking / Loan Origination) or a similar lending platform built on Salesforce
* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows and Platform Events, and a clear view of when to use configuration and when to use code
* Strong knowledge of the nCino data model and features: relationships, loans, product packages, covenants, collateral and the loan lifecycle
* Integration design experience: REST/SOAP APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft, event-driven patterns, Named Credentials and OAuth, plus error handling and reconciliation between systems
* Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and field-level security, and how to design these for least privilege
* Salesforce DX, source control (GitHub), automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (e.g. SFDX, Gearset or Copado)
* Experience planning and running managed-package upgrades with minimal disruption to users
* Experience working in a regulated environment, such as a bank or financial services firm, with change control, auditability and data protection (GDPR)
* Proven technical leadership: setting standards, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, breaking down and estimating work, and making sound trade-offs
* Clear communicator who can work directly with Lending, Credit and Product stakeholders across UK, US and India time zones

Nice to have
  
  

* Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer II, Application Architect, Integration Architect) and nCino certifications
* Understanding of commercial lending products and processes, including syndicated lending
* Experience with data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery) and moving data between Salesforce and other systems
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineering

Tech
  
  
We're pragmatic about our technology choices. These are some of the things we use at the moment:
  
  

* Salesforce Platform, nCino
* Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flows, Platform Events
* Salesforce DX, GitHub, CI/CD
* MuleSoft (being retired), REST APIs, Python and NodeJS services
* PostgreSQL, BigQuery
* AWS, GCP
* incident.io, Jira

Work Culture
  
  
We expect you to work in these ways, as well as encouraging and enabling these practices from others:
  
  

* Collaborate - We work in cross-functional, mission driven, autonomous squads that gel over time. We pair program to work better through shared experience and knowledge.
* Focus on outcomes over outputs - Solving a problem for users that translates to business results is our goal. Measurements focused on that goal help us to understand if we are succeeding.
* Practice continuous improvement - We optimize for feedback now, rather than presume what might be needed in the future and introduce complexity before it will be used. We share learnings in blame-free formats, so that we do not repeat things that have failed, but still have confidence to innovate.
* Seek to understand our users - We constantly seek understanding from data and conversations to better serve our users' needs.
* Test outside-in, test first - TDD keeps us confident in moving fast and deploying regularly. We write scenarios first, coupling tests to behavior rather than implementation.
* You build it, you run it - We embrace DevOps culture and end-to-end ownership of products and features. Every engineer has the opportunity to lead delivery of features from start to finish.
* Embrace difference - No egos - people listen to and learn from others at all levels, with strong opinions held loosely. A wide range of voices heard to the benefit of all.

**What We Offer**

* Health & Protection: Medical cover for you, your family & parents; life and accidental cover at a multiple of your salary
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and an Employee Assistance Programme — all sponsored
* Time Off: Earned, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity & paternity leave
* Life Milestones: A financial gesture of support at marriage, childbirth, and bereavement
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave & travel, and NPS
* Growth: Professional certification support, learning & development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days
* Our Workplace: Modern central offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee — we work hard to build a culture worth showing up for

title: Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager
description:
Join us as a an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Product owner, Analytical Skills, Business Acumen, and Stakeholder Management as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
You will work closely with business, operations and cross-functional partners to solve complex problems, shape scalable solutions, and ensure efficient delivery. Acting as the key interface between business and functional stakeholders, you will support the development of product propositions, and/or service strategies—from concept and release.
  
  
To be successful as an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Critical / Essential Skills**

* Define clear business requirements, manage prioritised backlogs and support feature teams through delivery using Agile ways of working and JIRA.
* Extract and analyse data from Barclays Information Warehouse using Structured Query Language, translating complex datasets into clear, business-focused insights and recommendations.
* Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify fraud loss trends, performance drivers, root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Use management information, dashboards, funnel data, complaints, contact drivers and customer feedback to support evidence-based decision-making.
* Own and assess customer journeys end to end, map pain points and conduct journey health checks to improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Establish, monitor and interpret journey and customer-outcome measures, including Net Promoter Score, complaints, customer effort, fraud losses and operational performance.
* Investigate complex customer and fraud-related issues and translate findings into strategic and operational change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of risk, control and governance practices, including Operational Risk and Control Assessments, issue management, Consumer Duty, control monitoring, evidence gathering and escalation.
* Exercise sound judgement on when to act, align or escalate, particularly where customer harm or regulatory risk may arise.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the United Kingdom and India, including Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Controls and Customer Experience teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional and cross-skilled teams to deliver sustainable journey, fraud strategy and customer-outcome improvements.
* Produce high-quality governance materials, management information, presentations and written recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Apply structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, attention to detail and ownership to resolve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrate commercial acumen and knowledge of market trends and the competitor landscape to benchmark performance and inform priorities.
* Use artificial intelligence-enabled tools responsibly to improve analysis, insight generation, backlog quality and documentation, while retaining accountability for outcomes.
* Use Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to at least an intermediate level.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Fraud and scam domain knowledge.
* SQL skills
* Experience supporting AI-enabled processes or transformation.
* Fraud and scam loss management.
* Ability to monitor and interpret loss performance, emerging fraud trends and portfolio risk indicators.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to identify key drivers of fraud and scam losses and define improvement actions.
* Experience supporting loss management, portfolio reviews or performance governance forums.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Sr./Lead QA Automation Engineer – AI Agent
description:
Are you a quality engineer who wants to build confidence in a fast-evolving AI agent — not just execute manual test cases? At SimCorp, we are developing an internal AI agent that supports the software development lifecycle (SDLC): a production-grade, distributed agent hosted in Azure — running 24/7, accessible to everyone in the company, and spanning deep integrations with our engineering systems, secure code execution, and remote development capabilities on user machines.
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve the quality strategy for this product. The product's risk sits in cross-service behavior — where agent runs, tool calls, external integrations, and cloud infrastructure meet. The role blends hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features and AI behavior with designing and building the automated test system — acceptance, integration, contract, and post-deployment validation — that lets the team ship quickly without breaking critical engineering workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a QA Automation Engineer on this team, you will:
  
  
**Test strategy and hands-on testing**

* Define and own the product's test strategy across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, post-deployment, and exploratory testing.
* Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features, AI-agent behavior, and edge cases before and alongside automation.
* Design approaches for testing non-deterministic AI/LLM behavior, tool-use correctness, and prompt regressions.

**Automated coverage**

* Build browser-level acceptance tests that cover key user journeys end to end, from the UI down to persistence and background processing.
* Create validation for MCP endpoints, including authentication flows, client compatibility, and tool schemas.
* Design contract and replay-based tests for critical external integrations where live systems are slow, expensive, or unstable.
* Strengthen test coverage for the highest-risk execution surfaces: sandboxed code execution and the agent's remote sessions on user machines.

**Release confidence and test infrastructure**

* Add post-deployment smoke tests that catch environment, configuration, and identity failures, giving rollback confidence.
* Introduce failure-injection scenarios — service restarts, network loss, expired tokens, rate limits — to prove the product degrades gracefully.
* Improve test data, fixtures, fake connectors, and CI test categorization; manage flaky tests and keep pipelines fast and trustworthy.

**Collaboration and quality leadership**

* Partner with engineers to make features testable and define acceptance criteria before implementation; mentor the team in testing practices.
* Monitor quality signals from CI, static analysis, telemetry, production incidents, and user feedback, and build release-readiness reporting.

**What We Value**

* Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We expect you to be strong in several of the following and interested in learning the rest:
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in quality engineering / test automation for complex web and API platforms.
* Strong C#/.NET test development skills: xUnit/NUnit-style frameworks, mocks and fakes, test fixtures, and CI integration.
* Solid experience with API and integration testing, including authentication and distributed-system failure modes.
* Experience with browser automation such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent.
* Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, and the ability to design test strategies rather than only execute predefined cases.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, test categorization, flaky-test management, and post-deployment smoke testing.
* Ability to investigate failures using logs, traces, telemetry, screenshots, and reproducible minimal scenarios.
* Experience testing AI/LLM products, agentic workflows, streaming responses, or other non-deterministic behavior is a strong advantage.
* At least 1 year of hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex in your daily work.
* Familiarity with open-source agents (e.g., OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, or similar) and how they behave in practice.
* Passion for the AI space and the flexibility to try new technologies: you stay on top of market trends and bring the ecosystem's best practices — better memory, context management, and agent autonomy — into how we build and test the product.
* Working knowledge of Linux and containerized environments (Docker), enough to test and investigate sandboxed code execution, is a strong advantage.
* Experience with Test containers, contract testing, Azure identity, or Windows automation is a plus.
* Proven ability to lead quality direction, influence engineers, and raise the testing bar across a team.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Founder's Office - Operations Lead
description:
Founder's Office – Operations Lead

Location: Noida (on-site, 6 days a week) · Experience: 5–8 years · Reports to: CEO / Founders

**The role:**

SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Lead in the Founder's Office. You will work directly with the founders to find the problems that slow our business down, design practical solutions, and put them into practice on the ground, across a mapping operation of 120+ cartographers serving customers in the US and Canada.

This is not an advisory role. You will spot a problem in the data or on the floor, work out the fix, get Team Leads, Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Sales behind it, roll it out, and prove with numbers that it worked. Then you will move to the next one.

This role suits someone who thinks like a problem-solver, executes like an operator, and knows how to bring people along through change.

About SiteRecon

SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech.

Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

**What you'll do:**

Find the problems that matter

* Dig into operations data, customer escalations and floor-level workflows to find what is hurting delivery, quality, cost or customer experience.
* Separate symptoms from root causes, size each problem by business impact, and agree priorities with the founders.
* Track the metrics that show where operations are slipping: productivity, TAT, SLA adherence, rework, backlog and capacity.

**Design and implement solutions**

* Turn each problem into a clear solution with an owner, a plan, a timeline and a success metric.
* Pilot changes with one team or shift, measure the results, and scale what works across the operation.
* Redesign SOPs, quality checks, workflows and team structures where needed, and make sure they hold on the floor after launch.

**Lead technology and process change**

* Work with Product and Engineering to define tool and workflow improvements for mapping and QA, and own their rollout to the floor.
* Identify manual, repetitive work that can be automated or simplified, and drive it through to implementation.
* Make sure operations can absorb significant growth in volume without the same growth in headcount or complexity.

**Drive change management**

* Win buy-in from Team Leads, QA Supervisors and cartographers for new ways of working, and handle resistance with clarity and patience.
* Plan communication, training and handholding for every change so adoption sticks across shifts.
* Align Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on changes that affect customers, delivery timelines or capacity.

**Track and report improvements**

* Build a simple tracker of every initiative: baseline, target, current result and owner.
* Set up daily, weekly and monthly dashboards that show the impact of changes on operational KPIs.
* Run regular reviews with the founders on what has improved, what has stalled, and what comes next.

Support the founders

* Take on high-priority operational projects directly from the founders, from capacity planning for a large new customer to setting up a new team or process.
* Act as the bridge between the founders' priorities and day-to-day execution on the floor.

**You must have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in operations excellence, process improvement, business transformation, founder's office or strategy-to-execution roles.
* Hands-on exposure to large, metrics-driven operations, such as GIS or mapping, data annotation, KPO, BPO or digital operations.
* A track record of finding a business problem, designing the solution and implementing it yourself, with measurable results you can show.
* Experience leading a technology or tool rollout with Product or Engineering teams and getting it adopted by the people who use it.
* Strong change-management and people skills. You can influence Team Leads and floor teams without direct authority.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You build your own analysis, trackers and dashboards.
* Clear, structured communication with founders, cross-functional teams and frontline staff.

**Good to have**

* Lean, Six Sigma or similar continuous-improvement training.
* Experience at a startup, SaaS or product company.

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
**Eykon Private Limited**
, formerly part of the Landis+Gyr Group, supports electricity, gas, water and thermal utilities in managing increasingly complex networks, improving operational efficiency and enabling more sustainable use of resources.
  
  
  
  
With more than
**2.800 employees in 19 countries**
and decades of experience in critical infrastructure technology, the company provides advanced metering, network intelligence and digital solutions to utilities and infrastructure operators primarily across Europe, Middle East and Africa. As a standalone organisation, Landis+Gyr EMEA builds on long-standing customer relationships and proven technology capabilities, backed by experienced regional teams.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Purpose and Objective
  
  
To ensure firmware and software products are developed and released with the highest levels of quality, reliability, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
  
  

* Embed quality requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to release.
* Work collaboratively with engineering, project, manufacturing, and supplier teams to ensure successful product delivery.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate quality and project risks before they impact customers or schedules.
* Ensure compliance with customer, industry, regulatory, and company quality standards.
* Drive defect prevention, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to improve product performance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance development processes, product quality, and team effectiveness.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide independent quality oversight at key project milestones.
* Ensure products meet customer expectations and are fit for purpose before release.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  
**Firmware/Software PQE Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Escaped Defect Rate: Percentage of defects discovered after release, measuring effectiveness of defect prevention and verification activities.
* Defect Detection Efficiency (DDE): Percentage of defects identified before release versus total defects found.
* Quality Gate Compliance: Percentage of projects passing phase/gate reviews on schedule with no major quality findings.
* Requirements Traceability Coverage: Percentage of requirements traced through design, testing, and validation to release.
* High-Risk Closure Rate: Percentage of critical risks mitigated or closed before project milestones and release.
* Customer-Reported Defects: Number of software/firmware defects reported by customer’s post-release.
* CAPA Effectiveness: Percentage of corrective and preventive actions successfully implemented without recurrence.
* Continuous Improvement Delivery: Number and impact of implemented quality improvements resulting in reduced defects, improved compliance, or increased development efficiency.

**Overview Of The Role**
The Firmware/Software Project Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring software and firmware products are developed, verified, validated, and released in compliance with customer, regulatory, safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.
  
  
The role provides independent quality governance throughout the development lifecycle, driving risk mitigation, defect prevention, process compliance, root cause analysis, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Core Areas of Responsibility/Accountability**

* Lead quality planning and governance throughout the firmware/software development lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Drive risk management, including FMEA, CTQ identification, and mitigation activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed quality, reliability, and compliance into product development.
* Review and approve key quality deliverables, design documentation, and validation plans.
* Facilitate quality reviews, design reviews, and release readiness assessments.
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and defect prevention activities.
* Monitor quality metrics and provide project quality reporting and oversight.
* Support audits, supplier quality activities, NPI, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the independent quality representative, ensuring products meet requirements and are delivered right first time.

title: Associate Vice President, UX Design
description:
**The opportunity**

Odessa is seeking a senior product leader to own the end-to-end user experience strategy across the platform. This role will turn product experience into a company-level advantage by combining product management, experience design, customer discovery, analytics, performance, and platform thinking. The leader will move the organization beyond isolated visual improvements toward simpler business workflows, stronger design ownership, and measurable improvements in adoption, usability, and customer confidence.

**Primary role**

The Associate Vice President, UX Design, will define and communicate a multi-year product experience vision, principles, and roadmap. The role will establish clear ownership for product experience, prioritize high-usage and high-friction journeys, and align Product, Digital Experience, Framework, Engineering, Automation and AI around shared priorities. This leader will translate customer and market insights into executable product decisions and ensure user-facing capabilities are designed for simplicity, responsiveness, quality, and scale.

**What you’ll do**

* Set the UX product strategy: Own a multi-year product experience vision and roadmap that connects market needs, measurable customer outcomes, platform constraints and Odessa’s broader product strategy.
* Own high-impact journeys: Prioritize the most-used and highest-friction workflows using customer feedback, telemetry, product analytics, usability evidence, and commercial impact.
* Simplify the experience: Reduce unnecessary screens, clicks and context switches; promote task-oriented journeys, progressive disclosure and role-relevant experiences that hide avoidable complexity.
* Integrate UI, UX, performance and business experience: Treat visual design, workflow design, terminology, responsiveness, and process fit as one product experience, with common outcomes and measures.
* Lead discovery and product definition: Engage customers, prospects, domain experts, and internal stakeholders to frame problems, define target outcomes, shape requirements and make clear portfolio and sequencing trade-offs.
* Drive roadmap execution: Convert strategy into sequenced initiatives, business cases, product requirements and release plans; partner with Framework, Engineering and Architecture to balance near-term improvements with foundational platform evolution.
* Strengthen design ownership: Build a high-performing product and design capability that creates high-fidelity concepts while owning product and domain understanding, product decisions, stakeholder influence and longer-term UX direction.
* Institutionalize customer-centered practices: Establish journey mapping, prototyping, usability validation, benchmarking, and experience-quality reviews across the product lifecycle.
* Make prioritization evidence-based: Define telemetry and product analytics for priority workflows, establish adoption and friction measures, and use evidence to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Champion quality by design: Introduce early UX and design-system quality reviews, so experience defects are identified before customer releases, and user-facing quality improves.
* Influence across the organization: Create shared goals across Product, Digital Experience, Framework, Engineering, QA, Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success; resolve cross-functional trade-offs and communicate decisions clearly.
* Represent the product experience: Bring a strong product narrative to executive reviews, strategic customer discussions, product demonstrations, and go-to-market planning.

**Basic qualifications**

* 15+ years of product management or related enterprise software experience, including significant senior leadership responsibility.
* Proven ownership of product strategy, portfolio priorities, and multi-release roadmaps for complex enterprise products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of user experience strategy, interaction and journey design, design systems, usability research, and product analytics.
* Ability to connect customer problems, business outcomes, market context, and technical constraints to make clear product decisions.
* Experience leading cross-functional work across Product, Design, Engineering, Architecture, QA, Delivery, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Demonstrated success building and leading senior product and design talent and strengthening product and domain capability.
* Executive-level communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with people who bring different viewpoints.
* Data-driven approach to adoption, usability, performance, quality, and roadmap impact.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with complex, configurable enterprise applications where scale, performance and domain complexity shape the user experience.

title: Senior/ Lead Product Designer
description:
**Design the product people use, and the AI agents that work alongside them**

ITILITE runs business travel, expense management, and payments for 500+ customers, with $50M+ in booking volume. We're building on two fronts at once.

* The first is the digital experience people use every day to book, approve, expense and manage spend. 500+ customers and 100k+ users rely on it, and there's plenty of craft left to put into it.
* The second is an AI-first layer, where a growing team of AI agents does the work for people: booking, rebooking, approvals, expense coding and reconciliation. These agents act in the real world, where mistakes cost money and people need to know when to trust the machine.

You'll design for both, and where they meet. When should an agent act, and when should it ask? How does it explain itself? Whether someone is clicking a screen or talking to an agent, it should feel like one product.

**B2B2C: business buyers, consumer-grade expectations**

We sell to businesses, but the people who feel the product are their employees, and they compare us with the best consumer apps they use. So the bar is the delight of a B2C product with the control a business needs. That's a rarer and more interesting design problem than either one alone, and it's why this work is more fun than "business software" sounds.

**Persona**

* Buyer (finance, procurement, leadership) cares about Cost, visibility, return on investment. Your design question: How do we prove value without burying them in dashboards?
* Admin (travel and finance ops) cares about Control, audit-readiness, fewer escalations. Your design question: How do we give them control without making them the bottleneck?
* Employee (the traveller, the user) cares about Speed, convenience, no friction. Your design question: How do we make the right choice the easy choice?

Cost, convenience and control pull against each other, and we don't want you to pick a winner. We want the design where all three feel the value, whether the work is done by a person or an agent.

**Your canvas**

We're in the 1-10 journey. The foundations are solid, the guardrails are sensible, and a good idea reaches production in weeks, not quarters. You won't start from a blank page, and you won't wait on a chain of approvals either. The design system works the same way. Think of it as a house that's mostly built: the foundations are poured, the walls are up, and most rooms already work well. A few rooms are still unfinished, and a few we'd happily knock through if you showed us a better way to live in them. Pick a component that's been bothering you, rethink it, and tell us where the walls should move. You won't redraw the blueprint, but you will shape it.

**What you'll own**

* **The everyday products.**
  Travel, Expense, and Cards—all three. Booking, approvals, expenses, card management, and the admin tools behind them. You'll make complex workflows feel clear and effortless, and sweat the details that make a product feel finished: empty states, errors, latency, edge cases, accessibility.
* **How people and AI agents work together.**
  You'll define when an agent acts, asks or hands back control, how it shows intent and confidence, how people review, override or undo its work, and how an admin supervises many agents at scale.
* **The machine that makes concepts.**
  A PM writes a PRD, and a workflow turns it into four or five solid concepts grounded in our design system. A designer steps in to steer the styling and make the two or three decisions that matter. We don't want our best designers hand-building prototypes or running twenty prompts. We want them to design this workflow once, so anyone on the team, PMs included, gets strong starting points in minutes. You'll own it and keep improving it.
* **The design system.**
  Improve the components and patterns that matter most, build patterns for AI states and complex workflows, and keep it coherent so AI-generated concepts meet the same bar as what we ship.
* **Decisions that move the business.**
  You'll work with Product and Engineering from problem to launch, build research into a team habit, and use funnels, session data and support conversations to find where people struggle. When a problem is hard, you'll lay out the real options, say which one will work and why, and tie it to outcomes like booking completion, policy compliance and support volume.
* **If you're coming in as Lead,**
  you'll also set the bar for craft, research and AI-assisted workflows across the team, run critiques, and grow the designers around you.

**Who we're looking for**

* **Taste you can defend.**
  You explore several directions fast and explain why one beats the others, with logic and evidence, and you understand the business well enough to connect a design choice to cost, risk or retention.
* **Craft and systems thinking.**
  Your work shows sharp interaction and visual design, and you care about design systems the way some people care about a garden: you know what to prune, what to let grow, and when to leave well alone.
* **Complex products, new interfaces.**
  You've shipped products with more than one kind of user, and you're curious about AI, agent or copilot experiences, whether you've shipped them or built side projects that show how you think.
* **AI in your own workflow, and in your team's.**
  You've turned a way of working into something other people use: a workflow, an agent, a prompt library, a template.
* **A good partner.**
  You work well with engineers and PMs, explain your reasoning, and make progress while things are still changing.
* Comfort with Figma, AI prototyping tools and a little code (React, CSS, HTML, Cursor, Claude Code) helps. None of it replaces design judgment.
* **Senior (5 to 7+ years):**
  you can own a complex product area end to end and ship it without hand-holding.
* **Lead (6 to 9+ years):**
  you've led designers or a product area, and built the workflows and standards a team runs on.

**What you get**

* **Real ownership**
  of an important part of multiple products, with a direct line to product & design leadership.
* **A rare design challenge:**
  consumer-grade experience at business scale, with AI agents in the mix.
* **Room for your craft:**
  a strong design system to improve and real customer problems to solve.
* **An AI-first way of working,**
  with the tools and space to build workflows that make the whole team better.

**This role may not be for you if**

You want a blank canvas, or a place where every change needs a long chain of approvals. You'd rather build a design system from scratch than shape a good one. You'd rather hand-build every prototype than build something the whole team can use. Or you want to work only on AI, or only on traditional screens, when this role needs both.

If you read all that and felt a little excited, we'd like to meet you.

**About the role**

As a Visual Designer, you will get to explore AI tools Flam is building to create the next generation of immersive experiences. Your ideas will go beyond static visuals and have the opportunity to come alive as animated, interactive and immersive experiences.

**What you will do**

Develop visual concepts, key visuals and storyboards for immersive experiences.

Turn complex information and stories into clear, compelling visual narratives.

Work closely with 2D and 3D artists, motion designers and creative teams to bring your ideas to life.

**What we're looking for**

3-4 years of experience in visual design, advertising, digital or creative studios. Agency experience is preferred.

Strong visual and conceptual thinking.

Excellent understanding of composition, typography, colour and storytelling.

A portfolio that shows ideas.

Someone who understands how a visual can evolve into motion, 3D and interaction.

Curiosity about AI and emerging creative technologies.

Ability to collaborate, experiment and move quickly.

**Build with AI. Not just use it.**

At Flam, designers are part of the AI platform creation process.

You’ll get early access to the AI tools and platforms Flam is building before they are released to the public. You’ll experiment with them, push their creative possibilities and work directly with our tech teams to shape how these tools evolve.

This is an opportunity to have active design participation in building the next generation of AI-powered creative platforms — rather than simply being a user of existing AI tools.

**Why Flam**

Because here, your design doesn't stop at a static frame.

Your idea could become a 3D world.

Your storyboard could become an immersive experience.

Your visual could become part of a Government or tourism campaign seen by millions.

title: Product Lead, UI Platform
description:
Product Lead, UI Platform

**About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA,
Rippling has raised $1.4B+
from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @
Rippling.com
addresses.

**About The Role**

As Product Lead for UI Platform, you will own Rippling’s design systems, modular components, and UI frameworks used across all Rippling products on web and mobile, along with the tooling and developer experience for building with them. Through these shared foundations, you will raise the quality and consistency of the user experience across Rippling’s 40+ products while helping product teams build without starting from scratch.
Your scope spans traditional UI, server-driven UI (SDUI), and newer generative UI experiences for Rippling AI.

You will help developers and product teams build and maintain high-quality experiences with less effort. A central part of your role is leading the development of a UI framework optimized for AI. Coding agents should be able to discover and understand its components and patterns, reliably generate and test UI, and extend it as needs evolve. The framework will also enable Rippling AI to compose interactive experiences at runtime that present information, collect input, and support actions, while preserving consistency and quality across web and mobile.

Additionally, you will be responsible for the core Rippling experience; from the homepage that users see when they log in to Rippling on web & mobile to how they navigate to different parts of the product. You will ensure that Rippling users – admins, managers and employees – see value quickly from Rippling.

**What You'll Do**

* You will own the strategy and roadmap for Rippling’s design systems, components, and UI frameworks across traditional UI, SDUI, and generative UI, balancing reuse, extensibility, and compatibility
* You will work closely with designers and engineers on your team to develop UX patterns and technologies that help Rippling’s engineering, product, and design teams build high-quality experiences faster
* You will work closely with developers and product teams to understand their needs, uncover opportunities, and drive adoption of shared UI capabilities
* You will own UI tooling and developer experience, including SDKs, documentation, templates, previews, debugging, and testing, with guidance and interfaces that work for both developers and coding agents
* You will lead the development of frameworks that let Rippling AI present business data, collect input, and support actions through rich, interactive UI across surfaces
* You will measure success through developer adoption, time to build, and the consistency, usability, accessibility, performance, and reliability of experiences built on the platform
* You’ll be eager to roll up your sleeves and dig into the technical details while obsessing over a simple, intuitive customer experience
* You’ll work cross-functionally with virtually every team – across product, engineering, design, marketing, and customer-facing functions – to design an extensible system that can meet the evolving needs of Rippling product teams and our customers

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of Product Management or Engineering experience
* Experience building platform products or developer tools used by other product teams and developers
* A passion for building developer products, UI frameworks, and design systems
* Technical depth to work with engineers on framework design, extensibility, compatibility, and performance
* Strong product and design judgment, attention to detail, and a bias toward simple, intuitive user experiences
* Strong ability to motivate others and drive cross-team execution
* Alignment with our leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, We go and see

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be use

title: Senior UI/UX Designer
description:
We are looking for a Senior UX Designer to join our design team and work on a large-scale banking platform that directly impacts Corporate and Institutional Banking customers.
  
The platform provides corporates with a single place to manage their banking needs, including accounts, deposits, account summary, cash flow analytics, tax payments, inflow and outflow tracking, IPO bidding, GST payments, A/R and A/P reconciliation, and many more banking and financial services.
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in designing banking products and be comfortable working on complex workflows, owning modules/verticals end-to-end, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders across business, product, and engineering teams.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned modules/verticals, from understanding the problem and requirements through design and implementation.
* Solve complex UX problems that directly impact corporate and institutional banking users.
* Understand business requirements, user needs, technical constraints, and translate them into simple and intuitive user experiences.
* Work closely with Business Analysts, Product Managers, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with multiple stakeholders and effectively manage feedback, dependencies, and design decisions.
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma.
* Create and maintain master product flows that bring together key banking journeys and capabilities for internal and external product demonstrations.
* Clearly articulate and visualize crisp UX solutions, making complex banking concepts and workflows easy for business stakeholders to understand.
* Present UX solutions effectively through structured walkthroughs, prototypes, flows, and visual storytelling.
* Design scalable and reusable solutions that can support evolving business requirements and future use cases.
* Follow established design systems and contribute to improving and scaling the design system.
* Ensure consistency across modules/verticals, workflows, and banking products.
* Work closely with engineering teams to ensure design intent and UX quality are maintained during implementation.
* Participate in design reviews, stakeholder walkthroughs, and product discussions.
* Balance user needs, business requirements, technical feasibility, and business objectives while making design decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify complex banking workflows and improve the overall user experience.
* Work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple parallel requirements.

**Must-Have Skills and Experience**

* 3-6 years of experience in UX/UI or Product Design.
* Banking experience is mandatory, with experience on at least one banking product or platform.
* Strong understanding of banking domain, workflows, and user journeys.
* Experience owning modules/verticals end-to-end.
* Strong collaboration with Business Analysts, Engineering teams, Product Managers, and multiple stakeholders.
* Strong UX fundamentals with the ability to simplify complex problems into clear, intuitive solutions.
* Strong knowledge of design systems and ability to create scalable, reusable solutions.
* Proficiency in Figma.
* Ability to create and manage master product flows for internal and external product demos.
* Strong ability to articulate and visually communicate crisp UX solutions to business and technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

What we are looking for
  

* You should be comfortable understanding complex requirements, working with multiple stakeholders, collaborating closely with Business Analysts and Engineering teams, and translating business and user needs into simple, scalable, and effective experiences.
* The ideal candidate should also be able to clearly articulate UX thinking, visualize complex product journeys, and communicate design solutions effectively to both business and technical stakeholders.

title: Product Designer
description:
**Who are we?**

IDfy is Asia’s leading TrustStack, trusted by the best, with global expertise and enterprise-grade tech, we’re solving trust challenges, making compliance easy, fraud detection smarter, and onboarding seamless.

Our clients include
**HDFC Bank, Zomato, Amazon, PhonePe, Paytm, HUL**
and many others. With more than 13+ years of experience and 2 million verifications per day, we are pioneers in this industry.

IDfy’s three platforms- OnboardIQ, OneRisk, and Privy - come together to form one seamless solution enabling trust.

**WE’LL GET ALONG IF YOU...**

* Have 2–4 years in Product Design, with real work on complex B2B products. We are hiring at both PD1 and PD2 levels and will calibrate based on depth of ownership, not years alone.
* Can read and reason about technical systems. Privy’s Data Governance surface deals with data lineage, asset classification, scan pipelines, and structured and unstructured data stores. You will not design these well without understanding how the data moves.
* Are comfortable in code-first design workflows. Our team builds and hosts working prototypes instead of handing off static screens. You should be able to work in a repo, or be ready to learn fast.
* Have worked with design systems for multi-product platforms: tokens, components, and the discipline to keep production consistent with design.
* Have advanced Figma skills and real experience with AI-assisted design workflows. (Bonus: Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity or similar.)
* Understand information architecture and interaction design for dense, data-heavy interfaces.
* Can hold your own with PMs and engineers: asking the right questions about feasibility, pushing back on scope, and driving alignment without a manager in the room.

**BONUS POINTS FOR**

* Experience designing for data platforms, observability tools, compliance workflows or developer-facing products.
* Familiarity with DPDPA, GDPR or similar privacy regulation and the workflows they create.
* Owning a product surface end to end, from discovery through QA.
* Interaction design, motion design or design system governance.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**

* Own Privy’s Data Governance surface end to end: Lineage, Asset Register, Operational Controls, Asset Rescan, Unstructured Assets and classification workflows.
* Design for technical users. DPOs, compliance teams and infosec teams use these modules daily. The work is about making complex data relationships legible, not about decoration.
* Work in the design repo. Build working prototypes, host them, and use them to validate flows with PMs, engineers and clients before dev investment.
* Partner directly with engineering on feasibility, data model constraints and scan behaviour, and translate those constraints into usable interfaces.
* Contribute to Privy’s design system: tokens, components and patterns that hold up across all products, not just your own.
* Run usability validation and stakeholder walkthroughs on your modules before handoff.
* Do design QA on what ships, so the shipped product matches the intent.
* At PD2: mentor juniors, raise design standards across the team, and shape how design operates at Privy.

At Ashoka, we encourage you to embrace the new, push the boundaries for continuous learning, and adapt to a world of constant change because we believe that each Ashokan is capable of becoming a thought leader.As part of our thriving and committed workforce, you will:Be Mission-Driven: Champion interdisciplinary learning, innovative pedagogy, and academic rigor to transform Indian higher education.Think Strategically: Collaborate with visionary minds to shape the future of higher education through strategic planning and a forward-thinking approach.Act Authentically: Embrace authenticity and integrity, fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where every voice is valued.Take Accountability: Own your work and drive positive change, as an empowering individual seeking to make a meaningful contribution.Build Collaboration: Experience the power of teamwork and diverse perspectives, working collectively towards our shared goals.Deliver Excellence: Strive for excellence in all aspects, upholding the highest standards of academic excellence, student support, and professional development opportunities.About the Centre for Social and Behaviour ChangeAt the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change (CSBC), we bring together behavioural scientists, policy experts, and researchers to develop novel insights and catalyse action. We partner with governments, non-profits, and corporations to embed behavioural science in programme design, creating solutions that work in practice and at scale. Established by Ashoka University with Gates Foundation support, we make development more people-centric through real-world applications of behavioural science. In recent years, CSBC researchers have contributed 25 peer-reviewed articles to top journals, advancing the nation’s behavioural evidence base and catalysing collaborations with leading institutions such as the University of Chicago, Yale School of Management, the University of Michigan, the Collegio Carlo Alberto, and Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. For more information, please visit https://csbc.org.in/.About System 3System 3 is a new research lab under the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change (CSBC). It will rest on two pillars.Basic science, from India: Most of what the world knows about how people think, trust and decide comes from a few narrow populations. India, with its range of languages, identities and institutions, is where those claims can be properly tested. We will run foundational, curiosity-driven research on cognition, judgement and behaviour, to learn which findings travel and which were only ever local. We take inspiration from the MIT Media Lab: open, accessible and joyful in the pursuit of credible science.AI and Behaviour: System 1 and System 2 describe the fast and slow thinking of the human mind, both shaped by the social and institutional worlds around us. System 3 will ask what happens to that mind in the age of AI. How do we learn, judge, trust and decide when intelligent machines are part of everyday life? What do we gain, and what do we quietly give away? This will be a major focus of our research agenda.The two pillars will reinforce each other. Understanding the human mind in all its diversity will let us study how AI changes it.We are a small team, early in our journey, based in Bengaluru. We are looking for people who like building something from scratch, who take ownership without waiting to be asked, and who are as comfortable rolling up their sleeves as thinking big. Role and ResponsibilitiesSystem 3 is hiring Research Associates to be the engine of the lab. The Associates will run studies, work with data and help bring the lab’s research to life, learning how rigorous behavioural science is done from the Pre-Doctoral Fellows they work with every day. The role suits someone who is curious about research and about how people think and decide, and who wants to learn by doing it in a small, ambitious team. Reporting to a Pre-Doctoral Fellow, the Associates will be part of the lab’s core team.What the Research Associates will do:1. Run studiesSet up experiment sessions, run them with participants and collect data carefully and accurately.Keep materials, schedules and records organised so that every study runs smoothly.2. Bring people into the labSupport the recruiting participants, scheduling sessions, and keeping participants coming back.Reach out to the wider public to invite them to take part in research.3. title: Growth Associate
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Growth Associate**
to help grow Atlys in the UAE.
  
  
You’ll research the market, figure out what’s working and what isn’t, and help shape and carry out our growth plans for the region. You’ll work closely with the Growth, Marketing and Product teams, and get hands-on with a wide range of problems from day one.
  
  
**The Job**

* Research the UAE market: study travellers, competitors and trends to understand how people in the UAE plan trips and apply for visas.
* Find out what works: track how our campaigns and channels are doing, and pull out clear insights on what to do more of and what to stop.
* Help shape the strategy: turn your research into ideas and plans for growing Atlys in the UAE, and present them to the team.
* Execute on the ground: help launch and run campaigns, partnerships and experiments, and keep things moving across teams.
* Report and follow up: keep simple, regular reports on UAE performance so the team always knows where we stand.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 1–2 years of experience at a high-growth startup, in growth, strategy, business or similar roles.
* Understand the UAE market, or are excited to get deep into it quickly.
* Are curious and research-minded, and enjoy digging into a market to understand what makes people tick.
* Are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets, and can turn data into clear takeaways.
* Are hands-on and reliable: you take ownership, follow through and get things done.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Team Size : 10 -15

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to tulika.hr@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.
