title: Technical Writer - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**About the Role**
  

We have a well established technical writing team, and are evolving our approach to content at JumpCloud. We are looking for an experienced
**Technical Writer**
to lead, scale, and optimize our product and developer documentation. In this role, you won't just write—you will act as an information architect and workflow innovator.

  

You will leverage cutting-edge AI documentation tools, prompt engineering, and modern automation to streamline content creation. Your goal is to keep our documentation technically accurate, end user focused, and optimized for both human readers and AI retrieval systems (RAG/chatbots).

**Key Responsibilities :**
  
**Docs-as-Code & Version Control Management**
  

  
* **GitHub Native Workflow:**
  Manage documentation using standard developer tools—drafting in Markdown, managing branches, opening Pull Requests (PRs), and conducting code reviews in GitHub.
  
* **Continuous Publishing:**
  Integrate into automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Static Site Generators (e.g., Docusaurus, MkDocs, Hugo).
  
* Maintain strict version control across multiple product releases, API versions, and branch merges.
  
  

  

**Content Generation & In-App User Guidance**

  

  
* Author, edit, and maintain clear, accurate end user documentation (API references, developer guides, user how to’s, configuration guides, and release notes) for IT admins and their teams
  
* **Cross-collaboration**
  : Partner closely with Engineering, Product Managers, and Designers to translate UX designs, and technical specs into intuitive content.
  
* **UX Writing**
  : Work with Design to provide copy and improve UX prototypes.
  
* **Manage Rolling Product Releases**
  : We have continuous releases meaning teams push new features and updates any time throughout the quarter. You should feel comfortable managing and prioritizing 15-20 feature/update releases during a quarter.
  
  

  

  
* **Conduct rigorous technical validation**
  : Test feature flags in the product, API endpoints, run sample code, and verify UI flows before publishing.
  
* **In-App Engagement**
  : Design, deploy, and manage in-app onboarding flows, tooltips, and release announcements using Pendo (or similar platforms like Appcues/WalkMe).
  
  

  
**AI Tooling & Workflow Optimization**
  

  
* **Prompt Engineering:**
  Design, test, and standardize custom prompts and prompt templates to accelerate process, information architecture, media, and content reformatting.
  
* **AI-Assisted Efficiency:**
  Integrate AI assistants into daily workflows to drastically reduce time spent on repetitive tasks (e.g., generating initial drafts, converting legacy docs, auditing terminology etc).
  
* **Human Quality Control:**
  Act as the final filter for AI-generated outputs, rigorously auditing content for technical accuracy, brand tone, hallucinations, and security compliance.
  
  

  
**Requirements & Qualifications :**
  

  
* **Experience:**
  4-7+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, Documentation Engineer, or Product Content Strategy Specialist in a SaaS or tech environment.
  
* **GitHub & Docs-as-Code (Required):**
  Proven mastery of
  **GitHub**
  (PRs, code reviews, branch management), Markdown, and Static Site Generators within a
  **Docs-as-Code pipeline**
  .
  
* **AI & Prompting Fluency:**
  Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (LLMs, AI coding assistants, etc) and a working knowledge of prompt engineering techniques.
  
* **Technical Depth:**
  Ability to quickly contribute to the platform and new features quickly given highly technical, and nuanced specifications.
  
* **Critical Thinking:**
  Strong editorial judgment. We want you to be able to catch subtle hallucinations, out-of-date parameters, or security risks in AI assisted drafts.
  
* **In-App Notification Tools (Required):**
  Hands-on, demonstrated experience building and targeting in-app messaging, guides, and analytics using
  **Pendo**
  (or comparable tools like Appcues, Userpilot, WalkMe).
  
  

  
**Additional Qualifications We Value :**
  

  
* Experience using Pendo to track documentation consumption and guide completion rates.
  
* Experience training and refining AI models on internal style guides and technical glossaries.
  
* Background in API design or developer-focused content strategy.
  
* Ability to create JSON scripts.
  
  

  

**Kindly share your portfolio while applying for the role. This can include documentation samples, AI prompts, demo video or video recordings of using AI to improve a process, examples of in-app notifications/announcements or onboarding flows, Git repositories etc.**

  



**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  
  

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  
  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  
  

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:

In this role you will be reporting to the Global Channel Support Manager. Your responsibilities include supporting ABB’s Automation Channel Partners globally, on all Presales Technical Support, Training and Aftersales Technical Support aspects.

This role is contributing to the Process Automation business for Energy Industry division based in Bangalore, India

title: SR SPECIALIST, DIGITAL OPERATIONS & WEB EXPERIENCE
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Northern Trust is seeking a Senior Digital Operations & Web Experience Analyst to help build, operate and continuously improve how digital content and experiences are delivered across our owned digital ecosystem.
  
  
This is not a traditional web-publishing role. The position combines digital operations, workflow and process optimization, governance, hands-on publishing, quality assurance, performance improvement and cross-functional enablement.
  
  
The initial and largest focus will be our global public web ecosystem, where the opportunity to improve operational consistency, scalability and performance is greatest. The broader mandate extends across the owned digital channels and platforms managed by Digital Marketing. You will help establish common workflows, standards and operating practices so content can be created, approved, published, distributed, measured and optimized consistently—regardless of platform or destination.
  
  
You will work as an integral member of a global Enterprise Digital organization, partnering with Marketing, Content, Digital Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility, Compliance and business teams.
  
  
**Major Duties**
Digital workflow and process excellence
  
  

* Own and continuously improve workflows spanning intake, requirements, prioritization, production, approvals, publishing/distribution, QA, measurement and optimization.
* Map current-state processes and identify bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, duplication, control gaps and sources of rework.
* Create and maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, checklists, service expectations, decision criteria and escalation paths.
* Use operational data to improve cycle time, throughput, quality and predictability.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work through process redesign, automation and platform integration.

Owned digital publishing and delivery
  
  

* Independently manage complex digital requests and releases from intake through post-launch validation.
* Author, maintain and publish content in Adobe Experience Manager or a comparable enterprise CMS.
* Support enterprise websites, landing pages, insights and thought-leadership experiences, product and solution content, localized experiences and other owned digital destinations.
* Manage content and asset requirements including metadata, taxonomy, tagging, approvals, localization and lifecycle.
* Promote approved templates, reusable components and structured-content practices that enable scale.

Standards, governance and risk reduction
  
  

* Help define, document, operationalize and maintain digital publishing and delivery standards.
* Translate UX, design-system, accessibility, SEO, analytics, content, privacy, compliance and technology requirements into practical procedures.
* Establish and apply QA and release-readiness practices.
* Identify inconsistent practices, unnecessary customization and workarounds that create operational risk, technical debt or fragmented experiences.
* Coordinate exceptions with the appropriate Product, Technology, Design or control owner.

Quality and experience assurance
  
  

* Perform and improve pre- and post-publication QA.
* Validate content accuracy, page structure, responsive behavior, links, imagery, documents, metadata, accessibility, SEO, analytics and experience requirements.
* Coordinate defect remediation and support regression testing and production validation.
* Analyze recurring defects to identify root causes and preventive improvements.

Performance and optimization
  
  

* Partner with Analytics, SEO, UX and Digital Product teams to understand operational, site-health and experience performance.
* Translate insight into prioritized opportunities that improve discoverability, accessibility, usability, engagement and conversion where applicable.
* Support audits, testing and experimentation; validate whether changes deliver the intended result.
* Create a closed loop from publish to measure, learn, optimize and standardize.

Automation, integration and productivity
  
  

* Identify repetitive tasks and workflow bottlenecks suitable for automation.
* Translate operational problems into requirements for Product, MarTech and Technology teams.
* Support integrations connecting work management, CMS, DAM, analytics and related platforms.
* Participate in implementation, testing, adoption and benefits measurement for workflow and platform enhancements.
* Evaluate responsible AI-enabled improvements where they solve a defined operational problem and preserve quality and controls.

Cross-functional partnership and enablement
  
  

* Serve as an operational bridge between business requirements and digital execution.
* Coordinate dependencies across Marketing, Content, Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility and control teams.
* Explain standards, platform constraints and operating requirements in clear business terms.
* Support onboarding, training and change adoption for publishers, contributors and stakeholders.
* Surface systemic problems and improvement opportunities to Digital leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Digital Marketing, Marketing Technology, Information Systems, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in digital operations, web operations, digital production, content operations, marketing operations or digital-experience delivery.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise websites, content-management platforms or complex digital ecosystems; Adobe Experience Manager strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning or improving end-to-end digital workflows.
* Experience developing or improving SOPs, governance practices, QA standards or operational controls.
* Experience coordinating complex work across business and technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of accessibility, SEO, analytics, UX, content lifecycle and web-performance fundamentals.
* Experience using operational or performance data to identify problems and improve outcomes.
* Strong prioritization, documentation, facilitation, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a global, matrixed organization.

**Preferred**

* Adobe Experience Manager Sites and Assets; Adobe Workfront or a comparable work-management platform.
* Adobe Analytics and/or Google Analytics 4.
* Global, multilingual or multisite content operations; localization, translation or MSM experience.
* WCAG accessibility, technical/on-page SEO and Core Web Vitals knowledge.
* Workflow automation, systems integration, structured-content or content-supply-chain experience.
* Agile delivery, experimentation, personalization or conversion-optimization exposure.
* Financial services or another regulated enterprise environment.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Bangalore Office**
The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Adviser - Document Control and Information Management
description:
* Great opportunity to serve as a subject matter expert in Document Control and Information Management
* Support controlled document integrity, regulatory compliance and quality standards throughout the document lifecycle
* Lead triage, process improvement, digitalisation, automation and standardisation initiatives
* The role is based in Bengaluru

**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced and highly organised
**Adviser - Document Control and Information Management**
to provide subject matter expertise across document control and Information Management activities.
  
  
The selected individual will work alongside Information Controllers and the broader Information Management team to maintain controlled document integrity, support project teams and ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards throughout the document lifecycle.
  
  
The role will also act as a key point of support for the team by troubleshooting complex document-control issues and identifying opportunities for process improvement, automation and standardisation.
  
  
What the role entails
  
  
This role is a great opportunity for an experienced Document Control professional with strong knowledge of information governance, Electronic Document Management Systems and controlled document workflows.
  
  
Success in this role will require excellent communication, strong stakeholder engagement and the ability to manage complex priorities and large volumes of controlled documentation.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide guidance to project teams and business users, support document approvals and compliance activities, and improve the effectiveness of document-control processes.
  
  
The role will also contribute to digitalisation and automation initiatives, knowledge-base development, AI-enabled support tools and broader Information Management improvements.
  
  
**Reporting line**
To be confirmed
  
  
**Function**
Document Control and Information Management
  
  
Scope
  
  
Your scope will include, but is not limited to, the following
  
  
Document registration and control
  
  

* Receive, review, classify and register incoming and outgoing project documents in accordance with established naming conventions, taxonomy and metadata standards.
* Maintain an organised and systematic filing structure within the EDMS or Information Management System.
* Ensure that project documentation can be retrieved accurately and within the required timelines.
* Track document revisions and ensure that only the latest approved versions are circulated across the project and organisation.
* Update and maintain document-control logs, registers and metadata to keep records current, accurate and auditable.
* Control access to documentation and safeguard confidential or sensitive information in accordance with company policies.

Quality and compliance
  
  

* Ensure that documents meet internal quality and compliance standards before distribution or filing.
* Support audits by providing the required documentation and verifying compliance with regulatory and industry standards.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of document-control procedures, standards and work instructions.
* Identify and escalate document non-conformances, version-control issues and quality risks.
* Maintain accurate audit trails and records in support of internal and external compliance requirements.
* Identify and report gaps relating to document compliance, version control and audit trails.

Document distribution and stakeholder support
  
  

* Distribute project documents to relevant stakeholders in a timely and controlled manner.
* Coordinate with engineers, project managers and other departments to facilitate document reviews and approvals.
* Ensure that document approval workflows are completed correctly.
* Act as a key point of contact for document-related queries from authors, project teams and business users.
* Guide business users on document submission, retrieval, classification and compliance requirements.
* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across geographically dispersed teams.

Continuous improvement and digitalisation
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve document-control processes, filing structures and workflow efficiency.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of document-control training and awareness sessions.
* Support broader Information Management initiatives, workflow improvements and compliance programmes.
* Support digitalisation and automation initiatives associated with Information Management governance.

title: Product Structuring, Requirements & Interfaces Structure Leader
description: Job Description SummarySystems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.Beeinträchtigt die Fähigkeit des Teams, Service, Qualität und Aktualität der Ziele zu erreichen.Die Rolle unterliegt operativen Richtlinienzielen.Innerhalb der Rolle besteht eine moderate Autonomie.Um die gewünschten Ergebnisse zu erzielen, ist ein hohes Maß an operativem Urteilsvermögen erforderlich.Job DescriptionRollen und VerantwortlichkeitenStellt die Übereinstimmung der Leistung, der funktionalen und physikalischen Eigenschaften eines Produkts mit den Anforderungen, dem Design und den Betriebsinformationen her und verwaltet Änderungen über den gesamten Systemlebenszyklus hinweg. Bietet Transparenz und Kontrolle der Systemleistung sowie der funktionalen und physischen Attribute. Überprüft, ob ein System die beabsichtigte Leistung erbringt und ausreichend detailliert identifiziert und dokumentiert wird, um den projizierten Lebenszyklus zu unterstützen. Unterstützt die ordnungsgemäße Verwaltung von Systeminformationen und Systemänderungen zu vorteilhaften Zwecken, etwa um die Funktionsfähigkeit zu überprüfen, die Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit oder Wartbarkeit zu verbessern; die Lebensdauer zu erhöhen, Kosten zu reduzieren; Risiko und Haftung zu reduzieren oder Mängel zu korrigieren. Erfordert Fachwissen innerhalb der Funktion.Beeinflusst die Strategieentwicklung für den Verantwortungsbereich, einschließlich Kontrolle der Ressourcen, und beeinflusst die Richtlinienformulierung.Wertet einfache interne und externe geschäftliche Herausforderungen aus und empfiehlt Best Practices zur Verbesserung von Produkten, Prozessen oder Dienstleistungen.Bleibt über Branchentrends informiert, die die Arbeit informieren können.Verwendet ein hohes Maß an Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen und komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme in den Bereichen Betrieb, Produktmanagement, Fertigung, Technologie oder Konstruktion zu lösen.Hat die Fähigkeit, die Qualität der bereitgestellten Informationen zu beurteilen und Stakeholdern relevante Fragen zu stellen.Kann neue Lösungen für Probleme anbieten, die außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter liegen, und ist in der Lage, Empfehlungen zu erstellen und abzugeben.Verwendet mehrere interne und einige externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um eine Entscheidung zu treffen. Kann Funktionsteams oder Projekte mit minimalem Ressourcenbedarf, Risiko und/oder moderater Komplexität leiten.Kommuniziert schwierige Konzepte und kann die Optionen anderer zu bestimmten Themen beeinflussen.Kann andere anleiten, einen anderen Standpunkt einzunehmen.GrundqualifikationenDiese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule.Gewünschte EigenschaftenSehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.Additional InformationRelocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Regional & Functional Communications - Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.
  
  
To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**The Role**
The Manager, Regional & Functional Communications enables effective, scalable communication across Vialto’s regions and functions. This role partners with regional and functional stakeholders to support communications aligned to enterprise priorities, ensuring messaging is clear, consistent, and locally relevant.
  
  
Through guidance, tools, and best practices, this role helps the organization communicate more effectively at scale—supporting cross-functional initiatives while enabling regional and functional teams to deliver their own communications.
  
  
This role sits within the Internal Communications team and reports to the Sr. Manager, Internal Communications. It works closely with the Manager, Enterprise Communications to ensure strong alignment between enterprise messaging and regional and functional execution.
  
  
Please note: this is an individual contributor role, with manager title aligning to a global team architecture.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Regional & Functional Partnership
  
  

* Act as a primary communications partner for regional and functional stakeholders, providing guidance and support for cross-functional initiatives.
* Support translation of enterprise priorities into relevant, audience appropriate messaging for regions and functions.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Communications to align on enterprise priorities, ensuring consistency in messaging while adapting communications for regional and functional audiences.
* Support the establishment and activation of employee communities (e.g., functional or regional groups) to enable connection, knowledge sharing, and consistent communication across the organization.
* Help stakeholders adopt consistent communication approaches that align with enterprise standards and ways of working.
* Support stakeholders in applying communication frameworks and best practices to their day-to-day communications.

Messaging & Channel Guidance
  
  

* Provide clear messaging and channel guidance to help stakeholders communicate effectively.
* Support effective communication by guiding stakeholders on messaging, structure, and channel selection based on communication needs and impact.
* Advise on the right channels for the right messages, balancing enterprise consistency with local needs.
* Support coordinated rollouts across regions and functions.
* Reinforce adoption of communication standards and channel best practices across regions and functions.

Core Channels & Content Creation
  
  

* Lead and support ongoing content development for core enterprise channels, including the intranet and Vialto’s all-employee newsletter.
* Support development of engaging content aligned with enterprise messaging and tone.
* Support editorial quality and consistency across channels.
* Partner with Enterprise Communications and stakeholders to coordinate and deliver content aligned to enterprise priorities.
* Enable regions and functions to create their own content through guidance, templates, and best practices.

Templates, Toolkits & Best Practices
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and evolve communication templates, toolkits, and playbooks.
* Support the development and evolution of best practices that improve communication quality, efficiency, and consistency.
* Enable regional and functional teams to deliver their own communications through scalable tools, templates, and guidance.
* Operationalize communication standards through practical tools, templates, and guidance that enable consistent, scalable communication.

Insights, Metrics & Feedback
  
  

* Act as a key feedback loop, bringing insights from regions and functions back into enterprise communications planning and decision-making.
* Identify trends, challenges, and opportunities across regions and functions to inform communication strategy and channel improvements.
* Track metrics and reporting related to channel performance and enablement effectiveness.
* Use insights to refine templates, guidance, and communication practices to better support the business.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
* 6+ years in internal, corporate, or enterprise communications, ideally within a global or matrixed organization
* Experience supporting regional or functional stakeholders across geographies and time zones
* Proven ability to partner with stakeholders to shape communications, providing guidance and influencing outcomes without direct authority
* Demonstrated experience creating communication templates, guidance, or enablement materials
* Experience supporting scalable communication approaches, including developing repeatable processes, templates, or frameworks
* Experience managing ongoing content for internal channels such as intranet sites or employee newsletters
* Comfort working in evolving environments, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or developing processes
* Experience using communication metrics or feedback to inform content, channels, or stakeholder guidance

Key Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent stakeholder partnership and relationship‑building skills
* Ability to provide clear guidance and influence without direct authority
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to evolving processes and ways of working
* Detail‑oriented, with a consistent focus on quality and clarity

title: ServiceNow Citizen Development Coach
description:
**About Us**
At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.
  
  
The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.
  
  
We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about
**our What and our Why**
and how we can work
**together**
.
  
  
**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.
  
  
ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.
  
  
ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.
  
  
The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.
  
  
ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.
  
  
To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.
  
  
**What Role You Will Play In Our Team**
Are you passionate about helping others build solutions that make a real business impact? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, enablement, governance, and innovation? We're looking for a
**Citizen Development Lead**
to help grow and support a thriving community of over
**1,000 citizen developers**
leveraging the ServiceNow platform.
  
  
In this highly visible role, you will serve as both a trusted advisor and technical enabler, helping business users transform ideas into scalable applications while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, and best practices. You'll play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation, empowering teams to solve business challenges through low-code development.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Drive Citizen Developer Success**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a growing community of 1,000+ citizen developers across the organization.
* Provide guidance, coaching, and technical support throughout the application development lifecycle.
* Conduct onboarding sessions, workshops, and hands-on training to help users maximize the value of ServiceNow's low-code capabilities.
* Create and maintain engaging training materials, learning paths, best practice guides, and FAQ documentation.

**Champion Innovation and Adoption**

* Enable users to build solutions using ServiceNow technologies including App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, and other platform capabilities.
* Explore emerging ServiceNow features and modules through Proof of Concepts (PoCs), evaluating their business value and adoption potential.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive adoption of new capabilities and platform enhancements.

**Ensure Governance and Quality**

* Establish and maintain guardrails that ensure applications meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, performance, and data integrity.
* Review and validate citizen-developed applications, providing guidance to improve design, functionality, and compliance.
* Support governance initiatives that balance innovation with risk management.

**Own Platform Delivery Excellence**

* Manage and oversee CI/CD processes for scoped applications, ensuring smooth and reliable deployments into production environments.
* Coordinate upgrade testing activities and validate platform readiness during ServiceNow releases.
* Utilize tools such as Automated Test Framework (ATF) to ensure application quality and stability.

**Act as a Trusted Consultant**

* Partner with business teams during major module rollouts and strategic initiatives.
* Provide consultation on solution design, development approaches, access requirements, and governance expectations.
* Help teams navigate the citizen development journey while ensuring alignment with organizational standards.

**About You**

* 4+ years of professional experience in ServiceNow platform development, application delivery, platform enablement, or related enterprise technology roles.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform capabilities and low-code/no-code development practices.
* Experience educating, mentoring, or supporting users, with a genuine passion for helping others succeed through technology.
* Experience establishing and enforcing governance guardrails related to security, data integrity, compliance, and platform best practices.
* Hands-on experience designing, developing, configuring, and supporting custom applications on the ServiceNow platform, preferably using App Engine Studio and other low-code capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, source control, Flow Designer, Catalog Item, Record Producer, ACLs and Glide scripts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions.
* Proven ability to collaborate across global teams, build trusted relationships, and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Adaptability and curiosity to explore emerging platform capabilities, conduct Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and drive continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Your Benefits**
An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life.
  
  
We offer you:
  
  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking & cross-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations & holidays
* Day care assistance program
* Training and development program
* Tuition assistance program
* Workplace flexibility policy
* Relocation program
* Transportation facility

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.
  
  
**Stay connected with us**

* Learn more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India andEnergy Factor India.
* Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
* Like us on Facebook
* Subscribe our channel at YouTube

title: Technical Writer - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Role**

We have a well established technical writing team, and are evolving our approach to content at JumpCloud. We are looking for an experienced **Technical Writer** to lead, scale, and optimize our product and developer documentation. In this role, you won't just write—you will act as an information architect and workflow innovator.

You will leverage cutting-edge AI documentation tools, prompt engineering, and modern automation to streamline content creation. Your goal is to keep our documentation technically accurate, end user focused, and optimized for both human readers and AI retrieval systems (RAG/chatbots).

### **Key Responsibilities :**

#### **Docs-as-Code & Version Control Management**

* **GitHub Native Workflow:** Manage documentation using standard developer tools—drafting in Markdown, managing branches, opening Pull Requests (PRs), and conducting code reviews in GitHub.
* **Continuous Publishing:** Integrate into automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Static Site Generators (e.g., Docusaurus, MkDocs, Hugo).
* Maintain strict version control across multiple product releases, API versions, and branch merges.

**Content Generation & In-App User Guidance**

* Author, edit, and maintain clear, accurate end user documentation (API references, developer guides, user how to’s, configuration guides, and release notes) for IT admins and their teams.
* **Cross-collaboration**: Partner closely with Engineering, Product Managers, and Designers to translate UX designs, and technical specs into intuitive content.
* **UX Writing**: Work with Design to provide copy and improve UX prototypes.
* **Manage Rolling Product Releases**: We have continuous releases meaning teams push new features and updates any time throughout the quarter. You should feel comfortable managing and prioritizing 15-20 feature/update releases during a quarter.

* **Conduct rigorous technical validation**: Test feature flags in the product, API endpoints, run sample code, and verify UI flows before publishing.
* **In-App Engagement**: Design, deploy, and manage in-app onboarding flows, tooltips, and release announcements using Pendo (or similar platforms like Appcues/WalkMe).

**AI Tooling & Workflow Optimization**

* **Prompt Engineering:** Design, test, and standardize custom prompts and prompt templates to accelerate process, information architecture, media, and content reformatting.
* **AI-Assisted Efficiency:** Integrate AI assistants into daily workflows to drastically reduce time spent on repetitive tasks (e.g., generating initial drafts, converting legacy docs, auditing terminology etc).
* **Human Quality Control:** Act as the final filter for AI-generated outputs, rigorously auditing content for technical accuracy, brand tone, hallucinations, and security compliance.

### **Requirements & Qualifications :**

* **Experience:** 4-7+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, Documentation Engineer, or Product Content Strategy Specialist in a SaaS or tech environment.
* **GitHub & Docs-as-Code (Required):** Proven mastery of **GitHub** (PRs, code reviews, branch management), Markdown, and Static Site Generators within a **Docs-as-Code pipeline**.
* **AI & Prompting Fluency:** Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (LLMs, AI coding assistants, etc) and a working knowledge of prompt engineering techniques.
* **Technical Depth:** Ability to quickly contribute to the platform and new features quickly given highly technical, and nuanced specifications.
* **Critical Thinking:** Strong editorial judgment. We want you to be able to catch subtle hallucinations, out-of-date parameters, or security risks in AI assisted drafts.
* **In-App Notification Tools (Required):** Hands-on, demonstrated experience building and targeting in-app messaging, guides, and analytics using **Pendo** (or comparable tools like Appcues, Userpilot, WalkMe).

### **Additional Qualifications We Value :**

* Experience using Pendo to track documentation consumption and guide completion rates.
* Experience training and refining AI models on internal style guides and technical glossaries.
* Background in API design or developer-focused content strategy.
* Ability to create JSON scripts.

**Kindly share your portfolio while applying for the role. This can include documentation samples, AI prompts, demo video or video recordings of using AI to improve a process, examples of in-app notifications/announcements or onboarding flows, Git repositories etc.**

###### **#LI-MS1**

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

**Language:**

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues

* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats

* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response

* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

title: Web Growth Manager
description:
**About the role**

JuliaHub is hiring a Web Growth Manager to own juliahub.com end-to-end: design an engaging, on-brand site, build and ship it in Framer, instrument every visit, and prove which web activity turns into sales opportunities.

JuliaHub builds Dyad, an agentic, Julia-native platform for engineering modeling and simulation, alongside the JuliaHub platform. Our buyers are engineers and technical leaders evaluating us against established dynamic modeling and control systems simulation tools. They research deeply, through search engines and increasingly through AI assistants, before they talk to sales.

You will be the single owner of the marketing site: its visual design, user experience, build, and measurement stack. You'll report to marketing leadership and work daily with the marketing team, application engineers, sales, and the development teams behind our products.

**What you'll do**

**Own the site's creative and experience**

* Own the look and feel of juliahub.com: apply and evolve the JuliaHub brand across typography, color, layout, imagery, and motion.
* Design page layouts, UI components, and a reusable design system directly in Framer.
* Create web graphics, illustrations, diagrams, product visuals, and simple animations that make technical products easy to grasp.
* Shape the UX: information architecture, navigation, page flow, and calls to action that pull engineers from first visit to trial or demo.
* Keep every product site and subdomain visually consistent, and set brand and style guidance others can follow.

  

**Own the site in Framer**

* Build, publish, and maintain pages, landing pages, and CMS collections (use cases, verticals, comparisons, FAQs, proof points) in Framer.
* Turn content into responsive, accessible, on-brand pages within days, designing directly in Framer.
* Run site governance: QA checklists, publishing workflow, redirects, navigation, forms, and a change log.
* Coordinate with engineering on DNS, CDN, and subdomains (help.juliahub.com, platform.juliahub.com, product docs).

  

**Drive organic and AI search growth**

* Own technical SEO in Google Search Console: indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, redirect chains, crawl errors, and Core Web Vitals.
* Maintain structured data (JSON-LD for Organization, Product/SoftwareApplication, FAQ, Article) and AI-readiness files such as llms.txt.
* Track how JuliaHub and Dyad appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) and optimize pages to be cited.

  

**Measure and attribute everything**

* Own GA4 and Google Tag Manager: event taxonomy, conversions, consent mode, and cross-domain tracking.
* Enforce UTM standards across campaigns, email, social, events, and partners.
* Connect web activity to Salesforce: form-to-lead routing, campaign membership, and offline conversion import.
* Build and maintain attribution reporting (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch) that ties web sessions to sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Publish a weekly web dashboard and a monthly growth readout with clear recommendations.

  

**Optimize conversion**

* Run A/B tests on headlines, CTAs, forms, and page layouts; report lift with sample sizes.
* Use heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix drop-off on trial, demo, and contact paths.

  

**Required qualifications**

* 4+ years designing and managing a B2B marketing website, ideally for a SaaS or technical product.
* A portfolio of live websites you designed and built, showing strong visual design, layout, and UX judgment.
* AI search optimization (AEO/GEO) experience, with tools that track brand visibility in AI answers.
* Hands-on Framer experience: you have designed and shipped production pages, components, and CMS collections in Framer itself.
* Experience applying AI technologies to accelerate and transform marketing workflows.
* Brand and visual design skills: typography, color, composition, and creating web graphics with tools such as Canva.
* Deep Google Analytics 4 experience: custom events, conversions, explorations, audiences, and BigQuery export or Looker Studio reporting.
* Deep Google Search Console experience: diagnosing indexing and coverage issues, sitemap management, and Core Web Vitals.
* Proven experience attributing web-based marketing activity to sales pipeline.
* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, UTM governance, and consent management.
* Experience connecting web forms and tracking to a CRM (Salesforce strongly preferred), including lead source and campaign attribution.
* Technical SEO fluency: redirects, canonicals, schema markup, site structure, and page speed.
* Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript for embeds, custom code, and tracking snippets.
* Clear writer and communicator who can turn data into a recommendation for non-analysts.

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Framer Expert certification.
* Experience turning complex technical concepts into clear diagrams and product visuals.
* SEO tooling experience: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse.
* Marketing automation and attribution tools experience.
* Experience marketing to engineers, scientists, or developers; familiarity with simulation, scientific computing, or developer tools is a plus.
* Experience in a venture-backed, high-growth environment.

description:
**About NCR Atleos**
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
  
  
Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor
  
  
**Role Description**
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you are considered a subject matter expert in NCR Atleos ATM products and act as an advanced level remote support analyst and technical learning instructor. You are part of our support services and learning delivery teams, and your passion for providing exceptional customer service, technical guidance, and effective instruction contributes to our world-class high level of customer satisfaction and associate readiness.
  
  
Acting as second line support to NCR Atleos Field Service Technicians and as an instructor for assigned technical learning programs, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with your focus being finding the right solution for each Field Service Technician, learner, and customer. You connect with Field Service Technicians to address questions and resolve various problems, including uncommon or complex issues, knowing when and who to turn to for additional support. You also facilitate classroom, lab, virtual instructor-led, and online learning experiences that enhance technical capability and improve the overall effectiveness of the business unit/organization.
  
  
You will have a proactive approach and may handle problems before they start by identifying knowledge gaps, improving course content, creating knowledge articles, and feeding live field learning back into training materials and knowledge systems. No matter the situation, your formal training, technical expertise, available knowledge repositories, and adult learning techniques will allow you to provide Field Service Technicians and learners what they need when they need it. Additionally, you will always be on the lookout for preventative measures you can take, escalate issues appropriately, contribute to continuous improvement, and serve as an ambassador for the NCR Atleos brand.
  
  
Your goal is to keep our Field Service Technicians, learners, and customers completely assured and satisfied through your technical expertise, instructional capability, consistent communication, and commitment to quality support and effective learning delivery.
  
  
Position Summary & Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you will provide support to Field Service Engineers who will generally be onsite at a customer location and requiring technical assistance.
  
  
The support will include problem identification, analysis, diagnosis, and resolution.
  
  
You will utilize Knowledge Systems provided by NCR Atleos and other vendors as appropriate to identify solutions to known problems.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that solutions provided are successful, ensuring first time and long-term resolution of the problem.
  
  
If no known solution can be identified, you are responsible for escalation to other support groups where deeper level skilled personnel are available.
  
  
You retain ownership of escalated problems/issues through to resolution.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that NCR Atleos Management is informed if resolution to a problem will take longer than contractual requirements require.
  
  
You will provide input to the Knowledge Systems as and when required and create and publish knowledge articles when required.
  
  
You will coordinate with your peers, Management, Learning teams, and other support groups in providing part numbers, technical details, field learning, and product/process information to Field Service Technicians and learners.
  
  
You will act as a second line escalation point for junior colleagues and provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance where required.
  
  
You will facilitate course delivery using classroom, lab, VILT (virtual instructor-led training), online, and other approved methods of instruction.
  
  
You will execute course delivery according to the published training schedule.
  
  
You will maintain classroom facilities, training center, lab environment, training equipment, and learning materials necessary for the class.
  
  
You will work collaboratively with and around other team members in a Lab environment.
  
  
You will support course development by providing subject matter expertise for assigned products, technical procedures, and service processes.
  
  
You will perform course maintenance and identify required updates to course content using existing knowledge, field feedback, service trends, and analytical skills.
  
  
You will use a variety of delivery techniques, leveraging formal and informal delivery tools such as virtual classrooms, web conferencing, discussion forums, blogs, wikis, job aids, and short-form instructional videos where applicable.

title: Production Documentation & System Coordinator
description:
**About us**

At Leanwatts, we develop innovative power electronic solutions for electric mobility and energy applications through continuous research, engineering, and manufacturing. Our “Designed and Made in India” approach drives us to build reliable, high-performance products for the future of transportation and energy.

**What is this role about?**

We are looking for a Production Documentation & Systems Coordinator to create and maintain each work order and its complete supporting document pack in Leanwatts systems/ERP and as signed physical records. You will ensure every document required by the customer and our internal process is identified, prepared, tracked, completed, and filed from work-order creation through production, testing, packaging, pre-dispatch inspection, and closure.

You will prepare records using approved plans, information, and templates, keep them current, and ensure every required entry and signature is obtained from the responsible person. You will work with PPC, Production, Quality, Testing, Stores, and the Factory Operations Lead to maintain a complete and traceable record for each work order. The responsible teams perform the operations, checks, and tests and approve their results; this role maintains the documentation and system records supporting that work.

**Primary KPI:**

100% of applicable documents required by the customer and internal process are accounted for on every work order and completed by the required stage. Each document must be at the correct revision, contain the required entries and signatures/approvals, agree with the system record, and be traceable and retrievable in its required physical and digital form. Pending documents must have a named owner and due date and remain visible until resolved; any not-applicable status requires confirmation from the authorised process owner.

**What you will do at Leanwatts**

* **Work-Order Creation & Maintenance:**

  Create work orders in Leanwatts systems/ERP from approved production instructions, with the correct product, quantity, dates, sales-order reference where applicable, and approved BOM/routing references. Prepare the corresponding physical work-order sheet, maintain approved changes, and keep system and paper records aligned.
* **Customer & Internal Document-Pack Requirements:**

  Maintain a document-requirement checklist for each work order, confirming applicable customer/order-specific requirements with Sales and Quality and internal requirements with the process owners. Prepare the current approved templates for line startup, process quality, in-process testing, End-of-Line (EoL) testing, packaging, Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI), and any other required records. Track each document’s revision, owner, required stage, due date, physical/digital location, and completion status.
* **Physical Document Issue & Control:**

  Print and issue the correct document pack before the relevant operation begins. Maintain an issue register showing the work-order number, document references and revisions, recipients, and location. Control replacement copies and revised sheets so the current approved version is identifiable and completed records remain traceable.
* **Entries, Signatures & Stage Follow-Up:**

  Follow each work order through the floor and collect the required entries, actual quantities, dates, test/inspection references, and signatures from the operators, testers, inspectors, and approvers concerned. Check completeness at each stage, return incomplete records to their owners, and escalate missing information or signatures promptly.
* **Leanwatts systems/ERP Records & Evidence:**

  Enter and maintain work-order information and authorised updates from verified source records. Ensure production progress, recorded results, quantities, and document references agree with the physical pack. Maintain signed scans, attachments, or linked records through the approved filing method, and keep each document identifiable against its work order.
* **Traceability & Reconciliation:**

  Reconcile work-order references, item and batch/serial details where applicable, material issue/return records, production quantities, testing records, packaging, and PDI documents. Track associated deviations, rework, retest, and approval records where required. Log mismatches and obtain verified corrections from the responsible teams.
* **Document Completion, Closure & Archive:**

  Reconcile the completed pack against the customer and internal document-requirement checklist. Confirm required records, signatures, approvals, and customer submission copies are complete and consistent; escalate gaps before requesting closure or recording an approved release status. Compile the final signed physical file and digital record, coordinate customer document handover through the responsible team where required, and archive and retrieve records under the approved process.
* **Department Training & Process Support:**

  Train users on their work-order entries, document completion, signatures, update timing, and Leanwatts systems/ERP workflows. Maintain simple approved instructions and examples, provide refresher support, and report recurring documentation problems or system issues to the responsible owner.
* **KPI & Pending-Document Reporting:**

  Maintain a daily tracker showing required versus completed documents for each work order, missing entries/signatures, overdue items, locations, responsible owners, and due dates. Report documentation completeness against the 100% target and escalate gaps to the Factory Operations Lead. Support accurate related sales-order and inventory references and resolve discrepancies affecting work-order traceability.

**Must have requirements****1. Education & Relevant Experience**

* **Education:**

  Diploma or bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, commerce, business administration, computer applications, or a related field; equivalent relevant practical experience may also be considered.
* **Experience:**

  2–3 years of experience in a similar manufacturing documentation, work-order coordination, production documentation, document control, or ERP/MIS support role, with hands-on responsibility for physical records and digital system entries.
* **Practical Ownership:**

  Experience preparing and maintaining work orders or job cards, collecting completed records and signatures, reconciling documents with system entries, and following a document pack through to closure.

**2. Work-Order & Manufacturing Documentation**

* **Document-Pack Knowledge:**

  Familiarity with line startup checklists, process quality records, in-process and EoL testing documents, packaging records, and PDI documents. Ability to translate confirmed customer requirements and internal process requirements into a complete work-order document checklist.
* **Document Control:**

  Ability to maintain document numbers, work-order references, current revisions, issue registers, signed originals, replacement copies, and organised physical and digital archives.

**3. Systems/ERP & Data Accuracy**

You should be comfortable creating and maintaining records in an ERP or operations system and checking them against signed documents throughout the work-order lifecycle.

* **System & Spreadsheet Skills:**

  Working proficiency in ERP/MIS or manufacturing operations software and Excel or Google Sheets for filters, basic formulas, reconciliation, and tracking lists. Ability to learn Leanwatts systems/ERP and its approved workflows.
* **Accuracy & Traceability:**

  Ability to check item codes, quantities, dates, work-order references, batch/serial details, document revisions, and approval status; identify omissions or mismatches; and follow verified corrections through to completion.

**4. Coordination, Training & Record Integrity**

* **Floor Coordination & Follow-Up:**

  Comfortable working with PPC, Production, Testing, Quality, and Stores on the factory floor, obtaining records and signatures on time, maintaining an action list, and escalating overdue items clearly.
* **User Training:**

  Ability to demonstrate the correct way to complete a document or system entry, explain required fields and signatures, and help department users maintain the records consistently.
* **Record Integrity:**

  Maintain factual, legible records and follow the approved correction process. Obtain signatures and test/inspection results from the responsible people, preserve supporting evidence, and record completion or approval only when the required evidence is available.

**5. Preferred Advantages**

* **Relevant Industry Exposure:**

  Experience in electronics, electrical equipment, power electronics, or related manufacturing, working with production travellers, job cards, quality records, test reports, or customer documentation packs.
* **Process Improvements:**

  Experience improving document completeness, reducing missing signatures, organising work-order archives, supporting document retrieval for audits or customer queries, or helping teams adopt digital manufacturing records.

title: System Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
System Engineer

**Department:**
System Engineering – Research & Development

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
4–6 years

**Education:**
Bachelor’s or higher degree in Biomedical Engineering or Systems Engineering. A Master’s degree is an added advantage.

Role Overview

We are looking for a System Engineer with experience in medical device R&D to support system architecture, requirements management, system integration, and verification and validation activities. The candidate will work with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure medical device systems meet functional, performance, safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Support the design and development of medical device system architectures integrating mechanical, electrical, hardware, software, and embedded subsystems.
* Define and maintain system requirements, specifications, interface definitions, block diagrams, and technical documentation.
* Support requirements traceability, change management, and compliance with FDA Design Controls.
* Participate in system integration, risk management, design verification, and validation activities.
* Prepare and execute system-level test plans, including functional and performance testing, and analyse test results.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, global stakeholders, PMOs, and external partners.
* Support risk analysis activities, including FMEA, DFMEA, hazard analysis, and fault tree analysis.
* Maintain design documentation, risk management files, and quality and compliance records.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and engineering process optimisation.

Required Skills and Experience

* 4–6 years of experience in Systems Engineering R&D, preferably in the medical device industry.
* Hands-on experience in system design, systems integration, and product development or sustaining engineering.
* Knowledge of systems engineering methodologies, requirements management, and system modelling.
* Familiarity with FDA Design Controls, 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 14971, and IEC 60601.
* Understanding of software lifecycle requirements, including IEC 62304.
* Exposure to Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and tools such as IBM DOORS or Jama Connect.
