Job Description (JD)
  
  
Job Title-
  
  
SAP Techno-Functional Demo Specialist – Pre-Sales (Offshore)
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The SAP Techno-Functional Demo Specialist is a key member of the offshore Pre-Sales team, responsible for designing, configuring, and delivering high-impact SAP solution demonstrations aligned with customer business scenarios. This role bridges functional business understanding with technical SAP expertise to support sales pursuits, RFPs, and solution validations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Pre-Sales & Solution Enablement

title: Systems Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
  
  
**Job Details:**
The Systems Engineer is a qualified, practitioner responsible for applying knowledge and
  
  
expertise within the field of systems engineering. This role involves overseeing and
  
  
executing interdependent systems engineering activities, including detailed requirements
  
  
decomposition, system design, integration, and problem-solving, requiring sophisticated
  
  
analytical techniques. The Systems Engineer manages tasks of moderate scope, works
  
  
independently on problems of diverse scope, and creates innovative solutions based on
  
  
analysis and evaluation of various factors. This position involves significant interaction with
  
  
internal and external stakeholders and requires adaptive communication styles for
  
  
di􀆯erent audiences.
  
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  
  

* Execute the development, management, and allocation of system requirements to

system elements and subsystems, overseeing the refinement of lower-level requirements
  
  
flowed down to other engineering disciplines.
  
  

* Perform complex analyses and trade studies to guide system concept selection,

ensuring system architecture and design align with operational concepts.
  
  

* Create and control systems engineering artifacts such as Requirements Verification

Traceability Matrixes (RVTM), Interface Control Documents (ICD), architecture diagrams,
  
  
design documents, system and service workflows, test cases, test plans, test procedures,
  
  
and test reports.
  
  

* Devise solutions to a range of complex problems where evaluation of information

requires an in-depth analysis of identifiable factors and creative problem-solving
  
  
techniques.
  
  

* Direct and oversee hardware/software integration, system-level integration testing, and

requirement verification, ensuring compliance with established requirements and project
  
  
standards.
  
  

* Collaborate with senior stakeholders, internal and external, to communicate technical

concepts, resolve problems, and influence decision-making on technical matters.
  
  

* Prepare technical reports, system documentation, and test plans while ensuring clarity

and compliance with project requirements.
  
  

* Conduct risk management and technical issue resolution activities, providing

innovative and e􀆯ective solutions to complex challenges.
  
  

* Mentor and provide guidance to junior engineers, o􀆯ering technical expertise and

professional development support.
  
  

* Provide artifacts, data, and technical advice to support proposal e􀆯orts.
* Develop and maintain relationships with stakeholders, ensuring e􀆯ective

collaboration and communication to meet project objectives.
  
  
General Duties and Responsibilities:
  
  

* Comply with Cubic’s Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies and

procedures.
  
  

* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.
* Comply with security in accordance with established policies and procedures of

relevant organizations.
  
  
Background and Experience:
  
  
 Tertiary qualification in the field of system engineering, electrical engineering,
  
  
computer science, information systems, or other relevant technical discipline.
  
  
 Minimum 5 years of related experience with a Bachelors degree; or 3 years and a
  
  
Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience
  
  
 Proficiency in preparing Business Requirement Document(BRD), High Level Design
  
  
(HLD) and System configuration document. Proficiency in writing and producing
  
  
documentation for system specifications, test procedures.
  
  
 Experience in performing UAT and Verification & Validation
  
  
 Experience in debugging using log management tools like Grey logs, Splunk etc.,
  
  
 Basic knowledge on SQL server
  
  
** Experience Using DOORS Requirements Traceability Tool**
 Experience using model-based design methods (SysML or UML) and associate
  
  
software applications e.g. Rhapsody.
  
  
 Advanced ability using typical PC software such as word processors, databases,
  
  
flowcharts, project schedulers, and spreadsheets
  
  
 Experience in preparing and presenting information using a variety of media to
  
  
various internal and external stakeholders and customers
  
  
 Experience using JIRA.
  
  
 Experience working in an Agile environment
  
  
‎
  
  
**Worker Type:**
Employee
  
  
‎
  
  
*We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Social Media and Brand Manager
description:
**SOCIAL MEDIA AND BRAND MANAGER**
**AMEENJI RUBBER**
**LIMITED |**
**CORE MARKETING**
**Company: Ameenji Rubber Limited**
**Department: Core Marketing**
**Experience: 3-4 years**
**Salary: 30,000 per month**
Ameenji Rubber Limited is hiring a social media and Brand Manager to strengthen our brand presence, manage social media communication and create content that connects our products with the right audiences.
  
  
You will own content planning, brand messaging and organic social media execution, working closely with sales, technical teams, designers and video editors. Your role will be to communicate our capabilities clearly, build customer trust and support business growth.
  
  
About Ameenji Rubber Limited Ameenji Rubber Limited manufactures engineered and commercial rubber products serving infrastructure, railways, industrial, fitness and agricultural applications. Our portfolio includes bridge bearings, expansion joints, railway components, industrial rubber sheets, electrical rubber mats, gym flooring and animal-care mats.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop brand and social media strategies: Create communication plans aligned with company objectives, product priorities and the needs of customers, contractors, procurement teams, dealers and distributors.
* Maintain a consistent brand identity: Define and apply brand messaging, tone of voice and visual guidelines across social media, website content, presentations and marketing materials.
* Manage social media channels: Own the day-to-day management of LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, adapting content and publishing approaches to each platform and audience.
* Plan the content calendar: Develop monthly calendars covering product education, applications, manufacturing capabilities, project stories, customer experiences, exhibitions, employee stories and company updates.
* Create compelling written content: Write captions, LinkedIn posts, video scripts, carousel copy, campaign concepts and creative briefs. Review content for clarity, accuracy and brand consistency before publishing.
* Translate technical information into clear communication: Collaborate with product, engineering, quality and sales teams to explain product features, applications and customer benefits accurately.
* Coordinate design and video production: Brief graphic designers and video editors, plan content shoots, review creative work and manage feedback, approvals and delivery schedules.
* Execute integrated brand campaigns: Coordinate communication for product launches, exhibitions, dealer initiatives and other marketing campaigns. Manage agreed timelines, vendor coordination and approved campaign budgets where assigned.
* Manage community engagement and enquiries: Respond to comments, messages and reviews professionally. Capture relevant enquiries, hand them over to sales and escalate complaints or sensitive issues to the appropriate team.
* Develop customer and partner stories: Coordinate testimonials, project case studies and relevant industry collaborations. Obtain approval before publishing customer information, project details or third-party content.
* Support sales and dealer communication: Work with sales and creative teams on brochures, product presentations, catalogues, dealer communication and other materials that explain the company’s products and capabilities.
* Research audiences, competitors and industry trends: Monitor customer questions, competitor activity and industry conversations. Use these insights to improve content topics, positioning and campaign ideas.
* Coordinate with performance marketing and SEO: Align campaign themes, website messaging and content distribution. Share audience insights and creative learnings to strengthen the overall marketing effort.
* Measure results and improve execution: Prepare monthly reports covering audience quality, engagement, website referrals, enquiries and content performance. Recommend improvements and maintain organised calendars, approvals and content records.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 3-4 years of experience in social media management, brand marketing or a closely related role.
* Demonstrated experience managing business social media accounts and delivering content campaigns.
* Strong English writing, editing, storytelling and communication skills.
* Ability to develop content calendars and adapt messaging for different audiences and platforms.
* Understanding of brand positioning, visual consistency and community management.
* Ability to learn technical products and communicate their applications clearly.
* Experience coordinating with designers, video editors and internal stakeholders.
* Strong planning skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, approvals and deadlines.
* Ability to interpret performance data and turn insights into practical improvements.

**Tools and Platform Knowledge**

* Meta Business Suite and native social media analytics.
* LinkedIn Page management and analytics.
* YouTube Studio.
* Social media scheduling and reporting tools.
* Canva and familiarity with design and video production workflows.
* Basic GA4 knowledge for reviewing social referral traffic and website activity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B marketing, manufacturing, industrial products, infrastructure or dealer and distributor communication.
* Experience developing product explainers, case studies, exhibition campaigns or corporate content.
* A degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Growth in relevant audiences and meaningful engagement.
* Consistent delivery of accurate, useful and on-brand content.
* Website visits and qualified enquiries generated through social channels.
* Timely responses and effective handover of customer enquiries.
* Successful execution of campaigns and measurable improvements based on content performance.

**What You’ll Work On**
You will help shape how Ameenji communicates across digital and offline channels, develop stories around real products and projects, and work with colleagues across marketing, sales and technical functions.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Interested candidates may send their updated CV to msl@ameenji.net / careers@ameenji.net
  
  
**Email subject: Application for Social Media and Brand Manager - Your Name**
**Please Include**

* Your updated CV.
* Links to social media accounts or brands you have managed.
* A sample content calendar and two campaign examples explaining your contribution and results.
* Your notice period and earliest joining date.

Anonymised work samples are welcome. Please avoid sharing confidential information belonging to previous employers or clients.

title: Python Full Stack Technical Trainer – LMS Video Content Creator
description:

Fuzentrix Education Private Limited is looking for a Python Full Stack Technical Trainer to develop and deliver a structured 30-hour video course for our Learning Management System (LMS).

We are looking for someone who can
**prepare technical subject content and teach it in front of a camera for educational video recordings**
.

This is a teaching and LMS content creation role, not a regular software developer position. The selected candidate will focus on preparing the course, developing presentations and scripts, demonstrating concepts, and teaching on camera. Our internal team will handle video shooting arrangements, editing, and the remaining production activities.

* Python programming: Basics to Advanced
* HTML and CSS
* JavaScript fundamentals
* React
* SQL/PostgreSQL and database integration
* Django or Flask

* Git and GitHub

title: Automation and Catalogue Specialist
description:
**Summary**
The Automation and Catalogue Specialist combines catalogue master data expertise with process transformation, intelligent automation and value realization. The role helps build a common, governed catalogue capability while identifying, shaping and delivering automation opportunities across the source-to-pay landscape.
  
  
You will ensure that articles, services, suppliers and pricing data is accurate, connected and ready for use, while partnering with business, platform and technology stakeholders to simplify processes, translate opportunities into scalable digital solutions, and demonstrate measurable business outcomes from implementation through adoption and benefit tracking.
  
  
**Job Description**
What you will be accountable for
  
  

* Catalogue foundation. Own and improve the article, service, supplier and commercial data that supports a consistent buying experience.
* Shared data language. Develop and maintain taxonomy, attributes, controlled vocabulary, standards, and cross-system mappings.
* Automation opportunity pipeline. Identify and assess process automation, AI and agentic AI opportunities using evidence from process performance, volumes, and pain points.
* Solution delivery. Translate validated business needs into requirements, solution designs, test scenarios, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes with platform and technology teams.
* Value-realization. Build credible baselines and value cases, define benefit measures, track adoption and outcomes, and provide transparent reporting to support prioritization and investment decisions.
* Stakeholder outcomes. Partner across category management, procurement operations, supply chain, suppliers, platform and technology teams to achieve sustainable adoption and resolve issues at source.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Catalogue master data and lifecycle management
* Create, validate, enrich, publish, modify and retire catalogue records, including base item and variant relationships, descriptions, units of measure, pack sizes, validity periods, pricing and lifecycle status.
* Classify content against the agreed taxonomy and attribute model, resolving classification questions and exceptions with category and business stakeholders.
* Maintain traceable mappings between catalogue objects and identifiers used in ERP, purchasing and other connected systems across business units and entities.
* Coordinate supplier catalogue onboarding from submission guidance and validation through reconciliation, upload, publication and ongoing maintenance.
* Data governance, quality and connectivity
* Define and maintain master data terminology, standards, validation rules, attributes, permissible values, ownership, validity and change history.
* Apply and improve data-quality controls, monitor exceptions and recurring error patterns, coordinate remediation and report the health of catalogue data.
* Work with technology teams on catalogue integrations and data exchange, including API-based connectivity, requirements, test scenarios, and validation.
* Design practical approaches for complex data scenarios where current system capability is limited, balancing control, usability, and scalability.
* Automation, AI and process transformation
* Identify automation, AI, intelligent automation, and agentic AI opportunities through process analysis, stakeholder discovery, and operational data.
* Simplify and standardize processes before automation, remove avoidable complexity, and help define the target operating approach.
* Translate approved opportunities into clear business requirements, user stories, solution concepts, controls, test cases, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with AI platform product owners, technology teams and business users through process design, testing, deployment, change management and stabilization.
* Perform structured root-cause analysis on catalogue and automation issues, then implement preventive and scalable improvements.
* Value realization and performance management
* Establish pre-implementation baselines using relevant measures such as transaction volumes, handling effort, cycle time, cost, quality, compliance, exception rates and scalability.
* Identify and quantify value levers including productivity, cost avoidance, improved data quality, reduced rework, faster turnaround, increased automation coverage, improved user experience, and stronger process control.
* Develop evidence-based value cases that set out expected benefits, assumptions, dependencies, implementation costs, risks and measurement methods for prioritization and investment decisions.
* Define benefit owners, KPIs, targets and measurement of cadence with stakeholders before implementation, ensuring accountability for adoption and outcomes.
* Track realized benefits after go-live, compare results with the approved baseline and value case, identify benefit leakage, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Create concise dashboards and management insights covering delivery progress, adoption, operational performance, and realized value.
* Stakeholder, change and delivery management
* Partner with Category Managers, Supply Chain, procurement operations, suppliers, platform colleagues and technology teams to align priorities and delivery outcomes.
* Support adoption through use cases, walkthroughs, training inputs, communications and solution conversations that make new capabilities practical for users.
* Manage dependencies, risks, decisions and issues across automation and catalogue initiatives, escalating clear options and recommendations.
* Promote best practice sharing and reusable solutions across functions, business units and locations.

**Critical Qualifications, Skills And Experience**

* 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in catalogue or product information management, master data, procurement operations, process improvement, automation delivery, data governance or related field.
* Good understanding of source-to-pay processes, particularly requisitioning and purchasing, and of how master data quality affects process performance and user experience.
* Experience working with structured data, hierarchies, taxonomies, attributes, identifiers, pricing, and relationships between records held in different systems.
* Ability to analyze processes and operational data, establish baselines, identify value levers, and convert findings into prioritized improvement or automation opportunities.
* Experience translating business needs into requirements, solution designs, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* Advanced Excel capability for large datasets, reconciliation, duplicate identification, gap analysis, and performance tracking.
* Working understanding of APIs, integrations and data flows, sufficient to collaborate effectively with technology and platform teams.
* Strong analytical judgement and structured problem solving, including the ability to design options for ambiguous or complex scenarios.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with confidence working across global business, technology, supplier and leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, changing and sometimes ambiguous environment while maintaining strong governance and attention to detail.

**Strong advantages**

* SQL, Power BI, or similar tools for querying, modelling, visualization, and performance reporting.
* Exposure to enterprise procurement, catalogue, ERP, product information or workflow platforms.
* Hands-on familiarity with process automation, AI, intelligent automation, agentic AI or low-code solutions.
* Experience supporting data cleansing, system migration, catalogue onboarding or cross-business-unit harmonization programs.
* Experience developing business cases, tracking benefits, measuring adoption or reporting value realization after go-live.
* Knowledge of change management, controls, risk management, and operational governance in digital delivery.

**Ways of working**

* Customer-focused and curious, with a practical mindset for improving everyday work.
* Comfortable challenging the status quo while collaborating respectfully across disciplines.
* Data-led and outcome-oriented, with the discipline to distinguish expected value from realized value.
* Proactive, organized, and accountable, with a focus on sustainable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Inclusive and collaborative, able to build trust across cultures, functions and locations.

title: Advertisement for the post of Project Lead for the project ‘A Scoping Report on Broiler Chicken Welfare in India’
description:
Job Title: Advertisement for the post of Project Lead for the project ‘A Scoping Report on Broiler Chicken Welfare in India’
  
  
No. of Positions: 1
  
  
Category: Project Lead
  
  
Date of Posting: 26 October 2026
  
  
Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
  
  
**Official Notification**
**NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad (NALSAR)**
NALSAR University of Law is an institution that aims to provide quality legal education that underlines constitutionalism, rule of law and justice, with a particular focus on social justice to the marginalised communities. NALSAR imparts legal education, promotes research and training, writing and publication, in order to disseminate information and promote legal literacy.
  
  
**ALPN Research Foundation, Bengaluru (ALPN)**
ALPN Research Foundation is a not-for-profit independent think-tank that is working towards improving animal welfare across India. ALPN undertakes research on the intersection of animal welfare and public health, human rights, food safety, environment protection, human rights and climate resilience.
  
  
**About The Project**
NALSAR is partnering with ALPN to undertake a study that systematically assesses the current conditions and challenges to the welfare of broiler chickens in India. This study aims to evaluate the existing broiler chicken industry end-to-end, from farming systems and supply chains to market demand, regulatory context, and the broader stakeholder ecosystem. It will inform targeted intervention pathways in India.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a Project Lead to oversee and conduct desk and field research, analysis, and report writing, and provide technical expertise with regard to broiler welfare in the context of India. This is a six-month-long, full-time research role with field research expected to take place for three months across approximately 60 farm visits in six states, plus slaughterhouses and meat shops. All fieldwork costs will be covered by the organisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead technical research and analysis on broiler farming systems in India – production practices, housing, breeds and genetics, feeding regimes, health management, and welfare conditions across different system types (backyard, contract, integrated, and commercial).
* Design and execute a fieldwork plan covering approximately 60 farm visits across six states, plus slaughterhouses and meat retail points, assessing on-ground farming practices and welfare conditions firsthand.
* Conduct and synthesise literature on broiler production and welfare in India.
* Build relationships with farmers, veterinarians, and production-side stakeholders to support fieldwork and ongoing insight-gathering.
* Assess the nature and extent of animal welfare across various farming systems, and evaluate the malleability of each system to welfare-improving interventions.
* Provide subject-matter expertise on technical sections of the final report (industry overview, farming systems analysis) and contribute broiler-specific expertise to cross-cutting insights.
* Identify and prioritise a list of potential welfare-focused interventions based on technical feasibility and likely adoption by relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the wider research team (who will lead economic, market, and regulatory analysis) to ensure technical findings feed into the overall report.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated subject-matter expertise in broiler chicken production in India with a background in veterinary science, animal husbandry, poultry science, or a closely related technical field is strongly preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of broiler farming systems in India (backyard, contract farming, integrated commercial operations) and common welfare issues within them.
* Familiarity with animal welfare science and assessment frameworks as applied to broiler chickens.
* Prior field experience visiting or working directly with poultry farms, ideally in rural or semi-urban India, would be an asset.
* Fluency in English required; proficiency in regional languages would be an asset for fieldwork.

Preference will be given to candidates with
  
  

* Strong technical/domain knowledge of poultry biology, husbandry, and production systems.
* Strong research and analytical skills, and the ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative information into clear, actionable insights.
* Stakeholder engagement and interviewing skills, including with farmers, industry players, and government/regulatory entities.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within India for fieldwork (across five states).
* Project management skills and ability to work against timelines, coordinate fieldwork logistics, and manage competing priorities independently.
* Cultural and contextual sensitivity for engaging with diverse stakeholders across Indian states.

**Application Process**
Interested candidates must submit their application through the Google form. Only shortlisted candidates from this application round will be invited for the further interview rounds. If you have any queries, please feel free to reach out to
**alc@nalsar.ac.in**
Apply

title: Technical Support/SKIL Instructor
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
  
  
Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor
  
  
**Role Description**
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you are considered a subject matter expert in NCR Atleos ATM products and act as an advanced level remote support analyst and technical learning instructor. You are part of our support services and learning delivery teams, and your passion for providing exceptional customer service, technical guidance, and effective instruction contributes to our world-class high level of customer satisfaction and associate readiness.
  
  
Acting as second line support to NCR Atleos Field Service Technicians and as an instructor for assigned technical learning programs, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with your focus being finding the right solution for each Field Service Technician, learner, and customer. You connect with Field Service Technicians to address questions and resolve various problems, including uncommon or complex issues, knowing when and who to turn to for additional support. You also facilitate classroom, lab, virtual instructor-led, and online learning experiences that enhance technical capability and improve the overall effectiveness of the business unit/organization.
  
  
You will have a proactive approach and may handle problems before they start by identifying knowledge gaps, improving course content, creating knowledge articles, and feeding live field learning back into training materials and knowledge systems. No matter the situation, your formal training, technical expertise, available knowledge repositories, and adult learning techniques will allow you to provide Field Service Technicians and learners what they need when they need it. Additionally, you will always be on the lookout for preventative measures you can take, escalate issues appropriately, contribute to continuous improvement, and serve as an ambassador for the NCR Atleos brand.
  
  
Your goal is to keep our Field Service Technicians, learners, and customers completely assured and satisfied through your technical expertise, instructional capability, consistent communication, and commitment to quality support and effective learning delivery.
  
  
Position Summary & Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you will provide support to Field Service Engineers who will generally be onsite at a customer location and requiring technical assistance.
  
  
The support will include problem identification, analysis, diagnosis, and resolution.
  
  
You will utilize Knowledge Systems provided by NCR Atleos and other vendors as appropriate to identify solutions to known problems.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that solutions provided are successful, ensuring first time and long-term resolution of the problem.
  
  
If no known solution can be identified, you are responsible for escalation to other support groups where deeper level skilled personnel are available.
  
  
You retain ownership of escalated problems/issues through to resolution.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that NCR Atleos Management is informed if resolution to a problem will take longer than contractual requirements require.
  
  
You will provide input to the Knowledge Systems as and when required and create and publish knowledge articles when required.
  
  
You will coordinate with your peers, Management, Learning teams, and other support groups in providing part numbers, technical details, field learning, and product/process information to Field Service Technicians and learners.
  
  
You will act as a second line escalation point for junior colleagues and provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance where required.
  
  
You will facilitate course delivery using classroom, lab, VILT (virtual instructor-led training), online, and other approved methods of instruction.
  
  
You will execute course delivery according to the published training schedule.
  
  
You will maintain classroom facilities, training center, lab environment, training equipment, and learning materials necessary for the class.
  
  
You will work collaboratively with and around other team members in a Lab environment.
  
  
You will support course development by providing subject matter expertise for assigned products, technical procedures, and service processes.
  
  
You will perform course maintenance and identify required updates to course content using existing knowledge, field feedback, service trends, and analytical skills.
  
  
You will use a variety of delivery techniques, leveraging formal and informal delivery tools such as virtual classrooms, web conferencing, discussion forums, blogs, wikis, job aids, and short-form instructional videos where applicable.
  
  
You may serve as course owner for assigned instructor-led training courses.
  
  
You will develop or support performance support materials, including job aids, technical tips, procedural guides, and YouTube-style videos where applicable.
  
  
You will mentor new instructors and support knowledge transfer across technical support and learning teams.
  
  
You will manage day-to-day operations of the learning center where assigned, including keeping it clean, organized, and ready to support the best learning environment possible.
  
  
You will use continuous improvement processes and tools to improve Services Learning and Technical Support processes and increase the value-add provided to our customers.
  
  
You will deliver quality support and enhanced results meeting established KPI and Customer SLA requirements.
  
  
You will provide onsite and lab support for equipment as required.
  
  
You must be willing and able to work flexible schedules, which may include night and weekend shifts, and perform overtime work upon management request or business need.
  
  
You will perform travel as required, where applicable.
  
  
You must maintain a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.
  
  
You will comply with NCR Atleos policies which include but are not limited to:
  
  
The Company’s Shared Values and Code of Conduct.
  
  
Employee Health and Safety policy and standards.
  
  
Accurate timekeeping and records of hours worked.
  
  
Company Fleet policies and requirements, where applicable, which include but are not limited to NCR Atleos requirements for safe driving.
  
  
You will perform other corresponding duties and tasks in accordance with your qualifications, as directed by Employer.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
High School Diploma.
  
  
Prior work experience in a Customer Support or Technical Support role is required, with experience supporting customers in the Financial sector and/or Retail and Hospitality sector being a must where applicable.
  
  
3–5 years of experience working with, supporting, troubleshooting, or servicing technical equipment, heavy machinery, ATMs, retail technology, networking hardware, or similar technical environments; or an Associate Degree in a technical field or in education.
  
  
Experience servicing NCR Atleos supported equipment or equivalent technical platforms is required where applicable.
  
  
Must be authorized to work in the country where position is posted.
  
  
Must be a local candidate for in-country teams.
  
  
PC proficiency.
  
  
Proficiency with Windows-based applications/tools and MS Office products.
  
  
Good English communication skills and telephony etiquette; other languages may be required for certain teams.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Strong demonstrated public speaking, facilitation, or presentation skills.
  
  
Ability to listen and communicate effectively in a professional environment.
  
  
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Strong team player with the ability to work collaboratively in a matrix-managed organization.
  
  
Ability to explain technical concepts in clear and understandable terms to Field Service Technicians, learners, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Ability to work in an office environment either full time or on a hybrid work model where applicable.
  
  
Ability to work collaboratively in a lab environment and support onsite/lab-based technical learning and troubleshooting activities.
  
  
Willingness and ability to work flexible schedules, including shift hours, nights, weekends, and overtime as required by business need.
  
  
Must have the ability to carry and lift tool kits, training equipment, or parts of varying weights up to 50 lbs. where applicable.
  
  
Must be available to work in other training locations as needed, where applicable.
  
  
Must have a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor’s Degree in Education, IT, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
Knowledge of Electrical Engineering.
  
  
Advanced understanding of Networking Technology.
  
  
Previous experience as a field-based Field Service Technician.
  
  
Previous experience in a Learning, Education, Technical Training, or Instructor role.
  
  
2–3 years teaching adult learners technical topics, including hands-on mechanical, hardware, electrical, or networking modules.
  
  
Knowledge of NCR Atleos products, services, tools, and processes.
  
  
Experience servicing ATMs, PCs, servers, networking hardware, or related customer service technology.
  
  
Experience with course ownership, course maintenance, instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, and learning center operations.
  
  
Proven ability to work independently, juggle multiple projects, and adapt to frequent change.
  
  
Ability to build rapport with internal and external customers.
  
  
Ability to self-manage while maintaining accountability for support quality, learning delivery, and operational readiness.

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
**Job Description**
We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
* Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
* Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
* Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
* Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
* Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
* Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
* Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
* Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
* Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
* Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
* Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
* Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
* Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
* Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
* Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
* Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
* Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate or Data Engineer Associate (or Generative AI Engineer Associate).
* GitHub certification (for example, GitHub Foundations or GitHub Actions) and/or formal Copilot training or enablement.
* Substitution: 2+ years of production, hands-on experience delivering end-to-end business requirements or testing using Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, and GitHub Copilot Agent Mode in banking.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Lead Assessor – Signalling
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Purpose of the Role :**
The Lead Independent Safety Assessment (ISA) Assessor has the overall authority and responsibility to ensure that all Safety assessment activities under a project are correctly prepared, executed and reported.
  
  
The role provides impartial technical judgement on whether safety requirements have been adequately defined, implemented, verified, and justified. Assessing whether risks have been demonstrated to have been reduced to an acceptable level.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead independent safety assessments for railway systems, including signaling, control command, rolling stock, infrastructure, and system integration projects.
* Review and assess safety documentation, including Safety Cases, Hazard Logs, risk assessments, system safety plans, verification and validation evidence, test reports, and assurance arguments.
* Assess compliance with applicable railway safety standards and regulations, including EN 50126, EN 50128 (EN50716), EN 50129 and other project-specific requirements.
* Provide independent technical opinions on the adequacy of safety requirements, risk controls, safety evidence, and residual risk acceptance.
* Plan, manage, and coordinate ISA activities across the project lifecycle, including assessment planning, document review, audits, inspections, test witnessing, findings management, and final reporting.
* Act as the primary technical interface with clients, project teams, design authorities, validators, certification bodies, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Lead multidisciplinary assessment teams, allocate tasks, review outputs, and ensure consistency, quality, and independence of assessment conclusions.
* Identify safety-related issues, observations, and non-compliances, and provide clear recommendations to support timely resolution.
* Prepare high-quality ISA plans, interim assessment reports, findings logs, technical notes, and final ISA reports.
* Maintain impartiality and independence from design, delivery, and implementation activities in accordance with applicable accreditation and governance requirements.

What we offer
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**
**Required Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelors degree in engineering, systems engineering or safety engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in railways, metros, or trams.
* Specific experience in developing or assessing complex railway signalling systems.
* Minimum 5 years railway safety assurance, independent safety assessment, systems assurance, certification, verification and validation, or safety-critical engineering.
* Demonstrable experience applying railway safety standards, particularly CENELEC standards EN 50126, EN 50128 (EN 50716), and EN 50129, including RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) specifications and demonstrations. Leading assessment activities for at least 3 complex rail projects, including multidisciplinary systems and interfaces.
* Deep understanding of hazard identification, risk analysis, safety integrity levels, safety requirements management, assurance cases, and lifecycle safety processes.
* Experience engaging with clients, suppliers, infrastructure managers, operators, notified bodies, designated bodies, assessment bodies, and national safety authorities.
* Professional registration, chartered engineer status, or recognized safety/assurance certification is desirable.

**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Strong understanding of the processes and potential defects related to the lifecycle of the railway’s products
* Knowledge and understanding of risk management, systems engineering and human/organizational factors for the subsystems within scope of assessment
* Knowledge and understanding of the interfaces related to interoperability and safe integration
* Understanding of the risk derived or likely to be derived from the integration of the product into the railway system
* Ability to perform sound robust judgement on any deviation of the product under assessment
* Strong technical judgement and the ability to form clear, evidence-based independent conclusions.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, defensible, and audit-ready assessment reports.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence engaging with senior technical, project, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Ability to lead teams, manage priorities, and deliver assessment outputs within agreed scope, schedule, and budget.
* High attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to reviewing complex safety evidence.
* Commitment to professional integrity, impartiality, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

title: Sr HRIS Professional
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
**We are seeking an HRIS Sr. Professional to serve as the first line of HRIS support for Workday.**
This role focuses on day-to-day user enablement, request triage and resolution, routine system maintenance, data quality, documentation, reporting, and testing. The position resolves routine issues independently and partners with Tier 2/3 HRIS and technical resources when a request requires deeper product expertise, complex configuration, integrations, security changes, or broader impact analysis.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Serve as Tier 1 HRIS support for Workday, helping HR users and other authorized users understand how to complete transactions, locate information, and use available self-service resources.
* Triage and manage assigned Workday support requests through Jira; gather relevant details, troubleshoot issues, document work and resolution, communicate status, and route requests to the appropriate owner when escalation is required.
* Investigate routine Workday issues by reviewing user steps, data, business process status, security/access context, and available documentation; resolve issues within established scope and escalate complex or higher-risk issues to Tier 2/3 resources.
* Create, modify, and maintain simple Workday reports and support users in locating existing reports and dashboards. Escalate advanced reporting, calculated-field, matrix/composite, or broader analytics needs as appropriate.
* Perform approved low-risk/simple Workday configuration and maintenance activities in accordance with HRIS change control, testing, approval, documentation, and production-validation standards.
* Maintain HRIS job aids, knowledge articles, FAQs, and other user-enablement content; keep materials current as Workday processes and functionality change and partner with functional stakeholders for business-process nuances.
* Perform routine data-quality audits, exception reviews, reconciliations, and follow-up activities; document findings, correct or coordinate correction of issues within scope, and escalate recurring or higher-risk data concerns.
* Assist Tier 2/3 HRIS team members with functional testing, regression testing, test-script execution, defect documentation, and validation of enhancements and configuration changes.
* Participate in Workday semi-annual release readiness activities, including assigned feature review, regression testing, issue documentation, and production validation.
* Support ongoing HRIS operational work such as documentation clean-up, process follow-up, recurring administrative activities, and stabilization efforts that improve the reliability and user experience of Workday.
* Follow established HRIS governance, change-control, data-protection, documentation, and escalation standards and maintain accurate work records in Jira.
* Partner collaboratively with HR functional stakeholders, Payroll, Business Applications, and other HRIS team members to resolve requests and provide a consistent support experience.
* Identify recurring user questions, defects, data issues, or process pain points and surface opportunities for improved job aids, training, self-service, controls, or system enhancements.
* Perform other duties as required.

**Qualifications**

* 2-4+ years of HRIS, HR operations, HR technology, or related systems-support experience; hands-on Workday experience strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Workday navigation and business processes; exposure to one or more functional areas such as HCM, Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent/Performance, Learning, Help, or Reporting is preferred.
* Experience troubleshooting user or system issues and knowing when to escalate based on complexity, risk, or required system access.
* Experience creating or maintaining basic reports, user documentation, job aids, knowledge content, or training materials.
* Comfort working with data, performing recurring audits or reconciliations, and identifying discrepancies with strong attention to detail.
* Experience participating in system testing, documenting defects/results, and validating expected outcomes is preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and common productivity tools; experience with Jira or another ticket/request management platform is preferred.
* Ability to explain system steps and technical information clearly to users with different levels of Workday experience.
* Strong organization, follow-through, customer-service orientation, curiosity, and practical problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive employee information with confidentiality and professionalism and follow established access and data-governance requirements.

**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
  
  
**Special Notice**
Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.
  
  

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.
* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in-person format.
* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

title: Application Engineer
company: Sciemetric Technologies India Pvt Ltd (TASI India)
description:
Job Summary

Location : Pune, Maharashtra.

The application engineer will be responsible for deploying Sciemetric test systems at

customer sites throughout India and the rest of the world. The job will involve the use of

our proprietary electronic signature analysis software and In-Process Testing (IPT)

technology to understand manufacturing process behavior and help customers find defects

in their processes. Typical duties will involve creating custom applications using

Sciemetric software to acquire, process, and analyze data from analog and digital

instruments , or gauging equipment , then apply it to new or existing manufacturing

equipment on a machining or assembly line. The application engineer is assigned to a

project from the start of application development (programming) through to debug and

commissioning on the end customers floor. The job will require significant amounts of

travel throughout India and overseas. (up to 50% of the time could be spent traveling).

Typical duties

• Travel to customer site to deploy and commission Sciemetric/CTS/Innomatec test

systems in a manufacturing environment. (Customer base is mainly automotive but

can include medical, electronic, or consumer products).

• Program and configure application software to collect and process data from

instruments such as load cells, pressure transducers, linear and rotary encoders,

measurement lasers, and accelerometers.

• Apply the appropriate filtering, smoothing, data processing, and statistical analysis

techniques to identify key features in a customer’s manufacturing process to enable

them to find defects and/or anomalies in their parts.

• Interface Sciemetric hardware (PC based) to communicate and extract data from

third party devices, PLCs, gauging equipment, and bolt tightening systems , using

various protocols such as field bus (Profinet, Ethernet I/P, Modbus) , file transfer

(FTP), serial Comm. and other data transfer schemes.

• Setup and configure Sciemetric data management host server (Qualityworx) to store

test results from plant floor data acquisition systems.

Candidate requirements

1. Engineering degree – preferred Electrical/Instrumentation/Electronic

2. 3+ Experience working in a high volume manufacturing environment.

3. Willingness and ability to travel extensively

4. Strong programing skills – preferably experience with a structured programming

language such as C or Visual Basic, or equivalent.

5. Familiarity with common manufacturing test processes, for example – leak testing,

gauging, engine Hot or Cold testing.

6. A working knowledge of instrumentation and sensors, for example pressure &

flow sensors, load cells, accelerometers, linear and rotary encoders, torque

transducers, LVDT’s.

7. Strong analytical and problem solving skills.

8. The ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Desirable Attributes

• Experience with data acquisition systems such National Instruments Labview, HBM,

or others.

• Prior experience with troubleshooting and calibration of instruments and sensors.

• Knowledge of engine testing techniques (hot test, cold test, fuel injection, ECUs).

• Experience with the manufacture or testing of medical devices

• Working knowledge of queries and procedures on Microsoft SQL databases

title: Implementation Success Manager - T&E
description:
**Role: Implementation Success Manager**

**About Us:**

AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend-to-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows to read, understand, and make real-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises, including one-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen’s invoice, expense, and card transaction solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com.

**Job Description:**

The Implementation Success Manager (ISM) is an experienced, hands-on project manager who owns the end-to-end delivery of AppZen Expense Audit and Card Audit implementations. You will run multiple single- and multi-country implementations simultaneously – from kick-off through design, configuration, integration, testing, go-live and hypercare – managing scope, schedule, risk, quality and stakeholders.

**Working Hours:**

This role requires working 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST (Monday to Friday) to overlap with our global customers and stakeholders. Please make sure you are comfortable with this schedule before applying.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Manage the end-to-end deployment of the solution (across all modules, functionalities, integration points, and people/change management topics in scope), manage the roadmap, and report to the global steering committee.
* Build trustworthy relationships to communicate and work effectively with customers, internal teams, and stakeholders.
* Oversee global/regional TE policy or template development if multi-country deployment and in program scope in case of EA implementation.
* Study the AP process and map it to the ecosystem of the Autonomous AP solution.
* Drive the requirement gathering and documentation.
* Evaluate complex customer business requirements gathered by the Implementation Consultants following Fin Trans proven and consistent methodology.
* Manage the development and review of functional documentation, such as TE policies and process documentation, CDW (conceptual design), and technical integration design.
* Independently drive the product configuration according to customer business requirements while considering functional and technical dependencies.
* Gathering of detailed integration-related requirements/inputs from the Fin Trans/AP
* Team customers and translate customer requirements into application design (according to customer needs and the respective scope of implementation)
* Act hands-on in complex technical configurations and conduct functional reviews of configurations completed by Implementation/Functional Consultants.
* Manage UAT-related test result evaluation and bug-fixing.
* Manage and maintain cut-over plan (business and technical) Deliver on SLA and commitments under time and budget pressure, incl. updating project tracking systems and fulfilling administrative responsibilities.

**Ideal candidates have:**

* 8+ years of experience implementing SaaS products or other relevant business consulting, with a track record of managing enterprise implementations end to end.
* Strong project management skills – scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality and stakeholder management – with experience running multiple concurrent projects.
* Project management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, etc.).
* Experience utilizing project management tools such as GoodDay, Asana, etc.
* Ability to effectively use, design and deploy AI agents.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and large language model concepts and how they are applied to finance automation.
* Knowledge of T&E, expense report and corporate card processes, policies and audit controls.
* Hands-on understanding of SaaS integration frameworks (APIs, SFTP/flat-file feeds, SSO) for integration with expense management, corporate card and ERP systems.
* Exceptional customer presence and presentation skills; comfortable talking with C-level executives.
* Ability to liaise with multiple internal cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Support, Sales).

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Content Strategy Analyst II
  
  
**Summary**
Content Strategy and Development (CS&D) provides the technical and
  
  
operational information that customers and stakeholders need to do
  
  
business with Mastercard. CS&D is committed to driving the business goals
  
  
of Mastercard by maximizing the impact of content. We foster solutions to
  
  
provide the right content, to the right stakeholders, in the right format, at the
  
  
right time. We accomplish this goal by collaborating with business partners to
  
  
understand customer needs and deliver timely, high-quality information in a
  
  
wide range of media and languages.
  
  
**Overview**
This position involves creating and delivering technical content and
  
  
publications about Mastercard products and services for our customers.
  
  
The position involves performing all stages of the processes to publish
  
  
technical content in online, mobile, and printed formats. It also includes
  
  
researching, evaluating, selecting, and implementing new enterprise-wide
  
  
processes and technologies.
  
  

* Are you passionate about technology and finding new ways of doing

things that challenge the status quo?
  
  

* Do you enjoy finding new solutions for delivering digital content?
* Do you enjoy working on a team that interfaces with business partners

across the globe?
  
  
Job Posting Details
  
  
**Role**

* Work with cross functional Teams and multiple Business/Product Owners to

create and update technical content
  
  

* Accountable for the successful completion of high-quality projects within the

technical writing function
  
  

* Ensure updates are made to content in accordance to the CS&D writing

standards
  
  

* Manage day-to-day writing and publishing needs to deliver content online for

consumption through multiple channels including Web and mobile
  
  

* Provide excellent customer service to our business partners and customers
* Author in XML or markdown, a tool utilized for content creation and editing
* Publish technical content to multiple platforms and output types, such as

PDF, HTML, Wiki, and online help file generation
  
  
**All About You**

* Possesses strong organizational and time management skills
* Exhibit strong written and verbal communication skills
* Technologically savvy, spearheading innovation through ingenuity, creativity,

and thoughtful risks
  
  

* Adaptable to dynamic change and ambiguity thriving in a fast-paced

environment
  
  

* Ability to identify process improvement opportunities
* Team player, ability to interact and consult with various levels throughout the

organization to cultivate and expand partnerships
  
  

* Exhibit the highest degree of professionalism, accountability, and

empowerment to drive results
  
  

* Basic working understanding of content localization
* Ability to work independently including the ability to problem-solve and

troubleshoot
  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Office products
* Experience with or prepared to learn content management system (CMS) and

other authoring tools, such as Ixiasoft, Oxygen, XML, xMetal, Visual Studio
  
  
Code
  
  

* Basic understanding of DITA/XML, HTML, and PDF
* Familiarity with taxonomy and entitlements within HTML, Markdown, and XML
* Willingness to learn and expand knowledge of Information Architecture
* Willingness to mentor and train peers
* Experience with MSTP/Chicago/any other technical publication guidelines

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Requirements Engineer, AS
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Requirements Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Associate**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
The Requirements Engineer will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and software development teams for credit and debit card processing applications. The role is responsible for eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business and system requirements throughout the product delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
  
  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with product owners, operations, compliance, risk, customer service, and technology stakeholders to understand business needs.
* Act as the go-between for business and development teams, translating business objectives into clear functional and non-functional requirements.
* Elicit requirements through workshops, interviews, process reviews, data analysis, and stakeholder discussions.
* Create and maintain business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, use cases, interface requirements, and traceability records.
* Support applications covering card authorization, clearing and settlement, transaction processing, refunds, reversals, disputes, chargebacks, fees, and reconciliation.
* Analyze impacts across upstream and downstream systems, integrations, APIs, data flows, and operational processes.
* Work with architects, developers, and testers to clarify requirements and resolve gaps, conflicts, and dependencies.
* Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and daily Scrum activities.
* Assist quality assurance teams with test scenarios, requirement coverage, defect triage, and business acceptance testing.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, track decisions and changes, and communicate delivery risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
* Ensure requirements consider security, privacy, regulatory, audit, resilience, and card-industry controls.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Experience as a Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role in financial services or payments technology.
* Working knowledge of credit and debit card transaction lifecycles and card processing platforms.
* Strong requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, modelling, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences and convert complex needs into actionable requirements.
* Practical experience working in Agile Scrum teams and understanding Scrum roles, ceremonies, artefacts, and backlog management.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence or equivalent requirements and delivery-management platforms.
* Experience writing well-structured user stories and testable acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across distributed, cross-functional teams.
* Familiar with Agile Team management tools (JIRA, Confluence)
* Pro-active team player with good communication skills as well as good English language skills.
* Experience with Agile/SCRUM environment including agile tooling and methodology together with knowledge of cards.
* Bachelor's degree from a college or university with an focus on IT or data evaluation and / or comparable professional experience

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
  
  
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
  
  
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Document and Data Control Specialist_WH
description:
**Entity**
Technology
