**Job Description**
**About the role**

* Assess the quality of engineering data, documents and models in ALIM proposing corrections to engineering to improve integrity of the design associated to assets and projects across P&O globally.
* Implement effective controls for internal delegation, audit and control of the quality of engineering data, documents and models in ALIM based on on engineering standards and procedures and through working with the Engineering Data Discipline Lead and Engineering.
* Assesses and manages risks around the use of engineering data, documents and models stored in ALIM based on the quality assessment.
* Contribute to reports on the consolidated status of quality and performance criteria as set by the Engineering Data, Doc and Model Delivery and Engineering Data, Doc and Model Discipline Lead to advise effective decision making.
* Recommends remediation actions as required.
* Ensures that engineering data, documents and models are presented optimally in accordance with IMD and Engineering management policies, standards, procedures, guidelines etc.
* Continuously improves IMD engineering data, document and model standards, tools, systems and processes through the Class Library and ALIM change request process based on the findings of the quality assessments.
* Deals with problems and issues, managing resolutions, corrective actions, lessons learned and the collection and dissemination of relevant information.

**What You Will Deliver**

* Information Governance – ensuring the delivery of complete and compliant engineering data, documents and models, whether produced internally or externally, in accordance with IMD standards to ensure high quality information and data is used to support decision-making, business processes and digital services.
* Stakeholder Management – The systematic identification, analysis, management, monitoring and improvement of stakeholder relationships in order to target and improve mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Customer Support – Acting as a point of contact to support service users and customers reporting issues, requesting information, access, or other services.
* Operational Excellence – Has a sound understanding of process and workflow streamlining, problem resolution and change management.
* Risk Management – Identifies external and internal factors that impact risk and mitigation opportunities. Identifies potential new or emerging risks/threats and implements mitigation plans.
* Change Management – Builds energy around a change using a systematic approach to transition from the present to the desired state.
* Digital Fluency – Effectively uses digital guidance, tools, methodologies, and security measures for operating as a digital business. Uses digital tools to collaborate, organize, plan and reflect on digital data.
* Analytical Thinking – Systematically breaks down a complex problem or process into component parts using logical analysis techniques to reach a solution. Logically assesses relationships, grasps interdependencies, and reviews trends within a complex problem or situation. Challenges assumptions and reliability of acquired information.

**Requirements**

* Fluent in English language with the ability to express any idea without hesitation, have good vocabulary and grammar; people understand you easily. Both your spoken and written skills are good.
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering (Preferably Process, Mechanical, Electrical or Instrumentation).
* 3+ years of work experience in Engineering Data Management in a global organisation that has a high turnover of green and brownfield engineering projects.
* Deep understanding of engineering design drawings, the standards to which they are created and how they relate to engineering data and business processes.
* Significant experience in following procedures to operate an Electronic Document Management Systems and Engineering Data Warehouses such as Bentley ALIM.
* Experience in applying information assurance, governance, analytics and data visualisation.
* Experience in demand management and prioritisation.
* Experience in quality assurance and conformance review.
* Excellent performance leadership skills.
* Experience in customer support and excellent relationship leadership skills.
* Knowledge of business analysis, business modelling, requirements leadership skills and the ability to find opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Knowledge of document and data management to support portfolios, programmes and projects.

title: Tendering Executive
description:
Job Description: Tendering Executive
  
  
Department: Sales & Estimation
  
Reporting To: Estimation Manager / Sales Head
  
Experience: 2+ years
  
Industry: Electrical Switchgear / Panel Manufacturing / EPC Projects
  
Salary: ₹3–5 LPA
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Job Overview
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented Tendering Executive with experience in electrical switchgear, panel manufacturing, or EPC projects. The candidate will be responsible for identifying suitable tenders, preparing technical and commercial documentation, submitting bids through online tender portals, and coordinating with internal departments to ensure timely and accurate tender submissions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Identify and track relevant tenders through GeM, CPPP, government e-tendering portals, and customer/vendor portals.
  
- Upload and submit tenders accurately within the specified deadlines.
  
- Review tender documents, technical specifications, BOQs, SLDs, GA drawings, and commercial terms.
  
- Handle tenders related to HT/LT panels, PCC panels, MCC panels, APFC panels, distribution boards, feeder pillars, CRP, bus ducts, and other electrical works.
  
- Check tender eligibility criteria, pre-qualification requirements, EMD, tender fees, and statutory documentation.
  
- Prepare tender checklists and coordinate with internal teams to collect the required documents.
  
- Prepare technical compliance statements, deviation sheets, product datasheets, test certificates, and company credentials.
  
- Coordinate with design, production, quality, purchase, finance, and sales teams for tender-related inputs.
  
- Maintain tender records, submission trackers, deadlines, amendments, and clarification responses.
  
- Prepare and submit clarification queries to tender authorities whenever required.
  
- Maintain a database of submitted tenders, approved makes, ISO certificates, statutory registrations, and past project credentials.
  
- Ensure tender submissions comply with applicable IS/IEC standards, technical specifications, and customer requirements.
  
- Archive tender documents and maintain confidentiality of technical and commercial information.
  
  
Educational Qualification
  
  
- Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering.
  
- Certification in project management or AutoCAD is preferred.
  
  
Required Skills
  
  
- Knowledge of government e-tendering portals, GeM, and CPPP.
  
- Experience in electrical switchgear or electrical panel manufacturing tenders.
  
- Understanding of BOQ, SLD, GA drawings, technical specifications, and compliance documentation.
  
- Good coordination, documentation, and time-management skills.
  
- Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and email communication.
  
- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet strict deadlines.
  
  
Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  
- Minimum 2 years of experience in tendering for electrical switchgear, panel manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  
- Candidates with experience in government tenders and electrical panel-related documentation will be preferred.

title: Technical Lead (Electrical)
description:
**PACCAR India**
is seeking a highly skilled
**Technical Lead - Electrical Engineering**
to join our high-performing engineering team in Pune. In this lead role, you will drive the design, development, and integration of advanced electrical systems, wiring harness solutions and electrical architectures for commercial vehicles. You will provide technical leadership across global cross-functional teams, ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality, production-ready solutions throughout the product development lifecycle.
  
  
At PACCAR, you will work in a collaborative and innovative environment that values leadership, technical excellence, and professional growth. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of commercial transportation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of automotive electrical systems and wiring harnesses for commercial trucks.
* Strong expertise in Technical / Wiring harness / EDS / Electrical Architecture and program management.
* Provide regular program status updates through weekly and monthly reports.
* Design and Develop Schematics, Harness drawings, Installation drawings, and Harness CAD routing using Siemens Capital (Capital XC/Logic) and CREO Cabling.
* Develop and support electrical system architecture, topology, and circuit design, including CAN communication and multicore wiring.
* Perform 3D cabling, routing, packaging, and sheet metal bracket design ensuring manufacturability, serviceability.
* Support integration of electrical systems across engine, chassis, cab, and sleeper assemblies.
* Lead design reviews, issue resolution, validation activities, and root cause investigations for virtual and vehicle-level concerns.

title: Senior UAT & Rollout Governance Specialist - SAP S/4HANA
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
You start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
In short, we are looking for a professional who can independently coordinate stakeholders, drive delivery follow-ups, identify risks and dependencies, and provide program-level visibility across multiple rollout workstreams, rather than primarily performing administrative project support.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience, including relevant experience in IT project/program coordination, enterprise transformation, rollout management, or testing governance.
* Proven experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing activities, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple projects or rollout workstreams.
* Strong capabilities in project governance and performance management, including status reporting, KPI tracking, risk and dependency management, and proactive escalation of delivery issues.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, drive follow-ups, resolve coordination gaps, and ensure timely completion of agreed actions.
* Experience coordinating internal IT and business stakeholders, project managers, and external IT service delivery partners in a complex enterprise environment.
* Understanding of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test planning, testing governance, and rollout delivery processes. Experience with SAP/S/4HANA implementations or rollouts is an advantage.
* Knowledge of IT operations, enterprise IT systems, service management structures, and service delivery performance frameworks.
* Ability to consolidate information from multiple workstreams, identify delivery risks and performance gaps, and provide clear, structured reporting to support decision-making.
* Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work proactively in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Business-fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Lead EDI Service Operations
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
We are looking for an experienced and proactive
**Lead for the EDI Service Operations**
to support and help lead production EDI operations for the
**US market**
. Reporting to the
**EDI Service Operations Manager**
, this role is responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and SLA-driven support across Cencora’s multi-platform EDI ecosystem, including
**Sterling B2B Integrator, Axway B2Bi, and Lightwell**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong technical depth in EDI production support, proven experience handling critical incidents, and the ability to guide support teams through issue triage, partner coordination, and operational governance. This role will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, partner onboarding support, and operational reporting to improve overall service quality and resilience.
  
  
This is a lead support role requiring strong operational ownership, cross-functional collaboration, and willingness to support a
**24x7 roster**
, including nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating basis.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
**Service Operations Leadership**

* Support the EDI Service Operations Manager in driving day-to-day production support and operational continuity for the EDI environment serving the US market.
* Help define, implement, and improve standard operating procedures, runbooks, escalation models, and service support practices.
* Track team activities, operational events, and support metrics to ensure timely issue response and adherence to SLAs.
* Guide team members in monitoring, triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving EDI production issues accurately and efficiently.
* Ensure effective shift handovers, incident tracking, and communication discipline across the support team.

**Incident Management and Issue Resolution**

* Lead and support investigation of production issues involving transaction failures, delayed processing, file delivery issues, mapping-related problems, connectivity issues, and application-to-application integration failures.
* Coordinate issue resolution with internal technical teams, external service providers, and trading partners.
* Help manage high-priority incidents and ensure clear stakeholder communication, status updates, and escalation handling.
* Drive root cause analysis for recurring incidents and help implement corrective and preventive actions.

**EDI Platform and Transaction Support**

* Provide functional and technical support across IBM Sterling B2B Integrator, Axway B2Bi, and Lightwell B2B Framework environments.
* Monitor production EDI transaction processing and investigate failed or delayed inbound/outbound flows.
* Support business-critical transaction types and ensure timely receipt, processing, and delivery of EDI documents.
* Analyze transaction, mapping, workflow, file transfer, and partner communication issues across multiple platforms and environments.
* Assist with production validation and controlled support for partner onboarding, setup changes, and operational readiness activities.

**Partner and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Work closely with business users, partners, vendors, and internal support teams to drive resolution of production issues.
* Coordinate with service providers and external trading partners to ensure delivery commitments and SLA expectations are met.
* Support onboarding activities by improving partner setup processes, validation steps, and supporting tools.
* Maintain strong communication with US stakeholders and business teams regarding production health, issue progress, and risks.

**Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence**

* Identify opportunities to improve support workflows, tools, reporting, and team efficiency.
* Help define and refine monitoring rules, alert handling processes, and issue categorization standards.
* Contribute to documentation updates including SOPs, troubleshooting guides, escalation procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Support process optimization initiatives for production support, onboarding, and service management practices.
* Collaborate with other EDI and integration teams on day-to-day support needs and project-related activities.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience.

**Work Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in EDI / B2B integration implementation, production support, and service operations.
* Strong hands-on experience with IBM Sterling B2B Integrator and/or Axway B2Bi.
* Prior experience supporting Axway-based data exchange environments is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Lightwell B2B Framework is preferred.
* Strong experience handling EDI formats including ANSI X12 and EDIFACT.
* Experience troubleshooting SAP IDOC and related data or integration issues.
* Experience supporting and maintaining business flows, transaction routing, partner connectivity, and production issue resolution in EDI ecosystems.
* Experience working in a 24x7 production support model with shift-based operations and escalation ownership.

**Skills And Knowledge**
**Behavioral Skills**

* Critical thinking
* Attention to detail
* Influence and impact
* Interpersonal communication
* Multitasking
* Problem solving
* Time management
* Team guidance and collaboration
* Ownership mindset

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of ANSI X12 and EDIFACT standards.
* Solid understanding of EDI production support processes, support structures, incident handling, SLA management, and ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
* Understanding of shared mailbox support, operational queues, and structured triage processes.
* Knowledge of enterprise application integration and production data flow dependencies.
* Experience analyzing and reporting transaction failures, file delivery failures, and data exchange issues.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and reasoning skills.
* Understanding of EDI transactions, B2B integrations, business process development, and mapping support.
* Working knowledge of ITX mapping concepts is preferred.

**Tools and Technology**

* IBM Sterling B2B Integrator Dashboard and production support features.
* Axway B2Bi and Lightwell B2B Framework.
* Oracle Database.
* SQL Developer.
* ServiceNow or similar ticketing tools.
* Experience with monitoring, reporting, and operational support tools in a production environment.

**Commitment**
This role requires commitment to support a team operating in a
**24x7 production environment**
, including
**early mornings, day shifts, night shifts, weekends, and holidays**
as part of a rotating schedule. The individual must be comfortable working in a high-availability support model and participating in major incident response when needed.
  
  
**Why Join This Role**
This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned EDI professional to take on a lead support role in a complex, high-impact healthcare integration environment. The role offers the chance to work across multiple EDI platforms, engage with global stakeholders, strengthen operational maturity, and contribute directly to the reliability of critical business transactions supporting the US market.
  
  
The three opening paragraphs repeat themes covered later—production support, incident handling, continuous improvement, and 24x7 coverage. title: HR Professional - Intern
description:
**Introduction**
As an
**HR Professional**
, you will contribute to delivering effective Human Resources solutions and support business and employee needs. You will work collaboratively with HR and business stakeholders to understand requirements, analyze information, support HR processes, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to develop broad HR expertise while leveraging data, technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve the employee and stakeholder experience.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
**Analytical Problem Solving :**

* Apply analytical thinking to understand HR-related issues and identify appropriate solutions with guidance when required.
* Analyze HR data and information to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support the preparation of reports, presentations, and analyses for HR and business stakeholders.
* Document and refine existing HR processes and workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify routine HR activities and improve the overall employee and stakeholder experience.
* Explore and support the use of automation, digital solutions, and AI-enabled tools to improve HR processes and productivity.

**Autonomy And Impact To The Organization**

* Take ownership of assigned HR activities and deliver outcomes within defined timelines.
* Work independently on routine activities while seeking guidance for complex or unfamiliar situations.
* Apply judgment and available information to recommend solutions and support decision-making.
* Contribute ideas and individual expertise toward team and organizational goals.
* Develop an understanding of IBM's business, industry, workforce, and HR practices.
* Participate in HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to business and employee outcomes.

**Skills And Collaboration**

* Collaborate effectively with HR colleagues, business stakeholders, employees, and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate clearly and professionally through written and verbal communication.
* Build positive working relationships through transparency, professionalism, and effective collaboration.
* Research HR practices and contribute ideas, insights, reports, and analyses to support team objectives.
* Demonstrate willingness to learn and develop professional HR expertise.
* Leverage collaboration, analytics, digital, and AI-driven technologies to enhance HR effectiveness.
* Support team members and contribute to knowledge sharing and a collaborative work environment.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
**Role 1 : HR Transformation Professional – Product Management**
As an HR Transformation Professional, you will play the role of a Product Manager for HR solutions, shaping digital products that impact employees across the organization.
  
  
You will work closely with business leaders, users, designers, and engineering teams to identify opportunities, define product requirements, prioritize features, and drive the product roadmap from concept to implementation. Leveraging data, AI, automation, and design thinking, you will solve complex workforce challenges and build scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.
  
  
This role is ideal for individuals passionate about product management, technology, innovation, and strategic problem-solving in HR.
  
  
**Role 2**
:
**HR Business Development Professional**
As an HR Business Development Professional, you will work on strategic business transformation initiatives including outsourcing, acquisitions, divestitures, and workforce integration programs. Partnering with clients, business leaders, and HR teams, you will help assess workforce impacts, develop people-focused solutions, manage transition activities, and support business deals from planning through execution. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy consulting, stakeholder engagement, project management, business analysis, and solving complex organizational challenges at the intersection of people and business strategy
  
  
This role is well-suited for candidates who are passionate about consulting, business transformation, M&A, organizational strategy, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Role 3: HR Compensation Professional**
As a Compensation Professional, you will help shape how IBM attracts, motivates, and retains talent through compensation, rewards, and recognition programs. Working with business leaders, HR, and Finance teams, you will leverage data, market insights, and analytics to evaluate pay practices, benchmark talent, support salary planning, and make evidence-based recommendations that align business goals with employee experience. This role involves data, solving complex business problems, influencing workforce decisions, and understanding how compensation strategy drives organizational success
  
  
Individuals who are interested in leveraging analytics, market intelligence, and business acumen to shape compensation strategies, support workforce decisions, and drive organizational performance through evidence-based insight
  
  
**Role 4 : AI Product Manager – HR Innovation Professional**
As an
**AI Product Manager - HR**
, you will help shape the future of work by designing and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform employee and HR experiences. Working at the intersection of business, technology, data, and automation, you will identify opportunities for innovation, define product requirements, and partner with cross-functional teams to build and scale digital workers, intelligent workflows, and AI-enabled products.
  
  
Individuals with a strong interest in product management, AI, emerging technologies, digital transformation, and data-driven problem solving, who aspire to build innovative solutions that create business impact at scale.
  
  
**Role 5 : HR- Talent Professional – Learning, Leadership & Skills**
As a Talent Professional in HR, you will help shape how IBM develops skills, leaders, and careers in an AI-enabled world. Working across learning, leadership development, skills, and career programs, you will use data, AI, design thinking, and workforce insights to create scalable solutions that help employees learn, grow, and succeed. You will contribute to talent initiatives, analyze workforce trends, build innovative employee experiences, and partner with stakeholders to solve future workforce challenges.
  
  
Role requires strong interest in talent development, learning, workforce skills, leadership, employee experience, and the application of AI and data to solve people and business challenges at scale
  
  
**Role 6 : HR Learning Consultant – Workforce Skills & Capability Development**
As a Learning Consultant, you will partner with business leaders to identify skill gaps and design learning solutions that build critical workforce capabilities. You will translate business priorities into targeted learning strategies, manage the delivery of large-scale upskilling and reskilling programs, and collaborate with global stakeholders to ensure employees have the skills needed for future success. This role combines stakeholder consulting, program management, workforce development, and learning strategy to drive business transformation through continuous learning.
  
  
Individuals with a strong interest in learning, workforce development, stakeholder consulting, program management, and skills transformation, who are motivated by creating large-scale impact through capability building and employee growth
  
  
**Critical Skills For Success**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Ability to learn new processes, technologies, and HR tools quickly.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated interest in Human Resources and business operations.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Up-to 1 year of industry work experience
* Experience in AI-related academic projects at the undergraduate and/or postgraduate level.
* Academic projects, internships, coursework, or other exposure to Human Resources or business-related activities.
* Exposure to data analysis, reporting, or process improvement.
* Familiarity with HR technology, digital tools, automation, or AI-enabled solutions.
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
* Strong learning agility, ownership mindset, and willingness to take on new challenges.

title: Lead Customer Success Engineer (UKG Ready)
description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Position Summary
  
  
The Lead Customer Success Engineer will serve as a senior technical advisor, product enablement leader, and customer intelligence partner for the India Customer Success organization. This role partners closely with CSMs to improve customer outcomes through technical guidance, product adoption strategies, scalable education, and data-driven risk identification.
  
  
A core focus of this role is helping CSMs confidently speak to the value of UKG products and newly released features. The Lead CSE will create practical enablement assets, demo experiences, talk tracks, and field-ready guidance that allow CSMs to connect capabilities to customer business outcomes in both 1:1 and 1:many settings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with CSMs to understand customer business objectives, technical challenges, adoption gaps, and opportunities to leverage UKG capabilities more effectively.
* Provide architecture and technical guidance across configuration, integrations, data models, APIs, security, governance, and product best practices.
* Lead technical discovery, solution reviews, adoption workshops, and customer-facing product discussions when Success Engineering support is required.
* Analyze customer health, Compass signals, adoption data, support trends, renewal information, and product usage indicators to identify accounts needing CSE attention.
* Translate data insights into clear recommendations for CSMs, including suggested outreach, product adoption plays, enablement opportunities, and risk mitigation actions.
* Mentor Senior Customer Success Engineers and help establish standards for technical assessments, product enablement, risk analysis, and reusable content.

Product Enablement & Content Creation Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the design and production of scalable product enablement for the CS organization, including short-form demo videos, feature walkthroughs, webinar decks, technical explainers, customer-ready talk tracks, and CSM coaching guides.
* Build demo libraries organized by product area, customer outcome, persona, and use case so CSMs can quickly show how UKG functionality supports business value.
* Translate new product releases into CS-ready enablement packages that explain what changed, why it matters, which customers benefit, how to position the value, and what CSMs should listen for in customer conversations.
* Host recurring enablement webinars, office hours, and product deep-dive sessions that help CSMs understand releases, adoption opportunities, common objections, and value-based messaging.
* Create CSM-facing value narratives that connect product capabilities to outcomes such as adoption, efficiency, compliance, employee experience, retention, payroll accuracy, workforce optimization, and operational scale.
* Package repeatable product adoption plays and success accelerators that CSMs can use in Success Plans, renewal preparation, risk mitigation, and customer business reviews.
* Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Support, Services, and Enablement to ensure CS teams receive timely, accurate, and practical product readiness content.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience implementing, consulting on, supporting, or advising customers on UKG products.
* Deep expertise in one or more UKG solution areas such as Pro, WFM, Ready, Talent, Payroll, Reporting, Integrations, or Security.
* Strong ability to connect product capability, technical design, customer goals, and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience creating demos, webinars, enablement materials, product guides, or technical content for customer-facing teams.
* Excellent facilitation and presentation skills with the ability to engage CSMs, customer executives, technical stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.
* Strong analytical skills and experience interpreting customer health, adoption, support, telemetry, or renewal signals.
* Experience with Gainsight, Compass, Power BI, Salesforce, SQL, telemetry, or customer intelligence tools preferred.

Success Measures
  
  

* CSMs can clearly articulate the value of UKG products and new features using consistent talk tracks and practical examples.
* Enablement assets are reusable, field-ready, and adopted by India CS and broader Customer Success teams.
* CSE recommendations help CSMs prioritize the right accounts, risks, and adoption opportunities.
* Product release readiness improves across CS through timely, relevant, outcome-oriented enablement.

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. The candidate must have strong knowledge of government tender documentation, preparation of technical and commercial bids, tender evaluation, compliance requirements, and online tender submission through various e-procurement portals.

* Manage online tender submission through Government e-procurement portals, GeM, PSU portals, and State Government tender portals.
* Ensure timely submission of tenders, clarifications, pre-bid queries, and other required documents.
* Participate in pre-bid meetings and coordinate with concerned departments for tender-related clarifications.
* Maintain a proper database of submitted tenders, tender status, bid results, and upcoming opportunities.
* Monitor tender amendments, corrigenda, deadlines, and other updates.
* Coordinate with concerned departments for post-tender activities, including technical clarifications, negotiations, and contract-related documentation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; technical qualification will be an added advantage.
* 8–10 years of proven experience in tender management, tender drafting, and government bidding.
* Must have excellent knowledge of tender preparation and drafting for PSUs and State Government Departments.
* Strong understanding of government procurement procedures, tender terms and conditions, and bid evaluation processes.
* Hands-on experience with GeM, CPPP, State Government e-procurement portals, and PSU tender portals.
* Excellent drafting, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and Word.
* Ability to independently manage multiple tenders and meet strict submission deadlines.
* High attention to detail, accuracy, and compliance.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in Railway, Metro, Electrical, Industrial, Infrastructure, or Engineering-related tenders will be preferred.
* Must be capable of independently handling the complete tendering process.
* Should have strong coordination skills and the ability to work with multiple departments.
* Candidates with practical experience in PSU and State Government tender drafting and submission will be given preference.

Salary & Benefits

Salary: ₹40,000 – ₹80,000 per month, depending on experience, expertise, and suitability.

* The salary will be finalized based on the candidate's knowledge, relevant experience, and ability to independently manage government and PSU tenders.

title: Associate Implementation Manager
description:
**About Global PayEX**

Global PayEX is a leading AI-powered FinTech SaaS company specializing in Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) automation. Our cloud-based platform helps businesses optimize working capital by automating invoice processing, payments, collections, reconciliation, and financial workflows. Leveraging advanced AI and machine learning, we enable organizations to improve cash flow, reduce manual effort, and enhance operational efficiency. Global PayEX serves enterprises, financial institutions, and mid-market businesses worldwide, partnering with leading banks and Fortune 500 companies to deliver intelligent finance automation solutions

**Role Overview**

As an Associate Implementation Manager, you will be at the center of how Global PayEX goes live with major bank and enterprise clients. You will work directly with client teams — CFO offices, treasury teams, and bank implementation leads — to configure, deploy, and onboard our AR/AP automation platform. This is not a coding role. It is a client-facing, problem-solving, project ownership role for someone who understands technology well enough to bridge the gap between engineering and the business. If you are someone who loves working with enterprise clients, can manage a project timeline, and wants to see how technology transforms financial operations at scale — this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Solutioning**

• Run product demos for corporate finance teams, treasury heads, and CFOs.

• Understand each prospect's accounts-receivable process, ERP landscape, and pain points; translate these into a tailored solution narrative.

• Prepare pre-call briefs, solutioning notes, objection-handling material, and follow-up communication for internal stakeholders and clients.

• Support the pipeline by qualifying prospects, contributing to sales collateral and audits, and moving accounts through the funnel.

• Represent the product with credibility in front of senior finance stakeholders.

**Implementation & Delivery**

● Lead end-to-end onboarding of enterprise clients onto the Global PayEX platform, working with bank partners and corporate treasury teams.

● Coordinate between client stakeholders, internal product teams, and technical teams to ensure smooth go-lives.

● Configure and test platform workflows based on client-specific requirements.

● Prepare implementation plans, training materials, and status reports for client and internal stakeholders. ● Identify and resolve implementation blockers quickly, escalating where needed.

● Build trusted relationships with client contacts throughout the implementation lifecycle.

● Support continuous improvement of our implementation playbooks and documentation.

**Operations, Onboarding & Adoption**

• Work with the Operations team on end-user onboarding once a client is live.

• Design and run training programs, adoption campaigns, and refresher sessions for the client's finance users and their downstream users.

• Monitor throughput and adoption metrics for your accounts; identify drop-offs and act on them. • Own the client relationship post go-live for at least the stabilisation period.

**What We're Looking For**

● 1–2 years of full-time work experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or a finance/treasury function within a corporate.

● Educational background in finance, commerce, or business (B.Com, BBA, BMS, MBA-Finance, CA Inter/CA, CFA L1+, or equivalent)

. ● Strong understanding of basic finance concepts — accounts receivable, invoicing, reconciliation, collections, working capital, DSO.

● Comfortable being client-facing: confident in demos, meetings, and presentations with senior finance stakeholders.

● Proactive by default — able to spot what needs doing next and drive it without being asked.

● Strong written and verbal communication in English.

● Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment.

● Familiarity with tools like Excel, JIRA, Claude, Confluence, or project management platforms is a plus.

Why Global PayEX

● JPMorgan-backed and JPMorgan channel-distributed — direct exposure to how Tier-1 banks adopt enterprise FinTech.

● Work with Fortune 500 clients from day one.

● Founded and led by a CMU alumnus — you will have direct access to senior leadership

. ● Competitive USD compensation with performance incentives.

● Real ownership from day one — this is not a support role.

**How to Apply Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to hr@globalpayex.com with the subject line: "Associate Implementation Manager | [Your Name]"**

title: R&D PDM Associate - Self Care
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Research & Development
  
  
In Research and Development, we're full of highly skilled talents that include Scientists, Engineers, Medical, Clinical and Regulatory professionals - all working to create a cleaner, healthier world. With nine Centres of Excellence, we continually seek out new opportunities by using science, our entrepreneurial flare and our fearless innovation to develop and enhance our existing portfolio, never compromising on quality or performance.
  
  
We do the right thing, always, by ensuring we act with responsibility and integrity, by complying with regulatory legislation across the globe, whilst ensuring our products are safe for our consumers and are to the highest quality.
  
  
The size of our organisation means you'll have the opportunity to learn and work in different functions within R&D, giving you exposure to different disciplines, teams and environments. You will also have access to our Research and Development Academy, designed to develop our team and allow you to grow in our great organisation.
  
  
**About The Role**
The role is ideal for a high-calibre individual with the necessary skill set to manage hands on scientific and technical issues on a range of products and projects primarily focussed on a challenging and complex base business resiliency plan to sustain future growth, primarily, the Self-care product portfolio.
  
  
This diverse role is to collaborate with R&D product development teams, other R&D PDM teams, Regulatory, Marketing, Supply and Production groups to deliver “best in market” consumer solutions.
  
  
Role will be accountable for providing R&D support to a designated range of Reckitt products, enabling revenue protection, revenue growth and compliance of the brands
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Responsible for all R&D technical activities, compliance programme and supply resiliency projects on Selfcare brands
* Support Supply for manufacturing, procurement, or packaging projects, to implement effective technical solutions and solving issues in manufacturing process including safety & sustainability objectives/compliance.
* Responsibility for ensuring all required formulation, feasibility work, analysis, validation, stability testing, industrial trials and dossier preparation is performed on time and to the required standards.
* Accountable for the delivery and execution of the project work as per the timelines
* Accountable for the KPIs / delivery of project milestones and stage gates
* Responsible for project management & budget management for the Technical projects, in addition responsible for Lab set up and equipment maintenance in all time audit ready state.
* Responsible for Formulation assessment for the Self-care portfolio.
* Responsible for the Regulatory submissions, variations and response of RTQs by generating the relevant documents through applicable platforms.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Minimum of a good degree in a relevant scientific discipline (e.g. Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Biology, Biochemistry)
* Post graduate qualifications in further scientific disciplines would also be beneficial (i.e. PhD, or MSc, post-graduate diplomas (e.g. Pharmaceutical Quality by Design)
* Experience in project and stakeholder management
* Significant R&D experience with a proven track record of delivery.
* Experience of working in a Healthcare environment is desirable
* Working knowledge of CTD modules and regulatory frameworks
* Proven track record as a leader in planning, prioritization and implementing projects as well as identifying costs savings and problem solving
* Proven track record in active collaboration with R&D and non-R&D functions

The skills for success
  
  

* The candidate should be comfortable with ambiguity and be a ‘self-starter’ with the ability to quickly learn and implement to keep up with the fast pace of the role
* Technically diligent and able to grasp new science and visualise a business benefit
* Prioritisation and time management skills are essential
* Stakeholder collaboration, communication and the ability to manage expectations are also key
* Strong leadership, influencing, motivational and interpersonal skills.
* Capable of building strong working relationships and motivating teams to deliver outstanding results.
* Strong negotiating skills.
* Strong analytical and technical skills.
* Ability to anticipate, plan and realize significant projects involving multiple technical and scientific hurdles.
* Ability to perform solid thinking into action (a thinker and an achiever).
* Strong intellectual curiosity.
* Appetite for exploring new and previously uncharted territories.
* Openness to change and ability to think out of the box.
* The business language in Reckitt is English, therefore fluency in English is essential and fluency in local languages advantageous
* Flexible to travel, if required

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Lead, Capacity Building
description:
**Position Overview:**

The Senior Lead, Capacity Building owns how Room to Read India builds the capability of its people and partners to improve children's literacy learning outcomes. The person in this role will lead all literacy training across the organization and with government and partner systems: analyzing training needs at every level, designing role-specific training and materials, including virtual modules and courses, building competency frameworks that track individual learning over time, and measuring training impact jointly with the Research, Monitoring and Evaluation (RM&E) team, with improvement in Knowledge, Attitude and Practice (KAP) as the central measure. The Senior Lead also owns the quality standards that all literacy training must meet. This position will be based at the Country Office in New Delhi, report directly to the Senior Director, Programs, Lead one Officer, work closely with the IDTS team, and require frequent travel to project locations and regular interaction with state teams, education officials, partners and training agencies.

**About Instructional Design and Technical Support Team (IDTS):**
The team enables RtR's state units to enhance program implementation by improving the adoption of structured pedagogy resources, teacher and team professional development, and evidence-informed assessment in instruction. The team is in charge of content creation amidst a lot of academic rigor and field experiences. This team supports other teams by providing technical inputs at various levels including internal and external stakeholders. It also leads Room to Read India's work on INCO, an AI-powered literacy coaching app, ensuring the technology stays anchored in sound pedagogy and real classroom practice.

**Responsibilities:**

**Training Needs Analysis Across Levels:**

* Conduct periodic training needs analysis across all levels of the organization.
* Draw on program data, field observations, coaching and monitoring records, assessment results and consultations with Program and RM&E teams to identify capability gaps.
* Translate needs into a prioritized, role-specific capacity-building plan aligned to program calendars, hiring phases and project goals.

**Ownership of Literacy Training and Quality Standards:**

* Lead the end-to-end literacy training architecture: induction, technical training on literacy pedagogy and program models, data-use training and mid-course correction training.
* Sequence and coordinate training delivered by IDTS, other internal teams, external agencies and consultants, and oversee logistics, facilitators and batches across locations with Admin, Finance and Program teams.
* Oversee training for government and partner systems (such as SCERT, DIET and partner organizations) where Room to Read supports capacity building.
* Define and uphold quality standards for the design, delivery and follow-up of literacy training, observing sessions, reviewing facilitator performance and gathering participant feedback.
* Document lessons from each training cycle, feed them into the next one, and share learning and recommendations with Program, Technical and Leadership teams.

**Training Materials and Virtual Courses:**

* Lead the design of training modules, facilitator guides, participant materials and job aids for literacy projects, including materials that help teams understand and use program data and run mid-course correction training when data shows implementation or learning gaps.
* Design and manage a library of virtual training modules and courses for each role and level, with defined learning outcomes, duration, mode, content sequence, practice tasks and assessments.
* Develop course content such as short videos, interactive lessons, case studies, classroom practice clips and quizzes, in Hindi, English and other languages the program needs.
* Run a learning management system or equivalent platform with enrollment, completion tracking, certification and links to competency and Knowledge, Attitude and Practice (KAP) results, and plan virtual and blended delivery, including live online sessions, peer learning and offline or mobile-friendly formats for low-connectivity locations.
* Ensure all materials are linked to children's learning outcomes and reviewed with technical experts before roll-out; build and mentor a pool of internal facilitators and master trainers.

**Competency Frameworks and Learning Tracking:**

* Create a competency framework for each training area and role, with defined learning outcomes and observable indicators.
* Design assessments, observation tools and rubrics so that each individual's understanding and practice can be measured and tracked over time.
* Set minimum competency thresholds for trainees to begin contributing to the project as per role expectations, and define follow-up support (refreshers, coaching, reassessment) for trainees who have not met them.
* Maintain learning records and a training dashboard that show progress by individual, role, cohort and project.

**Training Impact Analysis with RM&E:**

* Jointly with RM&E, design and carry out evaluations of training impact, with KAP improvement as the central measure.
* Co-develop KAP baseline, post-training and follow-up tools, and agree sampling, timing and analysis methods with RM&E.
* Link training participation and competency results to changes in field practice, program quality indicators and, where possible, children's learning outcomes.
* Co-author findings and recommendations with RM&E, and use them to revise training design, content and delivery for subsequent cohorts.

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Sciences, Development Studies, Management or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in education or development programs, including substantial responsibility for training needs analysis and for planning and managing training across multiple cohorts, roles and locations.
* Experience designing training materials and competency frameworks, with assessments or observation tools that track individual learning over time.
* Experience measuring training effectiveness, including KAP assessments, and working with an M&E or research team to use findings for improvement.
* Strong understanding of literacy instruction and how adults and teachers learn; ability to link training to children's learning outcomes.
* Experience using program and learning data to diagnose implementation gaps and design corrective or refresher training.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Hindi and English.
* Willingness to travel frequently to project locations.

**Desirable:**

* Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in education, training, or learning and development.
* Experience in foundational literacy or large-scale government education programs, including work with systems such as SCERT and DIET.
* Experience with multilingual education, or with digital and AI-supported coaching and learning tools.
* Experience managing external training agencies, consultants or facilitators.

**Compensation:**

Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include a thirteenth-month bonus, health insurance, and a retirement plan. The non-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is changing and transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries on literacy and gender equality in education.

Read is a child-safe organization; all personnel must adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy.

Room to Read is an equal opportunity employer committed to identifying and developing the skills and leadership of people from diverse backgrounds.

title: Engineer, Pump Order Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Position Summary
  
  
Pentair is looking for an Engineer with strong experience in centrifugal pump engineering, product configuration BOM finalisation, SAP engineering documentation and CAD design. The role will focus on finalising accurate configuration BOMs for centrifugal pumps, including Vertical Turbine Pumps, Solids Handling Pumps etc. The candidate should have a sound understanding of pump assemblies, material of construction, product variants, accessories and manufacturing processes. In addition to BOM engineering responsibilities, the candidate will support CAD activities such as 3D modelling, assembly modelling, detailed drawings and design documentation.
  
  
The selected candidate will work closely with global engineering counterparts to ensure that pump configurations are technically correct, manufacturable, properly documented and ready for downstream business processes such as quotation, order engineering, procurement and production.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Pump Configuration BOM and SAP Engineering Documentation
* Finalize configuration BOMs for centrifugal pump product families such as Vertical Turbine Pumps, Solids Handling Pumps and other pump assemblies.
* Create, review and update engineering BOMs in SAP based on approved product structures, configuration rules, materials, design standards and project requirements.
* Support material creation, classification, and master data maintenance in SAP.
* Validate pump assemblies and sub-assemblies including pump components and accessories.
* Ensure correct material of construction and documentation based on application and product standards.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve BOM gaps, missing/incorrect parts and duplicate items.
* Support engineering change activities including part creation, BOM updates, drawing revisions.
* CAD Design and Engineering Support
* Create and update 3D models, assemblies and manufacturing drawings of centrifugal pump components and assemblies.
* Prepare detailed drawings with appropriate dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, surface finish and machining requirements.
* Perform assembly checks, fit-up reviews and tolerance stack-up reviews before releasing drawings or BOM updates.
* Support design standardization, VA/VE and product rationalization initiatives for pump platforms and configured products.
* Coordinate drawing corrections, model updates and engineering documentation changes with internal teams and global stakeholders.
* Manufacturing, Quality and Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Apply good understanding of manufacturing processes such as casting, machining, fabrication, welding and assembly while finalizing drawings and BOMs.
* Work with manufacturing and sourcing teams to ensure that BOM structures and drawings are aligned with practical manufacturing and procurement processes.
* Participate in technical discussions with overseas engineering teams through meetings, emails and design reviews.
* Document engineering decisions clearly and maintain traceability for BOM changes, drawing updates and configuration corrections.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E. / B.Tech. or M.E. / M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering or related streams.
* 2 to 6 years of relevant experience in centrifugal pump engineering, BOM engineering, product configuration, SAP engineering documentation and CAD design.
* Hands-on experience with centrifugal pump assemblies especially Vertical Turbine Pumps, Solids Handling Pumps, or similar rotating equipment will be preferred.
* Good experience in SAP for engineering BOM creation, BOM maintenance and part master data.
* Strong understanding of pump construction, assemblies, configurations and material of construction.
* Strong CAD experience in SolidWorks or equivalent software, assembly modelling and 2D manufacturing drawings.

Technical Skills
  
  
Skill Area Expected Capability
  
  
Pump Engineering Centrifugal pump assemblies, configuration options, pump components, MOC etc.
  
  
BOM and SAP Engineering BOM creation, review, clean-up, configuration BOM finalization etc.
  
  
CAD- 3D modelling, large assemblies and 2D drawings.
  
  
GD&T and Tolerance Application of GD&T, tolerance stack-up, fitment checks and manufacturing drawing quality.
  
  
Manufacturing Casting, machining, fabrication, welding, assembly, surface finish, inspection and DFM/DFA considerations.
  
  
Documentation Clear engineering documentation and communication with global teams.
  
  
**Other Requirements**

* Strong drawing reading and drawing interpretation skills.
* Good analytical ability to identify BOM gaps, configuration conflicts, drawing issues and manufacturing constraints.
* Good communication skills to work with internal teams, manufacturing locations and global engineering stakeholders.
* Ability to work with accuracy, ownership and attention to detail in data-sensitive engineering documentation activities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across BOM engineering, CAD updates, drawing releases etc.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in centrifugal pumps especially Vertical turbine pumps, solids handling pumps or rotating equipment.
* Exposure to order engineering, configured products, SAP workflow, product standardization.
* Experience working with global teams, manufacturing plants and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

title: IP Specialist / Senior Specialist / Principal Specialist - Patent Docketing
description:
Join a growing, dynamic, and innovative team that has established itself as the market leader in Intellectual Property management solutions. ANAQUA provides Intellectual Asset Management Software and Services to help companies and law firms improve their management of their IP portfolios to gain competitive advantage. A primarily web-based product, ANAQUA has over 20,000 users with an ever-growing client base, including global leaders such as Microsoft, The Coca-Cola Company, British American Tobacco, Diageo, and NXP Semiconductors.
  
  
With a combination of adaptive software, great people and a proven implementation methodology, Anaqua partners with its clients to build global capabilities that integrate workflows and web-based collaboration across the IP lifecycle. Anaqua is committed to 100% client satisfaction.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Anaqua is looking for a highly motivated and proactive Docketing expert with Patent & Trademark knowledge who is eager to help us to attain our continuing growth goals.
  
  
**You’ll Love This Job If You Like To**

* Responsible for all aspects of Patent docketing for both US and Non-US jurisdiction

* Ensuring correct bibliographic information is updated, generating correct reminders so that the paralegals/attorneys are timely informed about actions due

* Minimum 1.8 - 7 years of experience in the related role

* Prior experience of working on Anaqua/Pattsy Wave platform would be an added advantage
* Ability to prioritize and multi-task to perform role smoothly without missing deadlines
* Good written and verbal communication skills (English)
