title: Content Strategist
description:
**Specialist - Research & Thought Leadership Content**

**Location-**

Gurgaon, India (JTG HQ — Udyog Vihar, Phase 5) | Work from Office

**Reports To-**

Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy

**Employment Type-**

Full-time

**Experience-**

5–7 years in content, research, journalism, or communications in a B2B / tech domain

**About Josh Technology Group (JTG)**

Josh Technology Group is a 16+ year old product engineering company with 300+ engineers across 20+ countries. We de-risk technology for businesses through AI-accelerated, outcome-accountable delivery — not staff augmentation. We have delivered 100+ projects across Healthcare, EdTech/HR-Tech, FinTech, Transport, and Emerging Tech verticals, primarily for North American and European clients, with a client retention rate of over 90%.

As JTG invests in building its brand with PE/VC firms, enterprise buyers, and startup founders in Western markets, we are building an in-house thought leadership engine — grounded in real delivery experience and domain depth, not generic content.

 

**Role Overview**

Think of this role as an embedded journalist inside a technology company — except your stories build pipeline, not just readership.

The Research & Thought Leadership Lead will sit inside JTG’s business, attend leadership discussions, absorb what is happening across client engagements, industries, and the market — and turn those raw signals into published thought leadership that positions JTG and its leadership as credible, insightful voices in Healthcare, EdTech, and product engineering globally.

You will attend the weekly leadership meeting, listen for problem statements, delivery learnings, client challenges, and market observations — and then go away, research deeply, and come back with a crisp article, POV, or whitepaper that can be published in the name of JTG, Pod.AI, or one of its Co-Founders and Advisors. The best content will not read like a sales brochure — it will read like something a smart practitioner would actually want to read.

This role reports into the Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy, who will direct topics, align content with active commercial priorities, and review output before publication.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Embedded Research & Intelligence**

* Attend the weekly JTG leadership meeting as the designated content listener — capturing problem statements, delivery insights, client challenges, market observations, and strategic priorities as raw material for content.
* Conduct deep, independent research on the topics surfaced in leadership discussions — industry trends, regulatory developments, technology shifts, competitive dynamics, and real-world case evidence — to build a well-grounded point of view.
* Research target industries and verticals (Healthcare, EdTech/HR-Tech, FinTech, Tech GCC/IT-ITES) to develop a running knowledge base that informs content quality and relevance.
* Research potential client companies, PE/VC portfolio firms, and technology leaders that JTG targets commercially — understanding their business context to make content resonate with the right readers.
* Monitor the broader ecosystem — competitor content, industry publications, LinkedIn discourse, analyst reports — to ensure JTG’s content is differentiated, not derivative.

**Content Creation & Publishing**

* Write thought papers, articles, points of view, and opinion pieces grounded in JTG’s delivery experience and domain knowledge — to be published on JTG’s website, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Draft executive ghostwritten content — LinkedIn posts, long-form articles, op-eds, conference abstracts, and panel talking points — on behalf of JTG’s Co-Founders and Advisors, capturing their authentic voice.
* Maintain a content calendar in coordination with the Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy, ensuring a steady cadence of publishing (target: at least one substantive piece every 3–4 weeks) aligned to commercial priorities.
* Convert client engagement learnings and anonymised case study insights into externally shareable content without breaching confidentiality.
* Write in multiple formats and lengths as the need arises — a 300-word LinkedIn post, a 1,500-word industry article, or a 4,000-word whitepaper — with equal comfort.
* Ensure all published content passes a simple test: would a PE partner, a startup CTO, or an enterprise technology buyer find this genuinely useful? If not, rewrite.

**Collaboration & Feedback Loop**

* Work closely with the Senior Specialist – Sales & Strategy to align content themes with live deals and target account strategies — the right article at the right time can open a door that a cold email cannot.
* Coordinate with JTG Co-Founders and Advisors to gather quotes, POVs, and authentic leadership perspectives that elevate content quality.
* Track content performance (LinkedIn engagement, website traffic, inbound leads attributed to content) and share insights to continuously improve topic selection and format.
* Maintain a well-organised content repository — drafts, published pieces, research notes — that can be referenced and repurposed across the team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in content writing, research, journalism, or communications — with meaningful B2B technology exposure.
* Exceptional command of written English — the ability to write with clarity, precision, and a distinct voice across formats and audiences. This is the single most important skill for this role.
* Strong storytelling instinct: the ability to take a dry technical or business topic and turn it into something genuinely compelling to read.
* Solid research skills — comfortable synthesising information from analyst reports, industry publications, academic papers, and primary conversations into a coherent, well-evidenced point of view.
* Good working knowledge of the technology and product engineering landscape — enough to write credibly about AI adoption, legacy modernisation, cloud engineering, Healthcare tech, or EdTech platforms without needing everything explained.
* Experience producing content for B2B audiences — particularly senior corporate, investor, or founder readership.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where content priorities can shift based on what is happening in the business that week.
* Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills — able to extract insights from leadership conversations and translate them into publishable content.
* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in English, Journalism, Communications, or a related field. MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Prior experience in a B2B technology company’s content/communications function, a tech-focused publication, or a management consulting firm’s knowledge/content team.
* A portfolio of published articles, whitepapers, or thought leadership pieces in tech, business, or policy domains.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn as a B2B content platform — understanding of what performs and why.
* Knowledge of Healthcare technology, EdTech, FinTech, or the Indian IT/GCC market.
* Experience writing ghostwritten executive content (LinkedIn posts, op-eds, keynote scripts).
* Familiarity with SEO basics and content optimisation for online publishing.

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A published cadence of high-quality thought leadership — at least one substantive article or whitepaper every 3–4 weeks — consistently building JTG’s and its leadership’s visibility on LinkedIn and the JTG website.
* Content that is visibly aligned to commercial priorities — at least one piece directly contributes to opening a sales conversation or supporting an active deal.
* The Co-Founders and key Advisors have an active, credible LinkedIn presence powered by content this person creates.
* A well-maintained research and content library that the wider Sales & Strategy team draws on regularly.
* Feedback from the Senior Specialist and Co-Founders that the content reads like a practitioner wrote it— not a marketer.

title: Consultant - Smart Cities
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
We are looking for a Smart Cities Consultant who can focus on details and see the big picture. You will be joining a team who is delivering digital transformation in cities, regions and developments, supporting Clients on major projects globally across multiple sectors. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team in a rapidly growing market, realize real change and contribute to revolutionary change on a city scale.
  
  
As a Smart Cities Consultant, you will be tasked with working across the Smart City project lifecycle, from the analysis of qualities of place, to the identification and design of smart services, to planning for and driving their implementation. A successful candidate will be able to evidence an excellent capability in applying advanced techniques such as user-centric design on real-life problems as well as presenting outputs in visual forms, infographics and/or dashboards. You will need to collaboratively engage with engineers, urban designers, city stakeholders and industry professionals to develop solutions and agree outputs
  
  
You will be responsible for building your personal brand and developing relationships internally and with clients to help us share knowledge and deliver best practice, you will also be called upon to help colleagues develop their digital awareness, sharing their own knowledge to help others.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Assess the qualities, needs, and opportunities of cities, regions, developments, and communities.
* Develop City/Infrastructure based digital strategies and identify services that can create value for stakeholders.
* Support the planning, design, and implementation of smart city services and digital infrastructure.
* Apply user centered design and advanced techniques to real world challenges.
* Present findings and recommendations through clear written outputs, visualisations, infographics, or dashboards.
* Collaborate with engineers, urban designers, planners, clients, city stakeholders, and industry professionals.
* Build client and internal relationships, share knowledge, and contribute to good practice and digital awareness.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Degree qualified
* Experience delivering strategies and projects for cities, regions, developments, and communities to help harness the potential of digital technologies.
* Experience of working with national or local government bodies and/or with property and infrastructure companies
* Analytical and Numerical skills are a strong advantage
* Expertise in both relevant technologies (such as 4G/5G communications, IoT, big data/analytics) and their business, social and economic impact
* Excellent communication, including both oral and written English
* Experience working in multi-disciplinary teams
* Experience and knowledge of digital master planning and related themes such as sustainability and climate change
* Experience working with planners, urban designers, and other built environment design disciplines
* Experience of networking and ability to build client relationships

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:

We are seeking an experienced Techno commercial Manager specializing in utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with 10 + years of expertise in project development, technology selection, techno commercial analysis, System/Plant configuration, System/Plant and Balance of system/Plant optimisation, bid preparation, and financial closing for large grid scale BESS + PV Solar energy projects. * Work cross-collaboratively with Project Development team to coordinate bid packages.
* Lead the BESS technology selection (e.g., lithium-ion, sodium-ion, flow batteries) and PV technology selection based on based on project-specific requirements, cost, and operational considerations. life cycle costing and techno commercial analysis including Sizing, design technical cum operational requirements and specification of the PV Plant and BESS system and Balance of Plant and Systems including the PCS , LV/MV. HV Electrical systems and SCADA and Energy management system.
* Responsible for the Power System studies and integration of the BESS system to run alongside the PV Plant and the grid including frequency regulation & response, peak saving, voltage regulation, primary and secondary response, harmonics, short circuit current and droop characteristics in compliance with grid code and renewable integration.
* Lead the develop battery container layouts and coordinate with electrical, civil, Solar and wind experts for complete packages to meet client needs.
* Responsible for the sizing and design of PV Plant including the selection of module, tracker and PCS and HV electrical systems
* Lead & access the third-party measurement campaign (met mast, LIDAR etc) and Solar resource assessments Energy Yield assessments for technology analysis and selection
* Responsible for the performance and technical drawings and documents.

* Responsible for the technical compliances to the international standards and Codes, certifications, local regulations, environmental regulation and ESIA
* Lead Modelling energy storage system performance, coordinate, obtain and integrate BMS, EMS and SCADA designs for the battery system from third party monitoring companies.

* 10+ years of experience in utility-scale project development, with a focus on PV, BESS and integration.
* Strong technical expertise of PV and BESS technology design principles, battery technology evaluation, system sizing, and performance optimization, degradation, augmentation and safety aspects.

* Proficiency with system modeling and simulation tools for BESS and PV (e.g., ETAP, HOMER, PVSyst)

* Previous experience with similar developers and projects in Middle East and North Africa preferred.

title: Senior UAT & Rollout Governance Specialist - SAP S/4HANA
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
You start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
In short, we are looking for a professional who can independently coordinate stakeholders, drive delivery follow-ups, identify risks and dependencies, and provide program-level visibility across multiple rollout workstreams, rather than primarily performing administrative project support.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience, including relevant experience in IT project/program coordination, enterprise transformation, rollout management, or testing governance.
* Proven experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing activities, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple projects or rollout workstreams.
* Strong capabilities in project governance and performance management, including status reporting, KPI tracking, risk and dependency management, and proactive escalation of delivery issues.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, drive follow-ups, resolve coordination gaps, and ensure timely completion of agreed actions.
* Experience coordinating internal IT and business stakeholders, project managers, and external IT service delivery partners in a complex enterprise environment.
* Understanding of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test planning, testing governance, and rollout delivery processes. Experience with SAP/S/4HANA implementations or rollouts is an advantage.
* Knowledge of IT operations, enterprise IT systems, service management structures, and service delivery performance frameworks.
* Ability to consolidate information from multiple workstreams, identify delivery risks and performance gaps, and provide clear, structured reporting to support decision-making.
* Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work proactively in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Business-fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners

**ERM**

title: Founder's Office - Operations Lead
description:
Founder's Office – Operations Lead

Location: Noida (on-site, 6 days a week) · Experience: 5–8 years · Reports to: CEO / Founders

**The role:**

SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Lead in the Founder's Office. You will work directly with the founders to find the problems that slow our business down, design practical solutions, and put them into practice on the ground, across a mapping operation of 120+ cartographers serving customers in the US and Canada.

This is not an advisory role. You will spot a problem in the data or on the floor, work out the fix, get Team Leads, Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Sales behind it, roll it out, and prove with numbers that it worked. Then you will move to the next one.

This role suits someone who thinks like a problem-solver, executes like an operator, and knows how to bring people along through change.

About SiteRecon

SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech.

Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

**What you'll do:**

Find the problems that matter

* Dig into operations data, customer escalations and floor-level workflows to find what is hurting delivery, quality, cost or customer experience.
* Separate symptoms from root causes, size each problem by business impact, and agree priorities with the founders.
* Track the metrics that show where operations are slipping: productivity, TAT, SLA adherence, rework, backlog and capacity.

**Design and implement solutions**

* Turn each problem into a clear solution with an owner, a plan, a timeline and a success metric.
* Pilot changes with one team or shift, measure the results, and scale what works across the operation.
* Redesign SOPs, quality checks, workflows and team structures where needed, and make sure they hold on the floor after launch.

**Lead technology and process change**

* Work with Product and Engineering to define tool and workflow improvements for mapping and QA, and own their rollout to the floor.
* Identify manual, repetitive work that can be automated or simplified, and drive it through to implementation.
* Make sure operations can absorb significant growth in volume without the same growth in headcount or complexity.

**Drive change management**

* Win buy-in from Team Leads, QA Supervisors and cartographers for new ways of working, and handle resistance with clarity and patience.
* Plan communication, training and handholding for every change so adoption sticks across shifts.
* Align Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on changes that affect customers, delivery timelines or capacity.

**Track and report improvements**

* Build a simple tracker of every initiative: baseline, target, current result and owner.
* Set up daily, weekly and monthly dashboards that show the impact of changes on operational KPIs.
* Run regular reviews with the founders on what has improved, what has stalled, and what comes next.

Support the founders

* Take on high-priority operational projects directly from the founders, from capacity planning for a large new customer to setting up a new team or process.
* Act as the bridge between the founders' priorities and day-to-day execution on the floor.

**You must have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in operations excellence, process improvement, business transformation, founder's office or strategy-to-execution roles.
* Hands-on exposure to large, metrics-driven operations, such as GIS or mapping, data annotation, KPO, BPO or digital operations.
* A track record of finding a business problem, designing the solution and implementing it yourself, with measurable results you can show.
* Experience leading a technology or tool rollout with Product or Engineering teams and getting it adopted by the people who use it.
* Strong change-management and people skills. You can influence Team Leads and floor teams without direct authority.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You build your own analysis, trackers and dashboards.
* Clear, structured communication with founders, cross-functional teams and frontline staff.

**Good to have**

* Lean, Six Sigma or similar continuous-improvement training.
* Experience at a startup, SaaS or product company.

title: Sr Principal Product Engineer

description:

**Role Description**
Camera Calibration Engineer responsible for developing and implementing algorithms to accurately calibrate camera systems for optimal image quality and geometric precision.

the payload.

**About Pixxel**
Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5-meter resolution and 135+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.
  
  
Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI-powered analytics.
  
  
Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high-frequency imagery with AI-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.
  
  
Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.
  
  
Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.
  
  
For more information, see our Careers page or follow Pixxel on LinkedIn and X/Twitter.

Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.
  
  
Central to our employee-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well-being and growth in all aspects of life

title: Senior Engineer - Testing & Certification
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O&M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Wind Turbine Generator (WTG)**
**:**
Adani Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) is a leading player in the renewable energy sector, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and installation of high-performance wind turbine systems. With a commitment to sustainability, Adani WTGs deliver efficient and reliable energy solutions, contributing to clean power generation across global markets.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Performance Management Engineer is responsible for analyzing wind turbine operational data to identify areas for performance improvement. This role uses advanced data analytics tools to assess turbine efficiency, power output, and reliability, conducting root cause analysis on performance deviations and implementing corrective actions. The Engineer participates in testing and validation of performance enhancements, such as control system updates and aerodynamic optimizations, and manages SCADA systems to ensure accurate data collection and monitoring. This role also involves supporting predictive maintenance initiatives by analyzing condition-based data and implementing maintenance strategies that reduce downtime. The Performance Management Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals and contributes to continuous improvement by proposing new methodologies and tools to optimize turbine performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring**

* Analyze operational data from wind turbines to assess performance against expected benchmarks, including power output, efficiency, and availability.
* Use advanced data analytics software (e.g., MATLAB, Python, R) to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement in turbine performance.

**Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Conduct performance optimization studies, focusing on areas such as blade aerodynamics, control system tuning, and power curve adjustments.
* Assist in troubleshooting performance issues on-site, using diagnostic tools to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective measures.

**Testing and Validation of Performance Improvements**

* Participate in the testing and validation of performance enhancement initiatives, including prototype testing and field trials.
* Collect and analyze test data to validate improvements, providing feedback to engineering teams for further refinement.

**SCADA and Data Acquisition System Management**

* Manage SCADA systems and other data acquisition tools, ensuring accurate and reliable data collection for performance analysis.
* Set up alarms, thresholds, and monitoring parameters to track key performance indicators in real-time.

**Predictive Maintenance and Condition Monitoring**

* Implement predictive maintenance strategies using data analytics to forecast potential failures and schedule proactive maintenance.
* Monitor condition-based data, such as vibration and temperature readings, to detect early signs of component wear and prevent performance drops.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain detailed records of performance analysis, tests conducted, and optimization measures implemented.
* Prepare performance reports, highlighting key findings, improvement opportunities, and corrective actions taken.

**Compliance with Standards and Procedures**

* Ensure all performance management activities comply with relevant industry standards and internal procedures, maintaining high data integrity and accuracy.
* Support the preparation of compliance documentation for certification and audits.

**Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with product improvement, R&D, and operations teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals.
* Provide technical support and performance insights during the design and testing phases of new turbine components.

**Training and Continuous Learning**

* Engage in continuous learning and professional development to stay updated on the latest performance optimization techniques and tools.
* Participate in internal training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance skills and contribute to team development.

**Adherence to Ethical Standards**

* Adhere to organizational ethical standards in data handling, analysis, and reporting, ensuring transparency and objectivity in performance assessments.
* Participate in training on corporate policies, ethics, and compliance to uphold high professional standards.

**Key Stakeholders - Internal**

* Lead - Performance Management
* QA Teams
* Manufacturing Teams

**Key Stakeholders - External**

* Performance Monitoring Equipment Vendors
* Data Analytics Consultants

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background:**

* BE in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.

**Work Experience**

* 5+ years in performance analysis and optimization, focusing on operational data, efficiency improvements, and maintenance strategy development.

**Industry Knowledge**

* Proficient in data analytics, SCADA data interpretation, and applying continuous improvement methodologies to enhance turbine performance.

title: Director - SLED Proposals & Pursuit Excellence
description:
**What Are We Looking For**
We are not looking for someone whose idea of proposal leadership is reviewing documents after everyone else has finished writing them. We are looking for a builder, problem solver and owner. The right person will see an ambiguous RFP, a fragmented team and an aggressive deadline and instinctively create structure around it. They will ask the difficult questions early, push teams to make decisions, challenge weak assumptions, refuse to submit mediocre work and take personal ownership of the quality of every major pursuit. This person should be comfortable recommending a No-Bid when the facts do not support pursuit, and equally comfortable mobilizing a cross-functional team when Dash decides to compete.
  
  
Pursuit Leadership & Win Strategy
  
  

* Own the proposal lifecycle from qualified opportunity through final submission, clarification, oral presentation and post-award handoff.
* Lead structured Bid/No-Bid decisions based on strategic fit, contract access, customer knowledge, incumbent position, competition, past performance, technical capability, delivery feasibility, economics and probability of win.
* Establish win themes, differentiators, competitive positioning and evaluator-focused response strategies.
* Challenge teams when the solution, evidence or value proposition is not strong enough to win.
* Participate in strategic capture planning for high-value pursuits before RFP release.

Proposal Governance
  
  

* Establish and enforce a repeatable Dash proposal methodology covering kickoff, compliance matrix, proposal outline, writing assignments, solution reviews, executive reviews, production and submission.
* Run a daily or near-daily pursuit war room covering pipeline, active capture, proposal status, risks, dependencies and next actions.
* Ensure every submission is compliant, responsive, persuasive and delivered on time.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation paths so issues are identified early rather than discovered near the deadline.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead the Capture, Proposal Development and Technical Bid/Solution functions in India.
* Coach proposal writers and capture professionals to become stronger strategic contributors rather than task executors.
* Set quality standards and provide direct editorial and strategic feedback.
* Build a culture where people take ownership, communicate risks early and solve problems rather than simply escalating them.

Content & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Develop and govern Dash's reusable public-sector proposal content library.
* Maintain high-quality reusable content for corporate qualifications, technical capabilities, management approaches, transition, staffing, past performance, resumes, security, quality, cloud, data, AI and application modernization.
* Create templates, checklists, review criteria and pursuit playbooks; retire outdated or weak content.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Work closely with U.S. business development, account leaders, solution architects, delivery leaders, finance, legal/compliance, recruiting and executive leadership.
* Convert SME input into a cohesive customer-facing story and hold owners accountable for timely inputs.
* Support oral presentations, demonstrations, clarification responses and negotiations when required.

Continuous Improvement & Metrics
  
  

* Track opportunities reviewed, go decisions, submissions, compliance defects, shortlist/interview rate, awards, win rate, cycle time and reasons for loss.
* Conduct structured win/loss reviews and convert lessons learned into process improvements.
* Identify responsible uses of AI and proposal technology to improve research, content reuse, compliance checking and productivity without compromising confidentiality or accuracy.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in proposals, bids, capture, presales or government contracting.
* Significant direct experience supporting U.S. government opportunities; strong SLED experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex IT services or professional-services proposals.
* Strong understanding of RFP/RFQ/RFI requirements, compliance matrices, evaluation criteria and public-sector procurement processes.
* Exceptional written and spoken business English and strong executive-level editing skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams under aggressive deadlines and challenging senior stakeholders constructively.
* Experience developing proposal processes, templates, content libraries and quality standards.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* APMP certification or meaningful Shipley-style proposal/capture experience.
* Experience with IT services, application development, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, staffing or digital transformation.
* Experience with U.S. state contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, MSP/VMS programs or large government IDIQ-style vehicles.
* Experience managing an India-based proposal/capture team supporting U.S. operations.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Takes ownership even when the problem technically belongs to someone else.
* Hates surprises and surfaces issues before they become emergencies.
* Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Can be demanding without becoming difficult to work with.
* Cares deeply about winning but is disciplined enough to recommend a No-Bid.
* Asks how the team can make the process better after both wins and losses.
* Does not need constant supervision or detailed instructions.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first six months, this leader should have established a predictable capture-to-submission operating model, clear pursuit gates, reusable proposal assets, consistent review practices and measurable visibility into why Dash is winning or losing government pursuits.

title: Senior Technical Expert – Control Valve Engineering
description:
**Are you a highly motivated, creative individual and passionate about Control Valve Application?**
**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**
  
  
**Join our team!**
  
  
The Control Valve Application Expert serves as the highest-level technical authority for control valve application, sizing, selection, process optimization. This role provides global technical leadership, supports strategic customer opportunities, drives application excellence, and mentors engineering teams while ensuring compliance with industry standards and customer specifications.
  
  
With over 12+ years of experience, the individual is recognized as a subject matter expert in control valve technologies, severe service applications, process control. The role collaborates closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, EPCs, End Users, and Field Services organizations to deliver optimal valve solutions that improve customer performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**As a Control Valve Expert, you will be responsible for:**
Application Engineering Excellence
  
  
  

* Review and approve critical control valve sizing and selection calculations.
* Troubleshoot challenging customer applications and provide mitigation recommendations.
* Validate compliance with IEC 60534, ISA standards, ASME B16.34, API requirements, PED, SIL, NACE, and customer specifications.
* Support digital tools, sizing software, configuration platforms, and automation initiatives.
* Act as technical advisor for strategic projects, EPC engagements, and major customer opportunities.
* Provides technical expertise and develops technical solutions (configuration, performance estimation, economics, etc.) as part of the pre-ITO process while interfacing with the commercial team and implement in sizing and selection software’s.
* Possesses a deep understanding of relevant markets and customer economic value that aid winning bid strategies. To include 'ITO': Technical analysis of client needs, Definition and optimization of the products, scope (description), schedule, industrial scheme, cost, considering contract and internal policies and procedures
* Maintaining awareness of competitive control valve technology and application engineering philosophies

Product & Technology Engineering
  
  
  

* Collaborate with Product Management and R&D teams to identify emerging application requirements.
* Drive innovation in control valve technology, severe service solutions, smart instrumentation, and sustainability initiatives.
* Lead lessons-learned and field feedback integration into product improvements.

Technical Leadership
  
  
  

* Serve as the global technical authority for control valve applications across process industries including Oil & Gas, LNG, Power, Petrochemicals, Chemicals, Hydrogen, and Industrial Processes. Lead complex application reviews involving severe service conditions such as high-pressure drops, flashing, cavitation, erosion, noise, and multiphase flow.
* Provide technical guidance on valve sizing, actuator sizing, trim selection, materials selection, and control strategies.
* Develop and maintain application engineering standards, best practices, and design guidelines.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or related field.
* Master's Degree preferred.
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in Control Valve Application Engineering, Product Engineering, Process Engineering, or Valve Technology.
* Demonstrated expertise in severe service and critical control applications.
* Strong understanding of process control systems and plant operations.

Technical Expertise
  
  
  

* Control valve sizing per IEC 60534 / ISA standards.
* Cavitation, flashing, erosion, and noise prediction.
* Severe service trim technologies.
* Pressure management and process control.
* Actuator sizing and selection.
* Materials engineering and corrosion management.
* ASME B16.34, API, NACE, PED, SIL, IEC, ISA standards.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Control Valve OEMs
* EPC organizations
* Oil & Gas operators
* LNG facilities
* Power generation plants
* Petrochemical and refinery operations

**Fuel your passion!**
  
  
To be successful in this role you will have:
  
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or related field.
* Master's Degree preferred.
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in Control Valve Engineering.
* Demonstrated expertise in severe service and critical control applications.
* Strong understanding of process control systems and plant operations.

**Work in a way that works for you**
  
  
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

title: Automation Engineer (FSE)
description:
bout Us

Mindox Techno is a leading provider of advanced, cutting-edge semiconductor process tools and platform solutions, including EFEM, End Effectors, and Loadports. We specialize in engineering software solutions and automation, and offer global engineering resources through our Global Capability Center. Serving the semiconductor industry, we deliver innovative solutions that drive efficiency and support the growth of our clients worldwide

At Mindox Techno, we believe in fostering a collaborative and inclusive work culture where our employees can thrive and grow while contributing to impactful, industry-leading projects.

Join us and be part of a company that is shaping the future of semiconductor technology.

Position Overview

The Automation Field Service Engineer is responsible for the on-site installation, maintenance, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment and precision systems. You will serve as the primary technical link between Mindox Techno and our global client base. This role demands a high level of technical autonomy, as you will be required to troubleshoot sophisticated electromechanical systems, vacuum technologies, and software interfaces in high-pressure cleanroom environments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Onsite Installation & Commissioning

* Deployment: Lead the physical installation and setup of Mindox systems at customer facilities, ensuring all utilities and environmental conditions meet technical specifications.
* Site Acceptance Testing (SAT): Execute rigorous testing protocols to verify that the equipment performs to "Copy Exact" standards before final hand-off to the customer.
* User Training: Conduct on-site technical briefings and operational training for customer engineers and machine operators.

2. Preventive & Corrective Maintenance

* Diagnostic Troubleshooting: Utilize advanced diagnostic tools and software to identify root causes of system failures, including mechanical wear, electrical faults, or software bugs.
* Emergency Response: Provide rapid-response on-site support to minimize customer downtime, often working under strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Scheduled Calibration: Perform routine preventive maintenance and precision calibrations to ensure equipment longevity and process repeatability.

3. Technical Reporting & "Copy Exact" Compliance

* Incident Documentation: Maintain meticulous service logs, detailing parts replaced, calibration data, and troubleshooting steps taken.
* Feedback Loop: Provide critical "Field Intelligence" to the R&D and Manufacturing teams regarding recurring issues or potential design improvements (Design for Serviceability).
* Inventory Management: Manage an assigned "Trunk Stock" of critical spare parts, ensuring all components used are tracked and replenished according to QMS standards.

4. Relationship Management

* Technical Advocacy: Act as a trusted advisor to customer maintenance teams, providing expert guidance on equipment optimization.
* Commercial Support: Identify and report opportunities for service contract renewals, spare part sales, or equipment upgrades to the Sales team.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in field service, ideally within the semiconductor (front-end or back-end) or medical device industry.
* Technical Mastery:
* Systems Knowledge: Strong proficiency in PLC logic, robotics, vacuum systems, and high-voltage electronics.
* Tools: Expert use of oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and precision alignment tools.
* Environment: Comfortable working in Class 10/100/1000 Cleanrooms and adhering to strict PPE protocols.
* Core Competencies:
* Problem Solving: Ability to stay calm and methodical when troubleshooting "Machine Down" situations.
* Mobility: Willingness to travel (up to 70%) to regional and international customer sites, often on short notice.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written English for technical reporting and customer interaction.

Why Work at Mindox Techno?

* Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge semiconductor technologies and engineering solutions.
* Global Exposure: Collaborate with industry experts and clients around the world.
* Career Growth: Opportunities for personal and professional development in a fast-growing, dynamic field.
* Inclusive Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive team that values diversity and creativity.
* Competitive Benefits: Comprehensive health benefits, paid time off, and other employee perks.

Mindox Techno is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and it takes a variety of minds to make our technology exceptional. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, and our employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other aspect of diversity.

title: RC-Risk Management-ERM-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY –Risk Consulting – Senior Consultant, Enterprise Risk Management**
As part of Risk Consulting, you will support and deliver client engagements focused on Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), risk governance and GRC transformation across the MENA region. You will work with clients across sectors and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop practical, sustainable and technology-enabled risk management solutions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a motivated professional with sound experience in Enterprise Risk Management to join our Risk Management team. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-quality risk advisory engagements, strengthen your consulting capabilities and help clients improve risk-informed decision-making, resilience and governance. The position will be based in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
  
  
Working in our practice, you will gain experience across ERM frameworks, risk assessments, risk appetite, key risk indicators, risk reporting, risk culture and GRC solutions in varied industries and operating environments.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As part of the role, you will:
  
  

* Support and deliver ERM, risk governance and GRC advisory engagements under the guidance of engagement managers.
* Assist in the design, implementation and enhancement of ERM frameworks aligned with recognised standards such as ISO 31000 and COSO ERM.
* Plan and facilitate risk interviews, workshops and assessment sessions with business and functional stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain risk taxonomies, enterprise and functional risk registers, risk appetite metrics, tolerance thresholds and key risk indicators.
* Perform risk analysis, including inherent and residual risk assessment, control evaluation, risk prioritisation and action tracking.
* Prepare management and Board-level risk reports, dashboards, heat maps and presentations that communicate key risk insights and trends.
* Research and assess strategic, operational, financial, technology, cyber, regulatory, third-party, sustainability and emerging risks.
* Support reviews of risk governance structures, committee arrangements, policies and alignment with the three-lines model.
* Conduct risk maturity assessments, benchmarking and gap analyses, and develop practical recommendations and improvement roadmaps.
* Support GRC requirements gathering, process design, data preparation, testing and implementation activities.
* Contribute to operational resilience, business continuity and crisis risk management assignments, where relevant.
* Manage assigned workstreams, monitor progress and ensure high-quality deliverables are completed within agreed scope and timelines.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders, document meetings and workshops, and follow through on information requests and agreed actions.
* Review the work of junior team members and support their coaching and development.
* Contribute to proposals, credentials, thought leadership, methodologies and other business development initiatives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good understanding of ERM frameworks, risk governance, risk appetite, KRIs, risk reporting and the three-lines model.
* Ability to analyse qualitative and quantitative information and convert findings into clear, practical recommendations.
* Strong report writing, presentation, workshop facilitation and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Effective project coordination skills, with the ability to manage assigned workstreams and multiple priorities within tight deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Attention to detail, professional scepticism and a commitment to quality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with data analytics, Power BI or GRC platforms would be advantageous.
* Knowledge of regulatory environments and risk practices across the MENA region would be advantageous.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or a related discipline.
* A minimum of four years of relevant experience in Enterprise Risk Management, risk advisory, governance, internal audit or a related field.
* Practical experience in risk assessments, risk registers, risk appetite, KRIs, control evaluation, risk reporting or ERM improvement initiatives.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and interacting with client or business stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* A relevant professional certification or progress towards a qualification such as CRMA, CIA, FRM, CRM, RIMS-CRMP, CISA, ACCA, CA or an equivalent risk, audit, finance or governance qualification.
* Prior consulting or professional-services experience.
* Experience preparing executive-level reports, dashboards or risk committee materials.
* Arabic language capability, where relevant to client engagements in the MENA region.
* Mobility and travel
* Willingness and ability to travel to client locations, sometimes at short notice.
* A valid passport and ability to meet applicable travel requirements.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching and practical experience. We value our people and provide opportunities to shape your development through challenging assignments, knowledge exchange and collaboration. We offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that is right for you.

**Structured Finance – Transactions – CMBS**
EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. Our FSO teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Structured Finance Team specializes in addressing varying needs of market participants in the securitization marketplace across asset classes, including asset- backed securities (ABS), commercial mortgage- backed securities (CMBS), residential mortgage- backed securities (RMBS) and collateralized loan obligations (CLO). The securitization market is a dynamic marketplace, continuously evolving with new regulations and technological advances every day. This a great opportunity to work in this fast-paced transaction business, support diverse engagement teams, work with a wide variety of clients and lead business development activities on strategic and global priority accounts.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The primary role of the SFT transaction team is to perform agreed-upon procedures (AUP) to help clients execute securitization transactions successfully.
  
  

* Work with and interact with front-office investment banking clients daily
* Perform loan document review and data reviews on loan files, recalculating fields on data tapes and run exception reports to tie out with clients
* Create collateral stratification tables used for assessing loan pool characteristics
* Review offering documents to verify information is accurate, complete, and conforming with industry and market standards
* Multitask and work under pressure to meet strict deadlines
* Articulate issues and problems and communicate clearly to the seniors
* Ability to work collaboratively with team members as part of the team
* Maintain awareness of emerging AI and data-extraction capabilities and their potential application to document review, while recognizing current processes, control and confidentiality requirements.

* Ability to interpret complex financial and legal documentation and connect document terms to structured data.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise issue articulation and client-ready reporting.
* Collaborative mindset, professional integrity and confidence working with global stakeholders.
* Curiosity and learning agility, including interest in understanding where AI and automation may add value while professional judgment remains decisive.
* Awareness of AI limitations, source traceability, confidentiality and responsible-use principles. development goals.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline and approximately 2 years of related work experience; MBA or equivalent preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, including data reconciliation, formulas and structured analysis.
* Awareness of generative AI, machine learning or intelligent automation concepts, including their potential applications, limitations and responsible use.
* Exposure to data, automation or emerging technology tools is desirable. Examples may include advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, Python, SQL, workflow automation or approved AI assistants.
* Strong prioritization skills and flexibility to support client deadlines and role-based shifts when required.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior structured finance, securitization, commercial real estate lending or transaction due-diligence experience.
* Exposure to CMBS loan documents, data tapes, offering documents, collateral analysis or agreed-upon procedures.
* Exposure to, or interest in learning about, AI, document extraction, anomaly detection, reconciliation, QA or workflow-automation solutions.
* Awareness of responsible-AI principles, data privacy, information security, explainability and the importance of human oversight.

**What We Look For**
We look for professionals who combine structured finance knowledge with curiosity about technology, analytics and emerging AI capabilities. Successful candidates will embrace continuous learning, use technology thoughtfully and translate complex findings into clear actions for clients and engagement teams.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. title: Operations Manager Intern
description:
**Location**
: Kalamassery, Kochi, Kerala

**Role Type:**
Internship | Hybrid (Primarily Work From Home)

**Duration**
: 6 months.

**Working Hours:**
11:00 AM – 8:00 PM.

**Monthly Stipend:**
₹5,000.

**Performance Bonus**
: Up to ₹10,000 based on individual performance and achievement of operational targets. The bonus is performance-based and is not guaranteed.

**Joining**
: Immediate.

**About the Role**

Fawrit Technologies is looking for an
**Operations Manager Intern**
to support and coordinate day-to-day operations across our laundry partners, riders, customers, and internal technical team.

The role involves managing operational communication through WhatsApp and other communication channels, monitoring orders, coordinating pickups and deliveries, following up with laundry partners and riders, assisting customers, and ensuring operational issues are followed up and resolved efficiently.

This is a people-facing operations role that requires strong communication, responsiveness, ownership, problem-solving ability, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups simultaneously.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Order & Operations Coordination

* Monitor incoming orders and ensure they move smoothly through the service process.
* Track orders from customer pickup through laundry processing to final delivery.
* Follow up on pending, delayed, or problematic orders.
* Coordinate with partners and riders to ensure timely order completion.
* Keep order information and status updates accurate in the system.
* Identify operational issues and take timely action or escalate them when required.

2. Estimates, Invoices & Payments

* Assist with preparing and sharing estimates with customers when required.
* Share invoices and payment links after confirming the necessary order details.
* Follow up on pending payments when required.
* Ensure payment and order-related information is accurately recorded.

3. Partner Coordination

* Communicate with laundry partners regarding orders, service progress, and operational requirements.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing partners.
* Understand partner concerns, requirements, and operational challenges.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to address partner issues.
* Communicate customer requirements and special instructions to partners.
* Assist with the coordination and onboarding of new partners when required.

4. Customer & Rider Coordination

* Communicate with customers regarding pickups, deliveries, order updates, and service-related queries.
* Coordinate with riders regarding pickup and delivery schedules.
* Communicate customer requests, changes, and important order information to riders.
* Follow up with riders to ensure pickups and deliveries are completed on time.
* Assist in resolving routine customer and rider concerns.

* **XCSM:**
  A client engagement and governance platform for wealth managers and banks, designed around the AI-governance guidance regulators are now issuing to licensed financial institutions.
* **PollenX:**
  Our private AI layer: models, guardrails and audit trails deployed inside a client's own cloud or data center, for institutions that will not send data to public models.

**Our Engagements**

Around the products, we deliver fixed-scope, fixed-price engagements:

* AI Readiness & Governance Review (3 weeks)
* Six-Week AI Pilot
* Compliance-Readiness Sprint against a named regulation
* Data Foundations Assessment
* Private AI Landing Zone

These are the doors. Multi-year platform work is what is behind them. Our marketing is already producing the signal: senior buyers engaging with our campaigns, attending our webinars and visiting our site. What we need is a closer who turns that signal into meetings, and meetings into contracts.

**The Role**

You'll work a defined book of named Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts across the target markets.

**Target industries include:**

* Carriers and MGAs
* Health systems and health plans
* Regional and mid-market banks
* RIAs and wealth managers

**What you'll own:**

* A six-month ramp, with a stepped quota and a non-recoverable draw
* An annual quota based on first-year contract value
* Intent data and account engagement signals to identify potential opportunities
* Entry engagements designed to expand into larger platform deals
* Enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders

**What You'll Do**

* Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, run discovery, build the business case, negotiate, close. No handoffs.
* Lead with a packaged offer. Every first conversation opens with one of our fixed-scope engagements, so the buyer gets a short, priced, low-risk yes. You expand from there.
* Get in front of the people who own the problem. Heads of Claims and Underwriting at insurers. CIOs, CMIOs and VPs of Revenue Cycle at health systems. Heads of Digital Transformation at banks. COOs, Chief Compliance Officers and Heads of Advisory at wealth firms.
* Be first on the trigger. New executives, funding rounds, regulatory deadlines, enforcement actions, revealing job posts. Marketing surfaces them; you are in the inbox within 48 hours with something specific to say.
* Multi-thread every account using Sales Navigator, webinars and executive content, so you never depend on a single champion.
* Mine your network. Five named introduction asks a week into customers, partners and former colleagues. Referrals convert at several times the rate of anything cold, and we protect the time for them.
* Run a disciplined pipeline in HubSpot. Every lead accepted or rejected with a reason, every touch logged, every opportunity with a dated next step. If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.
* Partner with Marketing weekly to sharpen campaigns, case studies and targeting based on what you hear in the field.
* Travel as needed to close, including occasional overnight regional trips.

**Who you are**

* 4+ years closing B2B SaaS or technology-services deals.
* 2+ years selling into at least one of our verticals: insurance, healthcare, banking or wealth management. You don't need all four; deep expertise in one is what matters.
* A consistent record of hitting or exceeding quota on high-value deals, and at least one seven-figure deal you can walk us through.
* **Experience working with customers and markets in both India and the Middle East.**
* Comfortable selling AI and data products to compliance-conscious buyers. You can talk human-in-the-loop workflows, audit trails, model inventories and regulatory exposure with confidence, and you know when to bring in the product expert.
* Experienced with account-based selling, Sales Navigator and a modern CRM (HubSpot preferred).
* A strong writer and presenter. Your first email to a new CRO gets read because it is about them, not about us.
* Self-directed and hungry. You would rather be measured on outcomes than watched on activity.

**Why here**

You won't be one of 400 reps dialing the same list. You'll be one of a handful of sellers building the go-to-market for five products that are already generating senior-level demand, with a founder-led company behind you that has been shipping production software to regulated clients for years.

The accounts are identified, the content is running, the intent data is live, and a partnerships lead is opening doors with the carriers' and health plans' own technology vendors.

The gap between our pipeline and our revenue is a closer.

You’ve exceeded quota, built pipeline from scratch and won new business. Now you’re looking for the next step. At UKG, you’ll move beyond selling to small businesses and work with Indian organisations employing

in the Application and Interview Process
