Santhosh Infinity Infra Pvt Ltd

Building Trust. Creating Value. Inspiring Futures.

Santhosh Infinity Infra Pvt Ltd is a dynamic and forward-thinking real estate, infrastructure development and property management company headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. We are committed to transforming real estate opportunities into valuable investments, quality living spaces, and sustainable property solutions.

With a strong focus on innovation, transparency, quality, and customer satisfaction, we provide comprehensive real estate services designed to meet the evolving needs of property buyers, investors, homeowners, businesses and Tenants.

Our Core Business Verticals:

🏡 Land Acquisition & Development – Identifying, acquiring, and developing strategically located properties with strong investment potential.

🏗️ Building Construction – Delivering quality residential and commercial construction solutions with a focus on modern design, structural excellence, and timely execution.

🏢 Interior Design, Renovation & Property Flipping – Transforming properties through innovative interiors, strategic renovations, and value-enhancing property improvements.

🔑 Property Management – Providing end-to-end property management solutions, including tenant coordination, renting / leasing support, maintenance, bills, tax payments and asset management.

Our Vision

To become a trusted and innovative real estate and infrastructure company, recognized for delivering exceptional property solutions, creating long-term value, and building lasting customer relationships.

Our Mission

To simplify real estate ownership, investment, development, and management through transparent practices, professional expertise, technology-driven solutions, and customer-centric services.

At Santhosh Infinity Infra Pvt Ltd, we believe real estate is more than land and buildings — it's about building dreams, creating opportunities, and securing futures.

Santhosh Infinity Infra Pvt Ltd – Your Vision. Our Foundation. Infinite Possibilities.

🌐 www.santhoshinfinityinfra.com

📍 Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Role Description**

Santhosh Infinity Infra Pvt. Ltd. (SIIPL) is seeking a dynamic, self-motivated, target-oriented, and customer-focused
**Sales Executive**
to manage end-to-end real estate sales activities, generate qualified leads, develop prospective customer relationships, conduct property presentations and site visits, negotiate sales agreements, and achieve individual and organizational sales targets.

The Sales Executive will be responsible for promoting and selling the company's residential plots, land parcels, residential and commercial properties, construction services, interior solutions, and property management services.

The role involves identifying new business opportunities, conducting market research, coordinating with customers and channel partners, managing sales pipelines, following up with prospective buyers, and ensuring a smooth customer journey from initial enquiry to booking, documentation, registration, and post-sales support.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and closing skills, along with a strong understanding of Bengaluru's real estate market and customer requirements.

Key Roles and Responsibilities1. Lead Generation & Business Development

* Identify and generate potential customer leads through direct sales, field visits, referrals, networking, digital enquiries, and channel partners.
* Conduct outbound calls, follow-up calls, WhatsApp communications, and customer meetings.
* Develop new business opportunities across residential plots, land, apartments, villas, commercial properties, and real estate services.
* Build and maintain relationships with prospective buyers, investors, property owners, and business associates.
* Coordinate with the Marketing Department to convert campaign-generated leads into qualified sales opportunities.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly lead generation and conversion targets.

2. Customer Enquiry & Relationship Management

* Handle customer enquiries received through phone calls, WhatsApp, websites, social media, walk-ins, and referrals.
* Understand customer requirements, location preferences, budget, investment objectives, and property expectations.
* Recommend suitable properties and services based on customer requirements.
* Maintain regular communication with prospective and existing customers.
* Address customer questions, concerns, and objections professionally.
* Develop long-term customer relationships to generate repeat business and referrals.

3. Property Presentation & Site Visits

* Present detailed information about available projects, layouts, plots, residential properties, and commercial properties.
* Explain property specifications, location advantages, connectivity, amenities, pricing, payment options, and project features.
* Schedule, coordinate, and conduct customer site visits and property inspections.
* Arrange transportation and site visit logistics when required and approved.
* Coordinate with site supervisors and project teams to ensure properties are ready for customer visits.
* Collect customer feedback after site visits and follow up until a clear sales decision is reached.

4. Sales Negotiation & Deal Closure

* Prepare and communicate property quotations, pricing details, offers, and payment schedules.
* Negotiate with prospective buyers within management-approved pricing and discount limits.
* Convert qualified leads and site visits into confirmed bookings.
* Coordinate booking forms, customer documentation, payment confirmations, and sales agreements.
* Follow up on pending booking advances and scheduled payments in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure all commitments regarding pricing, approvals, amenities, timelines, and property specifications are accurate and authorized.
* Achieve assigned sales revenue, booking, and conversion targets.

5. CRM Management & Sales Reporting

* Maintain accurate customer records and lead information in the company's CRM system.
* Update lead status, follow-up dates, customer interactions, site visits, quotations, and booking details.
* Submit daily sales activity and End-of-Day (EOD) reports.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales performance reports.
* Track sales pipeline stages, lead conversion ratios, site visit conversions, and booking performance.
* Attend daily sales meetings, weekly reviews, and monthly performance discussions.
* Ensure timely follow-up on all assigned leads without missing scheduled customer communications.

6. Channel Partner & Referral Network Development

* Identify and develop relationships with real estate agents, brokers, channel partners, and referral associates.
* Coordinate channel partner meetings, property presentations, and project visits.
* Generate qualified enquiries through approved referral and brokerage networks.
* Maintain channel partner lead records and coordinate commission-related documentation as per company policy.
* Ensure professional and transparent communication with all external sales associates.

7. Construction, Interiors & Property Management Sales

* Identify prospective customers requiring residential or commercial construction services.
* Generate enquiries for interior design, renovation, property improvement, and property flipping services.
* Promote SIIPL's rental property management, leasing, tenant management, and property maintenance services.
* Coordinate customer requirements with the respective technical and operational departments.
* Support cross-selling and upselling opportunities across SIIPL's business segments.

8. Sales Documentation & Compliance

* Collect and verify required customer information and sales-related documents in coordination with authorized departments.
* Coordinate with Legal, Finance, and Documentation teams for agreements, booking formalities, and property registration processes.
* Ensure sales activities follow company policies and applicable real estate regulations, including RERA requirements wherever applicable.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer data, pricing information, and company records.
* Avoid unauthorized commitments, misleading advertisements, or unapproved pricing assurances.

9. Post-Sales Customer Support

* Maintain communication with customers after booking confirmation.
* Coordinate with the Customer Support, Finance, Legal, and Registration teams.
* Assist customers with documentation, payment schedules, registration appointments, and project-related updates.
* Resolve or escalate customer concerns promptly.
* Encourage customer referrals, testimonials, and repeat business through professional service.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or any related discipline.
* Preferred experience of 1–5 years in real estate sales, field sales, direct sales, business development, or customer relationship management.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills, strong sales aptitude, and willingness to work in field sales may also be considered.
* Good understanding of residential plots, property sales, customer acquisition, and real estate market practices.
* Excellent communication, presentation, persuasion, negotiation, and deal-closing skills.
* Strong customer relationship management and interpersonal abilities.
* Ability to achieve sales targets and work in a performance-driven environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, CRM applications, and digital communication tools.
* Knowledge of Bengaluru's real estate locations, property market trends, and local customer preferences is an advantage.
* Fluency in English and Kannada is preferred. Knowledge of Tamil, Telugu, or Hindi will be an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings, site visits, field sales, and business development activities.
* A valid driving licence and access to a personal two-wheeler are preferred for field sales responsibilities.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

**Uttam Education | Remote | Full-Time | 0–1 Year Experience**

About Uttam Education

Uttam Education is an education and upskilling company helping working professionals build practical, workplace-ready skills in
**Business & Data Analytics**
.

Our programs include hands-on training in
**Excel, SQL, Power BI and Tableau**
, with a strong focus on practical application, projects, real-world datasets and workplace skills.

We are growing our Business Development team and are looking for motivated individuals who want to build a career in
**Sales, Business Development, Customer Engagement and Growth**
.

About the Role

This is
**not a traditional telecalling role**
. You will primarily work with
**inbound enquiries generated through Uttam Education's marketing channels**
. These are prospects who have already shown interest in our programs through our advertising and other marketing activities.

Your responsibility will be to understand their requirements, have meaningful conversations, follow up consistently, manage the sales pipeline and help interested prospects make an informed decision.

Along the way, you will also learn how modern sales and growth teams use
**CRM systems, WhatsApp Business APIs, broadcasting, lead nurturing, webinars, demos and funnel optimization**
.

What You Will Do

* Connect with inbound enquiries generated through our marketing channels.
* Understand the prospect's professional background, career goals and learning requirements.
* Conduct meaningful conversations through calls and WhatsApp.
* Follow up with prospects from previous conversations and manage the next steps.
* Reconnect with prospects who were previously unanswered or inactive.
* Maintain accurate information and follow-up activities in the CRM.
* Participate in webinars, demo sessions and other customer engagement activities.
* Learn and work with WhatsApp Business APIs, broadcasting and lead-nurturing workflows.
* Contribute ideas to improve lead engagement, follow-up processes and conversion.
* Work towards business development and revenue goals through consultative conversations.

What Your Typical Day May Look Like

You will start your day by reviewing:

* New enquiries received through our marketing channels.
* Previous conversations and pending follow-ups.
* Prospects who have not yet responded.
* Opportunities that require the next action.

You will then prioritize your day, engage with prospects through calls and WhatsApp, update the CRM, participate in scheduled webinars or demos, and review your progress.

The focus is not simply on the
**number of calls made**
. We value
**productive conversations, consistent follow-up, customer understanding and meaningful movement of opportunities through the pipeline**
.

Key Performance Expectation

The initial expectation is approximately
**5–6 productive prospect conversations per working day**
.

A productive conversation means a meaningful two-way interaction with a prospect—not simply making a call.

Targets are used to track progress, provide direction and identify opportunities for improvement. We believe in giving our team the training, tools and support required to achieve their goals.

Who We Are Looking For

* Freshers and candidates with
  **0–1 year of experience**
  can apply.
* **2025 and 2026 graduates**
  are welcome to apply.
* **Strong English communication is mandatory.**
* Comfortable speaking with working professionals over phone calls and WhatsApp.
* Genuine interest in building a career in
  **Sales, Business Development, Marketing or Growth**
  .
* Good listening, communication and follow-up skills.
* Willingness to learn CRM systems, WhatsApp tools and digital sales processes.
* Self-driven, disciplined and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Prior experience in sales, business development, customer support, marketing or internships is an advantage, but not mandatory.

Regional Language Advantage

Candidates who can confidently communicate in
**Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam or Marathi**
will have an added advantage.

What You Will Learn

This role will give you practical exposure to:

* Consultative selling and business development
* Customer communication and engagement
* Lead qualification and sales funnel management
* CRM and pipeline management
* WhatsApp Business APIs and engagement campaigns
* Lead nurturing and follow-up systems
* Webinar and demo management
* Conversion optimization
* Sales and customer behaviour
* Growth and marketing operations

Compensation & Benefits

**During Probation**

₹15,000/month fixed + performance incentives + insurance

**After Successful Confirmation**

**Up to ₹45,000/month**
+ performance incentives + insurance

Your compensation and progression after confirmation will depend on your performance, capability, learning, ownership and contribution to the business.

Work Details

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
Remote / Work From Home

**Working Days:**
Monday–Saturday

**Working Hours:**
12:00 PM–9:00 PM

**Experience:**
0–1 year

**Preferred Graduation Year:**
2025 / 2026

**Please note:**
Candidates should have access to a reliable
**laptop, smartphone and stable internet connection**
. A company SIM card will be provided.

Career Growth

This role is designed as a starting point for a broader career in
**Business Development, Sales and Growth**
.

As you develop your skills and demonstrate consistent performance, you can take on greater responsibility and grow into senior business development, sales or growth roles.

Why Join Uttam Education?

You will not be restricted to following a sales script or making calls throughout the day.

You will learn how to understand a customer, identify their requirements, recognize what may be preventing a prospect from moving forward, decide the next best action and contribute ideas to improve the sales funnel.

You will work with real inbound prospects, participate in live business activities and learn how marketing, sales, technology and customer engagement come together to drive business growth.

If you are looking for an opportunity where you can
**learn, apply, take ownership and grow**
, we would like to hear from you.

**Important:**
Please apply only if you are genuinely interested in building a career in Business Development / Sales and are comfortable with the working schedule and responsibilities mentioned above.

How to Apply

Send your updated CV to info@uttameducation.com with the subject line:

**Application – Business Development Executive**

Learn more about Uttam Education:

**Website:**
www.uttameducation.com

**Instagram:**
www.instagram.com/uttam.education/

**LinkedIn:**
www.linkedin.com/company/uttam-education/

title: Territory Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
NoBrokerHood is a technologically advanced visitor, community, and finance & asset management platform designed to make life more secure and convenient for gated societies across India. Launched in 2018 as a subsidiary of NoBroker, India’s first prop-tech unicorn, it has quickly become a market leader, managing over 25,000 societies and supporting more than 4.8 million families. The platform serves all key stakeholders in a community—administrators, guards, and residents—while offering services such as home maintenance and property rentals or sales. NoBrokerHood also enables revenue opportunities for societies and partner businesses through monetization and marketplace features. Backed by a recent $5 million investment from Google, it holds Level 1 PCI-DSS, GDPR, PDPB 2019, and ISO 27001 certifications, ensuring strong data security and privacy.
  
**Role Description**
The Territory Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Bengaluru Area. The individual in this role will identify and pursue new business opportunities with residential societies, manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to closure, and build strong relationships with key decision-makers such as management committees and facility managers. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting client meetings and product demos, preparing proposals, negotiating commercial terms, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and account handover. The role also involves tracking sales metrics, maintaining accurate records in CRM tools, gathering market and competitor insights, and consistently achieving assigned revenue and growth targets within the designated territory.
  
**Qualifications**

* Proven skills in territory sales, B2B or institutional sales, and business development within tech, SaaS, real estate, or related sectors.
* Strong abilities in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and customer service, with a consultative selling approach.
* Competence in lead generation, pipeline management, and use of CRM or sales tracking tools to manage accounts and opportunities.
* Effective communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the capacity to explain technical features in simple, value-focused terms.
* Comfort working on-site with frequent client visits in the Greater Bengaluru Area, and willingness to travel within the assigned territory as needed.
* Results-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently, meet sales targets, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field; relevant sales experience in community management or prop-tech is an advantage.

We are seeking an experienced sales professional with established expertise in the mobility ecosystem, a
  
  
strong understanding of enterprise customer needs, and a proven ability to identify opportunities, build
  
  
strategic partnerships, and drive revenue growth across international markets.
  
  
We have multiple openings for mid-to-senior-level sales professionals. The final designation will be
  
  
determined through the interview process, based on the candidate's relevant experience, industry

negotiation and closure. There are no fixed geographic territories; sellers can pursue opportunities globally
  
  
while collaborating with Pre-Sales, GTM & Growth, and technical teams.

title: Mgr. Supply Chain Planning & Logistics
description:
**Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

 **Job Description**

**Primary Function of the Position**

We are seeking a supply chain professional to own end-to-end **demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory control, and logistics execution** for a portfolio of medical devices — **capital equipment, instruments, accessories, and spare parts**.

The role drives a disciplined **S&OP** process across a regulated, lot-traceable, and often import-dependent supply chain — balancing patient-facing service levels, working capital, regulatory compliance, and cost-to-serve.

The incumbent will be the bridge between **Commercial (tender + commercial channel), Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Manufacturing / Imports, Finance, and Service** — ensuring on-shelf availability of life-critical products and uninterrupted service support to the installed base.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand Planning & Forecast Management**

* Own **statistical and consensus demand forecasts** at SKU / region / channel level, segmented by capital equipment, instruments, accessories, consumables, and spares, on a **rolling 18-month horizon**.
* Support **New Product Introduction (NPI) launches** — build phase-in plans aligned to regulatory milestones, sales-force readiness, and channel fill.
* Manage **EOL and product-transition planning** with care — clinical preferences and regulatory constraints make abrupt phase-outs risky.
* Run **spare-parts and accessory planning** driven by installed-base data, attach rates, and service-event history.
* Track forecast accuracy — **MAPE, WMAPE, bias, FVA** — at category level; isolate tender forecast error from commercial baseline.

**Supply Planning & Inventory Control**

* Convert the demand plan into a constrained **supply plan** across in-house.
* Work closely with global Supply planner.
* Own **inventory planning and control** — safety stock, cycle stock, and strategic stock — segmented by criticality (lifesaving / Class C-D items held at higher service levels, slow-moving accessories at lower tier).
* Manage **expiry, FEFO discipline, and inventory ageing** to keep write-offs within target.
* Plan around **import lead times, CDSCO license validity, and customs clearance** dependencies for imported SKUs.
* **Coordinate with global stakeholders** — regional supply hubs, principal manufacturers, and global category / planning teams — for **supply allocation, expedites, and execution tracking** across time zones.

**Logistics & Service Levels**

* Oversee **inbound (imports + domestic), inter-DC, and outbound logistics** to distributors, hospitals (direct), and field service engineers.
* Manage 3PL/4PL partners under **ISO 13485-aligned** vendor audits and **Good Distribution Practices (GDP)**.
* Track and improve **OTIF, lane-level cold-chain excursion %, expiry write-off %, freight cost per unit, OTIF-to-hospital direct, and tender-fulfilment %**.

**S&OP & Stakeholder Integration**

* Run a disciplined **monthly S&OP** — Demand Review Supply Review Pre-S&OP Executive S&OP — with a separate **tender pipeline review** layered in.
* Act as the **single integrator** across Commercial, Tender, Service, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing, Imports, and Finance; quantify trade-offs (service to a hospital vs. expiry risk vs. cash).
* Drive **scenario plans** for tender wins/losses, NPI go-live shifts, supplier disruptions, and import delays.

**Analytics, Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive deployment and adoption of planning systems — **o9, SAP** — alongside **QMS-integrated traceability** in ERP.
* Build dashboards for **forecast accuracy, inventory ageing / expiry runway, service level by hospital, tender OTIF, and import lead-time variance**.
* Champion **Lean / Six Sigma** initiatives and **GDP-aligned SOPs**; institutionalize a **logistics control tower** for critical SKUs.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage cross functional stakeholders across commercial, Service, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Planning , Imports and Finance.
* Build and sustain Strong working relationship with global counterparts ,3PL/4PL Partners.
* Represent the function in senior business reviews and external audits (CDSCO, ISO 13485 surveillance).

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **7–10 years** of professional experience in a similar position, **ideally within a medical device company**.
* Demonstrated ownership of **demand planning, supply planning, and logistics** in a regulated, multi-channel environment.
* **Strong analytical skills** with attention to detail and accuracy.

Budget Tracking, Business Operations, Cloud Security, Cybersecurity, Cyber Security Management, Data Integrity, Executive Reports, Identity Access Management (IAM), Operational Reporting, PMO Best Practices, PMO Leadership, Risk Assessments, Risk Management, Risk Management Framework, Security Architecture Design, Security Compliance, Security Policies, Security Risk, Third Party Risk Management, Vulnerability Management, Web Application Security

description:
**Role Overview**

**Job Title:** Showroom Sales Manager

**Industry:**  Jewellery Retail

**Total Experience: 6 – 10+ Years (Mandatory experience in the Gold & Jewellery Industry)**

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

**Department:** SALES AND SUPPORT

**2. Role Purpose**

The **Showroom Sales Manager** is fully responsible for driving retail showroom revenue, floor team leadership, end-to-end customer experience, and operational controls for high-value gold, diamond, and precious jewellery.

This role requires a retail leader with deep domain mastery of **Gold Purchase / Monthly Advance Savings Schemes** (enrolments, regular collections, maturity retention, and redemption conversions), hands-on showroom operations (daily gold rate display, gross-to-net weight calculations, old gold exchange/URD, BIS Hallmark verification), and exceptional floor leadership to hit ambitious monthly sales targets.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Showroom Sales Target Achievement & Revenue Growth**

* Drive and achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual showroom sales targets across gold ornaments (plain gold, antique, temple jewellery), bridal sets, diamond-studded collections, and bullion coins.
* Monitor retail sales metrics: footfall-to-bill conversion rate, Average Transaction Value (ATV), Units Per Transaction (UPT), and gross margins.
* Oversee bridal appointments and VIP high-net-worth client consultations, personally assisting in closing high-ticket sales.
* Plan and execute festive sales drives (Akshaya Tritiya, Dhanteras, Diwali, Ugadi, Wedding/Bridal seasons) with tailored floor offers and targeted customer outreach.

**B. Gold Savings & Advance Purchase Schemes (Chit / Monthly Plans)**

* **Scheme Pipeline Leadership:** Drive aggressive showroom-wide enrolment targets for the brand’s monthly gold purchase/advance savings plans.
* **Maturity & Conversion Management:** Track upcoming plan maturities month-on-month; design proactive follow-up workflows so maturing scheme balances are redeemed for high-margin jewellery and bridal collections rather than simple bullion or cash exits.
* **Payment Discipline & Retention:** Supervise counter follow-ups for lapsed or overdue monthly instalments via WhatsApp, SMS, and personal outbound calls to maintain active accounts.
* **Compliance & Redemption Transparency:** Ensure floor sales staff accurately communicate scheme benefits (bonus months, making charge discounts, purity guarantees) and follow KYC norms (Aadhaar, PAN collection) without misrepresenting scheme terms.

**C. Complete Showroom Floor Management & Operations**

* Manage daily showroom opening and closing protocols, including vault opening, counter tray layouts, security checks, and safe-locking procedures.
* Ensure accurate daily updates of the **Gold Board Rate** (22K, 24K, 18K) across all electronic boards and POS billing terminals.
* Oversee old gold evaluation and purchase (URD - Unregistered Dealer purchases): ensure accurate touch/carat testing (XRF machine analysis), stone-weight deductions, melting-loss standards, and customer consent before final billing.
* Enforce BIS Hallmark (HUID) compliance across every piece displayed on the floor.
* Maintain premium visual merchandising (VM) standards, window displays, lighting, tray hygiene, and showroom ambience.

**D. High-Value Inventory & Vault Control**

* Lead mandatory daily opening and closing physical stock tallies (Gross Weight, Stone Weight, Net Weight, and Tag Count) against ERP balances across all counters.
* Maintain zero tolerance for inventory shrinkage, pilferage, or untagged jewellery on the floor.
* Coordinate with the central supply chain/inventory department for timely replenishment of fast-moving designs, bridal sets, and seasonal stock.
* Supervise inter-branch stock transfers, repair/alteration tracking with karigars, and customer ornament cleaning/custom orders.

**E. Team Leadership, Coaching & Floor Discipline**

* Supervise, mentor, and motivate a sales team of 15 to 40+ floor sales executives, counter heads, and billing staff.
* Conduct daily morning floor briefings (daily targets, scheme quotas, stock highlights, focus designs of the day).
* Train floor staff on gold purity nuances, hallmark identification, making charges/wastage calculations, objection handling, and closing techniques.
* Manage shift rostering, attendance, grooming standards, sales incentive distribution, and annual performance appraisals.

**F. Customer Relationship Management (CRM) & Local Marketing**

* Build and maintain a personal roster of repeat, elite, and family bridal buyers.
* Drive post-purchase follow-up protocols, birthday/anniversary greeting routines, and tailored invites for private preview exhibitions.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to execute local catchment activations, BTL promotional campaigns, and customer referral initiatives.

**4. Mandatory Candidate Profile & Requirements**

* **Experience:** **6 to 10+ years** of progressive retail sales experience strictly within the **Gold & Jewellery Retail Industry**, with at least **3+ years in a supervisory/managerial role** (Showroom Manager / Assistant Store Manager / Floor Sales Head).
* **Domain Mastery of Gold Calculations:** Complete mastery over:
* Gross weight vs. Net weight vs. Stone weight deductions.
* Purity math: 24K (999), 22K (916), 18K (750), and conversion to fine weight.
* Value addition (VA), making charges per gram vs. percentage, and wastage rules.
* Old gold exchange calculations, melting loss deductions, and Hallmarking (HUID) protocols.
* **Scheme Expertise:** Thorough, practical experience running, selling, and reconciling monthly retail gold savings schemes (11-month plans, chit-type plans, advance booking schemes).
* **Showroom Handling:** Proven track record of independently managing showroom operations, including vault management, daily opening/closing routines, security coordination, and handling multi-crore daily inventory.

**5. Key Skills & Competencies**

**Sales & Commercials:** High-ticket closing, conversion rate optimization, bridal sales pitching, retail margin protection.

**Scheme Operations:** Enrolment acceleration, instalment retention workflows, scheme maturity tracking, POS redemption handling.

**Operational Control:** Daily vault reconciliation, weight-scale calibration checks, XRF carat-meter oversight, HUID compliance.

**People Management:** Floor sales coaching, grooming audits, grievance handling, shift planning, incentive-driven motivation.

**Software Proficiency:** Experience with jewellery ERP/POS systems and MS Excel.

**Languages**Fluency in the local regional language (**Kannada**) and **English**; working knowledge of Hindi is an added advantage.

**6. Qualifications**

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline (B.Com, BBA, BA, B.Sc). A Master’s degree or MBA in Retail Management / Marketing is an added advantage.

Pay: Up to ₹80,000.00 per month

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: ServiceNow Practice Head
description:
### **About InputZero**

InputZero Technologies is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and Enterprise Service Management company helping organizations transform and automate their IT and business workflows. Our capabilities span ServiceNow, BMC, AI, Automation, ITSM, ITOM, GRC and Enterprise Workflow solutions, with a strong focus on delivering outcome-driven solutions for global enterprises.

As we continue to expand our ServiceNow business and strengthen our global presence, particularly across North America, we are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Practice Head to lead and accelerate the growth of our ServiceNow practice.

### **Role Overview**

The ServiceNow Practice Head will have end-to-end ownership of the ServiceNow practice, including business growth, revenue, profitability, sales, presales, delivery governance, customer relationships, talent strategy and capability development.

This is a strategic leadership role for a business-oriented ServiceNow leader who can combine technology expertise, commercial acumen, sales leadership and delivery experience to build a scalable and profitable practice.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Practice Strategy & Growth**

* Own and execute the overall ServiceNow practice strategy, roadmap and growth plan aligned with InputZero's business objectives.
* Drive year-on-year growth in revenue, profitability, market presence and customer base.
* Identify new markets, industries and ServiceNow opportunities to expand the practice.
* Develop differentiated ServiceNow offerings, solutions, accelerators and managed services.
* Drive both Net New Logo acquisition and expansion of existing strategic accounts.
* Build a strong and predictable ServiceNow pipeline in partnership with Sales and Business Development teams.
* Identify opportunities around emerging areas such as AI, GenAI, automation and enterprise workflow transformation.

**2. Revenue, P&L & Commercial Ownership**

* Own practice-level revenue, P&L, profitability, margins, utilization and commercial performance.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue targets and operating plans for the practice.
* Monitor pipeline, bookings, revenue forecasts, utilization and margins.
* Partner with Finance and Sales teams on pricing, commercial models and deal negotiations.
* Ensure the right balance between growth, delivery capacity, utilization and profitability.
* Establish appropriate business metrics and governance mechanisms to track practice performance.

**3. Sales, Presales & Deal Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to identify, qualify and convert strategic ServiceNow opportunities.
* Act as the senior ServiceNow leader in RFPs, RFIs, proposals, solutioning and large deal pursuits.
* Lead executive-level solution discussions and customer presentations.
* Engage directly with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and other senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Support commercial negotiations and develop compelling value propositions for enterprise customers.
* Drive account mining, cross-sell and up-sell opportunities.
* Build strong relationships with strategic customers, technology partners and the broader ServiceNow ecosystem.

**4. Delivery & Customer Success**

* Provide executive oversight for strategic ServiceNow programs and large customer engagements.
* Establish strong delivery governance, quality standards and operational processes.
* Ensure programs are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality expectations.
* Monitor project health, customer satisfaction, utilization, margins and delivery risks.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues.
* Work closely with Delivery Heads, Program Managers, Architects and Account Leaders to resolve complex business and delivery challenges.
* Build long-term customer relationships and generate opportunities for account expansion and references.

**5. ServiceNow Capability & Offering Development**

* Build and strengthen capabilities across relevant ServiceNow areas including ITSM, ITOM, CSM, GRC, SecOps, HRSD, SPM and AI/Automation.
* Identify emerging ServiceNow products and market trends and convert them into commercially viable offerings.
* Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, IP and industry-specific solutions.
* Strengthen InputZero's positioning as a strategic ServiceNow transformation partner, beyond traditional implementation services.
* Work closely with ServiceNow on partner programs, competencies, certifications, joint GTM initiatives and strategic opportunities.

**6. People & Practice Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing ServiceNow organization comprising Architects, Consultants, Developers, Business Analysts, Program Managers and Delivery Leaders.
* Develop workforce and hiring plans aligned with business pipeline and future capability requirements.
* Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development and employee retention.
* Establish a strong ServiceNow certification and continuous-learning culture.
* Monitor team utilization, productivity, capacity and skill availability.
* Develop future practice leaders and create a scalable organizational structure.

**7. Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted relationships with CXO-level customer stakeholders and strategic accounts.
* Represent InputZero in executive customer meetings, industry events and partner forums.
* Collaborate closely with the CEO, Sales, Delivery, HR, Finance and other business leaders.
* Provide regular leadership updates on practice revenue, pipeline, profitability, customer health, talent and strategic initiatives.
* Drive a culture of accountability, customer obsession and profitable growth.

### **Key Success Metrics**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* ServiceNow revenue and year-on-year growth
* Practice profitability and margins
* Net New Logos acquired
* Qualified pipeline and bookings
* Strategic deal closures
* Existing account growth and expansion
* Customer retention and satisfaction
* Practice utilization and productivity
* ServiceNow certifications and capability development
* Employee retention and leadership development
* ServiceNow partner performance and strategic relationship

  
**Requirements**  

### **Required Experience & Skills**

* 15+ years of overall IT/Technology Services experience, with significant experience in ServiceNow.
* Proven experience in building, scaling or leading a ServiceNow practice.
* Demonstrated experience in revenue ownership, P&L, business growth and practice management.
* Proven track record of new business acquisition and Net New Logo development.
* Strong experience in presales, solutioning, RFPs, proposals and commercial negotiations.
* Experience leading large and complex ServiceNow programs and distributed teams.
* Strong understanding of the ServiceNow platform and the broader enterprise transformation landscape.
* Strong understanding of the ServiceNow partner ecosystem and go-to-market model.
* Strong CXO-level customer engagement and executive communication skills.
* Experience working with global customers.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building ServiceNow accelerators, IP or industry-specific solutions.

* Experience serving customers in North America.

title: Manager - Virtual CFO Practice
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Team Manager to lead a team delivering virtual accounting and finance operations services to startups and growing businesses in India.

The role combines people management, accounting oversight, statutory compliance, client relationship management, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will ensure that client books are accurate, financial reports are delivered on time, statutory obligations are tracked, and the team operates efficiently across multiple client engagements.

The ideal candidate has strong practical experience in Indian accounting, GST, TDS, payroll-related accounting, financial reporting, and accounting software, along with the ability to manage a team and interact confidently with startup founders and finance leaders.

Key Responsibilities.

A. Team Leadership and Performance Management

* Manage a team of accountants and finance executives servicing multiple startup clients.
* Allocate client portfolios and workloads based on team capacity, complexity, and deadlines.
* Establish clear deliverables, turnaround times, review procedures, and individual performance expectations.
* Review team output, provide technical guidance, and develop the capabilities of junior team members.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and knowledge-sharing discussions.
* Build a culture of accountability, accuracy, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
* Identify capacity constraints and escalate hiring or resource requirements proactively.

B. Accounting Operations and Quality Control

* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including sales, purchases, expenses, bank transactions, journal entries, fixed assets, and general ledger maintenance.
* Ensure timely and accurate bookkeeping, ledger scrutiny, and monthly closing of accounts.
* Review bank reconciliations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, advances, employee reimbursements, and intercompany balances, where applicable.
* Ensure proper accounting classification, supporting documentation, and appropriate use of the chart of accounts.
* Review trial balances, general ledger schedules, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Establish maker-checker controls and ensure that material accounting errors and unresolved reconciliation items are identified and addressed.
* Ensure books of account are maintained in accordance with applicable Indian accounting requirements and the client's reporting framework.
* Coordinate year-end closing, audit schedules, and preparation of financial statements.

C. Indian Tax and Statutory Compliance

*Note: The role is responsible for operational oversight and review of compliance deliverables. Statutory certifications, attestations, and professional sign-offs must be performed by appropriately authorised professionals.*

D. Monthly Financial Reporting and MIS

* Track cash balances, upcoming payments, receivables, and other working capital indicators.
* Assist in preparing budgets, cash flow forecasts, and runway analyses where included in the client engagement.
* Identify financial reporting issues and communicate actionable observations to clients and senior management.

E. Client Relationship and Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary operational contact for assigned startup clients.
* Conduct periodic client review meetings to discuss accounting status, financial reports, compliance deadlines, and unresolved issues.
* Manage client expectations regarding scope, timelines, information requirements, and service levels.
* Proactively follow up on missing invoices, bank statements, expense approvals, payroll inputs, and other client dependencies.
* Explain accounting and financial reporting matters in clear, business-oriented language to founders and non-finance stakeholders.
* Resolve routine client queries and escalate complex tax, legal, accounting, or commercial matters appropriately.
* Identify additional service requirements and opportunities to improve the value delivered to clients.
* Maintain professional relationships while ensuring that agreed service boundaries are respected.

F. Process Improvement and Technology

* Standardise accounting workflows, month-end closing procedures, reconciliation templates, and review checklists.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for recurring activities.
* Improve turnaround times and reduce manual effort through automation and better use of accounting technology.

* Use Excel and Google Sheets effectively for reconciliations, reporting, and analysis.

You support Consumer & Community Banking lines of business, product teams, and functional partners by delivering catalog reporting and insights that enable effective metadata change management, workflow oversight, and data quality monitoring. You help shape and implement data governance strategies, promoting adoption of standards, processes, and frameworks across business domains. You maintain and enhance end-to-end data lineage across platforms, including application-level, key data element (KDE), and table/column-level lineage, ensuring traceability throughout the data lifecycle. You align lineage practices with data governance, risk, control, and regulatory requirements, contributing to the evolution of lineage maturity models and success metrics. You work closely with technology and product teams to identify and remediate data lineage gaps in the Data Catalog and partner with Data Quality and Controls teams to map critical controls to data flows. You provide governance oversight for business-owned applications, acting as a data authority to support compliant and well-managed data usage. You build strong relationships with Controls, Product, Data Owners, and Technology stakeholders to coordinate cross-functional efforts and promote consistent governance practices. You deliver insights and recommendations that support both tactical fixes and strategic solutions for data lineage and catalog issues. title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
**Employment Type:** Full-time / Internship  
**Experience:** Freshers welcome; 0–2 years preferred  
**Qualification:** Any bachelor's degree; MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Development preferred.

Skynetic Ventures builds AI solutions that solve real-world business and industrial problems. Our focus areas include Computer Vision, Industrial AI, Enterprise AI, video analytics, and intelligent automation.

We work with businesses to identify operational challenges and implement AI-powered solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, safety, quality, and decision-making.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented B2B Sales Executive / Sales Intern to drive lead generation, prospect outreach, client engagement, and business development.

The candidate will work closely with the leadership and technical teams to identify potential customers, understand their business challenges, introduce relevant AI solutions, coordinate product demonstrations, and support the conversion of leads into paying customers.

This role is ideal for someone interested in technology sales, enterprise business development, and building customer relationships in a growing AI company.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead Generation and Prospecting

* Identify potential B2B customers across manufacturing, industrial operations, infrastructure, commercial facilities, and other relevant sectors.
* Research target companies, decision-makers, and potential use cases for Skynetic's AI solutions.
* Build and maintain a database of prospective clients.
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, email outreach, telephone calls, networking, industry directories, and other relevant channels.
* Identify opportunities where AI and Computer Vision can address operational challenges.

2. B2B Sales and Client Engagement

* Initiate conversations with prospective clients through calls, emails, LinkedIn, and in-person meetings.
* Understand customer requirements, business challenges, and existing operational processes.
* Communicate Skynetic's offerings and their potential business value in a clear, customer-oriented manner.
* Schedule client meetings, discovery calls, and product demonstrations.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and maintain engagement throughout the sales cycle.

3. Opportunity Development and Conversion

* Qualify leads based on customer requirements, business potential, budgets, and buying timelines.
* Coordinate with technical teams to assess the feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, quotations, and commercial documentation.
* Track opportunities from initial contact through negotiations and closure.
* Support the leadership team in converting qualified prospects into pilot projects, paid engagements, and long-term customers.

4. CRM and Sales Reporting

* Maintain an organised database of leads, contacts, meetings, follow-ups, and sales opportunities.
* Update the CRM or sales tracker regularly.
* Prepare periodic reports on lead generation, outreach, meetings, pipeline progress, and conversions.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and minimise opportunities lost due to poor coordination.
* Track customer feedback and share market insights with the leadership team.

5. Market Research and Business Development

* Research industries, customer segments, competitors, and emerging opportunities for AI adoption.
* Identify potential channel partners, system integrators, consultants, and industry associations.
* Assist in developing targeted outreach campaigns for specific industries and use cases.
* Help prepare sales collateral, case studies, pitch decks, and client-facing presentations.
* Contribute ideas to improve sales processes, messaging, and customer acquisition.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in approaching new people and initiating business conversations.
* Good research, analytical, and organisational skills.
* Strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Basic proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint or Google Slides.
* Willingness to learn about AI, Computer Vision, and enterprise technology solutions.
* A proactive attitude, persistence, and a target-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Development is an advantage.
* Prior experience in B2B sales, lead generation, telecalling, business development, or customer acquisition is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn prospecting, email outreach, CRM tools, or sales automation platforms is an advantage.
* Interest in technology sales, industrial solutions, SaaS, AI, or enterprise software.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on the role and experience level, including:

* Number of relevant prospects identified and qualified.
* Quality and consistency of outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.
* Number of qualified meetings and product demonstrations scheduled.
* Follow-up discipline and accuracy of CRM records.
* Value and quality of opportunities added to the sales pipeline.
* Conversion of qualified leads into proposals, pilots, and paid projects.
* Contribution to customer acquisition and revenue generation.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable talking to business owners, plant heads, operations managers, facility managers, and other decision-makers.

The ideal candidate should be curious enough to understand a customer's business problem, confident enough to initiate a conversation, and persistent enough to follow through until there is a clear outcome.

Prior technical knowledge is not essential. The ability to learn Skynetic's solutions and communicate their business value effectively is more important.

**Learning and Growth Opportunities**

* Hands-on experience in B2B technology sales and enterprise business development.
* Exposure to AI, Computer Vision, Industrial AI, and enterprise technology applications.
* Direct interaction with company leadership, technical teams, and prospective customers.
* Experience managing the complete sales process, from lead generation to deal closure.
* Opportunities to grow into a Business Development Executive, Account Manager, or Business Development Manager role.

**About Us**
------------

CloudifyOps is a company with **DevOps** and **Cloud** in our DNA. CloudifyOps enables businesses to become more agile and innovative through a comprehensive portfolio of services that addresses hybrid IT transformation, Cloud transformation, and end-to-end DevOps Workflows.

We are a proud Advance Partner of Amazon Web Services and have deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform solutions.

We are passionate about what we do. The novelty and the excitement of helping our customers accomplish their goals drives us to become excellent at what we do.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Culture at CloudifyOps :**  
Working at CloudifyOps is a rewarding experience! Great people, a work environment that thrives on creativity, and the opportunity to take on roles beyond a defined job description are just some of the reasons you should work with us.

**About the role :**  
As Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you own the technical side of our pursuits, from first discovery call to signed SoW and handoff to delivery. You will be the Senior Engineer in the pre-sales team, shape CloudifyOps' cloud, DevOps and AI transformation offerings, and act as the trusted advisor to enterprise and startup clients. You sit between Sales, Delivery and Technology, and you are expected to turn customer problems into differentiated, AI-enabled solutions that can be delivered and priced with confidence.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be in front of customers and in the architecture, while also building the assets, benchmarks and standard plays that let the whole team win more consistently.

**What will you do :**

**Solutioning and architecture**

* Design cloud infrastructure, DevOps and platform engineering solutions across AWS, Azure and GCP, and recommend the best-fit approach with clear trade-offs.
* Own end-to-end solutioning for RFIs and RFPs, including architecture, SoWs, effort estimates and cost models.
* Ensure solutions in every SoW follow best practice, match client requirements and are deliverable by our teams.

**AI transformation**

* Shape and position our AI transformation offerings: agentic AI for cloud migration and modernization, AIOps and autonomous operations, AI-assisted DevOps/DevSecOps, and AgentOps governance.
* Run AI readiness and use-case discovery workshops with client CTO, CIO and engineering leaders, and translate them into prioritized roadmaps and PoCs.
* Define where AI delivers measurable value (planning, estimation, IaC generation, code refactoring, incident response) and where it does not, with clear guardrails for data security, governance and cost.
* Work with the CTO office and engineering teams to feed customer needs back into our AI platforms and accelerators.

**Customer engagement and PoCs**

* Plan, build and deliver compelling PoCs and demos that show business value, including AI-powered migration, assessment and operations scenarios.
* Act as subject matter expert for end-to-end DevOps: configuration management, CI/CD, release engineering, provisioning and Day-2 automation.
* Build trust with customers through technical depth, strategic thinking and execution.

* Partner with Sales, Marketing and Alliances to build winning proposals, standard plays, upsell and cross-sell motions, and new service offerings that build pipeline.
* Build and maintain a repository of reusable pre-sales assets, pricing and effort benchmarks, and standard tools and processes.
* Work with Delivery for a smooth handoff and technical oversight after the deal closes.
* Identify trends, risks and issues that need escalation, and operate within defined SOPs.

**Requirements :**

* 8–12 years of overall experience, with at least 5 years in pre-sales, solution architecture or technical consulting for cloud and DevOps. Prior experience leading or mentoring a team.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure and GCP, including designing application and infrastructure architectures and hybrid/multi-cloud strategies.
* Proven experience migrating and modernizing workloads to cloud, including assessment, wave planning, containerization and Kubernetes.
* Strong DevOps background: CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), GitOps, observability and DevSecOps.
* Experience with cloud cost calculators and building accurate cost, effort and TCO estimates.
* Working knowledge of AI and agentic AI applied to engineering and operations (LLMs, agent frameworks, AIOps), and the ability to explain it credibly to executives and engineers.
* Track record of owning RFIs/RFPs, SoWs and PoCs, and of working closely with Sales on winning deals.
* Excellent presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills, from CXO briefings to technical deep dives.

**Good to Have**

* Certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, CKA/CKAD or Terraform Associate.
* Hands-on exposure to LangChain, LangGraph or similar agent frameworks, and to LLM observability and prompt management.
* Experience with FinOps, platform engineering and managed services (SRE, 24×7 operations) pre-sales.
* Experience building service offerings, partner plays or productized accelerators.

This unique role bridges the gap between deep technical defense and strategic business growth. If you thrive on the front lines of cyber defense and enjoy driving pre-sales strategy, this leadership position is your next career milestone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SOC Operations & Technical Leadership**

* **Command the Center:** Direct the daily operations of our multi-tiered (L1/L2/L3) SOC team, managing incident validation, prioritization, and response execution.

* **Deliver Executive Reporting:** Design and present transparent, impact-driven security dashboards and technical briefings for both internal leadership and client executives.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Framework Fluency:** Advanced comprehension of incident response frameworks, threat modeling, and industry standards, including **MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and ISO 27001**.
* **Elite Communication:** Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and articulation skills tailored for technical engineers and C-level stakeholders alike.
* **Pre-Sales Acumen:** Direct experience designing technical proposals, calculating resource estimations, and building competitive service pricing structures.

**Preferred Qualifications (But not mandatory)**

* Prior experience delivering pre-sales support within a premier **MSSP** or global cybersecurity consulting firm.

At Terralogic, your expertise will directly shape our defensive architecture and drive commercial success. We provide an empowering, highly technical ecosystem where strategic innovation is prioritized, leadership is autonomous, and global career progression is realized.

Advance your leadership trajectory today. **Apply now to command the next generation of digital defense.**

You’ve proven you can sell.

You’ve exceeded quota, built pipeline from scratch and won new business. Now you’re looking for the next step. You’ll own a territory of Indian organisations with **1,000–5,000 employees**, managing complex HR technology sales opportunities, engaging executive stakeholders and helping customers move from manual, fragmented or legacy processes to modern, connected and data-driven workforce solutions.

You’ll be trusted to own your territory while being supported by experienced leaders, Solution Consultants, Marketing and Business Development teams that help you succeed.

You’ll work with fast-growing and established businesses—including promoter-led companies, GCCs and organisations with distributed or frontline workforces—helping them improve payroll accuracy, workforce visibility, manager effectiveness and employee experience.

* 5+ years of success in SaaS sales or running your own successful business.

You don’t need Enterprise Sales experience.

title: Cargo Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Cathay is a premium travel lifestyle brand based in Hong Kong, bringing people closer to the places, experiences and opportunities that matter to them. Our purpose — to move people forward in life — begins with our own people.
  
  
Across our airlines, cargo and lifestyle businesses, it is our people who turn journeys into experiences and ambition into progress. Joining Cathay means being part of a global and inclusive community, driven by thoughtful care, progressive attitude and a can-do spirit — and supported to grow through a meaningful career that moves with you.
  
  
If you are seeking an opportunity to take flight, let your ambitions propel you higher and further. Make Your Career Move, together with Cathay.
  
  
**Role Introduction**
Reports to Regional Cargo Trade Sales Manager – SAMEA
  
  
To achieve and exceed agreed Global and Trade sales targets through the effective use of data, market intelligence, and customer insights. The role is responsible for acquiring new business, strengthening Cathay Cargo’s presence in existing and emerging markets, and proactively managing Global and Trade accounts to deliver sustainable revenue growth. The Account Manager will develop and execute commercial strategies across the assigned ports, drive performance from key accounts and special products, support digital and process improvement initiatives, and provide strong commercial governance while representing Cathay Cargo as the local port commercial lead.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Acquire high-value HBA and SBA business, generate quality sales leads and apply consultative, insight-led selling techniques to identify new commercial opportunities.
* Develop and execute port-level commercial strategies covering incentive structures, yield optimisation, customer agreements and revenue growth across key Global and Trade accounts.
* Grow special-product business across pharmaceuticals, perishables, express, e-commerce, valuables and live animals through clear targets and regular performance reviews.
* Manage customer portfolios, prioritise the highest revenue-generating accounts and conduct business reviews to increase market share, profitability and share of wallet.
* Govern contracts, tariffs, incentives and discount approvals while addressing revenue leakage, discrepancies, escalations and customer disputes in line with company policy.
* Deliver weekly and monthly account plans, conduct monthly sales reviews with Cargo Sales Support Assistant Managers and provide timely revenue updates to the reporting managers.
* Lead port-level adoption of e-booking, digital contracts, customer relationship management systems, reporting dashboards and automation while supporting change management.
* Promote LEAN thinking, continuous process improvement, appropriate use of artificial intelligence tools and cost-saving initiatives.
* Collaborate with Pricing, Customer Relationship Management, Operations, Finance, Regional Commercial, Global Sales and Trade Sales teams to align customer strategies, contracts and execution.
* Drive revenue growth from key Global and Trade accounts by prioritising high-value opportunities and improving the quality and profitability of the customer portfolio.

**Requirements**
**Academic Qualifications**

* University degree or tertiary qualification in business, logistics, supply chain, aviation, commerce, or a related discipline.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Marketing, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field is preferred.
* Additional certification or diploma in logistics, supply chain management, aviation sales, or commercial management is an advantage.

**Knowledge, Skills, Training And Experience**

* 3 – 5 years in Cargo commercial sales.
* Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to translate market insights into actionable sales plans.
* Proven capability in customer portfolio management, revenue growth, negotiation, and relationship management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data, dashboards, and market intelligence to support decision-making.
* Good understanding of cargo products, airfreight operations, customer segments, revenue management, and competitive market dynamics.
* High level of digital awareness, with a continuous improvement mindset and ability to support adoption of new tools, systems, and processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrix, multicultural, and geographically dispersed environment.
* Candidates must have the legal right to live and work in India.

**Benefits**
https://careers.cathaypacific.com/who-we-are/why-work-here
  
  
Cathay is proud to offer eligible employees competitive compensation & benefits package, as varied by location, regularly scheduled hours worked, length of employment and employment status as highlighted below.
  
  

* Travel Privileges on Cathay Pacific Airways Global Network
* Extensive well-being programs including health and employee assistance program benefits to help you stay well.
* Paid Leave
* If this position requires a uniform, a uniform allowance will be provided.

**Personal & Application Information**
Cathay Pacific is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly in accordance with our personal data policy and for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
All related information will be kept in our file for up to 24 months. A copy of our Personal Information Collection Statement will be provided upon request by contacting our Data Protection Officer.

All job opportunities are published exclusively on our official website. We advise applicants not to apply through or respond to any third-party websites or domains. Kindly exercise caution and avoid unsolicited offers from unofficial sources.

Job Description – E-commerce & Marketplace Executive

**Brand:** ULAMARA  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 2–4 years preferred

**About the Role**

ULAMARA is looking for an **E-commerce & Marketplace Executive** to take ownership of the day-to-day management and growth of our online sales channels.

Our products are already listed online, and the selected candidate will be responsible for monitoring marketplace performance, maintaining listing quality, managing inventory visibility, coordinating promotions, tracking sales, handling marketplace issues, and identifying opportunities to improve online revenue.

The role requires someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, commercially aware, and comfortable working across multiple online marketplaces.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and monitor ULAMARA product listings across e-commerce marketplaces.
* Ensure product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, specifications, and other listing information remain accurate and updated.
* Monitor listing health and resolve suppressed, inactive, or incorrect listings.
* Track daily orders, sales, cancellations, returns, and refunds.
* Monitor stock availability and coordinate with the warehouse team to avoid stock-outs.
* Maintain catalogue hygiene including pricing, variants, pack sizes, images, and inventory status.
* Coordinate marketplace promotions, coupons, discounts, deals, and seasonal campaigns.
* Monitor ratings, reviews, customer feedback, and recurring product concerns.
* Track competitor products, pricing, offers, discounts, and marketplace positioning.
* Identify opportunities for product bundles, combo packs, cross-selling, and promotional offers.
* Monitor marketplace account health and platform notifications.
* Coordinate with the design team for listing images, banners, A+ content, and promotional creatives.
* Coordinate with the sales, finance, and operations teams for pricing, inventory, settlements, and fulfilment.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly marketplace sales reports.
* Analyse SKU-wise performance and identify fast-moving and slow-moving products.
* Track platform fees, commissions, advertising costs, returns, and other marketplace expenses.
* Support marketplace advertising and promotional campaigns wherever applicable.
* Recommend improvements to listings, pricing, promotions, and product presentation based on performance data.
* Support expansion into additional e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms as the business grows.

**Platforms**

The role may involve managing channels such as:

* Amazon
* Flipkart
* Own website / D2C store
* Quick-commerce platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, or other relevant platforms
* Additional marketplaces introduced by the company

**Skills & Requirements**

* 2–4 years of experience in e-commerce, marketplace operations, online sales, or catalogue management preferred.
* Experience with Amazon Seller Central and other marketplace seller platforms preferred.
* Understanding of product listings, pricing, promotions, inventory, returns, and marketplace operations.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to analyse sales, inventory, pricing, and SKU-level performance.
* Good coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple products and online channels simultaneously.
* Experience in FMCG, food, health products, or consumer goods will be an added advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be measured based on:

* Online sales growth
* Listing accuracy and health
* Stock availability
* Order fulfilment performance
* Return and cancellation rates
* Marketplace ratings and reviews
* Promotion performance
* SKU-wise sales movement
* Inventory ageing
* Marketplace issue-resolution time
* Online channel profitability

**What You Contribute to ULAMARA**

This role directly supports ULAMARA's online revenue by ensuring that our products are:

**Visible → Available → Correctly Priced → Well Presented → Promoted → Monitored → Continuously Improved**

The candidate will act as the primary owner of ULAMARA's e-commerce marketplace operations and will work closely with internal teams to improve online sales and customer experience.

**What We Offer**

* Fixed monthly salary based on experience + Monthly performance-based incentives linked to online sales growth and marketplace performance.
* Incentives may be based on achievement of sales targets, listing health, stock availability, return/cancellation control, promotional performance, and marketplace growth.
* Additional one-time incentives may be provided for successful onboarding and activation of new e-commerce or quick-commerce channels.
* Higher performance incentives may be introduced as online revenue and marketplace responsibility increase.
* Exposure to multiple FMCG and food-product categories.
* Opportunity to manage and grow ULAMARA's online sales channels and Scope to expand into quick-commerce and D2C operations.
* Career progression toward **Senior E-commerce Executive / E-commerce Manager** based on performance.
