**Job Description**

Job Description: Executive, E-commerce Supply Chain (Outright)
  
Company : Purplle House of Brands
  
Function : E-commerce, Supply Chain Executive
  
Reports to Operations Lead
  
Location: Mumbai
  
Experience: 3-5 years in e-commerce or quick-commerce supply chain (outright/PO-based model)
  
  
Role Summary
  
You will own the end-to-end outright supply chain for our brand portfolio across e-commerce and
  
quick-commerce platforms, from PO receipt to delivery, GRN, returns and payment reconciliation.
  
You will work closely with Key Account Managers, the warehouse, finance and platform supply
  
teams to keep fill rates high, turnaround times short and disputes low.

  

Key Responsibilities
  
1. PO and order management
  

* Receive, validate and process POs from platforms across cities and fulfilment centres.
* Check POs against pricing, MRP, catalogue and inventory before acceptance.
* Raise sales orders, invoices and e-way bills in SAP accurately and on time.

2. Dispatch and delivery
  

* Book appointments and coordinate dispatches with the warehouse and logistics partners.
* Track shipments to delivery and ensure PO validity is not breached.
* Escalate delays, rejections and stuck consignments proactively.

3. Fill rate and availability
  

* Monitor PO fill rate, OTIF and stock availability by platform and city.
* Work with KAMs and planning on stock replenishment, short supply and stock-outs.
* Flag slow-moving and near-expiry inventory early.

4. GRN, returns and disputes
  

* Track GRN status and resolve mismatches, short receipts and rejections.
* Manage RTV, damage and expiry claims, and see them through to credit notes.
* Maintain a clean dispute log with evidence (POD, ASN, invoices).

5. Reconciliation and finance coordination
  

* Reconcile invoices, GRNs, credit notes and payments with platforms and the finance team.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and support month-end closing.

  
6. Reporting and analysis
  

* Build and share daily and weekly MIS: PO status, fill rate, OTIF, pending GRNs, claims and

aging.
  

* Analyse trends and root causes, and present findings clearly to leadership and stakeholders.

7. Process and stakeholder management
  

* Be the single point of contact for platform supply chain, warehouse, finance and internal

sales teams.
  

* Document SOPs and drive process improvements and automation.

Requirements
  
Education: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (Commerce, Supply Chain, Business or similar
  
preferred).
  
Experience: 3-5 years in e-commerce, quick-commerce or FMCG/D2C supply chain, with hands-on
  
exposure to platform POs, appointments and GRN.
  
Must-have skills
  

* Advanced MS Excel: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas and data cleaning.
* Working knowledge of SAP (invoicing, sales orders, stock and reports).
* Data presentation: clear dashboards, MIS and PowerPoint summaries.
* Stakeholder management: confident dealing with platform teams, warehouses and finance.
* Good spoken and written English.

Additional Skills and Good to Have
  
Recommended skills
  

* Knowledge of platform vendor portals (Nykaa, Myntra, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Flipkart,

Amazon).
  

* Understanding of GST, e-way bills, invoicing and credit-note flows.
* Strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail, since small PO or invoice errors become

payment disputes.
  

* Ability to work under tight dispatch and appointment timelines.
* Basic Power BI/Looker or Google Sheets automation (good to have).

Good to have
  

* Experience in beauty, personal care or FMCG.
* Exposure to quick-commerce city-level PO handling.

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)
  

* Fill rate and OTIF at or above agreed targets.
* Faster PO-to-dispatch turnaround.
* Fewer GRN mismatches and aged claims.
* Timely, accurate daily and weekly reporting.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Services Sales Executive-IT Sale
description:
**SERVICES SALES EXECUTIVE — INDIA**

Software Development & Managed Engineering · 12th Wonder · Pune

12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven — 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews.

What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India.

**THE ROLE**

This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them.

**You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers**
— identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan.

**You own your territory and your number.**
You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity — but the deal is yours to win or lose.

**Your buyer:**
India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments — automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~₹20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan–Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a morning's drive.

**WHAT YOU'RE SELLING**

Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models:

**Custom software development.**
Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients — web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships.

**Managed engineering teams.**
Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the client's product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure.

Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a ₹15–25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3–5x the initial contract value

**MILESTONES**

***Exhibit 1: Year-one de***

**First 30 days**

Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live.

**First 60 days**

Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision-maker.

﻿First 90 days

Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation

**First 180 days**

First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts

**End of year one**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue — roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team.

**COMPENSATION**

Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather be transparent about the economics than quote an OTE and let you reverse-engineer it.

***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***

Fixed ₹12–15L

Target ₹75 lakh

Variable Plan ₹5.6L

OTE AT Plan ₹18–21L

**FIXARGE**
**VARIABLE AT PLA**
**OTE AT PLA**

**Variable is a flat 7.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.**
The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1 crore and the plan pays ₹7.5L variable, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin. We're not going to pay you to discount, and you shouldn't want a plan that does.

**DETAILS**

***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***

**Location**

Pune. Remote (India) considered for strong candidates, with monthly onsite weeks.

**Buyer geography**

India-domiciled enterprises

**Reports to**

Chief Operating Officer

**Year-one target**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue

**Typical deal size**

~₹20 lakh

**Travel**

~30%, primarily metro India and the Pune industrial belt

**Team**

Individual contributor. Pre-sales and delivery support on qualified deals.

**Start**

Immediate

**HOW HIRING WORKS**

Three conversations over about two weeks:

**1. Screening call (30 min)**
— your track record, deal examples, and whether the buyer profile matches what you've sold.

**2. Pipeline walkthrough (60 min)**
— pick one of your best deals and walk us through it end-to-end: how you found it, how you qualified it, how you closed it, and what you'd do differently.

**3. Leadership conversation (45 min)**
— with the COO: territory, the number, and the terms.

Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Title: Business Development Executive
  
  
Function: Business Development — Outbound / Pre-Sales
  
  
Location: Pune
  
  
Reporting To: BD Manager
  
  
Experience: 2–4 years
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Candidates without outbound B2B sales, cold calling, or lead generation experience are requested not to apply. Profiles from research, consulting, KPO, or professional services with active outbound experience are strongly preferred.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This is a front-line, high-activity outbound role at the commercial engine of Quesrow. As a Business Development Executive, you will identify target accounts, initiate outreach across calls, email, and LinkedIn, qualify opportunities, and generate a consistent pipeline of meetings for Partners and Senior Consultants.
  
  
You will be reaching out to CFOs, Strategy Heads, Investment Directors, and senior decision-makers at PE funds, industrial conglomerates, and global producers. This is not a passive role — it demands commercial sharpness, research rigour, and the discipline to show up and dial every single day.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Outbound Prospecting: Build and maintain a structured database of target accounts across metals, materials, industrials, energy transition, and critical minerals. Execute high-volume, targeted cold calling and multi-channel outreach — phone, email, LinkedIn — in a sequenced, personalised approach.
* Meeting Generation: Identify and qualify commercial opportunities. Generate and schedule qualified meetings for senior stakeholders — meetings with clear context, the right attendee, and a defined agenda. Own the full outreach-to-meeting conversion funnel.
* Research-Backed Outreach: Use your market research background to personalise outreach — understand the prospect's business, spot relevant triggers, and craft messages that land. No generic templates.
* CRM & Pipeline Discipline: Maintain complete and accurate CRM records at all times. Track daily and weekly activity — calls made, conversations held, meetings scheduled, show-up rates. No orphaned contacts.
* Follow-Up & Nurture: Own re-engagement and nurture campaigns for unresponsive prospects. Persistence is as important as first contact.
* Pre-Meeting Support: Coordinate with BD Managers and Partners for clean handovers. Support pre-meeting research and post-meeting follow-up to keep pipeline momentum going.

**What We're Looking For**
Experience & Education:
  
  

* Graduate or postgraduate in any discipline — background in research, economics, or business preferred.
* 2–4 years of demonstrated outbound B2B sales, cold calling, or lead generation experience — not inbound, not account management.
* Prior experience in consulting, research, KPO, analytics, or professional services is a strong advantage.
* Exposure to market research — primary or secondary — is essential. You understand the industry context of what you're selling.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Confident cold caller — structured, high-volume, and comfortable with CXO conversations.
* Strong outbound instinct — you research before you reach out, and you personalise every touch.
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
* Proficient with CRM tools (Zoho / HubSpot / Salesforce or structured Excel) and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Familiar with AI tools for research and outreach personalisation at scale.

**Mindset**

* Hunter. You look for the next target, the next conversation, the next meeting — you don't wait.
* Comfortable with rejection — you treat a 'no' as data, not defeat.
* Disciplined — you maintain the cadence on days when it's not working.
* Commercially curious — you can explain to a prospect why Quesrow is worth 30 minutes, in terms that matter to them.

**How We Measure Success**

* Meaningful conversations: 8–12 / day
* Qualified prospects identified: 15–25 / week
* Qualified meetings scheduled: 8–12 / month
* Meeting show-up rate: >80%
* CRM hygiene: 100% — records updated within 24 hours

**Before You Apply**
Please apply only if you have:
  
  
→ Minimum 2 years of active outbound B2B cold calling as a core daily activity.
  
  
→ A market research or research-adjacent background — you understand sectors, not just scripts.
  
  
→ Generated qualified meetings for senior stakeholders — not just leads passed along.
  
  
→ Specific, measurable examples of outbound performance you can speak to.
  
  
At Quesrow, we move with precision and purpose. If you're a researcher at heart and a hunter by instinct — this role was built for you.

title: Sales Executive - Australian Market
description:
**About us**

Qamira Consulting helps businesses grow through process optimisation, automation, digital marketing and lead generation. Team Qamira brings years of expertise in performance excellence and process optimisation.

You will join our team and work full-time on the account of one of our clients, an established company in Melbourne, Australia.

**About the role**

You will be the first voice our client's customers hear after they request a quote or a callback on its website or other channels. You call them, understand their request, give them a clear quote and confirm the booking. When website enquiries are slow, you find and win work on other official platforms.

You are employed by Qamira Consulting, work from home in Pune, and work Melbourne business hours.

**What you'll do**

* Call every new quote request and callback request quickly, ideally within 10 minutes during your shift, and keep following up by phone, SMS, whatsapp and email until you reach them.
* Find out what the customer needs.
* Turn that into an accurate quote using the client's rate card, pricing template and instant-quote tool, and explain clearly what is included.
* Handle questions and objections on price, timing, insurance and trust, and close the booking without hard selling.
* Follow-up on every open quote until it is booked or closed out.
* Win jobs on relevant platforms (part of your training) through the client's accounts: write clear offers, answer customer questions and convert them to bookings, following each platform's rules.
* Pass every booked job to the client's operations team with complete details, so the team is prepared for it.
* Log every call, outcome and next step in our CRM or lead tracker the same day.
* Send a short daily report and tell us which objections and questions keep coming up.

**How success is measured**

* Speed to first call on new enquiries
* Share of enquiries you reach
* Quote-to-booking conversion rate
* Number of completed bookings each month, from the website and from platforms
* Accuracy of quotes and booking details, measured by changes needed on the day of the move

**What we're looking for**

* 1-3 years in telesales, inside sales or an international voice process, ideally with customers in Australia, the UK or the US.
* Excellent spoken and written English. You speak clearly, follow Australian accents and phrasing with ease, and write clean, friendly, professional messages.
* A record of meeting call, conversion or booking targets.
* Confidence on the phone: you build rapport fast, ask good questions and ask for the booking.
* Comfort with a CRM, Google Sheets, email, SMS and WhatsApp, and online marketplaces.
* Organised and reliable, with honest, accurate records.
* Based in Pune, and able to work Melbourne business hours consistently, which means an early-morning shift in India.

**Good to have**

* Experience selling logistics, home services or real estate.
* Experience quoting or bidding on online platforms.
* Familiarity with Melbourne suburbs, or a willingness to learn them quickly.

**Shift and location**

* Location: Pune, work from home
* Employer: Qamira Consulting, working on an Australian client account
* Shift: 9:00am to 6:00pm Melbourne time
* Shift in India time: 3:30am to 12:30pm IST from October to early April (Melbourne daylight saving); 4:30am to 1:30pm IST for the rest of the year
* Working days: 6 days a week; weekly off rotate and can fall on any day
* Employment type: Full-time
* Experience: 1-3 years

Equipment: We provide a laptop, headset, CRM and platform access. You need reliable broadband and a quiet place to work.

We will train you on our client's services and pricing, Melbourne geography and the platforms you will use.

**How to apply**

 Apply through https://www.qamiraconsulting.com/careers/sales-executive-australia

description:

As the largest manufacturer of wheels for the global marketplace, Maxion Wheels is continually seeking motivated individuals who have what it takes to make a positive impact on our business and our customers. **Key Account Manager**
The Key Account Manager (KAM) to lead business development and sales initiatives in alignment with our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Business Plan (BP). This role is responsible for managing OEM relationships, driving revenue growth, ensuring receivables discipline, and supporting quality systems compliance.
  
  

* Drive business development and manage sales performance as per AOP/BP.
* Maintain and grow share of business with OEMs.
* Manage cost compensation related to raw materials and other variables.
* Track and analyze market trends and competitor activities.
* Ensure timely collections and adherence to Maxion’s receivables policies.
* Support departmental compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 14000, OHSAS, and other quality systems.

**Your future role**
****Business Development (AOP/BP Aligned)****

* Visit automotive OEMs (excluding 2-wheelers) to introduce Maxion Wheels.
* Track OEM development plans and ensure timely receipt of RFQs.

* Track competitor strategies and make course correction, if required.
* Capture and report final customer decisions (business win/loss).

****Sales Management as per AOP/BP****

* Monitor OEM forecasts and align part-wise sales with AOP/BP targets.
* Ensure volume commitments are met as per agreed share of business.
* Coordinate with internal teams (planning, operations, supply chain) for seamless execution.
* Track daily consumption at OEMs and adjust internal forecasts accordingly.
* Develop contingency plans for volume fluctuations to minimize plant impact.
* Ensure timely and adequate supply to OEMs with agreed stock levels.

****Receivables & Policy Compliance****

* Regular reconciliation of customer accounts.
* Follow up diligently on overdue and due payments.
* Monitor and manage customer-specific credit limits.
* Ensure all documentation complies with Maxion’s financial policies.

****Market & Competitor Analysis****

* Track and report OEM sales trends and market intelligence.
* Monitor share of business based on actual OEM production.
* Maintain competitor activity reports and insights.

**Quality Systems & Documentation**

* Ensure departmental compliance with IATF 16949 and other quality systems.
* Conduct and analyze customer satisfaction surveys; present findings to management.
* Collaborate with MR/Environmental Manager for documentation, audits, and improvement plans.

**Your profile**

* Bachelor of Engineering – Mechanical, MBA – Marketing is a plus
* At least 15 years of relevant experience in Automobile related products and handling reputed Auto OEM’s.
* Culturally sensitive and has the ability and interest to identify and work with a multicultural team
* Ability to work in Matrix Organization
* Conflict Management
* Advanced Excel & presentation skills
* Strong analytical and quantitative competencies
* Understands complex concepts and the relationships between issues or problems
* Effectively communicates across organization and is confident in interacting with senior leadership team
* Exposure of working with various advance sales tools.

Maxion Wheels maintains a written and widely distributed policy on equal employment opportunity. The Company recruits, hires, trains, promotes, administers policies, bases decisions and conducts all personnel activities without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability (to the extent an undue hardship is not imposed), status as a covered veteran or other legally protected status, in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

**General Objective**

The Overseas MBBS Head leads the international medical education division, driving student recruitment, and overseeing end-to-end admission and visa operations for students pursuing MBBS degrees abroad. This role combines strategic business development, team leadership, counselor management, and strict adherence to domestic and international medical education guidelines (e.g., NMC FMGL regulations, WDOMS, and ECFMG accreditation standards).

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Business Development**

* Formulate and execute student recruitment strategies to expand market share across target regions for overseas medical admissions (e.g., Russia, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Georgia, Nepal).
* Plan and execute educational seminars, spot admission drives, webinars, and outreach programs with senior secondary schools and NEET coaching institutes.
* Analyze market trends, regional student preferences, fee structures, and competitive landscapes to build compelling counseling packages and promotional toolkits.

**University Alliances & Institutional Relations**

* Identify, evaluate, and establish strategic tie-ups with accredited foreign medical universities and official university representatives.

**Operations & Admission Pipeline Management**

* Oversee end-to-end admission processing, including candidate profile evaluation, academic document verification, apostille/attestation, eligibility certification, and letter of invitation issuance.

**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regulations set by bodies such as the National Medical Commission (NMC), Foreign Medical Graduate Licensure (FMGL) rules, and WHO/WDOMS recognitions.

* Oversee CRM workflow and database integrity, producing weekly and monthly performance reports on conversion metrics, operational bottlenecks, and projected revenue.

**Required skills and qualifications**

* **Education** - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Education Management, or a related discipline.

* **Core Competencies** - Sales leadership, pipeline conversion, institutional negotiation, public speaking, crisis management, and cross-cultural communication.
* **Languages** - Fluent in English, Hindi and Marathi. Working knowledge of Russian or other regional languages is a strong plus.

description:

**About UniAthena**

https://uniathena.com/about-us/our-background is a prominent global Ed-Tech organization headquartered in Oxford, United Kingdom. We specialize in offering flexible, self-paced online higher education, academic degree programs, and executive upskilling courses. In collaboration with top accredited international universities and professional bodies (such as OTHM-UK and CIQ), we deliver highly affordable, stackable, and workplace-relevant learning certifications to professionals across more than 60 countries. Our core mission is to make premium, job-ready higher education globally accessible.

  

**Role Objective**

The Business Development Team is responsible for acquiring enrollments by engaging with prospective learners from first contact through enrollment. The role focuses on converting intent into action, building a sustainable enrollment funnel, and expanding reach through both inbound and self-generated leads.

**Roles and responsibilities**

* Own all inbound inquiries across calls, email, WhatsApp, chat, and web forms, ensuring timely response and consistent follow-through until enrollment or clear closure.
* Engage prospects in structured discovery conversations to understand their goals, background, readiness to enroll, and decision-making constraints.
* Lead sales discussions with clarity and purpose, guiding prospects toward informed and timely enrollment decisions.
* Present program offerings transparently and confidently, covering structure, duration, fees, certification value, learning outcomes, and expectations.
* Connect learner needs with relevant program benefits, clearly explaining how the offering aligns with their academic, professional, or career goals.
* Address questions and concerns around pricing, workload, credibility, timelines, and outcomes with honesty, data, and confidence.
* Drive enrollments using clear next steps, timely follow-ups, and well-defined closure conversations.
* Build and manage a strong enrollment funnel, ensuring every lead is actively progressed, reviewed, or intentionally closed.
* Maintain discipline within the pipeline by documenting interactions, tracking next actions, and avoiding stagnant or unworked leads.
* Proactively generate leads through LinkedIn outreach, referrals, professional networks, and personal prospecting efforts.
* Follow up consistently and thoughtfully to keep prospects engaged until they enroll, opt out, or move into long-term re-engagement cycles.
* Take ownership of assigned enrollment targets, regularly reviewing performance and adjusting outreach strategies to stay on track.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in CRM systems, ensuring visibility into lead status, conversations, and outcomes.
* Identify early signs of drop-off and attempt revival before leads age out of the active funnel.
* Adhere to ethical communication practices when providing information about programs.
* Follow responsible marketing practices by aligning all interactions with data privacy norms, respectful communication standards, and culturally sensitive messaging across regions.
* Work closely with the Admissions, IT, Data, and Academic teams to ensure enrolled learners experience a smooth handover, complete documentation, and a seamless onboarding journey.
* Share insights, concerns, and patterns observed in learner conversations with Marketing and internal teams to continuously improve messaging, targeting, and program positioning.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Communications, or a related discipline.
* Strong verbal and written communication, persuasion, negotiation, and counselling skills.
* Ability to convert inbound inquiries into enrollments through effective sales conversations, objection handling, and consistent follow-ups.
* Experience or aptitude in lead generation, prospecting, pipeline management, and achieving sales targets.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, spreadsheets, and digital communication tools; ability to maintain accurate lead records and track conversions.
* Strong interpersonal skills, analytical thinking, self-motivation, and the ability to engage professionally with international prospects in a target-driven environment.

**What We Offer (Benefits & Perks):**

* High Performance Variables: Competitive, uncapped incentive structures aligned with enrollment metrics.
* Fast-Track Career Advancement: Verified history of rapid promotions and appraisals (rated heavily for career growth and skill development by current employees).
* Aptitude & Technical Training: Structured onboarding covering international education standards, global consumer consulting, and modern CRM systems.
* Flexible & Modern Culture: Highly collaborative workspace emphasizing a strong work-life balance (rated 4.1/5 by team members) and zero micromanagement.
* Global Networking: Exposure to communicating with international learners and educational professionals across diverse regional domains.

Client Relationship & Business Development Executive

**Company:** Project Dream Cars  
**Job Location: Delhi NCR (Preferred: North Delhi**)  
**Department:** Operations / Sales / Customer Relations  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Salary:** ₹18,000–25,000 per month (Negotiable for the right candidate)

Job Description

Project Dream Cars is looking for a confident, organised and proactive Client Relationship & Business Development Executive to manage customer relationships, coordinate business operations and generate new business opportunities.

The candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, banks, financial institutions, insurance providers and business partners, ensuring smooth and timely execution of day-to-day activities.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle customer enquiries and maintain professional communication through phone calls, WhatsApp and email.
* Coordinate with customers for document collection and ensure complete documentation for loan and financial applications.
* Liaise with banks, NBFCs, financial institutions and insurance companies.
* Manage end-to-end customer coordination, from initial enquiry to application processing and closure.
* Follow up with customers, banks and other stakeholders regarding pending documents, approvals and application status.
* Handle customer relationships for car sales, car financing, motor insurance, home loans, loans against property and unsecured loans.
* Generate new business through existing customer databases, referrals, incoming enquiries and follow-up calls.
* Maintain accurate customer records, lead databases and daily activity reports.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and provide customers with regular updates.
* Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth day-to-day business operations.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer relationship and coordination skills.
* Good follow-up and organisational abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, WhatsApp and email.
* Ability to handle multiple customers and tasks simultaneously.
* Confidence in communicating with banks, customers and business partners.
* Sales-oriented mindset with the ability to identify business opportunities.

Eligibility Criteria

* Graduate in any discipline (B.Com, BBA or equivalent preferred).
* 1–3 years of relevant work experience preferred.
* Experience in banking, NBFCs, loan processing, insurance, sales or customer relationship management will be an advantage.
* Freshers with excellent communication and interpersonal skills may also apply.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and capabilities.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to take ownership of customer relationships and business operations.
* Professional working environment.
* Long-term growth opportunities.

**Ideal Candidate:** Someone who is responsible, confident, proactive and capable of independently managing customer communication, documentation, follow-ups and business coordination.

Pay: ₹17,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

title: Commercial Operations Apprentice
description:
### **Description**

**Job Title:** Commercial Operations Apprentice

**Location:** DLF Cyber Hub, Gurugram
  
  
**Program Duration:** 12-Month Apprenticeship

**Schedule:** We are hiring 3 **Commercial Operations Apprentices**, each aligned to a different sales region. One apprentice will support the **APAC region and work primarily during Australia/APAC business hours**, one apprentice will support the **EMEA region and work primarily during UK business hours**, and one apprentice will support the **North America region and work primarily during Eastern Time (ET) business hours**. To support collaboration, learning, and cohort development, all apprentices will also work a designated block of **India business hours one day per week** to participate in training, mentoring, and apprenticeship program activities. exact schedule will be confirmed at time of offer, should you be selected for the role

**About the Program**

The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.

**Eligibility**

To be considered for this apprenticeship, candidates must:

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**

At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.

**Role Overview**  
  
The Commercial Operations Apprentice supports Eptura's sales organization by assisting with customer transactions, quote preparation, contract administration, and order processing activities.

This role helps accelerate customer responsiveness while allowing sales representatives to focus on larger and more strategic opportunities.

### **Responsibilities**

  

* Create sales quotes within Salesforce and related business systems
* Support small customer transactions and commercial requests
* Assist customers with license additions, upgrades, and other routine commercial activities
* Generate pricing requests using established approval processes
* Coordinate contract preparation and customer documentation
* Send agreements for signature and track completion status
* Support order processing and transaction fulfillment activities
* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information within Salesforce
* Partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Deal Desk, and Finance teams
* Ensure data quality and adherence to established sales processes
* Participate in apprenticeship learning programs, coaching sessions, and development activities

**What You'll Learn**

* SaaS sales processes
* Salesforce CRM
* Commercial operations and deal administration
* Quote-to-cash lifecycle
* Customer communication best practices
* Contract and pricing fundamentals
* Cross-functional collaboration in a global organization

  

### **About You**

  

* Degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Marketing, Communications, or a related field
* Strong attention to detail
* Excellent written communication skills
* Comfort working with systems and technology
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Monthly stipend of 21,000 INR
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hybrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information:**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

**Our Approach to AI**

At Eptura, we believe AI will increasingly shape how work gets done. We are looking for people who are curious about that future and excited to learn how to use AI responsibly alongside human judgment, creativity, critical thinking, and collaboration.

You do not need to arrive as an AI expert. We are looking for someone with the curiosity to learn, the confidence to experiment responsibly, and the mindset to continuously ask: Is there a smarter way to do this?

**After the Apprenticeship**

The apprenticeship is a **12-month development program**. Successful completion does not guarantee permanent employment; however, apprentices may be considered for future opportunities based on performance, business needs, and the availability of approved positions.

### **About Eptura**

Ready to make a difference? Explore opportunities with Eptura and join us on this incredible journey.  
  
Joining Eptura means becoming part of a forward-thinking, dynamic team that's on a mission to shape a better, more connected future. We're seeking passionate, driven individuals who want to make a real impact and be at the forefront of workplace innovation.

At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

description:
**Job Title:** Sales Executive — Educational Augmented Reality (AR) Products (Ramayana AR Flash Cards)

**About Mahhayatrah Entertainment**

Mahhayatrah builds culturally-rooted digital learning products for children. Our Ramayana Augmented Reality (AR) flash cards combine storytelling, augmented reality, and tactile play to make learning engaging for ages 4–10. We’re looking for a driven Sales Executive to grow distribution, onboard dealers, and drive school, retail, and regional channel sales.

**Role Summary**

You will own field sales and distributor onboarding for the Ramayana AR flash card product. The role requires active travel across assigned territories, building relationships with distributors, retail chains, toy stores, school buyers, and education resellers. You will coordinate closely with marketing, product, and operations teams to execute promos, demos, and local campaigns that convert trials into recurring orders.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify, prospect, and onboard distributors, sub-distributors, and dealer networks in assigned territory.
* Close sales with retail stores, toy shops, school procurement teams, coaching centers, and e-commerce channel partners.
* Conduct product demos and AR experiences for buyers, teachers, and parents; run in-store/demo events.
* Manage territory sales targets, prepare weekly/monthly sales plans, and report pipeline updates.
* Coordinate with marketing on local promotions, demo collateral, and point-of-sale materials; provide feedback from field.
* Negotiate commercial terms, set pricing with dealers, manage credit limits and collections in coordination with finance.
* Train distributor and dealer staff on product features, demo flow, and merchandising best practices.
* Monitor competitor activities, market demand, and customer feedback; suggest product/packaging or pricing improvements.
* Ensure timely order fulfilment by coordinating with operations; follow up on post-sales support and returns.
* Maintain CRM data—contacts, leads, visits, orders, and collections—and prepare periodic sales reports.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 2–5 years of B2B/B2C sales experience selling children’s educational products, toys, learning kits, AR/EdTech products, or school supplies.
* Proven track record of onboarding distributors and building dealer networks.
* Strong demo and presentation skills; comfortable conducting live AR demos to non-technical audiences.
* Good negotiation, relationship-building, and closing skills.
* Ability to travel frequently within territory (typically 60–80% travel).
* Comfortable working independently in field roles, self-motivated, and result-oriented.
* Basic familiarity with CRM tools (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce) and MS Office/Google Workspace.
* Valid driving license or willingness to travel by public transport; own vehicle preferred but not mandatory.

Preferred

* Prior experience selling to schools (K–12 procurement), toy retailers, or regional distributors in North India.
* Contacts in school networks, retail chains, or toy distribution channels.
* Knowledge of local languages (Hindi/Regional) and English.

Location and Travel

* Based in Noida/ Ghaziabad/North Delhi or other North India hub.
* Travel across assigned districts/states as required (frequent day trips and occasional overnight trips).

KPIs / Targets

* Number of distributors onboarded per quarter.
* Monthly revenue booked vs target.
* Retail/dealer penetration and SKU sell-through rates.
* Demo-to-order conversion rate.

Compensation (India guidance)  
Suggested total compensation depends on experience and territory. Figures are gross monthly amounts.

* Early-career (1–3 years): INR 22,000 – 30,000 base + performance incentives
* Mid-level (3–5 years with distributor experience): INR 30,000 – 45,000 base + performance incentives
* Senior/Highly connected (5+ years, proven network): INR 45,000 – 60,000 base + performance incentives.

Travel and food allowances will be reimbursed.

**Incentive structure recommendations**

* Monthly/quarterly sales commission: 1–4% of net sales value or fixed per SKU sold; higher commission for new distributor sign-ups.
* Onboarding bonus: one-time bonus for each qualified distributor onboarded (tiered by territory and expected monthly volume).
* Travel allowance: fixed monthly conveyance + reimbursements for overnight travel (per company policy).
* Quarterly/annual performance bonus tied to revenue, new channel expansion, and collection targets.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement

**Job Description**

**Job Description: Executive/Sr. Executive HR (Retail)**

**Department:** Human Resources

**Function:** Retail

**Location:** North & Central India

**Travel:** Extensive travel across retail stores, Exclusive Brand Outlets (EBOs) and offices as required

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented HR Business Partner to manage end-to-end HR operations and employee lifecycle activities across the North and Central India retail business. The role will partner with business leaders and store teams to ensure seamless HR service delivery, timely payroll processing, employee engagement, performance management, employee relations and statutory compliance.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced retail environment, managing multiple stakeholders, travelling to stores, resolving employee concerns and contributing to HR initiatives that improve business effectiveness and employee experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **1. End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding to transfers, promotions, employee movements and separation.

* Ensure timely completion of joining formalities, documentation, background verification coordination and employee exit formalities.

* Maintain accurate and updated employee records, including employee master data, onboarding trackers, exit trackers and other HR MIS.

* Ensure timely issuance and processing of employment-related documentation and employee requests.

* **2. Attendance and Payroll Coordination**

* Monitor attendance, leave, weekly offs, shift rosters and regularisation within defined timelines.

* Coordinate with store teams, employees and payroll stakeholders to ensure accurate attendance inputs and timely salary disbursement.

* Identify and resolve attendance discrepancies, missing punches, payroll queries and other employee-related issues before payroll closure.

* Track and resolve salary-related concerns through coordination with relevant teams.

* **3. Recruitment and Manpower Fulfilment**

* Coordinate hiring for existing stores and new store openings, based on business requirements.

* Partner with Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders to ensure timely fulfilment of vacancies.

* Support recruitment for store-level positions, including Beauty Advisors, Store Managers and other retail roles, as required.

* Track open positions, joining commitments, offer-to-joining conversions and recruitment-related issues.

* Coordinate with business teams to ensure smooth onboarding and deployment of new hires.

* **4. Vendor Management and Payments**

* Coordinate onboarding, documentation and activation of relevant HR and staffing vendors.

* Follow up with vendors, Finance, Procurement and other stakeholders to ensure timely processing of invoices and payments.

* Maintain vendor-related records and supporting documentation.

* Resolve vendor-related operational issues and ensure adherence to internal processes.

* **5. Employee Relations and Disciplinary Management**

* Address employee grievances, workplace concerns, conflicts and people-related issues in a timely and fair manner.

* Manage disciplinary cases, including absenteeism, misconduct, policy violations and other employee-related matters.

* Coordinate fact-finding, documentation, show-cause notices, employee explanations and disciplinary proceedings in consultation with the relevant stakeholders.

* Advise store managers and business leaders on HR policies, employee conduct and appropriate people-management practices.

* Maintain confidentiality and ensure consistency, fairness and proper documentation in employee relations matters.

* **6. Performance Management and Talent Processes**

* Coordinate annual appraisal cycles, goal setting, mid-year reviews, performance evaluations and calibration exercises.

* Support promotion recommendations, salary corrections and performance improvement plans (PIPs) in coordination with business leaders and relevant HR stakeholders.

* Monitor completion of performance management activities within defined timelines.

* Guide managers on performance conversations, documentation and performance-related employee concerns.

* **7. Employee Engagement and Retention**

* Drive employee engagement initiatives, recognition activities, feedback mechanisms and other interventions to improve the employee experience.

* Conduct regular store visits and interact with employees to understand workplace concerns, morale and engagement levels.

* Analyse attrition trends, exit feedback, absenteeism and employee concerns to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities.

* Partner with business leaders to develop and implement practical retention and engagement initiatives.

* Support employee welfare initiatives and projects that enhance employee benefits and workplace experience.

* **8. HR Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary HR partner for assigned business leaders, regional sales leaders, cluster managers and store managers.

* Provide guidance on people-related matters, HR policies, employee performance, staffing requirements and workplace issues.

* Build strong relationships with frontline employees and business stakeholders through regular store and office visits.

* Collaborate with Finance, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Compliance, Procurement and other internal teams to resolve employee and operational issues.

* Ensure timely communication and implementation of HR policies, processes and business initiatives across the assigned region.

* **9. HRIS, Employee Support and HR Operations**

* Work on the organisation's HRIS, including People Strong, to maintain employee data and support HR transactions.

* Help employees and managers navigate HRIS processes and resolve system-related issues.

* Track employee queries and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution.

* Maintain HR trackers, dashboards, reports and MIS relating to employee movements, attrition, attendance, recruitment, performance and other HR operations.

* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements in HR workflows, documentation and service delivery.

* **10. Statutory Compliance, Documentation and Audit**

* Maintain complete and accurate employee records, trackers and supporting documents required for audits and compliance reviews.

* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to support statutory compliance across applicable establishments.

* Ensure timely coordination for statutory documentation, notices, registers, records and audit requirements.

* Track compliance gaps and coordinate corrective actions with the relevant stakeholders.

* **11. HR Projects and Process Improvement**

* Take ownership of HR projects and cross-functional initiatives that improve business effectiveness, employee experience and HR service delivery.

* Support regional and pan-India retail HR initiatives, including policy implementation, employee feedback programmes, compensation parity reviews and process improvements, as assigned.

* Work collaboratively with business and functional teams to implement initiatives within agreed timelines.

* Measure the effectiveness of HR interventions and recommend improvements based on employee feedback and business needs.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of HR operations and HR business partnering in a retail or multi-location environment.

* Good knowledge of the employee lifecycle, attendance and payroll processes, employee relations and performance management.

* Understanding of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.

* Proficiency in HRIS platforms, preferably People Strong, and MS Excel/Google Sheets.

* Strong coordination, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently and meet strict operational deadlines.

* Good communication, interpersonal skills, confidentiality and attention to detail.

* Willingness to travel frequently to stores, EBOs and offices across the assigned region.

* A proactive, employee-centric and business-oriented approach, with the ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Smooth and timely execution of employee lifecycle and HR operational processes.

* Accurate employee records and timely attendance and payroll inputs.

* Timely recruitment coordination and onboarding for existing and new stores.

* Effective resolution of employee queries, grievances and disciplinary matters.

* Consistent execution of performance management, engagement and retention initiatives.

* Strong compliance and audit readiness across assigned establishments.

* Effective collaboration with business leaders and internal support functions.

* Successful execution of assigned HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

**Organization:** Universal Biotechnology Private Limited

**Open for Location:** New Delhi

#### **Position Summary:**

The Social Media Executive will be responsible for managing the company’s social media platforms, creating engaging content, and executing campaigns to promote our products, services, partner brands, and company activities.

The role requires creativity, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate technical information into clear, relevant content for researchers, laboratories, academic institutions, and biotechnology professionals.

#### **Primary Responsibilities:**

Manage and update the company’s social media accounts, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.

* Prepare and maintain a monthly content calendar aligned with marketing priorities, product promotions, events, and company announcements.
* Create engaging captions, posts, carousels, stories, reels, and short videos using approved product information and brand guidelines.
* Design social media creatives, promotional banners, and other marketing materials using Canva, Adobe tools, or similar applications.
* Coordinate with product specialists, sales teams, and partner brands to obtain accurate content, product updates, and promotional materials.
* Ensure that scientific information, product specifications, and performance claims are reviewed by the relevant team before publication.
* Promote webinars, exhibitions, workshops, product launches, special offers, and company achievements.
* Capture and edit photographs and videos of office activities, events, product demonstrations, and team initiatives.
* Monitor comments, messages, and enquiries; respond professionally and forward technical queries or sales leads to the appropriate team.
* Support paid social media campaigns, including audience selection, creative preparation, campaign monitoring, and reporting within approved budgets.
* Track reach, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, and enquiries generated through social media.
* Prepare regular performance reports and recommend improvements based on campaign results.
* Research relevant industry topics, competitor activity, platform trends, and content opportunities.
* Maintain an organised collection of approved creatives, photographs, videos, logos, and marketing assets.
* Follow company approval processes and maintain confidentiality of business and customer information.

#### **Qualifications**

Graduate in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* 1–3 years of experience in social media management, content creation, or digital marketing.
* Relevant certification in digital marketing, social media marketing, or content creation will be an advantage.

#### **Other Requirements**

**Preferred Background**

* Experience managing social media for a B2B, biotechnology, life-science, healthcare, laboratory, or scientific-products organisation.
* A portfolio demonstrating social media posts, campaign creatives, reels, videos, or accounts previously managed.
* Exposure to LinkedIn marketing, Meta Business Suite, social media scheduling tools, and performance analytics.
* Familiarity with paid advertising, website content coordination, and basic SEO will be an advantage.

**Other Requirements**

* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong copywriting, proofreading, and visual presentation skills.
* Working knowledge of Canva and basic video-editing tools; familiarity with Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand technical subjects and develop content with guidance from product specialists.
* Strong planning skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and manage several content requirements simultaneously.
* Willingness to attend company events, exhibitions, or other locations for approved content creation when required.

**Job Function:** Social Media Management | Content Creation | Digital Marketing | Brand Promotion | Community Engagement | Campaign Reporting

**Schedule:** Full-Time | Monday to Saturday | 09:30 AM – 6:30 PM

**Contact to HR Deptartment**
-----------------------------

We invite individuals who are interested in work with Universal Biotechnology to submit their resumes online to **HR@UNIBIOTECH.IN**
  
  
**Please Note** : Universal Biotechnology is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, gender, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Head –CRM cum Sales & Marketing
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Head –CRM cum Sales & Marketing 1. Position Details

* **Designation:** Head – CRM cum Sales & Marketing
* **Industry:** Real Estate / Property Development
* **Experience:** 5–8 years of relevant experience, including team leadership
* **Department:** Sales, Marketing & Customer Relationship Management
* **Reporting To:** COO / CMO
* **Location:** Gurgaon
* **Employment Type:** Full-time

2. Job Purpose

The Head – CRM, Sales & Marketing will be responsible for driving overall business growth through effective sales planning, marketing execution, lead generation, customer relationship management, and revenue optimization.

The position will oversee the complete customer acquisition and sales lifecycle, from brand awareness and lead generation to lead qualification, site visits, negotiations, bookings, customer engagement, and post-sales relationship management.

The key objective is to achieve sales and revenue targets, strengthen brand positioning, improve marketing ROI, enhance lead conversion, and build long-term customer relationships across the company's real estate projects.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Sales Strategy & Revenue Generation

* Develop and execute annual, quarterly, and monthly sales plans for residential, commercial, plotted development, and other real estate projects.
* Establish project-wise sales targets, revenue forecasts, booking targets, and inventory movement plans in consultation with senior management.
* Lead the sales team to achieve monthly and quarterly booking and revenue targets.
* Monitor the sales pipeline, customer inquiries, site visits, negotiations, booking conversions, cancellations, and lost opportunities.
* Identify new business opportunities, target customer segments, investor groups, corporate clients, and potential channel partners.
* Develop pricing recommendations, sales schemes, promotional offers, and project positioning in coordination with management.
* Build relationships with high-value customers, investors, brokers, channel partners, and strategic referral networks.
* Review sales performance regularly and implement corrective measures to improve conversion and productivity.
* Coordinate with finance, legal, project, and customer service teams to support smooth booking and transaction processes.

B. Marketing Strategy & Brand Management

* Develop integrated marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, project launches, sales targets, and inventory priorities.
* Plan and execute digital and offline marketing campaigns to generate awareness, inquiries, site visits, and bookings.
* Manage Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media, SEO, property portals, email marketing, events, outdoor advertising, and other relevant channels.
* Coordinate the creation of project brochures, presentations, advertisements, videos, landing pages, virtual tours, and sales collateral.
* Develop project-specific marketing plans based on location, price range, property configuration, target audience, and competitive positioning.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, customer profiling, and pricing comparisons.
* Manage marketing budgets, agency relationships, campaign calendars, and promotional activities.
* Track campaign effectiveness, lead quality, cost per acquisition, and return on marketing expenditure.
* Ensure project marketing materials and advertising claims are accurate and compliant with applicable RERA and other regulatory requirements.

C. Lead Generation & Conversion Management

* Establish a consistent lead generation strategy across digital platforms, property portals, referrals, channel partners, and offline campaigns.
* Define lead qualification criteria based on budget, location preference, property requirements, purchase timeline, and buying intent.
* Ensure timely lead allocation, follow-up, and tracking through the CRM system.
* Coordinate with sales teams to convert qualified inquiries into site visits, negotiations, and bookings.
* Monitor lead-to-site-visit, site-visit-to-booking, and overall lead-to-booking conversion rates.
* Identify reasons for lost leads, missed follow-ups, cancellations, and low conversion.
* Introduce lead nurturing, remarketing, referral, and reactivation campaigns.
* Conduct regular reviews with sales and marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion performance.

D. CRM & Customer Relationship Management

* Own the strategy, implementation, and effective utilization of the company's CRM platform.
* Establish standard processes for lead capture, assignment, follow-up, customer communication, site visits, booking, and post-sales engagement.
* Ensure all leads, customer interactions, follow-ups, and sales stages are recorded accurately.
* Implement CRM automation for lead assignment, reminders, escalation alerts, customer communications, and management reporting.
* Monitor CRM adoption and compliance across sales, marketing, and customer relationship teams.
* Develop customer segmentation and personalized communication journeys for prospects, buyers, investors, and existing customers.
* Establish processes for handling customer feedback, complaints, escalations, referrals, and repeat business.
* Coordinate post-booking communication, payment reminders, construction updates, possession-related communication, and handover support with the relevant teams.
* Maintain customer data accuracy, confidentiality, appropriate access controls, and consent-based communication practices.

E. Channel Partner & Business Development Management

* Develop and maintain relationships with brokers, channel partners, real estate consultants, and referral networks.
* Design channel partner engagement programs, project presentations, sales events, and incentive schemes subject to management approval.
* Track channel partner performance, lead contribution, site visits, bookings, and business generated.
* Identify new geographic markets, customer segments, and business development opportunities.
* Coordinate with channel sales teams to ensure consistent communication, lead tracking, and conversion reporting.

F. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Lead, train, motivate, and manage sales, marketing, and CRM personnel.
* Define departmental KPIs, individual targets, performance standards, and accountability mechanisms.
* Conduct regular sales reviews, campaign reviews, pipeline meetings, and performance evaluations.
* Develop SOPs for lead management, CRM usage, customer communication, reporting, and sales follow-up.
* Coordinate with project management, finance, legal, channel sales, and customer service teams.
* Manage external agencies, media partners, creative vendors, and technology providers.
* Build a performance-oriented culture focused on customer satisfaction, process discipline, and business results.

G. MIS, Analytics & Management Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales, marketing, and CRM performance reports.
* Develop dashboards covering leads, qualified prospects, site visits, bookings, collections where applicable, cancellations, and revenue.
* Track project-wise marketing expenditure, cost per lead, cost per qualified lead, and cost per booking.
* Analyze campaign ROI, sales funnel efficiency, inventory movement, and customer conversion patterns.
* Forecast sales performance and lead requirements based on project targets and historical data.
* Present performance reviews, budget requirements, risks, and action plans to senior management.

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Sales, or a related discipline.
* MBA in Marketing, Sales, or Business Management preferred.
* Relevant certifications in digital marketing, sales management, or CRM systems are an advantage.

5. Experience & Technical Competencies

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in real estate sales, marketing, business development, or CRM, with demonstrated leadership responsibilities.
* Proven track record of managing sales targets, marketing campaigns, customer pipelines, and team performance.
* Experience in residential, commercial, plotted development, or other property sales preferred.
* Hands-on knowledge of CRM systems such as Sell.Do, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, social media marketing, property portals, and lead generation.
* Strong understanding of real estate sales funnels, channel partner management, customer engagement, and lead nurturing.
* Proficiency in Excel, sales dashboards, campaign analytics, forecasting, and MIS reporting.
* Awareness of applicable RERA requirements, advertising compliance, and data protection obligations.

6. Key Skills & Competencies

* Sales leadership and business development.
* Strategic marketing and brand management.
* Digital marketing and lead generation.
* CRM implementation and process management.
* Negotiation, presentation, and relationship management.
* Budgeting, forecasting, and ROI analysis.
* Customer-centric decision-making.
* Team management and performance monitoring.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Cross-functional coordination and execution discipline.

7. Reporting Structure

**Reports To:** COO / CMO

**Direct Reports may include:**

* Sales Manager / Sales Executives
* Digital Marketing Executive / Marketing Manager
* CRM Manager / CRM Executives
* Lead Management Executives
* Channel Partner / Business Development Executive

**Key Internal Stakeholders:**

* Finance and Accounts
* Legal and Compliance
* Project and Construction Teams
* Customer Service and Post-Sales
* Channel Sales and External Marketing Agencies

The department head will be accountable for the overall sales, marketing, and CRM function, while coordinating with other departments to support bookings, collections, customer satisfaction, and project execution.

8. First 90-Day Deliverables

**Days 1–30: Assessment and Planning**

* Review current sales performance, marketing activities, lead sources, CRM processes, and team capabilities.
* Establish baseline metrics for lead generation, lead quality, conversion, cost per booking, and revenue.
* Prepare project-wise sales and marketing action plans.
* Identify gaps in lead follow-up, CRM data quality, and sales reporting.

**Days 31–60: Implementation**

* Introduce structured sales pipeline reviews and marketing performance dashboards.
* Improve lead allocation, CRM adoption, follow-up compliance, and customer nurturing.
* Optimize underperforming campaigns and review channel partner engagement.
* Establish individual and departmental targets.

**Days 61–90: Performance Improvement**

* Demonstrate measurable progress against agreed lead quality, conversion, sales, and marketing efficiency targets.
* Present a project-wise sale forecast and marketing budget plan.
* Implement customer retention, referral, and reactivation initiatives.
* Submit a quarterly performance review and the next-quarter growth strategy to senior management.

9. Overall Success Criteria

The successful candidate will build an integrated Sales, Marketing, and CRM function that consistently generates qualified property inquiries, converts prospects into bookings, improves marketing efficiency, strengthens channel partner relationships, enhances customer satisfaction, and delivers sustainable revenue growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong follow-up capabilities, research-driven problem-solving, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced business environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Executive Coordination & Operational Management**

* Serve as the primary coordination point between the Managing Director and internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain real-time action-item trackers and ensure timely closure of deliverables across departments.
* Follow up with department heads, unit managers, vendors, architects, contractors, and consultants.
* Research operational challenges, evaluate alternatives, and present actionable solutions before escalating matters to leadership.

**2. MIS, Reporting & Compliance**

* Analyse operational variances, identify budget overruns, track project delays, and flag compliance gaps.

**3. Site Visits & Project Coordination**

* Accompany the Managing Director on site visits, property audits, and new-unit launches.
* Record meeting minutes, assign action items, and monitor execution against agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with project teams, architects, contractors, consultants, and vendors to resolve operational challenges.
* Track site-level progress and report deviations requiring management attention.

**4. Travel & Calendar Management**

* Manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, itineraries, and local transportation.
* Strategically manage the Managing Director’s calendar, prioritising critical business initiatives.
* Coordinate meetings and ensure effective communication across locations.
* Adapt to changing schedules and operational requirements.

Candidate Requirements

* 3–6 years of experience as an Executive Assistant to senior leadership, Operations Coordinator, or Chief of Staff.
* Experience in F&B, hospitality, multi-unit retail, or high-growth businesses is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and dashboard creation.
* Working knowledge of Google Sheets and task-management tools such as Jira, Monday.com, or equivalent platforms.
* Excellent research, analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, follow up independently, and drive deliverables to completion.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to undertake frequent regional travel and work flexible hours in line with business requirements.

**Educational Qualification:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Finance, or a related discipline.

description:

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Utilizing Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology. Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement while nurturing satisfied customers that can be referenced in future sales cycles.
* Developing strong and collaborative relationships with customers, partners, and the internal Anaplan team to drive successful outcomes in your territory.

**More about you:**

* 10 plus years of successful Software sales/ SAAS/ PAAS experience with extensive experience selling to Large Enterprise and conglomerates in North.
* Experience handling enterprise-level accounts, experience selling complex opportunities with a solid track record of closing large ACV deals.
* Ability to influence C-level executives and navigate complex ecosystem
* Expertise in mobility and digital strategy.
* Executive-level communication and interpersonal skills.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.
