* Experience with Apache NiFi.
* Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts and practices.
* Knowledge of data management concepts, including data warehousing, ETL, and data integration.
* Experience with a compiled programming language, preferably a JVM-based language such as Java or Scala.
* Experience with streaming or micro-batch processing frameworks, preferably Kafka and Spark.

**Additional Information**

* Willingness to travel across the Asia-Pacific region and work with customers across multiple industries.
* Big Data Developers interested in systems administration and consulting are also encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Account Manager - IT/ITeS, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
description:
**Description**
Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a Senior Account Manager to lead cloud strategy and revenue growth across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.
  
  
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own the end-to-end cloud strategy for a portfolio of strategic, high-revenue IT services companies, software product firms, and technology-enabled services organizations. You will operate as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, influencing multi-year technology decisions and driving large-scale digital transformation programs. This role requires you to think at the level of how India's leading technology companies architect their platforms, modernize their delivery models, and build next-generation solutions on AWS for their global customers. You will define the strategic direction for your accounts, execute complex multi-stakeholder commercial engagements, mentor junior Account Managers, contribute to segment-level strategy, and represent the voice of the IT/ITeS customer within AWS to influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS.
* Own the long-term cloud strategy for your accounts and develop multi-year account plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives, including platform modernization, IP development on AWS, and enabling customers to build cloud-native offerings for their end clients.
* Executive Relationship Building and Influence: Establish and sustain CXO-level relationships across your accounts. Engage with CEOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Engineering Heads, and Delivery Leaders to position AWS as a strategic partner.
* Influence technology decisions at the board level and drive executive alignment on large transformation programs.
* Complex Deal Structuring and Negotiation: Lead multi-year commercial engagements including EDPs, PPAs, and custom pricing constructs.
* Navigate complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders, legal teams, and partner ecosystems.
* Structure deals that balance customer value with AWS business objectives.
* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Operate as the single-threaded leader for your accounts, orchestrating across Solutions Architects, Partner teams, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.
* Segment Strategy and Market Shaping: Contribute to the IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying industry trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities, pricing strategies, and product investments for the segment.
* Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
* Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement across GenAI, data analytics, and modernization use cases.
* Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice for IT/ITeS organizations

A day in the life
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, deal execution, and team development activities.
  
  
**A Typical Day May Include**
Strategic Planning: Reviewing multi-year account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions. Assessing deal progression across your portfolio, identifying blockers, and aligning resources to accelerate critical opportunities.
  
  
Customer Meetings: Conducting CXO steering committees and executive briefings with business leaders, technical deep-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum on large transformation programs.
  
  
Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go-to-market initiatives, engaging Product teams to address customer requirements, and providing customer feedback that influences service roadmaps critical to the IT/ITeS segment.
  
  
Deal Progression: Advancing complex commercial engagements through the sales cycle, structuring multi-year agreements, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals.
  
  
Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise.
  
  
Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations
  
  
**About The Team**
The IT/ITeS segment team focuses on one of India's most strategic industries, organizations that are transforming their own operations through cloud and building cloud-native solutions and services for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, innovation, and results.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or above, or MBA
* Experience reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals
* Experience navigating prospective accounts from and into a senior executive level to identify new customer opportunities
* 10+ years of technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree, or MBA
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience in technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.
  
  
We are hiring a Key Account Manager (KAM) to be based out of our Mumbai (Andheri) office to drive sales growth, enhance customer experience, and support collaboration with the WSS team. The Head of Sales also helps develop and implement WSS strategic plans, commercial practices, and customer solutions.
  
  
In Wilhelmsen Ship Services (Wilhelmsen Marine Products India Private Limited), people don’t just hold jobs here. They make the most innovative ideas a reality – and in the process, they shape the maritime industry. With one of the largest maritime networks in the world, we do work that makes an impact - if it floats, our products are probably on it. Supplying marine consumables, products, and solutions to every conceivable vessel type, our Marine Products division includes the Unitor brand of products, Timm ropes, Unicool refrigerants, and Unitor and Nalfleet marine chemicals. Last year we made product deliveries to 27,500 vessels, at over 2,000 ports.
  
  
**Who you are:**
The Key Account Manager reports to the Head of Sales. The role requires close collaboration with Technical Sales Managers (TSMs), Technical Sales and Business Development Managers (TSBDMs), Sales Support, Customer Service and Credit.
  
  
**What you will be doing:**

* Drive profitable sales growth on from current and new customers within the KAM’s portfolio.
* Contribute to achieving the respective solution area targets in collaboration with the TSM and TSBDMs, including facilitation of customer meetings, leading of tenders, sharing of customer knowledge and collaborating on opportunities as agreed with the respective TSMs and TSBDMs.
* Develop robust and measurable Sales Activity Plans and action assertively to deliver on the agreed targets.
* Build the sales pipeline to hit the targets as specified based on quality opportunities on existing accounts (share of wallet) and new business.
* Ensure accurate and updated information on own accounts in WSS CRM
* Proactively utilize the available sales tools to identify areas of growth and develop actions to achieve targets.
* Foster strong relationships with the customers through high quality and frequent customer face to face meetings.
* Lead or contribute to local marketing events, as agreed with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure customer portfolio adhere to agreed terms, including credit, and that the customer contracts generate the most optimal return through proactive contract management.
* Seek out, develop and maintain multilevel entry points and relationships with own accounts. Be a door opener for technical sales teams.
* Contribute to the team culture with customer centricity and collaboration at its core. Work closely with and ensure constructive hand-overs to internal stakeholders within Sales and Customer Service, Marine Product Solutions, Operations and Credit according to our processes.
* Ensure compliance according to agreed global sales governance framework, policies, and processes, including Compliance, Legal and Credit policies.

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent marine qualification (preferred).

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Solid technical background in welding processes, mechanical works, handheld power tools, and marine gases.
* Experience in technical sales, ideally in an international or maritime environment.
* Proven ability to influence sales outcomes through technical expertise and commercial understanding.
* Experience negotiating with customers and managing complex discussions effectively.
* Strong ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and deliver results within tight timeframes.
* Commercially minded, ambitious, and motivated by growth and results.
* Digitally confident, with experience using Excel (including pivot tables), Microsoft Office, Copilot, CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), and analytics tools such as Power BI.

title: Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services
description:
At Corbion, we exist to champion preservation in all its forms, preserving food and food production, health, and our planet.

**The role**

As Manager Bakery Applications & Technical Services, you will connect customer needs with practical ingredient solutions that support product innovation and commercial growth across India. Your primary focus will be bakery applications, complemented by opportunities in confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood.

This is a senior, customer-facing technical role rather than a traditional laboratory-based R&D position. You will engage directly with customers and their R&D teams, explore their current and future technical challenges, and translate these insights into viable solutions. Working closely with Corbion’s product management, commercial, regional and global application teams, you will develop, test and implement solutions using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.

A unique part of the position is the opportunity to help establish Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai. You will contribute your expertise and recommendations during its development and subsequently lead its activities as a regional innovation hub. The laboratory will support bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments applications and enable customer solutions to be tested and optimized before implementation at customer locations.

The position is based fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and involves approximately 30% to 40% travel, primarily within India and, where required, selected South Asian markets. Customer implementation and plant trials may require visits of several consecutive days.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build trusted technical partnerships with customers, distributors and strategic accounts by understanding their product, process, quality and manufacturing challenges.
* Work directly with customer R&D teams to identify current and future application needs and translate these into commercially viable ingredient solutions.
* Develop and optimize applications using Corbion’s portfolio of preservation systems, vinegar-based solutions, cultured ingredients, organic acids, emulsifiers, fermentation-derived ingredients and functional blends.
* Lead formulation and application work across bakery, confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry and seafood, with bakery as the primary area of focus.
* Develop solutions addressing shelf-life extension, food safety, clean-label reformulation, texture enhancement, yield improvement, flavour optimization and cost-in-use reduction.
* Take customer development projects from initial needs assessment and laboratory trials through validation, implementation and commercialization.
* Design and conduct application trials, including ingredient selection, dosage optimization and process improvement, to identify solutions customers can efficiently validate and implement.
* Lead customer plant trials, industrial validation and implementation across multiple manufacturing locations where required.
* Troubleshoot formulation, preservation, processing and implementation challenges, and conduct product benchmarking and competitive evaluations.
* Work with regional and global product management and application teams to adapt existing knowledge and solutions to Indian market requirements.
* Contribute expertise and recommendations to establishing Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai, and lead it as a center of excellence supporting customer innovation and business growth.
* Define laboratory objectives, budgets, equipment investment plans and capability-development roadmaps; manage resources, maintenance, calibration, utilization and materials inventory.
* Coordinate pilot-scale and customer-simulation trials, introduce new testing methodologies, and maintain protocols, formulation databases, technical reports and project documentation.
* Ensure compliance with Corbion’s safety, quality, food-safety and housekeeping standards and support internal and external laboratory audits.
* Deliver technical presentations, customer workshops, seminars and training programs, and support customer qualification processes and technical audits.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to identify opportunities, develop the commercial pipeline and convert technical projects into business growth.
* Participate in strategic customer engagements, business reviews, innovation sessions, exhibitions, trade fairs and industry forums.
* Monitor market trends, regulatory developments, competitor activity and emerging technologies, and recommend innovation priorities based on customer and market insights.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and regional and global R&D teams.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution and, as the laboratory develops, help build and coach its technical capabilities.

**You bring**

*Requirements*

* A bachelor’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a closely related food-science discipline.
* At least 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in food ingredients, food manufacturing or the specialty ingredients industry.
* Strong experience in customer-facing technical support and the credibility to work directly with experienced customer R&D and manufacturing teams.
* Strong knowledge of food ingredients and their functionality within finished-product applications, with strong technical expertise in bakery applications.
* Experience in at least one additional relevant category, preferably confectionery, sauces, dressings and condiments, meat, poultry or seafood. Deep bakery expertise with some confectionery exposure may also fit.
* The ability to explore customer needs in depth, ask strong technical questions and translate customer challenges into practical application and ingredient solutions.
* Experience with laboratory or application trials, formulation optimization, technical troubleshooting and implementation in customer production environments.
* Understanding of product scale-up and commercialization, including implementation across multiple customer manufacturing locations.
* Knowledge of food preservation, clean-label product development, food safety and microbiology fundamentals.
* Strong project leadership, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, communication, presentation and influencing skills.
* A customer-focused, commercially aware and collaborative approach, with the ability to work across functions and geographies.
* Willingness to work fully on-site in Navi Mumbai and travel approximately 30% to 40%.

*Preferred*

* A master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Biotechnology or a related discipline.
* Experience in application or product development. Candidates whose primary strength is customer-facing technical support may also fit when combined with strong ingredient knowledge and solution-development capability.
* Experience leading or contributing to the establishment, management or capability development of an application laboratory.
* Experience within a multinational food-ingredient company.
* Specialized training or experience in bakery, confectionery, meat processing, culinary products, preservation technologies or product development.
* Knowledge of organic acids, cultured ingredients, fermentation-based solutions, functional blends and emulsifiers.
* Knowledge of HACCP, GMP, FSSC 22000 and other relevant food-quality systems.
* Experience with experimental design, laboratory documentation, audits and equipment or budget planning.
* Previous production experience or direct exposure to customer manufacturing environments.
* Experience coaching or developing technical or laboratory colleagues.

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to shape and lead Corbion’s new Application Laboratory in Navi Mumbai and contribute your expertise while its capabilities are being established.
* A highly visible role combining customer engagement, technical problem-solving, application development and commercial impact.
* The opportunity to work on strategic innovation priorities, including natural preservation solutions for bakery and new confectionery applications.
* Direct collaboration with customer R&D and manufacturing teams and with Corbion’s Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing and global innovation organizations.
* Access to expertise from Corbion’s regional and global application teams, allowing successful technologies and solutions from other markets to be adapted for India.
* The opportunity to build application capabilities that strengthen Corbion’s position as an innovation partner for preservation, food safety, clean-label and sustainable ingredient solutions.
* Scope to build and develop a technical laboratory team as the Navi Mumbai facility grows.
* Potential to broaden into larger technical-commercial or business-development responsibilities in India and across Asia.
* The opportunity to contribute to measurable customer and business outcomes, including successful product launches, commercialized projects, improved technical solutions and stronger strategic partnerships.

**About Corbion**

Corbion is the global market leader in lactic acid and its derivatives, and a leading supplier of emulsifiers, functional enzyme blends, minerals, vitamins, and algae ingredients. We use our unique expertise in fermentation and other processes to deliver sustainable solutions for the preservation of food and food production, health, and our planet. For over 100 years, we have been uncompromising in our commitment to safety, quality, innovation and performance. Drawing on our deep application and product knowledge, we work side-by-side with customers to make our cutting-edge technologies work for them. Our solutions help differentiate products in markets such as food, home & personal care, animal nutrition, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and bioplastics. In 2025, Corbion generated annual sales of €1,267.4 million and had a workforce of 2,408 FTE. For more information: www.corbion.com

Corbion is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse workplace. All applicants will be considered equally.

***Corbion does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers. All candidates must be submitted by approved Corbion vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Talent Acquisition team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Corbion Talent Acquisition team and such candidate was submitted to the Corbion Talent Acquisition Team.***

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Agnimatic Technologies LLP provides specialist passive fire protection solutions for building and infrastructure projects across India. The company supplies, installs, tests, and commissions systems that maintain fire compartmentation, including firestopping, cavity barriers, structural coatings, and fire-rated construction aligned with tested systems and current standards. Agnimatic focuses on critical but often unseen aspects of fire safety, ensuring walls, floors, and seals contain fire long enough for safe evacuation. Headquartered in Thane, Maharashtra, the organization operates nationwide on projects ranging from specific details to full-building solutions.

**Role Description**
The Sales Manager will lead business development and sales activities for passive fire protection solutions, with responsibility for the Mumbai region and support for projects across India. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai, involving regular client visits, coordination with project and technical teams, and engagement with contractors, consultants, and developers. Day-to-day tasks include generating and qualifying leads, conducting sales presentations, preparing proposals and quotations, and managing the entire sales cycle from prospecting to closing. The Sales Manager will maintain relationships with existing clients, monitor market trends, contribute to sales forecasts, and ensure accurate documentation in CRM or other sales management tools. The role also involves collaborating on tenders and bids, supporting pre-sales technical discussions, and representing the company at industry events and meetings.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated skills in consultative selling, negotiation, and closing deals within construction, infrastructure, or related technical sectors.
* Ability to build and manage client relationships, including stakeholder engagement with architects, consultants, contractors, and developers.
* Competence in sales planning, pipeline management, and use of CRM or similar tools for tracking opportunities and performance.
* Strong communication, presentation, and proposal-writing skills, with attention to detail and clarity in commercial documentation.
* Understanding of construction project workflows; exposure to fire safety or passive fire protection standards is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Proven experience in a sales or business development role, preferably in building products, fire protection, or construction services.
* Ability to work on-site and travel locally as required, with a proactive, results-focused approach and ethical sales practices.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Business Development Executive**

timepay.ai is hiring a Mumbai-based Business Development Executive to win enterprise accounts in two markets: lenders (banks, NBFCs, ARCs and fintechs) and D2C brands.

**Location:**

Mumbai (candidates must be based in Mumbai)

**Work mode:**

Hybrid

**Reports to:**

Business Head

**Experience:**

1–4 years in B2B sales or business development

**About timepay.ai**

timepay.ai builds AI voice agents that hold natural phone conversations with customers at scale. We work with two kinds of businesses:

* **Lenders:**

  banks, NBFCs, ARCs and fintechs use our bots for collections and loan recovery. Leading lenders already run their collections on them.
* **D2C brands:**

  brands use our bots to recover abandoned carts, guide shoppers through complex products on consultation calls, and handle operational calls such as order confirmations and delivery updates.

Our in-house voice engine, Vox, replies with under 40 ms text-to-speech latency and speaks Hindi, English and 12+ regional languages, switching mid-call and with real emotion in its voice. During a call, the bots can send WhatsApp and SMS messages, such as a payment link or a cart link, and transfer to a human agent. Ask AI lets clients ask plain-language questions about their call data.

**About the role**

You will sell to both lenders and D2C brands, and own each deal from first touch to a live pilot. That means researching the right companies, reaching their decision-makers, running demos, gathering what our team needs to build each prospect's bot, and following up until the deal closes.

You will work directly with the Business Head and founders, and alongside our prompt engineering and tech teams.

**What you'll do**
**Across both markets**

* **Research and prioritise prospects:**

  map lenders (banks, NBFCs, small finance banks, housing finance companies, ARCs, fintechs) and D2C brands (beauty, personal care, health and wellness, fashion, electronics, home). Rank them by size and priority, and find the decision-makers using Apollo and LinkedIn.
* **Run outreach:**

  reach decision-makers through calls, personalised emails and WhatsApp, and follow up consistently until you get a clear answer.
* **Book and run demos:**

  set up demos with both business and tech teams. Share our deck and sample voice recordings. Answer questions on languages, latency, compliance and integrations.
* **Coordinate bot builds:**

  brief our prompt engineers on what each prospect needs, such as a higher-DPD bot that stays calm with abusive customers or a cart-recovery bot that knows a brand's products, and make sure demo bots are ready on time.
* **Manage the pipeline in Zoho CRM:**

  update accounts, contacts, tasks and statuses after every conversation, and share regular pipeline updates with the Business Head.

**Lending**

* **Pitch collections and recovery bots**

  to Heads of Collections, Chief Collections Officers, CIOs and call-centre heads.
* **Discover requirements:**

  understand each lender's buckets (Bucket X, higher DPD, NPA), call volumes, current vendors and pain points.
* **Gather what we need to build:**

  customer data points, scripts, call recordings and the escalation matrix for each lender's bot.
* **Represent us at industry events**

  such as collections summits, and build partnerships with field-collection agencies, BPOs and fintech platforms.

**D2C**

* **Pitch to founders and growth, marketing, CX and operations heads**

  at D2C brands.
* **Sell abandoned-cart recovery:**

  show brands how calling shoppers who left items in their cart brings back lost orders.
* **Sell consultation calls:**

  show how our bots explain complex products and answer shoppers' questions before they buy.
* **Sell operational calls:**

  order confirmations, delivery updates and other routine calls that take up a CX team's time.
* **Discover requirements:**

  understand where each brand's customers drop off, its order volumes, its product range and how it calls customers today.

**What we're looking for**

* 1–4 years in B2B sales, business development or inside sales, ideally selling software or tech services
* Comfortable selling to both lending and D2C stakeholders, and switching between the two
* Confident cold-calling senior people, and following up persistently without being pushy
* Clear spoken and written English and Hindi
* Highly organised: you log every conversation and never let a follow-up slip
* Quick to learn a technical product and able to explain it simply
* A self-starter who takes ownership and moves fast

**Good to have**

* Experience selling to banks, NBFCs or fintechs, or working in collections, a call centre or a BPO
* Experience selling to D2C or e-commerce brands, or working in growth, retention or CX at one
* Familiarity with collections terms such as DPD buckets, NACH bounces, promise to pay and the RBI Fair Practices Code
* Familiarity with D2C metrics such as cart abandonment, conversion rate, RTO and repeat purchase rate
* Hands-on experience with Zoho CRM, Apollo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* A regional language besides Hindi and English

**Why join**

* Sell one product into two large markets, built in-house by our AI team
* Work directly with the founders and Business Head, and see your customer feedback shape the product
* Room to grow your role as the company scales

URS EQUIPMENT PVT LTD is a fast-growing solutions provider in Aerial Work Platforms (AWP), Material Handling Equipment (MHE), and cleaning solutions, serving customers across India and SAARC countries. The company focuses on service, sales, spare parts, and rentals, delivering qualitative, timely, and value-added support to meet diverse customer demands. URS is the Pan-India Authorized Business Associate for the Italian brand AIRO and represents several other leading global brands in MHE and cleaning equipment. Headquartered in Mumbai with multiple operational offices across India, the company combines more than a decade of market experience with a skilled technical team to ensure efficient service and support. URS is committed to providing high-quality solutions at optimal prices with minimal delivery time and strong customer satisfaction.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time AWP Sales Engineer role based in Thane, offered in a hybrid work arrangement where some work from home is acceptable. The role involves identifying and developing new business opportunities for Aerial Work Platforms and related equipment, managing existing accounts, and building strong relationships with customers and channel partners. Daily responsibilities include conducting site visits, understanding customer requirements, preparing quotations, and negotiating commercial terms within company guidelines. The AWP Sales Engineer will coordinate closely with service, rental, and spare parts teams to provide complete solutions, ensure timely delivery, and support after-sales activities. The role also includes market research, competitor analysis, regular reporting to management, and participation in product demonstrations, exhibitions, and customer training sessions.

**Qualifications**

* Solid technical understanding of Aerial Work Platforms, Material Handling Equipment, or industrial/engineering products, with the ability to explain features and benefits clearly to customers.
* Proven experience in sales or business development in industrial equipment, construction machinery, or capital goods, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, and closing deals.
* Strong customer relationship management skills, including account management, responsiveness to customer needs, and coordination for service, spares, and rental support.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze competitors, and prepare accurate sales forecasts and reports for management.
* Effective communication and presentation skills in English and local languages, with the capability to conduct product demos and technical discussions on-site.
* Good negotiation and commercial acumen, including experience with pricing discussions, basic costing, and contract terms while maintaining margins.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), and digital communication channels for daily sales activities and reporting.
* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Industrial) or a related technical field; a qualification in sales/marketing is an added advantage.

title: Manager – GTM & Sales Strategy, Meesho AI Services (MAS)
description:
**About The Team**
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
  
  
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a
**technology company, not an AI BPO**
: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
  
  
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.
  
  
You own the
**middle mile**
of the deal: the stretch between a qualified conversation and a close-ready opportunity. That means deep client discovery, mapping who really decides, understanding how a client's teams actually work today, and making sure the deal never goes cold on your watch — following up, keeping momentum, and setting up the closer to walk into the room fully briefed. Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.
  
  
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the middle mile of the sales cycle — from a client's first "yes, let's talk" through to a well-packaged, close-ready opportunity.

* Run structured discovery conversations to understand a client's real pain points, current workflows, and AI-readiness.
* Map client org structures — identify the true economic buyer, decision-makers, influencers, and blockers — and keep stakeholder engagement alive between senior-level touchpoints.
* Help identify and nurture an internal champion for MAS within the account — someone advocating for us when we're not in the room.
* Support structured, MEDDPICC-style account qualification alongside your closer, so every deal has an honest diagnosis of what's actually blocking it.
* Make cold calls and run client meetings yourself where needed, working alongside (not just waiting on) the central lead-gen team.
* Own the follow-up cadence after every client conversation — chasing next steps, addressing objections, and making sure momentum doesn't drop.
* Build a working understanding of MAS's guaranteed-savings and outcome-based pricing models (per-minute, slab-based, pilot, risk-sharing) and contribute early pricing inputs on deals you're driving.
* Brief and prep senior closers ahead of high-stakes conversations — sharp account context, clear stakeholder maps, clear next steps.
* Bonus: build and iterate on client-specific product demos in partnership with Product/Tech.
* Feed client and market insights back into the sales playbook and to Product, Tech, and Ops.
* Bring structured, consultative thinking to every account rather than a transactional, task-based approach.

**What You Will Need**

* 4–7 years of experience in enterprise sales, GTM, business consulting, or client-facing analyst/BD roles, ideally with exposure to Indian mid-market/enterprise clients.

* Strong discovery and analytical skills — able to quickly and accurately unpack a client's business problem and current workflow.
* Comfort making cold calls and running early client meetings — this is not a purely inbound or coordination role.
* A structured communicator — able to produce crisp meeting notes, account maps, and follow-up briefs.
* Basic commercial acumen — able to understand and reason about pricing structures (you won't be expected to own pricing negotiations independently yet).
* Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology — you don't need to code, but you should "get it."
* Exposure to (or curiosity about) structured account-qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC is a plus — we'll teach you the specifics.
* High ownership and follow-through — comfortable chasing a deal over weeks or months without losing momentum.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity, without established playbooks, in a 0–1/1–10 business environment.
* Ambition to grow — either toward a full closing/sales-leadership role, or into Business/GTM Operations — over time.
* Bonus: prior exposure to building or presenting product demos.
* Evidence that you're genuinely top-tier talent — that might show up as academic pedigree (a strong record at a top institute) or as a professional track record (success at a recognizable brand, or a reputation for excellence in high-stakes client work). We care about the evidence of excellence, not which box it comes from.

title: Data Cloud Sales Specialist
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in quota-carrying enterprise sales.
* Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.
* Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).
* Experience positioning and selling technical solutions in data management, analytics, infrastructure, or AI/ML.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.
* Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation agreements within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing).
* Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.
* Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As an Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialist, you will be at the forefront of driving Google Cloud's most critical data and AI growth. You will secure net-new greenfield logos and identify untapped, uncommitted workloads. You will partner with Field Sales Representatives, Customer Engineers, and Partners to execute joint Data+AI plays that establish long-term data platform standardization. You are a master of value-selling. You will engage with line-of-business (LoB) leaders, CDO, CAIO, and CFO to discover critical pain points, build robust business cases (ROI/TCO reduction), and demonstrate the quantifiable business value of modernizing data estates on GCP.
  
  
Additionally, you will guide technical stakeholders and position Google Cloud's Agentic Data Cloud suite (BigQuery, Knowledge Catalog, Borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB) as the premium data intelligence platform for AI. You will present demos that showcase how unified, well-governed data foundations power secure, hallucination-free AI agents and real-time experiences.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.
* Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.
* Engage line of business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern data and AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.
* Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Sales Executive – International Business
description:
**1. About Aczet Pvt. Ltd.**

Aczet Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer and exporter of laboratory and jewellery equipment, including analytical and precision weighing balances, moisture analyzers, XRF gold testing machines, laser welding machines, laser marking machines, and other specialized instruments. With a global presence and an established international distributor network, Aczet serves customers across multiple countries.

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Sales Executive to develop international markets, identify new distributors, generate export business, and strengthen relationships with overseas customers.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. International Business Development**

* Identify and approach potential distributors, dealers, importers, OEM partners, and end customers in assigned international markets.
* Develop new business opportunities through email, telephone calls, LinkedIn, online research, and other B2B platforms.
* Conduct market research to identify potential countries, competitors, pricing trends, and market opportunities.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of international prospects.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers to convert leads into business opportunities.

**B. Distributor Development**

* Identify suitable distributors for Aczet products in assigned territories.
* Contact prospective distributors and introduce the company, product range, and business partnership opportunities.
* Arrange online meetings and product presentations with potential partners.
* Follow up on distributor enquiries, quotations, samples, demonstrations, and commercial discussions.
* Maintain regular communication with existing distributors and identify opportunities to increase sales.

**C. Sales and Export Coordination**

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products.
* Prepare quotations, proforma invoices, and other commercial documents.
* Negotiate pricing and commercial terms within company-approved guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal departments for order processing, production schedules, dispatches, and export documentation.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely order execution.
* Maintain accurate records of enquiries, quotations, sales orders, and customer communications.

**D. Lead Generation and Market Research**

* Approach new prospective distributors or companies daily through different communication channels.
* Obtain meaningful responses from targeted companies, including positive interest, requests for information, referrals, or a clear indication that they are not interested.
* Explore new ways to reach decision-makers instead of relying exclusively on email.
* Research competitor products, distributor networks, industry exhibitions, and potential customers in assigned markets.
* Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across the company's product portfolio.

**E. Reporting and Performance Management**

* Maintain and regularly update the CRM or company sales database.
* Submit weekly reports covering new companies approached, responses received, follow-ups completed, meetings arranged, quotations submitted, and business opportunities generated.
* Prepare monthly sales reports and presentations detailing achievements, pending opportunities, challenges, and action plans.
* Work towards assigned targets for new distributor acquisition, lead conversion, sales revenue, and market development.

**3. Qualifications and Skills Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, B.E./B.TECH
* **Fresh graduates with strong communication, research, and sales aptitude may be considered.**
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and email communication.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn prospecting, CRM systems, and online lead-generation tools.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, follow-up, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to research international markets and communicate professionally with overseas customers.
* Willingness to work with international time zones when required.

**4. Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable approaching new customers.
* Persistent in following up with prospects without being discouraged by rejection.
* Results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Capable of working independently and managing multiple international accounts.
* Interested in technical products and willing to learn product specifications and applications.
* Open to occasional international travel and participation in trade exhibitions, as required.

**5. What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with an established manufacturer serving international markets.
* Exposure to global business development, export sales, and distributor management.
* Training on the company's products, applications, and sales processes.
* Career growth opportunities within the international sales department.
* Performance-based incentives, subject to company policy.

**6. Application Process**

Interested candidates may submit their updated resume highlighting relevant sales experience, communication skills, and achievements in business development.

**Join Aczet and build your career in international business development and export sales.**

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

**About the Position**

Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self-motivated and professional person for the role of 
**Lead Energy Market Analyst**
in our Support Division. The company has consistently grown its global client base and the successful candidate will have many opportunities to interface with a diverse mix of clients with the goal of enhancing their software user experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Learn our software to an advanced level.
* Provide technical support to customers and track support cases from start to finish
* Work with clients to resolve issues related to our SaaS/Cloud offerings and our Desktop version

* Provide onsite and web-based trainings to existing and potential clients

* Assist in maintaining software user documentation and help platforms
* Maintain a high level of power market knowledge, news, trends and developments
* Communicate market trends and customer requirements with the development team as needed
* Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients
* Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences
* Travel to client sites as required.

**Candidate Requirements & Qualifications**

* Minimum 8 Years of experience in power markets, power systems, power plant operations, etc.
* Will lead a team of Energy Market Analysts. 2+ years of experience with people management responsibility.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques
* Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers.
* Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities.
* Team player, with the ability to be a self-starter and work independently as needed.
* Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approaches
* Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings.
* Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
* Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL
* Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)
* Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models
* Degree or certificate specializing in Power Markets.
* Bachelor’s degree: Electrical Engineering, Another Engineering Degree, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Applied Math, Physics, or related field.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships**

This role works collaboratively with all Energy Exemplar staff, particularly:

* Indian Development Centre colleagues
* Senior IDC Management
* Chief Product Officer
* Global Product Delivery Team
* Global Product Development Team
* Global Support Team

**Working Hours**

The support team operates across shifts including:

* 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST
* 7:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST

You will initially commence on the 1pm to 10pm shift pattern. Please note that shift schedules are expected to change from January, and we are looking for candidates who are flexible and open to working across all shift patterns as required.

title: Manager Exports - Pharma
description:
**Company Description:**

Vivaldis Animal Health, a proud subsidiary of Sun Pharma, is on a mission to raise the bar in pet care. Our team is fueled by a blend of ground breaking research and genuine compassion, all aimed at improving the lives of our furry friends. From top-notch pharmaceuticals to gourmet treats, we offer a comprehensive range of products designed with one goal in mind: to keep pets happy and healthy.

**Job purpose:**

To drive the company's international sales and business development activities for the veterinary/animal healthcare portfolio, with responsibility for revenue growth, new market development, distributor acquisition and management, product registrations, tender business, customer relationships and overall profitability of the export business.

title: Senior AI Enablement Manager
description:
**Shape the Future of AI-Driven Performance in Tissue**
At Valmet Tissue, we believe Artificial Intelligence will become a key enabler of growth, productivity, customer value, and operational excellence. We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented AI Enablement Lead to accelerate the adoption of AI across our organization.
  
  
This role will initially focus on Commercial Excellence, Sales, Service, and Business Analytics, where immediate opportunities exist to improve productivity, forecasting, customer engagement, opportunity management, and decision-making. Over time, the role will expand to support AI-driven transformation across Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, Manufacturing, and Business Support functions.
  
  
This is not solely a technical development role. Instead, we are seeking a business leader who can identify opportunities, drive adoption, lead change, and ensure that AI creates measurable value across the organization. This aligns with Valmet's business-led AI strategy, emphasizing value realization, adoption, capability building, and scalable implementation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Drive AI-enabled business transformation
  
  

* Develop and execute the Tissue AI enablement roadmap.
* Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve business performance.
* Build business cases and track realized value from AI initiatives.
* Prioritize and coordinate AI projects across functions.
* Promote scalable and reusable AI solutions across the organization.

Optimize commercial performance
  
  

* Improve sales productivity through AI-enabled tools and processes.
* Support opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, pricing, and proposal generation.
* Reduce manual administrative work and increase customer-facing time.
* Enhance installed-base monetization and customer insights.
* Drive data-driven decision-making across commercial teams.

Lead AI adoption & change
  
  

* Build and lead a network of AI Champions across Tissue.
* Deliver training, awareness programs, and practical AI workshops.
* Support leaders in redesigning processes and ways of working.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure successful adoption of AI capabilities throughout the organization.

Expand AI across functions
  
  
**As Adoption Matures, Support AI Initiatives In**

* Engineering and design productivity
* Supply chain planning and optimization
* Project execution
* Customer support and service operations
* Knowledge management
* Business support functions
* Performance management and analytics

Partner across the organization
  
  

* Act as the key interface between Tissue business teams and enterprise AI initiatives.
* Collaborate with IT, Digital, Data & Analytics, and process owners.
* Ensure AI solutions support business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Promote responsible and compliant use of AI technologies.

What success looks like
  
  

* Increased sales productivity and reduced administrative workload.
* Higher adoption of AI tools and capabilities.
* Improved forecast accuracy and commercial effectiveness.
* Measurable business value delivered through AI initiatives.
* Increased organizational AI capability and literacy.
* AI-enabled process improvements deployed across multiple functions.
* A growing portfolio of scalable use cases delivering sustainable business impact.

**Your profile**
You combine business acumen, transformation leadership, and a passion for technology-enabled improvement.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Transformation, Continuous Improvement, Digital Transformation, or related fields.
* Experience leading cross-functional change initiatives.
* Strong understanding of commercial processes and business performance drivers.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, automation, or digital technologies.
* Experience working in a global industrial or manufacturing environment is considered an advantage.

Personal characteristics
  
  

* Strategic and business-oriented mindset.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Curious and passionate about emerging technologies.
* Excellent communication and facilitation abilities.
* Ability to translate complex concepts into practical business solutions.
* Results-oriented with a strong focus on value realization.

**Why join Valmet Tissue?**
This is a unique opportunity to help define how AI will transform the future of Tissue. You will play a central role in building new capabilities, improving performance, and enabling our teams to work smarter and more effectively. Your work will influence how we serve customers, develop our people, and strengthen our competitiveness globally. Join us in shaping the next generation of AI-enabled business performance at Valmet Tissue.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Last day to apply is November 3, 2026. However, we work with ongoing selection, so don't wait with sending us your application.
  
  
***When everything works together***
***Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.***
***At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.***
***Join the team – and lead the way with us!***
***www.valmet.com/career***

title: Techno commercial Manager - Utility-Scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
description:
Al Jomaih Energy & Water (AEW) headquartered in Saudi Arabia, is a fast-growing investor, lead developer, and operator of utility and infrastructure projects in various geographical markets such as KSA, GCC, Asia & North Africa, with investments in 6 GW of Conventional and Solar power plants, and around 700,000 m3/day of water.

AEW was established in 2007, as a subsidiary of Al Jomaih Holding Company, a leading Saudi conglomerate with a legacy spanning over 80 years, focused on enabling sustainable, social, and economic progress in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and beyond.

At AEW, our mission is to tackle new technologies, solve complex problems, and leverage our expertise to unlock opportunities in the Power, Renewables & Water Sectors, while driving impact for our stakeholders across the value chain.

**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Techno commercial Manager specializing in utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with 10 + years of expertise in project development, technology selection, techno commercial analysis, System/Plant configuration, System/Plant and Balance of system/Plant optimisation, bid preparation, and financial closing for large grid scale BESS + PV Solar energy projects. The ideal candidate will bring both strategic insight and technical proficiency in PV solar and battery technology, technology selection & optimisation sizing, life cycle costing analysis for grid operation alongside Solar PV plant. This role will be instrumental in advancing our portfolio of BESS projects, combining commercial acumen with technical skills to achieve successful project execution from planning through to financial close.

**Location: Gurgaon, India**

**Your Job Functions (Duties & Responsibilities)**

* Function as the key Technical Manager between the development team, clients, technology providers, OEMs, EPC and service partners.
* Prepare all technical documentation for proposals.
* Examine RFPs and other customer documentation to define project scope, schedule, specifications, and technical prerequisites within energy storage applications.
* Act as a resource for discussions around product specifications and value engineering
* Work cross-collaboratively with Project Development team to coordinate bid packages.
* Lead the BESS technology selection (e.g., lithium-ion, sodium-ion, flow batteries) and PV technology selection based on based on project-specific requirements, cost, and operational considerations. life cycle costing and techno commercial analysis including Sizing, design technical cum operational requirements and specification of the PV Plant and BESS system and Balance of Plant and Systems including the PCS , LV/MV. HV Electrical systems and SCADA and Energy management system.
* Responsible for the Power System studies and integration of the BESS system to run alongside the PV Plant and the grid including frequency regulation & response, peak saving, voltage regulation, primary and secondary response, harmonics, short circuit current and droop characteristics in compliance with grid code and renewable integration.
* Lead the develop battery container layouts and coordinate with electrical, civil, Solar and wind experts for complete packages to meet client needs.
* Responsible for the sizing and design of PV Plant including the selection of module, tracker and PCS and HV electrical systems
* Lead & access the third-party measurement campaign (met mast, LIDAR etc) and Solar resource assessments Energy Yield assessments for technology analysis and selection
* Responsible for the performance and technical drawings and documents.
* Optimize system design and layout for efficient PV solar and energy storage and retrieval, considering factors like cycles, round trip efficiency, degradation, augmentation and maintenance needs that maximize system reliability, performance, and longevity.
* Responsible for the technical compliances to the international standards and Codes, certifications, local regulations, environmental regulation and ESIA
* Lead Modelling energy storage system performance, coordinate, obtain and integrate BMS, EMS and SCADA designs for the battery system from third party monitoring companies.
* Develop technical specifications and scopes of work for EPC/System Integrator
* Investigate design factors such as function, durability, performance, efficiency, and contractual requirements.
* Lead the preparation and submission of competitive bids for BESS projects, aligning technical solutions with financial models to meet client and regulatory requirements.
* Develop comprehensive techno-commercial proposals that include risk assessment, CAPEX/OPEX analysis, technical design, and regulatory compliance.
* Development of the O&M budget for the term of operation
* Analyze RFPs and RFQs to tailor bid responses that address project-specific grid services and performance requirements.
* Lead technical negotiations for key project contracts, including EPC, battery supply agreements, and operation and maintenance (O&M) contracts.
* Establish strong relationships with technology providers, integrators, and grid operators to ensure smooth project execution.

**Qualifications & Skill Sets**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, advanced degree in Power electronics or relevant certifications preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in utility-scale project development, with a focus on PV, BESS and integration.
* Strong technical expertise of PV and BESS technology design principles, battery technology evaluation, system sizing, and performance optimization, degradation, augmentation and safety aspects.
* Up to date with current technologies of commercial scale
* Proficiency with system modeling and simulation tools for BESS and PV (e.g., ETAP, HOMER, PVSyst)
* Strong knowledge of PCS, BMS algorithms (SOC/SOH), and EMS/PMS control systems.
* Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (e.g., IEEE, IEC, NFPA).
* Excellent project management skills and experience in managing cross-functional teams and complex timelines.
* Exceptional negotiation, communication, and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships.
* Previous experience with similar developers and projects in Middle East and North Africa preferred.
* This role is ideal for a commercially astute, technically skilled professional looking to drive the successful execution of large-scale PV/BESS projects from a techno-commercial perspective.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Role Purpose

MachineAstro is looking for a commercially driven Key Account Manager responsible for growing strategic industrial accounts through customer value creation, new opportunity hunting, use-case development, account expansion and revenue growth. The role combines consultative selling with strong technical understanding of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring and asset health. The KAM will work across plant, corporate, technical, procurement and senior-management stakeholders and convert customer problems into measurable business outcomes and sustainable revenue.

 Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Key Account Ownership

·      Own assigned strategic accounts and prepare account plans covering customer priorities, installed base, stakeholders, whitespace, opportunities, risks and growth actions.

·      Build multi-level relationships across maintenance, reliability, engineering, operations, digital/IT, procurement and senior management.

·      Understand customer operations, asset criticality, maintenance practices and business priorities to identify areas where MachineAstro can create value.

2. Account Growth & Expansion

·      Drive year-on-year growth within existing accounts through cross-sell, upsell, additional assets, plants, business units, applications and services.

·      Identify whitespace and increase MachineAstro share of wallet by expanding successful deployments from machine/area level to line, plant, multi-site or enterprise programs.

·      Convert successful POCs, pilots and initial deployments into repeat and larger commercial programs.

3. Opportunity & Use-Case Hunting

·      Proactively identify new customer problems, reliability gaps and business cases rather than relying only on inbound enquiries or RFQs.

·      Identify opportunities related to recurring failures, unplanned downtime, maintenance cost, inspection effort, safety, critical rotating equipment and predictive-maintenance initiatives.

·      Develop new use cases and convert identified pain points into qualified opportunities with clear technical, commercial and value propositions.

·      Maintain strong focus on pipeline creation, opportunity quality and conversion.

4. Value Creation & Consultative Selling

·      Position MachineAstro as a reliability and technology partner, linking solutions to measurable customer outcomes.

·      Develop ROI/value cases around downtime avoidance, maintenance cost reduction, asset availability, reliability, safety and productivity.

·      Work with SMEs and presales to quantify value, develop solution proposals and demonstrate business impact.

·      Capture successful outcomes and replicate proven value propositions across similar accounts or plants.

5. Customer Engagement, POC & Solution Execution

·      Conduct regular customer plant visits, asset assessments, POC discussions, technical workshops, demonstrations, reviews and training.

·      Lead customer-facing POCs with clear objectives, success criteria, timelines and commercial conversion plans.

·      Coordinate project planning and delivery from the account perspective, ensuring commitments and customer expectations are met.

·      Identify expansion opportunities during and immediately after implementation.

6. Technical & Fault-Analysis Coordination

·      Understand vibration and condition-monitoring concepts and customer asset failure modes sufficiently to lead technical-commercial discussions.

·      Coordinate with CAT-II/CAT-III analysts and SMEs for asset fault analysis, recommendations and data-driven customer insights.

·      Translate technical findings into operational impact, business value and recommended next actions.

7. Customer Success & Retention

·      Ensure customers realize measurable value from deployed solutions and maintain high levels of adoption and satisfaction.

·      Identify risks to customer satisfaction, renewal, adoption or expansion and drive timely resolution with internal teams.

·      Convert customer success into references, case studies, repeat deployments and expansion opportunities.

8. Internal & Partner Collaboration

·      Align SMEs, presales, product management, inside sales, delivery and customer-success teams around account priorities and opportunity strategy.

·      Develop productive relationships with system integrators, consultants and technology partners to create and expand opportunities.

·      Share customer requirements, market feedback and competitive intelligence with relevant internal teams.

9. Commercial Management & Payment Follow-up

·      Own commercial follow-up for assigned accounts in coordination with finance, sales operations and business teams.

·      Track purchase orders, invoicing, payment milestones, outstanding receivables and agreed credit terms.

·      Proactively follow up with customer commercial/procurement/accounts-payable teams to ensure invoices are processed and payments are received on time.

·      Escalate overdue payments, disputes and commercial risks promptly and coordinate resolution with internal stakeholders.

·      Maintain healthy receivables and ensure account growth is supported by disciplined cash collection.

10. Market Intelligence & Marketing Support

·      Track industry trends, customer priorities, competitor positioning and emerging technologies in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance and Industrial IoT.

·      Identify market intelligence that can improve MachineAstro's value proposition and opportunity strategy.

·      Support marketing with customer insights, case studies, application stories, demos, blogs, videos and success stories.

11. Revenue & Management Reporting

·      Own account-level revenue growth in collaboration with Business Development and Sales leadership.

·      Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, opportunity stages, closure plans and account-growth metrics.

·      Provide management updates on revenue, pipeline, new use cases, expansion opportunities, customer risks, collections and strategic actions.

   Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·      Year-on-year revenue growth from assigned key accounts

·      New revenue generated from existing customers

·      Account expansion and share-of-wallet growth

·      New opportunities and qualified pipeline generated

·      New use cases / business cases developed

·      POC-to-commercial conversion rate

·      New plants, business units and assets penetrated

·      Customer retention, satisfaction and referenceability

·      Forecast accuracy and opportunity conversion

·      On-time collection / receivables performance and reduction of overdue payments

·      Strategic account-plan execution and stakeholder coverage

 Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hunter-farmer and trusted advisor who can protect and grow existing relationships while continuously discovering new customer problems, creating business value and converting opportunities into revenue. The candidate should be comfortable engaging with plant engineers as well as senior business leaders and should combine technical credibility with strong commercial ownership.

 Qualifications & Experience

·      BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering – preferred/required based on role fit

·      10+ years of relevant experience in industrial B2B sales, key account management, business development, reliability, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, industrial automation or related fields

·      CAT-II / CAT-III Vibration Certification – strongly preferred

·      MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Management or related discipline – preferred

·      Demonstrated experience managing strategic industrial accounts and delivering account growth

·      Experience with manufacturing/process industries and technical solution selling is highly desirable

 Core Competencies

·      Strategic Key Account Management

·      Account Expansion, Cross-sell & Upsell

·      Opportunity Hunting & Consultative Selling

·      Value Selling and Business Case Development

·      Vibration / Condition Monitoring Understanding

·      Customer & Executive Stakeholder Management

·      Commercial Negotiation and Collection Follow-up

·      Pipeline, Forecasting and Revenue Ownership

·      Problem Solving and Cross-functional Leadership

·      Strong communication, presentation and plant-level engagement skills

 Preferred Industry Exposure

Automotive & Auto Components • Steel & Metals • Cement • Power & Energy • Oil & Gas • Petrochemical • Chemicals • Pharmaceuticals • FMCG • Food Processing • Pulp & Paper • Mining • General Manufacturing • Process Industries • Industrial Automation / IIoT • Condition Monitoring / Predictive Maintenance

  Role Success Statement

* The core objective of the role is to grow strategic accounts by creating more value for customers. Success means deeper stakeholder relationships, more use cases, larger deployments, new plants and business units, stronger customer outcomes, healthy collections and sustainable year-on-year revenue growth.

Are you passionate about solving complex industrial challenges by matching customers with the right pump and water technology solutions? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.
  
  
As our new Sales Engineer, you'll be driving technical sales engagements with industrial customers that help them optimize their operations while growing Grundfos's market presence.
