* Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics
* Familiarity with Grundfos products or comparable pump and water technology solutions
* Knowledge of energy efficiency standards and sustainability practices in industrial settings

Join Grundfos, apply today!

* **Trade & Channel Governance:**
  Monitor distributor inventory levels, track secondary sales throughput, streamline billing, and maintain commercial discipline regarding trade schemes, payments, and claims settlement.
* **Team Leadership & Field Execution:**

* **Market Intelligence & Schemes:**
  Evaluate counter-initiatives, pricing, and promotional schemes by competitor brands; customize trade promotions to gain local market share.
* **Product Placement & Merchandising:**
  Work closely with key retail outlets and multi-brand counters to ensure prime shelf placement, POS visibility, and timely push for new product launches.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  14 to 16 years of hands-on channel distribution and sales management in the Kerala market.
* **Industry Background:**
  Core background strictly within
  **Ceiling Fans, Water Heaters/Geysers, and Home Appliances**
  .
* **Preferred Companies:**
  Current or past experience with leading electrical/appliance brands such as
  **Havells, Atomberg, Crompton, Polycab, Orient Electric, V-Guard, USHA, Bajaj Electricals**
  , or similar direct peers.

**Core Competencies:**

* Demonstrated ability in building, restructuring, and growing wholesale distributor networks across Kerala.
* Deep understanding of regional buying patterns, dealer networks, and electrical market hubs across North and South Kerala.
* Fluency in Malayalam and English (working knowledge of Hindi is an advantage).
* Strong negotiation, conflict-resolution, and commercial P&L management skills.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**GTM Engineer**

**Talentz.ai · Full-time · On-site, Kochi, India · Overlap with US Central mornings**

**About Talentz.ai**

Hiring lacks signal. Resumes have become cheap to generate and nearly identical, so companies receive more applications and less information. Talentz.ai builds Zee, an agentic hiring system that brings verified signal into sourcing, engagement and evaluation, with every decision auditable. We work with US startups and growth-stage companies that hire senior and specialized talent without a dedicated talent acquisition team.

**About the role**

This role combines marketing and SDR in one seat, and it runs on AI. You find the right companies and the communities where their founders spend time, start the right conversations, and run discovery calls and product demos yourself. Agents do the volume work. You design the workflows, make the judgment calls and own the outcome: qualified meetings with companies that have a real hiring need.

**What you will do**

1. **Signal-based targeting.**
   Build and maintain target account lists from live hiring signals such as recent funding, new job posts, leadership changes and headcount growth. Score and prioritize accounts every week.
2. **Community engine.**
   Map where our customers live: founder communities, Slack and Discord groups, Reddit and LinkedIn groups, forums, accelerator networks, conferences and meetups. Build a repeatable, AI-run system that tracks them, surfaces relevant conversations and events, and engages with useful contributions, not pitches.
3. **AI-run outbound.**
   Own email and LinkedIn sequences end to end: enrichment, personalization, sending infrastructure, deliverability and reply routing. Agents handle the volume; you own quality and conversion.
4. **Discovery calls and demos.**
   Run discovery calls and product demos consistently to meet weekly meeting and pipeline targets. Qualify the hiring need, show how Zee solves it, and hand qualified opportunities to leadership to close.
5. **The GTM stack.**
   Run and connect the CRM, enrichment, sequencing and community monitoring tools, alongside our own Zee agents. Keep data clean and attribution honest.
6. **Experiments.**
   Ship two or more experiments a week across message, segment, channel and community. Stop what fails quickly and scale what works.
7. **Events and webinars.**
   Automate registration filtering and follow-up for our monthly working sessions, and run outreach before and after the conferences we attend.
8. **Reporting.**
   Share a weekly pipeline view: accounts and communities reached, reply rates, discovery calls, demos, qualified meetings and the source of each.

**Your first 90 days**

**By day 30:**
You own all email campaigns, the stack is documented, deliverability is healthy, and 500+ signal-qualified accounts are live. You have mapped the top 30 communities and events where our customers gather, and you are co-running discovery calls.

**By day 60:**
Weekly experiments are running, the community engagement system is live, and you run discovery calls and demos on your own.

**By day 90:**
You run a repeatable engine across outbound and communities that meets the weekly demo target, with cost per meeting known by segment and channel.

**What you bring**

* 3 to 6 years across growth engineering, marketing operations, RevOps or a technical SDR/BDR role at a B2B SaaS company
* Experience running discovery calls and product demos with B2B buyers against a meeting target, ideally with US founders or executives
* Hands-on experience with Clay, Apollo, HubSpot or similar, and sending tools such as Instantly, Smartlead or Lemlist
* Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, Python or JavaScript, and SQL
* LLM-powered workflows you built that ran in production (prompting, agents, n8n, Make or Zapier)
* An understanding of how founder communities work and how to add value without being seen as spam
* Email deliverability fundamentals: domains, warm-up, SPF, DKIM and DMARC
* Clear written and spoken English, and the judgment to talk with a US founder or CTO without sounding scripted
* Comfort working with a US team across time zones and owning outcomes without being chased

**Nice to have**

* You have built an outbound engine from zero and can show the numbers
* You have sold to, or recruited for, US startups
* Experience in HR tech, recruiting tech or developer tools

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary with a performance bonus tied to pipeline
* Employee stock options
* Work from our Kochi office, directly with the founding team and a US customer base
* An agent-native team where your leverage comes from the systems you build

**How to apply**

Apply through this posting and include one example of an outbound or automation engine you built, with its results. Our process is a short screening call, a paid work sample of four hours or less, and two interviews.

***PriceSenz is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.***

title: Sales Officer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION (JD)Sales Officer – Viya Builders Pvt. Ltd.

**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Designation:** Sales Officer  
**Reporting To:** Sales Manager / Business Development Manager  
**Location:** Office and project locations, as required  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Grade:** Proposed G2–G3, subject to Viya's salary architecture  
**Document Owner:** HR Department

1. Job Purpose

The Sales Officer is responsible for generating qualified customer leads, developing business opportunities, presenting Viya Builders' construction services, coordinating customer meetings, following up on prospects, and converting potential customers into confirmed projects.

The role requires a systematic, customer-focused, and target-oriented approach to support the company's revenue growth and business development objectives.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Lead Generation and Business Development**

* Generate leads through referrals, networking, digital channels, field visits, and other approved sources.
* Identify potential customers planning to construct residential or commercial buildings.
* Develop relationships with prospective customers, architects, consultants, landowners, and other relevant business contacts.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified sales opportunities.
* Follow up on marketing-generated leads within the company's prescribed response time.

**B. Customer Handling and Sales Conversion**

* Understand customer requirements, budget, project location, construction expectations, and timelines.
* Explain Viya Builders' services, project execution process, quality standards, and commercial terms.
* Arrange customer meetings, site visits, and discussions with the relevant technical or management teams.
* Coordinate preparation and presentation of quotations and proposals with the concerned departments.
* Follow up on proposals, address customer queries, and support negotiations within approved commercial limits.
* Work towards converting qualified leads into confirmed construction projects.

**C. Sales Pipeline and CRM Management**

* Record all leads, calls, meetings, follow-ups, quotations, and sales outcomes in the designated CRM or tracking system.
* Maintain accurate customer contact details and project requirements.
* Update the status of every active opportunity regularly.
* Prepare daily activity reports and weekly sales pipeline reports.
* Ensure no qualified lead is neglected due to delayed follow-up.

**D. Customer Coordination and Internal Communication**

* Coordinate with the technical, estimation, design, commercial, and project teams to respond to customer requirements.
* Communicate customer commitments accurately and avoid making unauthorized promises regarding price, specifications, or project completion dates.
* Ensure proper handover of confirmed projects to the concerned internal team.
* Support customer communication during the pre-contract and sales handover stages.
* Escalate customer concerns, commercial disputes, and potential business risks to the reporting manager.

**E. Sales Target Achievement**

* Work towards monthly and quarterly lead-generation, meeting, proposal, and project-conversion targets.
* Monitor conversion rates and identify reasons for lost opportunities.
* Develop follow-up plans for pending proposals and high-potential customers.
* Support sales campaigns, customer outreach activities, and promotional initiatives.
* Contribute to the department's revenue and business development objectives.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The following KPIs should be finalized by the Sales Manager based on the company's sales strategy and available lead volume.

KPIMeasurementLead generationNumber of qualified leads generatedLead responsePercentage of leads contacted within the prescribed response timeCustomer meetingsNumber of qualified customer meetings completedFollow-up compliancePercentage of scheduled follow-ups completed on timeProposal conversionPercentage of submitted proposals converted into confirmed projectsSales achievementConfirmed sales value against the assigned targetCRM complianceCompleteness and accuracy of sales recordsPipeline managementValue and quality of active sales opportunitiesCustomer experienceCustomer feedback and complaints attributable to sales handlingHandover complianceCompleteness of documentation transferred after confirmation

**Important:** Targets must be measurable, realistic, and approved before the performance period begins. Sales value, conversion rate, and activity targets should be assessed together rather than relying on call volume alone.

4. Qualification and Experience

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field.
* Candidates with relevant construction-industry sales experience may also be considered.

**Experience**

* Preferably 1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, real estate, building materials, construction services, or a related industry.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn may be considered for junior-level positions.

5. Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong verbal and written communication.
* Customer relationship management and negotiation.
* Lead generation and sales follow-up.
* Basic commercial understanding and quotation coordination.
* Ability to understand construction-service offerings.
* CRM, spreadsheet, email, and reporting skills.
* Time management and systematic work habits.
* Professional customer handling and problem-solving.
* Ability to work towards measurable targets.
* Integrity, accountability, and coordination across departments.

6. Authority and Limitations

The Sales Officer may:

* Contact prospective customers and arrange meetings.
* Explain approved company services and pricing.
* Coordinate quotations and proposals.
* Conduct authorized customer visits.
* Recommend commercial solutions to the reporting manager.

The Sales Officer may not independently:

* Approve discounts or change approved pricing.
* Commit to unapproved project specifications or delivery dates.
* Sign contracts or agree to non-standard commercial terms without authorization.
* Make commitments on behalf of technical, project execution, or finance teams without confirmation.

7. Reporting and Review Mechanism

* **Daily:** Lead updates, customer interactions, planned follow-ups, and immediate escalations.
* **Weekly:** Sales pipeline review, meeting outcomes, proposal status, and expected conversions.
* **Monthly:** KPI performance, target achievement, lost-lead analysis, and next-month sales plan.
* **Quarterly:** Performance review, competency development, and target realignment where required.

All reporting must be submitted through the company's approved CRM, sales tracker, or reporting format.

8. Performance Expectations

The Sales Officer is expected to demonstrate ownership of assigned leads, timely follow-up, accurate reporting, professional customer handling, ethical sales practices, and measurable contribution to business growth.

Performance will be evaluated based on results, process compliance, customer experience, teamwork, and individual accountability.

9. Career Progression

Subject to sustained performance, demonstrated competencies, business requirements, and management approval, the potential career path is:

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Product Marketing & Content Executive
description:
**Company:** Factori.ai

**Department:** Marketing

**Location:** Bangalore, HSR Layout

**Work Mode:** 5 Days Work From Office

  

**About Factori**

Factori is the real-world data layer for enterprise AI. Our real-world intelligence platform connects business decisions and AI systems to aggregated physical-world signals through the Real World Graph. We help enterprise teams bring external context into decisions about locations, markets and customers. Our marketing team is building awareness and qualified demand among multi-location retailers and QSR businesses, starting with the US market.

  

**The Role**

  

We are looking for a hands-on marketer who combines product marketing with strong content creation skills. You will help retail buyers understand what Factori does, why it matters and how our insights solve real business problems. Working closely with the Product Marketing Lead and Growth Lead, you will develop product messaging, sales enablement materials, customer stories, thought leadership and digital content. You will translate complex data and product capabilities into clear, credible and engaging narratives that educate buyers, strengthen Factori’s positioning and support marketing and sales efforts.

  

This is an individual contributor role with equal ownership across product marketing and content marketing.

  

**What You Will Own**

  

**A. Product Marketing (50%)**

* Buyer and Market Research: Research retail buying situations, including expansion, site selection, competitor evaluation and local marketing. Gather insights from customer interviews, sales conversations and market research to understand buyer needs and pain points.
* Product Positioning and Messaging: Translate Factori’s capabilities, including aggregated mobility signals, points of interest, APIs and MCP, into clear business value propositions for retail expansion leaders, marketers and analysts.
* Sales Enablement: Create solution briefs, one-pagers, sales decks, demo scripts, FAQs, objection-handling documents and competitive comparison materials to help sales teams communicate Factori’s value.
* Customer Stories and Use Cases: Work with product, data and customer-facing teams to develop evidence-based customer stories, use cases and original-data narratives. Clearly document sources, assumptions and limitations.
* Product Launches: Coordinate messaging and launch assets for confirmed product capabilities, including announcements, demos, FAQs and sales enablement materials. Ensure all communication reflects actual product availability.
* Feedback and Optimization: Gather feedback from sales, customers and marketing campaigns to refine messaging, strengthen positioning and improve the effectiveness of sales materials.

**B. Content Marketing (50%)**

* Content Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute a content calendar aligned with Factori’s marketing priorities, target retail audiences, product narratives and business objectives.
* Long-Form Content Creation: Write high-quality blogs, articles, industry explainers, thought leadership pieces, reports and other educational content focused on retail intelligence, location analytics, consumer behaviour and AI-driven business decisions.
* SEO-Focused Content: Create search-friendly content around relevant keywords, customer questions and industry topics. Collaborate with SEO and web specialists to improve content discoverability and organic visibility.
* Thought Leadership: Turn Factori’s insights, research and expertise into compelling content for executive LinkedIn posts, company updates, newsletters and other relevant channels.
* Content Repurposing: Adapt original research, customer stories and product insights into multiple formats, including blogs, social posts, email content, webinar materials, infographics and sales collateral.
* Editorial Quality: Maintain high standards for writing, structure, clarity, factual accuracy, tone and consistency across all content. Work with subject-matter experts to validate technical and business claims.
* Content Performance: Track relevant metrics such as organic traffic, engagement, content-assisted conversions and asset usage. Use performance data and audience feedback to improve future content.

**Required AI Knowledge and Skills**

  

Practical knowledge of using AI to design, execute and improve product marketing and content workflows is required.

* Proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or equivalents for research synthesis, content development, messaging, ideation and sales enablement.
* Ability to use AI to accelerate content production while maintaining originality, factual accuracy, brand consistency and appropriate human review.
* Understanding of prompt design, context grounding and source verification, including validating claims against approved product documentation, customer evidence and reliable sources.
* Ability to build repeatable AI-assisted workflows with clear inputs, review steps and quality checks.
* Awareness of responsible handling of confidential information, copyright considerations and the limitations of AI-generated content.

**What You Bring**

* Experience in product marketing, content marketing, B2B writing or a related role, with work samples demonstrating your individual contribution.
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business audiences.
* Experience creating multiple content formats, such as blogs, articles, thought leadership, case studies, product collateral or sales enablement materials.
* Understanding of product positioning, buyer personas, value propositions and how content supports the customer journey.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, keyword research, content optimization and content performance metrics.
* Practical experience using AI in repeatable workflows, including fact-checking, source verification and improving output quality.
* Strong collaboration and project management skills, with the ability to work across product, sales, data and marketing teams.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, charts and basic performance reports, and the ability to distinguish verified findings from assumptions.

Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, retail technology, data products, geospatial intelligence or AI-driven solutions is useful but not mandatory.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

In your first 90 days, you will understand Factori’s priority retail buyers, establish a strong foundation of approved messaging and content themes, and deliver a coordinated set of product marketing and content assets. Success will be measured through the quality and accuracy of messaging, adoption of sales enablement materials, consistency and effectiveness of content production, organic visibility, audience engagement and contribution to qualified marketing engagement and sales conversations.

  

**Why Join Factori?**

  

Your work will shape how enterprise buyers understand Factori and its real-world intelligence platform. You will work with experienced marketing leaders, explore practical applications of AI in marketing and build content and messaging that help a growing business reach the right audiences.

Creative concepts

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**PERFORMANCE MARKETING MANAGER**
**AMEENJI RUBBER LIMITED | CORE MARKETING**
**Company: Ameenji Rubber Limited**
**Department: Core Marketing**
**Experience: 3-5 years**
**Salary: 30,000-50,000 per month**
Ameenji Rubber Limited is hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to plan, execute and improve paid digital campaigns that generate qualified customer enquiries and support business growth.
  
  
This role combines campaign strategy with hands-on execution. You will work closely with sales, creative, website and technical teams to connect our products with the right customers and turn marketing investment into measurable business opportunities.
  
  
About Ameenji Rubber Limited Ameenji Rubber Limited manufactures engineered and commercial rubber products serving infrastructure, railways, industrial, fitness and agricultural applications. Our portfolio includes bridge bearings, expansion joints, railway components, industrial rubber sheets, electrical rubber mats, gym flooring and animal-care mats.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop performance marketing strategies: Create monthly and quarterly campaign plans aligned with product priorities, target customers, approved markets and business objectives.
* Manage paid advertising campaigns: Set up, launch and optimise Google Ads and Meta campaigns. Use LinkedIn and YouTube advertising where relevant to the audience and campaign objectives.
* Identify and reach relevant buyers: Develop targeting strategies for contractors, procurement teams, industrial buyers, dealers, distributors and customers across our commercial product categories.
* Own paid search optimisation: Conduct keyword research, structure campaigns and ad groups, review search terms, maintain negative keywords and improve bidding, targeting and ad relevance.
* Manage advertising budgets: Prepare media plans, monitor daily spending, forecast campaign outcomes and allocate budgets according to lead quality and business performance.
* Develop effective campaign messaging: Write and test ad copy, headlines and calls to action. Brief designers and video editors on product benefits, creative concepts and required campaign assets.
* Improve landing pages and conversions: Collaborate with website and technical teams to improve product pages, enquiry forms, page experience and conversion paths.
* Maintain accurate campaign tracking: Implement and validate GA4, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, conversion events and UTM tracking with technical support where required.
* Connect advertising to actual enquiries: Track verified form submissions, calls and other customer enquiries. Distinguish contact clicks from completed enquiries and reconcile campaign results with sales or CRM records.
* Improve lead quality with sales feedback: Agree on lead qualification criteria, review duplicate or irrelevant enquiries and refine campaigns based on sales acceptance and follow-up outcomes.
* Run structured experiments: Test audiences, creatives, offers, bidding strategies and landing pages. Document results and use findings to guide campaign improvements.
* Manage remarketing and follow-up campaigns: Build appropriate remarketing audiences and coordinate lead nurturing with the sales and marketing teams.
* Report on business performance: Prepare weekly dashboards and monthly reviews covering spend, qualified enquiries, conversion rates, acquisition costs and attributable sales pipeline. Present clear recommendations and next steps.
* Monitor competitors and maintain campaign quality: Research competitor messaging, customer demand and advertising trends. Ensure campaigns use accurate, approved product claims and comply with advertising platform requirements.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* 4-5 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing or paid digital advertising.
* Demonstrated experience generating leads and managing advertising budgets independently.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
* Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking and campaign reporting.
* Ability to analyse performance using Excel, Google Sheets or reporting dashboards.
* Strong understanding of audience targeting keyword strategy, ad copywriting and landing page optimisation.
* Ability to explain campaign results clearly and recommend actions based on data.
* Good planning, communication and coordination skills, with ownership of deadlines and campaign execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B marketing, manufacturing, industrial products, infrastructure or dealer and distributor acquisition.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, YouTube advertising, Looker Studio and CRM reporting.
* Experience connecting advertising enquiries to sales outcomes.
* A degree in marketing, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Growth in qualified customer enquiries and sales-accepted leads.
* Improvement in cost per qualified lead and landing page conversion rates.
* Contribution to attributable sales opportunities and pipeline.
* Accurate tracking, reliable reporting and effective budget control.
* Return on advertising spend where revenue can be reliably attributed.

**What You’ll Work On**
You will take ownership of paid acquisition within Ameenji’s core marketing team, promote products across multiple industries and collaborate directly with colleagues who understand the products and their customers.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Interested candidates may send their updated CV to msl@ameenji.net ,careers@ameenji.net
  
  
**Email subject: Application for Performance Marketing Manager - Your Name**
**Please Include**

* Your updated CV.
* Your notice period and earliest joining date.
* Your expected monthly salary.
* Two campaign examples outlining your contribution, budget range, strategy and measurable results.

Anonymised case studies are welcome. Please avoid sharing confidential information belonging to previous employers or clients.

title: SEO, GEO & AEO Specialist
description:
**Experience:**
3–5 years
  
  
**Function:**
Marketing & Growth
  
  
**About Zithara.AI**
Zithara.AI is an AI-native revenue optimization platform for consumer-facing businesses. We connect customer interactions across advertising, websites, WhatsApp, social media, calls, store visits and purchases—helping businesses capture opportunities, improve conversion and grow repeat revenue.
  
  
Our AI agents help optimize the processes behind marketing, sales and customer engagement. We work with businesses across jewellery, retail, wellness and other consumer sectors.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for an SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Specialist to strengthen how Zithara.AI is discovered through search engines and AI-powered answers.
  
  
You’ll translate the questions business owners ask into a clear search and content strategy—helping prospective customers discover Zithara.AI, understand its relevance and take the next step toward a conversation or demo.
  
  
This is a hands-on role covering keyword research, technical SEO, on-page optimization, content planning and emerging search experiences. You’ll work closely with marketing, content, product and website teams, connecting discoverability efforts to qualified inbound demand.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
**Build a search strategy around customer needs**

* Research how our target customers search for solutions to lead leakage, disconnected customer data, slow follow-ups, low conversions and customer retention.
* Map keywords and questions to industries, use cases and stages of the buying journey.
* Identify opportunities across product, solution, industry, comparison and educational content.
* Prioritize topics by business relevance, buyer intent and opportunity—not search volume alone.

**Improve website content and on-page SEO**

* Optimize page titles, descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links and content structure.
* Review existing pages for intent mismatch, thin coverage, duplication and unclear messaging.
* Develop actionable briefs for blogs, landing pages, case studies and FAQs.
* Work with content and product teams to make Zithara.AI’s capabilities clear, accurate and relevant to business decision-makers.

**Strengthen technical SEO**

* Run site audits and prioritize fixes by their impact on discoverability, user experience and conversions.
* Identify crawling, indexing, canonicalization, redirect, sitemap and performance issues.
* Coordinate fixes with developers and verify implementation.
* Implement and validate relevant structured data, ensuring it accurately reflects page content.

**Develop visibility across AI-powered search**

* Research and test ways to improve Zithara.AI’s discoverability across answer engines and generative search experiences.
* Structure content with clear explanations, direct answers, useful FAQs and evidence-backed claims.
* Strengthen consistency across product descriptions, company information, industry content and customer stories.
* Monitor relevant queries for brand mentions, citations and competitor visibility, documenting findings and measurement limitations.
* Turn experiments into practical recommendations without promising rankings or AI citations.

**Connect performance to business outcomes**

* Track organic visibility, relevant traffic, engagement, demo enquiries and qualified leads.
* Build clear reporting using Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush or comparable tools.
* Explain what changed, why it matters and what action should follow.
* Maintain a prioritized optimization backlog and document completed work and results.
* Identify opportunities to build authority through relevant partnerships, industry publications and credible mentions.

What You’ll Bring
  
  
**Must Have**

* 3–5 years of hands-on SEO experience across content and technical work.
* Ability to independently execute keyword research, on-page optimization and site audits.
* Strong understanding of search intent and how it connects to a B2B buying journey.
* Experience translating SEO recommendations into clear content briefs and developer tasks.
* Ability to prioritize work by business impact and follow through on implementation.
* Working proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush or comparable platforms.
* Familiarity with crawl tools such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb.
* An informed understanding of AI-powered search, answer engines and zero-click experiences.
* Strong written English and the ability to explain findings to non-technical stakeholders.
* Examples of previous work showing your contribution and measurable results.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with B2B SaaS, CRM, marketing technology, retail technology or AI products.
* Experience supporting international SEO, particularly for India and Australia.
* Familiarity with structured data, website CMS platforms and basic HTML.
* Experience creating industry pages, comparison pages and content clusters.
* Practical experience testing and measuring GEO or AEO initiatives.
* Experience connecting organic acquisition to CRM data and lead quality.

How You Work
  
  

* You take ownership—from identifying an opportunity to implementing and evaluating it.
* You can understand a complex product and explain its value in language business owners understand.
* You balance research with execution and maintain clear priorities.
* You distinguish evidence from assumptions and use experiments to resolve uncertainty.
* You use AI tools thoughtfully, checking accuracy and preserving original insight.
* You care about attracting the right customers and helping them take action.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* More visibility for searches relevant to Zithara.AI’s products, industries and customer problems.
* A technically sound website with clear, well-connected content.
* Growth in relevant organic traffic and qualified demo enquiries.
* A documented approach to monitoring and improving AI-search discoverability.
* Reporting that helps the team decide what to improve next.

How to Apply
  
  
Share your CV and two or three examples of SEO work. For each, explain the problem, your contribution, the actions you took and the results achieved. If you’ve tested GEO or AEO approaches, include what you measured and learned.

title: Sr. Manager - SEO & Content
description:
**About Pixelo Digital**

Pixelo Digital is a B2B growth and GTM company helping technology businesses generate pipeline, conversations and revenue. We work across outbound, ABM, intent-led campaigns, performance marketing, SEO, content and data-driven GTM. We’ve worked with 250+ brands across technology, SaaS and enterprise, and we’re building a brand around one simple idea:

**Great marketing should create business impact.**

Alongside our services, we’re building Prospectoo, our B2B GTM intelligence platform, to help businesses identify, engage and convert their ideal customers more effectively.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a strategic and execution-focused Senior Manager – SEO & Growth to lead organic growth, search visibility and website performance for Pixelo Digital and Prospectoo.

This role goes beyond improving keyword rankings or driving website traffic. You’ll be responsible for building a scalable organic growth engine that attracts the right audiences, strengthens brand authority, generates qualified leads and contributes to pipeline and revenue.

You’ll own the SEO strategy across technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO and programmatic SEO, while expanding our visibility across AI-powered search through Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).

Working closely with content, marketing, product, sales and leadership teams, you’ll combine data-driven decision-making with hands-on execution to identify growth opportunities, improve website conversions and turn organic visibility into measurable business outcomes.

You’ll work across the entire organic growth journey:

Research → Strategy → Optimisation → Visibility → Acquisition → Conversion → Pipeline

**What You'll Do:**

**SEO Strategy & Organic Growth**

• Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with business objectives, target audiences, ICPs and GTM priorities.

• Own organic growth across technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, content SEO and programmatic SEO.

• Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor benchmarking and content gap analysis to identify high-impact growth opportunities.

• Build keyword clusters, topic clusters, pillar pages and search-led content strategies to strengthen topical authority.

• Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic quality, keyword rankings, search visibility and qualified lead generation.

• Develop scalable SEO processes that support growth across Pixelo Digital, Prospectoo and relevant service or product categories.

**Technical SEO & Website Optimisation**

• Conduct technical SEO audits to identify and resolve issues related to crawlability, indexability, site architecture, redirects, canonicalisation, duplicate content and XML sitemaps.

• Optimise website structure, internal linking, URL architecture, metadata, schema markup and page performance.

• Collaborate with developers and website teams to improve Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed and technical search performance.

• Monitor website health, identify indexing issues and implement corrective actions to maintain search engine accessibility.

• Build and optimise landing pages, service pages, solution pages and product pages to improve search visibility and user experience.

• Identify opportunities for conversion rate optimisation (CRO) through landing page experiments, user journey analysis and on-page improvements.

**AEO, GEO & AI-Powered Search**

• Develop strategies to improve brand visibility across AI-powered search experiences, answer engines and generative search platforms.

• Optimise content for Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), featured snippets, rich results and relevant search features.

• Structure content to improve clarity, topical relevance, entity understanding and discoverability across traditional and AI-powered search.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen brand mentions, authoritative citations and visibility in relevant AI-generated answers.

• Monitor changes in search behaviour, zero-click searches and AI-driven discovery to adapt organic growth strategies.

• Experiment with emerging optimisation techniques and measure their impact on brand discovery, qualified traffic and conversions.

**Content SEO & Organic Demand Generation**

• Collaborate with content and subject matter experts to develop search-led blogs, landing pages, comparison pages, use cases, case studies and thought leadership content.

• Translate keyword research and search intent into actionable content briefs, page structures, content recommendations and editorial priorities.

• Identify opportunities to capture high-intent searches through solution-led, industry-specific, competitor comparison and bottom-of-funnel content.

• Optimise existing content to improve rankings, relevance, engagement, freshness and conversion potential.

• Build content strategies around buyer pain points, ICPs, industry trends and high-value search opportunities.

• Align SEO initiatives with broader content marketing and demand generation efforts to drive qualified organic leads.

**Off-Page SEO & Authority Building**

• Develop ethical link-building and digital PR strategies to strengthen domain authority and search visibility.

• Identify relevant websites, industry publications, partner platforms and authoritative sources for backlink opportunities.

• Build strategies for earning high-quality backlinks through original research, industry insights, thought leadership and link-worthy content.

• Monitor backlink profiles, identify potentially harmful links and address off-page SEO risks where necessary.

• Work with content, partnerships and marketing teams to strengthen brand credibility and authority across relevant industry ecosystems.

**Programmatic SEO & Scalable Growth**

• Identify opportunities to build scalable, search-led landing pages around relevant industries, use cases, solutions, integrations and customer segments.

• Develop programmatic SEO strategies that balance scale, search intent, content quality and genuine user value.

• Collaborate with product, engineering and content teams to implement scalable page templates, structured data and internal linking systems.

• Establish quality controls to avoid thin, duplicative or low-value pages that could negatively affect search performance.

• Evaluate opportunities to use automation and AI to streamline keyword clustering, content briefs, SEO analysis and optimisation workflows.

**Website Analytics & Conversion Optimisation**

• Own organic search reporting and track performance across traffic, impressions, clicks, rankings, engagement, conversions and qualified leads.

• Use analytics and search performance data to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance drops and prioritise optimisation initiatives.

• Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure organic acquisition, landing page performance, lead generation and pipeline contribution.

• Work with marketing and sales teams to understand lead quality and connect organic acquisition efforts with business outcomes.

• Conduct experiments on page layouts, calls to action, messaging, internal linking and conversion paths to improve website performance.

**Growth Strategy, AI & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

• Identify growth opportunities through competitor analysis, market research, customer insights and emerging search trends.

• Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve SEO research, reporting, content workflows and operational efficiency.

• Work closely with content, product, development, marketing and sales teams to align organic growth initiatives with broader GTM objectives.

• Collaborate with leadership to define growth priorities, allocate resources and establish measurable performance targets.

**Key Tools You’ll Work With**

• SEO & Keyword Research: Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console and relevant keyword research platforms.

• Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Looker Studio, Google Tag Manager and performance dashboards.

• Technical SEO: Screaming Frog SEO Spider, site auditing tools, PageSpeed Insights and Core Web Vitals reporting.

• AEO, GEO & AI Search: AI-powered research and content tools, AI search visibility monitoring platforms and relevant structured data tools.

• Content & Optimisation: Content optimisation platforms, CMS tools, keyword clustering and content auditing tools.

• Website & Conversion Optimisation: WordPress or relevant CMS platforms, landing page testing tools, heatmaps and CRO analytics.

• AI & Automation: Generative AI tools and workflow automation platforms for research, analysis, reporting and optimisation.

**What We’re Looking For**

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, Communications or a related field.

• 6–9 years of experience in SEO, organic growth, search marketing or digital growth roles, preferably within B2B SaaS, technology or IT services.

• Proven experience developing and executing SEO strategies that improve organic visibility, qualified traffic, lead generation and business performance.

• Strong hands-on expertise in technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, keyword research, site architecture and website audits.

• Practical understanding of AEO, GEO, AI-powered search experiences, structured data and evolving search discovery patterns.

• Experience with programmatic SEO, scalable landing page strategies and large-scale website optimisation is a plus.

• Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush and technical SEO auditing platforms.

• Ability to analyse SEO and website performance data, identify actionable insights and build measurable growth plans.

• Understanding of conversion rate optimisation, lead generation funnels, ICPs, buyer journeys and B2B demand generation.

• Experience using AI-powered tools and automation to improve SEO research, content workflows and reporting.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company:**

RMH & Group

**Location:**

Mumbai

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Work Mode:**

On-site

**Experience:**

2–4 years

**About RMH Advisors & Group**

RMH & Group is a growing professional services organisation. We are looking for a proactive, creative, and outcome-focused Digital Marketing Executive who can independently manage our digital presence, generate business leads, and strengthen our brand visibility.

**Role Overview:**

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role suited for someone who enjoys taking ownership from planning to execution. You will be responsible for managing digital marketing activities end-to-end, including social media, content creation, website updates, campaigns, lead generation, and performance tracking.

We are looking for a smart, resourceful, and self-driven professional who can work independently, experiment with new ideas, and deliver measurable results without requiring extensive supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Marketing & Strategy**

* Plan and execute digital marketing activities aligned with business objectives.
* Develop monthly content calendars and campaign plans.
* Identify relevant digital channels and opportunities to improve brand awareness and lead generation.
* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, competitor activities, and industry developments.

**2. Social Media Management**

* Manage the company's social media presence across relevant platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook.
* Create engaging posts, carousels, short-form videos, and other digital content.
* Write compelling captions, copy, and calls to action.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice and posting schedule.
* Monitor engagement, respond to relevant interactions, and improve content performance.

**3. Content Creation & Brand Communication**

* Create marketing content for the company's services, offerings, achievements, and industry insights.
* Work with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into engaging content.
* Design creatives using tools such as Canva and coordinate external support when necessary.
* Ensure all content is accurate, professional, and aligned with the company's brand identity.

**4. Lead Generation & Campaign Management**

* Plan and execute digital campaigns to generate relevant business enquiries and leads.
* Support lead generation through organic social media, email marketing, landing pages, and paid campaigns, as applicable.
* Set up and monitor Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns where relevant.
* Track incoming leads, campaign performance, and conversion opportunities.
* Explore cost-effective marketing initiatives suited to an SME environment.

**5. Website & SEO Management**

* Maintain website content, service pages, blogs, and other relevant updates.
* Implement basic SEO practices, including keyword research, on-page optimisation, and content optimisation.
* Monitor website traffic, search performance, and visitor behaviour using tools such as Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
* Identify opportunities to improve website visibility, traffic quality, and enquiry generation.

**6. Email Marketing & Marketing Collateral**

* Create and execute email campaigns, newsletters, and business communication materials.
* Develop brochures, presentations, service profiles, and other marketing collateral.
* Support campaigns for client acquisition, business updates, and brand-building initiatives.

**7. Analytics & Performance Reporting**

* Track and report key marketing metrics, including reach, engagement, website traffic, leads, and campaign conversions.
* Prepare simple monthly performance reports with actionable insights.
* Identify what is working, what is not, and what needs to change.
* Recommend improvements based on data, audience behaviour, and business priorities.

**8. Ownership & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work directly with management to understand business priorities and marketing requirements.
* Manage the complete execution cycle, from ideation and planning to publishing and reporting.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, or external agencies when required.
* Take ownership of timelines, deliverables, and the quality of work.
* Be comfortable working in a lean team, managing multiple priorities, and finding practical solutions with available resources.

**What we are looking for:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, preferably in an SME, startup, consulting, or professional services environment.
* Strong working knowledge of social media marketing, content creation, SEO, and digital campaign execution.
* Ability to independently create content, manage campaigns, and track results.
* Familiarity with Canva and tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Meta Business Suite, and email marketing platforms.
* Basic understanding of paid advertising, audience targeting, and lead generation.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and attention to detail.
* A proactive, resourceful, and outcome-oriented approach.
* Ability to manage multiple activities without constant follow-up or supervision.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* A consistent and professional digital presence for RMH & Group.
* Improved brand visibility and audience engagement across relevant platforms.
* Regular execution of planned marketing activities and campaigns.
* A measurable contribution to qualified business enquiries and lead generation.
* Improved website visibility, content quality, and campaign performance.
* Clear reporting, timely execution, and continuous improvement in marketing outcomes.

﻿

**Important to Know about this role:**

This is an
**individual contributor position**

, not a team management role. The selected candidate is expected to personally execute the work, take initiative, and manage day-to-day digital marketing activities independently.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically but is equally comfortable writing a post, designing a creative, updating a website, running a campaign, and analysing its results.

**If you are someone who enjoys taking ownership, learning quickly, and making a visible business impact, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Marketing & Social Media Lead at SOULSARA
description:
We’re hiring: Marketing & Social Media Lead at SOULSARA

We’re looking for a tigress or tiger. Anyone can post three times a week. Few can make a brand impossible to ignore, and fewer still can turn it into a movement. We want a storyteller with a strategist’s brain who builds reputations, not follower counts.

**OUR ECOSYSTEM:**

SOULSARA reads the signal. It’s a deep-tech workforce performance platform that uses biometric and psychometric data to help leaders grow their people and their business.

SOULSTREAM.CHANNEL tells the story. It’s cinema that rewires you, an immersive content engine built on 20 years of research.

SOULARIUM is where you step inside. It’s a patented immersive environment of light, colour and sound that restores the body and mind.

The role

* You will own social media end to end: LinkedIn for leaders and enterprises, Instagram and YouTube for audiences.
* You will turn deep science into content people stop scrolling for.
* You will build our reputation with founders, CHROs, partners, investors and media.
* You will run campaigns, launches and partnerships, and measure what works.
* You will own clear KPIs and targets for reach, engagement, leads and brand growth.
* You will lead agencies, designers, editors and freelancers.
* You will build one brand story across all three ventures, and give each its own voice.

You bring

* You have 4+ years in brand, content or social media marketing.
* You have success stories you can show: brands you grew and the numbers behind them.
* You are result-oriented, and you set, track and hit KPIs and targets.
* You have strong instincts for film, video and visual storytelling.
* You are comfortable selling to businesses on LinkedIn and engaging audiences on Instagram in the same week.
* Experience in deep-tech, health-tech, media or experiential brands is a strong plus.

What we offer

* Compensation based on experience, plus a performance bonus
* Years of collateral, research and content across three ventures: an established body of work, ready to be amplified, with the freedom to take it further
* Direct access to the founders
* Creative ownership, with no committee approving every caption

Location: Hybrid, covering South and West India

Preferred: Mumbai, Belagavi or Bengaluru

If you’re based outside Mumbai or Belagavi, you’ll join in-person meetings twice a month.

If you can take three ventures and make the world see one vision, we want to hear from you.

To apply, DM me with:

1. Your portfolio
2. Two success stories, with the KPIs and results behind them
3. Two professional references (we will speak to them)
4. One idea for how you’d introduce SOULSARA.WORLD SOULSTREAM.CHANNEL and SOULARIUM as one ecosystem

title: Social Media Lead (Podcasts)
description:
**The Attention Co. | Marol, Mumbai | Full-time, In-office**

About Us

The Attention Co. is a content and personal branding studio working across podcasts, digital content, and audience growth. We work with founders, leaders, creators, and experts to bring meaningful conversations to a wider audience.

We’re looking for a Social Media Lead who enjoys podcasts as a medium and wants to help build shows people choose to spend time with.

About the Role

You should already listen to English-language podcasts out of curiosity. You have favourite shows, remember conversations that changed your thinking, and enjoy discovering people with something worthwhile to say.

Our work centres on thoughtful conversations about business, science, health, psychology, culture, and how people live and work. You should enjoy finding the story, question, or practical insight that makes a conversation worth someone’s attention.

You’ll bring that judgment to content planning, clip selection, creative briefs, writing, publishing, and audience growth. You’ll work closely with the founder, producers, researchers, editors, and designers to help each show find its audience.

What You’ll Do

* **Understand the conversation:**
  Watch full episodes, follow the ideas, and identify what makes each guest and discussion interesting.
* **Find strong moments:**
  Select clips with a compelling opening, enough context to stand alone, and a clear insight or payoff. Preserve what the speaker means.
* **Plan episode releases:**
  Build campaigns across trailers, Reels, Shorts, carousels, Stories, and full-episode promotion.
* **Guide the creative team:**
  Brief editors and designers clearly, review their work, and give specific feedback on storytelling, pacing, captions, and visuals.
* **Write and package content:**
  Develop hooks, captions, titles, descriptions, and thumbnail ideas that make people curious and accurately represent the conversation.
* **Own publishing:**
  Maintain calendars, coordinate approvals, and keep content moving consistently across Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
* **Understand the audience:**
  Read comments, study viewing behaviour, and identify the questions and ideas people respond to.
* **Improve through experimentation:**
  Test formats and packaging, review results, and use what you learn to shape future content.

Who We’re Looking For

**A real interest in thoughtful English-language podcasts is essential.**
You should be able to talk about what you listen to, why you return to certain shows, and what makes a conversation work.

Beyond that, we’re looking for someone who:

* Is curious about people and ideas, asks good questions, and enjoys learning.
* Can recognise a useful insight, an unexpected perspective, or a story worth exploring.
* Writes clear, engaging English and can simplify an idea without losing its meaning.
* Has experience taking responsibility for content or social media projects.
* Is organised, dependable, and comfortable coordinating with a creative team.
* Takes feedback well and is willing to build their skills in analytics, packaging, and distribution.

Experience with podcasts, YouTube channels, editorial content, or creator-led brands would be useful. Your judgment, curiosity, and willingness to take ownership matter more than knowing every tool.

What Success Looks Like

Each show has a recognisable voice and a clear reason for people to watch. Strong ideas become well-chosen clips and thoughtful campaigns. Publishing is dependable, creative feedback is useful, and audience insights improve what we make next.

People discover a short clip, become interested in the conversation, and return for more.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
About Ruvimo

We’re Ruvimo — a fast-growing global EdTech platform making K-12 learning more personal, one-on-one, and actually fun.

We connect students with amazing tutors and use technology + human connection to create learning experiences that build confidence, curiosity, and real results.

And now, we’re looking for someone who’s
**organized, curious, quick on their feet, and low-key obsessed with getting things done.**

If you like turning ideas into action, keeping 10 tabs open at once, and saying
*“I’ll take care of it”*
— keep reading. 👀

The Role

We’re hiring a
**Marketing Coordinator Intern**
for a 3-month internship.

You’ll work closely with our
**Marketing Consultant and internal teams**
to make sure marketing ideas actually move from
*“we should do this”*
to
*“it’s live.”*

You’ll be coordinating campaigns, chasing deliverables, keeping things organized, supporting content, looking at numbers, and helping the marketing engine run smoothly.

And no, we’re not going to judge you based on how long you’re online.

**We care about what gets done, not how many hours you spend staring at your laptop.**

As long as your work gets done well and on time, you’ll have the flexibility to manage your schedule.

What You’ll Be Doing 💻📣 Make Campaigns Happen

Work with our marketing consultant to help plan, launch, coordinate, and track campaigns across:

* Social media
* Performance marketing
* Email
* Content
* Other growth experiments

You’ll get to see how an idea goes from
**brainstorm → execution → results.**

🧩 Keep Everyone on Track

You’ll be the person making sure:

**“Can you send this?” → “Is this ready?” → “Has this been approved?” → “Is this live?”**

actually happens.

You’ll coordinate between marketing, design, content, and other teams to keep campaigns and content calendars moving.

Basically, you’ll help prevent things from falling through the cracks. 🫡

✍️ Help Create & Ship Content

You won’t necessarily be creating every piece of content yourself — but you’ll be very involved in making sure the right content gets out.

You’ll help with:

* Collecting creative assets
* Proofreading copy
* Checking content for errors
* Coordinating posts and campaigns
* Organizing marketing collateral
* Helping create content for parents and students

📊 Look at the Numbers

Don’t worry — you don't need to be a data scientist. 😭

You’ll help track basic marketing metrics, put together reports, spot interesting patterns, and understand:

**What worked?**

**What flopped?**

**What should we do differently next time?**

Keep an eye on competitors, trends, social media, campaigns, and what’s happening in the EdTech/education space.

If you see something interesting and think:

**“Wait… Ruvimo should try this.”**

We want to hear it.

You’ll Be a Great Fit If You 👀

* Are super organized and weirdly enjoy keeping things in order
* Can juggle multiple tasks without completely losing it
* Have a basic understanding of digital marketing
* Know your way around Instagram, LinkedIn, email, ads, etc.
* Understand basic marketing metrics
* Communicate clearly and confidently
* Are proactive instead of waiting to be told what to do
* Learn quickly and ask good questions
* Are comfortable in a fast-moving startup where things can change
  *very*
  quickly
* Actually enjoy figuring things out

Bonus points if you...

✨ Have worked on social media/content projects

✨ Have done a marketing internship before

✨ Know Canva, Google Sheets, Notion, Meta Ads, or similar tools

✨ Have an eye for what makes content interesting

✨ Bring ideas instead of just bringing questions

🚨 One Non-Negotiable

**You MUST have your own working laptop.**

We need you to be able to work independently and jump into tasks without waiting around for equipment.

What You Get 💸

**₹10,000 – ₹12,000/month stipend**

And a crazy growth and exposure!

🕐 Flexible Working Hours

No unnecessary clock-watching.

You manage your schedule around your work.

**Tasks done well + deadlines met = happy team.**

🏠 Hybrid Setup

Mostly remote, with occasional in-office syncs at our
**Mulund, Mumbai**
office when required.

🚀 Real Startup Experience

You’ll work directly with our
**Marketing Consultant + senior leadership**
and get hands-on exposure to how marketing actually works inside a growing global EdTech startup.

Not the classic:

*“Make a PPT and send it to HR.”*
😭

You’ll actually
**do things, experiment, learn, and see the impact of your work.**

Think You’re That Person? 👀

If you’re looking for an internship where you can actually
**own work, learn ridiculously fast, experiment with ideas, and see your work go live**
— we’d love to hear from you.

**Come build with us. 🚀**

#Ruvimo #MarketingInternship #MarketingJobs #Internship #EdTech #DigitalMarketing #MumbaiJobs

for more visit www.responsenet.org

You'll work with programme teams to find stories, photographs and videos, and turn them into content that performs on each platform. You'll also be accountable for numbers: reach, engagement, follower growth and website traffic.

This role covers Responsenet and its social enterprises.

What You'll Do

**Content creation**

* Create posts, reels, carousels, stories and short videos for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and X
* Turn field visits, programme updates, photos and beneficiary stories into compelling, platform-native content
* Write captions, website content, newsletters, campaign copy and donor-facing communications
* Shoot and edit basic photo and video content, on the field when needed
* Excellent at leveraging AI tools.

**Publishing and channel management**

* Own and run a monthly content calendar across all platforms
* Publish consistently and maintain a recognisable brand voice and visual identity
* Keep the website updated with programme news, stories and impact content

**Growth and reach**

* Grow followers, reach and engagement across platforms month on month
* Use trends, formats, hashtags, collaborations and timing strategically to expand organic reach
* Engage actively with our community by replying to comments and DMs and interacting with partners, donors and peer organisations
* Build visibility through partner and influencer tags, cross-posting, and collaborations with CSR partners and allied organisations
* Support paid boosting and digital campaigns, including Google Ads landing pages and campaign content

**Analytics and improvement**

* Track performance using native platform insights, Google Analytics and similar tools
* Share a simple monthly report covering what worked, what didn't, and what's next
* Use data to refine formats, posting times and content mix

**Campaigns and events**

* Plan and run digital campaigns for awareness days, fundraising drives, events and programme launches
* Provide live coverage of events and field activities

What Success Looks Like in Your First 3 Months

* A consistent, well-planned content calendar running across all active platforms
* Measurable growth in followers, reach and engagement
* A library of strong field stories, reels and visual content from our programmes
* Regular, useful performance reports that shape our content decisions

* Comfort with analytics and making decisions from data

* Experience in the development, NGO, CSR or social impact sector (an advantage)

We're looking for someone creative, curious and consistent: a person who can look at an ordinary programme update or field photo and see a story worth telling. You should care about the work behind the content, and you should also care whether people see it.

What We Offer

* The chance to build an organisation's digital presence with real ownership
* Direct exposure to grassroots programmes across India

Apply through linkedin only.

is positioned to build a lasting presence across both digital and physical spaces. We are seeking a motivated and skilled marketing professional to join our core team and play an instrumental role in shaping the brand's journey.

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Marketing Executive based in New Delhi.

This is a
**Founder's Office role**
.

The selected candidate will work in close coordination with the founder, contributing directly to brand strategy, marketing execution, and business growth decisions from day one.

You will be a central figure in building and executing the Moolicious brand across all channels. This is not a siloed execution role — you will be involved in strategic planning, content creation, campaign management, and brand partnerships. You will work directly alongside the founder and have significant ownership over how Moolicious presents itself to the world.

**Digital marketing & social media**

* Develop and manage monthly content calendars for the brand's Instagram and LinkedIn channels

* Track performance metrics of ads and present structured weekly and monthly reports with recommendations

**Offline campaigns & brand activations**

* Identify, approach, and manage collaboration opportunities with relevant cafes, lifestyle brands, and community platforms
* Oversee partnership logistics from initial outreach through to post-collaboration content and reporting
* Plan and execute offline marketing initiatives including sampling drives, pop-up experiences, and community events
* Represent the brand on-ground during activations — active participation is a core expectation of this role

**Founder's personal brand management**

* Manage the founder's Instagram and LinkedIn presence in parallel with the brand's official channels
* Develop and publish content that establishes the founder as a credible voice in the food, business, and entrepreneurship space
* Identify and pitch opportunities for the founder to participate in podcasts, industry panels, and public forums

**Content strategy & coordination**

* Maintain a structured content library that supports repurposing across channels and formats
* Brief and manage the content writers for blog posts, long-form content, and outreach materials

* A demonstrable portfolio of brand work — campaigns, Instagram pages, or content projects
* Strong written communication skills in both English and Hindi
* Experience coordinating with external vendors, freelancers, or creative teams
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to work

**Company: At Stay**

**Work Mode: In-office or hybrid (3 days in-office)**

**Stipend: ₹5,000–₹7,000 per month for the in-office role; ₹3,000 per month for the hybrid role**

**Incentive: ₹100 for every confirmed booking on the At Stay website**

**Working Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM**

**Working Days: Monday to Friday + alternate Saturdays**

**Joining: As soon as possible**

**About At Stay**

At Stay is a curated homestay marketplace where guests can discover and book hand-picked homestays directly through the At Stay website.

**About the role**

The Marketing Coordinator Intern will work directly with the founder to launch and grow At Stay. The role involves helping bring the first 15–20 properties live, attracting guests to the website, and coordinating with the technology, marketing, and host teams.

This is a hands-on opportunity to learn how to manage a marketplace business, covering product operations, digital marketing, host partnerships, and customer experience.

The intern will work closely with:

- ATT: Website and technology

- At Buzz: Social media, advertising, and SEO

- Atraski Studios: Property shoots

- Finance: Booking and payment coordination

**Key responsibilities**

1. Website and product operations

- Test the website's search, property pages, booking process, payments, and confirmation emails.

- Report bugs and coordinate with the ATT technology team until issues are resolved.

- Upload and update property photos, descriptions, amenities, prices, minimum-night requirements, and availability.

- Maintain a weekly website fix list and test updates before they go live.

2. Marketing and content creation

- Plan weekly content calendars with the At Buzz team, covering property walkthroughs, destination guides, host stories, and offers.

- Develop 3–5 content ideas every week and shoot raw content on property visits.

- Support launch offers, referral codes, and creator stays.

- Write destination and property pages to improve Google search visibility.

- Track website visits, enquiries, and bookings to understand marketing performance.

3. Host and property coordination

- Shortlist and visit homestays, checking cleanliness, safety, and the accuracy of property photographs.

- Coordinate property shoots with Atraski Studios.

- Assist with host onboarding, agreements, bank details, and listing approvals.

- Maintain updated host records and follow up on availability, pricing, response times, and guest feedback.

4. Guest and booking management

- Respond to website, Instagram, and WhatsApp enquiries within two hours during working hours.

- Send booking confirmations and welcome messages and assist guests before and during their stays.

- Follow up with guests for reviews and photographs after check-out.

- Maintain booking records covering dates, booking value, commission, and payout status.

5. Reporting and team coordination

- Review weekly bookings, cancellations, and reviews, and share website issues with the ATT team.

- Prepare monthly dashboards covering properties, bookings, occupancy, commission, and ratings.

- Attend founder meetings, record action items, and follow up on pending tasks.

**What we're looking for**

- A graduate or final-year student in hotel management, travel and tourism, BBA/marketing, mass communication, or a related field.

- An interest in travel and homestays, with an understanding of what makes a guest's stay special.

- Comfortable using and testing websites and apps and identifying issues or confusing user experiences.

- Strong written and spoken Hindi and English.

- Ability to write clear briefs, property listings, and professional host messages.

- Basic smartphone video shooting and Canva skills.

- Organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to follow up independently.

- Willingness to travel for short property visits.

**Additional advantages**

- Internship experience at a hotel, homestay, travel startup, or online travel agency such as Airbnb, MakeMyTrip, or Booking.com.

- Basic knowledge of Google Analytics, Meta Ads, or SEO.

- Experience with WordPress, Shopify, or another website administration platform.

- Comfort appearing on camera for property walkthroughs.

**What you will gain**

- Experience launching and growing a marketplace business.

- Exposure to product management, website testing, and technology coordination.

- Practical experience in travel marketing, SEO, advertising, and promotional campaigns.

- Experience in host partnerships, pricing coordination, and guest experience.

- Understanding of bookings, conversion rates, commissions, and cost per booking.

**Growth opportunity**

High-performing interns may be considered for a full-time role after completing the six-month internship.

Interested candidates can share their CV at hr@atraski.com.

Please mention “Marketing Coordinator Intern – At Stay” in the email subject line.

**About EaseToLearn**

EaseToLearn is an EdTech platform focused on online learning and assessment solutions, helping students prepare for competitive examinations through digital learning resources and assessment tools.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced, results-driven SEO Executive to lead the execution of SEO initiatives, improve organic search visibility, increase qualified website traffic, and strengthen EaseToLearn's search engine performance. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in on-page, off-page, and technical SEO, along with the analytical ability to identify growth opportunities and deliver measurable results.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic rankings, website traffic, and search visibility.
* Conduct advanced keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and content gap assessments.
* Manage on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL structures, internal linking, schema markup, and content optimisation.
* Conduct technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexing, canonicalisation, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, Core Web Vitals, and website architecture.
* Monitor organic search performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or Screaming Frog.
* Develop and execute ethical off-page SEO and link-building strategies to improve domain authority and backlink quality.
* Collaborate with content writers to plan and optimise SEO-friendly blogs, landing pages, category pages, and educational resources.
* Identify organic growth opportunities for high-intent keywords, competitive search terms, and relevant educational topics.
* Analyse changes in rankings, organic traffic, CTR, engagement, and conversions; recommend corrective actions based on data.
* Coordinate with developers to implement technical SEO recommendations and resolve website performance issues.
* Track search engine algorithm updates and implement appropriate improvements to maintain sustainable organic growth.
* Prepare regular SEO performance reports, maintain documentation, and communicate progress against agreed objectives.
* Support website migrations, new page launches, and large-scale content optimisation wherever required.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in SEO and organic search optimisation.
* Strong practical knowledge of on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and technical SEO.
* Proficiency in Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, backlink analysis, indexing, crawling, and website architecture.
* Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, structured data, schema markup, and basic HTML.
* Experience analysing organic traffic trends, ranking changes, CTR, and conversion performance.
* Ability to translate SEO data into actionable recommendations and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.
* Experience in EdTech, education, e-commerce, or other content-driven websites will be preferred.

**Mandatory Application Requirement**

Candidates must submit an
**SEO portfolio or relevant work samples**

along with their application.

The portfolio should include, wherever available:

* Websites or pages for which the candidate has managed SEO.
* Examples of keyword research, content optimisation, and technical SEO audits.
* Case studies demonstrating organic traffic growth, keyword ranking improvements, indexing improvements, or increased conversions.
* Performance reports or screenshots showing results over a defined period.
* A clear description of the candidate's individual contribution to each project.

Candidates may share portfolio links, case studies, reports, or relevant screenshots. Confidential client information must not be disclosed.

Applications without relevant portfolio links or work samples may not be considered for shortlisting.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates must complete the application form and submit their updated resume along with their SEO portfolio or relevant work samples.

**Application Form:**
https://tally.so/r/o99D7P

Please ensure all required information and portfolio links are submitted before completing the application.
