title: Head of Marketplaces
description:
**Head of Marketplaces**

Location: Delhi NCR | Work from office

Experience: 5 to 8 years

Reports to: Founder

Direct reports: Quick Commerce Operations Manager, Flipkart Account Manager

Compensation: Rs 9.6 to 18 LPA, fixed

**About TNT**

TNT (The Next Trend) is a manufacturer of home utility products: steel cloth-drying stands, step ladders, shoe racks and multi-tier organisers. We have manufactured in India for 15 years and sell 30+ SKUs through quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Big Basket), Amazon, Flipkart, modern trade (DMart) and a pan-India distributor network. We own our manufacturing, which gives this role direct control over cost, assortment and supply.

**About the role**

The Head of Marketplaces owns the online marketplace P&L across Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce. You will personally manage the Amazon account on Vendor Central and lead the two managers who run quick commerce and Flipkart. This is a hands-on leadership position, not a supervisory one.

**Responsibilities**

**Amazon (personally managed)**

* Own the Vendor Central relationship: cost price and PO negotiations, terms, allowances and annual agreements.
* Maintain a complete, accurate catalogue, A+ content and advertising within agreed efficiency targets.
* Track the vendor scorecard, dispute chargebacks and recover approved but unpaid invoices.
* Deliver a written 1P versus 3P recommendation for the account within 90 days.

**Quick commerce and Flipkart (through the team)**

* Set the commercial plan for Blinkit, Zepto, Big Basket and Flipkart: assortment, pricing, city-level priorities, fees, replenishment and advertising.
* Agree targets with both managers, review weekly and remove blockers.

**P&L and reporting**

* Own revenue and contribution margin by platform, after commission, storage and ageing fees, advertising, returns and freight.
* Maintain pricing discipline so that no platform undercuts another without approval.
* Submit a weekly one-page brief and a monthly P&L by platform, reconciled to actual payouts.

**Key performance indicators**

* Amazon revenue growth and contribution margin
* Catalogue health and PO fill rate
* Advertising efficiency (TACOS) by platform
* Accuracy and timeliness of the weekly brief and monthly P&L
* Delivery of the quick commerce and Flipkart targets agreed with the team

**Requirements**

* 5 to 8 years in marketplace or key account management on the brand side, with at least 2 years across more than one platform.
* Hands-on Amazon Vendor Central experience, including PO, cost price and chargeback processes. Mandatory.
* Ownership of a multi-platform P&L, not only a revenue or GMV target.
* Brand-side experience on at least one quick commerce platform.
* Experience managing a team.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; able to build your own trackers and reconciliations.
* Clear, concise written reporting.

**Preferred**

* Category experience in home, kitchen, hardware or furniture.
* Working knowledge of Flipkart Ads and quick commerce advertising tools.

**Compensation**

Rs 9.6 to 14 LPA fixed, with no variable component. Final offer based on experience and interview performance.

**To apply**

Apply through LinkedIn. Include one line on a marketplace account you have grown, with the number.

title: Associate E-Commerce - Marketing Campaign
description:
**Role Purpose:**

This role supports the end-to-end running of Carrefour’s banking, fintech and payment partnership programmes, with two core areas of ownership: The role holder is the operational backbone between the Partnerships team, bank and fintech partners, and internal Finance, CRM, Marketing, Commercial and Technology teams – ensuring every campaign is set up correctly, tracked accurately, reconciled to the last dirham, invoiced on time and reported back with clear performance insight. The role requires a high level of numerical accuracy, strong Excel capability, disciplined follow-up with multiple stakeholders, and the ability to manage several concurrent partner campaigns without slippage on deadlines or financial controls.

**Role Details – Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

**1. Marketing Campaign Coordination – Banking Partnerships (core focus)**

* Coordinate the end-to-end execution of joint campaigns with banks, fintechs and payment partners – from brief and offer construct through to set-up, go-live, in-flight monitoring and closure.
* Own the partnerships marketing calendar: track campaign dates, funding source, offer mechanics (cashback, instalments, bank BIN offers, card-linked promotions, voucher codes) and channel plan.
* Work with CRM, onsite merchandising, performance marketing and creative teams to ensure campaign assets, banners, communications and landing pages are live on time and accurately reflect approved offer terms and T&Cs.
* Coordinate offer/voucher configuration with Technology and Commercial teams, and complete pre-launch QA to confirm the offer triggers correctly, caps and eligibility rules apply, and tracking is in place.
* Monitor live campaigns for budget burn, redemption pace, misuse or abuse patterns, and flag issues early with a recommended corrective action.
* Prepare post-campaign wrap-ups for each partner covering spend, redemptions, incremental GMV, ROI and learnings, and share with partner and internal stakeholders.

**2. Data, Excel & Reporting**

* Manage, validate and analyse campaign, transaction and settlement data using Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic, large-file handling).
* Build and maintain recurring trackers and dashboards covering campaign performance, partner funding utilisation, reconciliation status and receivables ageing.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports and PowerPoint summaries for internal leadership and partner review meetings.
* Identify data gaps, mismatches and anomalies between internal systems and partner files, and drive them to resolution.

**3. Partner & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as day-to-day operational point of contact for assigned bank, fintech and payment partners on campaign and financial queries.
* Prepare agendas, inputs and follow-up actions for partner review meetings and business reviews.
* Support new partner onboarding and programme launches – documentation, offer set-up, testing, reporting structure and reconciliation template.
* Coordinate internally across Finance, Legal, CRM, Commercial, Marketing and Technology to unblock campaign and settlement dependencies.

**4. Governance, Controls & Process Improvement**

* Maintain complete documentation for every campaign – approved brief, offer terms, funding confirmation, performance output and settlement record.
* Standardise reconciliation and campaign trackers across partners to enable faster, more consistent closure.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate recurring reporting and reconciliation steps, reducing manual effort and error rates.
* Flag operational or financial risks (over-redemption, funding overrun, offer misuse, delayed settlements) to the Associate Manager – Partnerships with proposed mitigation.

**Definition of Success**

* Reconciliation accuracy and timeliness: all partner reconciliations completed within the agreed monthly close calendar, with variances identified, explained and resolved; zero unexplained differences carried forward.
* Financial closure: partner invoices raised and settled within agreed payment terms, receivables ageing kept within target, and accruals submitted accurately at each close.
* Campaign execution quality: partner campaigns launched on the agreed date with correct offer mechanics, eligibility rules and tracking in place; no material offer or configuration errors reaching customers.
* Reporting reliability: weekly and monthly campaign and settlement reports delivered on schedule, accurate at first pass, and used confidently by leadership and partners for decision-making.
* Performance visibility: every campaign closed out with a wrap-up covering spend, redemptions, incremental GMV and ROI, with clear learnings feeding the next cycle.
* Stakeholder effectiveness: partners and internal teams receive timely, accurate responses; dependencies and escalations are resolved without repeated follow-up.
* Process improvement: measurable reduction in manual effort and turnaround time through standardised templates and automation of recurring reporting and reconciliation tasks.

**Personal Characteristics and Required Background:**

**Minimum Qualifications/ Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field.

**Minimum Experience**

* 1-2 years of experience in Finance or Marketing Operations, with a focus on campaign coordination or project support.

**Skills**

* Strong MS Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Strong data analysis & reconciliation skills
* Strong PowerPoint/presentation skills
* Good stakeholder and partner management
* Experience in banking, payments, fintech or e-commerce
* Strong attention to detail and operational ownership

title: Growth and Marketing Lead
description:
Position: Growth and Marketing Lead
  
  
Location: Gurugram
  
  
️ Working Days: Monday to Saturday
  
  
Experience Required: 1-5 years
  
  
Growth & Marketing Lead
  
  
Our Client is building the consumer company for where you live.
  
  
The first product is the smartest way to rent a home in India. You tell what matters once, and our AI understands your taste, searches and coordinates across a fragmented offline market, helps you see only the homes actually worth considering, and gets the transaction done, including ₹0 security deposit upfront.
  
  
What takes weeks today should eventually feel like one really good afternoon.
  
  
But renting is only where we enter the relationship. Where you live shapes a huge part of your life: how you commute, where you spend, the neighbourhood you become part of, how much you pay every month, and eventually where you choose to buy a home.
  
  
We think there is a large consumer company to be built here at the intersection of AI, fintech and the physical world.
  
  
Zomato made restaurants feel like consumer tech. Blinkit made grocery delivery feel culturally relevant. Snabbit is doing something similar with household help.
  
  
Renting is just as boring today. We think it can feel completely different.
  
  
We’ve raised $750k from a stealth fund, whose backers include Abstract Ventures, Bain Capital and Long Journey. We are still a very small team, which means the people joining now will have an absurd amount of influence over what our brand becomes.
  
  
Start: ASAP Location: Gurgaon, in-person
  
  
Compensation: Highly competitive salary + meaningful ESOPs
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
Creative growth. Come up with ideas people actually want to talk about. Online, offline, weird, cheap, expensive, scrappy, beautiful. We care much more about whether it works than what category it falls into.
  
  
GTM experiments. Reddit, offices, partnerships, societies, referrals, creator collaborations, companies relocating employees, offline distribution. Run lots of experiments and kill most of them quickly.
  
  
Content. Figure out how to earn attention even when someone isn’t looking for a house this week.
  
  
Launches. When we release the app, a new feature, a new city, Concierge, or something we haven’t invented yet, make the launch feel much bigger than a feature announcement.
  
  
The numbers. Brand is not an excuse to avoid measurement. You should know CAC, conversion, channel economics, referral rates and what every meaningful experiment actually did.
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
I care much less about a specific number of years of experience than whether you have unusually good taste, move quickly and genuinely enjoy figuring things out from scratch.
  
  
You should be able to look at a piece of copy, a landing page, an ad or an offline activation and have a strong instinct for what is working and what feels wrong, but you should also be comfortable proving or disproving those instincts with numbers.
  
  
You should also enjoy being close to the customer. We do not want to build from dashboards alone. Some of the best marketing ideas will probably come from spending time with renters, brokers and people moving into the city and noticing things nobody else thought were important.
  
  
We’re very early. You’ll be one of the first people building the brand, and will have an unreasonable amount of ownership from day one.
  
  
**The Kind Of Things We Want To Do**
A few examples of ideas already sitting in our notes:
  
  
The brand Autos: take over autos around Gurgaon and temporarily turn their interiors into tiny homes, complete with cushions, lamps, curtains and a message about finding the right place to live.
  
  
The Break-up Letter: a beautifully designed physical letter telling renters it is time to break up with their broker, complete with lipstick marks, drama and something worth posting on Instagram.
  
  
Corporate Building Takeovers: instead of another sad standee near reception, build physical activations inside offices where thousands of people who are actively moving to Gurgaon already spend their day.
  
  

* 100s more:

Apartment lifts, housewarming parties, cafés, moving boxes, creator partnerships, performance ads, unique referral loops, physical installations.
  
  
Marketing in this sector is still mostly listings, lead-gen ads and celebrities pointing at buildings. That leaves an absurd amount of creative surface area untouched.

description:

**Company:**
Bookscape | Repro India Limited

Noida

5–8 years

**Department:**
Digital Marketing

**About Bookscape**

Bookscape is an online bookstore and part of Repro India Limited, offering 8 million+ authentic titles across Indian and international publications, including fiction, non-fiction, academic, children's and regional books. We also offer personalised books and 24-hour express delivery in eligible locations.

With an extensive product catalogue and ambitious growth plans, performance marketing plays a critical role in our business.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale revenue through Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Unlike conventional D2C advertising, our business requires managing a catalogue of millions of titles, varying customer demand, multiple product categories, price points and margins.

We need someone who understands large-catalogue e-commerce, product-feed optimisation, campaign architecture, and profitable revenue growth.

**This is an execution-led role with strategic and commercial accountability, not merely campaign monitoring or agency management.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Performance Marketing & Revenue Growth**

* Own Google Ads and Meta Ads end to end, including planning, execution, optimisation, and revenue delivery.
* Develop scalable acquisition strategies across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Meta catalogue, and Advantage+ campaigns.
* Manage budgets, bidding strategies, campaign structures and spend efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to grow revenue, acquire new customers, and improve profitability.
* Build prospecting, remarketing, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Plan and execute seasonal campaigns, offers and category promotions.

**2. Large-Catalogue & Product Feed Strategy**

* Develop advertising strategies for a catalogue containing millions of SKUs.
* Segment products by category, publisher, demand, margin, price band, availability, and historical performance.
* Identify high-potential, underperforming and long-tail products to improve revenue opportunities.
* Manage Google Merchant Centre and Meta Commerce Manager catalogue health.
* Optimise feed attributes, custom labels, supplemental data sources, product eligibility, and disapprovals.
* Work with catalogue and technology teams to maintain accurate pricing, availability, and product information.
* Improve the proportion of commercially relevant products receiving effective advertising coverage.

**3. Google Ads Management**

* Manage Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns independently.
* Build campaign and product segmentation strategies aligned with category economics and business objectives.
* Optimise bidding, budgets, listing groups, asset groups, search intent, and relevant exclusions.
* Monitor branded versus non-branded performance and product concentration.
* Diagnose issues involving low campaign spend, declining ROAS, limited impressions, product disapprovals, and inconsistent conversions.
* Continuously test campaign structures, bid strategies and revenue-scaling opportunities.

**4. Meta Ads Management**

* Manage Meta campaigns covering prospecting, catalogue advertising, dynamic remarketing, and Advantage+ solutions.
* Build relevant product sets, audience strategies, and creative testing plans.
* Improve new-customer acquisition while managing repeat-customer and remarketing performance.
* Work with the technology team on Pixel, Conversions API, event matching, and deduplication.
* Collaborate with the creative team on high-performing advertising formats and messaging.
* Assess performance beyond platform-reported ROAS, considering attribution and incremental value.

**5. Analytics, Profitability & Planning**

* Own monthly and quarterly advertising budgets, revenue forecasts, and growth plans.
* Monitor revenue, ROAS, CAC, AOV, conversion rate, new customers, and contribution margin.
* Develop category- and product-level profitability strategies rather than relying on a single ROAS target.
* Analyse campaign performance, identify issues and implement corrective actions.
* Reconcile advertising-platform reporting with GA4 and backend business data.
* Build dashboards and weekly business reviews with clear insights, decisions, and action plans.

**6. Technical & Cross-functional Ownership**

* Work closely with technology, catalogue, merchandising, analytics, and creative teams.
* Identify and resolve product feed, tracking, landing page, website speed, and conversion issues.
* Understand the impact of product-page quality, website accessibility, and customer experience on paid performance.
* Translate business requirements into actionable tasks for technical teams.
* Maintain campaign documentation, optimisation history, testing learnings, and operating processes.
* Guide agencies, freelancers or junior team members when required.

**Required Skills & Experience**

title: Market Place Ads Manager-PAM
description:
**Marketplace Ads Manager – Paid Account Management**

**Location: Noida (Work from Office)**

*Drive advertising success for a portfolio of sellers — where your PPC expertise, playbooks and data-driven optimization help sellers grow profitably on Amazon.*

New Trends Commerce Private Limited is a Poddar Group Company with Amazon Investment. Our vision is to be the most trusted go-to-market partner for businesses, empowering them to establish and grow their digital ventures efficiently and cost-effectively — through a customer-focused approach, sales expertise, a high-performance culture, and tech-powered sales strategies. We provide end-to-end go-to-market solutions: identifying the right customer segments, data-driven sales strategies, sales training and automation, on-ground execution, and client retention.

We hire and develop the best talent through rigorous hiring & talent management mechanisms anchored in our Leadership Principles. Our teams invent & reinvent for customers, simplify execution, and deliver the key inputs of the business with the right quality and at speed.

**About the role**

We are building a Paid Account Management business that helps sellers launch, grow and scale their online business. The Marketplace Ads Manager owns end-to-end ads management on Amazon for all sellers in the program — a portfolio of 80–100 sellers at any given time. This is an in-house expert role: you design the campaigns, run the optimizations, work directly with sellers on their advertising, and partner with Account Managers to make ads a growth lever for every seller.

**Responsibilities**

1. Own each seller's growth through advertising and the ads goals for every seller — end-to-end ads management for a portfolio of 80–100 sellers, planning, launching, managing and scaling campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display
2. Set up ads for every newly onboarded seller within defined timelines — account audit, campaign structure, keyword research, targeting and budget allocation
3. Optimize every account on a fixed weekly/fortnightly cadence — bid and budget management, keyword harvesting, negative targeting, wasted-spend reduction and budget pacing — to deliver each seller's ACOS, ROAS and sales goals with full budget utilization
4. Use ads platforms, bulk operations and automation tools to run the portfolio efficiently
5. Work directly with sellers on their advertising — ads plans, budget recommendations, performance reviews and query resolution — alongside the Account Managers
6. Partner with Account Managers on each seller's aligned growth plan — build the ads goals of the seller's Joint Business Plan (JBP) with the AM and deliver progress against them through the year
7. Champion seller success — identify sellers where ads investment can unlock growth, and drive budget and campaign expansion with sellers
8. Support the business development team with ads audits and inputs during seller pitches
9. Build the ads playbook for scale — standard campaign templates, category-level strategies, SOPs and checklists — so quality stays consistent as the portfolio grows
10. Publish ads performance reports on a monthly cadence — portfolio-level dashboards and seller-level summaries — and keep track of the latest trends in Amazon Ads, bringing them into the program

**Basic qualifications**

1. 3–6 years of hands-on Amazon Ads (PPC) experience managing multiple seller accounts — agency, SPN or seller-services background preferred
2. Previous experience of managing marketplace brands and sellers is mandatory
3. Proven command of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display — campaign structures, keyword research, bid strategies — and fluency with ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, CTR, CVR and CPC
4. Strong working knowledge of the Amazon Ads console and Seller Central; comfort building and uploading bulk sheets to manage campaigns at portfolio scale
5. Hands-on experience with ads automation and research tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools
6. Experience handling sizeable monthly ad budgets across multiple categories
7. Excellent Excel and analytical skills
8. Strong written and oral communication; ability to explain ads performance simply to sellers and internal teams
9. Bachelor's degree mandatory; MBA preferred; Amazon Ads certification preferred

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**About Iriscale**

Iriscale is an AI-powered digital marketing and search visibility platform helping businesses improve their online presence, optimize marketing performance, and increase visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

We combine SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), marketing intelligence, and data-driven strategies to help businesses grow in an increasingly AI-driven digital landscape.

**Website:**
https://iriscale.com/

**About the Role**

We are looking for a results-driven
**Senior Digital Marketing Executive**

with 3–4 years of hands-on experience in SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, content marketing, and lead generation.

The ideal candidate should understand B2B digital marketing, be comfortable working with marketing analytics tools, and have the ability to independently plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital marketing campaigns.

The candidate will also have the opportunity to work on emerging marketing technologies, including AI Search Optimization, GEO, and AI-powered marketing automation.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**

* Execute on-page, off-page, and technical SEO strategies.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis.
* Optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, and metadata.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, indexing, and website performance.
* Work with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar tools.
* Coordinate with content and development teams to implement SEO improvements.

**2. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Search**

* Understand and implement optimization strategies for AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
* Research AI search visibility, brand mentions, competitor presence, and content opportunities.
* Support AI-friendly content optimization, structured data, and entity-based SEO.
* Use Iriscale's platform to analyze search visibility and identify optimization opportunities.

**3. Paid Advertising & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage Search, Display, and remarketing campaigns based on business requirements.
* Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and conversion tracking.
* Monitor CPC, CTR, CPL, conversion rates, and campaign ROI.
* Optimize advertising budgets and landing-page performance.

**4. Social Media Marketing**

* Manage B2B social media activities, primarily LinkedIn, along with other relevant platforms.
* Create monthly social media content calendars.
* Coordinate engaging posts, creatives, and promotional campaigns.
* Improve brand awareness, engagement, and website traffic.
* Track social media performance and recommend improvements.

**5. Content Marketing**

* Develop SEO-focused content briefs and blog strategies.
* Optimize existing website content for search intent and conversions.
* Collaborate with writers and designers to produce high-quality marketing content.
* Create content supporting brand awareness, product education, and lead generation.

**6. B2B Lead Generation & Marketing Automation**

* Support B2B lead generation through digital marketing campaigns.
* Build and optimize landing pages and conversion funnels.
* Assist with email marketing and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Work with tools such as Apollo.io, HubSpot, or similar CRM and automation platforms.
* Track lead quality, campaign performance, and conversion opportunities.

**7. Analytics & Reporting**

* Monitor performance using GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, and other analytics platforms.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Analyze traffic, leads, conversions, and campaign effectiveness.
* Recommend actionable improvements based on marketing data.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of practical experience in digital marketing.
* Strong working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, and social media marketing.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
* Good understanding of B2B marketing and lead generation.
* Experience with keyword research, content optimization, and competitor analysis.
* Ability to independently manage multiple digital marketing activities.
* Strong analytical, communication, and reporting skills.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini for marketing productivity.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

**Preferred Skills**

* Previous experience in B2B SaaS or technology marketing.
* Understanding of GEO, AEO, and AI-powered search.
* Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO tools.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Ads.
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and email outreach tools.
* Basic understanding of WordPress, HTML, and landing-page optimization.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate will be evaluated based on:

* Growth in qualified organic website traffic.
* Improvement in search rankings and AI search visibility.
* Paid campaign performance and cost-per-lead efficiency.
* Qualified leads generated through digital campaigns.
* Social media engagement and relevant audience growth.
* Website conversion-rate improvements.
* Timely campaign execution and accurate performance reporting.

**Why Join Iriscale?**

* Work in the growing AI-powered marketing technology industry.
* Gain hands-on experience in SEO, GEO, and AI search optimization.
* Work on B2B SaaS marketing campaigns and international markets.
* Explore modern marketing automation and analytics tools.
* Take ownership of campaigns with measurable business outcomes.

2–3 Years

Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

Full-Time

Digital Marketing

Job Summary

We are looking for a
**results-driven Google & Meta Ads Specialist**
with 2–3 years of hands-on experience in planning, executing, managing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta platforms (Facebook & Instagram).

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in lead generation, performance marketing, audience targeting, campaign optimization, and analytics, with a focus on maximizing ROI and generating quality leads.

* Plan, create, and manage Google Search, Display, YouTube, and Performance Max campaigns.

* Create and manage lead generation, traffic, engagement, and conversion campaigns.

* Monitor campaign performance and continuously improve conversion rates.
* Coordinate with the creative and content teams for advertising materials.
* Analyze landing page performance and recommend improvements.
* Track lead quality and campaign effectiveness through CRM or lead management systems.

4. Analytics & Reporting

* Monitor and analyze campaign performance using Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Meta Ads Manager.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports.
* Track key performance indicators, including impressions, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversions, and ROAS.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve advertising performance and budget utilization.

Required Skills & Qualifications

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Experience & Technical Skills:**

* 2–3 years of practical experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

* Experience in lead generation and conversion-focused advertising.
* Knowledge of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking.
* Experience with remarketing, audience segmentation, and A/B testing.

* Strong analytical, reporting, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

* Google Ads Certification.
* Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate or similar certification.
* Experience in education-sector marketing, student admissions, or institutional lead generation.

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Cost per Lead (CPL) and Cost per Acquisition (CPA).

* Click-Through Rate (CTR) and Conversion Rate.
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), where applicable.

What We Expect

2–3 Years

Coimbatore

Based on experience and skills

* Identify and build partnerships with complementary B2B SaaS companies, fintech players, industry associations, consulting firms, and relevant ecosystem partners.

* Build a structured event calendar aligned with target accounts, industry priorities, and business objectives.

**4. Content , SEO & Digital Thought Leadership**

* Develop customer testimonials, case studies, customer success stories, and other proof points that strengthen trust and support the sales process.
* Improve Valyx’s visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms through relevant, credible, and well-structured content.
* Maintain a consistent presence across LinkedIn and other relevant professional channels to build brand awareness and engage target audiences.

**5. Review Platforms, Analyst Relations & Brand Credibility**

* Ensure company profiles, product descriptions, and positioning are consistent across relevant platforms.
* Monitor brand mentions, customer sentiment, reviews, and competitor positioning to identify opportunities to improve visibility and reputation.

**6. Marketing Analytics & Sales Alignment**

* Work closely with Sales to align marketing programmes with target accounts, sales priorities, and pipeline goals.
* Establish clear tracking for campaign performance, account engagement, partner contribution, event outcomes, and inbound demand.
* Use tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, CRM, LinkedIn, and marketing analytics platforms to measure performance.
* Monitor lead quality, conversion rates, campaign effectiveness, and marketing-influenced pipeline.

title: B2B marketing lead
description:
**About Nucleo**

Nucleo is building the operating system for private markets in India. Our platform

brings compliance, portfolio management and exit tracking together in one place for

family offices, funds and investors, replacing spreadsheets and manual processes.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Marketing Lead to build Nucleo's brand and drive demand among

investors, fund managers and family offices. You'll shape how the market sees us,

own campaigns from idea to results, and help build a marketing function from the

ground up. This role suits someone who thinks big, moves fast and takes ownership

without waiting to be asked.

**Key responsibilities**

● Build and run Nucleo's marketing strategy to grow awareness and generate

leads among family offices, VCs, funds and wealth managers.

● Plan and execute campaigns across LinkedIn, email, events, webinars and

partnerships, from concept to reporting.

● Create content that positions Nucleo as a thought leader in Indian private

markets: blogs, reports, case studies, newsletters and social posts.

● Own brand voice and messaging, and keep it consistent across the website,

sales material and product communication.

● Work closely with sales and product to create pitch decks, product launch

plans and customer stories.

● Represent Nucleo at industry events and build relationships with ecosystem

partners, communities and media.

● Track performance (leads, conversions, engagement, cost per lead) and use

the data to improve what's working.

● Spot new opportunities and bring ideas forward, rather than waiting for

direction.

**What we are looking for**

**Experience:**

● 5+ years in marketing, with at least 2 years in fintech, financial services or

B2B SaaS.

● Hands-on experience with B2B marketing: content, LinkedIn, email

campaigns, events and lead generation.

● Understanding of financial products and audiences. Familiarity with private

markets, VC, AIFs or wealth management is a strong plus.

● Strong writing skills and the ability to explain complex financial topics simply.

● Comfortable with marketing tools such as HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign

Manager, Google Analytics and Canva.

**Mindset:**

● Go-getter: you set ambitious goals, take ownership and see things through to

results.

● Visionary thinker: you can see where the brand and the market are heading

and turn that into a clear plan.

● Proactive: you spot problems and opportunities early and act on them without

being asked.

● Builder: you're excited to build a marketing function at an early-stage startup,

not just run an existing playbook.

**Why join Nucleo**

● Shape the brand of a fast-growing fintech in a market that is still being

defined.

● Real ownership and direct work with the founders.

● A small, ambitious team where your ideas turn into action quickly.

title: Head - International Business [APAC] (Electric Two-Wheelers)
description:
**Role Overview:**

As Head of International Business, you will define and execute GEML's global growth strategy while ensuring sustainable revenue generation, operational excellence, and long-term profitability. You will work closely with cross-functional teams spanning product, engineering, supply chain, finance, quality, and after-sales to deliver successful market entry and scale-up initiatives.

This role requires a blend of strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with accountability for market development, partner management, exports, regulatory readiness, customer experience, and financial performance.

This role offers the opportunity to build new markets from the ground up, forge strategic partnerships, shape market-entry strategies, and establish Greaves Electric Mobility as a preferred EV brand in key international markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

International Market Development & Expansion

* Develop and execute GEML's international growth roadmap across priority geographies.
* Evaluate and prioritize markets based on EV readiness, regulatory landscape, market potential, competitive dynamics, customer demand, and overall business viability.
* Define and implement market-entry strategies including distributor-led models, direct distribution, CBU, CKD, and SKD operations.
* Drive country-level business planning, pricing strategies, sales forecasting, and profitability initiatives.

International P&L Ownership

* Own the full international business P&L, including revenue growth, profitability, market share, and business sustainability.
* Build and manage annual operating plans, budgets, and growth strategies for international markets.
* Drive strong commercial governance through effective pricing, working capital management, forex risk management, and performance reviews.
* Establish clear KPIs and operating rhythms to monitor business performance across all markets.

EV Product Commercialization & Regulatory Readiness

* Lead international product launch readiness, ensuring alignment between market requirements and product offerings.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to adapt vehicles to regional requirements, climate conditions, duty cycles, payload needs, and customer preferences.
* Oversee homologation, certifications, and regulatory compliance across multiple regions.
* Ensure products meet local market standards and requirements while maintaining a best-in-class customer experience.

Building Strategic Partnerships & Distribution Networks

* Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and onboard distributors, automotive groups, fleet operators, and strategic channel partners.
* Develop long-term growth partnerships with clearly defined business plans and performance expectations.
* Negotiate commercial agreements covering sales targets, territory rights, inventory commitments, warranties, and aftersales responsibilities.
* Drive channel productivity, customer acquisition, and market penetration through structured partner management programs.

Global Supply Chain, Exports & Aftersales

* Lead export operations, logistics planning, customs compliance, inventory optimization, and supply chain coordination across markets.
* Establish robust aftersales infrastructure including technical support, dealer capability development, spare parts availability, warranty management, and service standards.
* Ensure a seamless customer ownership experience across all international markets.
* Create feedback loops to capture field insights and support continuous product and quality improvements.

Business Scaling & Organizational Leadership

* Build and mentor high-performing international business teams.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align growth objectives, product roadmaps, and operational capabilities.
* Represent GEML with key customers, distributors, regulatory authorities, industry bodies, and strategic partners globally.
* Act as a trusted advisor to leadership on international growth opportunities, market risks, and investment priorities.

What We're Looking For

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Automotive, or related disciplines).
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in International Business, Strategy, or Marketing preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in Automotive, Mobility, Electric Vehicles, Two-Wheelers, or related industries.
* Demonstrated success in leading international business operations with direct P&L responsibility.
* Strong track record of establishing and scaling export markets across emerging and developed economies.
* Experience managing distributors, strategic alliances, and commercial partnerships globally.
* Exposure to EV ecosystems, mobility solutions, product commercialization, and international trade frameworks will be highly valued.

**Key Competencies**

* Export Sales & Market Development

* CKD/SKD/CBU Business Models
* Commercial Negotiations & Contract Management
* Regulatory Compliance & Homologation
* Product Localization & Commercialization
* Supply Chain & Aftersales Excellence
* Cross-Cultural Leadership & Stakeholder Management
* Business Planning, Forecasting & Revenue Growth

title: Category Lead — Car Commerce
description:
**Lane | Bengaluru |**

**Reports to the CEO/ Business Head**

**About Lane**

Lane is building India's most trusted, tech-enabled driving and mobility platform — transforming how first-time drivers learn to drive, and eventually buy their first car. We are India's first platform connecting certified driving instructors with learners.

In 18 months: 40,000+ hours of instruction, 4000+ learners, and a certified instructor network across Bengaluru. We recently closed a ₹8.5 crore pre-seed led by Kae Capital, with DeVC, Antler India, Panthera Peak, Titan Capital and angels participating 

Link:
https://lnkd.in/p/g4m9ubMx
,
https://businessreviewlive.com/lane-raises-%E2%82%B98-5-crore-to-fix-how-india-learns-driving/
, 

**The Vision**

Every Indian's relationship with a car starts the same way — with learning to drive. Almost nobody owns that moment. We do

Lane is building the full ownership journey: learn to drive → get licensed → buy the right first car → finance, insure and maintain it → upgrade. One platform, one relationship, one trusted source of advice across a decade of a customer's life. The driving school is the entry point, not the business

The ten-year goal:
**1 million Indians into the right first car — approximately ₹1,00,000 crore (~$12B) in vehicle GMV through the platform**

The near-term mandate for this role:
**5,000 vehicles and ₹500 crore GMV in 36 months**

, on repeatable unit economics

**Why This Moment Is Different**

Every existing player — marketplaces, dealer groups, classifieds, OEM channels — meets the customer at the
*same*

moment: when they are already searching. By then the buyer has a shortlist, a budget and four tabs open. It is a bottom-of-funnel fight won with discounts and ad spend.

Lane meets that customer very early — when they decide to learn to drive.

We know intent before the industry knows the buyer exists.

* A learning licence is the most reliable leading indicator of a first-car purchase in India. ~60% of Lane learners intend to buy their first car — and we capture that intent at onboarding: timeline, budget, fuel, financing route.
* We know not just
  *that*

  they'll buy, but
  *how they drive*

  . Instructors spend 10+ days one-on-one with every learner; our sensor platform will turn that into structured behavioural data feeding the recommendation engine. No one else has behavioural data on a buyer before the buyer buys.
* We earned trust before asking for a transaction. That is a distribution relationship no marketplace can buy.

Every incumbent's incentive is to sell you
*their*

car. Ours is to find you the
*right*

one — and stay through financing, insurance, RC transfer and service.

Everyone else competes for the buyer at the bottom of the funnel. Lane owns the top of it.

**The Role**

Complete ownership of Car Commerce, built from the ground up. Not a functional role — you own strategy, growth, revenue, operations, partnerships, customer experience and team. You report to the CEO

**You will own:**

* P&L — GMV, take rate, contribution margin, working capital. Decide and defend the operating model: brokered, full-stack, or hybrid by segment.
* Growth — convert Lane's learner base into transacting buyers; build seller-side supply across direct sellers, upgrade cohorts and dealer sourcing.
* Partnerships — OEM and dealer networks, NBFC and bank financing (including thin-file customers), insurance, warranty, inspection.
* Product & Ops — take buyer and seller journeys from manual process to product; own inspection and trust standards, inventory lifecycle, delivery, post-sale.
* Team — hire and lead across sales, ops, partnerships and category.

**What We're Looking For**

* 7–12 years, with meaningful time in automotive retail, auto-tech, marketplaces or high-growth consumer businesses
* Proven P&L or business-line ownership — you have carried a number, not just a function
* Deep understanding of the Indian automotive ecosystem: dealers, OEMs, financing, RTO, used-car pricing
* Strong operating instinct — comfortable in inventory, margin, inspection quality and delivery SLAs
* Founder-grade ownership. There is no playbook to inherit; you are writing it.

**Why This Role**

The thesis is proven, the capital is in the bank, and the category is still open. The next decade of Indian car retail belongs to whoever reaches the buyer first and earns their trust before the transaction. We already do — this role turns that into a business.

*Lane is the brand of Inlane Technologies Pvt Ltd, a DPIIT-recognised startup in Bengaluru.*

title: Founder’s Office (GTM+Growth)
description:
**About OLake**

OLake is an open-source CDC tool that replicates production databases into Apache Iceberg lakehouses and keeps those tables fast to query. It supports sources such as Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, MSSQL and DB2, and runs without Spark, Flink or Debezium in the path.

Our users are data engineers and data platform teams around the world.

**Why this role exists**

OLake has strong developer interest, but more people star the repo than run it. This role closes that gap. You will get OLake in front of the right engineers, wherever they spend time online, and make sure what they find is accurate enough to earn a try. They read benchmarks, check the repo, and can smell marketing fluff from a mile away. Everything we put out has to hold up to that reader.

This is a hands-on lead role. You set the strategy with the founders, and you also write, ship, measure and show up at events yourself. You work closely with product and engineering, because a claim that engineers can't verify does more harm than no claim at all.

**What you'll own**

1. Developer marketing and content. Own the content calendar, including technical blogs, comparison pages and SEO. Ship the blogs with engineering, and make each one useful to an engineer before it mentions OLake. Take part honestly on Reddit and data engineering forums, and build relationships with newsletter writers and creators in the space.
2. Video and YouTube. Run a weekly live series where internal teams demo features and reproduce benchmarks. Bring in guest speakers on lakehouse setups and migrations. Produce product videos and short-form clips.
3. Community and field. Grow the Apache Iceberg meetups in India and help start them in other APAC countries. Pick which conferences to attend, sponsor or speak at, and write the talks and CFPs.
4. Positioning and narrative. Own website and homepage copy, and the positioning for new features and products. Keep every performance claim consistent across the site and backed by a published benchmark. Build a story that works for a global audience, not just India.
5. Growth analytics and activation. Run the measurement stack: GA4, UTM conventions, Looker Studio reports, PostHog experiments and Mixpanel product telemetry. Use it to find which use cases and companies are active, and run the plan that turns stars into active users. Evaluate new tools against a clear decision scorecard.
6. Leadership and planning. Lead a team of 2 and help them grow. Set the team's OKRs and run them in 2-month cycles. Turn founder-level strategy into plans the team can execute.

**Your first 90 days**

You'll start with a running motion, so the first three months are about learning it and taking it over.

Days 1–30: Learn the product well enough to explain CDC, Iceberg delete formats and compaction to an engineer. Read the handover doc and meet the team, founders and key community contacts.

Days 31–60: Take over the content calendar and the weekly motions. Run the next Iceberg meetup.

Days 61–90: Lead your first OKR cycle review and set the next cycle's priorities with the founders.

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-haves**

* 2-4 years in product, developer or growth marketing at a B2B SaaS company, in a role where you owned outcomes, not just tasks
* Technical depth: you can read a benchmark, understand CDC, and explain why OLake differs from Debezium or Airbyte without looking it up
* Writing that engineers trust, whether it's a blog, a landing page, a Reddit comment or a cold email
* Comfort pulling your own numbers from analytics and product tools
* Experience leading or mentoring at least one person
* High agency: you move without tight briefs and are comfortable with ambiguity

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with developer tools, open source or data infrastructure
* You've spoken at, run or organised community events
* Comfort on camera or hosting live sessions
* A shipped project you can point to: a ranking comparison page, a community program, or a campaign that drove adoption

**Tools and what you'll get:**

*Tools you'll use:*

GA4, Looker Studio, PostHog, Mixpanel, the Docusaurus website, GitHub, Slack, Reddit and YouTube.

*What you'll get:*

* A budget and the freedom to run experiments
* A product engineers already like, in a category that is still being defined
* Cash, meaningful ESOPs and a performance-linked component, with exact numbers discussed with shortlisted candidates

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a
**Lead Product Manager**
to drive the next phase of product innovation and growth at FRND.

This is a
**0→1 leadership role**
where you'll identify new business opportunities, validate ideas, and build products from the ground up. You'll work closely with the founders and cross-functional teams to define product strategy, solve complex user problems, and turn innovative ideas into scalable products that drive meaningful business impact.

We're looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with strategic vision, analytical rigour, and the ability to execute in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. If you're excited about building new products, influencing business strategy, and driving initiatives from concept to scale, we'd love to meet you.

**What You'll Do**

* **Drive Product Strategy:**
  Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for new product initiatives aligned with FRND's business goals and growth opportunities.
* **Build from 0→1:**
  Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and validating ideas to launching, scaling, and optimising products.
* **Identify Growth Opportunities:**
  Understand user behaviour, market trends, and competitive landscapes to uncover opportunities for new products and experiences.
* **Own Product Execution:**
  Translate product strategy into actionable roadmaps, PRDs, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with engineering, design, analytics, growth, and business teams to drive execution and deliver impactful user experiences.
* **Drive Data-Driven Decisions:**
  Use user research, product analytics, and experimentation to validate hypotheses, measure performance, and inform product direction.
* **Define Success Metrics:**
  Establish and track key product metrics across user acquisition, engagement, retention, monetisation, and business growth.
* **Navigate Ambiguity:**
  Make informed decisions in uncertain environments, balance competing priorities, and drive initiatives forward with speed and clarity.
* **Influence Stakeholders:**
  Partner with founders and senior stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, align on priorities, and drive high-impact business decisions.
* **Drive Continuous Improvement:**
  Identify opportunities to improve existing experiences, test new approaches, and scale successful initiatives.

**What We're Looking For**

* **5–8 years of Product Management experience**
  , preferably in consumer internet, social, gaming, marketplace, or startup environments.
* Proven experience building and launching products from
  **0→1**
  , or leading significant product initiatives with measurable business impact.
* Strong product strategy and business acumen, with the ability to connect user needs with business opportunities.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data and experimentation to drive product decisions.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, make independent decisions, and operate effectively in fast-paced environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
* Experience working closely with engineering, design, analytics, and growth teams to deliver products at scale.
* Strong execution skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively, manage trade-offs, and drive initiatives from idea to impact.
* A high-ownership mindset, with a bias for action, speed, and accountability.
* Experience with A/B testing, product experimentation, and metrics-driven optimisation is a plus.

**Note:**
The FRND team works 6 days a week, with
**1st and 3rd Saturdays being working days.**

**About FRND**

FRND is redefining the way people connect by building a social platform that's not just engaging but also safe, inclusive, and fun. We're a rapidly growing startup with a bold mission: to transform online interactions into meaningful relationships.

**Why FRND?**

* **Impact at Scale:**
  Be part of the next big wave in social connection, shaping experiences for millions across India, LATAM, and MENA.
* **Rewarding Journey:**
  Competitive compensation, equity options, and growth that parallels FRND's explosive success.
* **Learn with the Best:**
  Collaborate directly with founders and industry pioneers, backed by stellar investors such as Krafton, India Quotient, and Elevation Capital.
* **Freedom to Thrive:**
  Enjoy an unlimited leave policy and unparalleled ownership of your work.
* **Product-Centric Mindset:**
  Work in a company where products take centre stage, solving unique challenges with innovative solutions.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**Level Up Your Career!**
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile and the indie PC and Console space.
  
  
As well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.
  
  
**Join The Team!**
Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Lead Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.
  
  
You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build; you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.
  
  
We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.
  
  
This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.

title: SR SPECIALIST, DIGITAL OPERATIONS & WEB EXPERIENCE
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary:**

Northern Trust is seeking a Senior Digital Operations & Web Experience Analyst to help build, operate and continuously improve how digital content and experiences are delivered across our owned digital ecosystem.

This is not a traditional web-publishing role. The position combines digital operations, workflow and process optimization, governance, hands-on publishing, quality assurance, performance improvement and cross-functional enablement.

The initial and largest focus will be our global public web ecosystem, where the opportunity to improve operational consistency, scalability and performance is greatest. The broader mandate extends across the owned digital channels and platforms managed by Digital Marketing. You will help establish common workflows, standards and operating practices so content can be created, approved, published, distributed, measured and optimized consistently—regardless of platform or destination.

You will work as an integral member of a global Enterprise Digital organization, partnering with Marketing, Content, Digital Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility, Compliance and business teams.

**Major Duties:**

**Digital workflow and process excellence**
-------------------------------------------

* Own and continuously improve workflows spanning intake, requirements, prioritization, production, approvals, publishing/distribution, QA, measurement and optimization.
* Map current-state processes and identify bottlenecks, unnecessary handoffs, duplication, control gaps and sources of rework.
* Create and maintain SOPs, workflow documentation, checklists, service expectations, decision criteria and escalation paths.
* Use operational data to improve cycle time, throughput, quality and predictability.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work through process redesign, automation and platform integration.

**Owned digital publishing and delivery**
-----------------------------------------

* Independently manage complex digital requests and releases from intake through post-launch validation.
* Author, maintain and publish content in Adobe Experience Manager or a comparable enterprise CMS.
* Support enterprise websites, landing pages, insights and thought-leadership experiences, product and solution content, localized experiences and other owned digital destinations.
* Manage content and asset requirements including metadata, taxonomy, tagging, approvals, localization and lifecycle.
* Promote approved templates, reusable components and structured-content practices that enable scale.

**Standards, governance and risk reduction**
--------------------------------------------

* Help define, document, operationalize and maintain digital publishing and delivery standards.
* Translate UX, design-system, accessibility, SEO, analytics, content, privacy, compliance and technology requirements into practical procedures.
* Establish and apply QA and release-readiness practices.
* Identify inconsistent practices, unnecessary customization and workarounds that create operational risk, technical debt or fragmented experiences.
* Coordinate exceptions with the appropriate Product, Technology, Design or control owner.

**Quality and experience assurance**
------------------------------------

* Perform and improve pre- and post-publication QA.
* Validate content accuracy, page structure, responsive behavior, links, imagery, documents, metadata, accessibility, SEO, analytics and experience requirements.
* Coordinate defect remediation and support regression testing and production validation.
* Analyze recurring defects to identify root causes and preventive improvements.

**Performance and optimization**
--------------------------------

* Partner with Analytics, SEO, UX and Digital Product teams to understand operational, site-health and experience performance.
* Translate insight into prioritized opportunities that improve discoverability, accessibility, usability, engagement and conversion where applicable.
* Support audits, testing and experimentation; validate whether changes deliver the intended result.
* Create a closed loop from publish to measure, learn, optimize and standardize.

**Automation, integration and productivity**
--------------------------------------------

* Identify repetitive tasks and workflow bottlenecks suitable for automation.
* Translate operational problems into requirements for Product, MarTech and Technology teams.
* Support integrations connecting work management, CMS, DAM, analytics and related platforms.
* Participate in implementation, testing, adoption and benefits measurement for workflow and platform enhancements.
* Evaluate responsible AI-enabled improvements where they solve a defined operational problem and preserve quality and controls.

**Cross-functional partnership and enablement**
-----------------------------------------------

* Serve as an operational bridge between business requirements and digital execution.
* Coordinate dependencies across Marketing, Content, Product, UX/UI, Technology, Analytics, SEO, Accessibility and control teams.
* Explain standards, platform constraints and operating requirements in clear business terms.
* Support onboarding, training and change adoption for publishers, contributors and stakeholders.
* Surface systemic problems and improvement opportunities to Digital leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Digital Marketing, Marketing Technology, Information Systems, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in digital operations, web operations, digital production, content operations, marketing operations or digital-experience delivery.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise websites, content-management platforms or complex digital ecosystems; Adobe Experience Manager strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience owning or improving end-to-end digital workflows.
* Experience developing or improving SOPs, governance practices, QA standards or operational controls.
* Experience coordinating complex work across business and technical stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of accessibility, SEO, analytics, UX, content lifecycle and web-performance fundamentals.
* Experience using operational or performance data to identify problems and improve outcomes.
* Strong prioritization, documentation, facilitation, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a global, matrixed organization.

**Preferred**

* Adobe Experience Manager Sites and Assets; Adobe Workfront or a comparable work-management platform.
* Adobe Analytics and/or Google Analytics 4.
* Global, multilingual or multisite content operations; localization, translation or MSM experience.
* WCAG accessibility, technical/on-page SEO and Core Web Vitals knowledge.
* Workflow automation, systems integration, structured-content or content-supply-chain experience.
* Agile delivery, experimentation, personalization or conversion-optimization exposure.
* Financial services or another regulated enterprise environment.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Market Research & Intelligence Manager - APAC
description:
**About the Role**

The Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager will independently lead high-impact qualitative and quantitative market research and competitive intelligence initiatives that inform critical business decisions.

The Market Research & Intelligence (MR&I) team is a strategic thought partner that helps the business make smarter, faster decisions by translating customer, market, competitor, industry, and broader external signals into clear insights, strategic direction, risk awareness, and growth opportunities. The team combines primary market research, competitive and market intelligence, and AI-enabled research capabilities to help Resmed anticipate change, reduce uncertainty, and maintain a competitive advantage in a dynamic global market.

  

**What You’ll do**

As a Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager, you will partner with cross-functional leaders to translate business questions into rigorous research and intelligence approaches, synthesize evidence from multiple sources, and shape clear, objective recommendations for different stakeholders and business needs.

The role requires integrating insights across consumers, patients, physicians and other healthcare professionals, payers, customers, competitors, partners, and broader market forces. You will monitor current and emerging developments, connect disparate signals, distinguish meaningful change from market noise, and develop a well-supported point of view on what is changing, why it matters to Resmed, what remains uncertain, and what the business should consider next.

The ideal candidate combines deep market research expertise, strong investigative instincts, strategic business acumen, executive communication skills, and an experimental mindset toward AI and automation. The role will primarily support APAC - with emphasis on China and Japan and secondary support for Australia - while contributing to global MR&I priorities.

**What You'll Bring**

Market Research & Strategic Insights

* Independently lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative market research projects from business-question definition through research design, vendor selection, questionnaire/discussion guide development, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and executive presentation.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into clear research questions, hypotheses, methodologies, and decision-oriented learning plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Integrate perspectives from consumers, patients, physicians and other HCPs, payers, customers, channels, and other stakeholders to uncover behaviors, needs, perceptions, barriers, and opportunities.
Interpret research findings and synthesize them into clear insights, implications, and strategic and tactical recommendations that enable action.  

Market & Competitive Intelligence

* Create and maintain comprehensive industry, competitor, customer, and market analyses, including market share, growth projections, market forces, landscape evolution, and emerging risks and opportunities.
* Proactively monitor and investigate competitor activity and broader external developments across healthcare policy and reimbursement, regulatory change, economics and demographics, technology and AI, consumer behavior, channel evolution, partnerships, and other forces that may materially impact the sleep and respiratory markets.
* Leverage secondary research, financial and company information, industry publications, news, conferences, expert sources, and market intelligence platforms to develop objective, evidence-based analyses.
* Provide situational analysis and intelligence support for quarterly business reviews, new product launches, portfolio and brand initiatives, strategic planning, market and landscape mapping, and ad-hoc executive priorities.
Prepare and/or oversee executive-ready intelligence briefs, presentations, landscape reviews, customized alerts, and other decision-support deliverables.  

AI, Automation & MR&I Innovation

* Leverage generative AI and agentic workflows to automate intelligence gathering, monitoring, synthesis, and knowledge retrieval, while maintaining human validation and source traceability.
Develop and continuously improve AI-enabled intelligence systems, including prompts, watchlists, taxonomies, knowledge bases, and governance practices, in partnership with MR&I and technology teams.  

Strategic Partnership, Communication & Execution

* Act as a trusted thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders, building strong relationships and aligning research and intelligence priorities to business decisions.
Craft and tailor recommendations for different stakeholder needs and levels of leadership, balancing analytical rigor with clear, concise storytelling.  

**Qualifications and Experience Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Market Research, Business, Economics, a related business or technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of market research, market intelligence, insights, strategy, consulting, or related experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex projects from definition through recommendation.
* Strong business acumen, critical thinking, facilitation, executive communication, and data storytelling skills.
* Ability to build trust quickly, work independently with stakeholders, and operate effectively in a cross-cultural, global environment.
Advanced PowerPoint and Excel capabilities; experience with market intelligence platforms (such as AlphaSense) and survey/research platforms.  

**Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare, medical devices, digital health, or adjacent industry experience.
* Familiarity with the healthcare landscape in China and Japan, with additional understanding of Australia preferred.
* Existing relationships with or experience managing Asian market research and intelligence firms.
* Bilingual Mandarin capability preferred; Japanese language capability is advantageous but not required.
    
    
  #LI-APAC

Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now!
