title: Web Growth Manager
description:
**About the role**

JuliaHub is hiring a Web Growth Manager to own juliahub.com end-to-end: design an engaging, on-brand site, build and ship it in Framer, instrument every visit, and prove which web activity turns into sales opportunities.

JuliaHub builds Dyad, an agentic, Julia-native platform for engineering modeling and simulation, alongside the JuliaHub platform. Our buyers are engineers and technical leaders evaluating us against established dynamic modeling and control systems simulation tools. They research deeply, through search engines and increasingly through AI assistants, before they talk to sales.

You will be the single owner of the marketing site: its visual design, user experience, build, and measurement stack. You'll report to marketing leadership and work daily with the marketing team, application engineers, sales, and the development teams behind our products.

**What you'll do**

**Own the site's creative and experience**

* Own the look and feel of juliahub.com: apply and evolve the JuliaHub brand across typography, color, layout, imagery, and motion.
* Design page layouts, UI components, and a reusable design system directly in Framer.
* Create web graphics, illustrations, diagrams, product visuals, and simple animations that make technical products easy to grasp.
* Shape the UX: information architecture, navigation, page flow, and calls to action that pull engineers from first visit to trial or demo.
* Keep every product site and subdomain visually consistent, and set brand and style guidance others can follow.

  

**Own the site in Framer**

* Build, publish, and maintain pages, landing pages, and CMS collections (use cases, verticals, comparisons, FAQs, proof points) in Framer.
* Turn content into responsive, accessible, on-brand pages within days, designing directly in Framer.
* Run site governance: QA checklists, publishing workflow, redirects, navigation, forms, and a change log.
* Coordinate with engineering on DNS, CDN, and subdomains (help.juliahub.com, platform.juliahub.com, product docs).

  

**Drive organic and AI search growth**

* Own technical SEO in Google Search Console: indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, redirect chains, crawl errors, and Core Web Vitals.
* Maintain structured data (JSON-LD for Organization, Product/SoftwareApplication, FAQ, Article) and AI-readiness files such as llms.txt.
* Track how JuliaHub and Dyad appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) and optimize pages to be cited.

  

**Measure and attribute everything**

* Own GA4 and Google Tag Manager: event taxonomy, conversions, consent mode, and cross-domain tracking.
* Enforce UTM standards across campaigns, email, social, events, and partners.
* Connect web activity to Salesforce: form-to-lead routing, campaign membership, and offline conversion import.
* Build and maintain attribution reporting (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch) that ties web sessions to sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Publish a weekly web dashboard and a monthly growth readout with clear recommendations.

  

**Optimize conversion**

* Run A/B tests on headlines, CTAs, forms, and page layouts; report lift with sample sizes.
* Use heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix drop-off on trial, demo, and contact paths.

  

**Required qualifications**

* 4+ years designing and managing a B2B marketing website, ideally for a SaaS or technical product.
* A portfolio of live websites you designed and built, showing strong visual design, layout, and UX judgment.
* AI search optimization (AEO/GEO) experience, with tools that track brand visibility in AI answers.
* Hands-on Framer experience: you have designed and shipped production pages, components, and CMS collections in Framer itself.
* Experience applying AI technologies to accelerate and transform marketing workflows.
* Brand and visual design skills: typography, color, composition, and creating web graphics with tools such as Canva.
* Deep Google Analytics 4 experience: custom events, conversions, explorations, audiences, and BigQuery export or Looker Studio reporting.
* Deep Google Search Console experience: diagnosing indexing and coverage issues, sitemap management, and Core Web Vitals.
* Proven experience attributing web-based marketing activity to sales pipeline.
* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, UTM governance, and consent management.
* Experience connecting web forms and tracking to a CRM (Salesforce strongly preferred), including lead source and campaign attribution.
* Technical SEO fluency: redirects, canonicals, schema markup, site structure, and page speed.
* Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript for embeds, custom code, and tracking snippets.
* Clear writer and communicator who can turn data into a recommendation for non-analysts.

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Framer Expert certification.
* Experience turning complex technical concepts into clear diagrams and product visuals.
* SEO tooling experience: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse.
* Marketing automation and attribution tools experience.
* Experience marketing to engineers, scientists, or developers; familiarity with simulation, scientific computing, or developer tools is a plus.
* Experience in a venture-backed, high-growth environment.

title: Manager, Vendor Consultant, AVS-NOP
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon.com
  
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
About the Role
  
Team Manager, Vendor Consultants Team - RBS AVS  
As a Vendor Consultants Manager in Retail Business Services (RBS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on the strategy for managing Amazon vendors.
  
RBS team is looking for a customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Vendor Consultants responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all operational aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships.  
You will lead the team that looks into strategic and operational aspects of vendors business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.  
  
  
  
A day in the life  
Responsibilities Include:
  

* Lead a team of Vendor Consultants, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience.
* Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience, in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams.
* Manage end to end goal setting for team to align with organizational goals.
* Build relationships with stakeholders across the portfolio; proactively build joint business plan action items and act as a point of escalation for outstanding issues, questions, and concerns.
* Act as a thought leader in defining success criteria and understand business needs of Selling Partners in an ever-changing business environment. Contributes to and leads strategic plans and documents for the organization.
* Leads recruiting and hiring efforts across direct team and broader organization.
* Manage stakeholders needs and monitor complexity through efficient resource allocation of Vendor Consultants.
* Monitor stakeholders satisfaction survey results to analyze both positive and negative feedback trends. Establish improvement plans and mange expectations with Vendor Consultants as appropriate.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software

description:

Round The Clock Events Private Limited is an independent, creative-led event management and brand experience agency established in 2015.

We create meaningful brand experiences through corporate events, conferences, product launches, brand activations and experiential marketing campaigns. Our work combines creative thinking, strategic planning and seamless execution to deliver experiences that connect brands with people.

We are looking for an experienced, commercially driven Business Development Manager who understands the events industry and can help us acquire new clients, build strong corporate relationships and drive sustainable business growth.

This is a hands-on, revenue-focused role for a professional who has already built a career in **business development within the event management, experiential marketing or brand activation industry**.

You will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing corporate accounts, pitching to prospective clients, managing the sales pipeline and converting opportunities into confirmed projects.

* Take ownership of business development targets and revenue generation.
* Convert client enquiries and briefs into proposals, pitches and confirmed projects.
* Lead commercial discussions, negotiations and deal closures.
* Build a healthy sales pipeline and consistently develop new business opportunities.

* Maintain an organised database of prospects, leads, meetings, proposals and opportunities.
* Track conversions, revenue forecasts and business development performance.
* Provide regular updates on pipeline status, upcoming opportunities and closures.
* Work towards agreed monthly and quarterly business development targets.

Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

**Please read carefully before applying.**

* Candidates must have **5–10 years of relevant, hands-on business development experience specifically in the event management, experiential marketing or brand activation industry**.

We are not looking for business development professionals whose experience is exclusively in industries such as FMCG, real estate, banking, insurance, IT, telecom, retail or other unrelated sectors without direct event industry business development experience.

Candidates whose experience is limited to event operations, production, project coordination or client servicing — without hands-on responsibility for acquiring new business and closing deals — are also not eligible for this position.

Skills & Competencies

* Proven new business acquisition and deal closure capabilities.

* Excellent communication, presentation, pitching and negotiation skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of event budgets and margins.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of revenue targets.
* Strong follow-up, pipeline management and organisational skills.
* A proactive, result-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset.

Compensation & Benefits

* Fixed annual salary of ₹8.4 LPA.
* Approved travel expenses for business development activities.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of an independent event management agency.

How to Apply

Interested and eligible candidates should share their updated CV at:

**Email:** spreethu21@gmail.com

Please include a brief summary of your experience in event industry business development, the types of corporate clients you have acquired, and your achievements in revenue generation and deal closures.

Applications will be assessed based on relevant industry experience, client acquisition capabilities and demonstrated business development results.

description:
Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto (VLTO) is creating today.  
  
Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Mass. with 13 operating companies and 300+ locations worldwide. Our global team of 16,000 associates is committed to making an enduring positive impact on the world and is united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™.

Our industry-leading companies and globally recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.  
  
Veralto’s Water Quality companies—Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, McCrometer, OTT HydroMet, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies and XOS—help manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply, from municipal and industrial wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans.  
  
Our Product Quality & Innovation companies—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Videojet, and X-Rite—help package and protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials, tracing and authenticating billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day.

**WHO WE ARE:**

Headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, X-Rite is a global company with locations around the world. Experts in blending the art and science of color, we focus on providing complete end-to-end color management solutions for our clients in every industry where color matters.

**Job Details:**

**X-Rite’s Global Brand Strategic Accounts team** helps customers achieve consistent print and color quality across their global packaging supply chains. Our portfolio of products and professional services enables customers to establish color and print-quality specifications, measure performance, and report results across their operations.

**The Global Brand Color Program Manager** will lead the operational, technical, and project-management activities for a strategic global Brand account. The role will coordinate program deployment across regions, suppliers, printers, pre-media partners, and internal teams to ensure consistent execution, measurable performance, and continuous improvement.

Drive profitable growth for X-Rite Pantone print and packaging solutions across North India by developing new customers, expanding strategic accounts, strengthening channel partners, and managing the complete sales cycle from opportunity creation through commercial closure, delivery coordination, and post-sale follow-up.

title: Accountant
description:
**Position Overview**

**Job Title:** Department Accountant

**Company:** Regal Jewellers Private Limited

**Location:** Regional Office, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru

**Experience**1 – 4 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

**Department:** Assigned Department (Retail Operations / Inventory & Bullion / Procurement / Marketing & Admin / Manufacturing)

**Reporting Structure**

**Operational Reporting:** General Manager (GM) of the Respective Department

**Functional Reporting:** Head of Finance

**Role Purpose**

The **Department Accountant** acts as the dedicated financial and accounting backbone for their assigned operational department at Regal Jewellers. Reporting operationally to the Department General Manager and functionally to the Head of Finance, this role ensures transaction integrity, accurate day-to-day bookkeeping, robust expense tracking, and statutory compliance.

**Detailed Key Responsibilities**  
**A. Bank Reconciliation & Settlement Management (BRS)**

* **POS & Digital Collection Reconciliations:** Perform daily reconciliations of all departmental payment channels—including EDC/POS credit/debit card swipe machines, UPI, dynamic QR codes, and payment gateways—against daily billing registers.
* **MDR & Deductions Verification:** Validate Merchant Discount Rates (MDR), gateway processing fees, and convenience charges deducted by partner banks prior to net credit settlement.
* **Cash-in-Transit & Counter Cash Matching:** Reconcile daily physical counter cash collections against verified bank deposit slips, pick-up agency receipts, and bank statement credits to eliminate cash shortages or deposit lag.
* **Banking Operations & Instrument Tracking:** Track inward customer booking advances and outward fund transfers (RTGS / NEFT / Cheques); promptly identify and address stale instruments, unpresented cheques, or uncredited inward remittances.
* **Chargeback & Dispute Handling:** Log, investigate, and resolve card chargebacks, duplicate counter charges, and failed gateway transactions with acquiring banks.
* **Preparation of Formal BRS:** Generate weekly and monthly Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) for all department-linked bank accounts; present unmapped bank charges, interest debits, and direct credits to the Head of Finance for monthly closing sign-off.

**B. Vendor Reconciliation & Precious Metal Accounting**

* **Statement of Account (SOA) Matching:** Carry out periodic ledger-to-ledger reconciliations against external vendor statements across bullion dealers, jewellery manufacturers, karigars (job workers), gemstone suppliers, packaging vendors, and departmental service providers.
* **Precious Metal Weight & Purity Discrepancy Adjustments:**
* Reconcile physical metal received (weight in grams/milligrams and hallmark purity) against purchase orders, karigar issue slips, and melting reports.
* Accurately compute and adjust wastage allowances, stone weight deductions, touch variations, and melting losses.
* **Debit/Credit Note Accounting:** Generate and record debit/credit notes for Rate Differences (RD), Return to Vendor (RTV) items, defective craftsmanship, short deliveries, or hallmark test failures within 24 hours of audit.
* **Advances & Karigar Metal Loans:** Track and reconcile running advance payments and metal advances issued to artisans/manufacturers against finished product delivery receipts.
* **GSTR-2B vs. Purchase Register Matching:** Validate all vendor tax invoices against GST portal data (GSTR-2B) to protect 100% of Input Tax Credit (ITC) eligibility and prevent tax leakage.
* **Statutory Withholdings (TDS/TCS):** Ensure accurate deduction and booking of TDS (e.g., Section 194C for making/job charges, Section 194Q for goods purchases) and TCS under Section 206C(1H).
* **Formal Balance Confirmation:** Facilitate quarterly and fiscal year-end Balance Confirmation Letter processes, securing formal vendor sign-offs on open balances.

**C. Departmental Accounting & Day-to-Day Bookkeeping**

* Scrutinize and record departmental transactions (purchases, sales, journal vouchers, and debit/credit notes) in the ERP/accounting system.
* Maintain accurate sub-ledgers and ensure smooth synchronization with the central general ledger.
* Process vendor bills, work orders, and utility invoices after matching with POs and securing approval from the Department GM.
* Supervise petty cash disbursements, verify expense vouchers, and manage imprest replenishments with complete documentary evidence.

**D. High-Value Inventory & Stock Tracking**

* Support periodic and surprise physical stock audits (gold, diamond, silver, bullion, and loose stones) against ERP system quantities.
* Audit and record stock transfers (inter-branch/inter-department), customer approvals, returns, and memo stock movements.
* Immediately flag any inventory discrepancies or transit delays to both the Department GM and Head of Finance.

**E. Budgetary Control & Cost Optimization**

* Track departmental operating expenses (OPEX) daily against approved monthly and annual departmental budgets.
* Identify budget overruns, unnecessary costs, or duplicate billings, alerting the Department GM before commitments are made.
* Assist in preparing monthly variance analysis comparing budget forecasts against actual expenditure.

**F. Dual-Reporting MIS & Analytics**

* **To the Department General Manager (Operational Focus):** Deliver daily/weekly operational reports on sales figures, stock velocity, order completion timelines, karigar turnaround times, and pending operational vendor payouts.
* **To the Head of Finance (Governance & Control Focus):** Submit standardized monthly financial closing packs, BRS summaries, vendor ageing schedules, GSTR-2B mismatch reports, and provisions for expenses.
* Participate actively in departmental reviews to provide financial data that supports operational decision-making.

**Required Skills & CompetenciesTechnical & Functional Proficiencies**

* **Accounting Software & ERP:** Strong working knowledge of Tally Prime, SAP, or industry-specific Jewellery ERP systems.
* **Advanced MS Excel:** High proficiency with XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, and multi-sheet data reconciliation.
* **Reconciliation Expertise:** Proven track record in high-volume bank reconciliations and multi-tier vendor ledger matching.
* **Taxation & Compliance:** Sound grasp of GST rules (E-way bills, e-invoicing, GSTR-2B ITC reconciliation), TDS (194C, 194Q), and TCS (206C).

**Qualifications & Experience Criteria**

* **Education:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce (B.Com) or Business Administration (BBA - Finance).
* Master’s Degree in Commerce (M.Com) or Semi-Qualified CA (Inter) / CMA (Inter) will be given distinct preference.
* **Experience Range:**
* **1 to 4 years** of hands-on experience in accounting, bank reconciliation, and vendor ledger management.

**Behavioral & Professional Attributes**

* **Dual-Reporting Agility:** Ability to balance the operational pace and support needed by the Department GM with the strict compliance and governance demanded by the Head of Finance.
* **Attention to Detail:** Meticulous accuracy in auditing high-value transactions and identifying fractional discrepancies.
* **Integrity & Confidentiality:** Uncompromising ethical standards when handling sensitive cost sheets, supplier terms, and precious metal accounts.

Pay: Up to ₹450,000.00 per year

* Food provided

title: Senior Associate HR Business Partner
description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We’re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we’re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future.  
  
As a member of the Huron corporate team, you’ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron’s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results.  
  
Join our team and create your future.

The HR Senior Associate is a member of the HR Business Partner (generalist) team with a focus on client needs, particularly Manager, Associates and Analysts. Plays a key role in managing HR-related projects and activities are designed, implemented, and managed to meet client expectations and business needs.

**Job Details**:

  

* Act as a resource manager and advisor to practice management on human resources matters including: performance management, coaching, new hire on-boarding, integration and company policies and procedures.
* Lead human resource processes and procedures to ensure accurate, timely and consistent delivery to clients.
* Consult with corporate specialists on pre-employment matters, relocations, work visas, benefits, leaves of absence, etc. Serve as a day-to-day point of contact within the practice to address employee HR questions and refer to appropriate corporate specialists as needed.
* Coach employees on employee relations matters including employee concerns, performance, performance improvement plans (PIP), training and development, advancement, etc.
* Coach managers on employee relations matters including employee concerns, management of performance issues, exit strategies, selected recognition, etc.
* Guide the team in ensuring a smooth on-boarding experience for new hires, including post hire follow-up and integration.
* Organize and provide support for midyear and year-end performance management process with follow-up on individual performance issues surfaced.
* Work with the Resource Managers as appropriate to help ensure matching of project opportunities with employee development needs and other elements of Career Management.
* Keep a pulse on employee morale bringing trends/issues and recommendations to HR Director. As issues are identified (through one-on-one interactions, group discussions, meetings, etc.), discuss them with HR Director and/or others to assess size of issue. Participate in solution development, if appropriate.
* Identify process improvement possibilities and participate in improvement efforts, sharing best practices and ideas across practices.
* Analyze employment practices (e.g., turnover, on boarding, engagement, etc.) prepare trend reports; analyze surveys and development recommendations for the practice.
* Assume a key role on special projects such as the testing/rollout of new products/services.
* Foster teamwork and a positive work environment through frequent collaboration with other HR generalists in promoting best practices. Attend HR meetings and participate in training workshops, research and present HR topics of interest at staff meetings; participate and assist with training incoming HR staff on area of expertise.

**Job Description**

  

* Bachelor's degree required. HR Certification preferred.
* Minimum of 6 years in an HR role. Prior experience in consulting industry preferred.
* Prior experience in one or more of the following areas:
* New hire integration
* Policy review and interpretation
* Performance management Employee relations
* Compensation administration"

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About MoEngage**

MoEngage is an insights-led customer engagement platform trusted by 1,350+ global consumer brands, including McAfee, Flipkart, Domino’s, Nestle, Deutsche Telekom, and OYO. MoEngage combines data from multiple sources to help brands gain a 360-degree view of their customers.

MoEngage Analytics arms marketers and product owners with insights into customer behavior. Brands can leverage MoEngage Personalize to orchestrate journeys and build 1:1 conversations across the website, mobile, email, social, and messaging channels. MoEngage Inform, the transactional messaging infrastructure, helps unify promotional and transactional communication to a single platform for better insights and lower costs. MoEngage’s AI Suite helps marketers develop winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help with faster execution.

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight Roads, F-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures.

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Real-Time Interaction Management, Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™ 2023 report. MoEngage was also featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni-Channel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023.

* Act as the primary point of contact for all customer-facing activities post launch for managed accounts.
* Ensure their day-to-day challenges are resolved in a timely and professional manner.
* Actively monitor client usage and identify opportunities to upsell additional products and services
* Conduct regular client check-ins and provide QBRs to ensure clients are receiving value from our products and services
* Have a good understanding of MoEngage features
* Advocate new MoEngage features adoption as well as identify new opportunities where MoEngage products and technologies can better fit client's marketing strategy and technical stack
* Develop and implement client retention strategies to ensure long-term partnerships
* Conduct client satisfaction surveys and analyze feedback to improve the customer experience
* Plan and consult client marketing team on use cases and solutioning
* Relay trends to customers and anticipate customer needs
* Predict and forecast risk, renewal and expansion within customer portfolio
* Help customers achieve their objectives by working with MoEngage internal teams delivering timely technical guidance, enablement, and best practices materials
* Work with internal account teams to identify and resolve renewal risk, build strategies to drive further customer adoption
* Be the voice of the customer when engaging with internal teams

**Requirements**

* Experience in Customer success and account management
* Previous experience in Customer Success role for a SaaS company is a plus
* SaaS and B2B experience is a must
* Comfortable with communicating with all levels of team members internally and externally from C level executives to individual contributors
* 3+ years experience in supporting customers with marketing technology solutions (email, push, SMS) or closely related solutions with understanding of technical, product and marketing disciplines
* Excellent multitasking and project management skills
* Exposure to Mobile App Technologies is a plus

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
**About Amadora**

Since 2011, Amadora has made ice cream the hard way: from scratch, in small batches, with real ingredients and no premixes. What started as a single Chennai parlour is now a premium artisanal brand with 21 stores across Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad and Cochin by the end of this year, and 20 more planned for 2027. Our range has grown beyond scoops into ice cream bars, cakes, sandwiches, chocolate bars, baked goods and high-protein ice creams, and we’re preparing to enter organised retail.

We’re a franchise-led business with a loyal following and a product people rave about. Now we need someone to build the brand that matches it.

**The Role**

You’ll be Amadora’s first CMO, reporting directly to the Founder & MD. You’ll own the brand, customer growth and marketing across stores, delivery apps and new retail channels, and you’ll build the team to do it.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own brand strategy, positioning and identity across every touchpoint, from store and packaging to social and retail shelf
* Drive same-store sales growth through local store marketing, seasonal campaigns and new launches
* Plan and execute launch playbooks for new cities and franchise openings
* Grow Swiggy and Zomato performance, including listings, offers, ratings and visibility
* Build Amadora’s digital presence: social, content, influencers, performance marketing and CRM/loyalty
* Lead the go-to-market for organised retail and new formats (bars, chocolate, cakes, high-protein range)
* Support franchise development with brand material that helps attract the right partners
* Manage agencies and build an in-house marketing team
* Own the marketing budget and report on ROI with clear metrics

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years in marketing, with senior leadership experience in F&B, QSR, food retail or premium consumer brands
* A track record of building a brand people love, not just running campaigns
* Hands-on experience with multi-location retail or franchise marketing
* Strong command of digital, performance marketing and delivery-platform growth
* Experience launching products into modern trade or organised retail is a strong plus
* Comfort with a founder-led, fast-moving company where you’ll build as much as you manage
* Someone who spends time in stores, talks to customers and tastes the product

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A clear brand strategy and identity guide rolled out consistently across all stores, packaging and digital channels
* Measurable same-store sales growth in existing stores, driven by planned campaigns and local store marketing
* A repeatable launch playbook used for every new store opening in 2027
* Higher delivery-app ratings, visibility and online revenue share across Swiggy and Zomato
* A successful brand launch into organised retail, with marketing support for new product lines
* An in-house marketing team and agency setup in place, with monthly reporting on spend and return

**Why Join**

* Build the brand of one of South India’s best-loved artisanal ice cream companies at a key growth stage
* Direct line to the founder and a real seat at the leadership table
* A product you’ll be proud to market

description:
Job Summary

We are looking for enthusiastic and customer-focused Relationship Managers / Sales Executives to join our automobile sales team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, understanding customer requirements, promoting automobile products, managing customer relationships, and achieving sales targets.

The candidate should have excellent communication and negotiation skills, a strong customer service mindset, and an interest in the automobile industry.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate new sales leads through walk-ins, cold calling, referrals, digital platforms, and other marketing activities.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable vehicles based on their needs and budget.
* Explain vehicle features, specifications, pricing, variants, mileage, warranty, and after-sales services.
* Conduct vehicle demonstrations and arrange test drives for prospective customers.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Follow up with leads regularly through phone calls, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets set by the management.
* Negotiate pricing and coordinate with the sales manager to close deals.
* Explain finance options, loan facilities, insurance, registration, and other vehicle-related documentation.
* Coordinate with finance companies, insurance providers, and the documentation team to facilitate vehicle purchases.
* Maintain accurate customer information, lead details, follow-up records, and sales reports in the CRM system.
* Ensure a smooth customer experience from the initial enquiry to vehicle delivery.
* Coordinate with the service department to address customer queries and support customer retention.
* Follow up with customers after delivery to collect feedback and encourage referrals.
* Stay updated on new vehicle launches, competitor products, market trends, and promotional offers.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, sales procedures, and customer service standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Any Degree or Diploma from a recognized institution.
* 1–5 years of experience in sales, preferably in the automobile industry.
* Experience in car sales, two-wheeler sales, commercial vehicle sales, or automotive dealership sales will be an advantage.
* Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good negotiation, persuasion, and customer-handling abilities.
* Ability to identify customer needs and convert enquiries into sales.
* Target-oriented approach with a willingness to achieve sales goals.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office or CRM software.
* Good follow-up, coordination, and relationship-management skills.
* Knowledge of vehicle specifications, financing, and insurance processes is preferred.
* A valid driving licence is an added advantage, especially for roles involving test drives.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in automobile dealerships or automotive showroom sales.
* Candidates with experience in lead generation, customer acquisition, and sales conversion.
* Individuals who can confidently interact with customers and build long-term relationships.
* Candidates willing to work in a target-driven sales environment.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in automobile sales may also be considered, depending on company requirements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly vehicle sales target achievement.
* Number of leads generated and followed up.
* Lead-to-sale conversion ratio.
* Customer satisfaction and feedback ratings.
* Number of test drives converted into sales.
* Customer retention and referral generation.
* Accuracy of CRM updates and sales reports.

title: Market Data Lead
description:
**Job title**
: Market Data Lead
  
  

* Location: Hyderabad

**Opella**
is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites, and four specialized science and innovation development centers.
  
  
Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale, and Mucosolvan.
  
  
B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.
  
  
Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at www.opella.com
  
  
The
**Digital Data, AI & Analytics team**
at Opella drives transformation through data-driven decision-making, advanced analytics, and AI-powered solutions. Within this team, the
**Master Data, Data Governance & Market Data group**
ensures robust data practices, governance, and actionable insights to support strategic business decisions across the organization.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The
**Market Data Lead**
is accountable for the strategy, evolution, adoption and value realization of
**Market Data Foundation (MDF)**
, Opella's global market data and sell-out intelligence data foundation.
  
  
MDF provides a centralized foundation for
**Global Sell-Out (SO), Point-of-Sale (POS) and syndicated market data**
, bringing together data from external market-data providers such as IQVIA, Circana and other strategic sources across markets. The platform enables standardized, trusted and timely access to market performance, growth, competitive and market-share insights.
  
  
The Market Data Lead acts as the
**strategic bridge between business, data, technology and external data providers**
, translating business needs into a clear product vision and roadmap while ensuring that the underlying data products are scalable, governed, reliable and fit for decision-making.
  
  
The role owns the product from
**strategy and prioritization through delivery, adoption, continuous improvement and value realization**
.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* MDF Strategy & Vision
* Define and continuously evolve the vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap in alignment with Opella's business and data strategy.
* Establish a clear product operating model covering business capabilities, data products, technology, governance and user experience.
* Identify opportunities to increase the business value generated from market and sell-out data.
* Translate strategic business priorities into a prioritized product backlog and investment roadmap.
* Balance short-term business needs with long-term scalability, standardization and architectural sustainability.
* Act as the primary product advocate for MDF across business and technology leadership.
* Global MDF Ownership
* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of MDF as a global data product.
* Define and maintain product requirements, capabilities, user journeys, data products and product standards.
* Drive the onboarding and industrialization of market data across countries, providers and data domains.
* Establish reusable approaches for data acquisition, integration, harmonization, quality management and consumption.
* Drive the evolution from market-specific solutions toward standardized, scalable global capabilities.
* Ensure that market data is accessible through fit-for-purpose products, APIs, analytical datasets and downstream consumption channels.
* Data Provider & Vendor Management
* Own the product relationship with strategic market-data providers and technology partners.
* Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and business stakeholders on vendor strategy, contracts, licensing and commercial considerations.
* Drive vendor consolidation and rationalization where appropriate.
* Establish clear expectations for data availability, quality, timeliness, service levels and issue resolution.
* Evaluate emerging market-data providers and new data sources based on business value, coverage, quality and scalability.
* Ensure effective management of provider dependencies and data licensing constraints.
* Data Quality, Governance & Trust
* Establish strong product-level accountability for data quality, completeness, timeliness and usability.
* Partner with Data Governance and Data Management teams to define and enforce relevant data standards.
* Ensure appropriate ownership of critical data elements, metadata, business definitions and data lineage.
* Drive resolution of systemic data-quality issues and recurring market/provider challenges.
* Establish product KPIs and data-quality measures that provide transparency to business stakeholders.
* Ensure that MDF remains a trusted source for market performance and competitive intelligence.
* Product Delivery & Technology Partnership
* Work closely with engineering, architecture, data platform and delivery teams to translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Own prioritization across enhancements, technical debt, platform modernization, data onboarding and business requests.
* Ensure delivery teams have clear objectives, requirements, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Drive Agile product delivery practices and continuous improvement.
* Ensure architectural decisions support scalability across markets, data providers and future analytical use cases.
* Proactively identify technology risks, dependencies and opportunities for automation and simplification.
* Business Partnership & Adoption
* Build strong relationships with global and local business stakeholders who consume market and sell-out data.
* Understand business problems and translate them into scalable product capabilities rather than market-specific solutions wherever possible.
* Drive adoption of MDF capabilities across relevant markets and functions.
* Establish mechanisms to capture user feedback and translate insights into product improvements.
* Develop product communications, enablement and adoption strategies for new capabilities.
* Demonstrate measurable business value from the product through improved data accessibility, speed, quality and decision-making.
* Product Performance & Value Realization

Define and monitor a product scorecard covering areas such as:
  
  

* Market and country coverage
* Data freshness and time-to-market
* Data quality and completeness
* User adoption and consumption
* Data-product availability
* Provider performance
* Cost efficiency
* Automation and operational efficiency
* Business value and stakeholder satisfaction

Use these measures to continuously optimize product investments and demonstrate MDF's contribution to Opella's data-driven decision-making agenda.
  
  

* Innovation & Future Capabilities
* Continuously evaluate opportunities to leverage AI, automation, advanced analytics and modern data-product architectures within the market-data ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes and improve data onboarding and validation.
* Explore new analytical capabilities that can be enabled through richer, standardized market data.
* Partner with Data & AI teams to identify opportunities for intelligent data quality, anomaly detection and automated insights.
* Keep the product aligned with evolving market-data, technology and industry practices.

**Key Stakeholders**
The Product Owner operates across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders, across Business teams, Digital and Technology teams, and External partners.
  
  
The role requires the ability to influence across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.
  
  
**Leadership & Ways of Working**
The Product Owner is expected to operate as a
**product leader and business partner**
, with accountability for outcomes rather than simply delivery of requirements.
  
  
Key leadership expectations include:
  
  

* Think strategically while maintaining strong execution discipline.
* Create clarity in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
* Make transparent and data-driven prioritization decisions.
* Challenge the status quo and simplify where possible.
* Build strong relationships between business and technology teams.
* Create accountability across internal teams and external partners.
* Communicate effectively with both senior executives and delivery teams.
* Drive change across markets while respecting local business needs.
* Champion product thinking, reuse and scalable solutions.

About you:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated conflict resolution & problem-solving skills in a global environment.
* Strong appetite to learn and discover, entrepreneur mindset.
* Adaptable and open to change.
* Team player, service-oriented.
* Analytical and synthetic, able to formalize solutions, good writing skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* With leadership attitude, autonomy and results driven.
* Role model our 4 values: teamwork, integrity, respect, courage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in Digital, Data, Analytics, Technology or Product Management.
* Proven experience owning enterprise-scale digital or data products. Experience with market data, syndicated data, sell-out/POS data, consumer insights or commercial analytics.
* Experience working with providers such as IQVIA, Circana or comparable market-data organizations.
* Strong understanding of data platforms, data integration, data governance and analytics ecosystems.
* Minimum 12+ years of professional experience across Digital, Data, Analytics, Technology, Product Management, Consulting or related disciplines.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management / Product Ownership, preferably with enterprise-scale digital or data products.
* Proven experience owning the strategy, roadmap, prioritization and lifecycle of complex data or technology products.
* Experience working across global, multi-market organizations, managing stakeholders across business, technology and corporate functions.
* Demonstrated experience translating complex business needs into scalable data and digital products.
* Strong experience working with data platforms, data integration, data governance, data quality and analytics ecosystems.
* Experience managing technology vendors, data providers, systems integrators and commercial partners.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience managing complex product portfolios involving multiple dependencies, markets, technology teams and external partners.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in data accessibility, quality, timeliness, adoption, cost efficiency or business value.

**Preferred Experience**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, Engineering or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in Product Management, Data Management, Data Governance, Agile/Scrum, Cloud or Analytics are advantageous.
* Experience in Consumer Healthcare, FMCG, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences or another data-intensive industry.

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a results-driven International E-commerce Sales professional to manage and expand the company's global online sales business through leading international marketplaces, including Amazon Global, Walmart Marketplace, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for developing international marketplace sales, managing product listings, identifying new business opportunities, optimizing product visibility, driving revenue growth, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth international order fulfillment.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in international e-commerce operations, marketplace management, digital sales strategies, and cross-border business development, preferably within the FMCG or consumer products industry.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. International Marketplace Sales**

* Manage and grow sales across international marketplaces, including Amazon US, UK, Canada, Australia, and other relevant global markets.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to increase international revenue, market share, and product visibility.
* Manage and expand business on Walmart Marketplace and other international e-commerce platforms.
* Identify new global marketplaces and online sales channels suitable for the company's product portfolio.
* Research international markets to identify growth opportunities, customer demand, and competitor strategies.
* Establish sales targets and monitor marketplace performance against revenue and profitability objectives.

**B. Marketplace Account Management**

* Manage seller accounts, product catalogs, inventory availability, pricing, promotions, and sales performance.
* Create, optimize, and maintain product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and product attributes.
* Ensure product listings comply with individual marketplace guidelines and category requirements.
* Monitor account health, customer feedback, product reviews, returns, and marketplace performance metrics.
* Resolve listing issues, account suspensions, catalog errors, and other marketplace-related concerns.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams to resolve operational and commercial issues.

**C. Sales Growth**

* Plan and execute marketplace advertising campaigns, including Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect, where applicable.
* Monitor advertising performance, conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), and customer acquisition costs.
* Implement promotional campaigns, deals, discounts, and seasonal sales strategies.
* Conduct keyword research and optimize product listings to improve organic search rankings.
* Analyze customer behavior, market trends, and competitor pricing to improve sales performance.
* Work towards achieving monthly and quarterly sales and profitability targets.

**D. International Business Development**

* Identify and evaluate new countries, marketplaces, distributors, and online retail partners.
* Develop strategies to expand the company's presence in international markets.
* Research market demand, pricing structures, competitor products, and customer preferences across different countries.
* Explore opportunities for direct-to-consumer sales and cross-border e-commerce.
* Build relationships with marketplace representatives, international distributors, and relevant business partners.
* Support the development of new international sales channels and commercial partnerships.
* Present marketplace performance, key challenges, and growth plans to management.

**3. Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, E-commerce, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in international e-commerce sales, marketplace management, or global online business development.
* Hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central for international markets.
* Experience with Walmart Marketplace is highly preferred.
* Knowledge of other global marketplaces and e-commerce channels is an advantage.
* Understanding of international sales, cross-border e-commerce, and global marketplace operations.
* Experience in product listing optimization, pricing, promotions, and marketplace advertising.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data and marketplace performance reports.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and marketplace analytics tools.
* Good communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and achieve revenue and profitability targets.

**4. Preferred Experience**

* Experience in FMCG, food products, packaged consumer goods, or other consumer product categories.
* Experience selling products in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, or other international markets.
* Understanding of international marketplace fees, fulfillment models, inventory planning, and product profitability.
* Experience with Amazon FBA, FBM, or other relevant international fulfillment models.
* Familiarity with international product compliance, labeling requirements, and export documentation.
* Experience in launching new products on international marketplaces and scaling them into profitable businesses.

**6. Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is commercially driven, analytically strong, and experienced in growing online sales across international markets. They should understand how to launch, manage, and scale products on global e-commerce platforms while maintaining healthy margins and operational efficiency.

The candidate must be comfortable working with sales data, marketplace dashboards, advertising campaigns, inventory planning, and cross-functional teams to drive sustainable international business growth.

**Primary Objective:** To establish and scale the company's international e-commerce business by increasing sales, expanding global marketplace presence, and delivering profitable growth across Amazon Worldwide, Walmart Marketplace, and other international online sales channels.

Squad Lead Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative **Squad Lead** to join the **Campaign Data Standards Product Team**. This role serves as the operational leader for the squad, responsible for driving delivery, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across campaign metadata, tagging, taxonomy, and data standards capabilities.

The Squad Lead will work closely with Digital Product Management, business stakeholders, data governance teams, marketing operations, analytics teams, and technology partners to ensure the successful adoption and evolution of enterprise campaign data standards. This role will play a critical part in enabling connected customer experiences, improving data quality, and creating a consistent metadata framework across Amgen's global commercial ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong leadership, Agile delivery expertise, data governance knowledge, and business acumen with experience supporting enterprise marketing technologies. This individual will help drive the strategy, execution, and adoption of Claravine and related metadata management capabilities across the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities:

* Lead day-to-day squad operations and delivery activities for the Campaign Data Standards Product Team.
* Partner with Product Managers to translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Coordinate work across business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and data governance partners to ensure successful delivery of business outcomes.
* Drive adoption and governance of enterprise metadata, tagging, taxonomy, naming conventions, and campaign data standards.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and PI Planning activities.
* Partner with global commercial marketing operations, analytics, media, and digital teams to establish and maintain consistent data standards across channels and platforms.
* Support the development and implementation of metadata frameworks that improve data quality, interoperability, reporting, and measurement capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to streamline campaign setup, tagging, and metadata management processes through automation and standardization.
* Monitor and manage dependencies, risks, and impediments impacting delivery or adoption of campaign data standards.
* Collaborate with analytics, customer engagement, and data platform teams to ensure metadata standards support downstream reporting, measurement, activation, and AI use cases.
* Drive continuous improvement through stakeholder feedback, performance metrics, and operational reviews.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Claravine capabilities, metadata governance, and campaign taxonomy best practices.
* Support organizational change management, communications, training, and adoption initiatives related to campaign data standards.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8 - 13 years of experience in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, IT or related field

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Claravine or comparable metadata, taxonomy, or marketing data governance platforms.
* Experience supporting Marketing Operations, Digital Marketing, Commercial Operations, Customer Engagement, or Data & Analytics organizations.
* Strong understanding of metadata management, taxonomy development, tagging strategies, and data governance principles.
* Experience implementing campaign naming conventions and enterprise data standards across marketing ecosystems.
* Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, media, and analytics platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale data quality, governance, or master data management initiatives.
* Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
* Experience supporting global teams and operating models.
* Knowledge of customer engagement, omnichannel marketing, campaign execution, and measurement processes.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across business and technology organizations.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and driving execution in Agile environments.
* Strong understanding of metadata, taxonomy, tagging, and data governance concepts.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable operational processes and technology solutions.
* Experience managing priorities, risks, dependencies, and competing stakeholder needs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and data quality.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Experience using Agile delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps.

**Professional Certifications:**

* Claravine certifications or platform-specific training (nice to have)

Soft Skills:

* Demonstrated proficiency in written and verbal communication in English language

* Ability to prioritize successfully based on business value

title: tellecaller
description:
**Inside Sales Executive (Inbound and Outbound)**

**Company:** V Green Media

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana (On-site, work from office)

**Employment type:** Full-time, Permanent

**Experience:** 2 to 4 years in inside sales, B2B sales or business development

**Salary:** ₹20,000 to ₹35,000 per month, based on experience, plus incentives

**Job Summary**

V Green Media is hiring an Inside Sales Executive for our corporate gifting, creative, web and digital marketing services. You will handle enquiries from our Meta, Google Search, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and YouTube campaigns and convert them into Clients. You will also make outbound calls to founders, business owners and decision makers to bring in new clients and new business for our agency services. This is a full-time, office-based role with strong growth into senior and leadership roles.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Inbound Corporate Gifting Enquiries**

* Respond to corporate gifting enquiries from Meta, Google Search, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and YouTube campaigns, and from offline marketing
* Understand each client's occasion, quantity, budget, branding needs and delivery timeline
* Recommend suitable gifts, hampers, welcome kits and branded merchandise, and share catalogues, quotes and samples
* Follow up through calls, WhatsApp and email until the enquiry converts or closes
* Coordinate with the sales, production and accounts teams on pricing, customisation and delivery

**Outbound Sales**

* Call founders, business owners, CXOs and decision makers in HR, admin, procurement and marketing
* Pitch corporate gifting for occasions such as Diwali, New Year, Sankranti, employee onboarding, work anniversaries, events and launches
* Build a steady pipeline of seasonal and year-round corporate gifting orders
* Pitch for gifting, creative, web and digital marketing services
* Generate qualified leads and set up meetings for the senior team
* Re-engage past enquiries and existing clients for repeat and seasonal business
* Meet monthly targets for calls, qualified leads, meetings and conversions

**Reporting**

* Update every lead and conversation in the CRM or lead tracking sheet
* Share daily and weekly reports on calls, leads, follow-ups and conversions
* Share client feedback and gifting trends with the team

**Requirements**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in inside sales, B2B sales or business development
* Proven experience in both inbound enquiry handling and outbound sales calls
* Experience speaking with founders, business owners and senior decision makers
* A track record of converting enquiries into orders and meeting targets
* Fluent spoken English
* Working knowledge of CRM tools, Google Sheets or Excel, and WhatsApp Business
* Graduate in any discipline

**Key Skills**

Inside Sales, Corporate Gifting Sales, Corporate Sales, B2B Sales, Business Development, Outbound Sales, Inbound Sales, Cold Calling, Lead Generation, Lead Qualification, Lead Conversion, Client Acquisition, Decision Maker Outreach, Sales Pipeline Management, Follow-up, Negotiation, Proposal and Quotation Preparation, Advertising Sales, Digital Marketing Sales, Agency Sales, CRM, WhatsApp Business, Google Sheets, MS Excel, Communication Skills

**Good to Have**

* Sales experience in corporate gifting, promotional products, merchandise or printing
* Sales experience in advertising, digital marketing or B2B services
* Experience handling leads from Meta, Google Search, LinkedIn, WhatsApp or YouTube campaigns
* Experience selling to HR, admin or procurement teams
* Experience with festive season sales and large order timelines
* Fluency in Telugu and Hindi

**Growth Path**

Good performers grow quickly with us. As you deliver results, you will take on bigger clients and larger accounts, and grow into Senior Inside Sales Executive, Business Development Manager and leadership roles. You will work closely with senior management, and strong work here is recognised and rewarded.

**About V Green Media**

V Green Media is a full-service advertising, branding and digital marketing agency serving brands across India, with over 19 years of work, 500+ brands and 800+ projects. Tribe Green, our corporate gifting brand, curates and delivers employee gifts, festive hampers, welcome kits and branded merchandise for businesses, with customisation and branding done in-house.

Our agency covers everything under a brand's marketing spend, digital and physical: strategy and brand, creative and design, content, video, social media, performance marketing, SEO, web and technology, media buying, print, outdoor, retail branding and events. Our clients span real estate, interiors, jewellery, retail, education, IT, hospitality, healthcare, pharma, manufacturing and many more industries.

**Why Join Us**

* Fixed salary plus incentives on business you bring in
* A steady flow of corporate gifting enquiries from our own marketing campaigns
* Strong seasonal demand, with year-round gifting and agency opportunities
* Fast growth into senior and leadership roles as you deliver results

**Applications with a LinkedIn profile will be contacted first.**

You can also send your resume to hr@vgreenmedia.com with the subject line "Inside Sales Executive".

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

title: Payroll Analyst
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

Yext is seeking an experienced payroll professional to join our growing team. The **Payroll Analyst** will be responsible for maintaining and operating the Company's payroll function, processes and systems, including global payroll, commissions payments, bonuses, payroll related taxes and certain business operations. The Payroll Analyst will partner and work closely with HR, Equity, and Finance teams. Reporting to the Team Lead, Payroll this person will be a true partner to the organization, always approaching work with a lens of adding value to the company.

**What You'll Do**

* Maintain, operate, and update payroll systems/processes daily.
* Execute the payroll cycle for assigned Yext entities.
* + Ensure bonuses/commissions/variable pay earnings are accurate.
  + Process payroll, commissions payments, and payroll tax transactions.
  + Prepare the reconciliation for Manager review.
  + Process Restricted stock options recording and Employee Stocks Purchase plan management.
* Investigate and drive resolution to payroll questions from employees, Finance, and HR teams.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies and controls, SOX as well as compliance with external laws and regulatory guidance.
* Assist with gathering supporting documentation for internal and external audit requests.
* Create and maintain SOPs and supporting documentation thoroughly and accurately, in accordance with company policy, best practices and business process controls.
* Close attention to detail to ensure accuracy to eliminate any subsequent adjustments to payroll.
* Commitment to process improvement and re-engineer current systems to build efficient and scalable payroll processes.
* Maintain the payroll email and ticketing system to ensure all issues are addressed in a timely manner.
* Working knowledge of processes, procedures, controls, regulations, and compliance as required.
* Support the team with statutory research and regulatory compliance concerning payroll-related labor and tax laws.
* Work with HR, Benefits and Equity teams to develop processes for the timely reporting, recording and review of bonuses, new hires, promotions, and other compensation related changes.
* Ensure accurate earnings and deduction totals, review general ledger backup and automated system outputs (including ledgers, registers, and standard reporting), and identify and rectify any out-of-balance discrepancies.
* Review and process involuntary deductions such as levies and garnishments.
* Assist with manual, quarterly, and year-end adjustments.
* Assist with ad hoc projects as needed.

**What You Have**

* BA/BS degree.
* 3+ years of Global Payroll experience.
* Payroll Certification is a plus.
* Experience with major Payroll and ERP systems (Workday, International Platform, ADP Smart Compliance).
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel.
* High degree of accuracy, attention to detail, and confidentiality.
* Demonstrated ability to roll-up sleeves and work with team members in a hands-on capacity.
* Ability to work independently or as a team member.

**Perks and Benefits**  
  
At Yext, we take pride in our diverse workforce and prioritize creating an engaged and connected working environment. Our ambitious mission is to transform the enterprise with AI search, and we know that to achieve that, we need a global team of innovators, visionary thought leaders, and enthusiastic collaborators passionate about making a meaningful impact in the world and contributing to an extraordinary culture.

We believe that people do their best when they feel their best — and to feel their best, they must be well-informed, fuelled, and rested. To ensure our employees are at their best, we offer a wide range of benefits and perks, including:

* **Performance-Based Compensation**: We offer an attractive bonus structure and stock options for eligible positions.
* **Comprehensive Leave Package**: Our leave package includes Paid Time Off (PTO), Parental Leave, Sick Leave, Casual Leave, Bereavement Leave, National Holidays, and Floating Holidays to ensure a healthy work-life balance.
* **Health & Wellness Offerings**: We provide medical insurance with **7L** **coverage**, including enhanced parental and outpatient department (OPD) coverage for you, your spouse, two dependent children, and two parents (as applicable and subject to eligibility requirements).
* **Relocation Benefits:** We offer relocation assistance and an allowance to eligible candidates to help ease your transition.
* **World-Class Office & Building Amenities:** Our office has a top-notch infrastructure, including gaming rooms, a plush pantry, and breakout areas.

title: GFCC Detect/Report Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Welcome to JP Morgan Chase. Are you a compliance specialist, passionate about risk mitigation and safeguarding the financial institutions and customers from the financial crime ? You have found the right team.

As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

The GFCC Alert Triage position is part of the firm's India AML Alert Triage team within AML Investigations. The Triage team dispositions alerts consistent with the Global AML Standards, provides an initial assessment of potential Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing as well as other nefarious activity and recommends alerts for escalation and further review or closure as false positives

Responsibilities:

* Collect and document data, including: alerting activity, account information, transactional data, KYC information, politically exposed person (PEP) status, adverse media as well as counterparty and any other required information to assist in the investigation
* Review and analyze underlying data gathered opposite Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Terrorist Financing (TF), Human Trafficking and other red flags to assess whether the alert should be recommended for escalation or to be closed with no further action
* Fully document all alerts, including supporting data, analysis as well as escalation or close recommendation rationale within the case management system in a timely manner and consistent with the firm's quality standards
* Build relationships with AML Investigations units and effectively communicate and transfer information for case investigations
* Collaborate with India and US colleagues to share processing and AML knowledge to enhance AML Investigation process flows
* Process work items in the order of priority and aligned with SLA priorities. Escalate issues in a timely manner and demonstrate courage and integrity by doing the right thing all the time.
* In conjunction with manager and consistent with overall department objectives, establish and execute on annual development goals. You would participate in special projects, quality improvement initiatives and other similar exercises

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Qualified graduate with minimum of 6 years' of relevant experience in Global Financial Crime Compliance
* Familiarity with the firm's internal systems and processes or similar processes at other institutions, and proficiency in MS Office (Outlook/Word/Excel/PowerPoint)
* You are a self-starter, capable of working under minimum supervision, able to multi-task and meet deadlines in high-pressure environment
* You are a result-oriented team player with strong problem solving ability.
* You have exceptional research and analytical skills with the ability to analyze large amounts of data, decipher higher risk attributes (transactional, geographical, product, customer type, etc.) and develop well-reasoned recommendations and strong documentation skills to clearly articulate alert disposition
* You are adaptable to change and demonstrate strong interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills.
* You adhere to and standards, controls and policy.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

The following additional items will be considered but are not required for this role

* CAMS Certification

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

Our Compliance teams work globally across all lines of business to advise internal stakeholders on the impact of regulatory requirements and how to balance these with the firm's needs. Their diverse mandate means they also provide input on new business strategies, product lines, policies, training, operational processes, risk mitigation and control.
