title: Consumer Product Development & Brand Launch Manager
description:
**About Lion & Child**

Lion & Child is an independent creative and venture studio building original consumer brands, media and entertainment projects.

We're developing a portfolio of consumer products across lifestyle and other categories, taking ideas from initial concept through product development, manufacturing, branding and commercial launch.

We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial professional to work directly with the founder and help bring these products to market.

**The Role**

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role for someone who understands how physical consumer products are developed, manufactured and launched.

You'll help turn early-stage product concepts into commercially viable, market-ready products, coordinating everything from manufacturer sourcing and sampling to packaging, costing and launch execution.

We're a small, founder-led company, so you'll need to be resourceful, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership without a large team or established infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, evaluate and negotiate with manufacturers, suppliers and production partners.
* Manage product development from initial concept through prototyping, sampling, refinement and final production.
* Coordinate product specifications, materials, packaging, quality standards and production timelines.
* Develop product costing, pricing structures, margins and minimum order quantity (MOQ) strategies.
* Work with external designers, branding agencies and creative partners to bring products to life.
* Coordinate the setup and launch of D2C sales channels, including Shopify and relevant marketplaces.
* Manage external vendors across packaging, logistics, fulfilment and launch activities.
* Research consumer trends, competitor products and opportunities for new product categories.
* Build practical execution plans, manage budgets and ensure projects move from idea to launch.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in consumer product development, sourcing, merchandising, category management or brand launches. More experienced candidates are welcome.
* Demonstrated experience working with manufacturers and suppliers to develop or commercialize physical products.
* Strong understanding of product costing, margins, MOQs, packaging and production processes.
* Experience in consumer categories such as lifestyle, stationery, accessories, gifting, homeware, beauty or related products.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of how consumer brands are positioned, priced and brought to market.
* Ability to manage multiple external partners and execute independently.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and genuine interest in building new brands from scratch.

**Direct experience taking physical products from concept through sampling, manufacturing and commercial launch matters more to us than total years of experience.**

**What Makes This Opportunity Different**

You'll work directly with the founder, helping shape and launch original consumer brands rather than simply managing an established product portfolio.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building things, solving practical problems and seeing their work go from an idea to a real product in customers' hands.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have personally been involved in developing and launching new physical products, not solely managing existing e-commerce operations or marketplace accounts.

title: Senior Lead - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
  
  
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
  
  
**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**

* Lead/Senior Lead, Business Strategy and Operations position will be responsible for partnering closely with functional leaders across Marketing and GTM to develop a shared set of priorities, growth strategy and operational plan. You will ensure our strategy is coordinated and cohesive, and supports our company objectives. As a key partner to Marketing leaders, you will act as a liaison between Marketing and the wider GTM teams, including Sales, GTM Strategy & Planning, and Financial Planning teams.
* In this role you will be required to meet our goals of supporting & optimizing all operations & technology to enable effective marketing at BrowserStack. This role will be a critical partner to the Marketing organisation for leading strategic planning and generating insights that drive Marketing performance.
* You will also conduct and support primary and secondary research projects and create relevant insights on market trends, market sizing, market forecasting, company bench- marking, customer needs, and competition that inform product, customer, and go-to-market strategies.

**What Will You Do?**

* Analyse unstructured, ambiguous and complex challenges facing the organisation making judicious use of qualitative and quantitative data; gather insights, define problems and identify underlying opportunities.
* Make compelling recommendations; develop a tactical plan to execute and translate them into results.
* Design and execute best-in-class quantitative and qualitative research to support decision-making, and strategic planning and shape marketing/brand strategies, campaign development, and product/solutions development
* Develop, implement, and maintain account intelligence strategies to identify profiitable, high-potential accounts, and garnish and retain customer base.
* Strategic Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of market trends, industry developments, and competitive landscapes to provide valuable insights that inform our corporate Strategy and executive decision-making.
* Data-driven Insights: Utilise data analytics and business intelligence tools to extract meaningful insights from various data sources, enabling informed strategic choices at the executive level.
* Market Opportunities: Identify new market opportunities and emerging trends that align with the organization's goals, enabling proactive decision-making to capitaliize on these opportunities.
* Competitive Intelligence: Monitor and analyse competitor activities, market positioning, and product offerings to help the organisation maintain a competitive edge.
* Marketing Database Hygiene: Should be able to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured marketing database/information for maintaining data accuracy by conducting regular data checks/cleansing and should also work on collecting and populating the accurate info for all the missing fields using secondary research, data mining and profile techniques
* Integrate data from multiple sources into a unified intelligence platform, and adjust database management to reflect changes, including adding new contacts and correcting inaccuracies
* CRM Tool Handling (Salesforce) – Detailed understanding/exp working on salesforce tool is a plus, end to end handling of Salesforce CRM tool. Conducting quality checks for the data/information collected by the team members before up- loading into salesforce. Preparing reports to ensure all the data is correctly mapped and accurate.
* Own the account, contact and lead enrichment activities along with its reporting and insights

**Desired Experience**

* 6 - 8 years of experience, with a minimum of 5 years in Strategy or Management Consulting, preferably with a leading global consulting firm or in a high-impact Corporate Strategy role within a leading B2B SaaS or technology company.
* At least 5 years experience in Marketing/Sales Strategy, Research roles for Marketing/Sales teams, using secondary and tertiary research methods.
* Must have exposure in SQL to create reports, analyses & insights Knowledge of working with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo,Rocket Reach, Lusha, Traxcn, etc.
* Proven experience in working with ICP identification across different segments and product portfolios.
* Advanced ability to analyze data and summarize information from multiple sources, including large and complex data sets to perform market, industry, financial and economic analyses. Structured thinking, strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* Proficient in analytics and be able to develop actionable insights using data. Be able to multitask, prioritize, rapidly iterate, and manage communications with different functions in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Excellent project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, often with non-congruent timelines.
* An MBA from a class A institution and an IIT or technology qualification will be a strong plus.

**Benefits**
In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:

title: Vice President - Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply and Ad Products, Digital
description:
**Job Summary**
As the Vice President – Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply & Ad Products, you will lead the end-to-end monetization strategy and product innovation for JioHotstar’s Digital Entertainment Ads business. The role will drive revenue growth through strategic pricing, supply planning, yield optimization, programmatic partnerships and the development of scalable advertising solutions.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of product, technology, sales and monetization, translating market opportunities and advertiser needs into innovative ad products and commercially impactful solutions.
  
  
**About The Team**
JioHotstar, under the JioStar umbrella, is India’s leading streaming platform, bringing together premium video content, live sports and entertainment at scale.
  
  
The Entertainment Product & Revenue Strategy (PRS) function plays a critical role in shaping the monetization of entertainment content. The team is responsible for pricing and packaging ad inventory, optimizing yield, strengthening supply architecture and introducing innovative advertising solutions that drive sustainable revenue growth for JioHotstar and deliver on customers changing objectives.
  
  
The function works closely with Product, Engineering, Ad Operations, Business Intelligence and Sales teams to build scalable solutions and strengthen JioHotstar’s position in the digital advertising ecosystem.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monetization, Pricing & Supply Strategy
* Lead the pricing, planning and monetization strategy for the Digital Entertainment Ads business.
* Drive supply planning, inventory optimization and yield management to maximize revenue potential.
* Develop pricing frameworks, packaging strategies and commercial propositions aligned with advertiser needs and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve monetization across devices, formats, audiences and content environments.
* Ad Product Innovation & Roadmap
* Own the roadmap for advertising offerings across devices and platforms, ensuring JioHotstar’s ad solutions remain competitive and future-ready.
* Drive the development and launch of innovative ad products, formats, targeting capabilities and advertising experiences.
* Translate market trends, advertiser requirements and business opportunities into scalable product initiatives.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to define priorities, manage dependencies and ensure timely execution.
* Programmatic Monetization & AdTech Partnerships
* Drive programmatic monetization strategy, including partnerships across DSPs, SSPs, exchanges and other ecosystem participants.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen programmatic yield, supply access and private marketplace offerings.
* Evaluate and enable new advertising technologies, monetization models and ecosystem partnerships.
* Ensure alignment between programmatic initiatives, commercial objectives and operational capabilities.
* Cross-Functional Execution
* Lead a high-performing team of individual contributors driving ad technology and product initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI teams to deliver business-critical initiatives.
* Coordinate pilots, A/B testing, feedback loops and phased rollouts to validate solutions before scaling.
* Proactively identify risks, resolve execution roadblocks and ensure effective stakeholder alignment.
* Sales Enablement & Commercial Solutions
* Partner with Sales teams to develop and commercialize packaged propositions, custom solutions and strategic advertising offerings.
* Support strategic deals by translating product capabilities into compelling advertiser solutions.
* Work with relevant teams to resolve initial technology or implementation challenges and ensure smooth adoption.
* Enable Sales teams with clear positioning, product understanding and commercial use cases.
* Leadership & Governance
* Provide concise and structured updates to senior leadership on program progress, key decisions, dependencies and risks.
* Establish effective governance mechanisms to track priorities, milestones and business outcomes.
* Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration and execution excellence within the team.
* Influence senior stakeholders across business, product and technology functions to drive outcomes in a complex and evolving environment.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline with 12–15 years of experience in digital media, AdTech, programmatic advertising, product strategy, monetization, pricing or revenue strategy roles or management consulting experience.
* Strong people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:

○ Ad product development and innovation
  
  
○ Pricing and packaging
  
  
○ Programmatic monetization
  
  
○ Yield and inventory management
  
  
○ New advertising formats and experiences
  
  

* Deep understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, header bidding, private marketplaces and targeting will be preferred.
* Experience in digital video advertising, connected TV, streaming platforms or entertainment monetization will be an advantage.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate product and monetization levers into measurable revenue impact.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Structured problem-solving approach, strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational rigour.

**Job Description**

**About the Role**

As a **Senior Manager — Performance Marketing** within our autonomous, geography-focused business unit, you will serve as a primary engine of execution and revenue generation. We do not look for traditional executors; we seek Growth Architects — professionals who view regional business, platform operations and marketing through the lens of data and first-principles thinking.

Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.

**Purpose of the Role**

To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested and scaled.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. First-Principles Growth & Execution**

* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.

* Plan, execute and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.

* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.

**2. New User Acquisition, App Installs & Product Sales**

* Own end-to-end acquisition strategy across Google (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube, App campaigns), Meta (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns), Apple Search Ads and programmatic channels.

* Drive app install volume and quality — managing CPI, install-to-purchase conversion rates and post-install engagement metrics using Branch and internal measurement for attribution.

* Scale new-to-platform customer acquisition while maintaining or improving CAC targets; continuously optimize channel mix based on cost-per-retained-customer, not just cost-per-install.

* Build and manage audience strategies — lookalike models, custom audiences, interest-based targeting and broad prospecting. With structured testing to identify high-value acquisition segments.

* Identify and eliminate fraud, low-quality installs and attribution gaming across app install channels.

* Drive product-level sales performance through paid channels. Structuring campaigns around hero SKUs, new launches, category pushes and seasonal sale events.

* Own Shopping and catalog campaign architecture,product feed optimization, Merchant Center management, product set segmentation and dynamic product ad performance.

* Plan and execute media strategy for 10–15 major sale events per year (pre-sale, during-sale, post-sale), managing traffic spikes while protecting CPA and ROAS targets.

* Build performance frameworks that connect ad spend to actual product economics — contribution margin, ROAS adjusted for returns and true cost-per-profitable-order.

**3. Budget Management, Performance Analytics & Platform Health**

* Make weekly budget allocation decisions across channels based on performance data. Reallocate aggressively from underperforming channels to high-efficiency opportunities.

* Set and track acquisition KPIs: CAC, CPI, Cost per First Purchase, D30 Repurchase Rate by acquisition channel, ROAS, contribution margin adjusted ROAS and new customer percentage.

* Present weekly and monthly performance reviews to leadership with clear diagnosis, not just reporting explain why metrics moved and what you're doing about it.

* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.

* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting and activation decisions.

* Maintain strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.

**4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Supply Operations**

* Partner with the creative team to build a structured testing pipeline — brief creative assets, define testing hypotheses and measure creative impact on acquisition efficiency.

* Coordinate with product and analytics teams on conversion tracking, attribution setup and measurement infrastructure — own the accuracy of the data you're optimizing against.

* Collaborate with category and supply chain teams to align campaign intensity with inventory availability avoid promoting products that are out of stock or overpromoting SKUs that create downstream inventory problems.

* Collaborate with the category team on pricing, promotions and assortment decisions that affect campaign performance ensuring marketing investments align with margin targets, not just volume goals.

* Design and execute high velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.

* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**What You'll Be Measured On**

**Primary Metrics**

Cost per First-Time Customer: What we pay to acquire a new buyer, tracked by channel

App Install Volume & Quality: Install count, install-to-purchase rate, post-install engagement

New Customer GMV Contribution:Revenue generated specifically by first-time buyers

Channel-Level ROAS: Return on ad spend adjusted for returns and product margins

D30 Repurchase Rate: Share of acquired customers who buy again within 30 days, by channel

**Secondary Metrics**

First-Order AOV by Channel: Average basket size of new customers from each acquisition source

New vs. Returning Customer Mix: Share of orders from first-timers vs. repeat buyers

Creative Testing Velocity: Number of creative hypotheses tested per week and win rate

Campaign Contribution Margin: Profit per order after ad cost, COGS and fulfillment

**What we won't measure you on:** vanity install numbers without quality filters, platform-reported ROAS without backend validation or total order count without customer quality context.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech./B.E. from an IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institute, or an equivalent degree with a strong quantitative and analytical focus.

* MBA from a Tier-1 business school is preferred but not mandatory.

**Experience & Competencies**

* 7+ years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech or data/business analytics.

* The Engineer Mindset: Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.

* Hands-on expertise running Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax, App campaigns) and Meta Ads (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns) at meaningful budgets.

* Proven experience driving app installs at scale while maintaining install-to-purchase conversion and post-install quality metrics.

* Strong understanding of product feed management, Merchant Center and catalog ad optimization for e-commerce.

* Technical Savvy: Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.

* Cross-Functional Fluency: Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain and central product environments.

* Ownership You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.

* Track record of managing sale events and promotional campaigns with measurable GMV impact.

**Preference**

* Experience in beauty, personal care, health, or FMCG categories — understanding of repurchase cycles, seasonal patterns and how beauty consumers discover and buy products online.

* Familiarity with incrementality testing — geo-holdouts, channel-off tests, or lift studies to measure true campaign impact.

* Experience with mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust) — setting up attribution, measuring post-install events and identifying fraud.

* Experience with AI-driven campaign tools (PMax, Advantage+, AI-generated creative) and a clear point of view on where automation helps and where it doesn't.

**Good to Have**

* Prior regional, hyperlocal, or category management experience within quick commerce, marketplace, or hyper-growth consumer apps.

* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.

* Experience with non-biddable channels — affiliate marketing, influencer performance campaigns, programmatic direct deals.

* Knowledge of CPAS (Collaborative Performance Advertising) or similar marketplace-brand collaborative ad products.

* SQL proficiency for pulling and analysing acquisition cohort data independently.

* Experience building or managing a small performance marketing team (2–5 members).

With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

The ideal candidate should have an established professional network, understand how projects are conceived and commissioned, and know how to connect Offish with developers, operators, creative directors, consultants, and project decision-makers.

* Develop opportunities for animatronics, themed attractions, sculptures, immersive environments, museums, interactive exhibits, and custom fabrication.

* Follow up on enquiries, negotiate commercial terms, and help close projects.
* Maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.

**4. Market Intelligence & Growth**

* Track upcoming projects, investments, developments, and tenders in the entertainment and attractions sectors.
* Identify new markets and services that align with Offish's creative and technical capabilities.
* Provide insights into competitors, industry trends, project budgets, and procurement processes.
* Help position Offish as a preferred design and fabrication partner for themed entertainment and experiential projects.

* 5–12 years of relevant business development, sales, partnerships, or project acquisition experience.
* Previous experience in the amusement, theme park, entertainment, attractions, experiential design, museum, or related industry.
* An established network of industry contacts and access to relevant decision-makers.

title: Structured Lending Specialist
description:
#### **At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

#### **Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are seeking an experienced Structured Lending Specialist to support and enhance our structured lending services. This client-facing role focuses on margin lending, conducting preliminary risk analysis, and providing exceptional client service. The ideal candidate will act as a trusted liaison between clients and internal teams, ensuring efficient and smooth lending processes.

  

#### **Your AMINA To-Do List**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding structured lending solutions, including margin lending.
* Conduct preliminary risk assessments of client portfolios and analyze collateral quality to ensure compliance with bank policies and regulations.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including underwriting and risk management, to streamline loan processing and documentation.
* Monitor market trends, collateral valuations, and margin calls, and proactively communicate with clients about potential risks and actions required.
* Provide tailored solutions to meet client needs while adhering to bank policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all client interactions are well-documented and maintain confidentiality and accuracy in all communications.
* Assist in the preparation of loan proposals and credit summaries for internal review

#### **Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in structured lending, margin lending, or a related field within banking or financial services.
* Strong knowledge of margin lending processes, financial instruments, and collateral management.
* Experience in conducting preliminary risk analysis and understanding loan-to-value (LTV) ratios.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a client-focused mindset.
* Proficient in financial systems and tools with an ability to manage data accurately and efficiently.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple tasks and priorities.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).

#### **Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!**

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

Partner with businesses to ensure long term sustainable and profitable growth.

* Ability to develop high levels of credibility and forge positive professional relationships with subordinates, peers, and upper management are prerequisites to success in this position

title: Senior AI Enablement Manager
description:
**Shape the Future of AI-Driven Performance in Tissue**
At Valmet Tissue, we believe Artificial Intelligence will become a key enabler of growth, productivity, customer value, and operational excellence. We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented AI Enablement Lead to accelerate the adoption of AI across our organization.
  
  
This role will initially focus on Commercial Excellence, Sales, Service, and Business Analytics, where immediate opportunities exist to improve productivity, forecasting, customer engagement, opportunity management, and decision-making. Over time, the role will expand to support AI-driven transformation across Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, Manufacturing, and Business Support functions.
  
  
This is not solely a technical development role. Instead, we are seeking a business leader who can identify opportunities, drive adoption, lead change, and ensure that AI creates measurable value across the organization. This aligns with Valmet's business-led AI strategy, emphasizing value realization, adoption, capability building, and scalable implementation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Drive AI-enabled business transformation
  
  

* Develop and execute the Tissue AI enablement roadmap.
* Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve business performance.
* Build business cases and track realized value from AI initiatives.
* Prioritize and coordinate AI projects across functions.
* Promote scalable and reusable AI solutions across the organization.

Optimize commercial performance
  
  

* Improve sales productivity through AI-enabled tools and processes.
* Support opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, pricing, and proposal generation.
* Reduce manual administrative work and increase customer-facing time.
* Enhance installed-base monetization and customer insights.
* Drive data-driven decision-making across commercial teams.

Lead AI adoption & change
  
  

* Build and lead a network of AI Champions across Tissue.
* Deliver training, awareness programs, and practical AI workshops.
* Support leaders in redesigning processes and ways of working.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure successful adoption of AI capabilities throughout the organization.

Expand AI across functions
  
  
**As Adoption Matures, Support AI Initiatives In**

* Engineering and design productivity
* Supply chain planning and optimization
* Project execution
* Customer support and service operations
* Knowledge management
* Business support functions
* Performance management and analytics

Partner across the organization
  
  

* Act as the key interface between Tissue business teams and enterprise AI initiatives.
* Collaborate with IT, Digital, Data & Analytics, and process owners.
* Ensure AI solutions support business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Promote responsible and compliant use of AI technologies.

What success looks like
  
  

* Increased sales productivity and reduced administrative workload.
* Higher adoption of AI tools and capabilities.
* Improved forecast accuracy and commercial effectiveness.
* Measurable business value delivered through AI initiatives.
* Increased organizational AI capability and literacy.
* AI-enabled process improvements deployed across multiple functions.
* A growing portfolio of scalable use cases delivering sustainable business impact.

**Your profile**
You combine business acumen, transformation leadership, and a passion for technology-enabled improvement.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Transformation, Continuous Improvement, Digital Transformation, or related fields.
* Experience leading cross-functional change initiatives.
* Strong understanding of commercial processes and business performance drivers.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, automation, or digital technologies.
* Experience working in a global industrial or manufacturing environment is considered an advantage.

Personal characteristics
  
  

* Strategic and business-oriented mindset.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Curious and passionate about emerging technologies.
* Excellent communication and facilitation abilities.
* Ability to translate complex concepts into practical business solutions.
* Results-oriented with a strong focus on value realization.

**Why join Valmet Tissue?**
This is a unique opportunity to help define how AI will transform the future of Tissue. You will play a central role in building new capabilities, improving performance, and enabling our teams to work smarter and more effectively. Your work will influence how we serve customers, develop our people, and strengthen our competitiveness globally. Join us in shaping the next generation of AI-enabled business performance at Valmet Tissue.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Last day to apply is November 3, 2026. However, we work with ongoing selection, so don't wait with sending us your application.
  
  
***When everything works together***
***Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.***
***At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.***
***Join the team – and lead the way with us!***

title: Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services use our unique and proprietary data, technology, insights and expertise to deliver solutions that meet the needs of our customers. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.
  
  
Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.
  
  
Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases & agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the definition and execution of the AI product roadmap for Payment Performance Intelligence, contributing to strategy and investment discussions led by senior product leadership.
* Own delivery of assigned AI product areas end to end, from discovery and requirements through development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Help identify and validate high-value use cases for GenAI, chatbots, agentic services, predictive insights, and self-service analytics.
* Translate customer needs, market inputs, and business objectives into clear user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Work day to day with Data Science, Engineering, and Platform teams to groom the backlog, unblock dependencies, and maintain sprint velocity.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance partners to ensure products meet regulatory and responsible AI requirements.
* Recommend prioritization based on customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and effort, escalating trade-offs where needed.
* Define and track success metrics for owned features, reporting progress, risks, and adoption to stakeholders.
* Prepare and present roadmap updates, demos, and release communications to internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.
* Mentor junior product managers and associates, and contribute to improving agile practices and product documentation standards across the team.

**All About You**

* Solid experience in agile product management for analytics, data insights, AI-enabled, or financial services products.
* Working knowledge of GenAI use cases, predictive insights, self-service analytics, and the data foundations required to support them.
* Demonstrated ability to convert customer problems into requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience mentoring or guiding peers and junior team members is preferred; formal people management experience is not required.
* Highly organized and analytical, with strong attention to detail in backlog management and delivery tracking.
* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience required; technical background, payments experience, or product certification preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: GM - Multi Cloud Platform Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology leader to own and govern a diverse portfolio of technology products, multi-cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role combines Technology Portfolio Management, Strategic Account Management, Product Leadership, and Enterprise Transformation responsibilities to deliver business value, accelerate modernisation, enhance service excellence, and strengthen VOIS as a trusted strategic technology partner.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as the primary technology engagement lead between Vodafone markets and VOIS, collaborating with senior stakeholders including Product Managers, IT Leaders, Architects, Engineering Leaders, and CIO-level decision-makers. They will drive strategy, governance, cloud adoption, transformation programmes, and portfolio execution across complex technology environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and govern a portfolio of technology products, cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and transformation initiatives aligned to strategic business objectives.
* Lead strategy, governance, and lifecycle management of multi-cloud platforms across Azure, AWS, OCI, and future cloud service providers.
* Act as the primary engagement interface between Vodafone markets and VOIS, building trusted and collaborative stakeholder relationships.
* Lead multiple Agile delivery teams to achieve portfolio objectives, customer outcomes, and strategic priorities.
* Contribute to business growth by supporting pre-sales activities and identifying opportunities across existing and new customers.
* Drive enterprise-wide transformation, cloud migration, cloud adoption, platform engineering, automation, resilience, and operational excellence programmes.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate objectives into roadmaps, epics, features, and user stories.
* Champion SAFe Agile, Portfolio Management, DevOps, and modern engineering practices.
* Govern delivery performance, budgets, risks, dependencies, escalations, and stakeholder communications.
* Lead executive governance forums, service reviews, steering committees, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
* Identify opportunities to expand technology services and increase business value delivery

**Who You Are**

* Extensive experience in Technology Delivery, Product Management, Cloud, Infrastructure, Transformation, or Service Leadership roles.
* Strong programme management expertise delivering large-scale transformation initiatives across multiple teams and business functions.
* Proven experience leading cloud migration, cloud adoption, and modernisation programmes in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple Agile engineering teams within SAFe delivery models.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platform governance across Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, and related cloud ecosystems.
* Experience managing platform lifecycle, resilience, security, performance, and cost optimisation.
* Strong understanding of cloud financial management, cloud efficiency, and value realisation principles.
* Proven ability to influence and engage CIOs, Product Leaders, IT Heads, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience defining technology roadmaps, governance frameworks, investment priorities, and portfolio strategies.
* Strong capability in:
* Multi-cloud strategy and governance
* Growth planning
* Capacity planning
* Product and platform management

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to lead strategic, global-scale technology portfolios and transformation programmes.Exposure to senior executive stakeholders and enterprise technology leadership forums.Ability to influence cloud strategy, platform modernisation, and technology investment decisions.Opportunity to work across multiple markets, functions, and technology domains.A highly collaborative environment focused on innovation, customer value, and continuous improvement.Experience shaping the future direction of cloud, infrastructure, and platform services within a global organisation.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Advanced portfolio governance and strategic technology planning.Executive stakeholder management and strategic account leadership.Enterprise-scale cloud transformation and multi-cloud governance.SAFe Agile portfolio execution and large-scale delivery management.Cloud financial management, optimisation, and value realisation.Service excellence, resilience, and platform engineering best practices.Business growth identification and technology consulting capabilities.Enterprise transformation leadership across global teams and markets.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Description

**Your role**
-------------

Bring your curiosity to work as our next Digital Marketing Specialist. You will be part of our Brand Studio team reporting to Manager Digital Services. In this role, you will be responsible for setting up, implementing, and managing digital marketing campaigns. Digital marketing strategies are vital to our company's success, so your role will be crucial in helping us achieve our business goals and objectives. We expect you to bring experience and a strong passion for digital technologies and marketing channels. You will contribute directly to how we create high‑quality products and solutions for our customers.

**Your day-to-day**
-------------------

* Manage pay-per-click (PPC) campaigns across social media and search engines (Google, Bing).
* Conduct analysis and A/B testing to identify strong, relevant keyword searches to optimize campaign success.
* Create targeted campaigns, including writing ad copies and optimizing creatives.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to develop ad copies and creative content.
* Provide regular reports on performance metrics and insights.
* Analyse, monitor, and report on ROI for all PPC campaigns to respective stakeholders.
* Analyse, monitor, and report on competitors' PPC campaigns, including keywords being targeted.
* Stay up to date with market and technology-related developments.

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

* Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Digital Marketing Executive with hands-on experience in SEO/SEM, PPC, Social Media Advertising, Google Analytics, and CRM software.
* Degree in Marketing, Communications, or a relevant field, or an equivalent certification from a recognized institute.
* Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels and online marketing tools.
* Familiarity with web design and best practices in online marketing.
* Excellent time management and English communication skills.
* Previous experience working with agencies is a plus.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

What we expect from you

* An inquisitive mind that constantly challenges the status quo.
* A positive attitude and strong team player.
* Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

**Your compensation and benefits**
----------------------------------

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.

Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.

**Your job location**
---------------------

This role requires you to work on-site at our office in Pimple Saudagar, India (IN). You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration.

**Why it is great to work with us**
-----------------------------------

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

At Brand Studio, we are passionately invested in supporting our people to reach their full potential. We believe that when people feel at their best, they can do their best. We set high standards for our work and support each other to succeed. You will have the freedom to explore new ways of achieving excellence and carve your path to success.
  
Along the way, you will collaborate with optimistic, vibrant, and talented team members.

**Application process**
-----------------------

Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us:

title: E-COMMERCE ACCOUNTANT (FULL-TIME)
description:
E-COMMERCE ACCOUNTANT (FULL-TIME)

RIITEK | Kondhwa, Pune | On-site | Full-time

Marketplace Reconciliation **GST & TDS Compliance**  Profitability Reporting **Tally / Zoho Books**

-------------------------------------------------------------------

QUICK DETAILS

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Company RIITEK - fast-growing consumer-electronics company selling across

Amazon, Flipkart, D2C and other digital platforms

Position E-commerce Accountant

Employment Type Full-time

Location Kondhwa, Pune (on-site)

CTC Rs. \_\_\_\_ - \_\_\_\_ per month (based on experience and skills)

Experience 2-5 years in accounting; e-commerce accounting strongly preferred

Who can apply B.Com / M.Com / MBA-Finance; CA Inter or CA drop-outs welcome

Key requirement Hands-on marketplace settlement reconciliation + working knowledge

of GST & TDS, Tally / Zoho Books and advanced Excel

-------------------------------------------------------------------

ROLE OVERVIEW

-------------------------------------------------------------------

RIITEK is looking for a detail-oriented E-commerce Accountant who can own the

money side of a multi-channel online business. You will track every rupee from

order to settlement - across Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify and other channels -

reconcile marketplace payouts with the bank, keep GST and TDS filings clean, and

tell management which channel and which product is actually making money.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. If you enjoy large data sets,

spotting the Rs. 400 commission that shouldn't have been charged, and turning

messy marketplace reports into clear numbers, you'll do well here.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

-------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Bookkeeping & Accounting

- Record daily sales, refunds, chargebacks, cancellations and marketplace

settlements (Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify and others).

- Process purchase invoices, expense entries and vendor payments.

- Maintain accurate general ledger entries and month-end closing schedules.

2. Marketplace & Bank Reconciliation

- Reconcile marketplace settlement reports with bank statements and books.

- Verify commissions, closing fees, shipping charges, storage and removal

fees, TCS and returns - and flag every discrepancy.

- Track short payments, lost/damaged reimbursements and follow them up to

closure with the marketplace.

- Reconcile payment gateway (Razorpay / others) payouts for D2C orders.

3. Inventory & Cost Accounting (works with the warehouse team)

- Match stock movement, FBA/FBF transfers and returns with accounting records.

- Maintain landed cost, and support periodic physical stock reconciliation.

4. Compliance & Taxation

- Prepare data for and ensure timely GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and annual return filings.

- Handle TDS/TCS working, deduction and return support.

- Maintain audit-ready documentation for statutory filings and assessments.

5. Financial Reporting

- Prepare monthly P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statements.

- Build marketplace-wise and SKU-wise profitability reports (after ads,

fees, returns and shipping).

- Support management in budgeting, cash-flow planning and pricing decisions.

6. Coordination

- Work closely with operations, warehouse, purchase and marketing teams so

the books match what actually shipped.

- Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants and banks.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

REQUIRED SKILLS

-------------------------------------------------------------------

- Strong working knowledge of GST, TDS and Indian accounting standards.

- Practical experience with Tally (Prime), Zoho Books, QuickBooks or similar.

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, pivot tables,

conditional formulas; comfortable with 50,000+ row reports.

- Ability to reconcile large marketplace data sets accurately and on time.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; high attention to detail.

- Clear written and verbal communication for follow-ups with marketplaces

and vendors.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

-------------------------------------------------------------------

- Bachelor's / Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce

(CA / CA Inter preferred).

- 2-5 years of accounting experience, ideally with an e-commerce seller,

D2C brand or 3P marketplace aggregator.

- Hands-on with Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub and Shopify

reports and payment dashboards.

- Exposure to reconciliation tools / automation, or the ability to build

recurring reports yourself.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT WE OFFER

-------------------------------------------------------------------

- Competitive salary, reviewed on performance.

- Complete ownership of the finance function of a fast-growing brand.

- Direct exposure to founders and to how a multi-channel e-commerce

business actually runs.

- Room to grow into a Finance Lead / Manager role as the company scales.

title: Assistant Manager, Regulatory Sciences (Evergreen Position)
description:
**Job Description**

The person will be responsible for overseeing strategy relating to obtaining, managing and maintaining product Marketing Authorization’s and support Clinical Trial Authorization’s (where applicable) in line with business goals and legal requirements in partnership with above-country operational hubs. Under the guidance and supervision of line management, lead strategic regulatory activities for assigned products and markets, and contribute to the implementation and leadership of projects and building expertise within the cluster regulatory team and support line management to make decisions that require developing innovative solutions to resolve complex problems.

**Job Responsibilities**

***Deliver Regulatory Strategy and Advise Cross-Functional Teams:***

* In line with assigned product and country responsibilities, utilise regulatory expertise to develop and deliver optimal regulatory strategies and plans to support the achievement of country business goals for both licensed and development products for Oncology portfolio for India, all TAs for Indochina and non-vaccine portfolio for Brunei.
* Represent Regulatory on cross-functional product teams and provide strategic regulatory input to the commercial operating planning process.
* Facilitate cross-functional awareness and understanding of regulatory issues and environment, including
* ensuring teams understand the potential opportunities and constraints that the latest legislation/upcoming changes to legislation might create for their commercial activities.
* Keep cross-functional colleagues and key stakeholders informed of progress with regulatory submissions.
* Work with above country strategists to provide country input into Global and Regional regulatory strategies as required.

***Provide Regulatory Advice and Information to meet Customer and Cross-Divisional colleague requests******:***

* Use expert knowledge of national legislation, guidelines and regulatory environment to provide insightful responses to enquiries from cross-divisional Pfizer colleagues and indirect interactions with external customers.
* Advise on matters of compliance, national regulatory requirements and Pfizer regulatory policy.
* Use a variety of communication tools and techniques to present complex ideas.
* Anticipate potential objections and influence others.

***Manage New*** ***Registration/Marketing*** ***Authorization Applications*****:**

**National Applications**

* Coordinate pre-submission meetings and other National Regulatory Authority (NRA) engagements, such as national Scientific Advice Meetings.
* Devise and obtain endorsement for submission strategy and plan and partner with above-country operational hubs and above-country strategists to obtain new product licenses. Manage associated interactions and negotiations with NRAs.

***Manage Marketing Authorisation (MA) Variation Applications******:***

* Trigger locally driven submission demands (e.g. NRA queries and requests for local label updates).
* Input to assessing regulatory impact, agree filing strategy with other business functions as appropriate and participate in risk-based reviews with above-country hubs and communicate any locally triggered delays & risks impacting the submission/approval, to the above and in-country stakeholders.
* Work with above-country strategists and above-country operational hubs to supply country documentation/information for dossier build as applicable.
* Communicate NRA decisions to relevant internal stakeholders as applicable.

***Manage MA Renewal Applications******:***

* Agree filing strategy with relevant stakeholders as appropriate and participate in risk-based reviews of plans with above country hubs.

***Management of NRA queries******:***

* In partnership with above-country operational hubs and above-country strategists, respond to NRA queries.

***External Relationships*****:**

* Proactively take opportunities to develop or enhance working relationships with Regulatory Authorities and trade associations.
* Develop and enact appropriate influencing strategies in order to negotiate optimal outcomes for the business on product issues.
* Utilize knowledge of NRA’s expectations, ways of working etc to appropriately direct company strategy. Share updates and regulatory intelligence with colleagues.
* Seek authority advice/clarification if regulatory position is unclear and answers are not available through internal network.
* Respond to spontaneous requests from authorities promptly and accurately.
* Work with authorities if Pfizer position differs from authority position to obtain a better outcome for the business/patients.

***Clinical Trials*****:**

* Support the following strategic clinical development activities in partnership with national Regulatory Authorities, Above Country Regulatory Strategists and Clinical Trials Regulatory Strategy Execution (CTRSE) as applicable:
* Optimization of Clinical Development Plan (CDP) and Country Footprint.
* Communications with NRAs to clarify questions during assessment as required by CTRSE
* Support Regulatory Requirements Manager (RRM) updates for local Clinical Trial Applications (CTAs) and study conduct requirements.
* Participation in national CTA Trade Association working groups and advocacy activities.

 **Populate and Maintain Regulatory Databases:**

* Perform database entry and the document management for regulatory transactions undertaken by Country Regulatory Strategists, in line with global SOPs.

***Obtain NRA Approvals for Supply of Unlicensed Medicines (Named*** ***Patient/Compassionate*** ***Use)******:***

* Following a request from a prescriber and internal approval to proceed with supply of unlicensed Pfizer medicines to address unmet patient needs, facilitate NRA approval for supply/import via above country execution hub.

***Safeguard Compliance in the Management of Packaging and Prescribing Information Component updates******:***

* Via defined procedures notify relevant internal stakeholders of NRA approval of changes to packaging components and prescribing information and the timelines for associated implementation activities.
* Negotiate extensions to packaging artwork implementation with Regulatory Authorities when applicable.

***Devices******:***

* Support regulatory activities for the development and maintenance of medical devices if required.
* undefined***Contribute to Good Regulatory Practice (GRP)*** Adhere to relevant procedures and practices (SOPs, Job Aids and WIs) to ensure GRP is maintained.Help identify changes to business processes to improve them as necessary, including to reflect changes in regulations.Lead by example, guiding more junior colleagues in relation to best practice and required procedures.Through maintenance of regulatory activities in line with company procedures for own products, contribute to “inspection ready” state. ***Support Regulatory Group Development*****:** · Contribute to and support as necessary, the maintenance and development of the cluster/country Regulatory team through pro-active involvement and participation and in some instances, leading of special projects; e.g. development of new operating procedures.· Support drive towards Pfizer and GRS Vision and Values.Support development of regulatory colleagues by sharing relevant knowledge and experience.***Lead Personal Development and support coaching/mentoring of team members******:***Identify own training and development needs in discussion with Manager to ensure a broadening skill and knowledge base and to maximise/optimise career development and contribution to the business. Develop product and therapeutic area knowledge as needed, according to product responsibilities list. With support of Manager build on competency strengths and address any development areas. Act as a senior mentor/coach for less experienced colleagues. ***Regulatory Team Support*****:** Oversee any assigned contractors to achieve agreed objectives, with high quality outputs, and to identify and address training and development needs. Ensure any assigned contractors are supported and that they have a manageable workload through redistribution, prioritisation or outsourcing of work, as necessary, including planning of appropriate timelines and resource allocation. Include consideration of individual strengths when allocating project/product responsibilities. Ensure regulatory team members work effectively in a productive and well-motivated environment through providing ongoing coaching, mentoring, guidance and sharing of regulatory expertise. Regularly takes informal leadership role during Team meetings to facilitate agreements and move the team toward its goals. May take responsibility for a portion of the team’s milestones/deliverables.Support the recruitment of new staff as required. Ensure systems are in place and adhered to for optimal process efficiency.

title: Director, Marketing Management & Operations
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.
  
  

* Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins
* Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development
* Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
The Head of Marketing, India will lead the marketing strategy for HARMAN’s consumer audio portfolio, with a strong focus on JBL and Harman Kardon, driving both brand growth and business performance. The role is responsible for building impactful brand and trade marketing programs that strengthen market presence, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance long-term brand equity. This leader will drive integrated campaigns, product launches, and omnichannel marketing initiatives across retail, digital, and e-commerce platforms. Success in this role requires strong cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Product, Finance, eCommerce, and regional leadership teams, along with the ability to lead high-performing teams and agency partners in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Brand Strategy & Integrated Marketing:
* Define and execute a strong brand vision for JBL and Harman Kardon in India, aligning global positioning with local relevance to drive premiumization, scale, and category growth.
* Lead integrated omnichannel marketing and communications across digital, retail, PR, and influencer touchpoints, ensuring consistency and impact.
* Balance short-term commercial goals with long-term brand equity, creating emotional consumer connections that sustain market leadership.
* Trade Marketing & Channel Excellence
* Drive trade marketing strategies that accelerate sell-out across traditional retail, modern trade, e-commerce, and D2C.
* Deliver best-in-class retail execution through merchandising, in-store experience, and point-of-sale excellence.
* Partner closely with Sales and Product teams to execute 360° launch plans and optimize channel-specific programs and MDF investments for ROI.
* Financial Management & Performance Optimization
* Own marketing budget allocation with strong P&L understanding, ensuring investments are directed to highest-impact initiatives.
* Build and evaluate business cases with clear ROI frameworks and success metrics.
* Track, analyze, and optimize marketing performance against business, financial, and consumer KPIs.
* Cross-Functional Leadership & Market Intelligence
* Collaborate across Sales, Finance, Product, and global teams to align strategies and deliver business outcomes in a matrix organization.
* Translate market insights, consumer trends, and competitive intelligence into actionable strategies.
* Build and lead a high-performing team, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous capability development.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in marketing, brand management, or commercial roles within multinational environments, with a strong track record of building consumer brands and delivering business results; includes 5+ years of team leadership and talent development in matrix organizations aligned to global brand standards.
* Deep functional expertise across product and brand marketing, including successful end-to-end product launches, trade marketing, and channel development across retail and digital ecosystems, with a clear focus on driving sell-out and sustained brand equity.
* Strong financial acumen with solid understanding of P&L dynamics, ROI-driven marketing investments, and the ability to build credible business cases while balancing short-term revenue delivery with long-term strategic brand growth.
* Strategic and execution-focused leader with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing cross-functional teams (Sales, Finance, Product), navigating complex organizations, driving change, and quickly adapting to new markets, categories, and business challenges.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem-solving, and quality is expected.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Experience in consumer electronics (audio/headphones) or broader consumer-facing sectors like FMCG/durables, with strong brand marketing and Indian market understanding.
* Strong digital and eCommerce expertise, including deep familiarity with India’s digital landscape, consumer behaviour, and agency-led creative development.
* Bilingual proficiency (English & Hindi) with ability to operate effectively across diverse stakeholders and market contexts.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Things To Know**

* Willingness to travel domestically within India and internationally as required (including regional meetings, global conferences, and customer visits).
* Legal right to work in India.
* Based in or willing to relocate to a major metro location (Mumbai, Delhi NCR, or Bangalore preferred).

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others).
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs.
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
* Tuition reimbursement support.
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available.
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development.

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
  
  
HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. **Company:** Salt Attire  
**Department:** E-commerce  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana
