**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Salt Attire

Salt Attire is a fashion and apparel brand focused on delivering contemporary styles and quality products. We are looking for a result-oriented Key Account Manager – E-commerce to manage our online marketplace accounts, drive sales growth, and strengthen our brand presence across e-commerce platforms.

Job Summary

The Key Account Manager will be responsible for managing and growing Salt Attire’s business across online marketplaces such as Myntra, Ajio, Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant platforms. The role involves account management, sales planning, inventory coordination, promotional activities, business analysis, and ensuring smooth day-to-day marketplace operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Marketplace Account Management**

* Manage day-to-day operations and business relationships across **Amazon**, **Flipkart**, and other e-commerce platforms.
* Act as the primary point of contact for marketplace account managers and category teams.
* Ensure timely product listings, catalog updates, pricing changes, and promotional submissions.
* Maintain strong relationships with marketplace partners to identify business growth opportunities.

**2. Sales & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute strategies to achieve monthly and annual sales targets.
* Monitor GMV, net sales, conversion rates, average selling price (ASP), and other key business metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, product visibility, and brand positioning.
* Plan and execute platform-specific campaigns, sales events, and promotional activities.

**3. Inventory & Catalogue Management**

* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure stock availability and timely replenishment.
* Monitor inventory ageing, stock-outs, sell-through, and product performance.
* Ensure accurate product descriptions, images, pricing, sizes, and catalogue information.
* Coordinate with merchandising and warehouse teams for smooth order fulfilment.

**4. Performance Analysis & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and performance reports.
* Analyse sales trends, category performance, returns, cancellations, and profitability.
* Track marketplace commissions, discounts, marketing spends, and account profitability.
* Recommend action plans based on data analysis and business performance.

**5. Marketing & Promotions**

* Coordinate with marketplace teams for campaign participation, visibility placements, and promotional offers.
* Work with the marketing team to improve product discoverability and online brand visibility.
* Evaluate campaign performance and optimise promotional investments.

**6. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with merchandising, design, warehouse, finance, and marketing teams.
* Coordinate with finance teams for marketplace settlements, payment reconciliation, debit notes, and claims.
* Resolve operational issues related to orders, returns, inventory, and account performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree .
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in e-commerce account management, preferably in fashion or apparel.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon, Flipkart, or similar marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of marketplace operations, sales planning, inventory management, and commercial negotiations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, data analysis, and sales reporting.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple marketplace accounts and meet business targets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Growth in GMV and net sales.
* Improvement in sell-through and inventory turnover.
* Reduction in stock-outs, cancellations, and return rates.
* Improvement in product visibility and conversion rates.
* Marketplace profitability and timely reconciliation of payments.
* Timely and accurate catalogue and operational management.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience managing marketplace accounts for fashion, ethnic wear, women’s apparel, or lifestyle brands will be preferred. The ideal candidate should be commercially strong, data-driven, proactive, and capable of independently managing key e-commerce accounts while driving sustainable business growth.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sr VP, Head Enterprise Business
description: As the Sr. VP, Head Enterprise Business, you will own and scale IndiaMART’s Enterprise segment through its next growth curve. title: Program & Growth Manager – Innovation Lab (AI/ML Expertise)
description:
**About UniVisory**

UniVisory is a premium global education advisory helping ambitious high school students develop exceptional academic and extracurricular profiles for admission to the world's leading universities, including the Ivy League, Stanford, MIT and Oxbridge.

Our
**Innovation Lab**
enables students to transform original ideas into meaningful, validated innovations across AI/ML, robotics, engineering, entrepreneurship, business, economics, public policy and social impact.

We combine rigorous problem-solving, multidisciplinary mentorship, experimentation and real-world validation to help students create original work with measurable impact.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Program & Growth Manager**
to lead and scale UniVisory's Innovation Lab as an independent, revenue-generating business vertical.

This is a leadership role combining
**business growth, end-to-end program management and strong hands-on AI/ML expertise**
.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience growing a business or program, managing complex operations and developing or evaluating meaningful AI/ML applications.

You will work closely with engineering, robotics and other specialist mentors while taking ownership of the Lab's commercial performance, student experience and innovation outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Growth & Revenue**

* Own annual and quarterly revenue, enrolment and growth targets.
* Drive B2C enrolments through consultative selling, webinars, workshops, referrals and digital marketing initiatives.
* Develop B2B partnerships with schools, educational institutions and innovation ecosystems.
* Build and manage the lead-to-enrolment pipeline, improving conversion and customer acquisition efficiency.
* Develop program offerings, pricing strategies and new growth opportunities.
* Monitor revenue, profitability and key business performance metrics.

**2. Program Management & Operations**

* Own the complete student journey, from onboarding and innovation strategy to final outcomes.
* Manage multiple concurrent innovation projects across different disciplines.
* Recruit, onboard, coordinate and evaluate specialist mentors.
* Establish project milestones, quality standards, progress reviews and delivery timelines.
* Manage student and parent communication, expectations and escalations.
* Oversee competition strategy, eligibility, submissions and external validation opportunities.
* Build scalable operating processes, dashboards, reporting systems and mentor management frameworks.
* Ensure projects demonstrate originality, technical rigor, student ownership and measurable outcomes.

**3. AI/ML Expertise & Innovation**

* Apply hands-on AI/ML expertise to evaluate and guide student innovations.
* Support projects involving machine learning, predictive modelling, computer vision, natural language processing and intelligent applications.
* Assess problem formulation, datasets, algorithms, model selection, benchmarks and evaluation methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering and robotics specialists on multidisciplinary innovations.
* Identify meaningful applications of AI and data science in business, economics, finance, public policy, sustainability and social innovation.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, novelty, scalability and real-world relevance of proposed innovations.
* Support students in developing credible demonstrations, technical documentation and evidence of impact.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* 2–5 years of relevant professional experience in technology, EdTech, innovation programs, startups, incubation or program management.
* Demonstrated ownership of revenue, enrolments, business development or commercial growth targets.
* Proven ability to manage programs end-to-end, including people, budgets, timelines and outcomes.
* Strong hands-on AI/ML experience, including developing, implementing and evaluating machine-learning models or applications.
* Working proficiency in Python and relevant ML frameworks.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, consultative selling and leadership skills.
* Strong entrepreneurial mindset, analytical thinking, initiative and accountability.

**Preferred**

* B.Tech/BE or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering or a related discipline; MBA is an advantage.
* Experience building or scaling education, technology or innovation programs.
* Exposure to competitions such as IRIS, Regeneron ISEF, Conrad Challenge, Diamond Challenge or similar innovation initiatives.
* Familiarity with robotics, IoT, embedded systems or engineering prototypes.
* Experience mentoring high school or undergraduate students.
* Experience working with premium education customers, schools or institutional partners.

**Why Join UniVisory?**

* Lead and scale a multidisciplinary innovation vertical with meaningful commercial ownership.
* Work at the intersection of AI, technology, entrepreneurship, education and real-world problem-solving.
* Collaborate with experienced technical mentors and ambitious young innovators.
* Build innovative programs with opportunities for national and international growth.
* Take ownership of business performance, operational excellence and meaningful student outcomes.

**We are looking for someone who combines the commercial mindset of a business builder, the execution discipline of a program leader and the technical credibility of an AI/ML practitioner.**

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume.

Please highlight:

1. A business, program or revenue growth initiative you personally led, including measurable results.
2. An AI/ML project or application you personally developed, implemented or evaluated.

title: Head of Marketplaces
description:
**Head of Marketplaces**

Location: Delhi NCR | Work from office

Experience: 5 to 8 years

Reports to: Founder

Direct reports: Quick Commerce Operations Manager, Flipkart Account Manager

Compensation: Rs 9.6 to 18 LPA, fixed

**About TNT**

TNT (The Next Trend) is a manufacturer of home utility products: steel cloth-drying stands, step ladders, shoe racks and multi-tier organisers. We have manufactured in India for 15 years and sell 30+ SKUs through quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Big Basket), Amazon, Flipkart, modern trade (DMart) and a pan-India distributor network. We own our manufacturing, which gives this role direct control over cost, assortment and supply.

**About the role**

The Head of Marketplaces owns the online marketplace P&L across Amazon, Flipkart and quick commerce. You will personally manage the Amazon account on Vendor Central and lead the two managers who run quick commerce and Flipkart. This is a hands-on leadership position, not a supervisory one.

**Responsibilities**

**Amazon (personally managed)**

* Own the Vendor Central relationship: cost price and PO negotiations, terms, allowances and annual agreements.
* Maintain a complete, accurate catalogue, A+ content and advertising within agreed efficiency targets.
* Track the vendor scorecard, dispute chargebacks and recover approved but unpaid invoices.
* Deliver a written 1P versus 3P recommendation for the account within 90 days.

**Quick commerce and Flipkart (through the team)**

* Set the commercial plan for Blinkit, Zepto, Big Basket and Flipkart: assortment, pricing, city-level priorities, fees, replenishment and advertising.
* Agree targets with both managers, review weekly and remove blockers.

**P&L and reporting**

* Own revenue and contribution margin by platform, after commission, storage and ageing fees, advertising, returns and freight.
* Maintain pricing discipline so that no platform undercuts another without approval.
* Submit a weekly one-page brief and a monthly P&L by platform, reconciled to actual payouts.

**Key performance indicators**

* Amazon revenue growth and contribution margin
* Catalogue health and PO fill rate
* Advertising efficiency (TACOS) by platform
* Accuracy and timeliness of the weekly brief and monthly P&L
* Delivery of the quick commerce and Flipkart targets agreed with the team

**Requirements**

* 5 to 8 years in marketplace or key account management on the brand side, with at least 2 years across more than one platform.
* Hands-on Amazon Vendor Central experience, including PO, cost price and chargeback processes. Mandatory.
* Ownership of a multi-platform P&L, not only a revenue or GMV target.
* Brand-side experience on at least one quick commerce platform.
* Experience managing a team.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets; able to build your own trackers and reconciliations.
* Clear, concise written reporting.

**Preferred**

* Category experience in home, kitchen, hardware or furniture.
* Working knowledge of Flipkart Ads and quick commerce advertising tools.

**Compensation**

Rs 9.6 to 14 LPA fixed, with no variable component. Final offer based on experience and interview performance.

**To apply**

Apply through LinkedIn. Include one line on a marketplace account you have grown, with the number.

title: GTM / AI Automation Engineer
description:
***Role Overview***

The selected candidate will design, build, test, and maintain AI automation workflows for sales, marketing, lead generation, recruitment, and business operations. This is a hands-on technical role requiring practical problem-solving skills, an understanding of AI agents, and the ability to convert business requirements into working automation systems.

***Key Responsibilities***

1. AI Workflow Automation

· Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, Make, or Zapier.

· Connect applications and services to automate repetitive business tasks.

· Configure triggers, conditions, loops, data transformations, and error handling.

· Test and troubleshoot workflows to ensure reliable execution.

2. AI Agent Development

· Build AI-powered agents using Claude API, OpenAI API, and other LLM tools.

· Create prompt-based workflows, structured outputs, and tool-calling integrations.

· Develop AI workflows for lead research, qualification, content assistance, data extraction, and reporting.

· Implement human approval steps for sensitive or high-impact automated actions.

· Test AI-generated outputs for accuracy and consistency.

3. API Integration and Development

· Integrate third-party applications using REST APIs and webhooks.

· Work with JSON, API authentication, OAuth, and data mapping.

· Use Python or JavaScript for custom automation logic.

· Connect CRM platforms, databases, communication tools, and business applications.

· Debug API errors, authentication issues, and workflow failures.

4. GTM and Sales Automation

· Build automated workflows for B2B lead generation and qualification.

· Integrate tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, and approved prospecting platforms.

· Automate lead enrichment, CRM updates, follow-up tasks, and sales reporting.

· Support AI-powered account research and personalized outreach workflows.

· Maintain data quality and follow applicable privacy and communication requirements.

5. Testing and Maintenance

· Monitor workflow execution and resolve errors.

· Maintain documentation for workflows, integrations, and technical configurations.

· Optimize automation performance, API usage, and execution costs.

· Follow secure credential-management practices.

· Collaborate with team members to deliver projects on time.

***Required Technical Skills***

· 1–3 years of experience in workflow automation, software development, API integrations, or AI automation.

· Practical knowledge of n8n, Make, or Zapier.

· Experience using Claude API, OpenAI API, or similar LLM services.

· Basic to intermediate Python or JavaScript.

· Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and authentication.

· Knowledge of prompt engineering and AI workflow design.

· Strong debugging, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

***Good-to-have skills***

· Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho CRM.

· Familiarity with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and AI agent frameworks.

· Experience with PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, Slack, or Google Workspace integrations.

· Knowledge of Docker, cloud platforms, and workflow monitoring.

· Understanding of sales, marketing, and business process automation.

***Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)***

· Successful development and deployment of assigned automation workflows.

· Accuracy and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

· Reduction in repetitive manual tasks.

· Timely completion of development tasks.

· Number and quality of successfully deployed integrations.

· Reduction in workflow errors and recurring failures.

· Quality of documentation and troubleshooting.

Pay: ₹325,000.00 - ₹720,000.00 per year

title: Research Analyst
description:
**Job description:**

InvestMentor Securities Ltd. is a fast-growing and leading full-service stock broker in Gujarat. Supported by experienced research analysts, the company offers in-depth market analysis and research reports. Known for its advanced technology-driven approach, clients can trade conveniently using the user-friendly mobile app from anywhere. With a strong commitment to customer satisfaction, the company has established itself as a trusted name in the stock-broking industry, building a loyal client base.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented Equity Research Analyst with strong market understanding and analytical capabilities. The candidate will conduct in-depth analysis of stocks, sectors, derivatives and market trends, and provide actionable insights to drive investment decisions. The role also involves preparing research reports, creating content for investors, and engaging in client-facing communication.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct thorough research on stocks, sectors, F&O, and market trends.
* Analyses financial statements, balance sheets, sector data, market information, and economic indicators.
* Develop financial models and perform valuation analysis using industry-standard methods.
* Create and publish research reports, market insights, and investment recommendations.
* Prepare presentations, daily/weekly outlook reports, and investment cases.
* Stay updated with industry developments, global markets, and new research methodologies.
* Collaborate with the in-house research and advisory team on strategy building.
* Be comfortable in **making educational videos, daily market insights, and hosting webinars** for clients.
* Work with **algo strategy builders & third-party algo vendors**, and provide inputs for strategy development & back-testing.
* Track derivatives data (OI, PCR, rollovers, IV) and use it in market interpretation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, MBA, or a related field.
* Proven work experience in equity research, brokerage, wealth management, or investment banking.
* **Strong knowledge of F&O markets, derivatives, technical and fundamental analysis.**
* Experience working with **algo strategy builders / third-party algo vendors** (e.g., Tradetron, Algotest, Quantower, etc.)
* Ability to analyse and interpret charts, OI data, volume, and price action.
* Excellent analytical and communication skills — **must be comfortable speaking on camera and conducting webinars.**

· **Note**: NISM-Series-VIII: Equity Derivatives & NISM-Series-XV; Research Analyst Certification is MANDOTARY

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Experience:**

* Equity research: 1 year (Required)

**Location:**

* Ashram Road P.O, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Required)

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

* Are you currently based in Ahmedabad
* Do you have at least 1 year of professional experience in equity research, with strong knowledge of F&O, derivatives, technical analysis, and fundamental analysis?
* Do you hold both NISM-Series-VIII (Equity Derivatives) and NISM-Series-XV (Research Analyst) certifications?
